reviews.comment: I find his accent is over childlike. He is full of fun and shares just stories and examples but focuses less on the teaching resources. I suggest to choose someone else for real learning, he is good for grades only.

Professor Sherma was the greatest professor of all time. His lectures were great he used fun stories during lectures. The assignments due dates are flexible up until the end of the semester. Make sure to do the first drafts because he gives very good feedback. Class is attendance mandatory so don't skip. The class has very little to no homework
Prof Sherma gives many quizzes, yet u will end up earning good points at the end. He is kind to students.   I will take his 1302, too.
I am taking his summer II class. He is ready to give you extra time. He listens to your situations and extends due dates for you if you convince him. He is really a teacher to be admired....cool!
He gave me a good grade. He was flexibe last summer.
I took the professor's class last summer. He made us do class assignments during his lessons. No stress, no hard deadlines!
The professor is cool! He gave me extra credit for completing his course survey last summer! He is generous. His course is fun.
Dudes, if u wanna really hone ur writing, take his class. He makes y'll work harder and achieve good grades. If u don't value ur writing, then u have other options to chose from!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took his summer course (1301) last year. I got a good grade despite missing some classes. He wants us to be regualar in class. He gave us a moderate amount of tasks. I had fun.
He motivates us to read textbooks but he does not impose any rules on us. He is a tough grader but he gives u chances to revise ur work until it is acceptable for credits.

He always encourages students to read book and come to class prepared. Even if you do not manage your time to read in advance, it's okay. He engages every one in class discussions. Get ready to read slides and participate in discussions. I enjoyed his class..

He is a sympathetic grader. If you are a sincere student, he gives you extra credits and always inspires you to do your work on time. But his attendance policy is to motivate students to show up in class is amazing!!!

He was my favorite because if u r absent he's gonna send you courtesy emails and asks if u need any help. He talks a lot about his course policy but his course is flexible. More importantly, he is hardworking. His slides will help u most.

It was hard for me to familiarize myself with his accent and teaching earlier, but I picked everything later. He is helpful and professional. He is very much focused on quality, so he grades things tightly. But his class is worth attending. You will be a hardworking student!

The professor rescued me at the eleventh hour. I was gonna fail his course but I got extra credits from him for doing some extra work. He does his things very strictly. But you'll lean many things in his class. Had a stressful yet fun time toward the end. He is considerate!

The professor was amazing. He would mostly focus on assignments. Sometimes he'd share something that did not relate to the course. He'd bring humor into class. But he is a strict grader. It doesn't mean he takes off points from tasks. He also gives chances to revise our work.

He did make us do activities and listen to his lectures. He was a funny teachers. I liked his POP quizzes the most. But even if u were absent on the quiz day, you would be allowed to do it some other day. He respects students. Ha d agreat class with him!

Truly he is a non-native speaker, yet the man is a good teacher and well conversant with his pedagogy. I missed out on some assignments. But he extended due dates for me and those who asked him. He is caring and understanding. You will surely enjoy his class despite being a bit tough grader! Quality matters, friends!

This professor is a helpful man. He is willing to help you with your assignments after class. He surely has an attendance criteria, but he is considerate and flexible. I enjoyed his teaching and feedback.

Although he can be a strict-at-times professor, he can be goofy and humorous. He is passionate about teaching English and is respectful of culture differences among students. He gives detailed feedback and encourages his students to do better. Attendance is mandatory, but it genuinely helps your grade. Communicate with him and he will help you.
Would give out a grading rubric but would take off points for things outside of the rubric. Wasnt clear on instructions
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He is not a good professor. He talks about things that have nothing to do with the lesson. He makes the most straightforward assignments hard to understand.

GREAT TEACHER! As someone who hates writing Essays he made them feel so easy and honestly helped me better my writing/structure. Take his class! It's pretty easy just attend the class and do the work. I honestly wish students were more respectful towards him because he really is helpful. If he had a 1302 I definitely would take it.
He was so fun. He would sometimes repeat chapters; perhaps the man was trying to ensure that everyone got the lesson he delivered.

The professor is new, but he delivers his lessons through slides. In case someone has a hard time understanding his accent, the slides prove to be useful. He is strict because he expects quality work and hard work from students. He is awesome!
The professor comes from a different culture, yet he is doing good in a new cultural set-up. He is inspiring and strict about grading. You will learn a lot from this man.

The course structure was confusing, marked by the professor's lack of preparation, rigid teaching style, and stringent grading. Disrespect for diverse perspectives and unclear assignment instructions added to the challenges. professor expressing a belief that students should not expect to achieve an A+ because nobody is perfect.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Although attendance is "mandatory", Professor is actually very understanding and has even said that if a student didn't show up to any classes but does all the assignments on time and communicates with him they could still receive a good grade in the class. Does not hand out 100's easily. Struggles a bit with the culture difference.Expects Respect!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Boy oh boy where do I start.
He is not a good teacher. He doesn't know how to teach. He changes the rules of assignments without warning. He doesn't explain things well. He talks about pointless things for most of class. Doesn't respect his students. Grades very harshly, literally no one got a 100 on anything ever. Our entire class was miserable.

Only take this professor if you have mastered at least one coding language.  He gives labs and barely gives any helpful resources while the labs are worth a lot of your grade.  He always brings up the Latin roots of concept words and his lecture slides don't make a lot of sense most of the time
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's an easy professor for operating systems and the concepts and tests were not difficult at all. That being said, the labs had so little information on what they were expecting that it made it impossible to do everything correctly. I had to assume so many things about what was expected and he's no help either. Easy class if you know what to do.
The syllabus has no useful content basically. The course slides have nothing and is not helpful for revie wing. I don't understand why he is hired as a professor.

This professor was difficult to work with.  At times, grading criteria for assignments not clear.  The professor would ask vague questions during lecture and then critique all the answers we gave.  The TA mislead the class on when our last exam was, and the professor did nothing about it even after we all complained.

Syllabus barely has anything on there and any anything that is will not be followed, he changed the grade weights last week of semester made attendance and pop quizzes a thing after saying he would not...

Wants you to attend class where he whispers the entire lecture, notices not many show up to waste their time listening to mumbles, then last weeks of semester changes grade weights and have pop quizzes that lower your score by alot. Material easy, Professor the worst. If you do take him, dont even read the initial syllabus as he will not follow it.

Changed his grading scheme the last quarter of the semester without notifying the class through canvas. Said that quizzes would be "optional" and would be bonus points but turned it into 10% of our grade.
Made attendance 10% of our grade 12 weeks into the semester when initially it wasn't factored into our grade. Take somebody else

This is by far one of the worst professors I have taken at UTA. I could barely understand his lectures and he talks so slow it's hard to keep up with him. He's not very responsive when it comes to emails and everything feels extremely unorganized. His syllabus is literally two pages and doesn't mention anything but the grading criteria.
He teaches his class very clearly. He does not intend to make the material impossible. Take his class, if you are new and want to build your knowledge.

He is very quiet and he only reads off of slides, but he makes the content of exams and labs easy so i didn't have to stress too much on those and if you get any bad grade he has a few extra credit opportunity throughout the semester so you can make for it.

This is a great professor. He help students learn and understand every concept. Only negative is he is a bit quiet but he tries to bring a microphone to accommodate for that. His labs are easy and help learn the material and his exams are very easy he tries not to stress students
If you want to be ready for 4000 level course take this professor
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE OS with Jude. He teaches "theory" (aka nothing), The most technical we ever got is that "FTP stands for file transfer protocol". Take Hui Lu instead or listen to his lectures from the hall. Jude teaches a blow off of blow off classes. You will not be prepared for any higher level class if you take his class. Its a .5 course at best.

This is the easiest class Ive ever taken in chemistry. Her exams are 80% of the grade, discussion boards 19%, and homeworks are 1%? I didnt even do the homework and I got an easy A. It was kind of annoying how easy this class is because I didnt learn anything, but you can take this class for a free A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Cojima is very nice but her handwriting is not readable when we are doing notes. The exams were worth 80% of our grade and they were difficult because it contained concepts from physical chemistry. The homeworks and the discussion boards are worth the other 20%. She has an attitude and constantly gaslights her students about exam grades.

Professor Cjoima, was a professor with humor but let it be known the exams aren't a joke! Lectures are hard to understand, she expects you to already know the material, prior to her lectures, when asked question she replies "Were you not listening, that's not a good question" She is very humous so class is never dull! Overall Great Professor!

80% of the grade is one exam which is the final, 19% are discussion boards, and the assignments and homeworks are 1%. If you think you can just not do the homeworks she takes them into consideration for how active you are in class and she will take it off your grade. She also has pop quizzes about biology. She says they go hand in hand. She is kind

She is not a good professor. She does not listen to her students and does not have office hours. She jokes around but her exams are not reflective of her personality. Half of the exams does not make sense. She also teaches us physical & analytical chemistry. Don't ask her about research she will get mad. One rule: everything she says is right.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tests are 80% of the grade. If you ask a question, she yells at you since it is "easy". If you miss a lecture you are a few chapters behind. The majority of the assignments are homeworks but its only worth 1% of your lecture grade. The discussion boards are worth the other 19% but you can't write out the reactions. Overall, she's a great professor.

Love her! She is very generous with her late policy (only 10% per week deduction) and allows a few free extensions. Exams are deceptively difficult and requires good studying. learning objectives, while still great study material, could be a bit more specific. Its not insanely hard but definitely takes more effort than i did for an A.

Dr. Ravenscraft is my favorite professor!! She is very lenient with time restrictions and also very understanding. She is enthusiastic about what she teaches and that makes the course so enjoyable. She is available outside of class, either through email or her office hours. I highly recommend not only this course, but also this professor.

There isn't a more understanding professor out there. It's a tough course and you'll need to put in a lot of effort for an A. She is VERY generous when it comes to asking for extensions or even her late policy. There is a lot of extra credit opportunities in this class and each exam is slightly curved.

Dr. Ravenscraft is one of the sweetest people you'll know. Regarding EXAMS, there are no textbooks and everything you learn is from the lecture. She gives several extra credit opportunities (worth up to 8 points for one exam total) and slightly curves exams (for us, +6 points per exam). Her exams aren't a walk in the park and this isn't a free A.

Dr. Ravenscraft is one of the BEST professors in the department! Her lectures are very clear and easy to understand. She's ALWAYS willing to answer questions and is flexible w/ due dates. Exams are based off learning objectives given in each powerpoint. HW and projects are very doable and help you understand the course material better.

Dr. Ravenscraft is an amazing professor for Micro ecology and evolution! She is understanding and fair. Her class includes projects that are extremely fun and helpful. Her powerpoints are amazing and good study material for the test. This class is an easy A if you put in the effort!

She's nice and seems to enjoy teaching. But she does not follow her syllabus and adds assignments that were not included in the syllabus. Also if you miss her class you will 100% be lost. Even then if you do attend her class all the time chances are you will be lost anyways. There are no youtube videos or textbook that will assist you.

i never once wrote a review for a professor but she deserves it. Worst professors ive ever taken and cant stand her engligh its like unmarkatable tomato and she doesnt curve or anything i ended up with the class at a 79 and no one had enough time to even finish any of the exams when they were only 9 Qs. she expects u to just learn by yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Aroul might be the greatest professor of all time! She makes the class easy to understand, sets clear expectations of assignments and exams, and offers tons of extra credit opportunities. Believe me when I say that she wants her students to get an A in the class. I highly recommend her!

Highly suggest binging Shark Tank to be familiar with the concepts of this class. Prof Aroul is a very fair grader, and she makes it clear that the exam will only cover exactly what is taught in the lectures. The exams are on your computer (excel), you just can't use the internet, so download the lecture ppt's and your notes and you will be fine
She helped out so much, even though the course was departmental. If you follow her examples and study outside, you will be fine.

The professor cares about all her students! She helps prepare students the best she can for the departmental exams. This course is mandatory for most business majors and is percentile-based, which causes stress for students. If you pay attention to what the professor says and do your best to practice outside of class, you will be set!

Professor did her best to teach all of the material but lots of concepts and formulas to try to comprehend and she is restricted on grading criteria by the finance department. Goes over most of homework and all of topics in class. 3 tests that are similar to homework questions so study all of those for tests. Very accessible and willing to help.

Every bad review is just mad about the UTA Finance department being horrible, which it is. This professor does A LOT to try and balance the scales between her class and the department tho. Before every exam she gives really helpful reviews, and in class will literally go over the homework with us so we know how to do it. Best FINA Professor by far.

To start off FINA is difficult by itself. All work is designed by the district and they are not great at it.  Prof. Aroul however is amazing at helping you prepare/learn

Lectures: Great but do HW first then lecture
Attendance: Mandatory due to district
Homework: A lot but graded close to Exams
Exams: Horrible due to district's terrible design
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Finance in general is a hard class, especially because the department designs the curriculum and tests, which gives little to no freedom for the professors. Personally, Dr. Aroul was one of the most helpful professors at UTA. Her lectures help clear up any doubts in how to do homework and quizzes. She even sacrificed her time outside work to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Little late on the rating, but do not take her even if it's fitting your time slot... its not worth dropping middle of the semester... take any other professor or wait for the next semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor was great, very knowledgable, ratings do not reflect this because of the overall difficulty of the course. It's just a tough course and students suffer from the grading structure if they do poorly. All reading/assignments are done through canvas and this material is CRITICAL to success in the course. As a Finance major, it was an easy A.

Be careful! (3?) Exams are not multiple choice and any rounding errors will be considered incorrect - once you move on from a question, you can't go back. 
Grades by % of class, not individually.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Extremely challenging for no reason. Lot's of mini quizzes, waits till the very end of the semester to grade your spreadsheet assignments. Exam averages were always super low with no curve, and are extremely difficult for no reason. Doesn't explain the process of how to solve the problem very well. Trust me there are better options

Terrible Canvas management. Purchase code confirmation (which is reviewed manually) is a requirement to access material. Rather have students complete 30 separate 1 question quiz vs a single 30 question quiz. Exams are terrible. Average is always lower than 50%. Class material will not prepare you for the exams. Extremely rude condescending.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Hard class, professor doesn't explain things well. Gives no insight or reviews for the Exam, uses the excuse she doesn't know anything about the exams till last minute because it's departmentalized. Really strict grader for the spreadsheet work we have, never answers anything directly and instead answers questions with questions of her own. Rough!

Okay, so honestly this class is a disater for any major and we all have to take it. Its Incredibly hard and not finance newbie friendly. She tries her best but unfortunately she is one of those professors who are too smart for their own good and cannot pass that knowledge to their students. Anyways this class would be bad no matter who teaches it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is a tough class for all finance majors. Everyone has to take it anyways. Other instructors teach it  too. But professor Aroul is absolutely not helpful at ALL. She mostly always replies a question with another question. I would take with another instructor.

She's incredibly smart but definitely not the best teacher you'll ever have. Tests are very similar to the homework except for the final. The final is incredibly hard if you don't prepare way in advance. She goes over every problem on the homework and tests but does it really fast and her handwriting is difficult to read sometimes.

DO NOT TAKE HER. I DONT CARE IF HAPPENS TO FIT YOUR TIME SLOT AND YOU THINK "OH IT'S FINE BECAUSE I HAVE A REALLY EASY LOAD THIS SEMESTER." She LITERALLY does not teach.  YOU WILL REGRET AT THE END OF THE SEMESTER. WOULD NOT LEARN ANYTHING FROM LECTURES. JUST READ THE TEXT BOOK AND LEARN.
She has a hard time communicating the concepts to the class. She is a really bad teacher. I would advice to take different professor for this class.

This is a tough class for non-finance majors anyways. But Aroul is absolutely not helpful at ALL. She always replies with another question. Her style of teaching is good, but has no sense of the classes progress.
Group quizzes and only 2 tests. Everyone made an A in her course. Book not required.

Two quizzes that were encouraged to be done in a study group on your own time, mid-term, final, and TVM project is what your grade is based on.  She offers some extra credit.  She explained everything and would not move on until everybody's questions were answered.  I wish I could have taken her for finance classes.  Actual useful info learned!
Don't take this professor.
Good professor. Knows what she is doing. Takes a little long to update grades. Took two exams, a final and many quizzes. No hw. Did not need book. Good class!

Pretty easy if you take FINA 3313 first because when you come to TVM, you'll already know and that is pretty much the 2nd test. No textbook needed. Attendance is part of grade. Just go to class and take notes. Last test was take-home exam.

Very easy course! Would definitely recommend this teacher. No book,3 exams and she spends time going over the reviews which are almost the exact same as the tests! Easy B. would take her again if i could.

Three M/C tests with no comprehensive final. Also one TVM project that is easy but a little time consuming. Gives reviews very similar to the tests.  Do not need the book at all. Would definitely recommend her. If you do the reviews you should get an A in the class.
Awesome professor. You'll make an easy A if you do the review and do the extra credits. I would definitely take her again for any other classes.

LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE EVERYTHING ABOUT THIS TEACHER. She gives great reviews for the exams which are almost identical to the actual test. Curves a little bit and gives extra credits when needed. Do not need the book at all. Sometimes her style of teaching is a bit slow and hard to understand, but once you do the review, you're good to go. :D

In the college classes I have taken I have noticed there seem to be several professors that tend to reinvent the wheel so to speak in how their class is conducted. If this is your learning style you will probably like this class.
The instructor was very organized and clear as to what we need to know. Also she did various activities to facilitate our learning and I would definitely recommend her to any finance major.

I took this class hoping to learn something interesting. She covered everything that would be on her exams. She was reachable via email. Tests are manageable. Overall though the class was not that exciting.
Very good teaching. Easy A if you focus only on class notes and problem sets.

The class is hard but if you attend the classes and follow the review it is an easy A. She goes over all the material in detail and is very organized. I liked the various activities she did to facilitate learning.
Don't take this professor. She knows the material but she's not very good at teaching it clearly. Examples given in class are easier than test questions.

She stresses on understanding the concepts and repeats major ones over and over again.you will retain a lot after the class.There were 3 tests and final is not comprehensive!!But they are not multiple choice questions and so you have to work hard.But gives a great review before the test. Focus only on the notes and problem sets she gives in class.

Professor Peterson is by far one of the best lecturers in the nursing program. Her lectures give you 90% of what you need to know and she's pretty funny, it makes the 4 hour lecture easier to handle. Along with lecture, complete the guided readings with the recorded lectures, and watch the student success video for each exam, that's an A.

Peterson's really good at reminding students of upcoming deadlines and assignment expectations. The grading criteria and details were specific and I never received a bad grade on any of the discussions. It's LOTS of reading, textbook heavy, no slides, and the assignments take FOREVER though. It's 100% "fend for yourself," not ADHD friendly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: amazing professor. I recommend downloading the powerpoints before class and writing your notes while she teaches. Look at student success videos & blueprints before every exam! Vsims were pretty easy and very helpful for when you get to clinical. Overall great instructor her lectures are very resourceful!!

Professor Peterson explains the material decently, but don't expect the explanations to be relevant to the exams, even during a review session—like other professors, she seems to get a thrill from leading students toward the wrong answers. Regarding student interaction, she's nice, but not kind, often forgetting that she was once a student herself.

The quizzes were like a treasure hunt—except the treasure was nowhere to be found! The answers were so hard to locate, I felt like I was searching for a needle in a haystack. If you love playing detective with your textbooks, this professor's quizzes are the mystery you've been waiting for!

She encourages you to ask her for help or to clarify any class material you may have but gets bothered when you don't know the answer to a question she asked. Which is counterintuitive. She had trouble herself explaining what AVA was.

Hands-down my favorite professor ever. Her lectures are very informative. She lays out pretty clearly what you need to know for the exams. Before starting the class, I leaned more toward pediatrics, but now I'm on the OB side. Much easier than complex needs, but studying is still required for this class. Information is digestible, however. 10/10

Professor Peterson is awesome. I personally believe that she is the best teacher of the whole nursing program. She is very helpful and does a great job of explaining all the topics she teaches. Plus, her student success videos are amazing. I'm not even interested in OB nursing and I enjoyed the heck out of this class. 15/10 Thank you Prof Peterson!

OB was an easy class, print out the lecture notes to follow along and make notes, use student success it helps the class is not difficult will have some math formulas on every exam, overall easy class. Lecture was great but boring some of the prerecorded videos are an hr. long it's that or read the book the test questions are good no trickery.

I took him like 1-2 semesters ago… The only thing I can recall from my time in his class was him accusing us of cheating, and then making us take a test in person because of it. Way to go on stressing out a whole class by accusing them of cheating. Might as well say we were using AI to replicate ourselves in class…
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Dhaliwal for Brain and Behavior. His lectures were engaging but since it was 50 minute lectures 3x a week there was a lot of material to cover and not a lot of time. Read the textbook and attending SI sessions. 4 exams and 4 homework assignments , o studying for the exams is super important. He did give extra credit and curves.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is truly all about if you get a good group. Professor Dhaliwal gives you lots of creative freedom and is pretty clear on his expectations and deadlines. As long as you and your group communicates well you should be good. It's like he said, this will either be the easiest or hardest class you'll take; just depends on your group members!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Most lectures were just him reading off slides, and he struggled to answer questions clearly. He delegated much of the workload to TAs, causing confusion. There was constant miscommunication with TAs and students. He acts caring, he doesn't truly support students or foster meaningful academic connections.

Lectures can feel long sometimes. The homework is McGraw Hill, so it can take awhile to complete. The exams are fairly easy, but you do need to study. Most questions are scenario based and require more than just memorization of topics. He's a super nice professor who really enjoys psychology!

Took in Fall. Our class was the 1st to be given a research topic instead of choosing. Unclear instructions, prof reversed decisions, TAs had no answers, and groups had to redo work after being told there was a problem later. Prof wanted GPT to teach us, which made it worse—people trusted it, then got told it was wrong. Stressful, but easy enough A.

class is pretty easy, skipped like 5 lectures and still made an A. most of the questions on his tests are from the textbook so i'd recommend reading that but he also throws in some questions from his lectures. also given some extra credit opportunities as well. only thing i'd say is he talks quietly sometimes so i'd often doze off but he's cool

Currently in this class and I have noticed he is one of those professors that stick out from the rest. You can really tell he enjoys what he is doing and is passionate about the material he is teaching. Which in turn creates an enjoying easy to listen to lecture. Take this professor!

Professor Dhaliwal is a caring and helpful instructor who makes the material relatable to real-world situations. He sticks to the book, which makes studying for exams easier. Attendance is optional, but taking notes in class is enough to do well. Psychology isn't my major, but I really enjoyed this course!

Tough class, learned a lot, professor is very compassionate and was available to meet me for homework help. 
There are 4 exams and 4 homework assignments. Attending lectures helps (for C or B) but to get an A, I had to read the text book and review his slides. He does curve exams, which also helped me get an A.

For the lecture, he basically reads the textbook to the class. To succeed in his class, I suggest reading the textbook multiple times and studying the PowerPoints he posts. The tests are highly textbook-based. Attend lectures for the participation points, but don't expect to learn much in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor assigns random participation grades and gives extra credit for one of them. Homework is easy, but the exams are brutal. The provided “review” only covers general concepts and isn't very helpful. Exams are curved by 6 points, but scores remain low—I got a 46, and my friend got a 52 after the curve. Good luck!

This class is based on one research paper submitted in sections before all together. While instructions were clear in beginning I feel as if they got less clear as class went on. Often answered questions on how to do things with "Use ChatGPT". Which was not very helpful. He was very slow when it came to grading and giving feedback, even with 2 TAs.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Seems like information overload at first, but the lectures stick really well! The lectures and homework are very helpful when studying for exams. Really enjoyed the pacing!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Idk why he doesn't just require attendance, but if you don't go to lectures there are no resources available to help you and don't asking him a question about something you might've missed because he will be rude when answering. Lecture heavy and the slides are text on a white background for the most part, might as well just read the textbook
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It's a group project class. You get 1 group the whole semester to make an experiment and manuscript. If your groupmates are bad, you'll have a bad time. Prof was really nice and helpful though and gave extensions when he saw fit. Gave clear grading outlines in the beginning but not as much in the end but overall good. Took forever to grade though.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took Professor Dhaliwal's class in Fall 2021. His lectures weren't really beneficial to me as he would just ramble on and go off topic. I mostly relied on reading the book in order to learn the material. Exams are lockdown browser, but he gives attendance extra credit, 15 point EC review for final exam and some bits of EC to supplement the exams.

Pretty good prof overall. He gives a lot of extra credit throughout the semester, however you do have to purchase the book to actually do the homework. His 3 exams aren't too bad, and I'd recommend doing the "recharge" reviews in the textbook to study for those. Lectures also can draw on, but he does give five minute breaks pretty often.

Very good professor. He sometimes gives extra credit opportunities. Definitely need the textbook since you will need it to complete the homework. Attendance is not mandatory, but I would encourage to attend. I enjoyed this class, so yea, take him as a professor if you ever get the chance!
Honestly the best psychology professor ive ever had! if you get the chance TAKE HIM. hes very caring towards his students and will give out extra credit if the class ask for it!

He is very understanding and knows that many of us aren't planning to major in psychology. Purchasing the book and access code is mandatory to do the homework. It was a bit expensive like 98ish I think
