He tells you what will be on the exam but 50% of the time not on there. Do the homework and remember it because it will be on the test.
Although the class was very test and quiz heavy (almost every class) and the questions very tricky- Aranda himself is a kind person and very flexible to accommodate students.

I took Aranda last year for A&P I and they took my review off so here I am again to complain about this prof. He isn't passionate about what he does. He lectures in a dark room. Overall, lectures are a sad experience. I would rather eat a whole jar of toe nails than take this prof again.
Heavy class and exams can be tricky. But he tells you what to focus on. He can remember you if you come to class. Prepares you for future classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Aranda, is awesome! Caution though: read!! Do not memorize LEARN IT. It bites you again later. However, he is always available for extra help. Literally. Hes very helpful outside of class. His exams are scary! But if you learned it dont worry. Review ! Review ! Review! It comes back!! He does throw a few jokes to loosen the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Aranda is ABSOLUTELY TERRIBLE! If you want to learn, take someone else because aranda's inept. You seriously will not learn anything. Worst "professor" ever. He needs to be fired. I have no idea how he still has a job. Pay $5k for the semester to be read PPTs & he can't even read well. Don't expect a test review. Very boring. Save your time and $.

Great professor, very helpful. Attendance is mandatory, a ton of content but if you go to class material gets narrowed down significantly. A difficult course but very realistic if you study and show up to class. An A will not come easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Greatest Professor ever! Forensic Lab was fun. I've learned a lot in this lab. Wish they offer more courses with him in it. You can use your notes in quizzes and tests are take-home. Multiple options and free response, but do-able. Just make sure you have all your notes ready to use! You won't regret it. It's an advanced bio elective. Easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Aranda is actually quite a good professor, but doesn't have the best lectures. Very fair test and quiz questions. He is very helpful outside of class, by email and in his office hours. I self taught a lot of the class, but I also know people who went to lecture and did well too.  Definitely take him over Henry.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: It is very well possible to get an A in this class but you will need to put in a lot of hours studying. He has powerpoints that he just reads off but explains them more in depth. Going to class isn't mandatory but i would recommend it. To get an A in this class really know the ppts and do your best in Lab(he curves grade and get all the quiz points

Prof Aranda is a great professor. If you apply yourself to this course and dedicate a little bit of time a day to study then you will succeed. Attendance is not mandatory, but this is where you'll hear about his likes & dislikes on tests! You don't have to worry about class being boring because he keeps you entertained the whole time with his jokes

Aranda tried his best to help students out. He is a great professor! A&P is a hard class so if you didn't do well it's because you didn't study! I recommend for any UTA student to take Aranda. He cares about his students a lot. It was a very tough class but I was able to succeed thanks to him!

What do you guys expect from A&P? This isn't high school, so pre-read before class and attend his lectures. He provided a way for his students to earn extra points from quizzes online, which are straight from the book. Not timed. Don't be sour that you did not EARN a good grade in the class, instead be sour that you did not read and take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Aranda is a good person & tries to get to know his students. Anatomy is already a hard subject as it is but he doesn't make it any easier. Each chapter has parts A-D and each one contains around 80 slides. It's impossible to remember every single sentence/detail of the PowerPoints (which he just reads off from). He doesn't tell you what to focus on

Aranda is a great PERSON. He is nice and really makes an effort to get to know his students.... I am disappointed on how he teaches. He reads straight off the PPT, and says everything will be on the test. There's about 400 slides for each test. I've heard a lot of students going to Henry's lectures to understand the material better.

Aranda is great. He really cares about the success of his students and goes out of his way to accommodate for anything a student doesn't understand. The exams are hard, but this is a weed out class so keep that in mind. Also he introduced one of his TAs as a private tutor (Adam). He was super helpful and knowledgeable of the material.

He is a VERY caring professor and tries to get to know his students even though there are 200+ per lecture. For the lectures he just reads off of the power points but the reason everyone goes to class is because he will say stuff like "I like this", "This will be on the final" or "Memorize this word for word" etc. His tests are 100 questions timed.

Mr. Aranda is the most amazing professor ever. His tests are very fair and he makes sure that you understand the material well. If you have any questions, he will respond to your email as soon as he can.  Also, quizzes are fair if you pay attention in class. I definitely recommend taking his class!
Tough grader!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Looking at his old reviews I thought he would be good but I wouldn't choose him. Textbook and homework website changed this semester so maybe that's why. 5 chapters a test with about almost 400 slides per chapter. He does tell you what's important, aka everything. Didn't help really, you learn from yourself.

MOST AMAZING PROFESSOR!!! Seriously! His tests are extremely fair (as long as you study well). As long as you show up, he sets you up for success.  He is very understanding with any life issues that one may have.. as long as you keep in communication with him. He is hands down my most favorite professor I've had at UTA. Take him if you can.

Aranda is great. I knew the class would be hard, but I had no idea that it was going to be the hardest class I'd take in my 3 years of college. You must read the book and do the Orion assignments to be successful in the class (at least 300 questions each chapter).  It's a lot and very overwhelming, but the material itself is interesting.

I took him knowing how tough this course was going to be, but I couldn't stand him in lecture anymore. Only reads off of ppt so i stopped going to class after the first exam. Overall you can self study the materials and still get good grades on the exams. READ THE TEXTBOOK, do the online quizzes/hw as some of the questions appear on the exams!

I recently got a position in the Medical Field, and because of  Professor Aranda, I have so much knowledge on various conditions and structures of the body that have overlapped with my job. He is a very nice and an extremely helpful instructor. IT IS NOT EASY, but if you take it seriously you will be amazed at what you learn.I would take him again

Reads off powerpoints but tests are easy! Passes every single one of them with a 75 or higher. The quizzes taken on Wiley are some of the questions on the exams. Also homework grades are included in the exam grades so its a easy booster.

Does not teach at all, he reads off of PPT. Homeworks and quizzes are timed but online. Test are not as tough as Henry but need to study on your own for it. Would not take again. I showed up for class for the first 2 weeks and could not handle anymore after.

Aranda is a great professor!  Choose him over Henry!!!!!! Anatomy is a hard subject so there is no going around that.  The thing that I loved about him was that there was homework and quizzes that factored into your grade instead of just tests like the other professors.  I would highly suggest taking him over any other professor.

Xavier was a little tough when it came to his exams but he normalizes tests to help people out. He's there for you & responds quickly to his emails. Class requires alot of reading, attendance is a must because he does do quizzes randomly.
Reads off of the powerpoint and posts powerpoints...

He is not a good A&P professor at all! His lectures are full of "know this", "know that". He doesn't teach! He takes things personal, even though most of the issues are his fault. Do not take this professor if you are planning to have a stressful semester full of confusion and dealing with a butthurt professor. DO NOT TAKE!!

Lectures are thorough, precise, and engaging. write everything he writes and says to prepare for exams. If something is unclear ASK, he will answer any questions until the concept is understood. He's an easy going Prof. BUT grades reflect your effort and attention to detail. Professionally taught and enjoyable course I HIGHLY RECOMMEND, trust me.

Professor Aranda was VERY disorganized. He changed the syllabus almost weekly, will only spend 20-30 minutes on the 700 muscles in the body, and frequently uses the phase "I don't care about that" instead of explaining essential materials. Tests are really easy because they were online. Pay attention in lab since it's 35% of your final grade.

He is not a tough grader and not hard too. But his classes is kind of disorganized. Lab is super important. Because lab is extremely hard and it covers 35%, you can cover the lab grade with this one. Exam is online so don't have to stress that much. Overall I like the class and recommend...

Not only was he never prepared, he changed the syllabus so many times. I received a B and I did not do anything and I never went to class. I've heard hes awesome at Forensics but I took him for A&P and he had no idea what was going on. Best advice I can give you is read the book and do the online homework. Exams are online,  do not go to class.

Xavier is nice, easy going, & very helpful. Tests are very fair, partial credit on some answers, & daily quizzes. He pays attention to all the details in the lab. He knows a lot in the field of forensics. The class lacks organization a bit, and his TA adds to the confusion.  But I certainly recommend taking his classes. Attendance is key to succeed

This class is fun and you get hands on training. Mr. Aranda is helpful & knows his stuff. He is also kind and respectful and very humble. I strongly recommend taking his classes. He will make you study hard, but it definitely pays  Daily quizzes and set in stone midterm dates. Rigorous class however very rewarding. Tests are a bit tough inclusive

She's nice, but the instructions are insanely long-winded. The TA took points off for things that made no sense to me. The class is easy, but she does like to micro-manage the group project. There's a lot of extra credit, though. Overall not bad but the class was definitely set up in a frustrating way. The directions were harder than the content.

The professor is very nice and understanding, but the workload is heavy. There are many assignments, though they're open anytime and easy, so it's doable. The interview and final reflection were exhausting with long responses. She offers a lot of extra credit. Overall, she's good if you have no other option.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Corbitt doesn't assign any exams. Lots of homework but all easy and open. There is a group project that you have to do, pretty mid. Gotta research for the group project, you also have to conduct an interview. She grades really strictly, however her class was pretty easy. There are some discussions and you have to write a lot for it but not hard.

If you are a nursing major, just take Anthropology instead. Even though this class can be an easy A, the assignments are annoying and she is even more annoying. She says that she is going to take attendance "every so often," but she takes it every time. She is a tough grader on some things but not others. Take Anthropology or a different professor.

Professor Corbitt is one of the best professors I have ever studied from. She has sooo many extra credits and overall, her class is so fun. She is not at all a tough grader. There is a final group presentation but that too is super straightforward. Best of all, she brings chocolates and snacks every day to class for us (what else could I want).

Professor Corbitt was okay, but I don't blame her entirely for my experience with this class. There was a mandatory group project and I was placed with a group that never reached out. Corbitt did not really help this and at one point said I should've reached out sooner (I didn't know they were going to stop reaching out..)
She is very caring for her students. There is tons of extra credit, though, and there are a lot of assignments. There is no other professor for this class. Take her!!

Professor Corbitt was great, and I can tell she cares about her students. She gives a lot of extra credit, but there is one group project and interview project that you're going to have to do. There's a lot of quizzes for homework, but they have unlimited attempts. There's also a lot of reflection writing for homework. Overall, pretty easy class.

This class is an online class which made it an easy A. The professor meets online once every other week, but meetings are optional and just go over weekly assignments. She gives out lots of homework, but it will take you 30 mins max to complete for the week. There are no tests, and the final was a 1 page reflection paper.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The online class was definitely NOT online classing. It was very homework-heavy which I will admit was kind of easy, but the writing assignments were graded very hard. If you're going to take her pay attention to the rubrics because she's very picky. If you are taking this as an online class I would recommend going with another professor.

Mrs.Corbitts class is such an easy class for KINE 2350! DO NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK, IT IS NOT NEEDED!! ! Her quizzes have unlimited attempts, there is only one group project, one individual project, and has reflection papers. There are no exams. Easy class to pass if you follow rubric and do your work! Also provides ALOT of extra credit! 10/10 class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is the kind of professor that cares about her students. She offers a textbook for the class, so you don't pay. The assignments are not hard, discussion boards but they are time consuming. The website assignment seems hard but she helps you through it, brings research librarians to help you and explain tableau (will use for data visuals).

Professor Corbitt was a great professor for both epidemiology and informatics. I felt like she cared a lot about her students and made sure that they all understood the class material and assignments. She is very accessible outside of class and is very willing to lend a hand.

Having Professor Corbitt has been amazing this has been my third class taught by her. She is smart, resourceful, and charismatic .Professor Corbitt really cares about her students and helping them succeed.She gives us balance and answers any questions we have. She is one of the most memorable Professors in my time at UTA.

Professor Corbitt is such a caring professor to her students. She is also readily available to help if needed and usually responds within the hour. She really cares about her students succeeding and actually takes the time to explain concepts if you are having a difficult time understanding. 10/10 take her classes!!!

Professor Corbitt is awesome! She delivers materials that are easy for students who don't understand health informatics to understand. The course workload wasn't bad at all. We had a few discussions, short reflection papers, and a group OER project for the six-week course I just took.

Taking her class is an out of body experience… walking in there just to walk out 90 minutes later confused and frustrated. The few times you do leave confident in your ability to do the work don't worry the next class will surely leave you wondering where you went wrong. The class average is a 53 currently… save yourself….

Though this class was more on a self teaching basis, Aleks actually helped me a lot. If you study it's not that bad but I will say it is a lot of homework. There were quizzes every 2 weeks with LDB and exams were taken on Saturdays requiring LBD webcam from 6am-1pm. Professor Burt was very caring and helpful and also offers a lot of extra credit.

This class was HARD- The work load was INSANE! The LOCKDOWN BROWSER was invasive- Exams were only taken on a Saturday at 6am or 1pm! Its just Math! It should be that hard of a class to take, especially if you're not a math major!

ok so i actually took 1302 with Mrs. Burt so ignore the course code above. anyway, shes okay. i will say that she explains things SOMETIMES but yk when it comes to some topics, you will have to teach yourself and just become well-versed in them. she's also not really accessible outside of class. would i take her course again? probably not.

I understood Math a lot better because of her class, but be ready to collaborate and do a lot of independent work. All tests are open-answer and no MCQ. I loved her class nonetheless. Also, she's one of those "You do it, or you don't" so be prepared to work!

This class wasn't hard at all. The concepts are super easy to understand. There's a lot of homework, and the tests are difficult, but she offers a lot of extra credit and doesn't have strict deadlines. Since I was online, I was able to complete a week's worth of material in one day.

Expect 3 exams + a final. No solid study guide. Attendance is graded. HW has 14–22 Qs. Stat Coins can boost your score (max 15 EC points) and replace lowest exam. Study guides aren't reliable, and MyLab includes irrelevant Qs. Prof. Burt doesn't write the exams. The math dept is disorganized. Take it at TCC if possible. This A gave me headaches...

she is super nice to you and will show compassion when finishing up your exams if you scored low she would do anything she can to help your grade and give irl scenarios that will make the lecture go down smoothly

I feel as if the subject and course material itself is not difficult, yet she makes it difficult.I feel as if I only go to lectures for attendance and learn everything at home. Lectures are fast, and there are lots of group projects in lab. She is vague and passive agressive when you ask for help sometimes. There is extra credit though.

She is so sweet! I took stats with her and it was rough I am terrible at math. The exams are HARD but every stats class at UTA has the same workload and exams. The only thing that differentiated her from other professors was how involved she was in making this online course feel like an in-person course. No lab but in-person exams on Saturday
DO NOT TAKE
Listen to the other ratings, they are not exaggerating i have never experienced a worse professor than this actually diabolical and yes she fat.
Took her anger out on the grades instead of actually grading do not take this professor i dont think a single person in this class has a achieved an A
chubby cheek ah ho learn how to teach u suk
Do not take this professor if this is ur last option, if you do your gpa will actually plummet.
grading is so unrealistic she expects you to be the next shakespeare or sum sh actually insane.
i wish the worst for this professor u are not a philosopher, stop grading at the standard of Socrates
Her grading is so unrealistic do not take
Do not take for the love of god

Bad professor, shes pretends to be super nice and helpful but proceeds to grade you horribly, unrealistic standards, unorganized, doesnt know how to work canvas apparently, grading criteria is a mess and even when you follow instructions she always seems a way to lower your final grade.

She's approachable and encourages participation, which makes class discussions comfortable. The downside is that assignments, grading guidelines, and due dates can be unclear. Canvas feels disorganized, and projects often require figuring out expectations as a group. Your experience depends a lot on your team.

I'm not sure why there is so many negative reviews as the assignments she gives us is meant to prepare us for the real world. The group project is manageable as long as your team corporates. There is definitely not a lot of essays (2 at most) and she gives us plenty of time to do it. She is very clear when it comes to grading and instructions.

Choose another lab professor if possible. This professor makes everything harder than it needs to be. Labs repeat lecture content but add pointless assignments. Grading is slow and disorganized, an essay due in October wasn't graded until the end of the semester, with no feedback at all. Overall, the workload felt excessive for this class.

Professor Leefers is a very nice professor, I enjoyed being in her class. I did not really like the group project but it is understandable since it is a management course. We had to fire someone in my group and she made us have a therapy session as a group and I don't think that was necessary lol

Okay, this professor gives no heads up about anything and whenever she does she's not clear about what she's looking for. Next is her grading process, I don't know if she's just trying to rage bait the class but how is she going to grade everything last minute right before the final exam. So you'll never know what you have in that class.

She's “nice.” The labs are just copy paste from the lecture. Labs are basically a way for her to do a sermon on subjects we already learned and that she can be friends with the students. Be careful, she'll give you attitude if you aren't chummy with her. During the lab she doesn't explain anything about the project or the essay, overall unhelpful.

The online lab requires a lot of participation. Pre-assignments, major essay, reflections, exams, mini presenations at the end of lab, and group projects are what you should expect. Pray you get good groupmates, or your semester might be full of work. Exams are easy if you pay attention in lecture.

She is a very nice professor but her lecture for the lab are just a copy of the actually lecture, it doesn't add anything new, she doesn't explain the project at all and we have no time to work in class with our group, if you have horrible teammates then you might as well drop the class and she doesn't really help with that either.

Compared to other professors, she would not provide study guides for the exams after exam 1. Even if I took notes and dedicated a sufficient amount of time for her class for each exam, I would not understand a single thing about it, and she would not provide any examples for her exams, which were scenarios. Good personality, but I wouldnt take her.

She was awesome, the group projects were fun, the tests were ok, needs some improvement on how they tie to the lectures. The lectures were easy to digest, she's very empathetic and understanding towards her students. She genuinely wants to prepare us as leaders when we hit the business world. I would take her again if she taught more courses.

Hated her. Lectures well, but get ready to be so frustrated with loads of work just for it to be a elective core class. Lectures were fine, she just doesn't explain her project instruction or signature essay AT ALL and took over 2 months to grade the essay because she submits any little thing thats off to academic integrity. Don't waste your time.

Entertaining lectures, frustrating group projects. The tests were easy, but I attended every lecture. She genuinely cares about her students and takes feedback seriously if you have a problem with her. She leaves a lot of room for insightful, critical thinking, which may be difficult if you're used to doing assignments just for a grade.

I took the synchronous online version. The tests, lectures, and participation assignment are easy. Its just the awful group project that is so tedious. You just have to have patience ig. She is good at providing clear instructions and expectations just beware of all the group work.

Great professor who really cares about her students. She is a big rule follower and will call out AI usage if done wrong. Some may say she grades very tough as she follows the rubric very strictly. Overall, a very knowledgeable, caring professor who does grade hard.

Dr. Leefers is a great professor, very inspirational and knowledgeable in her field. Very tough grader, abide by the syllabus and instructions given. 3 major exams, 5 reflections (2 are conjunct assignments involving LinkedIn Learning), 2 essays (less than 2 pages and less than 1 page assignments, respectively), and one major 8-part group project.

Terribly described late penalties for major essay assignment. Expect tough grading on the group project paper. For Group presentations, don't rely on a sound to keep you under the max time. Super slow in responding to emails and seems like she responds when she feels like it. Expect slow grading on group project as well. Good professor, bad grader.
Shes entertaining. Not anything too bad about her besides her being a tough grader.

Great lecturer and delivers valuable insights during class. However, she is a hard grader and tends to be slow in returning graded assignments. Feedback is limited and achieving a perfect score on major assignments is unlikely. She does provide up to three points on top of the overall course grade for course evals, which I feel are pretty standard.

If anyone is trying to take MANA 3318. Do NOT choose this professor. Very tough grader, she literally will try to fail you and makes the exams harder than it should be. But she is a great person to be around, not just as a professor.

Takes forever to grade and provide feedback. How would I know where I need to work on my essay, when she grades the outline and the essay itself together? The essay is a huge chunk of the grade. If you mess it up, it will  impact your grade heavily. Has one group project and presentation. She loves to talk and hear herself talk.
Fantastic professor, Friendly, caring, and has amazing lectures and demonstrates leadership just as she teaches. Would highly recommend taking her!

Her lectures are so engaging, it feels like you're having a conversation between just you and her. the bad thing about this is you get so invested, you dont take notes (in my case at least). Exams are departmental and require critical thinking, she loves to connect with her students and overall makes the lecture fun.

Passionate professor who prioritizes getting to know students and promotes involvement. Exams require critical thinking. A significant % of your grade is based on the group project; start early and follow the rubric. Extra credit includes exam curves and completing eval. Best to ask questions in person.

Tests are extremely difficult and the group project seemed excessive. She waits until the last minute to grade everything for the entire semester which explains why she messes peoples grades up. Email her immediately, and make sure to follow up if you don't get a fast response or else she'll actually never respond to you. Don't recommend her, TBH.

One of the worst graders I've ever seen. Took off 10/30 total points from my paper for not including a direct link to the article, but the link was included, and didn't even answer me when I emailed her to fix it. Made me finish the class with a 79.67, which she also didn't round to an 80 and put in a "C" when I really made a "B". RIP my GPA.
There were 3 exams and they were extremely hard. She makes it impossible to get a 100 on them or even pass. She is nice, but i wouldn't recommend her.

Prof Leefers was actually funny if you paid attention. However, it was hard to not fall asleep on certain lectures that were so boring. You may think that some of the course is common sense (especially if you've worked around managers). However, the tests never made any sense. Tests were very hard for no reason.

Like mostly everyone else, the exams were hard. She says they're this way because she wants us to know how to apply the terms we learn, which is understandable and all, but at least test us on stuff we ACTUALLY talked about. Around 5-10 questions asks us stuff NOT mentioned in lectures, "word salads" at end of lectures, or in the study guide.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Never in my life would I want someone to go through this class, I feel like she makes the tests as hard as possible so she can make as many people as she can fail. DO NOT TAKE HER, ITS NOT WORTH THE PAIN

she was a great professor, put students first; push students to their bests. engage students and make sure to apply which is why her tests are "hard." you just needed to know the definitions on the study guide and knew how to apply it. 1 pt away from an A. grades aside from exams were easy pts. mandatory attendance due to lab but they were easy pts
I want to start by saying that the exams are very hard to pass. Study reviews don't even help because she includes something diffrent from the lecture. I would not take her....

She's great! Lots of easy grades, big group project-she gives you lots of class time to work on it. 
Exams are HARD. Conceptual and confusing. Provides a study guide but it's way more than is on the exams 
I loved her class, but hated the exams. 
Lots of easy Extra Credit options. 
Speak up in class!
Graded for attendance.

After taking professor Leefers. I will admit her tests are extremely tough. The study guides provided did not seem to help. But, I will still give her a good rating. She is a great professor that offers a few extra credit assignments. That will help your grade. She also definitely cares about her students and also willing to help whenever she can.

Dr. Leefers was my lab prof.  If you're interactive and engaged with her, the class will be much more enjoyable. The class itself is difficult because of all the info you have to juggle. The group project consists of interviewing a manager and writing a report about it. She's very technical with her grading, so be sure to make time for assignments

I would not wish this professor on my worst enemy.  ANYWAYS.... her test are HARD. Don't take her PLEASE. I literally studied for hours and still couldn't pass her exams. She gives you test that are hard and will MAYBE give back 2 questions. As I type I have a 70 on the class. PLEASE don't take this professor

Dr.Leefers will work with you, but her class is one of those classes that requires effort. If you are looking for an easy grade, this is not the professor for you. However, if you are organized, driven, and willing to take charge of your learning, Dr.Leefers is a great professor to get to know.

Firstly, this professor made things (test) difficult more than they should've been. If I would have known I would use the professor that I had for lecture as my lab instructor. She makes the test so difficult that you wanna cry. She surprisingly offered extra credit, that is not easy at all. Don't take her class
always talking about fan fiction and drinking dr peppers all the time, while giving 10+ assignments to finish in the span of 30 minutes
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This teacher makes class SO stressful for no reason. 12 pages of homework a day, then she doesn't grade till the LAST second. My grade stays 0% all year then BOOM A+ then BOOM failing  She's unorganized, yaps about fanfics, and this class got me praying for a fire drill like it's a vacation!!!!!!!!1
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: She's very sweet and we did nothing in most of the classes, which was relaxing, but we had to read the books on our own (which no one read), got no explanations and the assignments were very confusing. She grades till the last moment, which gives you less chances to make up your grade. But still, if you ask for help, she will be happy to help you.

I had this class my first semester at UTA, and it was dreadful. She never graded things on time, so we had no idea what our grade was till the last minute. She is not clear on assignments and so you never know what she is looking for in essays. She's messy and never ready for class. Don't even think of taking her!

The worst professor at uta. She is very obviously preferential to race in the grading of papers and will destroy your gpa. She will never be successful with the attitude she has. SHE ALSO GETS FOOD ON EVERY GRADED PAPER.
Bad. Terrible teacher

She is really sweet and helpful. I am not the best writer however I still got an A. She is very understanding and if you need more time for an essay she will work it out with you. The down side is she take FOREVER to grade, so you have no idea what your grade is until the end.

I would advise not to take her! This professor drove me absolutely crazy all semester because she didn't grade things until the end of the semester. I had no idea what my grade was going to be and no clue if I was writing my papers the way she wanted them. She does move deadlines and can be accommodating. It could be worse, but look elsewhere!

Right now I have an A in the class, granted she still hasn't graded some of our essays. She almost always pushes the deadline for essays back a couple times, except for her last one she only pushed the deadline once. She is very friendly and if you go to her office hours she will help you. Lectures are all book material, but she takes attendance.
She is the hardest grader that i've ever had. Very strict on her syllabus. Had to take her because my class got replace. Biggest mistake ever

I was not taught how to write papers. Takes the entire semester to grade. Her lectures usually are reading out the book or don't relate to the upcoming papers. Doesn't give feedback on papers unless you ask. Takes attendance. I taught myself how to write papers and read English book all day. That's how I made my A. Very nice lady. Not as a teacher

She was a pretty good professor overall. She's super nice and helpful. It's not hard to pull an A in the class as long as you do all your work on time and put in a reasonable amount of effort. I would recommend taking her class for sure and I'm probably going to try to take her for lit. The only down side really is that she takes attendance.

She is very nice and is ready to help whenever you need it. She is very picky when it comes to grading major essays but she is still a fairly easy grader. She also takes attendance The biggest downside is she takes really long to grade anything.

In general, she helps you with material fairly well if you ask in class or during her office hours; however, I think she grades hard and takes too long time to grade. Sometimes, assignments are uploaded late too and expect us to finish in time.

English Comp 2: Good teacher, very nice and helpful. Doesn't explain daily assignments at all but explains papers thoroughly. Very slow grader so valuable feedback is extremely delayed (e.g. I turned in a paper before receiving the previous one graded). However, she is very helpful in preparation of writing a paper and is almost always available.:)

She is a very friendly person, easy to talk to and makes English enjoyable (for what it's worth). She does take attendance, giving only a few days for sickness of whatever. She is always willing to answer questions, there is no reason why anyone would fail her class...unless they just don't try.

American Lit: Big mistake. She requires you to read atleast 5 novels and many more stories. This takes away valuable time from other studies. She is no where near ready to teach a class. She was always unprepared, gave most papers back at the end of the year that makes her feedback on them useless, and several times called herself lazy. Avoid.
This professor is very nice and helpful. There are many assignments which takes away from studying for other classes.

She's nice as a person, but not very well developed as a teacher. Her grades percentile are broken down tediously, making it hard to make an A. For ex., she  practically give you an assignment everyday. And these assignment only worth 10% of your grade and takes awhile to complete, plus she she grades these small assignments TOO particular.

She's a fine teacher for English Comp, but she's a horrible English Lit teacher.  She doesn't know what she's doing, and when she tries to act competent, it's painful to see.  Avoid this teacher if you're in a class that's not English Comp
She is a great teacher

She is a good teacher, but likes to do "group" work. You are required to come to class, but her assignments are pretty easy, and there are a lot of them, so failing is really hard to do. If you are already a good writer, don't expect to receive criticism, because she grades too nice!

Amazing teacher, A reading response is required every week and a lot of text but she makes it effortless to keep up. She also pics very interesting texts to read from in world lit. I finished my final today hitting for an A :).

She is pretty cool, but her grading is very subjective. You have to "wow" her to get full credit and she "fishes" for specific answers. Over all she is pretty good at what she does, and she lets you rewrite two of the essays.
She is a very cool teacher and she is always helpful. Her class is helpful, she is a very nice woman. She teaches really well, you do have to write a couple of papers but she will def. help you.

Please don't take this professor, it's waste of time and money, sign up for ANY other professor. I notice that EVERYONE in the class is struggling, not because calculus 1 is that hard but because we are not being taught right, I did not sign up for this professor, UTA gave me this professor and they did me and so many other kids dirty.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I originally picked professor Alice Lubbe and then I got switched to this joke of a professor. Let me tell you when you are at lecture there is no point in even paying attention because her Indian accent makes her really hard to understand what she is saying. When she ask students questions and no one knows she just waits and she never explains it.

What I can say, is that she doesn't have a feeling with the students, but it is important to follow closely every words that she is using and also work a lot on assignments. 
I succeeded because I was working a lot on this and through this, I show that it is not impossible

Bro they just let anyone teach nowadays. I had a 69.50 and when I emailed her she was like "we Go BY tHe PoLicY" even though all my other teachers rounded my grade. I studied day and night just to fail by 0.5... >:( Calculus at UTA is terrible and if I were you I would take Calc at community college. She's not a good teacher, good luck...

Absolutely HORRIBLE! Hope UTA fires her soon. Worst professor on campus without a doubt and the TA Thomas Tran is just as horrid. She won't hesitate to patronize you for not knowing something. Also, she didn't drop the lowest lab quiz after begging us to do the survey or the lowest exam after the SYLLABUS ITSELF said she would. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!

Worst professor on campus. Avoid at all costs! Horrible at teaching and patronizes you if you don't know something. Also, she didn't drop lowest quiz after begging us to do the survey, didn't drop lowest exam even though the SYLLABUS ITSELF said she would, plus the exam setup is ridiculous. No structure. Just all around horrifying experience…

Unless you already have experience in calc, don't take this prof. The exams alone are 70% of your final grade and she does NOT curve. I was less than a point to getting a B, and even then, it was very difficult to get a C. She does know a lot about the topics, but she can't teach at all. If you end up having to take her, good luck.
do not take this professor. i'm scared. i'm sad.

Hard to understand and moves very fast through topics. But for exams she gives a lot of review material and does lots of practice problems in class. She seems like she knows a lot about the class and I believe she has potential to be a better professor.

As a retired school nerd, never in my years have I met a incompetent teacher. It's obviously clear that she has little to no experience when it comes to teaching university classes, no preparation at all. I have practically learned nothing at all. With all due respect, she's difficult to understand. Do not waste your time and money on this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Thank the lord I already had credit for and knew all the course content from high school. I once watched her incorrectly evaluate a derivative and then simplify her incorrect answer incorrectly once more. So nice she had to do it twice I guess.

She does a million practice problems in class which is all you need. Ask questions if you dont get it and she will try to explain but lowkey her explanations are sometimes hard to follow. Her actual explanations of the material as she's teaching it are very good though.

Doesn't explain how or what she is doing in the lecture, no workbook, no textbook, doesn't speak clear English. Other students sometimes had to tell her how to do examples. 0/10 will never recommend you take her classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dropped her class for a different Calc 1 slot. Her teaching has absolutely no structure and she isn't that thorough. You're better off teaching yourself through YouTube videos, there's really no point in going to the lectures honestly. Her labs are just as bad and the structure there is maybe even worse. Taking her should be a LAST RESORT honestly.

Initially had a lot of homework densely packed throughout the week, but spread it out not long after. Biggest issues were short office hours, lectures that weren't as thorough as the homework, and exams that were punishing on conceptual questions that sometimes weren't worded strictly enough. It was definitely very hard to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I cried and dropped the class as soon as I got out of first lecture. I am now settling for an 8am if that tells you anything.

AVOID AT ALL COST. She didnt even curve any grades at all like she said she would. Complete waste of time. The tests were 10 questions multiple choice and there was no partial credit at all. Also tests (which she made) were more difficult from homework questions. The concepts aren't hard she just barely gives examples. You have to teach yourself…
Professor is a really nice man, but his exams are hard. All he pretty much does is read through the slideshows, there's not really a review for the exams.

this is the only time i've ever called an elective hard. teacher expects too much for an intro class. tests are curved but average scores are failing. He explains 3 slides then throws you into groups, wont help, then grades difficult

This was an easy class, lectures were entertaining and it was clear he was very knowledgable on the subject. The final exam is optional, lecture slides are a great way to study. There are group activities but they aren't too bad. Overall, it is an easy class if you study and try to understand the material.

The tests are unnecessarily hard. 5 multiple choice answers for each question, trick questions as well. Lectures are great, he is knowledgeable and has a great personality. 5 group assignments, randomly assigned- the worst. Homework heavy- 8 assignments every week, but takes about 2 hours total.

In class group activities. Exam every 4-5 chapters. Final exam is optional. Pretty easy if you try to understand the content. Slides & HW are pretty good to study. Wish he did a study guide for exams. Gives extra points sometimes & extra points when guest speakers come in & you write down questions to ask if you want on notecards.
He alright

I would 100% recommend Professor Briggs, he was available in and out of the classroom when needed, my only concern would be exams being 80% of your grade. My advice would be to go through all the material through Cengage and complete the practice tests. He definitely wants his students to succeed
useless

I had an amazing experience exams are bias to lectures, videos shown and examples. There are some things from the textbook but majority is from class. If you study and make flashcards for each exam you'll do fine his course is not hard. totally recommend again you get what you put into his class. If you put little in then don't expect a lot out!

Good professor. He creates the exams with a bias on what was covered during lecture. I recommend showing up for lecture. Lowest exam score is dropped. Lowest group exercise is dropped as well. He grades these very tough! You can make up points by making sure to do the Cengage assignments and REP Surveys-- EASY points.

The class is just tough in general with lots to remember for each exam. The workload is fine, just need to pay attention to the lectures. He did give us an exam the first day back from Thanksgiving. Not sure why anyone would think that's a good idea. Sets students up for failure. Pretty frustrating on that part.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Marketing is a class that requires a ton of studying of terminology and Professor Briggs made it interesting and understandable. His exams were based off his lectures so make sure to attend them. Stay on top of the homework and REP surveys. Those are easy points. The class  exercises were interesting and you have the option to work in a group.

The only grades in the class were tests and exercises (which you can work with others on). There is SOOO much information to remember for each test. And the tests come up so fast that its hard to have time to study it all. I recommend just studying his powerpoint slides as that is all you need for the tests. Boring lectures, find another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His lectures are plentiful and thorough, I typically write over a page and a half worth of notes during lectures. I never used the textbook, it's optional but recommended. Only grades that practically matters are Exams and Exercises which are both done in class. Study to understand and interpret concepts correctly as they account for most of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: It's probably my fault that I haven't been succeeding in this class. The other student's are just as confused as me with the tests, they are difficult and a lot of the questions have two different answers but the one that is more right is the correct one. I have trouble testing in general so that is what gets me. He does tries to help u understand!

This professor is very informed on this course, he gave good lecture. BUT he grades extremely hard every little detail matters i think his TA did most of the grading which was terrible. He calls on you in class so be prepared. not much extra credit, too much material and heavy tests.

I really enjoyed this professor, he was nice and funny. I never went to class but be careful you don't miss group project days, they will sneak up on you. The only way I managed my grade in the class was reading every chapter before each test so I taught myself but his tests weren't bad if you read. Just make sure you can comprehend the material.

5 tests, usually 40 multiple choice questions, worth 80 points each, final was 75 questions but he gave a 10 point curve which he didnt do for the other tests. 5 group projects worth 15 points each, he drops the lowest one. 4 REP studies, sign up ASAP or youll miss it. If you read the book before class and pay attention, you wont have an issue.

I came in thinking this would be an interesting MARK elective... man I was wrong. This professor truly has issues and I am upset rate my professor didn't warn me or my peers. Hardest class I have taken SO far.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: What can I say? He's the GOAT (greatest of all time for those who don't know that expression). Take him for Multicultural Marketing, be grateful that he is such an amazing person, study a little, and get your A.

One of the best professors I have ever taken. The workload seems heavy, but all the assignments are explained well and graded fairly. His Multicultural Marketing class comes with very engaging lectures. He cares about each of his students and will go above and beyond to help you. He knows the content very well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor! Provides great feedback on the major project as you work on it, making it easy to have exactly what he wants for an A when all is said and done. He cares about his students and their success and does a great job at making lectures entertaining. Dr. Briggs is very knowledgeable in his field. I would absolutely recommend him.

He is a really good professor, do not be afraid to ask him a question in class. He takes time out of every class to use examples and ask if there is any questions. Test are right from his powerpoints, study the power points and ask questions in class and you will be okay! He does ask if you are going to leave early to sit in the back,that is all.

Easy A. I def recommed this professor. The workload may seem like alot but it's not at all! There are 4 REPs (super simple can be completed within 20 mins), 5 group in-class group exercises (super simple but he tries to increase the difficulty but not bad and he lets you leave early after completion), 5 tests (40 questions but lowest grade dropped)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very good professor. I took him for multicultural marketing and I would take him again in a heart beat. He was very helpful on the group project and provided lots of feedback throughout the process. He has entertaining lectures and genuinely cares about the students. His test require studying, but he tells you what top focus on.

Dont Take his class! HE doesnt help you on Group research studies. He's a teacher he's suppose to help and provide steps. He thinks you should already know this info which of course is not possible. Would highly recommend not taking his class, heard that marketing is easier taking it online. Noone really passes his test and way to strict on them.

Dr. Briggs is a great professor, he definitely makes you work for your grade. Overall provides a great lecture and interactive environment during class. There are a few group exercises (never made a 100) He is a tough grader for sure. Gives extra credit opportunities.  I would recommend if you're not a Marketing major.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Don't take this class! Beware he is a terrible grader. He makes marketing the hardest subject to understand. Grades like its Chemistry and its rare if you get a 100 in group studies. By far the Hardest class I have ever taking. Not a great teacher at all. Wont take his class even if UTA paid for it. Please don't take this class.

Terrible teacher! Grading is terrible, he gives no-one a good grade or a 100 on group assignments. His grading criteria is terrible. I wouldn't take his class again if he paid for it. His Test have nothing to do with the power points I would recommend reading the book and teaching yourself Marketing because you won't learn it from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I definitely wouldn't recommend if you are not a marketing major and want a good grade. He is a nice guy but the way he makes his exams makes the class impossible to do well in. I studied a lot and barely made a C in his class. He does provide bonus opportunities so try to attend class.

ID's on test day, bc he doesn't want to pass a 'dog'. Test days gives 3 different colored test to prevent cheating. Not understanding & doesn't like being proved wrong. Called me out for being late even though the TA told him I wasn't, he refused & still only gave me partial credit. Wrecked my car, had tow slip, still no make up test allowed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: He's awful. I wouldn't recommend him just because he is very vague on helping you understand what's going to be on his test. His group assignment are nearly impossible to get a good grade on. I understand you are supposed to work for your grade but just save yourself the trouble and take someone else. Especially if you aren't a marketing major.

Prof Briggs was awful absolutely awful he is very vague not clear exactly what is going to be in the test. Very confusing I would not recommend anyone to take him. ...I thought is going to be intro class to marketing but his exam are based and application.

I don't recommend this teacher. He is unclear and strict. He will call you out if you try to leave early, isnt understanding. I was late a few minutes and he grouped those that were late apart, deducted major points, and wouldn't let us complete the assignment. His test are unclear, like his reviews, he basically says study everything. No makeups.

Dr. Briggs is an excellent professor who knows his stuff. Lectures based on ppt but you have to read the textbook to understand what his is talking about; provide good examples to understand the material. His exams are tricky, for real!  Make sure to do well on the first 4th exams; last exam is comprehensive! About 3 or 4 pop quizzes.

Dr. Briggs is a great professor. There are 5 exams during the semester but only 4 count so he drops your lowest test grade. There are 5 groups exercises and he drops the lowest group grade. He works with you if you have any questions. He makes his power point's available online but if you want to do well on the test its good to read the book.

Info that would have made me choose a different class: Group project. 15-20 pg paper. 13-17min presentation. Daily quizzes for attendance and grade ... Seriously, if you're not a Mark major, stay away. Prof is not bad, but slightly unorganized and unclear. The workload is hardly justified for the overall course message that is constantly repeated.

Rookie when it comes to teaching. Only reads from ppt. Takes attendance personal and tries to see who is on phone/laptop during class. Don't take class if you aren't into Marketing. Pop quizzes each day for attendance and reflective summaries about class. Two books required for class. Wish it was online.

AWESOME! I love that he is a young professor because I felt like he easily related more to the students and explained things in a way where I understood. Tests are all through Powerpoint slides so just study those in detail and should be fine. About 4-5 group activities. Drops 1 test grade including FINAL so I did not have to take FINAL.

Lectures interesting, interactive, and are important to passing. 5 tests including final will drop one. 6 in class group assignments, drops one. Take good notes, and study the in class PP that are on blackboard, and you will do well on the tests. The book publishers study quizzes are very helpful.

I would definitely take him again. Study the powerpoint slides and read the chapters and you will for sure pass. He doesn't care about personal issues at all, so make sure you don't have any, & if you do, don't bother telling him. The tests are just memorization and the group work isn't hard, but come prepared for it.

Professor Briggs Marketing 3321 course required the normal attention given to any lecture course. The main requirement is to read to understand not to memorize, also extra points were given thru out the semester so attendance is necessary.  Great Teacher enjoyed the course.

Extreamly hard class if you don't read the book and follow his lectures. His group assignments are very hard to make a high grades, so you have to do well on every exam to make a above an c. I recommed taking marketing online heard it's alot easier.

Great young professor. If you want an A then read the book before class and engage. Many students got Bs or Cs due to slacking off. Read the book and study the slides, his test covers the slides but you'll need in-depth cover for the test. He drops a test, do yourself a favor and do well on the first 3, that way you can drop the final(hard I heard)

This professor enjoys Marketing and you could tell his class was full. We had group assignments this is a great concept it helps you interact and get feedback from your peers.  He gives a lot of extra credit and info on marketing jobs for job seekers I would recommend him.

Briggs is really good. I enjoyed his class. I got a B by just going to class and study his slides and write notes. He is very helpful in case you have any questions. Everything he says in classes or on his slides will be tested. The book is handy, but I would say record his classes and listen them at home and write notes by the slides.
Test are pretty much right from the notes and things he says in class. So it would really help if you go to class. Reading the chapters would also help. Overall pretty easy!

Tests are difficult.  Group project is time consuming and intensive.  Making an A on the simulation is literally impossible.  This is the worst professor I have had in 3 years of undergrad/grad work at UTA.  AVOID BRIGGS AT ALL COSTS.

I would not take this class if this was not one of my core courses. Briggs was the only one teaching it, so I had to take him. He selected the worst textbook, and we didn't even use it the entire semester. Attendance is a must, one group simulation, several group assignment.Test are tough, he doesn't show concern for anyone that doesn't understand.

Teaches from ppt slides but you have to know the material inside out. Must read the chapters to do well. His TA grades the group exercises and avg was around 10 out of possible 15. Gives extra credit but only 5 points of 500 total so doesn't really help at all. Had 449/450 for possible A before final, but he wouldn't give a point so had to take the
WORST PROFESSOR AT UTA! He doesn't care about you so don't bother with this class.

If you ask him a question, he'll either answer you "I can't tell you that" or he'll babble about some random stuff that has nothing to do with the question. He doesn't give any reviews, and his test isn't all off of his powerpoints. You'll be better off with a book.

Dr. Briggs is very nice and you can tell he is really into marketing.  This was his first semester teaching at the graduate level, so that could contribute to some of my frustration.  He was always vague with instructions, but then very meticulous in grading.  He did ask for suggestions, so hopefully he will get better!

He's a really cool professor and all, but don't think this is a blow off class because it's not. Memorize the powerpoints(that alone will give u a B). Eventhough attendance isn't mandatory, he usually gives out a few details in class that WILL pop up on the test, so i recommend going to class. Very strict about grades,so be careful. READ THE BOOK!

Heard he was hard and was kinda reluctant to take his class at first seeing the rating from ratemyprofessor but he's like the best out of all Marketing professors at UTA so I went ahead and take his class anyway. Turn out he wasn't that hard at all, all you have to do is attend the class, read the book [just the parts he mentions in class]
Very nice professor but strict. You must study for the tests. The powerpoints help alot. There is 5 mandatory group assignments. I do recommend.

VERY EASY Class especially for slackers, attendance isn't mandatory but extra points if you do, teaches off powerpoints so only need to study that & somewhat read book to make a B, videos in class, interesting examples, TAKE THIS PROFESSOR

Attendance is helpful gives extra credit pop quizzes. know the slides read extra in book about slides to get an A. There are group projects which he refuses to help with then grades hard.. 5 tests, last one is comprehensive, lowest grade is dropped, if you do great on the first 4 there is no reason to take the final. I made an easy A without final.

You must show up for an A. He gives a few pop quizes in the beg of the sememster for extra credit. The power point slides are very helpful, but you must go read about each slide in your book to make an A. And there are 5 group projects in class worth like 30% of your grade, so make sure you show up for those! Test are not easy, so you MUST study!

You must show up for an A. He gives a few pop quizes in the beg of the sememster for extra credit. The power point slides are very helpful, but you must go read about each slide in your book to make an A. And there are 5 group projects in class worth like 30% of your grade, so make sure you show up for those! Test are not easy, so you MUST study!
he is just happy to be there,,,,,

I enjoyed this class, attendance is helpful, know the slides. The book is not 100% neccesary, but it can be the difference between a B and an A (need the definitions). There are group projects, 5 tests, last one is comprehensive, lowest grade is dropped, if you do great on the first 4 there is no reason to take the final. Extra credit is offered.

You will be fine if you [1] show up [2] participate & [3] study the slides.  The only thing I hated about this class was the group assignments because he picked the groups and you have the same group all semester.  Also, on day one, dress nice & say cheese to receive extra credit!

Very straight-forward. Not an exciting professor. However, the material is very helpful, especially to entrepreneurs. You don't need the book at all. Do attend and take many notes on the power point slides. Study the slides to a T and I can guarantee an A. Helpful and easy.

I needed a 91 on the final to make B in his class. I got 91, so i went & talk to him it was useless he gave me a C. His class very easy if you just study of his slide. Just memorize his slide before his test you will be fine.
This class is easy if you make the effort to go to class and pay attention. Read the powerpoints and take notes in class.  Easy A
Reads off slides, test off slides pretty much. Good teacher, easy class just study slides and you're good!
he is so boring and unhelpful.he reads off slides so if that's your cup of tea i guess you'll love him.

He is confusing.  Test is worded tricky, the book is an easy read but he make it so much more difficult.  He is also very monotone and boring, i hate this class.  Study my butt off and still make a B :(

Very tough professor. Gives you the powerpoints, but don't expect to make good grades just studying that. Gives "extra credit" but if you look at the totals at the end of the semester they really work out to be mandatory points. Because they hurt you if you didn't get them. Also have group projects. Small, but graded tough and he won't help on them

He is one of the BEST marketing Professors I have had so far. He is super organized and loves to teach. All the guidelines are in the schedule.Follow those and you will do great. One thing is always read a bit before coming to class as sometimes he gives extra Credit Pop quizes and they really help bump up your grade.

He is a very nice guy, but his class is very hard for a Principles (intro.)class. His exams are not over general ideas and concepts but instead over the tiny details in his pointpoint slides. The textbook is not very useful because its information is often different than what the slides and lectures contain. Exams are only over slides and lectures.
Tests are straight off the powerpoint presentations.  Attendance is only required for the group work.
Didn't like this prof. at all! Tests were nothing like what he went over in class--Don't ask for help because he will most likely not give it to you! Would not take him again for any class!

This guy is not hard, he lectures does not teach in my opinion. I normally pull A and B grades, this class is hard because the information on test is worded tricky, and he doesnt seem to care as much as he shows. I would suggest taking another teacher if you want to learn and pass.  He understands, but if your not a marketing major you wont like it

Great professor.  Just show up and do what he asks of you and you will be fine. He really cares about his students and is always willing to help. You have to earn your grade, he will not give it to you.

This professor is out of control. He will call students out in front of the class, so you better come to class and be prepared to stay until the very end or sometimes over. He may be alright for Principles, but anything higher than that class I encourage you to take Dr. Freiling or someone else. Quizzes every week and lots of assignments

Great style of teaching. Tests are pretty easy if you pay attention to the powerpoints. Only thing I didn't like were the in-class group assignments. They were easy, but not enjoyable. Great teacher overall! Would take him again.

Good easy class!! This prof makes going to his class fun because he always wants feedback. Test are pretty easy barely studied for them and got a B in the class. I would recommend this prof for principles of marketing if you want to help your GPA.

The way she structured the class was perfect, and the notes she prepared were really good as well. She's also funny; she should try comedy one day. But yea the curriculum is hard because that is how the UT system for schools is supposed to teach their subjects, as each UT system is ABET accredited, which basically means there are no easy classes

This is the most honest review you're going to read Shes not a bad professor in terms of personality but when it comes to her lectures your better off throwing on YouTube to learn it yourself someone mentioned she belittles you if you're not sure how to solve a problem, this is true I seen it. if you decide to take this class stay on top it

She uses fill in notes during lectures, that are easy to follow. The homework that she assigns is useful for the exams, though occasionally the questions on the homework are harder than what you will find on the exam. The mandatory lab for this class can get stressful because you will get a packet you have a week to complete, so don't put it off.

Dr. Beach teaches clearly with an intuitive style; most frustrations come from the curriculum, not her. She gives fillable notes that make it easy to follow along and review later. Lab: day 1 review + quiz, day 2 group work. One drawback: she sometimes makes math errors that students make her aware of.

Genuinely don't know how she's a professor you won't learn anything from her lectures literally nothing you'll need to depend on other sources to learn she sucks as professor but tbf she is caring just don't know how she managed to get this far as a professor DONT TAKE HER CLASSES.
Her rating on this website is definitely more of a student issue than a professor one. This professor is as good as they come.
I never wore my seatbelt while driving to school because i wanted to die before making it to his class

Be ready to work in groups because that is literally all you do in class. She is there to help and guide you, but other than that you rely most on getting your work done in groups. There also isn't really lectures... she just hands out the lesson of the day packet and you have to learn it on your own. Also, take the time to study by yourself!

Dr. Beach was a wonderful professor for Cal 1. Contrary to other reviews, she's eager to answer questions and doesn't belittle students.
