Lecture is not really needed and is super boring but does help a bit to attend (and it's 5% of your grade). Make sure to read the chapters and study vocab. Tests are kind of hard so STUDY no matter how good you are at bio. Overall, you'll be fine if you take him and try to listen and read the book thoroughly.

I took Chippindale for biology my freshmen year and made a D. I retook him and made an A the second time around. Hes a good teacher, but youre really going to have to sit down and read the book and PowerPoint every few days to make a good grade. If you can explain things to yourself then you know the material, if not go back and read it!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I would not recommended him. He is nice person, but his lectures are horrible and boring. 2 midterms and final. His free response questions are a killer. He expects you to be so specific.

His lectures are boring. You take a midterm + a final and that's it. Grad students do a MidTerm Paper, Term Paper, & Presentation. He reads off his PPT slides. The main problem is with the exams: they are completely RANDOM and most are free-response qs where he expects you to be specific after briefly mentioning said topic in class. He is nice tho.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: He is a brilliant biologist but a horrible professor as teaching goes. His powerpoint slides is just letters and sentences against a blue background and his lecture is extremely boring. His test is EXTREMELY DIFFICULT! No joke. He gives you like 7 multiple choices and 5 impossible writing questions.

Really nice guy, really boring lectures. He puts the powerpoint on blackboard so I just skipped class and studied at home. Lecture grade is three exams plus the final, and the final replaces the lowest test grade.
Dr. Chippindale seems like a really nice guy, but I did not find his lectures useful at all. Reading the book was the most useful way to prepare for the tests.

While Chippindale may not be the best professor ever, he's honestly such a sweet guy. He tries his best to make sure everyone understands what's going on, and his lectures were enjoyable. His PhD is in Zoology which is why he wasn't always able to explain things that great, but he still knows his stuff. Would definitely take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: He's a sweet guy. Biology itself is hard, but he does a good job of making it clear.

If you wanna do well on the tests just read your textbook... a lot. Most of the people in my class didn't even show up to class. They just read the textbook and took the exam. The lectures are okay but they're definitely not anything special.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: He is very nice guy and good biologist. But he is not a good teacher as teaching goes.
Chippindale is a nice person just not a great teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: His lectures are boring so it's very hard to stay focus plus he has a monotone voice which makes it even harder. You pretty much have to teach yourself, if not you're screwed.

He's knowledgeable. Seems like a very nice person, pretty chill. Grade is only 3 tests for undergrads, which is fine. I don't like when they add assignments to try and force you to study. Sink or swim on your own. It seemed like when he curved final grades students didn't all receive the same curve. The tests were difficult, but I would take again.

I took this class instead of taking Wilk but it was in no way better. His lectures are interesting if you like evolution, but they get boring listening to them for 3 hours a week for 16 weeks due to the redundancy of the powerpoint slides. Tests are extremely difficult, averages were in the 50's-60's. Doesn't curve tests, but curved final grades.

So the class is chill about 95% of the time. The remaining 5% is miserable. Lectures are easy, boring, and dull. He tells you himself not to read the book so there is absolutely no reason to. Two midterms and a final which are the most dreadful moments in the world. Questions are just weird and you have to think hard. By some miracle I pulled an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Really cool professor but lectures are really thick sometimes and it gets a little hard to stay focused because its so much. Posts all his powerpoints so kinda hard not to know whats going on even if you don't go. Since he's kinda monotone and the subject is dense it gets difficult at times but I would take his class again because if i ever had to.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Biology is already a difficult class to take as it is, but when you have a professor who only reads off of his power points word for word, it kind of makes it hard for you to learn the concepts, we did not have any quizzes in the class. Your grades will be based on participation, lab grade and test grades and that is it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Awful professor. His lectures are boring and monotone and all he does is read the slides word for word. I skipped class most days and would just read the slides he posted online. Thankfully I had a great lab TA so it balanced out my grade and I passed. But yeah - don't take him.

He is a very polite and respectful person by nature however, his lectures are VERY monotone AND so boring I just want to end my life. The flying spaghetti monster lecture was the only funny, his lectures are in no way funny at all. Tests are not easy but not too hard either. The content is very redundant, only difference is the examples he gives.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very informative about this course but he looses a lot of people due to him rambling on and on in lecture. He expects you to know the entire textbook in order to pass the test. Doesn't give any test reviews.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I haven't even taken the first exam in this class yet but his lectures are so entertaining I'm rating him now. We had an entire class about scientology and the flying spaghetti monster. Take the course for that reason alone. Ask him about the time he punched Tom Cruise.

So if you have to take him you will need to read the book. I also had to watch videos on certain topics. Study the power points. I would say you are going to have to study ALOT! His voice is so monotone I would lose interest.  and your grade is based on test mostly with the exception of the lab. I just barely got my credit.  I studied a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Need easy A to brush up on evol&ecology class, & creationist/ID counterarguments? Then this is the class for you! Just graduated & this is the easiest upper lvl bio class Ive taken. Just studied the slides day before exam. All exam Qs are MC except the Qs on graduates presentations in final. Warning: a bit monotone, & grads must do presentation

Not a hard class for an undergrad. Grad students have to write term papers on top of the exams. Might be harder for them. Textbook is not required but I would suggest you read it sometimes. 2 midterms and 1 final. Easy A for people interested in/familiar with evolution. Tip: Reformat the boring white-on-blue slides to make reading them easier.

He's not a terrible professor, but he's far from the best. I took his class Fall 2015 as a freshman who didn't know how to study or pay attention. If you don't know how to do that, good luck. It is extremely hard to listen to his lectures in the morning, if at all. Overall his class demands a lot of independent study. Know how to put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The class was kinda boring, just listening to him lecture for the hour, but he is nice and does know his stuff. It would be really helpful to study the powerpoint and then read in the textbook things you need help on. Tests felt fair. He seems to care and is available outside of class if you need him. No homework so that was a plus.
Just go to lecture and study the slides in detail and you will be good.

Study his powerpoint slides (no matter how awful) even though they look like he is writing to himself, this are the only way you will pass.   He is dull in most of the lecture BUT when he gets into things he can really be a great lecture. Find ways to stay alert in class. I recommend writing things out and what he says or even recording him.

Lectures are from a powerpoint that he gives you at the beginning of class. He can't adequately explain topics. He doesn't take attendance so nobody goes to class. I got more understanding from reading the book and watching you tube videos on subjects. AK Lectures is great. Tests are very difficult. Have to know all of the information, no reviews.
He was a pretty tough teacher.

Conservation biology is  a small class (less than 30 students), so exams are short answer. If you pay any attention to his lectures and can explain the concepts, you should have no trouble earning a good grade. He gives partial credit and provides his slides. Easy 4000-level class.  .

Going to class is pointless because he posts his powerpoint on BB and he reads off of it directly during lecture, but I wouldn't ignore his notes completely because some questions on the test could come from it. I recommend reading the text book as well as looking over his notes because they're not very detailed. TESTS ARE VERY STRAIGHTFORWARD!

If you attend and take notes, you'll do well. Your grade comes from the 4 tests and lab, so your exam grades and especially your final will make or break you. He goes through his lecture very fast, but the powerpoint for the whole semester is made available from week 1. The textbook is a $200 paperweight.

I wouldn't take his class unless you want to teach yourself. I am not great at teaching myself and studying in general but if you are great at that you should be fine. He reads off the slides and he posts it online so what is the point of even going. His tests are hard and in general is not a very great professor. Try to take someone else.

Terrible teacher, bad lecturer, not very clear as to what to expect on the test. I studied two weeks in advance for both tests and I still did terrible and I was forced to drop out. Beware before taking him, and if you dont have a choice, good luck. Youre going to need it.  I am very glad I will no longer take the class due to a degree change.

Professor Chippindale is a really cool guy, some people end up not taking him just because of the fact they would feel other professors might be easier. He tends to go into detail a lot, but his test primarily focuses on just the core material, so do feel overwhelmed when studying. I hardly studied in there and it was a breeze.

nice guy but probably one of the worst college professors i've had in my whole college career. Tests are confusing and hard. Very boring lecturer and slides are very boring and basic.  Class is not easy. if you don't have to take the class, i wouldn't.

Obviously would rather be doing research than teaching. Not the worst professor I've had, but he's down pretty low on the list. Makes his lectures confusing, doesn't look students in the eye while lecturing, uses a lot of generalities and then expects you to be super specific on his tests.

Yes the lectures are fairly boring, however the exams are literally based off of the power point slides. He is more than willing to help anyone who asks for help. It isn't that hard to study the power points and if you know that material, you know the tests. This class is easy as long as you go to lecture and more importantly STAY AWAKE.

Seems like a nice guy outside of class, but one of the worst professors I have ever had. Just disheveled in general, lack of clarity regarding test material, and monotone speaking voice/ boring slides that makes for a real boring class

I had him as a sub for the end of my Spring semester. He reads off slides, can say "So," "So-basically" about 10 times in five minutes. He often says "we won't go into detail about that" on things that I saw were on the test later that we DID need to go over in detail. I got an A from studying my butt off and using study checks in the book.

His final exam is NOT made up entirely of previous test questions to all who are wondering. I know that I desperately wanted to know that while taking this course. There are a few repeats (like 6-7 out of 50) but most are made up of other material.

I would definitely not recommend this professor to anyone. He reads directly off of the power points which anyone can do themselves. His tests are made up of very in depth questions (you can't study the night before and expect to do well). I made a B but that is only because I was above the class average of a 50. Good luck to all who take him......

Terrible class. The lab was pretty easy but his tests are terrible. He just reads off of slides and doesn't explain much. I had a lot of prior knowledge about bio and I'm making a C in this class while studying over 20 hours a week because his tests are terrible. If you can avoid him, DO IT.

DO NO TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! All he does it read off of slides, with his mono-toned voice. If you want to be bored to sleep then this is the perfect class for you. His lectures have nothing to do with his tests. Save yourself the agony don't take him.

DON'T TAKE THIS PROFESSOR... all he does is read off of slides. He is mono-toned and I want to fall asleep. Most of the class doesn't show up until test day.. His tests are nothing like the lecture. He asks very long broad questions.. I don't recommend anyone to take his class.
Very nice guy, but a very hard class.

He's a very nice man, but a very poor teacher. He is very scatter brained and monotone during lecture, and basically reads off his power points. It is very difficult to get an A in this class, even while attending all the SI sessions.  Very vague when it comes to exams; no review or any clue as to what he'll include so you need to study everything.
Powerpoints are extremely unclear and poorly organized. He tends to confuse himself during lecture. The class is extremely fast paced. Nice guy just not the best professor.

DO NOT TAKE! He is completely unclear, and has no organization in his lectures. The class average is about a 62%, and he seems happy to teach biology, but he doesn't know how to teach it. He says his test are 50% lecture, and 50% textbook, but I had to literally learn biology on my own. Just don't take him at all. I promise you'll regret it.
I don't know what everybody's problem is...this professor is great.  Interesting lectures, fair grading and tests, very helpful and friendly.

He's a really nice guy. If you go to class and take notes, you'll do fine. Study the powerpoints religiously and you WILL make A's on the test. True, he is a bit unorganized and boring at times, but his class isn't hard at all if you take the time to study.

His lectures are dry, and you will probably sleep. His tests are from lecture AND the book. His tests are trick in that there's a majority of conceptual questions. However, he asks them in a way that aren't very direct. If you don't know your fundamentals, you will fail. I got an A because I know how to study. Don't expect to skim the PP.

This man... This class is VERY HARD! Even with the book and attending his class everyday, I was still completely lost. Even attending SI sessions didn't help. His lectures are also VERY dry so paying attention is a must! To save yourself time, effort, and heartache don't take his class!!!

all he did was read off his powerpoint, which he posted on his website, so no need to go to class really. his tests were based off his powerpoints. he gave a mock test before each test and posted the answers next to his office. i made a C on the first test and failed the second one, but made a B+ on the final, so he gave me a B+. he's super chill.

Professor Chippindale is a nice guy & very helpful but he is very disorganized. I recommend reading the book to pass this class. He is very disorganized & doesn't gives study guides or even an idea of what will be on his tests except the chapters he went over.He does curves at the end of the semester and is very fair.

He sounds like he is just rambling on and on during his "lecture". All his content is available online on his website, but it is NOT organized and it is like reading a 100page essay when you want to study.. And tests are HARD, I am a good student but underestimated his exam because of how casually he lectures and explains things..

I DO NOT recommend him . He is disorganized and the way he lectures is awful. He just writes (illegibly) on transparencies. I honestly did not take notes in class and I quit attending near the end. I studied myself. However, if you do better on the final than the midterms, he'll replace the midterm grades. I failed both midterms, still got a B.
I'm an honor student. And even I wouldn't recommend taking him. Nice guy, but just disorganized in every way. Believe me, you should see his office.

I am taking his Biol 1441 class right now and he is a very nice guy, however, his handwriting is almost illegible at times and he writes and speaks way too fast. His class is pure lecture and is kind of monotonous. He uses his notes to make the tests,though, so if you get all of the notes and memorize EVERYTHING, you will be fine on the test.
He realy is a nice guy, but i wouldn't recommend him to nobody.  Everythig that the others are saying is so true.  He is all over the place and his handwriting was rediculous.

I am taking his BIOL class now and I must say that I really dislike his way of teaching. His handwriting is unclear and he teaches way to fast. Majority of his classes fail the exams, and he does not care. His class is hard and I've heard there are way better teachers than him.

Very interesting, provides his notes which are fairly thorough, tests are LONG. Fair grader, nice guy, but classes are pure lecture and can be monotone...dont take your laptop, its easy to get distracted and quit paying attention

He is fine.  I dont understand why someone posts the same bad rating for him twice and it gets counted the same.  He is nice and helpful. His tests are hard and he doesnt curve except that then he does at the end and most ppl are happy except the ones that dont try.  He wants every one to do well and helps the ones who want to.
Good guy.

I thought he was fine. He was boring, but he was not a bad teacher. He's ALWAYS in his office, and he's always willing to talk about bio. 1 time I went to his office the day of a test and talked to him, he gave me a private lecture! The best part was he was making the test while talking to me and all the questions I asked were on the test! Score!!!

i do not recommend taking this guy for biology, because he doesnt teach well. All he does is talk alot and not explain things well. You have to basically learn biology by  yourself. I made a C but the final was what made that happen. Final are the same questions as midterms. Dont recommend him though. TAKE SOMEONE ELSE.

I'm speaking from real experience, so its very trustworthy. This guy doesn't know how to teach. All he does is copying his old lecture notes onto the transparencies and stare at the wall. If you are a genius at BIOL and still make an A by reading the book, then take him and just show up on the test day. If not, Pls run for ur life (he doesnt curve
No Comments

I thought the material was interesting but this professor is pretty bland.  Lectures consist of the guy writing nearly illegible notes on the overhead.  He speaks about the same speed that he writes...slowly, lots of uhhh's and umm's as if he's new at teaching.  Expect him to stare at the wall alot.  If you want to succeed just read the book..

If you struggle at grasping math concepts, he is NOT the one for you. Lectures are unorganized and sporadic. He connects what you're learning to real concepts but it's a lot of theory and not that much time on practice problems. Quizzes every day(pretty hard). Doesn't record lectures. No notecards on test unlike other profs. Not a bad person though

SO much homework.Quizzes every week,another quiz before class which is not considered a quiz, at least 2 assignmnts per week, (need 2 hours for each to complete), exams, labs due every week PLUS labs due during the lab, need to submit your notes from lectures (graded), impossible to keep up with. DO NOT TAKE HIM. plus he never responds to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Only take this teacher as a last choice. The issue mainly stems from his teaching which could easily be described badly. He expects you to grade your own quizzes (given at the end of every class), Homework daily (Completion grade). His lectures go over only the basics, and other profs let you bring notecards for all exams while Diaz does not.

He legitimately did not realize he was teaching the course I was in until a couple of days before the semester began, and sometimes was confused by the textbook he used himself. Expect 2-3 assignments per week with 20-30 questions per assignment, with no well-taught explanations. Would NOT recommend.

The class set up consisted of watching video lessons prior to class, getting into groups and solving problems related to the lessons, and then completing homework for each lesson. The set up allows for exposure to the material over and over again making it pretty easy to learn. If you have questions ask in person because he doesn't reply to emails.
There are quizzes every class so get ready for that, Lots of studying outside of class but he is available and very clear on what you need to know.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The class in itself is naturally hard, but professor Diaz does a good job handling it overall. There are quizzes every class but as long as you understand your homework they are not too bad, and the two midterms are based on 80% of the quizzes you take so it all loops around in the end.

He's a really good professor who actually tries to explain the materials in the more simple terms. Maybe it's not for everyone, but I find going to his office hour where he gives out practice problems really helps a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The workload for this class is heavy, but it is necessary for the subject matter, and his office hours are incredibly helpful. True, there is a quiz in every class, but this forces you to stay on top of the material and gives context to the lectures. Great professor to take this subject with because he is genuinely passionate about teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Funny and passionate guy. The way he is able to connect real applications to the concepts taught in class were really insightful while also nice to listen too. He really wants his students to dive deep into calculus and mathematics overall so be prepared for that. (can be overwhelming). Also be prepared for a lot of homework.

i wasnt a fan of his lectures he talked too slow and spends an entire class on 1-2 problems. i liked the TAs lectures a lot better than his. we have weekly lecture visits to watch and fill out notes, we had to attend his lecture and there were 2-3 homeworks every week, a quiz, and webcast problems. class had a lot of material to do

His lectures were very disorganized.The quizzes after every class were frustrating because you had to create your own problem.He would give you a question and you had to create your own function and solve.The homework was excessive.2-3 homework,2 quizzes,hour long video pre-lectures sometimes.If you struggled in Calc 1/2, don't take this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Terrible professor, sure he is smart but good luck trying to learn anything in lecture. You will spend most of your time teaching yourself the topics. Quiz after every class which are also ridiculously hard (20% of your grade is quizzes) He will give you no review material before the exam nor tell you what will be on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Esteban Diaz is the WORST professor. Quizzes every single class and 18% of ur grade. No review material for exams. Quizzes are VERY hard BEWARE
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His lectures are genuinely terrible, quiz after every class and the quizzes are ridiculously hard. I wouldn't even complain about that but the quizzes are worth almost 20% of your grade. He sits on geogebra half the class and door a poor job of teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He's just a cool guy. Technically, there is no attendance check, but there is a quiz per class, so attendance is pretty much mandatory. Although you can miss three quizzes.
absolutely terrible.
As he says at the start, no ta, no labs, the final is 30% of your grade. Otherwise regular guy trying his best for us to learn. Plenty of office hours, use them.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: excellent but too much geogebra sometimes
Bad professor
If you ask him a question about the lesson he says figure it out or i don't know.
Worst professor so far.
Trust the process.
Just not a good professor if you struggle with math, please find someone with better ratings.

I truly dislike this professor, He has a thick and hard to understand accent. He doesn't actually teach you how to solve the math, he just does one question per unit with very poor explanation of what he did to get the answer and 60% of the time he was actually wrong. He also requires attendance but doesn't show the code, he is unprofessional.

He actually knows what he's teaching and also teaches the reasons why certain methods work. If you can't keep up with fast paced lessons, it might be difficult but he's always willing to help, slow down, and answer questions.

I chose this professor despite the bad reviews in order to prove them wrong, but they were all accurate. This professor's discipline is cheap. He doesn't allow formula sheets on tests, lectures are unorganized and feels unnecessary to attend, Echo360 is disabled, and quizzes rarely align with the course sched; makes Calc 3 needlessly difficult.

The lectures were great and covered all of the material. This course used ALEKs as the way to provide homework and Lab time gave you plenty of time to do the work. The TAs were very helpful when he was not around to provide help. I would take this course if you manage your time well. He also provides a LOT of extra credit assignments!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Taking this class was my worst decision ever. He made this class 20x harder than it should've been. His lectures were erratic and unorganized. A terrible balance of examples and theory in his lectures. The lectures, hw, quizzes, and exams are all too different. It's like taking 4 classes instead of 1. He is the bane of my existence. DO NOT TAKE.
Would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He makes simple things hard. I don't understand his writings on board (unorganized). His funny and entertaining but hard grader and hard quiz maker. He doesn't put quiz questions in exam. so studying quiz is useless. Oh by the way exam's free response questions are easier than his given quiz. We had a petal math one time and no one got it.

Teaching is not for everyone. And it's best Diaz take his knowledge of math to something else. Lectures and assignments are unbearably erratic. He has you do work before teaching the subject. Once announced a "follow up exam" to one we took the previous class so nonchalantly I thought he was joking. He ended up giving us another exam. Truly awful.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I was a little apprehensive because of some of the other reviews, but Professor Diaz is an amazing professor. He's hilarious and great about explaining new concepts and tying things together. He emphasizes understanding the material through experimentation rather than brute memorization, which is super important in Calculus II and on.

All of the math majors I've talked to love this guy. He's extremely accessible outside class if you have questions on the topic. It's a discovery focused, proofs based math class which means you are not spoon fed information and expected to regurgitate that information blindly on exams. Even then, some questions were literally just calculations.

Do not take him if you struggle with math. Very fast-paced course. HEAVY on homework. He did not explain anything in the lectures rather just went over some examples. You have to learn everything on your own. Go take this class at TCC or just hold off until there is another option if you aren't the best at math.

I would not like you to hurt your GPA. This professor never responds email promptly. He finishes his class much earlier. He doesn't explain materials more clearly. He is always late for class. He doesn't stay in his office. He is very tough. Be careful.

Professor Diaz is great at explaining math principles (through use of multiple examples) during both lectures and office hours.  He's got a great sense of humor.  Giving 4/5 because his assignments tended to have too few problems on them, making mistakes more costly.

I will say this about him. He is a decent person but not a great lecturer in my opinion. Half the time, he would rarely explain the content and expects you to figure it out yourself. HW and Quizzes were just too difficult and going to office hours made no difference since he wouldn't want to help you out. Try to work with other people if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor doesn't teach anything during lab time and only goes over a few topics.  If you start off extremly behind then you will never catch up because he gives way too much homework and group work.  Also doesn't have clear grading criteria for the writing assignment
Quite possibly the least racist professor I've had, with little to no signs of Alzheimer's as well! 10/10, read the book.

Diaz knows his math well but sometimes struggles to communicate how to solve the problems the hw system gives us. He's great at making up examples in class and explains things pretty well (although you rarely know what section he's lecturing on), and the exams he handmakes so they are simpler. He put effort into making the math relevant to arch.

Does not teach very well and does not go over information properly. Stays on examples for way too long in such a short class period and does not ever seem to have a clear lecture on a single topic. I learn a whole lot more from a simple lecture video of 40 minutes over the topic than his class that is an hour and 20 minutes.
You basically have to teach yourself if you don't get a certain amount of subjects mastered on Aleks from the diagnostic

I had to watch bunch of YouTube videos in order to do remotely good in this class. It was all thanks to YouTube and not the disorganized professor. On top of that knowing the class was 5 weeks and over summer he overloaded the homeworks. I would not take him even during 13 weeks course because of how disorganized he is.

If you have all the free time in the world and can spend multiple hours teaching yourself then go for it. He is disorganized, the syllabus is just for the show, and he does not even finish lectures in one class period. He has a god complex and tends to act right up until the drop date, then he will start showing his true colors. RUN AWAY FROM HIM!!

Hard quiz each weekend & rarely reflected over his lectures...disorganized & focused on useless concepts & not solving example probs bc he "didn't feel like solving it"...1st exam was easy. Didn't prepare us for the final & taught us new concepts all the way to the end..take Calc 3 at a community college! He made it way harder than it needed to be.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I am typically a straight A student and have never gotten a C in a math course before. He's described his own teaching style as perpetual struggle before and has once spent 2 lectures without finishing a single example because he "didn't feel like it". If you take him be prepared to teach yourself and fight to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor is extremely good at explaining the concepts around the topics in class. He is truly available outside of class. During our class he takes attendance by asking you to "Take out a sheet of paper". You can tell he cares about students and wants them to succeed. Make sure to start studying for the final when he tells you to.

The classwork is very easy. There is one essay but it's pretty easy. Attendance is mandatory with a minimum requirement of lab hours. Professor Diaz is very friendly and funny but can be hard to understand at times and isn't the best at understanding/answering questions directly. Only got a B because I got lazy at the end of the semester

Professor Diaz was an amazing professor. He balanced being very funny in lectures with making sure everyone understood exactly what was going on. His class was the first time I had ever looked forward to going to my math lectures. I'm actually a little sad his class is over.

Don't get me wrong, I love professor Diaz; he is funny and attentive but lacks organization in lecture and on canvas. Half the time he goes off topic and we don't finish a discussion then have to learn material ourselves which isn't that bad. He NEVER answers emails so don't even try.

Dr. Diaz is a great person and is always willing to help, but number theory is already hard as it is and I was confused most of the time during class. Its easy to get lost if you're not paying attention. Just come to class, read the textbook, youtube, cheg and go to office hours and tutoring if available. If you have to take him, just do your best.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Wanted to like them but the entire semester felt like a roller-coaster by the end. You teach yourself via provided videos and their lectures are meant to be reviews, but quality could be very questionable. Has a tendency to make fun of people asking questions or even for no reason, which makes it hard to want to learn. Fair grader and extra credit.

one of the worst professors. takes forever to finish a lecture, can't stay focus in teaching, never completely finish a math problem. he would tell silly jokes and laugh on his own. acts like a clown, never be serious with anything.

He doesn't teach from the book like most professors, so the book is just used for extra practice problems if you need the help. The material can be really confusing to undertand, so don't be scared to ask for help. He'll definitely help if you just come to his office hours! He also gives assignments that boost test grades.

Do the Homework before attending class lecture as he goes over how to set up and answer questions in class. During our class he takes attendance by asking you to "Take out a sheet of paper". Before the final he showed more passion to have all students pass class and set up study sessions for us. My class was silly which made lectures interesting.

Dr. Diaz is hilarious and I always enjoyed class. But you need to put in effort. Reading the book will help immensely as well as attending office hours to fill in any knowledge gaps. He was always available outside of class for any questions related to the material. He is a great professor that cares about his students.

best math prof ever. i failed this class my first sem and had to retake it, and I got a b this sem with him. he curves every test and offers lots of opportunities to get your grade up. he's really understanding and wants you to do well. talk to him if you are struggling, and he will definitely help you out. content is difficult and course is heavy.
He is a good teacher that is also pretty funny as well. Is very helpful if you have any questions about the course. Would take again!
Get ready for a lot of homework and lots of hours of studying. There is a lot of opportunity for extra credit and a lot of time to study.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Diaz is a hilarious professor with a clear passion for math. He expects you to learn most of the material on your own, though, and lectures are used to go over practice problems and to teach the concepts he thinks will be more difficult. The textbook + online HW provide plenty of explanations, so do the homework and you should be okay.
VERY unorganized and doesnt know how to teach. Most if time wont help students. The class average was so low. Never responds to emails either. I would avoid him.
Really funny and relatable teacher. Makes you pay attention, and helps you imagine on how to use math in the real world.

Professor Diaz is great! He cares about his students and is really chill. There's a lot of extra credit opportunities. He gives partial credit on exams and has algebra coins that will help raise your grade too. However, he takes a while to grade things (like the partial credit forms) and respond to your emails. But he's a good professor for algebra
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This was probably the weirdest, most unorganized class I have ever had. I can't say that I really learned anything useful for my future in mathematics or education. He definitely doesn't follow the program guidelines for this class, he makes up everything on the spot so just try your best to understand his random scenarios and you will be okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Just like other people said try your best NOT to take this guy. He seems like a good person, but seems unorganized and sometimes is late to class. There's few assignments, but takes a while to grade everything.

Dr. Diaz is like a funny genius. He knows his stuff. Sometimes its hard for him to explain it to us. He loves to answer questions, and he loves to have students show him their work. He wants interaction. If you do the work, he will help you. He answers every message and has office hours. He really makes you think. Id take his class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Reading the book will make your life a lot easier with understanding the concepts. Really unorganized professor when it came to lectures, and getting back to students on questions outside of class. Might have been a good professor in person, but not online. Don't expect the exams to be multiple choice(2nd exam for us was all free response).

Don't take him unless you absolutely have to. He won't reopen hw and doesn't do test corrections. He very obviously doesn't like that he has to teach online and it hinders any teaching ability he had. Literally paid money to watch him play around on Geogebra.. The reviews for the exams weren't always helpful, so study a lot!

Doesn't provide feedback. Provides post-tests, to boost exam score and redo questions. I started with an F and ended with an A. 99% comes from the textbook, except one question. Use your resources. Classmates don't help, just look at textbook solutions and use that for the quizzes and exams.
Try your best not to take this guy. He legit has no idea what he's doing and he takes like 3 months to grade everything. The material isn't too tough but you basically have to teach yourself.

Cal 3 at UTA is horribly managed and Diaz did not make it any easier. His lectures consisted of him just showing examples on Geogebra and not even explaining the math behind it. I stopped watching his lectures and just started reading the book (which I have never done in any class). There is so much to learn in Cal 3. DO NOT fall behind.

in lectures, he seems very unprepared. he confuses you more than teaches you. he is not very clear with what he wants on quizzes/exams. You have to ask for feedback &even then his feedback doesn't help you improve. The only reason I gave a 2 rather than a 0 is due to the fact that he gave extra assignments to raise your grade after exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Diaz is a really good professor! He is clear of what he excepts throughout the semester.

I genuinely don't remember learning anything at all. If u suck bad at math don't take this class. There is insane amount of work to do. Also, don't buy the manual bc he barely uses it. He's nice and funny but I didn't find him great at teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Id give 1.5 out of 5 if I could. Hesa great person, but TERRIBLE professor. Although he takes thorough notes for our lectures, he doesnt say what topic in the textbook we do. Tests (take-home) arent at all what he teaches in class. Only reason I have a 90 is because I used Chegg. Hes great at what he knows but should use it somewhere else.
Gets very mad when people skip class, no phones, always late to class, too much homework, does not explain very well and moves through stuff very quickly. Do not recommend if you struggle with math.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He may come off as an a hole, but he genuinely cares about his students passing and understanding the material. He offered corrections for the first midterm. His midterms and quizzes are all multiple choices. He's funny.

He provides lots of homework online but he gives you a while to do it. Some of the questions given on the homework won't be taught in class but if you ask for help he would help. He likes to joke around a lot. Diaz also makes up examples to teach the class but you will notice that he randomly came up with it and did not put effort into it.

Dr. Diaz is one of the best math teachers I have ever had. He will listen to all of your questions and do his best to answer them. He does sometimes question himself, but no one is a perfect teacher. More than willing to help you when you ask.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: If you can try and take college algebra at a community college, you have to write a two page paper about algebra. Its homework heavy and he is always second guessing himself. The lectures do not match up with the labs. The college algebra course is ridiculous and should not have to write a paper about algebra.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He's funny and good at explaining, but you can't look away for too long or miss class without becoming confused. He would come up with confusing & random examples on the spot and you can tell he didn't plan/prepare beforehand. To get a good grade, you should skim the textbook & watch online videos. There are no reviews or formula sheets for tests.

Never teaches same way twice. Decides what to teach at start of class, no planning. Fast through hard stuff and slow through easy. Midterms are easiest thing ever; final is departmental. Homework is 9 questions. Outside work is a lot if end up teaching yourself. Hilarious professor but don't like teaching style. Only teaches what's needed for final

Professor Diaz was probably one of the most caring professors Ive ever had. He helps you a lot if you dont understand something. The class is not easy so you need to put a lot of effort but he will make sure you pass the class by letting u retake one of the tests if he sees you are really struggling. Overall I would take him again if I need to.

He is a funny person, but an alright professor. Towards the end his lectures got better, but for the most part I learned from Youtube videos (professor Leonard!) Midterms are heavily weighted (also curved) but there's only 4-6 questions and NO formula sheet. He curves a lot but that might not save you!
Great professor, encourages you to show up to his office hours if you have any questions or just need someplace to study.
One of the best professors ever!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: does not teach very well, is not specific about the work, gives too much work and is always second guessing himself when you ask him a question, if you struggle with math i do not suggest you take him

Loved Dr. Diaz's class. I am terrible at math, but I managed to squeeze a B on my first 2 exams, still studying for the final. I really did enjoy his lectures, he has a really fun personality, one of the few professors who actually looks like he enjoys math lol (in my experience). He really cares about his students, I would take him again 10/10.
Dr. Diaz is a hilarious professor that lectures in a casual way, but he's not TOO casual. You still learn a lot from his lectures and you still have to study outside of class for the grade.

Class is substantially easy if you're decent at math. I'd go to class but barely listen, because he went over topics slowly and sometimes confused himself and us when trying to figure out a problem. All tests are on online Pearson, so as long as you do the homework and maybe the study plan, you'll do good on the tests.
Professor Diaz is a good professor. He offer more chances on quizzes. He also teaches the material slow.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Diaz moves so slow on the material that is so simple and sped through the last unit (interest etc.) because he didn't allow enough time to teach the material. Also, he makes you waste so much paper each class! I never want to hear "take out a piece of paper" again. The class itself is so easy though. I made an A, but I'd never take Diaz again!!

Easily one of the best professors I've had so far. Attending class is very helpful in understanding concepts and problems, plus he'll notice if you didn't attend and might say something to you if he sees you in lab or outside class. He's also very funny and makes attending class enjoyable. Homework isn't too heavy and he's flexible with assignments

Hes funny and really helpful. Hes flexible with due dates but he moves very quickly during lecture and he uses every minute. He will always help you and give you examples during his office hours. he teaches better during his office hours and you will definitely understand better if you go. Hes a joy, and I looked forward to his class every week
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: Easy A class, just do the homework and show up on exam days. He is a funny dude and pretty chill, he is easily accessible outside of class, and is willing to help with confusing concepts. Great Class

I had Dr. Diaz back in the spring 2017 semester, and I have to say passing this course was the hardest thing I have done in my life. Dr. Diaz was unusually caring, and is one of the warmest professors I know. He has different teaching techniques. I will not sugarcoat anything; he makes you WORK for a good grade. I was on his good side and made a C.

reviews.comment: Easy A Class, just do the homework and show up for the exams and you'll be fine. He cares a lot about his students and wants you to learn. If you know and understand the homework you will pass. Tests are based off of homework.
Hard

Dr. Diaz is a blast! He does his best to break things down but this is ABSTRACT alg. He encourages students to go to his office and I can tell you that it is worth it. Something wrong with you if you get less than a B. Homework prepares you and covers stuff not on review. Can miss 6 classes and still get full attendance points (only counts 5% too). reviews.comment: Moves too fast, big workload always due on the weekend. Attendance mandatory as a grade. Exams in person. She's really sweet though. Textbook needed, calculator needed.

This professor was outstanding, dedicated to students' success, and always willing to provide extra help. Her clear explanations, flexibility, and supportive teaching made complex concepts easy to understand. I genuinely looked forward to class and would highly recommend her.
Amazing professor 100% my favorite math teacher of my college career!
She's great!
Loved her! one of my favorite. Her teaching style is the best. she will explain everything super clear and will take her time to do so. caring and also generous about her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This professor was one of the best I've ever had. She explains every thing and, and she can help you whenever you need help.

The amount of effort you put into this class will reflect your grade, but I will add that Professor Delgado is amazing, one of the best professors I ever had! Her lectures are well understood, and she takes the time to explain further if student is still confused. Her passion for teaching is shown on a daily basis and is greatly appreciated!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Delgado is an amazing teacher and truly cares about her students. The course I took had lectures and homework assignments that generally easy, and if I had any question Professor Delgado was always there to help me. I would take her again in a heartbeat!

Professor Delgado is a great teacher. I loved earning algebra coins for milestones, like scoring above 70 on exams. I earned 101 coins, and spent them to boost all of my exams and final by 7 points each. My only concern is the attendance policy; missing lectures lowers your grade, but you can use coins to improve that, so it's not a big issue.

Loved this professor! Her lectures were very easy to comprehend, and we use a workbook to follow along with her. However, there are a couple of homework from ALEKS we have to do every week. She also gives extra credit if you complete the practice HW on ALEKS. Exams were easy since they are very similar to the questions on ALEKS.

Amazing professor! She made it clear she did not set the date for the final exam and reviews wonderfully for each exam. She is very understanding and the grade you get from the class is based on the work that you put into it. ALEKS has all the assignments that are all accessible from the first day of class and don't take long to do per week.

She's amazing and has extra credit. Our final was on a Saturday. She discussed at the beginning of the semester that it was not her decision and told us months in advance. The textbook is required, and I bought it but didn't end up using it at all. Pay attention and do the assignment and you'll succeed!

If you take this lady get ready to take a final on a saturday. I get not having a life but we all do😭 waste of my time. Didn't even buy the 80 dollar textbook. Rip to the people who have to work on the weekends to support themselves.

I really enjoyed this professor she is an amazing teacher. Her lectures are very easy to understand, but there is a fair share of work like 3 or 4 assignments each week. However, all the assignments are very easy, if you pay attention to the lecture. 10/10 would take this professor again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Take Mrs.Delgado class, she is a great professor !!!!
- Extra credit added to test when completing review on ALEKS
- You have to provide your own textbook from book store
- Homework is on ALEKS and gives you unlimited attempts.

reviews.comment: I LOVE Mrs.Delgado! She is so kind, comforting and helpful.  Her lectures are really helpful and she is always willing to answer questions.  Her office hours are also really helpful.  I give her a 5/5 stars. Please take her class!!!

My favorite professor has been Professor Delgado. Very caring and respectful ensures to answer any question you might have regarding lectures or assignments. Straightforward lecturer and very knowledgeable with the material so she knows how to teach it extremely well. Definitely recommend this professor for anyone taking math 1402.

As someone who hated math going into college, Professor Delgado has made me enjoy math with her straightforward lectures and the way that she teaches you the concept. She conveys her materials clearly, and always ends class at the right time. As long as you attend her lectures and pay attention in class, you will be okay.

love professor Delgado so much, the class itself is hard but she always there to help and responds to every email. she will no degrade if you don't understand anything and is always there to help in lab when needed.

She was nice enough, she just was not for me. I have zero skills or knowledge in math. I can honestly say that I didn't learn a thing in the class. I got more from YouTube videos. And extra credit is provided in Alex, but you actually have to know how to do the work. If you don't, it doesn't benefit you at all. But you get 2 chances on quizzes.

Professor Delgado is nice and caring towards students.I recommend taking her class because she will help you and breakdown any questions you might have! If you ever have any personal problems, she'll be understanding and accessible outside of class for help(office hrs).She also does answer emails within 24-hrs which I really appreciated.

She was a nice lady; she would answer any questions or break the problem down again if anyone needed before moving on. There was a lot of homework, but it helped, and she gave reviews which are extra points for the exams. She also gives a 24-hour grace period for assignments and quizzes, which is nice, and two attempts for the quizzes.
I had her for college algebra and she was amazing. She goes through the book which makes it easier and she helps out even more at office hours and shes a nice lady who cares and is willing to help.
Mrs. Delgado is a very fair teacher and she teaches very well. If you have the opportunity to have her as a teacher, then I would take it.

This professor has been my favorite to date. She is always prepared for lecture and never cancelled class on us. Additionally, she was amazing when it came to answering students' questions in and out of class. I recommend not missing class and completing all the homework assigned to be best prepared for exams.

A really good math teacher, highly recommend. She goes a steady pace and makes sure that everyone understands the material. Something I really appreciate is that she also does the homework so she knows exactly what she has to teach us. Always reminds us of important deadlines and of her availability.
I loveedddd Ms.Delgado. She made lectures very easy to understand, and her reviews + homework were so helpful to prepare for exams. I recommend everyone to take her class, we all love her.

She taught the material very well and was always willing to explain anything you didn't understand. She does practice tests before each exam and goes over the answers which definitely helped a lot. Great to talk to.

Seriously not a math person, but I really enjoyed this class. Pro. Delgado makes it light and fun, and explains everything through each process! Lots of homework aka assignments, some quizzes, BUT SHE REVIEWS BEFORE EXAMS AND IT IS THE BEST! Definitely get the workbook. Don't miss it unless you must. LOVE her as my math professor!

This was the best prof Ive had in the education program so far! She was fair in how many assignments she gave and definitely set us up for success every week. If you miss a class, youll be behind. We would start on TEAMS as a whole class and then separate into groups. She clearly explained everything and the assignments actually helped me learn!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Awesome professor. I don't know why people didn't like him in the past. Super nice and funny. Would recommend.

Professor Davis is very flexible and understanding. His exam format includes multiple-choice questions.  The review materials he provides are extremely helpful and closely reflect the exam content.
I was once very close to the next letter grade, and after reaching he was considerate and adjusted my final grade. I highly recommend taking his class.

Fun professor to take for 3310. His passion for the material really shows with his lighthearted tone during lectures. The class project was really fun and taught me a lot about Java. He really takes past criticism well by trying to improve his teaching methods and going easier on students. Attendance mandatory and lecture heavy. Take him if you can

He's the nicest professor. Exams are multiple choice and he gives out reviews for both exams. There's a group project that makes up for almost half of grades. He's very flexible on due dates and provides study materials. Overall, he's a great professor.

His classes can be difficult for people who don't attend lectures, its easy if you show up every day and do the required work. The group project we did was a great learning experience I learned a lot about real-world work and people management. He genuinely cares about his students and continuously asks for feedback on how he can improve the class.

He is the nicest professor in the CSE department if you actually care about your grade and degree. He is accommodating and is willing to work with you on homework and exams as well. His group projects are so important because it teaches you how to work with a lot of people and prepares you for the real world. Plus he truly cares about his students.
Embedded I was the best course so far in the CPE program, and Davis showed up on Saturdays just to give the class more lab hours.

If you're in CSE 3310 with Bud Davis and just complain, you're not ready for the real world. His class isn't easy, but if you attend, pay attention, and take notes, you'll be fine. Everything on the exams comes straight from lectures. No shortcuts, no cheating -- just show up and put in the work. :))

One thing to say, you will get a whole class project where you have to build something together which was fun and I learn lots of things from this class but, the exam was messy(only mid-term) because the questions were too many and couldn't even complete them at all and assignments were hard to understand what we're submitting. GREAT CLASS TO LEARN

Assignment instructions are confusing, ask questions until you are sure what is going on. He wants everyone to learn but the way he teaches this class is not the way tbh. The group project was a mess, not organized, not enough time for the project. Make sure to do well on the 2 exams as they are the most weighted. Easy grader for assignments tho.

I cannot describe how much i hated this class. Half the semester was individual assignments were so ridiculous which he himself stated "made it out of a wimp" were sooo difficult for no reason the other half of the class was the group project the whole class had to make one game,cooperation was a nightmare.AVOID IT AT ALL COST. 89.89 no curve B a B
Lowkey the class wasnt hard at all idk what all the other people talking about. Assignments were easy and hardly took any time. Easiest A of my degree

This class honestly wasn't that bad, however he writes the most atrocious assignments that never make any sense. The good news is he is lenient about due dates so if the entire class isn't really turning something in, he extends. Definitely possible to get an A with effort, but you will be wishing you took another professor

reviews.comment: The coursework is disorganized, and the professor often rambles. The notes and textbook will be your best friends if you actually want to pass the test.

Exams where exactly like the practice exams. Don't expect multiple choice, true or false questions on the exam, everything was short answers. We had a class group project that everyone worked on, and I mean everyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: In this class, the professor was never present. Professor Davis rarely ever showed up to the classes and it was run by the teaching assistants. The TAs at the start of the semester did not help much however as the semester progressed they helped more. The class is an introductory class however you're expected to know how circuits work.

I mean he's alright, nothing crazy. He really only focused on the group project, which for this semester was a whole class project. I actually had fun coding the project up and working together as an entire class to simulate a real-world job. As for the class material, that was boring, didn't learn much, exams are exactly the same as practice exam

Class is intended to be self taught with the material provided and TA's to answer any questions you have. However, it doesn't work: the TAs are pricks and won't help you unless you are a woman, the assignments are written by someone who never learned English, missing material, or have mistakes. Even with some familiarity with the content its hard

I mean he's alright, and the material he teaches is kinda interesting and important, he's not horrible or amazing, he just gets the job done. He seems like a nice guy though, and even brought us coffee one day, but his teaching style and the structure of his assignments just aren't for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you don't know coding or circuits before this class, you can still pass the class but you will struggle a lot. As others already said, there's only 2 TA's for each section, and they are always overwhelmed. They're rude asf and they use their phones a lot, causing many students to raise their hands for several minutes until they finally look.

Strict attendance policy. Completely run by TA's, saw professor total of two times. Some labs you leave hours earlier, while others will have you using the full time + makeup. Read the labs before hand and write the codes/try your best to understand the instructions throughly before class. Also try to make a friend, makes the work easier to do.
Professor was rarely in class and most of the help is dependent on the TA.
Bro does not help you out on anything even if you got a good reason

Professor Davis is kind, understands his material, and is very helpful.... whenever he is in class.  Didn't like that his Intro to Computer Science class was led by TA's, but I otherwise have no complaints about him.

I was lucky to get the section where our TAs were very helpful and friendly, so they were there to help whenever we got stuck. I heard some other sections' TAs are not as helpful as ours, so I guess it is a hit or miss. If you get helpful TAs, it will be an easy A.

Not hard if you are decent at problem solving. Strict homework submission dates. Arrive early if possible, and read/comprehend material a day in advance. Tip: Sit close to the front so you have a greater chance to get help from the TAs

Teacher isn't there and TAs get overwhelmed. Nothing is taught by anyone, you follow a worksheet and assignment info that is almost always confusing and missing key pieces to complete the work. Teacher belittled us a few times for needing help. Lab can be very stressful. Says it's an intro class, but need decent knowledge of coding and circuits.
Lab Assignments are not very clear

reviews.comment: Unorganized lectures, clearer explanations, lack of engagement. TA Needs to be more responsive and unhelpful. Overall, it was a disappointing learning experience. I would not recommend it. 0/10.
