Sometimes her accent is hard to understand, but it's not too bad. Easy A, no textbook needed. Exams are online. Just look up the questions on Quizlet. Don't have to show up to make an A.
She's very nice and has a cute sense of humor. All grades come from 4 online exams. She gives extra credit. Most test questions can be studied from quizlets.

Easiest class EVER!! Rarely showed up but when I did, her lectures were alright. She's very sweet and tries to get the class to participate. Her tests are online and attendance was for extra credit. I recommend anyone who wants an easy A to take her!

The easiest class. All her tests are online, and all the questions can be found on quizlet. Don't buy the textbook, b/c you'll learn more from crash course sociology. The only reason I attended class was b/c it was extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I took her online sociology class. Everything was on quizlet and google so dont worry. Only two easy exams. She is always sending messed up emails that are confusing and make literally no sense. Other than that the content is easy. 10 quizzes, 7 discussion posts, offers some extra credit. I would take her online but not in class

Dr. Kalanzi was a great professor. All the tests are on Blackboard. I would recommend getting the book, because the majority of the exam material is from the book. Attendance is not mandatory, but she gives up to four points on each test if you attend regularly. Very encouraging and uplifting professor.

Very easy class, the tests are straightforward with all material gotten from the textbook. Dr. Kalanzi provides a lot of real-life examples for sociology and likes to joke a lot as well. Only four tests make up your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Kalanzi is friendly and encourages student involvement. She encourages students to share their cultural background. I took Social Inequality with her.

I took Social Inequality with this professor? Her lessons were interesting and engaging. The movies gave students a break from note taking. However, she picks on students to answer questions, uncomfortable. Very pleasant though. She strongly encourages students to speak out and have a voice.

Medical Sociology was a 5 week summer 1 intensive class. Dr. Kalanzi organized this course well although there was a lot of material being learned very quickly. She made the sections manageable, I think everyone was set to succeed. I enjoyed every bit of it, and would take another class with her.

I took Medical Sociology with Dr. Kalanzi. I loved the format of lectures and how we were given the opportunity to share ideas and examples that applied directly to the content. I will definitely recommend this class in the future to other students. I learned a lot but without stress. Thanks to Dr. Kalanzi!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Good professor. I liked her teaching style. Class was interesting with many examples drawn from day to day situations. Very nice professor. I like her accent. I would take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Kalanzi is the sweetest professor I've ever had. Very caring lady and truly wants the best for her students. All test are online and there are quizlets for every question. I would take her 100x more just to get an easy A. Class is also kind of interesting.

Attendance isn't required but can give you extra credit. Tests are online. She is a really nice professor and cares for students. The class can be a bit boring. As long as you read tests are easy. The only grades are the test.

Class can be quite difficult. Reading the book is not recommended as she regularly contradicts the book. Lots of "Extra Credit" but does not apply it. Extremely tech-illiterate, be ready to clarify things over email and to have her request a different lockdown-browser for each exam. Also makes tests harder if too many people make A's

Yikes. All exams including the final is online, so that is not bad. She started using lockdown browser mid-semester but exams are still easy. Final is non-cumulative, but the professor has a THICK accent. She says the books is required, but all of the exam questions can be found on quilt, and the lecture/book do not help on exams.

Took her for intro and now medical sociology. She knows her stuff and is passionate she seems to care a great deal about you succeeding. She has an accent that makes listening to her lecture a real treat. Took her medsoc online. Graded on 20+ 1 page papers and 10 quizzes. She is not a harsh grader at all on papers. Quiz wording is wonky though.

I loved Dr. Kalanzi! I would take her again if I could! She is passionate about sociology and it shows in her lectures. She cares about her students and occasionally gives extra credit opportunities. Her tests are heavy, but if you take notes and listen during her lectures, you will do fine in the class. I highly recommend her!

TAKE HER! GPA Boosting class. Probably one of the easiest classes Ive taken at UTA. Thought this class was going to be boring but it was actually interesting the handful of times I went to class. She does take attendance (Just have a good friend), her tests are online, and there is one extra credit assignment.

Her exams were online, and every question was on quizlet. If you want an easy A, take her!! She really cares about every student. Attendance is mandatory and she gives extra credit for attendance. SHOW UP. She doesnt like people to use laptops during class so sit at the back of the class.
I liked taking her class.  The material was relevant to reality. Also, she always comes to class more than excited about teaching, which makes us excited to learn.

The class I took with Dr. Kalanzi was interesting as a whole. She is helpful in explaining the concepts in class and providing useful and world related information.  Also doing group activities and relating to concepts in the real world helps learn material easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Kalanzi is fabulous! She really interacts with the students and her information is clear. She gave us time to take good notes and overall the material was interesting to learn about. I did not see any issues taking her class.  Cares for students a plus plus.

She's alright.  I wouldn't take her again because she doesn't explain throughly and she's sometimes hard to understand. Beware though , do not get on her bad side because she will not take it. It's an easy class but she can be a little obtuse sometimes because if you didn't answer how she wanted you to answer, you'll be ignored.
Literally easiest class I took last semester. All her exams were online and she gave extra credit to those test for attendance. Was a boring class but she is a sweet lady.

Kalanzi's lessons were interesting and engaging. Movies the professor shows give students a break from note taking. Professor picks students to answer questions, which engages students into the lesson although I did not want to be picked on.  Friendly woman and entertaining. Encourages students to speak up and have a voice.

I liked her, she responds to emails quickly. Really communicates to the students and gives good examples to the topics we talk about. Always smiles and laughs in class. Great learning atmosphere and talk to the class. Extra credit opportunities.
The professor keeps lectures fun by including power points, videos, stories, and accurate examples. I think that these items all really made the material stick with me.
The class was interesting as a whole. Kalanzi was very helpful in explaining the concepts in class and providing useful and world related information.

If you need to take intro to sociology, take her! Professor Kalanzi is absolutely amazing! She is such a caring and kind professor. She will actually take the time to learn your name if you attend class regularly. Her tests are not hard, pretty much common sense. TAKE HER! She is amazing!

Kalanzi's class was SO easy. You only have to show up to lectures if you want extra credit, which you really don't even need because all of her tests including the final are online. You can find almost all answers to them online, as well. She's a very kind woman and is easy to work with. Definitely would recommend!

Kalanzi is a super sweet lady but if you don't make an A in this class then something is seriously wrong with you. All of the tests are online even the final. You don't even have to go to class just if you want extra credit. Such an easy class like it's unbelievable that it's even considered to be a college course lol.
Kalanzi's class was great. The lectures were straightforward, and the tests were online and doable from home. You can get extra credit if you show up to class sometimes! Easy A!
Kalanzi is fine. Nothing to complain about the class. Participation and attendance doesn't matter for the most part only that sometimes she'll count it as extra credit.

By far the easiest course I've ever taken.  Attendance is not mandatory, however she does offer extra credit points for those that attend.  All exams are online.  There is no excuse for failing this class.

This class was the easiest college class I had taken! All of the tests are online and every test day, she cancels class and you an literally just take the test in bed. Attendance isn't mandatory but she gives around 4-5 extra credit points per test if you showed up to class.
Easiest college class I've ever taken. Attendance isnt mandatory, but she gives out extra credit opportunities. If you don't make an A in this class then somethings wrong with you.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I did not get a desired grade in this class.  However, I enjoyed the course.  We had to write a significant amount of papers.  If you want to pass, keep up with these papers.  Otherwise, her exams are fair.  The professor is nice and will try to work with you. No hard feelings about the grade.

Let's start with the positive: participation matters, lots of papers but only few exams. Negatives: I feel that she is not really helpful when it comes down to emails, better luck on emailing her about anything. She will only reinforce what she previously stated without explaining what she meant before. It was frustrating and inconsiderate.

I really enjoyed Medical Sociology with Dr. Kalanzi.  Deadlines exist.  She may work with you though based on circumstances.  I liked her classes.  Grading was fair.  I found her funny at times.  Good professor.

Took this as an elective. It was a hybrid course, half in class and half online. Her lectures are fairly dry but assignments are easy. You must read the textbook for the quizzes for the full points. She often makes weird comments that should not be said to students. She has an accent that is sometimes hard to understand.

I am 100% sure this professor writes her own reviews. I mean just read them. The material is easy but you must read. Lectures notes help. She sometimes makes offensive comments that she thinks are funny. She also encourages at least one student to fail each semester so that it makes her look good to her boss. She said not everybody can get A's.

She knows the content well, and taught it well. She gives real world examples and videos to help understand the material which was helpful.  Pleasant to work with. She wants you to take your own notes.  Makes one take an active role in their learning.  Slow lecture pace.  I love her access.  It is I think African.

She takes extra credit for roll. This encourages not to skip class, and rewards those who are diligent to come. Involves students through discussions in class, allows for a broader intake of knowledge from those with different backgrounds and opinions, which in turn, creates a nice diversity within the classroom.

Excellent professor. I did not score the best on my exams when they were timed online, but her teaching style is excellent. I have learned a lot in this course and I really have had a different view point in today's world than what I did have before taking the class. She explains something and given several examples verbally and orally. Her power p

She's a good teacher in that she understands that students have a life outside of school. Her powerpoints don't make sense a lot of the time time and neither does what she say. The quizzes aren't hard but you do need to read the textbook pages as well as review her notes.

The hot pepper on here made me question if I was in the right class. Y'all, she is old. However, her class isn't so bad. Only issue I have is that she posts deadlines for the quizzes on syllabus but  then tells you there is no real deadline. She also tells you she doesn't accept late work.
Her lectures are good as long as you go to class and pay attention. She will give helpful information about what will be on the test

Dr Kalanzi, enforces the things that need more studying, discussions are brief but effective, power points are very clear to understand but only available in class.  You have to write your own notes. She knows what she is talking about, knows the subject matter, and knows what is required and fit for the class level.  Took her as a college junior.
The professor presents the information in a way that makes sense and is easy to follow. She also gives us the opportunity to participate in class discussions.  She has a unique accent.  I like it.

Kalanzi is a great Professor. Her way of presenting all the required materials is excellent. I like her interactive PowerPoint slides and the movies related to what we were learning. She taught us as much as she could from the book and did so very well.

She gave a worldwide perspective and I learned way more relevant and important lessons than I expected too. She was engaging in her students and made a point to explain topics in different ways and to have class discussions.

Dr. Kalanzi manages to be both adorable and incredibly intelligent. She's an incredible sociologist, but breaks it down to a level that everyone can understand. She makes sure she brings in video clips or readings to class that will help tie in what we're learning to the real world. Just make sure you study; sociology is all about vocabulary.

The professor took a holistic view in her teaching and allowed students to implement their perception of a certain topic into her teachings. This allowed students of varying cultures to help better define a subject she had been teaching which presented a better picture of the topic.

Professor Kalanzi is such a sweet person. On numerous occasions she has gone above and beyond to make sure that the students are learning the material. She is great about utilizing instructional technology in addition to lecturing. This added an interesting dynamic to the course. She definitely has a passion for the subject matter

Great individual, great teacher, her tests were just very hard. Her lectures do not cover all material in tests. Reading is a MUST to fill in the gaps for her class. Very helpful and readily available to work with students. Just be prepared: it is not an EASY A, but it is obtainable if you strive for it. And also, she forgets to take attendance.

I agree with the majority of respondents to RateMyProfessor.  Dr. Kalanzi is a very good professor.  She is well read in the area of Sociology.  Her classes are enjoyable and she really cares about students. I also really love her accent. It is exceptional. I love diversity because not everyone has to be British. I plan to take her again

The quality of Dr. Kalanzi's lectures is very good. The material is thoroughly covered and well explained. I really appreciated and liked that my professor had a very culturally diverse background and well rounded understanding of other cultures; it made the class much more enjoyable and easy to understand. I would take more of her courses.

Dr. Kalazni was quite funny, which made her lectures more enjoyable.  I loved how Dr. Kalanzi stressed the importance of note-taking. I feel like this is an important skill that every college student should excel in, and I'm glad this professor encouraged our growth in it.  Dr. Kalazni was quite funny, which made her lectures more enjoyable.

She suffers from a very strong African accent and struggles when the class participates because she may not understand your answer. EC for attendance. Final wasn't cumulative. Her lectures are boring. She's very, very nice. No real HW. Study the textbook for an A.
Extremely helpful, considerate, and super nice. She will work with you and makes sure that you complete all assignment. She is awesome. Gives you great notes!
Professor Kalanzi is a very sweet teacher! She loves sociology but her lectures are boring and you really don't have to go as long as you get the notes or read. Easy class.

She is so sweet! She has an accent but once you get used to it you won't even notice. Her class was easy. She gives good feedback on several topics. She also gives out extra credit assignments but you must go to class in order to do them. You don't need the book but it helps out if you don't go to class one day! She takes attendance so go to class!

Dr. Kalanzi is a good professor.  But be ready to learn how to take your own notes.  Which was good for me. I was so used to getting everything handed down to me. But hey I had to take an active role in learning.  Interesting course.

Dr. Kalanzi is very helpful when you go see her during office hours  Her lectures move fast, but the book supplements the information you may miss.  She would come late to class or class would be slow to start.  The only grades you get are exams, no homework and limited extra credit.
Very good professor.  I enjoyed her class. Always looked forward to it.
I did learn a lot from this class.  It was informative. Very good professor. Very nice too.
Very good professor. I really loved her. I also liked her Ugandan accent. Easy to understand. She did a good job in the course I took with her. I am glad I had her. Very understanding.

She has a VERY thick Ugandan accent and doesn't talk very loud, so sometimes it's difficult to understand her. She also doesn't allow electronic notetaking but you can get away with it on a tablet or other device. She was late to class and always wasted time starting class and letting us out early. She's a pretty good professor overall though.

A lot of students don't like her, but Prof. Kalanzi is one of the main reasons why I chose to minor in Sociology. Her course is fun, she's an interesting person, and if you can get past her thick Ugandan accent (which I actually find very pretty), she's a good professor. Tests are easy if you take notes, skim each chapter, and study beforehand.
This is a good professor. She will expect you to take your own notes though. Which is OK as she wants students to keep up the skill of taking their own notes.  I enjoyed the course. I recommend her.
I liked this course.  I could take my own notes so I did not need any PowerPoint Outlines. I recommend the course.
I took Dr. Kalanzi. She is a nice professor and very helpfuld. I enjoyed this class. She had good powerpoints. Good visuals. I recommend taking her class.
Awesome professor. The class is exciting. I learned a lot from the class. We covered many various topics. I recommend this class.
Very interesting class.  Enthusiastic professor. Very knowledgeable.  Cares about students.  I liked her.  My roommate took her and recommended her to me. Take her if you can.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. Very unhelpful and she's from Uganda so you literally cannot understand a single thing she says. She doesn't put her powerpoints online and she takes attendance- sometimes foe extra credit although it was like 1 point. DO NOT TAKE!
Good professor. My friend recommended her to me. I was not disappointed.I really enjoyed the course.
I really enjoyed this course. The grading was fair and we did get lots of extra credits.  Take Dr. Kalanzi if you get an opportunity. She takes a global perspective.

This is a good professor.  I really enjoyed her Medical Sociology course.  She was nice.  We also got enough extra credits if we played our part in learning.  I highly recommend her, especially with this course.  Good to see the Sociological view of the medical field.
I really enjoyed taking Dr. Kalanzi's course.  I always looked forward to coming to class. I also enjoyed her sense of humor. Ha! Good for the mind.

This professor is very bad she does not provide any reviews for exams, nor help outside of class. Also no extra credit, and is MANDATORY that you attend her class since she doesn't provide any notes or power points online. Everything you learn you learn it from the notes you take and that's how you study for exams. AVOID her, do not take her class!
This is a good professor.  I liked her Medical Sociology class.  She helped me develop a Sociological Perspective on day to day situations.
Dr. Kalanzi is so nice.  Her expectations are reasonable, and clearly laid out.  If you do the reading which is fairly easy you  will make an A!

Prof. Kalanzi is really adorable and nice. She usually tells you which questions will be on the test, but you have to read the textbook for extra vocabulary. Attendance is required (she takes role), and she gives out a lot of extra credit in class.

She is a really good professor. She requires attendance as she grades 5% of the total from the attendance. She gives a lot of extra credit stuff and 3 exams in all. It is quite easy to get an A if you pay attention in the class.

Look, Dr Fernandez is an amazing guy and absolutely hilarious. His lectures are amazing and he genuinely wants you to succeed. The thing is, his grading practice is abhorent. Your grade is sectioned and youre graded by the lowest one. You could have a 100% exam and HW grade but your final is mid and you get a B, etc. Also, exams can be very random
Very clear about what you need to do and very helpful after class. Just do your work and it should be a easy 100%. DON'T PROCRASTINATE ON THE FINAL PROJECT.

reviews.comment: Dr. Fernandez himself is wonderful. Lectures are lively and open for discussion, but content is not usually covered even though attendance is mandatory. Make sure you read the textbook and watch his canvas videos. Exams are often strangely worded, and he goes by the idea that multiple answers can be justified but there is a single best answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Test heavy, study well, take notes on the textbook (not as much) and the video lecture as the video covers most of the textbook. Group project from what I've checked online gets harder each semester for some reason. Be prepared to learn how to model, code and electrical stuff for the project for this "introduction" class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Make sure you get a clear understanding of the syllabus grading criteria from day one. Its noting like any class you have taken in the past. you could get an A on every single assignment/exam/project and if you miss more than 6 lectures you automatically fail. Overall he's a hilarious person but be prepared for very time consuming work.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super passionate and expressive man. Really cool dude, but he is a no-nonsense kind of fella, and I think that's where the negative reviews stem from. Grades done with CAD, engineering design-related homework, and memory-based tests. Get ready to read and memorize random details in the book.

reviews.comment: He's a funny and engaging guy that is actually passionate with his professing, but the class curriculum is structured to be done outside of lecture. Tests are pretty memory based so make quizlets. The grading criteria is meant to weed you out so try not to drop out of the class, C's are common. Don't go on reddit to find group partners.

reviews.comment:
It doesn't matter what the rating is there is only 1 professor 
He will DEFINITELY PUT THE Final EXAM ON THE DAY Of CALCULUS SO IT BETTER NOT TO TAKE CAL WITH IT

Class is test heavy, study well on your test. Take good notes of the video lecture, the textbook isn't really needed since the video lecture covers most but should still read it. Group project from what I have checked gets harder each year, start the project early if you can.

reviews.comment: he's nice but that's... about it. doesn't really lecture about the content on the exam in class, but attendance is mandatory + you need to buy an iclicker. grading system lowk sucks, homework isn't bad, and make sure you have a good group for the final project. you 100% NEED to read the textbook and watch lecture videos to pass the class. good luck

reviews.comment: This professor does not teach anything. Attendance is mandatory, yet lectures cover no meaningful content. He is absolutely terrible in his role as an educator. The class could be easy if he actually made an effort to teach, but instead it's difficult. His grading rubric is poorly designed. Worst of all, he's the only professor available for 1351.

reviews.comment: One of the Hilarious professor at UTA. I know he is the only professor for 1351 at UTA, His exam are super tricky, lecture never helped me, for attendance you need Iclicker. be ready to prepare yourself before taking his class.

He is very clear from the start of what he expects from you, gives help whenever he can, and he CARES about your success.This is not an easy course, if you want to do well on exams you MUST read the given chapters and watch video lectures given (study key terms well). For the group project start early , communicate with your team and ask questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lectures are mandatory (get an iClicker secondhand) but a waste of time.  Pay attention to the criteria for each grade; if you do not meet one of them, they will not round up!  Alongside, the tests are too nitpicky and rely heavily on if you can decipher his wording.  Also, work on the final project ASAP.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: love the professor but hate the class. READ THE SYLLABUS!!! This class is a weed-out course for sure, so get ready. The grading is set in stone, NO exceptions are made (even if you fail by one point). You will be learning on your own time (video lectures/textbook) AND SHOW UP TO CLASS!! I had friends fail due to attendance :'(

He's a good professor and he really cares about his students. I think the class is just hard, so don't procrastinate anything. The textbook readings can be a lot, so I would dedicate time to reviewing the textbook every week. Overall, he's a nice professor and is really open to talking to you about your project. Don't trust the FABLAB for printing
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Honestly. Worst class I've ever taken, the definition of a weed out class. The grading rubric is ridiculous having grade “requirements” instead of the normal standard of averages. TONS of material to study for exams but even that won't get you far, you would have better luck studying the Quizlets. Would not recommend, but he's the only professor .…
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Fernandez taught an online GD&T course for MAE4301. It is remote, and while interesting, just not very engaging. I feel like I just memorize information, rather than actually applying the concepts. Also the lecture videos are boring when the textbook covers the same material as one of these videos in a single paragraph.

Had to drop bc of the insane exams PLUS the weird grading system. If taking 1351, you will have to listen to the in-person lectures, watch the online lectures ~2x a week, and then read the chapter in the book to even consider getting a 70 on the exams. Exams pull RANDOM niche information from all 3, so it's hard to study. Sem-long group project.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Do your homework early and start on your project early. Try to find people who are good with coding (Arduino) and comfortable with CAD. Tests are pretty difficult and tricky, so try to take note of everything in the book and lecture videos.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr Fernandez post's online lectures and those are incredibly helpful towards passing the three tests. I would suggest watching them over before every test. I do wish his lectures were more substantive. Many of the in person lectures were not well thought out and I didn't find much value in them. I wished he focused on teaching during them.
This class is easy but gets very difficult if you procrastinate the online lectures or starting on the final project. Almost all students failed from the final project or poor attendance.

Dr. F is a very kind and understanding person, and he does his absolute best to see his students succeed. You can 1000% tell he cares a bunch about each student, his class is just difficult for many freshmen students. The only critique I have of this course is the annoying mandatory attendance policy, but everything else is good, simply lengthy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is a great professor, The Course is difficult but very doable. If you are a slacker you will fail, but if you study a reasonable amount you will pass just fine. Study the sections of the book and the videos (neither are very long) and Don't procrastinate on the Project. If you truly want to be an engineer you will enjoy this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Going in to this class I had read all of the warnings, but what I found was not really the same. I think that Dr. Fernandez really wants to see his students succeed. The tests' phrasing is confusing but as long as you watch the video lectures and read the textbook you should be fine. Oh and start on the project early or it will get you.
don't take him
I wouldn't recommend this professor but it seems like he's the gate keeping lecture are pretty much useless but mandatory expect for this class to take up a lot of your time.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This professor is bad. He's the only professor you can take for 1351 and he knows it. He does whatever he wants and has a horrible attitude. He thinks he's nice because he abides by the "policies". The dude is more strict than my Asian parents. All I can say is get ready to make this class your life If u want to get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Start HW as soon as it's assigned, go to all lectures, and start that stupid final project as early as you can. Please please read the grading criteria, it's assigned very early on, but if you don't pay attention your final project will be "non-compliant" and you will fail the course. The exams are rough, take textbook notes, skim videos, quizlet.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
He is funny, thats where it ends on the good part though.
You are required to buy an expensive "iClicker" you won't use ever again and are required to pay (out of pocket) for materials and tools to complete the final project.
He does not lecture, instead directs us towards videos online (Not kidding!) and the grade feedback is very very vague.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Guy is the gate keeper of the ME degree. This class will really test you if you really want to become a Mechanical Engineer. When ppl say that this is a weed out course, they are not kidding tons of people dropped it within the first 2 weeks. I can't stress this enough but start the hws as early as possible, theyre long and take forever to complete
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: All of his lectures are recorded but attendance is MANDATORY. You have to buy a $50 Iclicker for attendance. Grading policy sucks because everything is weighed the same. He's pretty strict and does everything "by the books". His lectures/class doesn't really prepare for the big project at the end of the semester. READ THE BOOK AND WATCH THE VIDS!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: READ THE BOOK, most of the test is from this. Lectures not worth it but attendance is mandatory or you will fail. Test are worded in a tricky way (hardest part of it). Knowing SolidWorks beforehand is a big help. His grading criteria is ridiculously strict but very valid tbh. Most of the class is just an accumulation of pass/fail. Genuinely cares
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The lectures were pointless but mandatory for a passing grade. He makes you buy an iclicker to keep track of attendance throughout class, you have to answer all or most of the questions or you are counted absent. The exams have multiple correct answers, and he says to choose the most correct answer. You also cannot see which questions you answered incorrectly.

reviews.comment: She is an excellent lecturer, she does take attendance but honestly her lectures are worth coming to. Take notes, review the study guide and you will pass.
if you take her lecture class make sure you have the powerpoints ready! Just make sure to read the chapters and study the powerpoint materials.
Condescending and alright lectures but homework heavy no help during times of need
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Funny and intelligent with clear course expectations and easy-to-navigate materials. Approachable and uses applicable examples to teach. Great professor if you want to learn and face a slight challenge.

Prof. Froidevaux is a super sweet professor! I had her for both lab and lecture and she was great. Her lectures can be a little bit lengthy, but she thoroughly covers all the topics. The exams are not bad at all. 40 questions and if you review the study guide, you'll make a minimum B. The group project is lowkey tedious.. but not too terrible! :D

Everything she does is very particular to her, but it is in a way that makes it fair for everyone in the class. Her class is heavily lecture-based with videos to help supplement the material. You take open-note quizzes every week and you have a big group project. She brings a ton of real-life experience into her lectures which I appreciated.

She was my lecture professor. If you can't make it in person, you have to watch her through ECHO and get the attendance code for the attendance quiz. There are 3 exams all multiple choice with locked down browser and webcam. Her study guide is exactly like the test but some questions you will have to guess on. Five chapters per test! Get ready
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! Wants the best for you! Best grad class to start my Master's in HR Management!

I highly encourage you to take any course with Dr. Froidevaux. I can only say great things about her. She is easily accessible, easy to understand, Swiss (so she's got a cool accent), an easy/clear grader, and really passionate about the topic. Seriously, take Dr. Froidevaux. You will not regret it.

Take notes and fill out the review material given; that will prepare you for the tests pretty well. Harder topics are also reviewed in the lab. Group project is the hardest in my opinion, there is a lot of work & steps that go into it. The lab contains all the work, the lectures are only a small percentage of the grade. Easy but PACE YOURSELF!!

She is a great professor really knows her stuff, and attend lectures to get an attendance code. She provides a study guide for each exam, fill it out every class and you will have your study guide easily. Most of the grade comes from your assignments in the lab, choose your lab instructor wisely. I liked Correy Retzloff for the lab portion.

Professor Froidevaux has a very easy chill class if you are looking for an easy grade.The downside though is to be careful with attendance because something went wrong with my echo 360 live where I didn't get attendance code. I told her about the issue and she confirmed that I was in class but still gave no points because of her rules. be careful

Group project that counts as the final. Give yourself enough time to do the project = 25% of your grade. Some assignments throughout the semester are for the project. 3 exams & study guides for them. DO THEM! Exams are online and ind. assignments that you do aren't hard. Attendance is a grade, lets you miss 10 days tho. She has a small accent.

VERY HARD GRADER! I should've dropped out when I had the chance to do so. Make sure you turn in all your assignments and stay on top of the group project and all syllabus requirements. I didn't enjoy anything about the class, she's a very bright Professor but her teaching doesn't seem to be the right one for this class' level.

TOUGH GRADER. A lot of group assignments. Her exams are designed to fail the students. Just knowing the basic concept of the topic isn't going to help. A lot of students from our class failed and dropped her class. She teaches great but exam questions are really hard.

Get ready to learn. Solid professor the workload can feel overwhelming at times but once you actually get around starting it, its not bad at all. Be prepared for group projects and study well for the exams. Her study guides are essential.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: I loved her!! She had her class material up and organized 2 weeks before school started. Helpful for getting ahead. Everything is prerecorded, paired with its assignments, etc. There are weekly tedious assignments but are easy as all as you know the material. Group project, 6 people, given in start and due at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Froidevaux is intelligent and wants students to be able to apply lectures to real life. There are approximately 6 short assignments every week that are to done after watching the lectures. HOWEVER, there is a group project worth 30% of your grade with 7 other members. THIS IS NOT REALISTIC IN AN ASYNCHRONOUS SETTING!!! 20 min presentation
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: Great professor and always gives detailed feedback on assignments. Must put in the work to receive an A, very rewarding.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: she's honestly a good professor she cares about us, and gives feedback pretty quick, for a first time professor at UTA she's doing well compared to others. she's gives out a good amount of extra credit (enough to change your letter grade), exams are a bit hard they're generally scenario and definition, the HR paper is simple just read the slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Super easy class and she's very nice. Just get work done and you're gonna pass attendance is not mandatory, I was barely in her class and still got an A, she responds to email so quickly, it was so amazing having her as a professor
Easy classes and lectures, you don't have to attend lectures but its helpful. Since you meet once a week, you have a lot of time to do the work.

Ms. Jawad is amazing—her class was so easy, and the work she gives out is mainly watching movies and answering questions about the art in the movie or art escape rooms. If you need to take any art/film class, I recommend you take her. Anything she teaches is an easy A.

Very fun professor. Took her for art appreciation and every lecture was engaging with kahoot (didn't use kahoot but something similar) style presentations. Discussions are due at the end of the day lecture day and a couple of "projects" throughout the course. Doing the homework and attending class will give you an easy A for sure.
She really cares about your projects, and she is helpful.
Lover her!

Lectures can be boring and doesn't teach as it just examples on top of examples which isn't useful and her technique can be hard/bad depending on your knowledge already. It's easier to self teach yourself than what she can teach in lecture. Very caring I guess with extra credits given.
Very forgiving grading with the tests. Also is very passionate about students being able to learn in the classroom. Wants engagement and offers a ton of extra credit for it. Also is very funny

Very kind and gives the most extra credit out of any class I've ever had. I didn't find her lectures very helpful for exams, but she posts every possible question and answer on her study guides, so you'll be fine as long as you study them. The few assignments outside of those are also very easy. I'd recommend if you don't mind attending lectures!

we spent a week and a half learning how to add vectors. (Something we almost never had to do) and we spent 40 minutes going over simple harmonic motion (the most difficult unit) which was 1/5th of our final exam. We also completely missed the entire last unit and spent 0 time ever going over it. Horrible time management, the worst lectures.

Just pick her. You won't regret it. I picked her for fall 2025, and I think it is the best decision I ever made. She genuinely wants all her students to pass, and is extremely nurturing as well. There Is also ALOT of extra credit opportunity. And only 2 of your best midterm grades are counted. All MCQ questions throughout the course as well!

Is a month behind the other physics professor. Needs to give 40 points of extra credit per student to have a normal curve. Lectures are the worst lectures I've ever experienced and some days she just repeats her entire confusing terrible lecture a second day in a row. Which is why we are so behind the rest of the department. Avoid at all costs.

She is a very nice lady who offers lots of extra credit. So much so I received a failing grade on an exam and it went up to over a 100. Her lectures are awful. She repeates the same information over and over again. Has little to no practice problems. You will be a month behind the other professors. Her lectures are so bad I sometimes leave and cry
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Honestly best professor this semester. She's super nice and helpful.
nice teacher, you will be able to pass if you just try.
Dr. Jafaari is a nice teacher shes very sweet and gives A LOT of extra credit. However I would be lying if I said I learned from her class.. goes on tangents..

Ms. Jaafari is very nice, but wow I never taken a class where the teacher is so unorganized. She will not allow you to take notes saying "you need to pay attention to me" but you really don't since the 4 tests she gives you are on LockDown Browser. The Test review are already filled out but each test has 250 review questions with only 50 on test.

Dr. Jaafari is the best professor at UTA. She gives tons of extra credit opportunities and her class is divided up into 4 tests. 3 of which can be taken online 1 in person (the final). If you look at the study sheets a week before tests then you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I absolutely LOVED Dr. Jaafari. I think she is amazing, and so kind and understanding. She wants you to be able to understand the material and will work with you if you don't understand. She gives ample opportunity for extra credit IF you apply yourself to it. If you fail this class, in my opinion, it is your own fault. She provides so much help!

Professor Jaafari is a nice lady, but her teaching style leaves much to be desired. The lectures can be disorganized, and the textbook is often more helpful than going to class. Luckily, resources like Unstuck AI can supplement the course material.

All exams online except final. Her lectures…. Useless to go to in my opinion and the class just kept getting emptier and emptier. Her final was pretty hard and average was in the 50's. I really wanted to take her to help with the MCAT but she is not the right professor to take if you actually want to learn something.
Not good at teaching. Tangets. Lectures were bad and the topics were poorly explained :(

She offers plenty of extra credit. Her lectures can be very scattered, and honestly I stopped going after a few weeks. Her tests are pretty hard, but they come right from the digitral textbook. A very sweet lady and very knowledgable!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is a really friendly and helpful professor and put so much efforts to make the class enjoyable.

She does not know how to teach the concepts of this course.  Most classes she would just go on tangents and start class as soon as it was about to end, then proceed to hold us over 20+ minutes to teach.  She constantly repeats the exact same concepts without giving examples to make it make sense.

accommodating, but not really in a good sense (will change due dates with no warning and is very bad at sending out alerts). she gets distracted easily and tends to go on tangents, so the class is pretty much self-taught. if you're pre-med or don't have a good foundation in physics (or just want to stay sane) stay the hell away from her class.

She isn't the worst physics professor. You will manage to at least pass the class if you try. She tries to make her lecture interesting but they are hard to understand. She is very lenient with due dates and gives a lot of extra credit

I would not recommend her class to my worst enemy. Just avoid her at all cost if you are unlucky get the textbook that shes using is it called Giancoli, read it by yourself and solve the problems. Going to her class would leave you more perplexed.

Truly a nice and caring professor.  Her grading policy is very generous as well: 25% hw and lab each - fairly easy to do but take caution.  Takes best of 2 of 3 midterms.  Downsides are: her lectures are nightmarish, notes presentations are almost useless to go by; takes too long to explain concept/question; expect to mostly SELF STUDY

Professor is nice, but poor time management for MWF, 1 hr, classes. I dropped after about 3 weeks, after she took up to 20 minutes after the scheduled time to begin the lecture and then kept going on an important topic at least 10 minutes after the scheduled end time.

Avoid her sections if you do not have a strong physics background.
Honestly, I dont know what I am doing taking this professor. Shes terrible, Avoid at all cost.

Shes a nice lady but teaching isn't for everyone. Her lectures are everywhere, and her time management is terrible. She doesn't give enough examples. She does give extra credit but I don't recommend her class if you have no physics background.

This is a self-study class. Dr. Jaafari is a kind person but her lectures consist of skimming over concepts and teaching general physics instead of calc-based. This would be off-putting for tests because you weren't used to the difference, and she'd often take up class working on one problem. Overall an okay class if you put in the work.

I had professor Jaafari for ASTR 1346 online asynchronous. There's reading assignments due every week (no time limit so plenty of time to complete), biweekly discussion posts and exams on lockdown browser w/ webcam. Make sure to study thoroughly for the exams as there are questions here & there that focus on the tiniest details of the textbook.

Dr. Jaafari is a very good professor. If you took AP Physics in high school, this class will be a breeze. She sometimes overcomplicates simple concepts, but maybe that's my bias because I'm pretty good at physics already. Offers extra credit on the exam if you review thermodynamic chapters. Homeworks aren't hard, if you're having trouble google it.
You will need a little bit of prior physics knowledge but khan academy helps a lot! She is VERY understanding of her students when it comes to due dates. Overall lovely person. I will miss her! :)

The kindest and sweetest soul ever. She is so caring and really wants her students to succeed. She provides so many extra credit opportunities. Quizzes can be challenging if you dont know the material but I definitely learned a lot. I personally never used the book.

We had to switch to online due to the virus, however, she is a really understanding professor. she allowed me to boost my grade last minute with some extra credit assignments and she is extremely quick to respond to her emails. I would take her again and focus strongly on what she is trying to teach us. I would 100% recommend it to anyone starting.

I took her Physics 2 class for summer and it was not that bad. She did a live lecture going over a few concepts but did not follow with the power points provided. She did not go over many math problems but did fully explain 1 or 2 questions that would help with homework assignments and quizzes. She is a nice professor that will help you pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Jaafari is not the best lecturer after the switch to online class, but she is very caring and will accommodate for her students as much as possible. Tests are only 40% of your grade, so this helps a lot. Quizzes are open notes as well and represents the exams! She gives a good amount of extra credit as well.

She is awesome! She takes time to explain difficult topics and she really cares about your grade. If you attend her lectures, she gives out extra credit points if you are one of the first to answer her question. She also gives an extra credit assignment to further boost your grade.

Seemed to never understand that the majority of students in her class have little to no background in physics. Always treated us like physics majors. Tests and quizzes never reflected homework or lecture. Quizzes and tests often had typos and/or incorrect answer keys. Would only give back credit when asked. Do NOT take her course.

Lectures are fun. Dr. Jaafari explains and shows interesting videos on YouTube. Love the discussion part but you need to memorize the Tests questions to make high grades. She requires us to present topics as teams, it was fun but lots of prep. Very helpful professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Physics is hard but professor Jafarri made it simple and clear. She was always available when I had a question. Physics is definitely not my strongest subject but I earned an A due to her many examples and solving problems. I enjoyed all her lectures. I would take her again and again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Even though attendance is not required but if you attend her class she will do her best to help. Dr. Jaafari one of the best professors I ever had. Teaches with passion and gives lots of examples and extra credit. She gave me many chances extending the HWs. If she teaches the second part I will take her again.

Really good professor for physics. Quiz over each chapter and the tests are really similar to the quizzes. She goes over main topics in class but definitely read the book. Homework is tough, a lot harder than exams. Grading scale is really helpful - midterms only 30% total. More conceptual questions than calculations, so go to class!
REALLY PASSIONATE PROFESSOR!! you do not get to meet lots of those now a days! Would highly recommend taking your class to any of my friends who have to take physics.

Dr. Jaafari is a great prof to take. She is very kind and a has a really funny personality. Shes very understanding and is always willing to help if you dont understand something. If youre thinking about taking one of her classes, you definitely should!

Had Fajer for Physics and let me tell you, she is the most personal professor I've ever had. Will explain things to you 100 times if you say you don't get it. Do the HW and study guides and you will pass EASY. Kept things interesting with videos during class. Lover her!!!!

This is my second semester taking Dr. Jaafari for Astronomy. She worked very diligently to make sure that her students were successful. Her tests are online and they are in lock-down browser (No Webcam). She is very accessible out side of class and responds back to emails quickly. She has a clear interest in the subject. I will miss her class!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Lectures are worthless but you can't skip because she has daily quizzes. She ends up showing useless videos on YouTube. Her tests are hard because, although she gives review questions, she will give 175 review questions and choose 50 of those questions. Oh and by the way, most of the questions are over material she has never talked about. Horrible.

While she's a really nice prof and really cares about her students' learning, her lectures are largely pointless. You learn so much more in the Lab and she doesn't really teach you anything, she just gets stuck on certain topics and spends a lot of time showing videos that aren't even educational. She's a wonderful lady but not a good teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I absolutely love Dr. Jaafari!!! She is one of the sweetest professors I have ever had. The textbook is not needed as her slides which are on blackboard are from the book. There are 3 tests and a final. She drops the lowest test grade and gives lots of extra credit. She gives you the answers to the tests, just study and you will have an easy A.

I love Dr. Jaafari! I was skeptical to take her class at first but Im so glad I did. Theres absolutely no homework, only like 5 discussion posts throughout the semester. Also the tests are online, except the final (she gives us the questions and answers for us to study). She is such a doll, I wish I could take her class again.

STEER CLEAR. Jafaari was extremely unclear of her expectations for assignments but would take late assignments. Attendance is not mandatory but there are some in class iClicker quizzes. She was hard to understand and not helpful at all when someone would ask her a question in or out of class.

Try not to fall asleep. Just talks and shows Youtube videos. Tells you the lesson plan for next week so you know when to come for quizzes and tests. Four tests, gives you questions and answers before hand but gives 200 and only uses 50. Two tests were online, all answers on quizlet. Has a few discussions that you read to the class (if you come).

Her lectures are a bit confusing, but she gave us a packet of questions and answers to study and chose fifty to put on the test, study those it will be a breeze. She gives clicker quizzes in class, posts a few discussions and planetarium shows that bring your grade up, and one group presentation. It's an easy class if you turn in all of your work.

I loved taking her physics 1 class and am now taking her physics 2 class. She really tries her best to be engaged with the students and make the material accessible. She is also very helpful and responds to emails pretty quickly. She obviously has a lot of work she's balancing, but I think she's a genuine person and an encouraging teacher.
all i have to say is EVERYTHING IS ON QUIZLET !! :)

She's a terrible teacher who is very unorganized and can't teach at all. It takes her 2 classes to solve for a linear system of 2 equations in this intro to physics class. Dont be fooled by taking the positive reviews that was all made up by her(same pattern). Terrible instructor. Please take someone else if you want to learn and do well.

Although her PP slides are filled with info, reading the book is a huge supplement. She posts homework for credit and very random Clicker quizzes. Her exams are about 50 questions and are timed. The homework is 50 questions and not timed. If you do all your homework assignments, pass your online exams, and do well on your final, no reason to fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Sharp and knowledgeable, sometimes she discusses  an interesting weird Astronomy topics and sometimes talks about things above our level  of understanding but in a cool way. Her tests are easy but the quizzes are tough and confusing. I am planning to take her Astro 1346. I l enjoy her class, she is an interesting teacher and fun

Truly an amazing teacher. No boring moments. The discussions she brings to the class is interesting. I love the clips. I am enjoying this course   Her slides are good to study and prepare for Homeworks and Tests. The Hws are not difficult at all. But even the tests are similar to HW questions but with are more difficult. I am making an A so far.

You must attend  all her lectures and pay attention, study her slides carefully . Doing that and watching all interesting clips I passed with an A. Sometimes, she is hard to understand but is open to explain. Exams and HWs are multiple choice some are difficult but she drops the lowest test grade. The best part is thfinal recycling of HWs questions
Great teacher loved her both classes

Dr. Jaafari knows the material but she is just very unorganized ABOUT EVERYTHING! Her lectures are confusing and hard to sit through. She also gives quizzes for attendance but the questions are confusing and hard to answer. An A is possible with the homework and exams because all answers can be found in the textbook or online.

Easy A because all homework and test answers can be found on quizlet. Her in-class quizzes are pretty ridiculous but don't sweat it because as long as you're present for ALL, get A's on your homework and tests, you'll be just fine. It's boring but you don't need to pay attention. I suggest bring other homework to keep yourself occupied. No textbook

She goes over information that is on her slides so just listen. It's not really critical to take notes. Her in class quizzes (iClicker) are tough though, so you should actually listen to her. Don't sweat the online homework/tests, if you don't know the answers, it's very likely they are on quizlet (use the find function in Google) HW helps studying

Dr. Jaafari is a very sweet lady, but her lectures were almost intolerable. She jumps around A LOT, and students who have little knowledge of astronomy will be very lost! The questions for the quizzes, homework, and tests are often poorly worded and the answer choices were VERY similar. It made it  very difficult to answer them correctly!

As long as you show up and take notes, do the homework, and study you'll make an easy A. A lot of her test questions come from the homework. All multiple choice. Sometimes she even has planetarium visits for the class, which is fun! If you're looking for an easy science credit this is it.

Dr. Jaafari has a great knowledge in astronomy and she shows her passion for astronomy as well as her passion for teaching it. She loves when people ask questions or participate. Expect homework at least one every week,  but they are not hard. You take 3 exams and a final and she will drop the lowest exam grade. Over all, an easy class to take.

Dr. Fajer is a wonderful  teacher. She makes you actually understand Astronomy and love it. She lets you question everything you knew though, amazing!!. Still you have to work for your grade. I like the HWs and tests, not complicated. Just participate, study the slides and watch the movies then you are ok. Love this professor!

I took cal physics I  with Dr. Jaafari at TCU, it was a hard course but she broke it down to simplify it. She gave examples during the lectures some were on the tests. She gave three tests but dropped the lowest one which helped tremendously. I liked the  pre tests quizzes as extra credit. However the Online Homework was confusing. good teacher

Dr. Jaafari is an involved and invested instructor here at TCU. She tries her very best to ensure that every student understands the core concepts in the introductory physics courses, so expect that the course can progress slowly at times. However, she tries to meet every student half-way by giving them opportunities to recover and succeed.

I took her physics I (calculus based) class as a basic course for engineering. The lab that accompanied the course taught me more than she did. Consistently hard to understand because she learned physics in Arabic. It's not the accent that's hard- it's her inability to communicate properly. I had to teach myself the material and go by common sense.

Took her class twice. She was good, knew her material. In both classes she asked for Homeworks with so many questions but all her tests questions were directly from Home work questions which I liked. She was using clips to help us understand some difficult concepts. The lab was the difficult part but she did not teach it. I reaenjoyed her class.

Dr. Jaafari class is exciting. She turned Astronomy to fun subject by using pictures and clips. The presentations helped me understand it even more. You have to read from the book and do the Home works. Her tests questions are from the homework that helped a lot. I did not like the quizzes but I made an A in her class.

She is a good listener and responsive to her students. She was able to bridge the gap between theory concepts and practical information, that what I most liked about her.   Besides she has that nice smile and positive attitude.

Great professor. Her lectures really helped me better learn the material. She kept us engaged in lecture. She made sure to ask us questions and interacted with us. PowerPoint were helpful to prepare for tests as well as home work
The course was really hard to comprehend but Dr. Jaafari went to our speed to deliver it to the students in simple terms. She did a great job making it relevant.

Even before the end of the semester, I must say, Dr. jaafari made this course one of the best I have taken so far. She is knowledgeable of the stuff she is teaching, communicates effectively with her students, but most of all, she is a thoughtful considered teacher. All my respect to Dr. Jaafari.

Kind professor who truly cares for her students. Patient and has a class. Her Hws are tough but tests are mostly similar to HWs questions. She posts our weekly lessons plan Bb, which help us all keep track of everything. I am learning a lot of astronomy from her lectures as well as the Planetarium shows. Lovely teacher.

I like Dr. Jaafari and her lectures. She is organized and patient. She tried hard to make it interesting and exciting with lots of pictures and clips. However, we all had to study hard for tests. The good part was most of the tests questions were off the homeworks. I am taking her Atsr 1346 next semester.

Dr. Jaafari is a passionate knowledgeable professor. Every time before we start with the class, she always likes to keep us informed about what is coming up next. She tries to make the chapters material easier for us to learn. I feel like she really has the best interest of her students and not her own. I really enjoyed her class.

I like Dr. Jaafari's lectures. She  was open minded to what the students have to say. She is very concerned with how we feel in her class, which it feels great to have a professor worry about the students.

Dr Jaafari is very understanding and that is a quality I really appreciate in professors. I am a visual person, the clips she posts along with the planetarium shows are helpful when it comes to learning new things and those shows have been very informative and interesting.

I enjoyed Dr. Jaafari's Astronomy class. She is effective in communicating with her students. She persistently states the schedule in her Emails and on Blackboard. I also like that our Homeworks and the presentation are maintainable. But what I like most is that The tests questions  are similar to the HWs questions.
I have to say Dr. Jaafari an understanding person. She is a really good teacher and mentor. Her focus is on the students and their learning.

I Like Dr. Jaafari, she is a good thoughtful teacher. She is a helpful fair teacher. Learned a lot of Astronomy during the semester.  What I liked most about this class, the presentatios and the tests , just study the HWs questions to prepare for the exams, no surprises.

Dr. Jaafari is very passionate about astronomy. She always comes in positive and happy. I would have to sit through the lecture that involves discussion because I think she could make it interesting. I am taking her Astro 1346.
I think Dr. Jaafari is very kind and wants best for the class. She is very intelligent and knows the content.

I like Dr. Jaafari and her lectures. I don't want to say she an easy teacher but a good teacher, flexible and helpful. What I like most about her that our opinion matters to her and she adjusts accordingly.

I think Dr. Jaafari knows and enjoys astronomy. The idea of class presentations is a good one and we all benefited from. If you ask Dr. Jaafari for help, she is more than willing to help. I like that she is always cheerful and smiling.
Dr. Jaafari seems to be very eager to try and help the students. I liked her lectures and the flow of the course.

Dr. Jaafari is a good teacher, I learned so much astronomy. I loved the subject due to her approach to Astronomy. Doing HWs helped for the tests. She organizes the course progress by the weekly lesson plan.
Dr. jaafari is good teacher. She really cares about her students and wants them to succeed. She keeps engaging with the class. Her tests are easy if you do all HWs. I truly enjoyed her class.
Dr. Jaafari is a good teacher. Do your HWs then should be ready for the tests. She is professional, kind and organized. I am taking her Astro 1346 next semester.
Great professor.
Dr. Jaafari is a good teacher knows her material well. Kind and helpful. Her weekly lesson plan helps me stay on track.  I am taking Astronomy part 2 with her.
I just want to come to her class. She makes everything interesting and relevant. How astronomy is related to our lives She made that connection. I have learned a lot thanks Dr. Jaafari

One of the best professor. She knows what she''s talking about in Astronomy and Physics . Hws are simple straight from the book. Tests are all from HWs. Just attend and you should do fine. Love Dr. Jaafari''s lectures.

Wounderfule teacher. Kows her stuff kind and approachable. She is willing to help you understand material if you don''t get it. Always engages the students in every lecture topic. Im taking her for 1346 for spring.

I loved astronomy after her class. Made it exciting and easy to understand. She assigned presentations which helped me a lot to understand even more. Her tests are easy if you do and study the homeworks.
A great professor. The tests and homework are both conceptual and problems. If you pay attention to her lectures, you should be very fine. She's friendly and helpful. I took both physics with her.
She is very smart person, kind and helpful. Has a clear structured syllabus. Learned so much in Astronomy. I enjoyed her class, thanks Dr. Jaafari.
Dr. Jaafari was one of the best teachers I dealt with. Was organized, fair but most of all very helpful.

She is not a bad teacher but not a very good teacher either. The class is incredibly easy (if you do the homework). The tests are made from the homework she gives out. Also, if you show up to class you get extra points on your tests.
I like Dr. Jaafari. Very kind helpful teacher. She helped me understand the book  material but most of all, enjoyed Astronomy.

The course is SYNCHRONOUS, meaning she needs to teach DURING lectures but since she was so focused on not "falling behind", made us watch small recordings after if she didn't complete her lecture in 50 minutes. This is her FIRST time teaching cell physiology (BIOL 3301) and I'm not even half way through the semester and I can already say TAKE HER! The way she explains the material makes it interesting and much easier to understand than the book. There is a lot of material and she wants her students to succeed. Hope she continues teaching this class!

Took professor Charles Fall 2021, and was okay in terms of lecture. Quiz every week w/ 3 attempts, and exams were the bulk of the grade but had curves due to the exam material being shared between 2 professors. Study quiz questions and the textbook as you will need those to pass the class. Everything has lockdown browser w/ webcam.

reviews.comment: Only have quizzes and text. Only good thing about her is the curves. Gave me zeros for test 1 and 2 and waited till the last week of class to file a report knowing we needed this credit for A&P. Definitely makes me want to transfer. AVOID HER!! She should not be teaching bio.

i would say to take Dr. Charles if you can. For me, it was asynchronous, which means we only met before exams. the class was mainly only quizes, which there was one due each weekend, and three exams. She gave pretty solid curves, which honestly saved my grade. Definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Avoid her please. Only have quizzes and test and the test are made up of 75% of your grade. Gave me zeros for all test. Failed with our even taking the final.

The reviews she gives don't help whatsoever. Maybe only two things from the review is actually on the test. On the exams, the questions are based off of 2 other professors. The quizzes kind of help you on the exam but not so much. You have 3 chances to retake the quizzes but she only tells you that once.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Charles is amazing. She truly cares! This is not an easy course in general, you really need to comprehend the material before you take a quiz or exam. Overall she's awesome and curves her exams a lot!! I had a 68 and she curved it to an 80! Take her please!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Only assignments are quizzes (25%) and exams (75%). I took the asynonline course. There are lectures uploaded for every week along with a weekly 10 question quiz with three attempts. Lockdown browser and webcam required for every quiz and exam. She provides the textbook, READ IT! That is the only way you will pass the exams! Gives curves on exams.

Took her async-online class, lecture days didn't really help. She gives you 3 attempts on the quizzes which are 10 questions each. Tests are really hard, so don't cram for it. Everything is on LOCKDOWN Browser with WEBCAM on. No extra work given either, it's just the quizzes which are worth 25%, and exams 75%.

Took her asynchronous class, it was okay. Her review days arent worth the gas lol. If you want to succeed in this class you NEED to read the book. Quizzes arent so bad. She only has quizzes every week as homework, and three exams, and the final is optional. She also does curve exams depending on how everyone did on it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Took her async-online. Quiz every week with a 40-80 minute lecture over the quiz. YOU DO NOT NEED THE BOOK DO NOT BUY THE BOOK she will provide you the book. Take notes and review the lectures, even past ones weekly. Exams are not cumulative. Quizzes are 10 questions each with 3-attempts (Lockdown browser WITH webcam)
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Charles was sometimes disorganized, but she recognized when she was not on top of things and made it right. Made our tests open-book and provided extra-credit assignments to make the class fair for a 5-week. I can tell she genuinely cares about student's learning and wants us to get the best educational experience possible.

Dr. Charles can be a little disorganized, but she is sweet and cares about students. She struggled to get our lectures posted in time, but she would give us extra time and attempts on quizzes when it was her fault. Tests off PPs and not text, so really focus on her lectures. Overall, easier professor.

Dr. Charles is really nice! I took her for Neurobiology as selected topics 3310, but she actually has the class set up as a 5000 level course for master's students. Don't really need to the textbook. Two exams are worth 30% of grade each, showing up to class is 20% of grade and open-note and book quizzes are 20%. Interesting class, not too hard

Dr. Charles's teaching style is very straightforward. AP2 is generally a challenging class, but with Dr. Charles, it didn't feel overwhelming. Coupled with her genuine care for students, in my opinion, she's the best AP professor I've taken. There are two types of quizzes to cushion your grade, and the lowest exam is dropped. Highly recommend; 4/5.

Dr. Charles used lectures and assignments from Prof. Pollock. In his intro video he stated that he would not help with anything and we have a week to figure it out. It pretty much went downhill from there. What was being studied was not on the exams and when I expressed frustration, I rec the, "well other ppl have gotten A's this time." response.

Dr. Charles truly cares for her students. I really believe that Dr. Charles wants her students to do well, and her grades reflect that. Compared to other A&P professors, she is a breath of fresh air. The downside is that she was often late in getting materials to the class in a timely manner. While frustrating, I still highly recommend.

I would not recommend as a first choice. The professor never posted lectures, quizzes, and exams on time. Hardly anything from the quizzes was on the exams and just about every student I've talked to from the class was also failing and had the same issues as I did. I wish she would have given some homework or posted reviews so that we could pass.

I liked the class, it was a little hard in the beginning, but as long as you read the textbook you'll be fine, DON'T DEPEND ON THE SLIDES/LECTURES ALONE!!! She gives big curves and I ended passing the class.

Very good professor. Cares a lot about her students and what they have to say. She does upload her presentations before class and only uses class time to "review" those presentations so it's kind of hard to keep up sometimes, but overall very straight to the point. Class isn't mandatory, but she notices who joins and keeps that in mind at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: 2nd time taking AP II. Of all the AP II teachers, she's 1 of the best. Just like other AP II classes, YOU HAVE TO STUDY, but Dr. Charles gives good lectures. reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Charles provides everything you need to pass this course. I will say this class was difficult, but I expected that. She never helps with ANYTHING!!! She literally said that we were on our own. She never posted anything on time. Would never answer students' emails and found an excuse for everything. I took this class during COVID. DO NOT recommend her at all, this class really discouraged my ability to become a nurse. The quizzes every week were based off the lecture but the tests covered NOTHING that she taught.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The people who say this professor is good are LYING. She never respected her students and always posted lectures late. She had to curve every exam because the average would be fifties EVERY TIME.

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took this class during COVID-19, so her class was asynchronous. I suck at doing online school so I kinda struggled. She only gives out quizzes and exams. reviews.comment: this class is a quiz every week and an exam every 5 ch. she curved all our tests and the final was optional. she wasn't the absolute worst but def difficult, a student got covid & asked for an extension on an exam and she said no. the NEXT week, SHE got covid and was out for 3 weeks. if u study, u'll be fine but overall, id pick someone else

took professor Charles for Bio during COVID, and the class was asynchronous. She always had an excuse when it came to posting the lectures only 2 days before the chapter quizzes were due. reviews.comment: Very, very lecture heavy, responds late to student emails, and always posted lectures and power points close to their due date.

This class was my most favorite online class that I have ever taken. Dr. Charles is very straight forward with tests and gives a review prior to the test. If you do the review, you will be fine. I made an A while serving Active Duty in the military and being a full time mom. This class was excellent! HIGHLY recommend her.

She was very condescending to her students and did not respect our schedules. Not very helpful

reviews.comment: Absolute queen love her so much.

This professor SUCKS at communicating. She DOES NOT respond to any emails, instead she posts on the announcement page about your concerns. She doesn't  have due dates for major assignments. How are we supposed to successfully succeed in a course with ZERO communication or clarification in anything?
9/10 DO NOT RECOMMEND

Dr. Hogg graded several assignments the night before the deadline which left no room for error. She assigns more work than she can handle. NO, NO, & NO.

I am in 5304. This is an online distance learning course w/ group assignments tailored to local students. This professor does not care for her students. She is harsh and does not treat her class with respect. Please avoid this professor as she will help tear your mental health apart. This was an online class so communication was through email. So do your work

reviews.comment: She is very rude and very unprofessional. She changes dates on you and doesn't tell you. She is slow to grade anything and lousy at responding to questions you have as a student. She seems to think that her students are mind readers.

Amazing Professor, there is a lot of homework, but it is all online and shouldn't take more than about 30 minutes to complete. Really sweet prof who truly wishes to help you learn Spanish. Amazing professor! Super sweet, engaging, and encouraging. Who knew you could learn so much in just a few months?
