reviews.comment: I would highly suggest this professor for Span 1. She was really nice and as long as you're paying attention and answer questions every so often you should do fine in the class.
pretty good, you should take her :)

Learning a new language and having to participate can be nerve racking but she truly makes her classroom a comfortable space to be yourself. She actually wants you to succeed and learn and it shows! Impossible to fail and would definitely take again!
I had Dr. Zaera for 1441/1442, very engaging in class. Have to buy the book to use for HW. Tests always matched the review posted

This class is only a little bit more difficult than its predecessor. Profesor Zaera, however, teaches and relays the information quite well and offers students a lot of practice with the material. Attendance is graded.

Professor Zaera gives the impression of a professor who cares about her individual students. Having been a freshman when I took her class, that was incredibly important to me. The class itself is relatively easy, as it is made very clear what specific material will be on the tests.

test heavy, BUT the review is almost verbatim what the exam is. study that and you'll do fine. shes also so nice and understanding. she takes attendance, but you can tell her you're sick or out for whatever reason and she wont count it against you. just study the study guides and you'll do well on the exams, thus you'll do well in the class :)
Caring and understanding. Tests are in-person and closed-note closed-book but she gives comprehensive study material prior to exams.

I am so amazed at how much Professor Zaera is willing to work with students to make sure they get the best grade possible. Love her!

reviews.comment: Professor Zaera is great. She really cares about her students. She is always available to help if you need it. She teaches out of the textbook. Attendance is mandatory and I recommend that you go so you can learn the material. I wish I could take her for 1442 but she doesnt teach that. If you are taking 1441, you should consider taking her.

For context, I am a non-native speaker and this was my first Spanish class taken out of high school. If you are unsure if this will be above your level, I guarantee you will do fine, as she reviews material at a slow pace and if you put in the effort, you will get good grades. I earned a 100 on a Spanish test for the first time in my life.

Shes amazing! We had zoom lectures twice a week. She teaches the entire chapter. I bet if you have some knowledge of Spanish that you wouldnt have to study. Quiz on each chapter, midterm, and final. 2 oral presentations and some writing to submit with feedback and a chance to improve your grade. Shes so nice and thorough. She welcomes questions.

She was very fun and up beat. She did take attendance but I would just log in and turn it down. You did have to remain connected the entire time in order to receive a 100. She does drop some of your lowest grades so that helps your grade a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof. Zaera made Spanish relatively easy. If you have any questions about assignments she's easy to reach. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great Professor, I dont normally write reviews, but Ms. Zaera is worth it! She is very caring and helpful. Her reviews before exams are verrrry useful. Best spanish prof
Take Profesora Zaera if you can! I can't emphasize it enough. She is so caring and sweet. The assignments are easy and she gives a great review class before tests.
She is super nice and gives you plenty of practice for the exam. She answers all questions during the lecture and tries to make it entertaining.
Profesora Zaera is great! She helps you with any homework and she is clear on grading. Only issue I had was the final review was nothing like the actual final.

I hadn't taken Spanish since elementary school and was dreading this class. She made the material so accessible and genuinely cared about our understanding before moving on. She was constantly letting us know what kind of questions we would be tested on and making sure we understood exactly what would be expected of us. Would 100% take her again.

She taught with just the textbook-provided videos and worked on textbook examples in class. She was upset with lack of participation but didn't really do anything to encourage us to participate. not the best professor

reviews.comment: really bad.

Take her!!! Professor Klang knows what she teaches and knows how to teach it well. She knows how to simplify tricky concepts in order for students to understand. As for the course work its easy. There is one homework assignment for each module which just consist of 15-20 questions. Other than that she provides review days for most of the test.

Had this professor in my first semester of college and just have to write a review. The best professor at UTA! I struggled with Biology ever since I was a kid, and she made it so easy to understand. The only professor I've had that is understanding of LDB technical difficulties, which eased my testing anxiety.

Dr. Klang is very passionate and caring about biology. You can tell she cares about her students and tries to help them as much as possible. 1-2 HWs per week. 4 Tests and 4 practice tests per semester. She allows 2 attempts on practice tests. 2-3 chapters on each test. This class does have a final. She's funny, very nice, and engaging in lectures.

I took her for Cell Biology and she only read off the slides. Attendance wasnt mandatory so I would just read the slides at home and teach myself. She is very kind and helpful if you have any questions. Exams are proctored and have to be taken in class.
This class is a lot to learn, but she breaks it down in a way that makes it super easy to understand. She's super caring and knows a ton about the material. I loved this class because of her.
The best biology professor at UTA. You will enjoy attending her lectures and will learn everything you need to succeed in bio 1441

She is very very easy for biology if you have a decent study habit. I did not show up to most of her lectures however it is mandatory to show up to her practice/real exams. Just study the PowerPoints she has on canvas and it's an easy A from her. Other than that, I think she is a great professor that has a great personality as a whole.

I like how she starts the first lecture with "Don't base your expectations on Rate My Professors" because she knows she has a near-perfect score. Very nice prof, makes the information clear and easy to memorize. She replies fast to emails. You shouldn't struggle at all in her class.

love her! u can tell she's very passionate and a caring person. i'd say she's strict abt missing exams so definitely try to make them. some of the material is kinda hard to understand but she explains it well, but i would recommend watching youtube videos to fully be prepared because the class is test heavy. gives a lot of extra credit

She is overall a really good professor. I tool the biology for nursing students' class, and it was really easy. The final exam is comprehensive, but it is really easy if you have studied even the slightest bit during the past midterms.

Straight foward class

reviews.comment: She was a good prof. the only thing I didn't like was that you can only makeup ONE exam at the end. She's unrealistic when it comes to situations happening. I became sick when the semester started and had a funeral to attend. So I missed 2 practice exams.

She was such a good teacher. She's super sweet and always does test reviews. Her lectures and PowerPoints are super easy to understand and cover all the material. If there's any teacher you should choose, take her. She makes it easy to learn and makes it interesting. I didn't think I'd do good in this course or like it, but I absolutely did.

This is a relatively easy class if you attend the lectures. Even if you don't, you can look over the slides. The homework is usually short and quick and can be used as a review for exams. She gives good feedback and detailed answers when you don't understand the material.

Great bio professor!. She explains the material very well, if you don't understand something she will try her best to explain. The way the course is set up on canvas is great, lots of opportunities for you to test yourself on the material. She explains well, but she does lecture fast, you get lost if you're not paying attention to the lecture.

She doesn't have an attendance requirement (except for practice exam and exam days), but you will definitely perform a lot better if you show up to lectures. She's very good at explaining concepts that might be confusing and is really passionate about biology. I found her powerpoints to be super thorough and easy to digest as well.

Professor Klang is a very nice teacher. Attendance is not mandatory but I highly recommend you go because she does a TON of extra credit assignments that will do so much for your grade. She is very nice and entertaining. Her lectures are helpful and the material she provides really sets you up for exams. Highly recommend taking her course.

Professor Klang is very sweet and helps students with any questions. Make sure to come to all lectures and if one is missed go to her slides and look through them. Take notes and study well before all exams. This is not an easy A class and effort is needed. A lot of memorization is necessary but if you start early you will have a lot of time.
She is so nice and explains concepts extremely well. Even thought I am not a science major, she made the course super understandable and interesting. If you can, you should absolutely take her.

I absolutely loved Dr. Klang as my professor! I loved how she explained the lecture material in depth and was always available if I had any questions during office hours. I also enjoyed how the weekly homework assignments on Canvas had multiple attempts.

I loved her lectures and her personality. Put in the dedication to get an amazing grade. She also gives extra credit during lecture by doing assignments. Overall great experience and recommend her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: UGH DR KLANG WAS AWESOME. You can tell she knows Biology. With the bottom of my heart, for the person reading this. If you want a lecturer that doesn't just read from slides. PICK HER BEFORE ! And attend her lectures because she's funny and teaches well.

Dr. Klang was easy to communicate with and was a good professor for a hard class like bio. Although, it was very lecture heavy and all she did was read off slides. Personally, I learned better by just reviewing and learning the material on my own with her provided resources. She provides a lot of practice homeworks for each unit which was helpful.

Knew a good bit of biology prior to this class, but Dr. Klang really expanded on that and made it fun. She makes dull slides entertaining and gives good ways to memorize concepts. Additionally, she goes out of her way to link videos and create reviews prior to each Midterm Exam. Very caring and loved being in her class!

A very passionate and caring teacher. The PowerPoints were easy to understand, and she explains everything really well. I felt like she was sometimes annoyed by questions but always answered them. This class is easy if you go to lecture and do the homework.

Second time taking this professor, and yet again she is amazing! This is a professor that actually teaches and cares about her students. I would definitely recommend her. She does reviews and has outlines for each chapter, so it is easy to study for.

She is a great teacher definitely take her as your professor. The lecture will have everything that you need for the exam so make sure to study the lectures. She is good at explaining the topic and will sometimes bring snacks for us. The practice exams and homework are really helpful.

Took her for both 1441 & 1301 and I'm so glad I did. Her class is very entertaining and informative. Class is not hard if you do all your assignments, look through notes and study. Easy A for sure. She also gives extra credit!
Took her for 1345 (wasn't an option on here) , slides & homeworks are soooo helpful! She is very caring! Easy A in class if you put the effort!

Grade is dependent on exams, but if you study, you'll be fine. HW is super easy, and she gives extra credit out like candy. Super interactive with the class and is nice. Group project is okay if you like your group. Quizzes are easy, and holds booklet exam reviews with prizes for the winners.

She is great, fast-paced, and fun at teaching. It was challenging and required a lot of additional studying outside of class to get a good grade. Overall, she's amazing though, she didn't use textbooks only extensive power points, which made it a lot easier to learn. Also, wouldn't recommend missing her lectures, she goes over a lot.

This professor is AMAZING! She made the concepts so easy to understand and made studying for tests less daunting because of how much you learn in lecture! She really made me love Biology and love going to class!

Prof.Klang is a really good proffessor. She cares about her sutdents successes. She gives a lot of extra credit and exlpains everything really well. The project is extremely helpful towards final average even if exams are not. I would definitely recommend taking her.
So engaging and beautiful. I would love to take her class again, textbook isn't necessary because her lectures and slides are so engaging and useful!

dr. klang is the best bio professor ever. im the type of person to not really study & i found the materials to be so digestable. she puts the powerpoints for lectures in canvas. but i attended every lecture bc she explains everything much more. she is so enthusiastic and gives tips & detailed notes for studying! i wish i can take her again (,:

Great professor for Nutrition! If you pay attention in class and study the review that is given you will do good on the exams. There is also a group project, but it is super fun and not hard at all!

Dr. Klang may be the best professor I have ever had! The passion she has to teach is inexplicable, she always makes sure that every student understands the material. I was fortunate enough to have her as my professor for BIOL 1301 as well and let's just say that I BIOL 1441 and BIOL 1301 are by far my favorite classes!

Attending lecture is important! She taught very well and provided ample learning resources that really helped. The exams can be tough, but I just made flashcards from the learning objectives and did well. I would highly recommend this professor, she is awesome!
I loved Dr. Klang! She was super engaging in her lectures and was helpful during her office hours. If you apply yourself during the tests, you will succeed! Be sure to study hard and attend class.

I would 10/10 recommend her to anyone who has to take Biology. She was very passionate and entertaining during lecture and you can feel that she cared for her students. Tests are manageable but you definitely have to study and she gives you all the material needed to succeed. Great Professor!

This was hands down the best professor I have ever had! She has great lectures and great study materials! Pay attention in class and complete the study materials, you will pass this class with flying colors!

I actually had her for BIOL 1345 and she really understood what she was talking about. She replied to emails in a timely manner. Professor Klang is great. Her lectures are easy to comprehend. She will make sure that the class understands what she is talking about before moving on. the worst class i have ever taken please do yourself a favor and dont take her class... youll thank me later

reviews.comment: No. No. No. Don't you dare click that enroll button unless it is your only option. This professor teaches a graduate level version of this course and does not know the difference between that and a regular 3305 class. Tons of readings, 3 HARD quizzes, weekly blog posts( no responses which is nice), and 2 papers 1 3-4 page, 1 8-10 page. NO!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Do NOT take this class if you are expecting to work or have a life outside of it. There is so much reading it feels like History Seminar class by the amount of reading you have to do. Along with difficult quizzes there are two papers one is a 3-4 page map analysis not too bad right? Then there is a term paper that has to be 8-10 pages. Stay AWAY!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Demhardt is an excellent professor. You will have to work for your grade and expect lots of reading. He knows how much effort you put forth. Get the textbook. The quizzes are the hardest part but if you attend lectures and read them you'll be fine. No tests just 2 quizzes and a final paper.
If you read well, you can participate better and he's impressed
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very arbitrary, sometimes contradictory grading standards. No negative feedback, but still gives 80's and 90's. A lot of unnecessary assignments, quizzes, homework, and discussion boards; often due on the same day.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Marchand is a great English teacher. His class is a lot of work, but the assignments are straightforward, and as long as you try, it's very easy to do well. His feedback is clear and really helps improve your writing. The class is definitely beneficial and worth taking.

I would retake him. Although he gave out work every week, it was manageable (coming from someone with a really packed schedule). His feedback was helpful, so if you depend on it and improve your writing, you will be fine. He is also really chill and sweet. Attendance will be taken, but it will not be counted toward your grade.

Took both his 1301 and 1302, and taking both helped a lot since some things went hand in hand. He was extremely helpful in terms of what he's looking for and his criticism. The essays were lengthy and repetitive, but if you just put in the work and take from his criticism, you can easily get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: He was great and gave clear instructions on paper criteria, even though it did feel like I wrote an essay every week. He is great though if you make sure to do your part and turn in your work. Easy class, and he is not a tough grader. I feel he is very understanding sometimes.

I took his hybrid class, so class only met once a week. Amazing prof who def understands what he teaches. Interesting lectures, laughs a lot, and is joyous. Although attendance isn't mandatory, I strongly recommend going. Most assignments are either group assignments or individual, with about 5 essays. Posts mostly everything you need in canvas.

This is a debate class with essays. This is a pre-req class & the structure feels like an advanced English majored class. The discussions are repetitive, and the word counts for them are extensive for a discussion that has little effect on grades. The essays are 4-10 pages. Don't take his if you're just trying to complete your English pre-reqs.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Amazing professor to take if you want to get an A in English 1301. Classes are not mandatory and he gives out detailed directions on how to approach essays in class. If you follow his suggestions in the peer reviews he will give you an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is very chill and easy-going. He makes class fun and often lets us out early. There is quite a bit of writing however it is definitely manageable and well spaced out. There's at least 2 assignment per week. Provides great feedback from essays.Sometimes it can take him a while to grade final draft essays.

Marchand was pretty chill and seemed passionate about writing. He provided excellent feedback on assignments which if followed, would earn you a great grade on the final drafts. My only complaint is that sometimes, essays were not due at 11:59 but rather right before class.

Took him for 1301 and 1302, and would take again if I needed more English credit. Very easy going professor, just follow the writing instructions and you're set to get an easy A. Follow his feedback very closely to score high grades every time. There's a lot of writing but he spaces it out very well throughout the semester. Great experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mr. Marchand was a good teacher he was really chill and fun, and although he was a harsh grader he gave good feedback on how to fix it, I do suggest going to the classes you will be able to understand the lecture more even though he has the powerpoints posted.

Professor Marchand was pretty straight forward with how assignments should be done. Although attendance wasn't mandatory, It is best to show up to class when you feel confused about a specific lesson or assignment. He is very good at emailing right away and he always stays after class if have any questions or assistance!

I'm confused about where all the negative comments come from because he is a good professor! Sure, he grades harshly, but he also provides lots of time and availability to provide student feedback. He ensures every student is doing well on whatever paper we may be writing at the time, and he allows you to ask questions and answers them.

Professor Marchand is nice but can be almost a bit aloof. His feedback on papers is not very detailed which left me feeling confused - then having to email him for clarification (and he can take a while to respond). I would say he can be a tough grader at times.

He was a chill professor and attendance wasn't mandatory but I would suggest going at least 1 or 2 times a week. I never had to email him so I wouldn't know about rude responses. He was helpful and gave good feedback when I asked questions in person after class. He graded pretty leniently on everything except rough drafts and final essays.
Legit got a 89.79 and he would not curve it up to an A. Also by the way he grades extremely hard and is rude at some times in regards to emails. Look elsewhere for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This professor is one of the worst I have had. He responds to emails semi-on time but expect a rude response and sometimes he might threaten you with lowering your grade, and he does not follow grading based off of the rubric but rather he grades way more than what is on the paper so on the rubric you might get a A but you might get a B or even a C

This professor without a doubt is the most toughest grader I have ever seen. Unless you are an English major, I suggest heavily looking elsewhere because this professor does not clearly state what he looks for in papers and grades more than just what the rubric is asking. He is also pretty rude when it comes to emails.

The feedback he provides is decent but more so overall he is an extremely tough grader. The assignments that I had to complete I followed all guidelines and followed the rubric but his critiques don't follow them. I'm not good at English but my last English professor was way better grading wise and following the rubric.

Take him! One of the best professors for English. He will give you good feedback on your drafts, and is accessible outside class. Attendance is not mandatory. Took him in-person, and spent 1-2 hours in a week completing the assignments.

I took English 1301 with him over the summer, very easy A. As long as you put in a bit of effort and complete all of the papers and assignments, you should have an easy A. My only criticism would be that some of the essay prompts were confusing at times, and he didn't do the best job at explaining them.

I liked his class a lot. He gave us a lot of time to do our assignments and always answered his email very quickly. Super sweet professor, just communicate with him and he will help you as best as he can. I had his evening class and he was able to keep my attention the entire class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He's always really prepared in class, so even if you don't remember everything he says during his lecture, it's all on a PowerPoint. He's easy to like and understand, and the classwork is kind of tricky, but he gives you a lot of chances to do well. I would definitely take him again.

Professor Marchand is great. If you listen in class to his advice on the essays you write, you'll end up writing great stuff and get an A. Also, he always gives great feedback and is always wanting to help. Take his class!

Jeff was awesome! Def. recommend taking him for Tech Writing. The assignments are super easy, and he gives good feedback on the essays to prepare you for the final version. There is one group project at the end but still super easy. Nothing bad to say about him.
I just liked this guy. Took his class over the summer and it was super easy. He also made it that way being so laid back. I highly recommend him.

Professor Marchand is one of the most amazing professors of UTA. He is a great person, always there for you. PARTICIPATION MATTERS! As long as you're following his instructions, COMING TO THE CLASS and PARTICIPATING and submitting assignments on time, you'll get an easy A. Overall, an amazing professor, I would highly recommend taking him.

Mr. Marchand is very kind and helpful professor. He has really nice personality. He takes time to listen and understand what concerns and problems you have with your paper. He also gives good feedback which will bring your grade up. He takes attendance, so make sure to show up in class. I am going to take him again for my 1302. He is just awesome!

Although there's a lot of discussion after assignments are due, they were very easy. She's very helpful and responds to emails quickly. Great teacher, essays are extremely straightforward, and her grading criteria are clear. I would definitely recommend taking her class, especially the online section.
She is very understanding and flexible, as long as you are open and honest with your situation.

This class was very easy and self-paced. This class consists of discussion boards and three essays. She would open up modules so we could work faster If we wanted to. The grading can be kinda confusing at times; I felt like I wouldn't get the right grade that I deserved, I know people who have also experienced this in the same class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I enjoyed having Professor Jones for English 1301, she is very kind and will always quickly respond to any questions. The class consisted of discussion boards and 3 major essays but overall they were very simple and easy to understand, as long as you follow instructions you will definitely receive an A!

I really want to like this class. The grading was done by coaches, which makes grading criteria unclear and unfair. I would suggest not procrastinating on assignments and please your coaches. There will be a requirement that you buy the textbook. Be ready to write discussions every week, reply, and do peer reviews.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is very nice, if you need her you can email her and she respond rather quickly. This course has 3 big paper and the rest is based on peer reviews and your note summary. Those peer reviews are really helpful when writing your paper.
Just do the homework, participate in the discussions, and keep up with the final paper! Easy A!

Easily one of the easiest English courses, especially having Ms. Jones. She is fair with grading if you follow the rubric. You will have 3 main essays, along with 2 peer reviews for each, and 10-12 discussion posts. Just pay attention to deadlines and you will succeed. She also gives everyone an opportunity to submit a rough draft to her.
Took this class online and I don't regret it. She reviews and gives feedback on every one of your essays. She also grades fairly as long as you follow the rubric!

I took ENGL-1301 online with her and overall she was a great teacher. Most of the class dealt with online discussion boards and participation is key to getting an A in this class. She does have a specific way of grading but she is more than willing to help students. As long as you're not lazy you should easily pass this class. Would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I took Professor Jones online over the Fall 2022 semester. For this class really just following the rubrics expectations (very easy to understand) and you should easily get an A. There are many discussion assignments, peer review assignments, and then the submission of 3 essays. I really enjoyed this class and highly recommend this professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The class consisted of 3 essays, peer reviews for those essays, and 11 discussion posts. All of the discussion posts and peer reviews were easy to do as long as you followed the rubric. Professor Jones is an incredibly kind professor who was willing to answer emails about the essays. Syllabi stated textbook was mandatory, but I did fine without it.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This rating is more for the class itself and the coaches. Professor Jones was irrelevant in the course. The coaches do all the grading and they are extremely tough graders. Following the rubric to a T you will still not get a perfect grade on any assignment. The peer reviews are annoying, repetitive, and impossible to get full points on.
Tough grader for no reason she doesn't even grade it herself. Don't take this course with her

Theres not much work to do for the class its honestly a decent workload. She is a tough grader in essays but she give you the opportunity to reach out to her before you submit it. Just do your discussion posts and write your essays according to the rubric and you will succeed.

Ms. Jones takes the time to ensure that your essay and your material is in the best shape by going through peer reviews, her own personal reviews, and self reviews from a checklist which helped so much over the course of the semester. Everything was planned out easily and made the class flow so well.

I took this class for Technical Writing. After reading a couple of reviews I was scared to take her class, but honestly, this class is really easy. There are discussion boards every week, 4 essays, peer-reviews for each essay, and 2 quizzes. She also responds to emails very quick which was very nice.

Regret taking my online class with her. Every assignment includes peer reviews. Then what is she even for if she can't grade her own students work? Too many coaches, assignments, and stupid irrelevant discussion boards for such a simple dumb class. She needs to realize that no one cares for this class as much she does.

This course required you to purchase/rent a book. Each week there were readings, quizzes, discussions and a paper due along with peer reviews. The class was fast paced and required a good amount of time to complete the assignment. A rubric was provided so it helped when writing papers. Each paper built on the next. Do the work and you will pass.
She is a very tough grader.. nothing else matters. A lot of points get deducted for extremely miscellaneous things.
This professor is very straight forward and gives very good directions for her assignments. As long as you are paying attention of what is asked from you, you should make a good grade in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took the online 5wk course. It was a simple course if you follow the rubric and the guidelines about what is needed in the paper you will be fine. The weekly discussions are not complicated and I made 100s on those. Good feedback. Just follow the rubric it is the difference between receiving an A or B
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took the five week online course for technical writing. It was a really helpful class but prepare to write! Theres a paper due every week and the last week theres 2 papers due. Shes very clear on what she wants but is a tough grader! I would not call this a blow off class. I highly suggest her though! Her coaches are awesome and reply quickly!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: It seemed like no matter what I did I could not get a perfect score on an assignment. She is very specific in the material she wants. Make sure to meet the expected word count on assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This was the easiest class I have ever taken at UTA. It was online so attendance didn't matter. Jones is an extremely easy grader - just do the work and you will pass. You have weekly discussions and 3 total essays. Also, remember to reply to at least two of your peers on the discussion board - it is easy, but easy to forget.
Good class, just follow the Rubrics and you will be fine.

This class was harder than expected. As others have said, the coaches are extremely nit picky. It is doable, but you have to really work to earn an A on your assignments. Grading is a bit unfair. Uploading one of my documents through SafeAssign messed with the format of my paper and affected my grade, yet the coach would not change my grade.

More difficult that I was expecting. Everything is through the Academic Coach and they are knit picky, just like the other person said. A little ridiculous for a non-English/Writing major.  If you are a stickler for detail and have no issues putting that in writing, you will likely be fine. No Lecture, just reading and assignments

Took Technical Writing, online. The format & grading criteria was extremely easy to follow w/several wkly assignments. Ensure to do the work early or on time to meet the deadlines and you'll be fine. I found the Academic Coach that graded the assignments to be very knit picky. There was little interaction w/the actual Prof. Only the book is needed.

It is extremely difficult to fail this class. I did not try hard during the semester and received an A. Some of my papers were complete BS, product of my procrastination; but I somehow received As on all of them. REALLY easy class. I definitely would recommend her if you need a GPA boost, or if English isn't your forte.
Ridiculous amount of stuff for an English class. There are weekly discussions and 6 or 7 quizzes. She doesn't really give good feedback on essays. Easy class though.

Technical writing was a very clearly laid out and organized class. I have taken several online classes but this one was by far the most organized. There was no guessing at what was expected or when things were due. Everything was due on Sunday (discussion board, memo, and essay) every week. Very thorough instructions. Great team of instructors!

Always in her office & there but she isn't too specific with help & rude if you ask during class even if she's not lecturing. Talks to you like you're 5 and has pointless activities in class that don't help, a lot of no class days though. I learned nothing. If you're a amazing writer, take her, otherwise... not really recommended.

It is a very small class, I had her for English 1301 and most of the class was grades over quizzes and essays. The textbook First Year Writing is a must and is very expensive. She is helpful but also talks to students like we're 3rd graders. She's an okay professor, class is dull but it is an easy grade.

Jones is really helpful when you get confused on the essays. There are many peer reviews that make it really hard to fail an essay. There are a few reading quizzes, but they aren't usually super hard. She does take attendance, however.

Great teacher!! I hate English and I still do but she made it very clear about what is required to pass the class. Just don't wait till the last min to turn in papers if you miss one of the four mandatory essays you automatically fail.
Her online course is easy as long as you keep up with your work and turn in your work on time. She always answers emails and is willing to help if you need it.

The classwork may seem overrated,but the teacher explained in-depth analysis on assignment. In doubt, the teacher can help. She will always be in her office when the class time is cut off. Overall, any composition should take her as the book explains the assignment guildlines also!

Professor Jones is great.  There's a lot of reading for quizzes but for the most part the class is very easy.  She is willing to help with your essays, she is direct, is lenient, and a very fair grader.  You're allowed to miss a maximum of four classes but she cuts class short usually and cancels sometimes.  Her class is by far the best I've taken.

I agree with the comment saying she was like a "cheesy therapist" No connection whatsoever. All we did was take some quizzes, talk about the upcoming assignments and turn in our papers. I didn't learn anything. If you are looking for a chance to learn new things and really connect with your professor, don't take her.
She's very amazing and really nice. Super lenient and gives you very good advice about your essays. She's a gift from God. Take her. TAKE HER NOW!!! Also, easier grader.

Comparitvely, her class was not as easy or laid back as most of my friends classes. We had blogs, and quizzes, and reading responses, and essays that were due WAY before everyone elses. She is not the "easy A" that everyone is reffering to on here. I made in easy A in 1301 but had to work pretty hard to get my A in here.

This class is a guaranteed A! Her quizzes are a little difficult but that's only if you don't read. She gives plenty of time for essays and she is also very laid back and understanding. I WOULD DEFINITELY RECOMMEND HER.
She's helpful with the essays and allows plenty of time to complete assignments. However, the quizzes are ridiculously detailed and hard to do well on.  Thankfully she drops the lowest two.

I loved having her, she's very nice and nothing is too difficult in her classroom. You have to read and know what's in the assigned reading-her quizzes are very detailed! Overall she's great all around, she answers all questions and she encourages visiting her during office hours and she'll edit your paper for you
extremely helpfull..i recommend her

In the beginning, her class is intensive because I have to read hundreds of pages of the book to do the quiz. But after the reading part, it became easy, just take sometime to write some essay, not very hard. Thanks to her I can finish my other class

Ms. Jones is an awesome professor! She is a guaranteed A :) She is so laid-back, helpful, & approachable. Her quizzes were a little difficult because you have to read the textbook, but she grades very fairly on the essays & helps you in any way if you ask. Take her for as many English classes as you can!

She was a good professor. Very clear about what she wanted and very easy going. She was pretty lenient but make sure you attend class and do your assignments. Over all she's an easy going person so it's an easy going class.

This was probably my favorite class this semester. SUPER EASY. Taking IB English in high school, I was used to rigorous for and loads of it too. Taking this class afterwards was a breeze. Easy quizzes. Easy Essays. Super sweet and helpful. I wish I could count how many work days we had where we didn't have to go to class. She's awesome. Take her!
Kind woman; very easy grader. Cancels class VERY often, but gives quizzes that can be a bit tricky. Read FYW textbook, and memorize anything in list form, and you'll be fine. Cool woman.

wow my high school ap english teacher was so wrong =/ this class was a joke foreals, she graded really easily and we barely had to show up because of so called "work days". if you want a easy A take her
Super nice and helpful!! Easy A!!

easy class but she was more like a cheesy therapist " how do yall feel about that" " what do you have to say about that" i learned nothing from her at all, might as well take an online class. if you r good at english and are looking for an easy A take her. If you are not good, and want to learn atleast a little bit find someone else.
She was really helpful and you could always direclty ask her for help on essays in her office. She was not strict about late work. Easy A.
Makes class super easy, we had about 10 work days, somedays we didn't even stay the entire period. Take her if you just want to get your English Credit. Don't if you are an actual English Major.

Professor Jones is suuper laid back and she's very understanding. If you forget something, just talk to her after class; she's very reasonable. Classes are canceled often ("work days") and her class is super easy. I only recommend taking her if you took an AP class and did not pass the exam. If you really want to learn, take a more rigorous prof.

She is wonderful, very lenient and understanding if you did a project incorrectly or turned it in late. SOOO laid back. After you do the essays she gives you a chance to go to conference with her to get help and review and it boosts your grade. Cancels class quite often, but does take absences and after 4 you get points taken off your final grade
easy. cancels class quite often and very rarely will you be in class for the entire session lol. laid-back, nice....take her if you can. i slacked off a lottttt and still made an A :)

I was told that this would be easy and that was kinda true. i think I just slacked a bit but she is pretty easy. There is a fun project at the end of the class. But even though I wasn't always on point I still made an A so take this class if you can!
She is AWESOME! =)
She is super easy!!! I took her over fall 09 and i made an A, you need to go to class and take the quizzes, but she is very laid back! Take her if you can!
Ms. Jones is really easy to have as a instructor and she is very helpful. Enjoy
Ms. Jones is EASY and extremely laid-back. Take her if you get a chance!
i loved her... she was really easy... great class to have when you are just starting college...

Ms. Jones is an EASY professor. I got A's & B's on all essays that I wrote in her class, & 100's on all my homework assignments. My most FAVORITE class I took my first semester! She'll usually cut class short too, sometimes we would only have class for 10 minutes! It was awesome! She's definitely really nice & helpful! Her classes fill fast though!
The second essay was hard, but she is still a great professor!!! EASY A!

I pretty much loved her!  You only had to write 3 essays on modern topics which she graded easily.  The quizzes are at times somewhat difficult but if you read the material you shouldn't have a problem.  She also will help you a lot if you need it.  She tends to cancel class for "workdays" frequently as well.
She is amazing!!!

Very sweet and caring teacher. I hate english but this class was enjoyable. She makes you read and write about modern day interesting things. I wish she taught english 2. Very understanding about late work and will let you re-write papers. Take her.
real easy teacher. in english 1301 we usually watched a tv show then did group work. easy grader no tests  or quizes. you do write 3 papers which are easy.
No Comments
Very awwful
If you are taking his class, I am sorry for you. Good luck.
Good person, but terrible professor. The class was disorganized, directionless, and felt improvised. I frequently got frustrated with how he taught and what I'm supposed to study.

Lectures are decent, ~8 online hw, lots of slides to help solve hw but you will probably have to find other sources to complete hw. Two term exams, midterm, and final, are half multiple choice and half free response. Partial credit given on FRQs. Exam avg is always failing, he boosts everyone's final grade to have normal distribution of grades.
terrible, literally doesnt takes your grade as a joke and just takes off points for fun. awful lecturer

DO NOT take this professor. Unless you want to make your semester harder than it has to be, I suggest taking another professor like Spurlock. Exams are unnecessarily hard, no review days or past exams to work with, reads off the slides, doesn't provide any resources on canvas, and you are unaware of your grade till the end of the semester.

AVOID THIS PROFESSOR. 

- He assigns homework which is several classes ahead of what is currently being learned.
- Goes through lectures as if you know the material.
- Doesn't teach
- Ignores struggles, says not his fault
AVOID, or don't take physics that semester. Don't see the good reviews and think it's fine, I did that and it was a huge mistake
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: okok. this dude is stressful af... but do the extra credit and finish all the homework. that curve saves LIVES. My jaw dropped when I saw my grade jump 2 letters at the end of the semester.
no

Yes, he offers extra credit. ironically, it isn't that 'extra' as it may bring you up from a C- to C. __Congratulations. Homework is long. Tests are extremely unpredictable. No revision class. Write your own formula sheet, tough luck if you left something out. Does not use canvas. This class was an emotional and academic struggle.

DO NOT DO IT! DO NOT DO IT!
Trust me, no matter how difficult, you want to know what's happening in class. Dr.Yu usesSpurlock's Ppts and spends the entirety of lecture just reading the board-LITERALLY-variable after variable likeatranslation app instead of explaining where the variables come from, what they mean,and exploring other approaches.

The test/quiz average was always failing and the tests were too hard compared to hw and lecture. He seems like a nice guy, just not a good teacher especially since he just reads off a PowerPoint. Final grade curve, 10 extra points if you get the most bonus points. No test reviews given and you have to make your own formula sheet.

This is not it. I was quite interested in physics but this man single handedly turned me away from it. Only reason I got an A was because I had taken and passed AP Physics in HS. Too much homework, tests are random and overly hard, completely unlike homework and lectures. Test Avg was: ~55. Take Spurlock instead. He is nice, just not a good teacher

Tests make up most of your grade in class and the tests are so bad in this class. No test reviews given, barely a guideline, have to make your own formula sheet, test questions are 20 times harder than practice problems in class. Test averages are always below passing, that should be a sign to help the students understand better but nope .
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Not great, not awful. He's very monotone which makes it hard to focus, given that physics is dry as is. Not interesting to listen to, and his rather strong accent makes it a tad hard to understand what he's saying, combined with the confusing material of physics. I wouldn't recommend him, per se, but if you get him, he isn't awful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Yu started his online lectures by a roll call of over 100 students in the Zoom meeting, made me feel like I was in a big high school class. His lectures are just him reading off PowerPoint slides where he frequently gets off topic. The only reason I would take Dr. Yu is for his Extra Credit which literally can give you an extra letter boost.

Lets get this straight, if ur looking to learn physics dont take this class. If u just need to get physics outta the way take this class. Dr. Yu is a hilarious and smart guy who gets off topic in lecture; however, he gives extra credit that can change a whole letter grade. Dr. Yu is honestly a legend imo, he just lacks teaching in a timely manner.

Lectures are barely beneficial bc he gets off topic & expects you to know material he never taught. Its extremely frustrating that the homework & tests cover material he doesnt teach until after theyre due. I read the reviews saying that^ & I thought I could handle it, but its a horrible teaching style for online learning. Id avoid if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Honestly not a bad lecturer. He knows his stuff & what he manages to cover in class he explains well, but the main problem is that the class is slow. He does not cover everything that he tests & assigns homework on & instead expects you to read the chapters. YouTube helped a lot because the book wasn't always helpful. BTW EXTRA CREDIT IS THE GOAT!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you want to rely on extra credit and hope rather than being taught the course material, this is your class. Talked more about politics than physics. HW is due for a grade before it is taught. Exam material is rushed in class, if covered at all. Literally skipped through slides with final exam material so it could be included. No partial credit.

Take this class at TCC if you can. This professor will constantly tell you that the tests are easier than the HW but its all lies. There were stuff on the test that we did not cover yet. This class was horrible! Do not take it!! Tests were harder than my Calculus tests. Tests are online but they are very tricky; If you want to get an A in this class, go to every lecture, read the book, and pray that his effin tests are not confusing like always.

Punitive, Tedious, and Boring. He is the only class I know that make history feel like a trite matter. More obsessed with screwing you over in the weekly online testsminiteststests on a book because of "Google". (Yep...) Ironically he is the worst user of technology that I know. He uses Word instead of  Powerpoint... Show videos, with ads...

His tests are online and timed, each question is on its own page so there is no going back and checking your work or changing answers. You do not get 1hr 20 (class time) to take the test, the times vary depending on the number of questions he puts on it. Some questions are unclear and were not even covered in class or in the text! DO NOT TAKE!!!!!

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!! I thought it would be easy bc the tests are online I WAS WRONG. The tests are SO hard and they're timed. NOT TO MENTION each question is on its own page so there is NO GOING BACK AND CHECKING YOUR WORK OR CHANGING PREVIOUS ANSWERS (not like you would have time)  50min for 54 ? test is WAYY stressful. It's a literal joke

This class is deceptively hard. The tests are online so you can use your notes but good luck. I'm naturally bad at history so I knew I would have to work my butt off, but even that wasn't enough. I've never been in danger of failing a class but I am absolutely in danger of failing this one. Take the best notes you possibly can.

Dr. Smant is a good guy and the class started off great for me, but if you plan on skipping class I wouldn't recommend this professor. Definitely not an easy A even with online test.   The online tests are unnecessarily hard and you really need to know the material if you want to get an A

At first its hard to understand him because his minor speech impairment, but you adjust. He's a nice man; lectures are extremely long and detailed but they are interesting. Unfortunately even though tests are online they're quite hard and often contain questions outside the spectrum of any lecture or textbook. I would just say go to class.

Dr Smant is a great professor. He incorporates videos and music clips into his lectures so they will be more interesting and less boring. Overall the assignments were pretty straightforward and somewhat easy. You have 2 book assignments, 10 quizzes, and 4 tests (one of those including the final). I would recommend him to students who need a history

He is an awesome professor! You use 1 book besides your textbook & I recommend that you read them both. Every assignment is online; there's online quizzes, book assignments, tests, & a final exam. He teaches with YouTube videos & other online videos . This class was awesome & I learned a lot about history after 1865. :D

I have to say that this class is way too strict for a history class. The tests are extremely tough and some questions aren't even from class! Avoid this professor at all cost! I STRONGLY recommend that for any history classes to take David M Watry, I have heard from peers that he is hands down the best history professor at UTA.
Very hard. Do not take his class. He quizzes and the lectures. Should not be this difficult for a core class. His tests are hard, and its very difficult to decide what answer he is looking for.

Smant is a very good professor. All assignments are online and he gives you time to finish them. It's best to always go to class because he makes the lectures interesting and the lecture notes help a lot during exams
Great teacher lots of videos in class and keeper the class interesting

Best for HIST 1311 & 1312. I did not like history until I had Dr. Smant for 1311. He made it fun so I decided to take him for 1312. He does online everything!(test,quiz,assignments). although he doesnt take attendance his lectures are very important to attend for answers to test and quiz questions. TAKE NOTES AND READ ASSIGNMENTS & YOU'LL GET AN A.

Professor Smant is a great teacher. Though his test are fairly difficult, I learned very well from him. He actually care unlike other professors, he sends out emails of advice to help you with upcoming test. You actually have to go to class to do well, and you can't just copy paste the question on google to find them for the test.
Good professor. Covers the material. All multiple choice exams. Kind of hard.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!! I studied for several weeks before his tests and went to the TA and I still struggled. Only a final and midterm and they're both long with hard questions. Could have several answers when he's looking for a specific one. Not all material was covered in class. Lectures are long and lots of info. Good luck!

Great professor. Gives extra points for attendance. Take good notes on lectures. He is pretty clear about what he expects and is very funny. I enjoyed his class. It isn't an easy class but if you turn in all your assignments on time and study, you will do just fine.

For someone who does not like history at all I sure did find myself really enjoying this class. His lectures are great, taking notes is a must. Read the book for quiz answers. Test are on notes and book so attendance is a must but if you do all that the class is easy to pass.
I wouldn't recommend this reacher what so ever

Good teacher. easy quizzes and extra credit for attendance to boost grade. tests are easy just go over the notes n skim the topics taught in book. Got A from reading night before the tests. books are interesting

Super nice. Easy take home quizzes, a few fairly simple tests, 2 easy reading assignments (the books were actually really interesting). He used videos and music in his lectures. I never really read out of the book, just skimmed over while looking for answers to the quizzes and still made an A. He takes attendance for extra credit. Take him!

Easiest professor I've had so far. If you attend his lectures, take notes, and complete the take home quizzes (which are extremely easy), you'll be fine. His take home quizzes are directly taken from his lectures and a small portion of the answers are found in the book. There are two tests in his class and 2 reading assignments as well.

Really nice professor, enjoyable lectures, but the tests, take-home tests, and book reports were HARD. He grades harshly. If you are a history whiz, you will LOVE this class; if not, it's going to be really difficult.

He's great. Clearly defines expectations. He is a tough grader. 3 books with questions. 2 take home exams, and the final is in class. Just go to class, and you don't even have to buy the book. Plays videos and songs relevant to the lesson, which is great. Awesome professor, definitely recommend.

Prof. Smant is easy if you go to class, read all the books (3 novels) and do the book assignments.(if you go to class you don't need to by the textbook) Write down all the notes he puts on the board, and use them exactly on the take home test. If you talk to him, he accepts late work. Grades assignments hard, use exactly whats in books/notes.

He is really fun professor. There are two book assignments and about 8 take home quizzes. There are not that hard though. Mid -term and final are multiple choice and an essay, but he tells u the the words 2 study for and essay topic before hand.

He's a pretty straightforward teacher. You come to class and take notes on his lecture. He even writes the main points he's talking about on Word with the projector. However, you cant just copy that. You have your book lists ahead to read them. *He plays a video/song every class period pertaining to that day's subject= cool
Great teacher!2 book assignments, 8 take home quizzes, midterm and final. Very easy to get an A. Gives extra credit for attendance. Gives reviews for midterm and final. Take notes.

Great Prof. Makes subject very interesting and knows what he is talking about. Took for summer, work load was tough, but had enough time to read 2 diff books, reports on them, and he gave us 2 take home exams, plus final in class exam. You have to be thorough, and read, otherwise you will not pass. Oh, and take notes!!!!TXT book is optional.

I made an A in 1311 and I expected 1312 to be just as straightforward. Not so. To pass his essay portion you have to pick up on *exactly* what he wants written, anything else (even if its relevant to the topic, correct, and even thoughtful) and you still fail. Don't expect any real help from him.

took a maymester with him; he's funny, a little hard to understand at first, but you get used to it after about the first day; tests were a little difficult; quizzes were easy, books were actually interesting to read; very understanding professor
good Teacher! as long as you do the take-home quiz and read the book assignments you will do great!! loved this class!

Dr.Smant is extremely helpful. Class went by smoothly, watched some videos and listened to songs related to the subject. Attendance wasn't mandatory but he gave some extra credit for it. Test weren't bad if you folloed the review. Take home quizes and book projects were not too hard either.
Great professor, very easy to follow. There's only two tests, and they're both pretty easy. Also take home quizzes and book assignments .

Very good professor. He is funny and keeps class pretty interesting. You have 4 take home quizzes and two book assignments which are all fairly easy. The tests are a bit challenging, but he gives you a comprehensive review. If you study for the tests, you'll do fine. I attended about half the classes and got an A

Really great class. Watch a video clip every class, and have 3 book assignments. The textbook for the class was never used, so you don't need to buy it. There are two take home tests and two take home book assignments that are really easy. This class was so interesting and an easy A. I would definitely take him.

This teacher is very nice & fun to listen to. He shows clips of movies every class. There are 2 reading assignments which are given, but they aren't hard & the books are actually interesting. I would HIGHLY recommend that you buy & read the text book or you wont get an "A". I loved this class so much that I took HIST 1312 with him again!
He was pretty hard, his test were very hard. He gave two book assignments that made the class alot harder than it needed to be. I'd say pass up on him, and take someone esle. He is a forsure B though

The professor is very lecture-heavy and reads off slides with little to no explanation about the concept. Quizzes are spontaneous, and they happen after each topic that you JUST learned. The TA explains the material in the same way as the professor, so they are no help, especially since this class has tough material and grades HARSHLY. AVOIDDDDD!!!

Very lecture heavy. Just reads from PowerPoint every class, never elaborates on topics or gives examples. Quizzes are worth 15% of the overall grade, and there is a quiz after pretty much every lecture on the topic you just "learned". reviews.comment: The professor reads directly from the slides. I had to teach all of the material to myself. The TA, Wonjun, was utterly unhelpful for the entire semester. I tried asking him questions a few times, but he just seemed confused and told me to read the slides and practice. Every time I spoke to him, I ended up more confused.

Tough grader, Assignments are worth 30% without partial credit an 80 or a 0. reviews.comment: She's a great professor and you can tell she is very passionate about the subject. She kept the class engaged and encouraged participation about topics we discussed. Most of the weight of your grade will come from the tests and the few assignments she gives but she gives reviews and the assignments are easy.

Compared to previous sociology classes, Environment and Society was very engrossing. In my opinion, the only downside to the course was on days I was absent with a doctor's note I still had to complete the attendance assignment. Otherwise, Dr. Bergstrand was as excellent lecturer and made sure to include relevant and timely information.

reviews.comment: Literally an angel on earth, she made social statistics really enjoyable. She gives very helpful feedback and she really cares about lol of her students. Planning on taking her again next semester!

Professor Bergstrand was awesome! She graded on a few things but the assignments were easy. The quizzes were worth most of your grade but they were based on the lectures. reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Love this professor! Already have plans to take her again next semester.

Professor B was awesome! Attendance isn't mandatory but there is daily participation grades that are worth 16% of your grade. She emphasizes what's on the tests on the review lesson :)

reviews.comment: Professor Bergstrand is one of the best professors I have had. There are 3 exams and 3 signature assignments and daily participation grades.  Tests are easy as long as you memorize vocab and read the textbook. Lectures were always interesting and interactive.

Class is very straightforward. Professor is accessible outside class. The textbook is required as it goes along with the lecture and there is book-check questions on the exams. Graded by a few things: signature assignments, exams, and daily participation grades so make sure u attend lecture!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super easy and to the point. Lectures were short and pretty interesting. Grading was easy.

I loved this professor. Her lectures are interesting, engaging, encouraging, & easy to understand. The exams are mostly based on her lectures, the textbook is really to get a deeper understanding of the material. I enjoyed this class so much that I considered switching over to a sociology degree at one point. Easy A if you pay attention & study.

Very sweet and passionate about her field. Tests were very well reflective of study guides and mostly based on vocabulary from lectures. Papers were very confusing and difficult though. She wanted it written differently then any other paper I've written but did not explain well of what she was looking for. Papers were the reason I got a B instead A

She's one of the best professors I've had in a while. The material isnt the hardest. almost all of the test questions are from her slides, she also posts her slides online but I recommend going to class cause she counts class activities as attendance, no extra credit or curves.

reviews.comment: Ms. Bergstrand's sociology class was by far my favorite class. She was available outside of class, gave test reviews, and her lectures were never boring. She is the best professor I have ever had! She takes attendance every class so make sure you go. She assigns 3 essays (which are required by the state so it is not up to her) She has 3 exams (2 regular and 1 final that isn't cumulative) and gives a study guide the class before the test which is everything you need to know to get a 100. Very easy A!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Easy in-class activity every lecture- mostly asking about your opinions. For tests, know your vocabulary and you'll pass. Vocab + slide review  an A or a high B. She reviews before every test. 3 essays- the hardest part honestly is picking a topic. Loved the discussions. The class I looked most forward too. She mediates controversial convos well.

Dr. Bergstrand is an amazing professor, her lectures are very interesting and makes you wonder about so many things. She does take daily grades for every class so you must show up and just 3 exams which are fairly easy as long as you study the material she goes over in the powerpoint! reviews.comment: 3 or 4 assignments, one of which is a group project. Pop quizzes over daily readings. Professor Bergstrand is amazing and shes funny and caring. Makes the class a breeze and always willing to help.

reviews.comment: Probably the best professor I have ever taken. Her lectures are informative and fun. I felt like I have learned the most from her. She has a talent of making subjects that others may find boring interesting and fun. I highly recommend taking her.

I took her class for Statistics, it is a tough class but the way she explains concepts make the tough topics doable. No attendance required but she gives attendance points if you do come. reviews.comment: Dr. Bergstrand is awesome! She's a servant for the community by pioneering this course (Environmental Sociology) at UTA. EVERYONE NEEDS TO TAKE THIS CLASS BEFORE GRADUATING no matter their degree. It gives you a more woke perspective on the planet, your consumerism, food intake, and more. reviews.comment: Awesome professor she is so kind and the lecture is very interesting( many videos and class discussion). I definitely would take her again.

Professor is great, really listens to students. The class is very interesting and eye opening. You should come everyday because tests are mostly lecture based but the lectures are very interesting. Honestly I think this is a good class to take no matter what your major is, topics are very relevant (like climate change).

Dr. Logan is a good professor. He's very knowledgeable in his area and is always making sure everybody understands everything. The test don't necessarily follow exactly the examples in class but as long as you understand the material you will be fine. They are meant to test if you understand rather than if you can copy and paste.

Dr. Logan wasn't the best and wasn't the worst. His class is very hard to know the exact criteria for grading. That being said, if you don't understand something he will take the time to try to explain it. He is a nice enough guy and takes cheating VERY seriously. He usually allows you to have a sheet during the exam as well which helps.

While the professor is knowledgeable and presents material clearly in class, the exams often do not reflect the content or format of the homework assignments or review materials. This makes it difficult to prepare effectively, as the study resources provided don't align with what's tested.
Professor Logan is by far the toughest professor I have ever encountered in my college years. He does not create a positive class environment & the reviews for his exams do not match the final exam.

Dr Logan creates stressful environment for students during the exams. His exams are extremely difficult and don't match the material covered in his reviews. He keeps interrupts students during exams, making discouraging comments like "You shouldn't take too long. If you know estimate you should've got it done in 10 minutes" which makes you confuse.

one of THE easiest graders i've had so far! amazing feedback. she does a great job at teaching and participating in the growth of her students. her students enjoy participating since she makes it enjoyable. if u can't handle the base education of communications or participation but you're in comms.. consider studying smth else :/

I'm not 100% sure this is Dr. Chatterjee's fault, but I am SO sick of having her for so many classes. Like, come on, mix it up. Also why do we have to take group comm and group theory. Waste of money and boring class.

Responded to my emails QUICK. Loved her lectures. Such an ez A+ (show up and do ur assignments tho). group presentation criteria was clear and helpful. she is so sweet and helpful when you have questions. she remembers faces and names, really good at connecting w/ her students. loved her & cant wait to have her again

Basically all group projects and long lectures. There was a some easy quizzes over the reading due every weekend. The major group project instructions and grading rubric will not reflect the actual grade given. The syllabus only matters when she needs it to. She will not be accessible outside class when needed for any guidance.
Dr. Chatterjee is a hard grader! She usually has a stern face and rarely smiles. Take another teacher if possible.

Super easy straightforward class. You get one big semester Group project, and the rest is just open note chapter quizzes. If you download the pptx and fill in the missing words during lecture and use ctrl + F and the free online book website for the quizzes you should get an easy A. Love herrrrrr

Professor was good with lectures and class.She is kind to students and will give back good constructive feedback when needed. reviews.comment: Lots of group work, your entire grade depends upon it. She says 'rate them low if they don't participate' but it won't affect them that much. Very picky on papers with little feedback. ESPECIALLY CITATIONS! Do not mess up your citations!!!!!

Dr. Chatterjee is very kind and understanding! She really engages with her students during lectures and doesn't mind going over a topic again if you're confused. No tests, just quizzes that you have 2 attempts on. She is pretty picky with the group presentations though, ask her to look over it so you have everything she's asking for!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Not consistent. I gave her my paper to look at to see if I was on the right track and she told me it looked good. Turned in the same paper she review in and got a horrible grade. Pal was a lot of busy work. The lecture was extremely boring but the class is easy if you attend class.

There were no tests. 2 papers, group project, quizzes every other week. You do have to go to class for material for the quizzes and in class assignments. There was a PAL course we had to take that felt like busy work. But she is a great professor. She will review your work before you submit it and she offered us extra credit. Very personable.
The lectures were long and boring. lots of group work, and a quiz every week. attendance was optional, which was nice. she gives good feedback if you reach out.
Great professor. Ignore the reviews. She is very kind, and gives great feedback. Lot's of group work, but a fun class. You learn a lot.

Professor Chatterjee is a great professor. Read the book, the test is very book heavy and the online modules help too. Go to class! Attendance is very important in her class. I learned a lot from her as a professor and am taking her again this semester. She is fair, kind and very clear on her expectations.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: She was okay, nothing great but nothing horrible. She makes everything due on Saturday nights, not sure why she thinks that's a good idea. No teacher makes things due on Saturday nights, except for her.

Chatterjee is an adequate teacher. However, I think the questions she uses in her test & quizzes arent the best. reviews.comment: Tests were very easy and presentations are graded fairly, so make sure you put in effort. Material/class was a bit boring, but not too bad overall.

I took 3 classes with Dr. Chatterjee this past semester and she's a great professor. Her classes are not easy but just put in some thought and you'll do fine. She's very caring about her students and gives you every chance to be successful in her classes. Textbook readings are a must for class discussion/lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: The book is not mandatory but SUPER helpful especially on exams. She gave open book/note quizzes at the end of each section with multiple tries and easy notes to understand. She did require group assignments and discussion board posts but it was short and fun with a good group. If you put the effort in, you pass with a high grade.

Not sure why she has such low ratings on here...I graduate in a few weeks and this class didn't make me sweat or anything. I thoroughly enjoyed the content and her lectures! Definitely not a "no book, no attendance" but if you actually read and participate, you'll be fine. She's amazing! 11 stars (and she does not have a monotone voice haha)
This is an an upper level course. Don't expect to ease by. It's interesting material and Dr Chattergee encourages feedback during her lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is a 4000-level COMS class: if you aren't prepared to read the textbook, then you should probably switch majors. Otherwise a great prof for Comm major students!

reviews.comment: Read the book before class start Take notes during the class study the PowerPoints and pay attention during the group presentations -- you will be tested on those theories.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Chatterjee is a sweet lady but definitely a boring lecturer. As others have mentioned, she has the same monotone voice that makes it really hard for you to stay interested. GO TO CLASS, it is an easy A bc of group tests and participation points. The only thing that made me not get an B instead of an A was messing up my participation points. :(

Her lectures are boring, but the tests come straight out of the book so just read it and you'll be good. THE BOOK IS AN ABSOLUTE MUST. No reason to go to class except that 25% of the grade is off participation points that she gives out randomly throughout the semester and you don't know when. 5 tests and 1 easy group project, no other work.

reviews.comment: It's not easy if you just want to study note to get A. Read the book. It's help a lots. She grades hardly on presentation. Be careful. Attendance is mandatory.

reviews.comment: You will learn a lot in Dr. Chatterjee's Communication Theory class.
