The Aleks takes so much time and the problems aren't on exams. Each lab has 2 quizzes and lecture is always behind labs, so you have to stay ahead of lecture which makes lecture useless. After you waste all your time on Aleks and lecture, you're out of time to work on book problems or study for your other classes. More tedious than highschool

He's a great lecturer and is a nice guy - gives you notes that have everything you need to know. The exams come right from the book problems. Only issue is the UTA Chem dept forces you to do pointless online HW. Tons of online homework that wastes your time because the material is not on the exam.
Do the practice exams and you're good. He gives you a lot to work with to study for exams. I also enjoyed the lectures

He suggested I quit my job to have enough time to study for his INTRO class. The book he wrote is so riddled with errors that he had to give us a correction supplement for it. He expects us to learn quantum physics for an INTRO CHEM CLASS, doesn't curve grades, and gives you 50 mins to answer 20 grad-level questions, no formulas provided. Sadistic.
This class is so hard, but Dr. Rogers makes it amazing. I love love love love love Dr. Rogers and I could not recommend taking his class strongly enough. He's an amazing lecturer and awesome person

Fantastic lecturer and really wants you to succeed. On top of helping you build great notes, he hosts Problem Sessions to help you study for his tests. He teaches to the test, something a lot of profs don't do! His class is a lot of work, but he is hands down the best chem prof on campus.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This was honestly my easiest class so far. As long as you come to class regularly and listen, and study the past questions behind the textbook (he wrote it so we had the pdf version for free) you'll pass.

Never in my life have I had a better teacher/professor than Dr. Rogers. Chemistry itself is a challenging subject but he manages to break it down and make it easy. He has tons of old test questions he gives you to review, which are the EXACT same format as the midterms you'll take, only the numbers are changed (some are even recycled). Amazing man.

Dr. Rogers is a great professor. He is very good at actually teaching the material, and seems to care about his students. His lectures are excellent. The tests were very difficult and the ALEKS homework program was time-consuming.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Probably the best professor I've ever had. His tests are hard af, but he teaches well it sort of evens out (but not really). Inspirational and makes chemistry fun. The final was the hardest test I have ever taken, even after just finishing OChem 1.

Dr. Rogers is an amazing professor and I'd take him again in a heartbeat. The tests are multiple choice but not easy. Attendance is mandatory and checked by way of clicker questions. The ALEKS program for homework takes a lot of time. He is very kind and easily accessible, always trying to help students do well. He really cares.

Professor Rogers is the best at chemistry; he really enjoys it and makes the class interesting. For tests just study the review problems and you'll do great. I got an A but I would study a week prior to the test. ALEKS homework is going to kill you but do it anyway it helps to prepare you for the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor rogers is an outstanding professor and I enjoyed his lectures. I wasn't able to attend all the classes and lab session and because of that I have to redo the class because I need a better grade than what I got. Attending all lectures, problem sessions, reading the book and notes before and after class is recommended. Ill retake his class.

What you need to do to pass: 1) attend every lecture 2) go through the practice exams he posts on BB before the test 3) Go to the reviews held by the biochem society (you have to pay for these but I honestly think it's worth it- I wish I had gone to each one!) 4) go through the study guides in the lecture notes
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: My Chem1 teacher @ TCC recommended Dr. Rogers class. I knew that it wasnt going to be an easy A but the amount of work I put into the homework and studying for the tests, Its not adding up. Tests are hard and he has all possible answers as a choice. Ill be back to take it again in the spring or fall with a different instructor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: If you find out your lab TA grades hard then switch to a different section cause its counts as 25% of the overall grade. Homework is done on Aleks, which can be VERY time consuming and confusing. Dr. Rogers tests are tricky so you better know the material.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Professor Rogers was amazing, BUT only take this class if you absolutely need it. I'm a science major but in psychology and I wasn't motivated enough to keep up w/ the countless HW assignments, HW alone took so many hours of my time I could've used studying for classes I actually need. If you need any science credit, don't take chem here.

I feel like this the professor that made me love chemistry and understand it which made it easy. He is knowledgeable and an excellent teacher. I could not take him for one of my chem courses so I used his notes which saved my life. Read the textbooks and study his notes too. Its chemistry you have to study consistently if you do your part SUCCESS.
Dr. Rogers is the best! I had him for both chem 1441 & 1442 and it was easy! He tests exactly like how he lectures!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took this man for both Gen Chems. Dr. Rogers is a great professor and deserves every bit of praise. however, I will warn that he wants to master the material, know it front to back. His tests can be pretty difficult if you don't study effectively. So basically, its easy to make a B but its hard to make an A

The first test  60% of the class failed. Yet he refused to curve or to write better test. Each test is set up to trick you not to test your comprehension. The test have material god knows where it came from. Lectures are fill in the blank. This makes it hard to learn the material. Lab was easy (received a A). As a professor he wasn't encouraging!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Rogers is THE BEST chemistry professor. I had him for Gen Chem 1 & 2 and made an easy A. His fill in the blank notes make you understand the material and his tests are fair. Come to class, fill out your notes, and do the $1 practice tests from the SECC till you're sick of it. He'll be more than happy to see you in office hours also.

He's very passionate about chemistry, which makes him a great professor. He's very easy to talk to and will try to remember your name. People say he's hard, but the subject is just hard itself. Buy his old test questions because his test is the same thing. Read his textbook and do the practice problems. Finish ALEKS because you get extra credit.

For organic chemistry he provides printable notes that you bring to every lecture and simply fill in the blanks as he shows them in the powerpoint. Even with pretty large class sizes, he strives to know student's names, and personally wants all students to pass. His tests can be difficult due to the coursed material, but he gives effective reviews.

Dr. Rogers is an AMAZING professor, he gives lots of bonus points in class and explains things so clearly that you'll understand the material even if you're not a science major. Exams are not tricky--study all old exams on his website and SECC, go to problem sessions and you'll be fine. Lab Sucks and the TA named Roy is the worst, he WILL fail you.

Took him for Gen Chem 2, and it was great! Amazing lectures and a great guy giving them. Tests are exactly like the reviews you can buy. He basically gives you the steps to solving each question on the exam. Best professor at UTA, and an easy A if you come to class and pay attention.

Best professor ever, very funny, smart and intelligent. notebook from bookstore helps a lot. Yeah his homework is super hard(from Aleks and took about 8 hours to finish it), test question sometimes are tricky, but his passion and intelligence let me learn a lot. Definitely, I will take his class if I have the chance.

I appreciate Dr. Rogers so much. He makes outlined lecture notes for you to better follow and understand. When you ask him a question, even through email, he explains it well and shows you that he really cares. He does problem sessions, speaks eloquently, ALWAYS has a kind and enthusiastic attitude, always willing to help. He really is the best.
Such a lovely guy, he always does his best for his students
One of the best in the university. Took him for CHEM 1441/1442 and soon 2321!

Absolutely amazing professor. Out of the stereotypical professors that many freshmen have learned to be fearful of due to popular media and scare tactics by others, he defies all of them and shows you what a real college professor ought to be. Study hard and you'll do fine. He won't kill your GPA if you procrastinate; ALEKS will.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: There are not enough words in the english dictionary to describe how amazing of a teacher and person Dr. Rogers is! He makes Chemistry such a fun subject (never thought I'd have fun in Chemistry) his jokes are hilarious, and his teaching style is brilliant! Dr. Rogers is truly UTA's greatest gem! Go to class, study, ask questions and you're set!
Great Prof! Test are not insanely hard but it is  not easy! You have to work for it. Do the back problems and old tests and you'll be fine. YOU HAVE TO STUDY!

Dr. Rogers will be tough to beat as my favorite professor! Chemistry at UTA is notoriously difficult, but thats mitigated by the fact that hes such a phenomenal professor. He genuinely cares about his students and his lectures are coherent and fascinating. Hell make you work hard, but study well, use your resources, and youll succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This man should be praised for his teaching ability, chemistry is tough but doing the practice problems help out a lot and read his textbook, really well written and it pretty much follows his lectures. use the Chemistry Clinic too and watch the practice problem sessions.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Had him for 1441, and I will take him for chem 1442 as well. Chem is a challenging class, but he help students to learn. Test can be hard, but if  do practice problems, practice test, and read the book you will do just fine. He is awesome I really enjoy his lectures.
Amazing! That's enough to describe him and his lectures. Great professor. Wish all my lecturers were like him, I learned a lot.

Took for 5-week summer 2 and it was tough! Still, Dr Rogers is sweet, upbeat and his lectures draw your attention. He really cares about his students, always answers questions thoroughly and kindly. Review notes taken in class and work through practice exams in order to pass. Must attend class or you'll get lost real quick! Don't slack off in lab!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Had him for 1441, which is a challenging class, but he does a lot to help students learn and prepare for the test.  It is a very doable class. But the tests are made to challenge your understanding of the concepts, not just plugging in equations. He offers good advice on learning; students should heed it, and assess their own learning/study habits

I had Rogers for Chem 1441 and 1442. He is my favorite professor, hands down. His lectures are excellent. His tests are tricky, but he mentions ahead of time *exceptions* to know and has practice tests available. I would definitely recommend him! He cares about his students and is very approachable. Study hard and you will be fine. Good luck guys!

Great lecturer and very entertaining. Dr. Rogers knows how to engage his students and make sure they absorb the knowledge he gives. Tests are hard, but if you study your notes and do the homework, the grade you want is achievable. In this class, the grade you end up with is what you deserve. I absolutely recommend Dr. Rogers to all chem students.

He has one of the best lectures for CHEM-1441, notes are pre-printed and are the "fill-in-the-blanks" type. Very funny and interesting too. He tries his best to supply you with resources (HW, Practice Problems, Reviews, etc.). The material itself was easy to understand, but he makes you work for the tests. If you're not going to try, you'll fail.

Dr. Rogers was an amazing professor! I love how he makes his own lecture notes as they help you understand the material very well.  Also, his tests are not tricky but they can be tough. Make sure you study his practice problems and his past exams non stop, that is what got me through the class. Very funny guy and really knows his stuff.

Dr. Rogers is one of the best teachers I have ever had, he makes learning Chemistry fun (well as fun as it can be). His lecture notes are incredibly helpful and he really wants to make sure you understand the material. If you can get into his class try your best because he is awesome. GO TO CLASS. Attendance can majorly effect your grade!!!

They don't make professors like Dr. Rogers anymore. He is a diamond in the rough. Forget all the negative things you may have heard of him--no one will make you understand chemistry the way he does. He is clear, and concise in his teaching, passionate about chemistry, and quirky and funny to top it all off. You will love him. I guarantee it.

I'm a senior now & I still have not encountered a single professor who teaches better than Dr. Rogers. He could teach a course on underwater basket-weaving & make it interesting. I've had him for 4 courses & he has the same method in each course with notes. Print the handouts, go to class, & write down "hints" he gives you & you'll get an A.

Passing Chem 1441 isn't as difficult as everyone is making it out to be. Dr. Rogers gives you all the tools to succeed it is just up to you on whether or not you use them. His notes are fill in the blank and very easy to follow. Go over the problems in your notes and practice old tests. He replaces the lowest test grade with your final. Put in work

Dr. Rogers is a hilarious professor who makes learning Chemistry really enjoyable. Go register for his class right now or by the time you're done reading this it will already be filled up. If you want an A in the class get his practice test and review them a few times, the exam will be a piece of cake. If you want comedy & chemistry take his class!

Dr. Rogers is one of the best professors I have had. He makes sure that you understand the material and will go out of his way to make sure that you understand what he is trying to teach. He has nothing but the best interests of his students at heart. I would take him again in a heartbeat! As long as you study and apply yourself you will do well.

I took Dr. Rogers for CHEM 1441 during a 5 week summer course and then CHEM 1442 during the following semester. He is absolutely the energetic professor I have had at UTA and really cares for his students. He will try to get to know each one of his students. His tests are not easy, but if you work hard you will get an A.

Dr. Rogers is the reason I'm pursuing a science degree. He goes above and beyond to present information in the clearest way possible and his passion for teaching is evident in everything he does. He says the first day, "science is not easy" and it shouldn't be. He says that standards are high in the beginning which means you actually have to work

He is a good professor that loves what he does. Don't expect an easy A but if you put in the effort you will receive what you deserve. Be prepared for long ALEKS assignments but overall he is the best CHEM1442 professor to take.

Organic chemistry is hard; there's no such thing as a walk in the park for any ochem class.  But Dr. Rogers's teaching style is effective, and he has worked hard to make the content understandable for people like me with simple brains.  Be prepared to put in some time & effort, and if you do, you will do great!

This is the best Chem Professor anyone can take at UTA. Its clear to see that he takes time to prepare his lectures and is passionate about what he does. His tests are not a walk in the park, he makes you work for it but nevertheless you are bound to love the class since he is phenomenal as a teacher. Loved his class.

I took Dr. Rogers for CHEM 14411442. He is very energetic. He takes his time with his students and gets to know them. He loves teaching and creates a positive vibe throughout his lectures. He gives you everything you need to be successful in the course. He expects you to earn your grade. I have never taken a chemistry course in HS, but I did well.
I love Dr. Rogers so much. He is such a good teacher, and you should definitely take him!!

I don't really understand all of the comments saying his test are difficult. There are many old exams floating around and he basically tells you what "tricks" will be on the exam. Overall a phenomenal instructor i would recommend to anyone.
I wouldn't take him if i were you.. his test is nightmare.. He's a good professor though, incredible lectures
A very intelligent professor that is passionate about his lectures; however he is extremely difficult.

Jimmy Rogers is the best - I would take him if he taught the phone book.  I took his special topics MCAT prep course, and it will save my MCAT score.  He has incredible short cuts and his humor somehow manages to keep the class engaged through four-hour lectures.  He uses fill-in-the-blank notes, which are an invaluable resource for future study.

I took Dr. Rogers in fall 2012 at UTA. I really enjoyed all of his lectures and he is very funny. He makes learning the material fun and he is very knowledgeable in the subject. I do want to note his tests are VERY difficult. You need to study for many days to adequately prepare or you will not pass. Homework due every week, 3 tests, and a final.

His general chemistry II class is more difficult than his general chemistry I class.  I feel like you do need to rely on the book a little more than in general chemistry I.  He also likes to use ALEKS for homework, which is the biggest pain in the butt in the world. He is a good lecturer, so go to class because he tests over small things.

Dr. Rogers knows chemistry very well.  His lectures are crystal clear, and he is concise and tells you what you need to know.  He goes through examples too in class.  His exams are just like his notes, but you have to go to class to understand them. He is a fair professor, and he even has practice exams available. He is a great professor!

Great professor. Really knows his stuff. His tests though are ridiculous. Way way too hard. Due to this I would not recommend you take him unless you have a GREAT understanding of chemistry or are premed (and even then....)
Dr. Rogers in thorough and very knowledgeable.

Dr. Rogers is absolutely amazing! He loves chemistry and knows exactly what he is talking about. Chemistry is a hard subject but he provides a lot of options for students to pass his class such as S.I., problem sessions, chemistry clinic, test reviews, etc. A lot of online homework, so get ready!

Best teacher I've had at UTA. Don't take him if you don't want to learn! Took for Genchem1 and OChem1 and loved it! He makes you work for the grade, but in the end you come out with a greater understanding of chemistry than you do with any other teacher here. Have to read book and work prac. probs! Enthusiatic, organized, nice, and awesome prof!!

Dr. Rogers truly cares for his students and the material he teaches. He is enthusiastic about the subject, which makes lectures immersive. I don't understand how previous posts think his tests are "tricky" (made a 92 and 100 on the mid-terms so far); he gives an abundance of resources to allow you to succeed.  - Current student

Wouldn't take unless you are a chemistry major. Puts far too much emphasis on the exceptions in chemistry instead of seeing if we actually understand the concepts. Openly known as the hardest chem professor at UTA.

Rogers is awesome, his energy is infectious, and he's always available to help. He genuinely wants you to succeed, and part of that success is understanding the rules AND EXCEPTIONS in chemistry. Yes, his exams are hard, but he also tells you exactly which 'tricks' he'll test during lecture. Also, great focus on material for the MCAT, PCAT, etc.
Would not take again. Tests are pretty ridiculous. Focuses more on asking about the tricks for each problem than making sure we understood the content.

Although I didnot make the grade i wanted, it was my fault! he is an incredible professor, very encouraging and helpful. read the book and do all end of chp problems and you will make good grades! the key is not to procrastinate... It was not an easy class but learned a lot!

Here's the deal with Rogers. His notes and lectures are awesome. Heavy book work required in all classes. His tests... HARDEST THINGS EVER. BUT, you will be more prepared for the final then any of the other classes will be. But.. they will have higher test scores throughout the semester. My advice.. get his notes from a friend but take someone else

His lectures are entertaining and his notes are organic chemistry gold  He's always willing to help you and holds extra sessions out of class to do example probs.  This is a very hard class with a lot of information to go over and he made organic chemistry understandable.  I put hours every night into studying and reading the chapters and made an A

Dr. Rogers is a great lecturer. He is good at inspiring students to learn the materials and passionate in teaching. To have an A in his class, you must know the materials. His tests are hard because there are only about 20-24 questions/test. I definitely love him. If you must take the course, take it with him since you can learn a lot. Gluck
Dr. Rogers is the best chemistry professor of all time. He is the best.

In every level of education (grade school, highschool, undergrad, and grad school) you will have just a small handful of teachers that you will never forget, it is a rare and wonderful thing and Dr. Rogers is Absolutly one of those teachers. His tests are hard but the departmential final is based on his tests so your better off learning it from him

Yes, his lectures are incredible, in fact it made chemistry fun and interesting. But his exams will have you pulling your hair out. They ARE tricky, every little detail and rule exception will screw you over. I studied day & night and still struggled tremendously. If you have another option, take it without doubt.
Great guy, great lectures! Only downside is the long homework. But you definitely learn the material, and he is a great professor!

He's a good professor, but his homework can be excruciatingly long and his exams are HARD. Class average for exams is always failing. Some opportunity to pass (lab is easy and helps a lot). Overall, I would take him, just be prepared for his ridiculous exams.

Great Professor. Will single you out if you're on your phone and will move you during test if he thinks you're cheating. Great professor and easy class. Understand the concepts and tie it to each other and you're set
Hands down the absolute best teacher you will ever have. Not an exaggeration. Words cannot describe how wonderful this professor is. If there is a chance to register for his classes, do it!

Dr. Rogers is an amazing professor who cares about the success of his students. He  gives us everything we need in order to pass. If you don't pass it's because you didn't study. I love his teaching methods. He encourages his students and teaches with a passion. No other professor like him. I can't imagine taking a chem class without him

Dr. Rogers is an amazing professor! He truly cares about his students succeeding in his class. If you are confused he will gladly try to re-explain it. he takes attendance through clicker questions. He tries to make the class fun but informative. Not a easy class at all but if you study hard and i mean at least 3hrs everyday you may just pass.

His fill in the blank notes made everything a lot clearer. I took strom for ochem 1 and barely got a B, but with rogers I understood so much more and got an A. I didn't use the book very much. Tests came straight from his notes and the old exams were also helpful. He's AWESOME!!

I look forward to going to his lecture every mwf. His fill in the blank notes are so helpful and he keeps class interesting by making quirky little jokes. I haven't even opened the textbook so if you've taken chem in high school you probably won't even need the book. He takes attendance using a clicker though

One of my friends that graduated last year told me to take Dr. Rogers and it was the best decision I made this semester. I am a biochemistry major so I already loved chemistry, but he made me love it more. His lectures are great plus he is very engaging and funny. I would recommend anyone to take this course. The tests are not easy, but tolerable.
He's a pretty cool professor. He loves what he's doing. Easy to understand and his notes are the best.
the only positive part of this class is the notes....If I had a choice I would take this class with another professor

Fantastic lecturer, always answers the questions asked in class so that everyone understands. Tests can be tricky at times, but you will be guaranteed to learn the material. He uses fill in the blank notes, but you dont have to use them. He is so passionate about teaching/chem and it makes it easy to pay attention to.

Let me start by assuming this page is for Dr. Jimmy ROGERS, as there is no professor at UT Arlington named Jimmy Rodgers, in the chemistry department or otherwise. With that in mind, Dr. Rogers is passionate and enthusiastic; if you pay attention in his class, you will learn what you need. Tests are tough, though - work out each problem CAREFULLY!

He tells lots of jokes during lecture. There are notes that he uses which are fill in the blanks. He's a great lecturer, but his tests can be tricky. "I don't test if you understand the material; I test if you've mastered the material." The Mastering Chemistry is awful btw.

If you have trouble with or want to learn chemistry this is the guy to take! People complain about his concept questions (which are the ones I tend to miss) but they are a true test of understanding. He is the best to take for gen chem, this is not a plug and chug class but one you learn in. Highly recommend! Amazing amazing!

Made intro hard than needs to be as his only job is to teach textbook concepts n write xms.Testing silly exceptions on exams doesntreflect grd earned nor gud to put wrong ans when ull mistake under just 50 min for 22-25 problems so no doubl checkExpects to give all time to chem n histime consuming masteringchem. feel sorry for freshmans becz of he.

Great professor! I loved Rogers class, he made lecture interesting with his stories that helped you remember what he is trying to teach. Very understanding and always willing to help out.. He even threw in bonus points for attending class. The class is difficult but you can pass. Attend every class. He made me love chemistry again!

I think he is the best teacher I have taken so far. He gives really good notes. however, his tests are tricky and a little bit hard. Make sure you know everything and you do all his practice tests; problem sessions are helpful as well. I got a 45 and a 60 in his first two tests, and I ended up with a B.So don't give up if you start with a low score

His tests are very tricky. It took me making a 35 before I realized that it is important to go buy the old exams and attend the Chem/Biochem society's review. Then I made As. He replaces your lowest test grade with your final if it will help you. Go to class, join AURAS if you can, do the problem sessions, follow his outlines, and you'll do fine.

I had Prof. Rogers for both 1441 and 1442. All I can say about him is that he is ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC! I love his teaching style and how much he wants his students to succeed. I have never met a professor tat cares so much about his student's success like he does. Please do take him, it will be a great experience. You will learn a lot from him.

Chemistry is a difficult course so do not expect to pull of an easy A. This class requires a lot of work and attention. Yes, you can manage an A but expect to put a lot of effort to this class and stay on top of the material. Dr. Rogers is an amazing professor who will help you and provide a lot of resources for you to succeed.

Dr. Rogers is amazing. One of the best professors I've had. The class is tough, but any decent student willing to put in the work needed to achieve their desired grade should have no problem. I never bought the book, but heard it helped with the hw. Nonetheless, I did well without it. I highly recommend taking 1465 with Rogers.

I would highly recommend anyone to take his class.He provide fill-in-the-blank notes for class and his lecture are great! He makes chemistry understandable and he does practice problem sessions. His tests are a bit of a challenge, but if you study and do practice exams, then you should do well.

Dr. Rogers tests are not tricky. Science is about exceptions and he is just checking how well you know them. Study and get comfortable with the material, you can do it and still maintain a 4.0 just STUDY like you would a challenging class. Dr Rogers is one of the best professors at UTA, he does everything he can to help you succeed

This was the first chemistry class I have ever taken in my life and I am glad I had it with Dr. Rogers. He is clear and concise and to do well in the class attend the problem solving sessions he holds and do the practice tests he provides. You do need to study but you can do well if you put in the effort. By far one of the best professors at UTA

I took him over summer for Ochem 1/2, and it was great. After taking it at another school, it's amazing to experience someone actually teaching the material. Come to class, pay attention, and practice the problems and you'll do fine. Staying focused is the only hard part.

Taking Ochem 1 and 2 with Rogers back to back over the summer was grueling and stressful-even for Rogers. Nevertheless, when summer was over, I felt enlightened. His teaching style and tone really gets you hooked into the material. I recommend taking him over the spring/fall semesters because you'll be able to see him more often! haha

My favorite professor at UTA. I had nearly failed chemistry in high school, but Dr. Rogers made chemistry very understandable. The class isn't easy by any means, but do the practice exams and you'll do alright. He's also the head of the chess club. ;)

Ochem is no joke and he's one of the best professors for the subject. The first day of class, he'll outline the course for you. To do well in the course, you'll have to spend at least 3 hours studying for every 1 hour of lecture. That's what it'll take to succeed in this course. And the grading scale is lenient too-- 88 or higher is an A.

Dr. Rogers was TERRIBLE. He was very discouraging when I asked for help and his tests are the hardest exams I have ever taken in my life. I studied daily (Put more effort into this class than my major classes- biology) and I still didn't pass. I would go to his lectures, but take another teachers exams. It was terrible.

SAVE YOUR GPA AND DON'T TAKE ROGERS!!! I did all the homework, attended class, paid for private tutoring, attended the SI (subsitute intructor) sessions, and STILL it wasn't good enough for this class. BEWARE because during dead week he will teach 3 new chapters and either you understand it or your screwed for final.

Took chem 1441 & 1442 with him, he tries his best to make you know chemistry, but you have to put in effort too, otherwise you are screwed up, I am glad I took him, although I did not make  A in either of his classes, but the grades in his tests truly tell you how serious you are in studying.

After having an A the entire semester, I faced a final almost completely based upon info he sqeezed in on dead week. Such a great professor but such a terrible way to end the class. That exam was in no way indicative of the knowledge gained during the course of that semester.

Expects you to know stuff from Chem 1 and thinks you took him. Nice to the front row but doesn't care about the others. Tests are tricky and prepare to study a lot. I spent at least 12 hours a week and I still made a C.
I really recommend you guys take him for chemistry.  His notes are all you need to get an A. (plus showing up to class and doing homework).

Rogers is a great teacher. He explains chemistry subjects very well and is a great teacher to take if your serious about taking the MCAT. The only downfall is that his tests are extremely tricky. He says they are not, but they really are. I would suggest taking another teacher if you plan on keeping your science GPA high.

Fantastic lectures and a great prof but his tests are extremely tricky. The homework is incredibly time consuming and difficult to figure out. With lab and studying it's overwhelming. I would not take this class unless you took Chem I at UTA and recently. Don't make my mistake and wait between 1441 and 1442 or take 1441 elsewhere.

Dr. Rogers is the best lecturer I've had. He always records his class sessions in case you have to miss, and he also offers practice sessions for Gen Chem I and II. Also, his practice exams give you a taste of what to expect on future exams. I highly recommend him if you're serious about school. You can't go wrong with him.

Dr. Rogers is the best lecturer I have had the privilege of having. He always records his class sessions in case you have to miss, and he also offers practice sessions for Gen Chem I and II. Also, his practice exams give you a taste of what to expect on future exams. I highly recommend him if you're serious about school.

Really good chemistry teacher. Very clear, however, he has a lot of loopholes that he uses in his tests. Alpha decay and deuteron chapters is where it gets easy. This class needs a lot of keeping up, though.

He's one of the best Professors I have had during my time at UTA.  He is VERY helpful and understanding.  This semester I had to leave for 1 1/2wks and he was more than willing to work with me so I could make up tests and homework.  I would suggest him to anyone!

Awesome professor, I will take him again. His lecture is amazing. I can say that I learned in his class.

Very good professor,  absolutely recommend. You don't have to show up for class but it is good to. Follows the book so alot of reading is required. Come to his lectures and listen, you'll remember the material better because he likes to emphasize. He also tells you exactly what is on the exam on review day. Don't think that you can just go to class on review day and make an A or B on the exam. Multiple choice and T/F 50/50. Pretty easy class.

Gave an extra credit paper at the end of semester. Made me like law.

Multi. choice & T/F if 50min class, multi choice if 1hr20min class, no hw.

Don't bother to answer in class, you are in fact wrong.  10 page paper (do your best, use lots of references), midterm and final (I relied on the IRC itself and did well).  Class is long.  We got out "early" at 9:45 a few times, but mostly it was to the bitter end.

He tries really hard to make a boring subject interesting and his personality helps. Hes a great guy! Great class

Read for test 1 got a 92 because I had to much info in my head.

It is helpful to go to every class. But the only class you really have to go is the review day. He does very detailed reviews for his tests, pretty much goes over every question. Great teacher. Makes the subject interesting. Would definitely take him again!

No attendance taken, no curves on the exam and no pop quizzes. Book is a must-have. Attend test review days bc he literally has a copy of the exam he will be giving and tells you what to study and gives you the page number. No reason not to pass, even with a C (unless you're daft, lazy or just don't put in any effort at all).
only gives 4 tests then final, gives out a review of the test, but none of the questions or answers appear on the test..

2ND time taking Prof and I love his class. Very helpful and clear lectures. Clearly explains all concepts and cares if students understand. I feel like he wants us to be successful and not just a means to a paycheck. Come to class and get the book. Don't skip out because you'll miss out on great material that will matter in life. Take him!
His lectures are great. But he never responded to any of my emails. So I would not recommend him. Seems very hard to communicate with.

Loved loved loved him! He's funny, interesting, helpful, and you'll really learn a lot! He'll answer your questions, gives great reviews for tests, and all the stuff is really applicable to every day life. Loved him. Loved this class. Highly recommend!
I would recommend this professor. He was entertaining, clear, grades consists of 4 tests and extra credit. Tests are semi-hard but make sure to come on review days! Final is NOT comprehensive.

I had him for BLAW I & II.  I went to class everday but others didn't. It's helpful if you go to class bc he will give tips on test questions.  Most importantly, show up for review bc he gives the page of the book to study for every question. He is funny at times and talks about 2 min before class until the very end of class.

Take his class.  He loves the law and it shows in his teaching.  He also wants you to get an A.  He happily answers questions, gives an opportunity for extra credit, explains things clearly, and tells you what's on the tests down to the page numbers each question came from.  Go to class, especially on review days, take notes, and you'll ace it.
Great professor! I enjoyed his class  very much. Gives reviews for tests, a total of 4 tests and drops the lowest test grade.

Great Professor, gives reviews for every exam which cover exactly what will be on the test! 3 test and the final, he drops lowest test grade from first 3 test... he also makes the class interesting with his examples

Great class.  Great teacher.  He gives great reviews. Go to class and take good notes and you will be fine.  Easy A.  Gives extra credit--4.5 points added to your overall grade for the class if you do a short (5-10 minutes) powerpoint presentation about anything involving real estate.  Can earn additional 1.5 points by watching others presentations
The course material is pretty boring but he explains it well. Overall it's a fairly easy course, make sure you show up for the exam review the day before a test and you'll be good to go.
EASY PEASY! Attend every class, record his test review days, take class notes (vocabulary + examples given.)Super easy A! What's on his review is EXACTLY what's on the test - no surprises!!
Easy class, but a lot of work. At least 50 pages of writing (essay and mid-term combined).

He tells you exactly what is going to be on the test, question by question during the review so you don't really need to show up to class but it is recommended so that you can understand the material.

He is so boring. If you want to keep your sanity please do not take him. He has a 25 page paper due midway through the semester. He speaks all 2 hours and 50 mins of the class with a 5 min break in the middle. He speaks so fast that you cant even always get the notes down. Save your self if you have a choice or bring coffee every time if you don't.

His text were very straight forward and what I would recommend recording his class then listen to it again. I took his class this past summer and it was worth it because he let you out early but Jere Turner is more entertaining then him.

The class itself is hard, but he makes it as simple as possible. The class requires a lot of reading and plenty of studying, but it is not impossible to get an A. His reviews before the exam are very important. He tells you exactly what will be on the exams. He uses no visual aids, all verbal lectures. Gives extra on final average (3pts). Take him!

He's a good lecturer and very funny. Lectures straight from the book and gives really good reviews. He tells you what will be on the test, which are situational. You still have to know the information though, to do well on the test. Extra credit assignment end of semester. He goes too fast sometimes and two of the tests were 9 chapters long.
B law 1. He is GREAT! Definitely take him. He follows the book and his reviews are so easy. Tests are the easiest out of all the B law teachers.

Really loved his class. Lecture is really helpful, tells what wil be on the coming test. His reviews are the best. He tells you exactly what will be covered and what you should focus on. The book was really helpful to me. He bases his reviews and lectures from it. He tells jokes and stories. Made a boring subject fun!
good prof. def recommend taking him for blaw gives good review before tests, curves tests, and is pretty funny during lecture. straightforward class no tricks!

Great professor, very helpful.  He definitely has a way of making his class interesting.  Holds the attention of the student very well.  His vocal fluctuations made me giggle sometimes as he will suddenly get loud.  Very excitable, but great prof!

he is better than Jere Turner.  enjoy his class.  His lecture is pretty fast pace even for reg. semester. 3 MC tests.  lectue are entertaining. test @ has quite a bit of tricky Q's, not intentional, bt the wordings can be tricky.  give xtrs credit easy assignment if class insist on it.  helpful & willing to answer q's and help student, unlike Turne

Hi Guys! Do not take his class. He is thinking he is smart but he is not.. He insults everyone when someone ask question, no reviews or powerpoint presentations online or anything to study..He is fast and telling reviews verbally.. which is not fair..Do not take his class
Great prof. Very interesting class. Gives awesome test reviews. Highly recommend taking him for blaw.
Very easy class. He tries to make the subject interesting. make sure you attend class and take notes or record test reviews.

I did not buy the book and attended class on every other occasion(or less). He gave a review be4 the test. He goes quickly so write fast. Test were roughly 40 TF questions. He also would give out case review assignments(if no book use google) These only help your grade. Thought I had a C for sure, got a B instead. Would reccomend as MANA elective.

Just show up and you will make at least a B+.  He gives you questions on the test on the class before the test so you can just look them up in your book the night before the exams! You must have your book though to pass!!
I had him in grade school. His a very nice prof, but he just talks a lot. But overall I would take him for other classes
you will need the book but an old version will be sufficient.he gives great reviews, go to class b-cuz he gives out test questions. knows what he is talking about. is a nice man.
Great teacher! Nice and funny guy and he trys to keep lectures entertaining. Easy tests! He literally tells you exactly what will be on the exam.

you will need the book for this class, but you don't need to attend class. he gives an extensive review the day before a test. however, he does tend to move his tests around so you might show up to class a couple days before the test just to make sure you get the review. he gives 3 tests and a final, pretty straight forward, easy A

Took this professor for gift & estate tax & we was fabulous. Only 2 tests (both 50 questions on a Scantron) & a 10 page paper on a topic of your choosing. In class, he tried to use interesting examples to liven up otherwise boring material. Really enjoyed the class & he seems to be a nice guy as well.
You must read and study the chapters to do well on his tests. He goes over the chapters fast so if you want to do well on his tests then read, study, and memorize ahead.

Gives killer reviews for the tests. Tells you exactly what you do and do not need to know. Do not expect to have much class discussion. He knows what he wants to talk about and doesn't like to get interrupted. Good prof overall.

He knows his stuff. Materials can be dry at times. But you MUST read the book to do well on the test. Be ready to read about 25 chapters for this class(it's not as bad as it sounds.) Does give out extra credits which is really easy. Also curves if the class average is low. Overall it's a do-able class.

He lectures straight from the book. The materials can be boring at times but he tries to give interesting case examples. Tells us exactly what will be on the test. Read your text and you will do good on tests. Never try to rush thru materials, will postpone tests.

this prof. is the most born prof. I ever had. read straight from book.an advise... just stay home and read on your own b/c thats what he does in class....and i must not forget sometimes he mumbles then all of sudden he yells...very annoying.
Teaches straight out of the book. Tests are fairly straight-forward. Animated lecturer keeps you at least awake for the late evening section.
A good teacher, does a good job. Has a nice review, says everything that is on the test. You have to study a little for the tests, and you should get a B. Highly recommended.
No homework.  Scantron tests.  Schwemer is not the most entertaining lecturer, but he answers all questions to the best of his ability.  Read the text carefully and you will make an A or B.
Easy class.  Read and regurgiate.  Scantron exams.
Do not take her. She never responds to emails, and she is extremely hard to get in contact with. The workload isn't heavy, but It's difficult with zero support. I would not recommend her at all.
I did not have a good experience in this class.

Do not take her. She never responds to emails and she is extremely hard to get in contact with. If you need clarity on an assignment, you basically have to ask weeks in advance. She does extend a lot of deadlines, but the workload is heavy, especially with zero support. I would not recommend her at all.

reviews.comment: Fluids with Dr. Zhang was probably one of my favorite classes. She follows the textbook strictly and her lectures are very organized. Any information that you may have missed can be found directly in the book. She makes it very clear what material you are expected to understand for exams, and exam questions are just like the homeworks.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Everyone I know either dropped or failed, grade is test heavy, lectures aren't posted so you can't reference them to study and it's the same deal with homework as there are no posted solutions, so you have no reference to study those either.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not the best but also not the worst. Doesn't post lecture notes on Canvas even though she does them on her iPad in lecture. Homework is lengthy but doable, expect 5-7 hours weekly. Her exams consist of problems nearly identical to homework problems. Would HEAVILY recommend using CPPMechEngTutorials on YouTube as help for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love this class and Prof Zhang. I've never met a professor so focused on TEACHING. She doesn't allow distractions, she encourages questions and is 100% all about the student learning. People who don't like her rules simply just don't respect the classroom environment. I learn so well in her class because I'm not distracted by other students.

Professor Liwei spends a lot of time deriving the equations needed for class. This is about 25 percent of her lectures. She gets very upset if she sees students talking, on their phones, making too many chewing noises or chairs squeaking too much.She does not post lecture notes or record lectures. You must attend class.

Professor skipped through derivations quickly which made it hard to understand when to apply assumptions. Feedback on homeworks was next to useless and no solutions where given. the exam questions come almost always from homework problems, with changes to what is being asked for. every homework assignment was long and frustrating.

Shes an okay teacher, the course is hard, and she rushes through derivations so making it tough to understand how formulas work and what assumptions accompany them. The tests are just old homework problems that she adds smaller questions on to and changes the numbers on. If you read the book you should be fine. Final is worth WAY TOOO MUCH !! (40%)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable professor especially when it comes to fluid dynamics. The homework is long and difficult but she's is very helpful during office hours and really works to make sure you understand the material. Overall a good professor that holds students to high standards but if you're not willing to work hard don't take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: It's a mystery to me how anyone can learn from her.
Hard grader, too much homework (spend around 7 hours home work each week), no solution given, very hard to follow and understand the problems.

Very clear and knowledgeable professor. She explains the concepts well in her lectures and gives modest amounts of homework. She will also surprise her students with pop quizzes, but these are usually very easy. She is very easy to reach through email and through office hours. She is rigid in the grading but has a alot of care for her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr Zhang did a good job with teaching the material and her lectures transitioned well to online when on-campus classes were halted due to COVID-19. There is a short/simple quiz given nearly every class period which you can work on with other students as well as getting assistance from Dr Zhang. Gives generous partial credit for tests.

reviews.comment: Lectures are confusing and her handwriting is often illegible. She is available to help during office hours. Short quiz given each lecture which you can work on with those around you. Ten hw problems given each week. The material isn't too difficult but it isn't explained well. Utilize other resources (e.g. book & online lectures by other profs)
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took this class last semester and she wasn't all that great. The class is Aleks. You'd have many modules to complete that at some point you'd stop trying to actually learn, and only focus on getting it done. Her lectures were not engaging either and attendance was mandatory, she didn't really care for the reasons why you couldn't show up either.

Never in my college days have I experienced this heavy of a workload. This course uses ALEKS and it is absolutely ridiculous. Every two-three says something is due. I don't care if the professor is nice. I am full time and one or more of my classes is slacking because of Math. It's required, so no work around, but prepare to be stressed.

Dr. Lubbe is a fantastic professor. Although calculus is a hard class, Lubbe's lectures are able to help clearly elucidate the concepts. Additionally, Lubbe is extremely helpful in her office hours. If you attend the office hours and go to lecture regularly, the class becomes easier. You should also bring homework problems to her office hours.

Professor Lubbe is super caring for her students and wants them to succeed. She always made sure to post in-class examples on Teams and made sure to make herself available for her students. Take her for Calc 1 if you can!

There is a ton of homework every week but Dr. Lubbe makes sure you feel prepared for it in labs and lectures. She's very open to helping and answering questions so don't be afraid to talk to her. The work was hard for me, but she helped a lot.

This teacher is amazing. She was able to explain math amazingly and very clearly. She rarely made mistakes and was very helpful when needed. She is very accessible after hours and definitely cares about the students. Best Calc I teacher.

I absolutely love taking her class, she is so funny there is a lot of homework but if you pay attention during the lecture you will have 0 issue. She also cares for her students and will always explain when needed. Sometimes she's a little to mathy when explaining but besides that she's the best:).

She's very outgoing! This was her first year teaching this course so it kinda seemed like she was learning as we went along which would throw me off. She gives out a handful of homework usually due either Thursday or Sunday, but doing the notes will make things easier since  quizzes/homeworks are online. Overall I'd say she makes the class easy!

Amazing Professor, difficult class if you don't put effort in. Quizzes and Exams will ruin your grade. Stat coins will be your best friend. It seems like there's no use for them, but wait until the end of the semester. Get those lab hours and attend every single lecture to get easy coins. You cannot get out of the final with coins though; removed.

I love love love professor Lubbe, she is caring and truly inspirational. For this course, you will have both lectures and labs(group activity in which you work on problems together). It provides a textbook but in my opinion as long as you watch the video and take notes you won't need it. Has one major paper towards the end.
Professor Lubbe makes the challenging stats class manageable. Her lectures are engaging, and the stat coins system helps boost grades. Unstuck study proved a useful study tool alongside the textbook.

Mrs. Lubbe was the best professor I had all semester. I will say that you can't just attend lectures and expect to do good. I would recommend learning the material through her videos for individual units, and then coming to class for clarification. Overall, I would definitely recommend taking her!

Professor is caring to students and gives good feedback.There s quite a bit of HW but as long as you pay attention in class it will not be overwhelming.Giver good extra credit opportunities.Overall a very good teacher who is good at what they do and wants there students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is very kind and welcoming. There isn't a better professor to teach MATH 1308. The topics in this class are hard, but Dr. Lubbe makes them easy to understand. There are group assignments, but they aren't hard, so don't stress about them. This class can easily be an A if you put in the effort to study. I recommend attending lectures and labs.

This professor truly cares about her students and tries her best to make difficult material much more approachable. Take every opportunity to earn "stats coins" as they will become helpful at the end of the semester. I definitely recommend taking her!

Stats is just a difficult class with a lot of material to learn, she makes it easier for her students. Her lectures are good and she has good learning resources and materials. I would recommend taking this teacher, but you will have to work if you want a good grade. There are four exams, and multiple homework's a week as well as a sip report.
I loved her! The nature of the course requires a somewhat heavy course load, but Alice Lubbe does a great job of making it manageable.

Good professor with a cute southern accent. The homework assignments take a long time. If you can go slow and steady, I would recommend it. However, if you do cram the homework until the last due date, start at least 3 days before its all due.
This professor provides plenty of extra credit opportunities. She isn't the best at teaching, but the book explains the concepts clearly. Also, the tests are in person, but they are online.

I took this course online with a different professor and failed but I decided to re-take it in person and I was able to get a B. Her stat coins extra credit system helped me get a good grade in her class and she was very accessible through her email outside of class. I can tell she genuinely knows what she is teaching, and cares for her students.

Professor Lubbe was a decent lecturer, though she was pretty monotone, but she was nice about answering questions and helping in labs. Calculus 2 is quite a hard class and I highly recommend using the practice tests to study for the midterms and final.

Her stats class is mostly mandatory attendance until the end, creating a participative learning environment. However, it's worth noting that the study plans don't perfectly align with test content. The class offers valuable insights, but students should be prepared to supplement their learning for comprehensive exam coverage.

Professor Lubbe's course is fairly easy as long you apply yourself and complete homework/study. She provides video notes for each topic so I found the lectures to be a little repetitive. Overall she is a kind and helpful professor that wants you to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Take her for calculus if you can. She was always very caring and welcoming during lecture and office hours. She goes thru many examples and reviews a whole week in advance for midterms. She posts multiple worked out old exams that help to study and prepare for midterms.

You can see this professor really loves her job. Through out her class time she provides opportunities to ear stat coins (in short words these are like extra credit)  these really help earn higher grades. She has her own way of doing things but as long as you pay attention it is great.

Professor Lubbe was really good! I was scared because math is a very hard subject for me but she did a good job teaching. She also walk around during lab and ready to help if you need it. There are 3 main units plus a readiness unit. 3 unit exams, 7 quizzes, 20 HW, 8 group lab activities, 2 induvial sip reports. Lots of ops for extra credit too.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Her lectures are engaging, and she is open to any questions, either in email or in-class. There is a lot of work in which include homework, quizzes, engaging lab activities, sip reports, and exams, although she does gives stat coins which you can use to trade in for attendance for lectures or labs, for retaking an exam, bringing up a grade, etc.

What I liked the most about professor Lubbe's class was her Stats Coins system she had in place. To get stats coins you have to answer questions, get good homework grades, etc. These coins can be used as quiz replacements, lecture replacements, and even get you out of the final exam. Her tests are pretty difficult so be sure you study the review!

Highly recommend. Her lectures are engaging, and she is ALWAYS open to questions, email or in-class. Lots of work tho, although she gives stat coins which you can use to not take the final. She is also caring and if you don't get the material, she really helps, and she has 100s of students. She's also open to creativity and not too rigid.

Great professor and passionate about her work. She gives a grace period as well. Easy professor but the subject material was not in my favor. Be sure to participate by going to the lab because she has group activities and also attend lectures- these will help earn stat coins. Stat coins will help out at the end of the semester.

One of the best teachers I had this semester. Lots of homework, and take home quizzes. She will work with you and genuinely wants you to pass the class. Lectures are mandatory but really helpful. Her stats coins system is beautiful. Study for the tests because a lot of information is covered.
Group project. I hate math with a passion, but she made it less miserable. She genuinely wants you to succeed. Responds to emails so quick. So appreciate of her. Take her please!!!!!

Professor Lubbe is not one of the math professors that deserves a low rating. I am taking her elementary statistics class over a summer session and she is efficient, laid back and knows what she is teaching and how to teach it. Seriously one of the best college professors I've had at UTA! If you are able to take her for a math course, DO IT!!

Dr Lubbe gives great lectures and is probably your best bet for Calc 2 at UTA. Calc 2 is very difficult, but she covers all difficult concepts in her lectures and walks you through lots of examples. She will answer your questions well and isn't condescending at all. She'll help you with any advanced academic pursuits (like honors projects) as well.

Professor Lubbe is incredible and truly cares for each of her students. The amount of effort you put in will ultimately determine your grade, but there are also plenty of opportunities to bring it up. Stats coins are lifesavers so participate in lecture quizzes and breakout sessions to get as many as you can! Take advantage of MyLab to study!

2 midterms + 1 final, each with an absurd individual weight of overall grade. Overall, a nice professor who doesn't really rush and helps you understand the material. Lots of homework to do which helps you prepare for midterms, tho grade weight isn't worth that much, but DO THEM. Make sure to always prepare in advance for midterms.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Lubbe is a really sweet professor, and she definitely made Cal 1 a lot easier. She does go pretty fast through the notes at times, so be aware of that, and go through the online textbook for stuff you don't get down in class. Also, for the midterms, go through the past exams she posts online and you should be good to go.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Online textbook that is included in tuition fees that gives insight on how to use statcrunch and excel but is not needed to pass. Professor Lubbe is well organized and her syllabus was really useful having all assignments descriptions and dates. There extra credit points that are easy to get and use, with options such as exempting the final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I hate math with a passion, but Professor Lubbe made taking a math class a lot easier. She posts lecture videos on Canvas. For labs she basically just lets us do our own thing, but will occasionally offer "breakout sessions" for extra credit. She also offers Stats Coins which can be redeemed. If you earn enough you can even exempt the final.

Cal 2 at UTA has departmental exams so exams will never get any easier no matter what professor you have. I will say that Lubbe is probably your best bet for Cal 2. She is understanding that students may not grasp the concepts right away and she tries her best to break things down to make them more understandable.

Not only did she care about me as an individual, she made a huge change in the class to accommodate other individuals with the same issue that may have not spoken up. Also when I clearly had not finished my readiness work, she did not shame me at all, she just taught me the material. She is also hilarious in her words and mannerisms. Great person.

Very helpful and nice professor. I honestly had a hard time with her lectures because her teaching method was not great for the way I learn so I found myself stop going to class and doing most of the studying on my own. She gives out a lot of resources.

This class is very easy just try. Lectures are great but her canvas is full of these like 10 minute videos over every module and watching those before a lecture make it SO MUCH EASIER, I promise. Lubbe is great. She's nice and easily approachable. She also really tries to learn her students names so she's sweet! EC stat coins can save your grade 2!
Prof Lubbe is super kind and funny. She helps ease this intimidating course with her upbeat personality. Well laid out course and instructions. Would highly recommend for calc 2 !!!

Good teacher who responds to questions during lecture. The homework is super crunchy and is basically 5 problems repeated but thats math for you. Understands the material and is usually easy to understand.

Professor Lubbe helped make the difficult subject of Calculus much more bearable, providing students with many other sources to learn from such as mathlabs or past exams. Her class goes very fast, so you'll miss a lot if you zone out for too long, but she always encourages and answers questions, prioritizing her students to ensure that they pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I'm not good at math and I personally struggled in this class. Lubbe is a wonderful professor; she is so kind. Please attend every single lecture and study your butt off. The stats coins that she offers will literally save your grade; earn as MANY as you can!!! do not procrastinate!! I was close to getting a B but she didnt round it.

Professor Lubbe is truly a gem! She cares about her students and their success. Due to COVID-19 class was online, which made learning a little more tougher. However, Professor Lubbe is very understanding and she responds quickly if you ask her for help! If you are going to take Elementary Stats (MATH 1308) Professor Lubbe is the best!

I'm horrible with math, but this professor made this class as bearable as she could. The subject matter gets heavy, but she gives many chances to redeem points you may have missed. Kind and quick to answer emails, especially if you come to her with a problem.

Professor Lubbe is a very nice teacher and person, She takes extra care during lectures to make sure everyone who has questions gets them answered. Even though I had already taken this class in HS I still listened to the lectures because they were pretty interesting.

professor lubbe is such an amazing professor. she is extremely caring, kind-hearted and the most understanding professor during everything we are currently facing. she is always willing to help and accommodate if needed. i seriously love how she has been toward my classmates and i. I highly suggest in taking her. if I had to, I definitely would!
Amazing class overall. Even through Corona she has been very attentive to questions we have during lectures. 10/10 reccomended

Unbelievable... I mean are you kidding me? Since the Covid-19 pandemic, this class turned into a disaster. The entire department showed no empathy for the students and refused to accomodate for the class converting into an online platform. Taking MATH2425 was an utter disaster and I would advise anyone not to take this class here.

I have an A in the class bc the work itself isn't hard but she is so unreasonable with this situation it has made this class DREADFUL. I hope she reads this.
its like they acted that the whole covid-19 chaos didnt affect the students and showed no empathy from converting a in person class to an online class
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I mean this rating isnt against her, shes a decent professor who knows her stuff however the math department is just incredibly strict and the class became online and it has actually become a disaster, because the information is a mess and they aren't understanding of the current circumstances which in incredibly frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Alright so, Lubbe knows her stuff and is clearly passionate about math. My issue is, the class was taught is a large lecture hall of over 150 students and she never used her microphone. The work is overwhelming and impossible to keep up with unless you're super into math. Be prepared to work. I ended up dropping it when the COVID19 crisis happened.

She gives you all the assignments and materials needed on canvas which made the class pretty straightforward. Plus you have at least 2 attempts for each assignment/quiz, so it's really easy to get an A. She is also very kind and helpful if you have any questions.

Professor Lubbe was amazing! I've always been god awful at math, but her lectures and the online homework setup (if you don't know how to do a question it will walk you through an example), this class was my best grade this semester. The extra credit system was great too, allows you to add points to test grades and then average those for your final

Really enjoyed her class. super easy to make an A. they do this thing called stat coins and you can cash them in to retake a test, skip the final, or replace a quiz grade, etc. 12 lectures are mandatory and 30 hrs of lab are also required. I feel like it's an easy A but you have to make sure you keep up with the work. I didn like the group project.

Though one of my easier classes, this class had the most homework. Sometimes can take me up to 15 mins or up to an hour. Practice is well needed though. The HW questions are heavily reflected in the quiz/test questions. Easy A but tedious. STAT coins are extra credit and are easily earned- most simply by doing what she assigns

You have to go to class for attendance but doing the homework will help you the most on tests. She lets you use a notecard on the tests and you can earn stats coins to use as extra credit and replace the final. She is one of the nicest professors I've ever had and the class is not challenging as long as you do your homework.
