reviews.comment: Attendance & e-text are REQUIRED (at least 30 hours of lab/at least 11 lectures). Exams, quizzes and homework are taken online. On Exams, you're allowed: a 3''x 5'' index card, syllabus approved calculator/formula sheet & scratch paper. One Group Stats Inquiry Project and Presentation is given. Tons of opportunity for Stat Coins. No make up exams.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed her class. As long as you do your work you should not have any homework or trouble getting an A. Very nice, always willing to help, and responds to emails very quickly!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Fine teacher but dont take stats for math if you struggle with math+sentences+judgement. She counts attendance on mylab randomly during lectures and right answers matter towards your grade. Need 12 lectures & 30 lab hrs, or get 0 for attendance grade. "Stats coins" extra credit, earn 75 & you dont have to take final exam. Tries to make jokes lol

a literal sweetheart. ive always sucked at math but stats with lubbe was the best. she offers extra credit, multiple attempts on quizzes, and stat coins to help your final average. You get partial credit on every exam, just make sure to go to class to accumulate all of the attendance hours you need. She responds quickly by email and is considerate
A solid choice as far as math profs go. Calc1 will always be difficult, especially at UTA, but she is a fair lecturer who is a great help you in the lab.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She is a really nice professor. Lecture attendance is mandatory (has an attendance question at the end of class and you have to attend a certain amount of lectures to get credit for attendance) but you can go to labs whenever. If you go to her office hours to discuss the tests she will definitely help you out. Stat coins are a life saver

pretty good calculus professor. if you are not understanding in class then you should consider going to office hours. STUDY FOR THE EXAMS. if this is your first time taking calculus and you do not study for the exams, then I can almost guarantee you will not pass the class because of how the exams are weighted.

She is the best math teacher I've ever had. She's so nice and is super willing to help when you are struggling. I got an A bc I made sure to get stat coins. I recommend going to all breakout sessions and doing the readiness hw to get coins, they really help you in the end. Make at least like 170 coins bc thats enough to use it for points on hw/test

Lubbe is a great statistics professor, really gives student plenty of help on homework, videos for each lesson to review on own time, gives extra credit in form of stat coins. Honestly, just show up to lab hours and you will rarely have to do things outside of class. Rake up as many stats coins as you can, this will help (no final, bonus points)

Professor Lubbe is a great professor. She always willing to help me with a problem whenever I needed help. Statistics is not really a hard subject. It's more of understanding the definitions and the formulas.
Professor Lubbe was a great professor to take if you have ever struggled with math. She'll help you understand and if you show up to lectures and labs you can easily get a B or A.

She's an amazing professor!! Teaches by examples and that helps A LOT! She truly cares for your grade, and offers stat coins to redeem yourself. No question about it, take her! Take her! Take her! Easy A!

I really liked Lubbe's class. Lab attendance is come and go as you please, but not lectures. The homework is really easy, although the quizzes are tougher. The 2nd exam is the toughest one! She offers extra credit in the form of "Stats Coins" which you can 'spend' at the end of the semester to either retake an exam or completely skip the final.

I loved professor Lubbe! I took the 5 week summer class and it was super easy. I got an A(Im pretty good at math). The tests are easy and you get a notecard. Attendance mandatory. She also gives amazing extra credit;I didnt have to take the final, You can retake 1 test and add 5 bonus points to each test with stat coins. TAKE THIS PROFESSOR.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Lubbe is really great! Especially if you just suck at math. Her lectures are easy to follow, and the tests aren't as bad as most online math tests.

So I'd definitely say take this professor and it'll be one of if not your easiest class ever. This class has a 1 hr 20 lecture once a week then the rest is lab. Lab is literally just time for you to do your homework and quizzes. You will have minimal work to do outside of this class. This is the class you can study 2 days before and get an A.

Grading criteria is the same for other 1308 classes - Tests make up for 50% of your grade, while other categories such as HW/quizzes/attendance only equate to 5% of your final grade. Attendance is mandatory, typically about 1-2 HW assignments/wk (she assigns them before actually learning them and it's a great idea). She is very nice and means well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I naturally don't struggle in math, so this class was a breeze. Her lectures are boring but mandatory because of the attendance questions. Her exams are easy, just study the quizzes and write all vocabulary down on the notecard she allows you to bring. She Is very lenient in grading the short response on the exams. Lubbe is very kind.
Lubbe is an amazing professor. She is easily the best math professor I've ever had and I highly recommend her.

Shes the sweetest person!!! Shes too kind, dont take advantage of that. There is quite a lot of homework but labs help a lot since shes right there ready to help with anything. If you do good on the first 4 exams, you dont even have to take the final!!!
if you're professional at being bad at math, look no further Ms. Lubbe can sure as heck help yah be good at it! just study and schtuff and you're all good.

Lubbe is very good when it comes to grading, and she offers extra credit opportunities. Study plans are given for exams that aren't too hard if you follow the material given in lecture and do the online homework. Everything is clear and concise in the syllabus and schedule. She is a sweet woman who knows what she is talking about and is helpful.
attendance does count as a grade, approachable professor! easy A, she gives so many opportunities for extra credit so take advantage of them!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I really wished that I tried harder in this class. There are loads of extra credit if you do not do well on the test. Although I struggled in this class, Lubbe was one of the best professors I ever had. Very quick to respond to emails and willing to meet with you in her office hours or after class. All work was done online,but she is very helpful!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Lubbe is an exceptional statistics teacher! Stats can be a difficult course, and there is LOTS of homework (tests, quizzes, homework assignments over every section covered in class). If you try your best to maintain a solid homework average and bank up on 'Stat Coins' that you can redeem at the end of the semester the class is an easy A/B.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Easiest math class ever. SO much extra credit through stats coins, I exempted the final! Tests have nearly identical questions from MyLabsPlus. I made an A on every test and ended with a 100.05 at the end of the semester. Also Mrs. Lubbe is the sweetest person! Her required lectures are kinda pointless cuz u can just do the loads of hw and pass.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I HATE statistics, math period. But Prof. Lubbe made this course as easy as possible for me. She allows you to bring a notecard when you're taking your exams, and the exams are almost identical to the homework.

Professor Lubbe is not only an outstanding teacher, but she is also a fantastic person to talk to. She definitely knows what she's doing and explains concepts clearly and concisely. She is very flexible with office hours. Homework was extremely helpful and is essential for mastering concepts. Would take again if she taught math higher than Calc 2.

Mrs. Lubbe is wonderful and so patient with her students. She was always accessible during lab times, and gave step by step instructions on how to solve problems. Her lectures and videos helped me understand the material. Stats isn't a easy class (for me, at least), but she made it easier. I wish more professors were caring like her.

Professor Lubbe is an awesome teacher. She explains things very well and is easy to understand. Meeting with her outside of class is very easy to do and she responds to emails pretty quick. I would definitely take her again if she taught calc 3. Text wasn't required but helped. With the free online homework new to UTA, it had our text in it.
Great teacher, well prepared, and understandable.
I think I could have done better in the class had I taken it in person versus online. Online was difficult because I had to teach myself half of the work that was to be done. It was very tough!

She is strict, but only because she actually cares that students are learning. She offers extra credit, even if you just attend the class. Good professor, easy class. As long as you watch her videos in Blackboard, you will be fine. Although lectures are not helpful, she takes attendance and gives bonus.

Taken Online. Actual text not required. Online course code required for quizzes and tests. She gives extra credit for showing up to her online webcasts. Always willing to work through any problem you ask about in the webcast. She will meet outside of class regularly and is quick to respond to emails. Completed online HW gives second try on quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is THE best. She goes above and beyond for her students. She went the extra mile to tutor me personally online too keep me from dropping the class and she was the reason I graduated in the Fall of 2016. Extra credit is offered and you get multiple attempts on the quiz pending 75% completion of the homework. Do yourself a favor, take STATS w/her

Took this class online in Fall 2016. 3 major tests and Final. Extra credit can be earned by attending web classes. I watched many of them, some test  questions will come from live webcasts, just changed amounts. Works though problems on webcast also. Can email also and ask about problems you may have on hw. Great teacher overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Mrs. Lubbe was probably one of my favorite professors so far. She really cares about her students and does a great job at preparing those who pay attention and put forth effort for exams.

Professor Lubbe posts videos with printable notes onto blackboard for every topic. As such, the textbook was not needed except for the access code. You have two tries for each quiz and the homework is not for a grade. Exams are about as hard as you would expect from stats but you can bring in a notecard worth of notes.

Professor Lubbe is an amazing person, but an average teacher. Honestly though, its not her fault. The class was all online based, so her lectures were basically pointless since she already has videos online. Just watch the videos online, do the homework, and keep up with deadlines. I wouldn't have even gone to class if it was not required.

Mrs Alice Lubbe is not only a great teacher but also a great person. She is always help you with your problems. You can contact her with email and she replies very soon. She makes the subject interesting and supports students in mastering its very details. Highly recommend her for Calculus. Personally this lady saved my one semester too!!

Professor Lubbe is a good professor, however, during the grading of lab work , they are strict. She gives pop quizzes on the topics we just learn in class. Which I think did not really help in the learning of material as sometimes the content is confusing. But since all the lectures are online, it is not a must to attend the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Lubbe herself is sweet. She gets side tracked or goes off on a tangent and for an hour class there simply isn't time and we rarely finished the material we needed to cover. This course should be listed as a hybrid as ALL your work is through MYLABS. Watch the videos prior to class, class should be used to clarify what confuses you.

She is a good person and is always willing to try to help but as a professor her lectures aren't that effective. You will do fine in the class if your mathematical base is strong and if you practise as well as do the homeworks. But do not depend on her for learning anything new, you will have to put your own effort.

Some Professors just don't get that your taking the class because it's required for your degree, not because you plan on being a finance major or math teacher. Did the extra credit, did all the assignments, did not do well on all the test and didn't feel like she really cared to help me.
If you can find another professor to take, do it. She is not helpful, lots of homework. I am not a great math student but I usually understand it but not with this class. Get out while you can.

Took this class online so I wouldn't have to attend a lecture, and I made the right choice. She gives a lot of extra credit, so utilize it! She has extra assignments after each test and all you need to do with watch 10 max webcasts. My 96 at the end of the year jumped to a 99 after she put in the extra credit.  finished with a strong A
She is just great.

Ms Lubbe is a great calculus professor. She does a great job explaining new concepts in the course. The only reason that the tests are tough are because they are departmental and the questions on the test are much tougher than anything on the homework. It's calculus, so you definitely need to attend the lectures and labs to do well in the course.

I'm not very good at math at all, I actually had to drop this class in the end. While this professor is very nice and helpful, her teaching style isn't the best for those who don't like math. She is fast-paced! Expect hard tests as well. However, if you must take this math make sure to take a section longer than 50 minutes.
DO NOT TAKE! She makes the concepts so much harder to understand. It could be such a basic problem and she turns it too difficult and the way she talks is so annoying.

I took Professor Lubbe last semester and WOW! I've always hated math, probably because of my past teachers. She go over things clearly. SHE GIVES EXTRA CREDIT! Totally boosted up my grade. I would recommend! Definitely my favorite teacher from this school! She also has extra sessions for students to go over harder topics.

I'm not a math wiz but Mrs. Lubbe definitely made Stats easier to understand. Required math lab hours and class meets once a week but she always put videos and helpful tips online to help you succeed. lots of homework and quizzes but the info was on the tests. You can have notecards for the tests as well.
She's really nice, easily the easiest professor for MATH 1315, I barely attendance class and got an A, she take attendance though

Prof Lubbe was very helpful and taught so students could understand.  There is a lot of homework but it works in your advantage.  When it came to the test I didn't even have to study and I am not a math wiz.  She allows you to use notecards each test and lets you earn extra credit.  I wish I could take her again because she was awesome.  Take her!

Overall this class was manageable only if you kept up with the homework assignments. They help tremendously on preparing for Quizzes and Tests. Her lectures were long but worked out problems thoroughly and made note taking easy. Extra credit with attendance and answering correctly the Entry and Exit quizzes which aren't hard.

Enjoyed her lectures. Although they were kind of long, she's not boring. And during math labs, she is very helpful! Very nice and easy going. She also helps you understand the material! Everything is on mymathlabplus

Alice Lubbe is hand down the best professor in the Math Dept. as far as I'm concerned.  I'm now in Calculus III.  If it weren't for her I would not have made it this far.  She is hyper organized.  She puts everything including here class outline and notes on Blackboard.  She definitely puts her students first - very noble cause in this day and age.

Awesome teacher! This is coming from someone who also is not strong in math. She goes above and beyond to make sure you understand. Don't get behind on chapters and homework, you're setting yourself up for failure. Always answers questions and always clear, very personable.

Professor Lubbe is AWESOME!! She explains stats really good.  You have 3 exams and a final but you can retake one exam. Make sure to do the Extra Credit Assignments ,they are worth 5 points each!!! Can improve your grade

If you love math you will do great! She is awesome! She's sooo kind & helpful! She's the type that WANTS to see her students succeed. The book really helped. You have alot of online HW & quizzes that you must keep up with but it helps your grade.  You have to work hard to pass but she really does help if you ask. Overall she's amazing!

Alice Lubbe is always ready to help, though most of the work is dependent on you completing the online homeworkassignments. The exams are easy if you do all your homework. Attendance at labs and lecture is part of your grade, though if you do the rest of your work an A is still obtainable without it. She gives an opportunity for extra credit.

Since everything's online, the grade you get is all up to you. She was super nice and helpful. Lectures were kinda long on a Monday morning but it's not too bad. I'd take her again for stats. I never used the textbook, but you definitely need the access code for MyLabsPlus

She was an awesome Pre-Calc 1 professor! You only have 2 mid-terms & 1 final exam, but if you study hard from the Pearson MyMathLab homework, quizzes, and practice tests, you'll do fine. She teaches well & answers questions with better understanding of the material. I con't wait to have her for a higher math course. ^_^

This class is insanely easy and the instructor is great! Attendance is taken during lectures, but I never showed up and passed the class with a 96. Lab Attendance is mandatory, and you need to reach 12 hours prior to each test. Everything is done online, and quizzes may be attempted twice. Really easy class, just don't fall behind!
She's very helpful especially since in maths, you need all the help you can get. And she teaches well. Just take her class seriously and its a easy A.

A very helpful teacher. She is someone to take in Calculus 1 if you do not have a calculus base. The only problem with her is that she teaches from slides which may be a problem trying to learn maths. A okay teacher if you have already have a calculus base.

She is the most helpful teacher you can ever get in a college. She gives her 100% and is always willing to help. However, she teaches from slides so you may not be able to learn the process of solving questions.

She is the sweetest professor ever! Very helpful! Always jokes about silly things and tries to make her students happy. She would take a week before every test to review and would answer all of the questions you have and emails you send her. Also, after each exam, she would add extra points depending on how you did. Would definitely take her again!

AMAZING teacher. She is very sweet and will help anyone out. I emailed TONS of questions and she responds very quickly with a ton of help. It is not an easy class with alot of material but she is an awesome teacher. She doesn't require attendance but it helps to show up. Records EVERYTHING and posts online to review. Always trying to help. So nice.
Gives a lot of second chances to improve grade
She is good but teaches from slides.
Good teacher and helps students get ready for each test and the final. Her labs are easy and she takes a week of class to review for each test. Very helpful and is flexible on homework.

Good individual, is in love with math and knows her stuff. However, she is a grad student and last minute opened a section for this class after not teaching for a while. She's confusing and jumps from topic to topic. If you took cal1 previously then maybe you will do well with her because I noticed people that have taken cal can answer herquestions
Very nice professor, tried to give all the options she could to help us all
Good prof. Much more clear than other math profs.
Take Her
She is GREAT at explaining, very patient in answering questions, and very clear in what she says. YES take her if you wnat a better understanding of Calc 1

Ms. Lubbe is currently a grad student but she teaches with the clarity & rigor of an experienced professor. I enjoy her class so much because she is extremely thorough with her notes, is readily available thanks to her tech savvy skills, & completely prepares you for the 3 departmental tests. If she is an option for your future math class, TAKE HER
Tough grader. She is just the one who run the class but grade by another professor. You have to follow Lawton Brewer and her instruction

2-3 somewhat easy discussion boards each week. Responses to the discussions due Wednesdays and responses to peers are due Fridays. Strict word count on responses. VERY strict with deadlines. Major grade essay can be difficult finding a topic. She is very helpful if you reach out. Emails back quickly and very nice. Take the class seriously.
can't answer questions
You typically have 1-2 assignments a week that don't take very long, along with 3-4 big papers. The papers are only 3ish pages so workload really isn't bad. If you do the assignments, you will pass.

I took the class online. We just had to do simple discussion boards and write 3 essays. They require a textbook but you don't really use it that often. She takes off alot of points for slight mistakes. She responds to emails quickly. She could be clearer on certain criteria.
very communicative you just have to start it! if you have any questions don't be afraid to ask!

reviews.comment: This teacher takes forever to grade so you have no idea what you have until the end. Worst way to learn composition, the teacher doesn't seem to have time.

Professor is a tough grader even when you think you followed all directions and the rubric they ask for more even if you know for a fact you followed the rubric to a “T”. She is responsive with emails, but you get docked down on your grade heavily for very tiny infractions.

She was very straightforward with the material, dedication, and expectations. Depending on the TA that you get (strict or not grading-wise) will determine the grade you end up with. Overall, I learned immensely from this course; the instructor was responsive and attentive to questions.

reviews.comment: She was extremely helpful by email and didn't grade too harshly. I feel like there was a bit more work than usual for an online class (discussions, readings, and papers). reviews.comment: Great class. Dr. Midwood provided clear feedback for everything submitted, which helped tremendously. All you have to do is follow the rubric and actually put effort in your work.

He is a great professor. Pro. Thapa listens your challanges and tries everything possible to help students to get over the hurdles. This professor is a cool man but his attendance policy needs to be more flexible for students.

I suggest professor Thapa make his attendance policy little relaxed.

He is very helpful instructor and also very friendly. He does not mind to reply the email even in weekends. I was very moved with his teaching for writing. In a very slow pace, he can make students to be a good reacher. His focus on group discussion and peer-assignment for each class activities helped me to bulldoze my low-confidence off. Great teacher and motivator for writing class.

He sounds thick accent, but beats the standard teaching practice. His focus on making students aware of the course contents is just awesome. He is always ready to listen you and give his feedback that helps bulldoze off your complications.

Very flexible and reachable. Brings interdisciplinary way in writing. One thing, he often cares for attendance. I strongly recommend for his class.

Comprehensive lectures with additional writing workshops besides syllabus. Group-projects in a  way that creates an opportunity to be familiar with class closely. He is tough.
No..No. I don't recommend his class. He is at times strict and he follows his attendance policy strictly.
I do not suggest his course. He is a new teacher. He's yet to learn many things. I earned a bad grade.

Never taken classes by a non-native English-speaking teacher in the past, I found the class too useful and knew that how english language is widely spoken across US. A real professor. He always loves to be with the side of students and encourages to rise even in the low by giving extra support. He is the most caring professor with high responsibilty to ensure students understand the course
Honestly a very good professor he is very kind as a person, he replies to e-mails,he give feedback for the essays. Sometimes his accent is a bit thick but not impossible to understand.

This professor will not give you a break on anything. He is firm on 89.50% rounding and will not extend any deadlines even past a minute. Read the syllabus carefully. That being said he knows what he is teaching.

Easy A. He is very nice and clear when he teaches. Exams are very easy. His PPTs are perfect to prepare and review for the exams. He highlights all key terms and concepts. Weekly LPAs and pretests won't burden you because they are easy, as well. His email feedback is very fast.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He's chill and his class is easy. He does go off track and rambles during lectures sometimes. However, he does ask the class for opinions and will kinda add to that. Attendance isn't mandatory but he'll give you extra credit if you're present 90% of the time.

Super easy class!! I took this during fall 2022, which is also my first semester in college and this class is definitely not one that I had to focus on. Many of the assignments are just answering the question asked and using a quick reference from the online textbook (I took this class online). Also, the quizzes and final exam was a piece of cake!

Although I did not interact much with the professor due to it being an asynchronous course, the course was super organized. Just read a chapter a week and answer the week's question. The professor also gave us weekly pretests (completion grade). These pretest questions are almost the same questions on the exam, so study them and you're good!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took this class online this sem. Morris had all assignments open first day, made many mistakes in his exams so we had to retake them but he just kept our highest grade. reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you are looking for a summer class to take, please take this one. Professor Morris is one of the best and understands that the main goal is to pass. You will need the online textbook to do LPAs and further studying, but overall your main focus of study are pre-tests and provided PowerPoints. He is quick to answer any questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor to take online if you need a credit for summer hour he has pre test that help you before you take the test overall great professor highly recommend no complaints

Prof Morris had some iffy opinions at times. I was excited to have him as a teacher, but overall let me down. When doing recent event discussions, the topics were so obvious and often unfulfilling. Clear grading criteria and work however tests are worth a little under half your whole grade. Personally, I am a terrible test taker and fail almost every test but in class/homework I made all 100s. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Morris is extremely caring. All of the assignments were very clear and straightforward and were used mainly to check in on your reading comprehension. The exams used material from the slideshows and similar questions from the pre-tests, so definitely review those to study. Be sure to complete all of the pre-tests to receive extra credit!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is such a caring Professor, but just because of that doesn't mean that you can shrug this off. I would say to make sure you study a week early before the midterms, and he will give you hints during the lectures on which questions will be on the exam. I am going to take his class next semester :)
Along with being a good teacher, he seemed like a great person as well. For the quizzes, just do the highlighted areas of the lectures & you have atleast a B

Professor Morris was an amazing professor to take. His class consisted of 4 exams and 1 cumulative final. All of the exams were super easy if you study the highlighted terms in the power points and the pre-tests. He has open discussions at the beginning of every class so it's not boring. Definitely recommend taking for an easy A.

He is one of the best who will make you love Political science. He understands that most people may not be pols major and this gives easy questions most of it coming from his short ppt and pretests. He will teach you for the sake of learning instead of stressing you for grades

Great professor, very open to discussions. My only issue was there was no late submission allowed at all. But nonetheless, very easy assignments, basically free 100s. There were 4 unit exams and 1 final exam, of which he drops your lowest unit exam from your final grade. If you put in minimal effort, except exams, you can get an easy A.

Professor Morris was literally the kindest professor youll have. Assignments are basically participation grades because I got a 100 on everything. For exams, make sure you study the pretests (which are auto 100s if you complete them). He gave us extra credit at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I loved this class and prof. morris. two assignments a week (one is completion, and one is very easy, you just use the book to find the answer). unit tests are made up of the completion assignment and highlighted portions of the notes. he never puts anything on the test that isn't highlighted or on the completion assignment. attendance optional.

class was pretty straight forward two chapters a week followed by a test, so weekly tests, 2 discussions per week with a 2 peer replies for each and one final. quizzes are straight from the book, you just have to rememorize them if you can. final is a mix of all chapter tests and he uses respondus lockdown browser w/webcam. Class is well organized.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Honestly I did like this professor and the day to day work was easy and straight forward but it does get very repetitive because its the same assignment every week. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Totally loved this class! The level of difficulty is very appropriate considering that this is an intro class. Read the material and study the pre-tests and you will pass easily. Thought it would be a boring class but was totally mistaken- lots of new and interesting info to learn! Would definitely recommend this class by professor Morris.

Pretty easy class, as long as you have the textbook and study the PRE tests you'll pass easily. He does get off topic at times but it's still entertaining and eye-opening. 10/10 would definitely recommend. Also, Quizlet will be your best friend for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is honestly the best professor I had this semester. He is so understanding and kind. If I could take home for all my courses I would. I didnt even show up to class every day but he makes the course super easy and easy to understand and gives you every resource needed to understand the test and pass even if you dont attend the class.

Amazing! Took 2 classes w him b/c he really cares and made online classes actually enjoyable. Really respectful and cares about his students; occasional "how are you doing" surveys and personal discussions. Really clear grades, no surprises and easy to ace if you read a bit. Not hard at all, just be there and ask questions. Loves discussions + Kind

Professor Morris is the best professor I have had in college. His lectures are clear, and he has assignments that are 100s as long as you do them. His class is super engaging as he always opens lectures with a current event discussion. His tests come from highlighted sections in lecture notes and concepts on the pre-tests. 10/10

He is probably the best professor I've had all year. I took him for two semesters and his class is amazing. He is inspirational and he helps students a lot with the material. As long as you do your assignments that's an easy A.

Good teacher, cares about his students, do all the pretests and study the pretests and you will do great on the tests and the LPA's are all from the book. Good Teacher, more teachers should be more like him!
If youre looking for an unresponsive professor giving a lackluster, phoned-in attempt at teaching.... this is your guy.

Professor Morris is a great professor who really cares about being an educator! The course is very organized. Every unit consisted of a Pretest and LPA then the unit test. Just do everything on time and show effort! The unit tests consist of questions from protests, so just be familiar with them!

Assignments were simple and straightforward. His tests are pretty easy as well and are directly from a practice quiz that you take for each unit. You'll definitely do well in this class with this professor.

He sets out all assignments you need to do at the beginning of the semester, so there are no surprises. Three monitored tests and one final. Simple assignments and pre-quizzes. Overall it is a well organized class and if you do the assignments and read the textbook you should do great.

reviews.comment: Lots of reading, but test came straight from practice tests. Overall, great professor.

reviews.comment: Awesome. Kind and caring and wants you to learn in his class. Even though this subject isn't everyones cup of tea, he respects that and still helps you to succeed. Definitely take him over other profs

Great teacher! He was so nice. His lectures are pretty chill and he likes his class to be discussion-based. You can tell he really enjoys what he does. Assignments aren't bad and the book will definitely help you for the tests.

Prof. Morris is the best guy for anything Political Science. He cares for the students and is easily accessible besides class hours. His lectures are well-organized power points (at least for FALL 2020)and are to the point. You can easily score an A if you just give your little effort consistently and complete the LPAs and PreTests on time.

Excellent professor, if you are not ready to read and study the chapters then don't expect an A. Easy weekly assignments, I took the summer session so it may be different for a full semester. reviews.comment: You read 2 chpts a week with an exam due every Fri. Learning progress activities are a minimum of 50 words answering specific questions about the chapters & due every Wed. reviews.comment: Very good feedback fro professor and coach. The textbook is online for purchase. Participation matters. Reading and note taking is required.

He was a really caring teacher. Since the coronavirus came up, he was the only teacher i had this semester that helped his students pass during this terrible time. As long as you study for the tests from the pretests you should get an A too

Great professor overall. The book can help but if you simply do the review worksheets he provides and show up for the review days, its an easy pass. The only grades was weekly quizzes graded on completion, short discussion posts, and two exams.

The class is very easy as Mr. Morris provides many resources to help you prepare for the final exam and for the unit exams in between. Homework is based on content from the required textbook for the class. However, Mr. Morris basically goes over the major things you'll need to know from each chapter in class. He's a very nice older man that really loves what he does. In all honesty, DO NOT READ THE BOOK. That book is so long you'll fall asleep taking notes on it. GRAET professor ez class. consists of quizzes(online), lpas (50 words answering a prompt), and tests. quizzes were just completion grades. lpas were from the book (find online-dont buy). for us, he gave us a study guide worksheet for each chapter and then made questions from that. IT WAS SO EASY just study that worksheet!! he's funny and a nice guy

reviews.comment: Professor Morris's online class wasn't bad. The workload is pretty consistent. He doesn't give extra credit so never expect it.
I love that Mr. Morris is so organized. It made taking this class on-line easier to do while I am working.

Gov't of U.S. online. It was very interesting, but I'm interested in politics. I learned a lot in this class. It was an easy A. As long as you do the reading in preparation for the exams, it should be an easy A for you as well. I would take another class by him.

reviews.comment: Read the chapters, review the chapter questions. He assigns chapter quizzes that help tremendously on exams. He gives 100% for effort and he's really easy to talk to. I hope to be able to take POLS 2312 with him.

Took him online for summer 1. He is Clear on what he wants and how he grades. Strict on citations, there are pretests that are 100's no matter what, then LPA'S that he grades and you NEED the book. Make sure to read and do everything required.

Professor Morris' online class wasn't too difficult but it wasn't easy. You have to read the book as well as do the Pre-Test every Monday (automatic 100s) and the LPAs (automatic 100s). Professor Morris has made coming back to college after 18 years a pleasure. He is clear in expectations and is well prepared. I wish he taught more classes or there were more professors like him. I learned more in this class than any other this semester. Thank you.

Tough class for a general ed. required course. Advice: pre-tests and LPAs/discussions are easy points; do them. He is very caring and understandable and HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Professor Morris was a great teacher. A majority of your grade comes from the pre tests and LPA's so do them (they are super easy) and the tests are easy if you go the review day in class. (most of the answers on the tests are on quizlet) This POLS class was great and easy 10/10 would recommend!

This was a pretty easy class. He kept the class interesting by debating current events the first 20-30 minutes of class! Just show up to class, take notes, do your quizzes and LPAs and you'll pass. I'd recommend taking him 100%

His lectures can put you to sleep, but his in class discussions are worth sitting in for! If you love politics, you'll love his class. The homeworks, quizzes and exams are all online,Quizlet :), and very easy. He's a very caring person so if you have any concerns, he'll listen attentively! It's IMPOSSIBLE to fail his class!!

I'm not sure how you fail government or POLS, but with Professor Morris can't tell you how easy it is to get an A. Maximum 10 minutes a week on the pretest and short answer question. For the tests find a buddy and take it together. You honestly have to try to not get an A in this class.

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: Took it online. Simple and straightforward. A light workload. Just study and take exams. He also works with you if you have technical difficulties or work-related problems. Finally a professor who understands.

reviews.comment: I took this this past spring and it was incredibly easy. The only thing that was annoying was that you had to purchase an access code to the class. Other than that, you have to read, do the pretest, and respond to the LPAs weekly. You can find the answers to the LPAs straight from the reading. Three unit exams,  one final - all answers on quizlet

I took his online US Govt class. It was very easy, the assignments and tests had answers straight from the textbook.  However I could never get a reply from him to get feedback on a test so I could know what I got wrong. Just don't miss assignments because he doesn't accept late work. That killed my grade a bit, but it's my own fault. Easy A.

I only read the chapters for the first test (Since I wasn't sure what to expect) and then after that I just took the tests with my textbook out. Every week there were three or four pre-tests (completion grade), three or four short answer questions (just look up the answer in the book and you'll get a 100) and a test at the end.

This class was mandatory for my RN to BSN.  The grading criteria was clearly outlined.  Class was easy to maneuver on blackboard.  You could tell Prof Morris truly had a passion for Government and as long as you read the material you will do fine.  This class was manageable with a full time job and children at home.

Straightforward and clear layout of the entire course is there since day one, just do the LPA's and Pre-Tests, and study for the tests, you'll get an A. The professor is passionate and knowledgeable about the subject and has made an effort to make the course as easy and as simple as possible.
If you read the chapters and highlight key terms you should be fine. If you get tired of reading (because you WILL read a lot) just look up the quiz/test answers online.
I learned a lot just be ready to read and comprehend what your reading. The test was tricky.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Easy online class, pre-tests(automatic 100 just for attempt), an lpa( a simple question you have to answer) and the tests which are simple. He uses lockdown browser, but you can easily look up the questions for the test on another laptop or your phone. I barely read the book and many times forgot I was in this class.

Extremely easy class.  2 pre-test, you will receive an automatic 100 for just attempting them, one discussion per chapter (extremely easy), and 1 test a week (over 2 chapters).  Test are taken in lockdown but most questions are available on quizlet if you have access to an extra computer.

I took US Government online as a prerequisite for the RN to BSN program. It was not hard at all, and I actually enjoyed learning about government. The class and Blackboard was very organized. Each week 2 pretests, 2 writing assignments, and an exam over 2 chapters were due. I definitely recommend taking Professor Morris!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Easy format to follow. Get ready to read the entire textbook.

Great class with an easy format. The assignments are easy do all of them. Lots of information and a lot of reading. You basically read the entire book because there are no lecture notes. The tests were a little tricky with the questions but are multiple choice and true or false. There is a cumulative final and no review.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Easy A: read the book & do the quizzes. We did have one issue where the grades were dropped out of blackboard but that wasn't the professor's fault & he communicated the issues quickly. IT got the grades back up in time for finals. One note, some questions on the tests are not as important but appear regardless - take note of #'s of employees, etc.

Boring Lectures but overall not a hard class. Great for an elective. No homework, slides are blackboard, and tests online. Don't need the book, don't need to go to class, just study before test and you'll be fine.

He is a good professor but a little dry and sometimes hard to pay attention. He will let you do quizzes with your neighbor to check your answers. His tests are somewhat difficult but online and can be done at your convenience. Overall I would take him again. Easy A if you pay attention in class.

Great class. The tests can be a little difficult because they are designed to confuse you sometimes but the assignments are easy to do and you do pre-tests beginning each chapter. There is a lot of reading.  Read carefully and take good notes for the exams.

Straight forward class and Professor.  Very structured and the same every week.  You know exactly what to expect.  There will be 2 pre-tests due on Monday (it's easy), 2 chapters to read for the test on Friday and there are usually 2 discussion topics to type---50 words, please---no biggie.  Made great grades by reading and outlining chapters.

Online class, no  long papers  just answer easy questions per chapter (super short and easy writing assignments), mandatory pre-test which you get 100 automatically just for trying. Exams are a little bit challenging but if you read the book and google the exam you will be fine but you must use another device since you use lockdown. Easy grade.

Very straight forward class. Minimal writing and no discussion board for an online class. You get an opportunity to review your previous exams before the final. Take advantage of this because a lot of the questions are repeated.

This online class was the best way to fit a core requirement into my schedule. It was basically a joke. I got an A. I did all the quizzes (it shows you the right answer so you always get 100%) and journal entries for the whole semester at the start. As for the exams, just google everything. Use a different device because he requires lockdownbrowser

If you want an "A" in this class, all you need to bring to the table is an IQ just north of what a monkey possesses.  Seriously, SUPER easy class.  You will have to read the book and know key concepts, however its only 2 chapters a week- each being only 30ish pages of light reading.  Tests are mildly challenging, but not if you go over the quizzes.

I regret taking this online class. Tests are tough, you have to take them using Lockdown browser. After taking the exam you cannot see the questions anymore to study for final. 3 test plus the final. No opportunities for extra credit. Took online class thinking was going to be easier with my work schedule but I was wrong. Going to class is better.

The class didn't have much work, the quizzes were easy and open book. The test were kinda hard so you do have to study are at least take notes but it's online so you can use your book. The test are long so don't count on trying to get through it at the last minute with no notes.

Class was very easy.  Exams were difficult, however if you have a good understanding of how government works, you'll be fine.  If you don't, you will have to read.  Otherwise, easy A.  Course work was light.  Expectations are clear and working ahead encouraged.  Asked for help with an issue with an assignment in BlackBoard, didn't receive any.

Hes pretty cool, show up to class and you're good, he gives pop quizes that you can take with your neighbor, there is one short 50 word assignment online a week, the tests are online so you can take them at home or with a buddy.

Mr. Morris made political science a rather interesting class, he likes to begin class discussions with current events (relative to politics in Texas). His tests and quizzes are all online and he has assignments due every week regarding the lectures from the previous week. If you take notes and are open to new ideas I highly recommend his class.

Had him for Fall 2025, good professor, do read the slides and pay attention in class since what he teaches is in exams. He doesn't take attendance but has in class activates at times and they do count towards the grade. Drops the lowest homework grade and 2 lowest classwork at the end of the semester. Over all, I liked his class.

2 midterms, 1 final and 5 homework assignments throughout the semester as well as short in class assignments. Utilize the homework and in class assignments to study for exams and it is a fairly easy pass. He gives you both of the exams back to study for the final to!

reviews.comment: Each week, there are individual discussion posts (1,000 words minimum) and group discussion boards that need to be submitted. The midterm and final are open book and open note (written responses). Weekly quizzes are open note and can be retaken as many times wanted. It's an easy elective class that you can easily get an A in!

Easy class tbh. He goes over exactly what's on the quizzes. There's 5 assignments over the semester, 2 midterms, and then the final. He has extra credit reading opportunities throughout and some participation grades but that's about it. In class, he goes over slides but he has the slides on canvas so as long as you look through them you'll be okay

Took this in an 8-week session so the readings definitely piled up. The topics are very interesting but you are on your own to interpret & make critical evaluations. Worked the whole class in a group, tests are open note. Grades to make sure you understood the articles & that you can make inferences on them. 7 discussion & 2 tests

very interesting class, pretty easy if ur passionate ab topic. quizzes were ab readings and tests/discussions were applying readings. everything open book plus a group you work with all semester with.

The second best Economics teacher at UTA other than Roger Wehr. All exams (3) are open books requiring your knowledge thinking. Discussion posts are due every week from 3-4 articles are given to your group weekly, which you are assigned to a group at the beginning of the semester. One final project at the end.

Easy course to take if you're looking for something chill. Discussion boards everyweek, no exam (except for 2 midterm tests), Reading quizzes. Everything is open note and can be accessed through canvas. He is very responsive to emails. Also, you will have assigned groups. for discussion boards but super easy if you do the reading!

Best Economic professor I had in a long time since TCC! You don't have to purchase a textbook because he provides all the resources and articles for you while learning the course. I learned so much in economic in discrimination and how it's applied both in society and the workforce. The exams are open ended questions instead of multiple choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I have a lot of respect for Professor Quigley, his way of teaching should be set as an example of how all other economic electives should be. As long as you watch his lectures, take the quizzes, and do the group project you should be able to make the grade you desire. Most of the material on the exams comes from the lectures and quizzes, take him.

Quigley is one of the best professors to take for an ECON course, all material from the exams come from the lectures, he offers a lot of extra credit on the group projects, and it very permissive on due dates. Take him you, will not regret it one bit at all.

Quigley is by far one of my absolute most favorite professors ever. He is exremely accomodating and helps every step of the way if you find yourself struggling, and lectures cover literally everything and then some (we even did some machine learning outside of the course material at the end of the semester! :D you NEED to take this professor, 5/5!!

Lectures were not boring and pretty straight to the point. Lecture slides basically covered most of the material. The textbook wasn't necessary, Professor Quigley gives you everything you need to know for the exam. Overall he is a super nice guy and if you take him you won't be disappointed.

Excellent professor for micro(3310) and econometrics(3318). These courses are challenging by nature but he provides great lectures and examples to help you. If you put in the work to understand the concepts, an A is easily achievable with him. Offers lots of extra credit on group reports. Only wish he taught more classes that I need to take.

ECON 4321 or International trade. Quigley gives amazing lectures, especially with his graphs. But, he draws on a whiteboard and not on his PowerPoints, so you must go to class. In-Class Assignments & Homework (15%), 2 Midterms (25%), Final (35%). Some EC. Exams are half conceptual and half graphing. Pay attention to concepts he repeats.

reviews.comment: He is very detailed and there are pop quizzes for extra credit, he's understanding and will provide help in office hours.

reviews.comment: I love this professor, even though the material is hard, he makes it funny and is super nice. He also adds a lot of extra credit points to tests, and I currently have a 99.5 in his class. He is the best professor I have had, and he is a cutie.

Dr. Parks is an amazing professor! I took his BIOL 2457 course and he was one of the best professors out there. He doesn't read off of the lecture slides. He gives great examples when discussing confusing topics. There are a total of 10 homework quizzes, 4 exams, and a final exam. The homework quizzes helped big time with the exams.

This is the second course I have taken Parks for, and he is still wonderful. He makes micro interesting, which is difficult, and ensures all questions are answered. Exams are 100% off the powerpoint, no surprises and TONS of extra credit. Be ready to study though exams are 75% of your grade. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Professor Parks had good lectures. He doesn't just directly read off the slides, but he incorporates stories and other bits of info to help you understand things. He is really nice and funny and if you have to take micro, please take it with him!

very easy class with a good professor. 4 exams + 1 final exam, lowest exam score gets dropped. very good lecturer and his slides weren't very hard. definitely need to memorize everything he goes over in class + everything on the presentation, i read the textbook for extra help. going to class will secure you the A but overall, would take him again

It doesn't let me select it, but I took Dr. Parks for A&P I this semester. He is a good professor. His teaching style is mostly just going over the slides, and he teaches pretty fast. There are 10 homework assignments, 4 pre-exam quizzes, 4 exams, and a final. Be prepared to study!!

This class can be a challenge, but getting an A is doable—especially with Dr. Parks. Go to lectures or watch recordings; he gives helpful hints for tests. There's a lot of extra credit you gotta go to class to get it. His real-life examples make lectures interesting and memorable. Not mandatory, but going helps a lot. GOODLUCK
Your grade mainly consists of exams and open-book quizzes. If you pay attention and study, it will be an easy class.
He's awesome overall, and keeps class interesting
Very clear and straightforward. His lectures were engaging and the homework had unlimited attempts. Tests are very easy if you study effectively.
Favorite teacher !! , he made micro so interesting and offered lots of extra credit . He truly cares for his students grades and learning experience.

Took Dr. Parks for BIOL-2457 but I couldn't select that option. Dr.Parks is not a bad professor by any means, he is just very bare minimum. The class was very organized from the start and he stuck to the syllabus:10 hw assignments, 4 practice exams, 4 exams, 1 cumulative final. He doesn't provide any exam reviews or extra credit. Records his lecs.

Micro is not an easy subject, but he does well to make it easier. His slides are really helpful and organized. My only complaints are that he does not provide study outlines, and he talks to fast during lecture. I opted to watch the lectures online so that I could pause as I pleased, made flashcards over all lecture material to cover everything.
I have him for A&P I and he's so funny. He cares about his students and will take the time to help you out if you're struggling, his lectures are not mandatory but helpful, they're also recorded.

Really good professor that cares about the success of his students. Class isn't mandatory but I HIGHLY recommend going to the lectures, they're packed with information (and exam questions) plus he makes them very engaging. Yeah, I had him for BIO 1441 lab. Lots of group projects, but doable. However, he does basically give you the answers so there is that. Other than that, he is a great teacher. Loved him a lot.

reviews.comment: I advise others to take the course with a different professor to enjoy your 8-week path and the final grade. Lectures can veer on the boring side, but the amount of extra credit he gives are insane. I will say there are some chapters that are on the heavy side, so beware of the amount of info to memorize. He will give you hints about what to expect on the exams, and will tell funny stories during class. Personally, I thought the lectures were too fast so I rewatched most of the lectures on echo360. Dr. Parks is an excellent and understanding professor. The only downside is the lack of graded material. Your grade is 75% exams, 5% exam quizzes, and 20% lab. Get ready to study your butt off in this class.

Prof. Parks really cares about his student's success. Although I found the course a bit tough because the pre-exam practice tests he gave was not necessarily on the actual exam, he already opened himself up for providing feedback and 1 on 1 guidance to help his students succeed.

Dr. Parks was an amazing professor! He is extremely understanding, especially with the bs of the lockdown browser. I highly recommend you take him for lab if you can. Really great, organized online class! Dr. Parks is a great professor and he cares. Remember, Microbiology has rigorous material, so be ready for lots of bacterium and their functions. Dr. Parks is an amazing lecturer. He is passionate about microbiology & is very caring. He always answers any questions during & after lecture. He tries to make lectures fun & he gives extra credit on exams too. Just read the textbook, back off the book questions & his slides & you'll pass. He is also very very attractive man!

Dr. Parks is a cool guy, and was very ready to listen and talk with student after class. Professor Parks is a very chill and laid back Professor. His material is rather easy but you do have to listen/read a lot in order to pass . She took half off of a quiz grade for me because I turned in a PDF from Google Docs rather than from Microsoft Word. This was mentioned in the instructions, but not in the grading criteria. This happened to around 1/3 of the class, and none of our grades were changed.

This class was super easy. The class is 3 hours but attendance is not mandatory, however, she gives the answers to the homework at the end. She talked about some things that happened to her when she was a nurse and some of them were interesting. There are 4 quizzes that are on lockdown but you don't need a webcam.
I have never felt so disrespected by an instructor so openly. I would not recommend this instructor at all. The experience felt unprofessional.

(Taken in Fall 2025) Very easy class! If you do the work and follow the rubrics, you will get an A. Attendance was not mandatory and all assignments were on Canvas. There are 3 (easy) quizzes instead of tests and each one is open-book, open-note, and LDB is not required.

She doesn't require participation. Her assignments are easy, and there are like three or four quizzes in lock down but not proctored. Her class is quite long and get's really boring but she does assignments with the class and gives answers for some. the assignments you have to do yourself are really easy though. Easy class.

She goes over the answers to the assignments during lectures and she talks about her experiences as a nurse a lot, which is really insightful and cool. But, she IS a strict grader. Either way, as long as you pay attention you'll be fine.

I loved her as a professor. Classes were very long and often hard to get through but she had great stories and you can tell she's passionate about nursing. Tough grader, but if you follow the rubric exactly you will be fine.

All of the work is straightforward you can easily look up the answers. The lecture is quite long, but if you attend the lecture, she does assignments in class on paper and will give you an easy 100 for it. Very patient and knowledgeable about what she teaches. Attendance is not mandatory.

reviews.comment: I would say she's amazing, she does talk a lot but it's better than just reading off of slides and gives us a lot of information regarding nursing school. Would take her class again.

She is a good teacher, I will say the class time is what sucks, you have this class for 3 hours but she does say very helpful things about Nursing. She's passionate about nursing and her way of doing things is smoothly

I only went to lecture on the first day of the semester.. and still got an A lol. A lot of assignments are easy 100s. This class is very easy. She responds to EVERY assignment with helpful and sweet comments. You can tell she actually cares and tries to make an impact with your experience as a pre-nursing student.

I have no idea why this professor has bad ratings. She is patient, reasonable, works through assignments in class, and tells stories from her experience. This class is extremely easy, mostly completion grades, and everything is open book. Attendance is not mandatory. I will most likely get an A.
Easy going and kind. Work is easy and quizzes are easy to prepare for as she provides a guide for them. As long as you are on top of your work, the class should be easy.
All of the work is extremely easy, and her lectures are very thorough. If you go to class and pay attention, you will get an A.
I loved taking her class! She is a good professor and seems passionate about what she teaches. She is easygoing and cares about her students. I reccommend taking her.
Lectures felt soo long. Although they do help understand the material, I feel like her lectures did not impact my grade. Though grader as well!!!!!

It is a very easy class as long as you keep up with your work and do you best. I like how she explains everything, and sounds clear.

Overall super easy class with easy assignments that she would go over in class. Tests were also open note/book. HOWEVER, the majority of the time you have no idea what she is talking about. Professor Suber was new to J2 as a clinical instructor from S2. She is a tough grader when it comes to your critical thinking skills and actions during checkoffs
Very easy material. Go to class for the powerpoints because she doesn't post them. Class consists of three quizzes (51%) and weekly learning activities(10%) /assignments (39%).

This is a really easy class as long as you do the assignments. Just go to class and listen to the ppt presentation, all the answers as there. At first, I was scared to take this professor Bc of the ratings, however, the class is super super easy. Attendance isnt mandatory. do your part coming to class. Don't expect to get an A if you are lazy. This class is a preview to what nursing classes will be like, so take it seriously!
I highly recommend taking this professor for nursing concepts. She was super laid back and I learned a lot and had fun in this class!

Do not take professor Suber. She grades late and loves going back into the grade book to change grades she has already posted. She is very hard to contact and doesn't give an explanation for a grade I receive. The lecture is useless to go to and I haven't learned anything.

Overall she's a nice person. Her lectures were not the most engaging, and it would sometimes be a bit boring to be honest. Attendance wasn't mandatory but she doesn't post lecture material or recordings (she reads straight from the ppt too lol). She's a nice person. Love professor Hao (Grace) she is very organized and homework/ review are really close to the exams. Don't think about it just take her :)

He is very funny, and a real laid-back professor and I would recommend him for 2nd year students. Just ask questions, if you prefer to figure things out by yourself you will get lost.

Disorganized, ineffectual, pompous, unpleasant, and inconsistent. Criteria is unclear, critiques are unhelpful if you get one at all; only critiques a few students per class because his time management is so poor. His studio isn't worth the cost of tuition, especially if you want to learn practical skills.

For the love of God, pick a different professor if you can, I trusted the reviews and I wish I hadn't. Lectures are long, assignments arent clear at all, students literally grouped up at the end of class just to UNDERSTAND THE INSTRUCTIONS. Lost years of my life just trying to get these assignments done, nice guy though.

One of the best professors! He is very knowledgeable and is extremally helpful. Do not be afraid to ask questions. Will actually help you if you do not understand how to draw something or in regarding plans or projects. Gives grate feedback!

Quevedo is very knowledgeable about architecture and will provide lots of articles, books, sketches, models, lectures, etc. to help you learn. He assigns projects constantly and will have you pinning up nearly every class period, but if you put effort in and listen you will learn a lot. He likes sketches and scale models.

In my third year and he is my favorite studio professor I have taken, I wish it wasn't online. He is actually funny, and he is nice, which is hard to find in architecture professors. If you are struggling, he will help. It is an odd feeling when you actually like your studio professor, it becomes very notice me senpai. He is also very talented.

He was very knowledgeable about famous artist and how they thought while they worked. He is also provided a pretty clear understanding of what he wants from you. He gave pretty good feedback to most of his students. The assignments are pretty easy, but they are very time consuming. He does lecture quite a lot, but it is for your benefit.

BEST PROF! Q is very knowledgeable and will go out of his way to get books, references, and sketch to help with your project. Yes, its a hard studio but, you learn a lot and become a better designer. Hand drawings are encouraged. Architecture is hard. So, these freshmen in ARCH 5251, stop whining. If you want an easy career this is not for you.

I have to give Quevedo a perfect score on this rating. He is one of the most knowledgeable, helpful and motivating professor in UTA SOA. He is a great teacher. He pushes you to think and work hard for yourself . He provides a lot of help and information that a student will need. His workload is average and definitely necessary.  So don't whine.

Quevedo is really knowledgeable about arch. He really knows what he is talking about and I learned a lot from his class. He does give out a lot of work!!! If you push urself, he will help you and pay attention to you, but if your slacking or jus don't know how anything about arch, he will make u feel like trash lol.
Learned a lot from him. Very sarcastic yet funny at times. Great professor! Definitely recommend him. Not too much work load. Take him!

Pretty cool prof but unclear and give too much work (standard for architecture at UTA).In general,to make it in archi,at UTA at least,you should be prepared to have no life,no job but still be able to pay for your material (middle class to rich).Keep in mind archi used to be an elite  profession, so it has changed but not completely
His personality is an F in my book. You do learn a lot from him but his work load is CRAZY BIG!If you survive his class, I think you will do considerably well in 2552....if you survive(i did!).
HE IS VERY SARCASTIC, BUT HE KNOWS HIS STUFF. YOU WILL LEARN ALOT FROM HIM BUT BE PREPARED TO DO ALL WEEKERS, NOT ALL NIGHTERS. WORK WORK WORK, BUT IT PAYS OFF.
Avoid if possible.
DO NOT TAKE HIM!!!! He will make your life miserable...
Take some body else.

Be prepared to go put up with all niters every other night. Materials/Concepts are not hard, but projects are time consuming. Prof. Quevedo is knowledgeable and understanding (willing to push back deadlines!!).
Really moody. Seems to enjoy being vague just to watch you flail about. Gets frustrated easily. Been at UTA too long.

How can anyone claim this studio is "hard, but you'll learn a lot."  Surely they mean is that the "material is simple, but the prof makes class unnecessarily HELL-ish."  Quevedo doesn't "teach," he "tells."  Loves to hear himself recite txtbk terms & sketch Corb projects. This class would trample even Corbusier's enthusiasm for the profession.

Professor Quevedo is a good teacher if you are wiling to learn and commit yourself to the studio.I learned a lot in his class, and I recommend him to everyone. He lectures the whole time but he knows what he is talking about. He will definately push you all the way through but in the end it will be worth it as it was for me......

worst studio professor i had. he's been stuck in uta for too long; boswell's pet; he def should have stayed in watercolours and art. i feel ashamed to have been taught by someone who doesn't know the difference between vivaldi and verdi, although rome and italy are the loves of his life. he's constantly depressed and will bring you down.
One of my favorite professors..had to work REALLY hard to earn the grade.

The work required for this studio is a big leap from 1242.  Be prepared to spend large amounts of time on your projects outside of class.  Nice guy, but he gets mad when students show up with little work done.  Give your best on your assignments, because they will count off, no  more breaks in grading!

Be prepared for a heavy work load, no pats on the back and to learn alot.  I invite you to be open to the possibilities.  I learned a lot about myself and acheived things I did not know were possible before.  I would take a class from him again.  Hang on tight the ride is tough.
No Comments
No Comments

do not take unless you want to go through a very stressful semester, he expects a lot of work from you in a short amount of time. talks the entire 3 hours, you never get to work in class and you dont get desk crits. He pushes you trying to get you to drop and if you a failing and you try to drop with a W with him signing, he will give you an F in the class, "to help prevent students from retaking classes and get them out of the arch. program"

I learned a lot from Quevedo but (There is always a but) He likes to talk and he lectures the entire three hour so all of your work is done out of class. He is also very moody and prone to throw a fit or two in class. I did how ever learn a lot from him and would reccommend him over all.

Class is easy if you apply. His lectures are boring and more complex than the ebook. No need to go to lectures as tests are based off the ebook. 3 exams graded 100pts each, up to 60pts extra credit. I received an A (86+ is an A btw) just by reading the book a few days before exam and doing the optional quizzes he gave as they will be used on test.

reviews.comment: VERY difficult class. He is a sweet person but honestly not good at giving lectures. If you want a good grade in this class, be prepared to study every day. To even have a CHANCE, make a study group, read the textbook, make flashcards, GET CENGAGE!!! He doesn't help if you're struggling. His TA's are amazing and even made review lessons.

reviews.comment: Pretty much don't go to class and teach yourself. Lin is a wonderful person but sucks at making sure his students are grasping the material. Be ready to read and study tons for the 80-100 question exams. There are only 3 and that makes your grade. No hw/quizzes etc.

STUDY STUDY STUDY!!! The textbook and MindTap will be your best friends for this class. Attendance isn't entirely necessary unless you just want to hear the information from the textbook/slides read out by another person, and his accent was not a problem for me at all personally.

reviews.comment: He really isn't that bad, he's ok as a lecturer. I am not too sure what all the hate is about. Read the textbook, use his slides, and make quizlets and you'll be okay. I haven't been to class and was able to get an A on all my exams just by using the content he provides. If you're giving him a bad review because he has an accent then youre a pos.

reviews.comment: The attendance is not mandatory. You don't need to come to class. The professor will read the slides anyway. You can read through it yourself way faster. Save yourself some time. If you're a good student, you can pull an A without attending a single day

Graded depended on only 3 exams. Can not understand him due to a heavy accent on an already tough topic. The highlighted portions on lecture slides were not incorporated in the exam at all. reviews.comment: This course was in person, but honestly I didn't go to class and still pulled an A. reviews.comment: He reads from the slides the whole class and it is really boring; You will have to teach yourself majority of the material. Gives 3 exams throughout the course each with 100+ questions, some are extra credit questions so you are able to score over 100. Not an easy class you can just get by.

Dr. Lin has a great personality, but he just stands and reads off the slides. His exams were 100 questions each and the class average was always in the low 60s. This is NOT an easy extra class to take, as you have to memorize around 150 powerpoint slides filled with information.

Dr. Lin is a fairly decent professor.  He cares about student's learning, but this is a hard class for most people.  I think the main issue is that this class is really a biology class.  As a student with a nursing and biology background, this class was a breeze.  I had already taken A&P 1 & 2, mental health nursing, and neurobiology, so I was fine

He is hard to understand, but he asks straight facts off power points which is hard to find in a teacher. Made over a 100 on the first exam, but the average was a 63, so I guess it is pretty hard for a lot of people. If you like anatomy and mental health, this class is not that bad. Acts first-order questions, not usually application based.

Hes a nice and fair professor but the material for Neuropharmacology is really difficult. The class periods are going to be all lecturing from powerpoints and three exams make up the entire grade. There is extra credit built in to each exam though.

I took him for Neuroscience and his exams were extremely difficult they were all short answers and there was no word bank provided, the questions were broken down into parts and the lab is horrible as well. The articles were to be done every week and the lab instructor barely teaches the class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

Good dude, just a bad class format. I wish he improves.

reviews.comment: I don't get why everyone is complaining. His class isn't hard, if you read the power-point and do your own additional research to tie things together you should do fine. reviews.comment: He tests only what he puts on his power points but his slides are very comprehensive. If you read them fully as you would a textbook you will pass. There is a language barrier both in him fully understanding student questions and being able to understand his in-class lectures. He is very knowledgeable though and good with one on one questions.

No need to buy the books for his class, everything you need to know is in the power points. The power points are very dense, and no detail is too small when preparing for his tests. If you want to pass get the cengage and use the questions!

Horrible! Don't take him. you won't learn anything.

This class is what you make of it.
