reviews.comment: Three exams. All you need to get an A is the textbook and the PPT's .
worst teacher ive ever taken
No sense in coming to class. No attendance taken. Pretty horrible teacher. Just read the book and pay very close attention to detail and you'll do ok.

I stopped coming to class after the first test. he has a thick accent and going to class was useless. i studied the power points and made an A. even made 100 on one test. if you're a good student you can make an A just make sure to READ! people act like you are supposed to learn everything in lecture. for a bio major this is very doable

Take someone else if possible. You get absolutely nothing out of lecture. Simply reads back powerpoints which he posts online. You must study! You will not be able to cram for this class. Three moderately difficult tests with a 4 point curve on your overall grade. No other grades or extra credit.

Horrible teacher and class. Really hard to understand due to heavy accent. Lectures are just powerpoints which are directly from the book. There's no need to come to class. 3 exams. That's it. 4 point curve.  Avoid.
Knows his stuff!

I didn't go to class for the last three months. Not one. I made an A.  It's really not that hard if you READ THE BOOK.  He doesn't take attendance.  Thick accent,and just reads from power points, which are word for word from the book.  Test questions are over general knowledge, not overly detailed, just moderately challenging. Study is a must.

Going to class is pointless; however, attendance is mandatory and 10% of your grade.  He just reads the slides back to you, so you won't get much out of class.  Material isn't difficult, but you are responsible for a lot of information, so studying is a must. 3 test total.  No comprehensive final.

3 tests that equal grade. I never went to class and studied the book/my own notes and got out with an 84 (86 and above equals an A). Material may be hard but it's very interesting! Study by asking yourself trick questions about the details.

Hey guys I beg you dont take him because i dont want you guys to be stuck like me. I am an A student and barely got B in his class its my first B on my transcript. exams are sooo tricky. He doesnt know how to teach. You will fail at end with 0 KNOWLEDGE. He doesnt care if a student pass or fail. He barely speaks english. you will FAIL. TRUST ME
3 tests that are worth 90% of grade, the other 10% comes from attendance and class discussion. Must read text book to get good grades on tests.
Super easy professor. I took this class online and he was an extremely easy grader as long as you follow the rubric and do the discussions.

He was an interesting professor. He did not grade hard and was very easy-going. it is a tech writing class so it was a little difficult to pay attention and was a little boring. But easy class if you do all the work on time.

if you hate presenting and writing, you probably won't like the class. There are multiple major assignments,  weekly assignments, plus a semester-long project. Professor Q offers a lot of examples and a rubric but is vague about instruction during class. He always canceled class last min but is very generous with accepting late work and grading.

Was not aware that this was some sort of business class?? The group semester project is way too involved and you will be graded on social media use. Multiple assignments a week, would have been better if we learned more things related to technical writing. May as well change my major to business.

Other than struggling to reach him via email sometimes, he is great. There's a semester-long project which is a lot better than writing a bunch of papers, other than that, in-class assignments and a couple of major assignments that arent hard to do. He normally teaches in the evening but it is WORTH IT.

A truly outstanding professor! Is very caring and understanding especially during COVID-19. Easy A+ as long as you finish each assignment, which is a group discussion board and with some major assignments; however, he does have office hours in which he will go over major assignments one-on-one and revises it while teaching you.

Imagine ur favorite twitch streamer as a teacher, this would probably be it. Professor Quijano is very laid back to the point where it seems he couldn't care less about essays and schoolwork. Just do your work and you should be fine. The main thing is the group project where you create an actual business and product. Be creative and choose wisely!

he's just very boring and the year-long group project doesn't feel very structured. Make sure to find a group that you think you can trust to do their part, the entire project was finished by me and another girl, when he gave us work that was meant to be done by the SIX people in our group. Assignments are explained well but not as well as I like

Professor Quijano is the best English professor I've ever taken. His class is easy to get an A in, even though attendance isn't mandatory it's expected because he gives a lot of opportunities to raise your grade. He also makes is topics very interesting by making them relevant and always making references that his students can relate to.

I would highly recommend taking Professor Quijano. It's very easy to pass his class with an A. He offers a lot of extra credit points. If you get a certain amount of points for an A, he gives you an option to write the final paper or not. The class has 4 papers. You have to choose a topic to talk about for every paper for the whole semester.

If you do everything, including the really easy extra credit, there is no reason you don't get an A. Even if you're writing is really bad he gives so many opportunities to get points it's crazy if your fail. I didn't have to write the final paper since I did all the extra credit so it's worth the extra work during the semester.
You will write better when you're done. Class has a lot of work and writing but he gives good feedback and will actually review your work before the deadline and comment. Book isn't needed.

Some criticize for his monotone voice, but he actually makes a lot of jokes and really tries to relate to all his students. In this Comp 1 class, you pick a topic that YOU like and are interested in. You only have to write 3 big papers but they are not difficult and he will help you as much as you need.
He gave good feedback and allowed plenty of opportunities for him to give feedback. Very prompt in his emailing, and was very detail oriented.
Show up, participate, take notes, make your deadlines, write some decent papers and you should have a a pretty good grade.

Super easy class! Most people didn't show up to class, but they still managed to pull of As in that class. He provides you an outline and helps you write out your essay to get an A. I highly recommend to take him for English 1301 and 1302!
Super easy class! Gives you an outline on how to write your essays, if you follow it then you should get an A on your paper! I would honestly take him again because his class is just so easy.

Really good English professor compared to others.  Got A's on all of my essays, just follow the rubric. Explanation of essays not 100% clear but if you ask for clarification he will accommodate you. Participation is mandatory but can also act as extra credit. Gives assignments but doesn't always take them up, not hard to do at all.

This is an easy class to pass, but he is so monotone! I could not stand going to this class, but since he doesn't have blackboard you do kind of have to attend to know when things are due. Also his handwriting is impossible to read so you can forget about feedback on your essays. And he responds late to emails!! Do NOT take him!!

Easy course but requires work in order to get the A. The grade depends on the entire class assignments instead of the exams. He also gives out extra credit. Really laid back but he misses somethings on the assignments which you need on your part to check with him to make sure you get the right grade. Do not take him if you are lazy.

I'd say good professor but kinda boring and monotonous at times. There is A LOT of writing required and sometimes you can't keep up with all of it. 3 major essays, 7 required  2-pgs long reader response, around 15 1-pg long opinion essays. But he is very flexible and easy. I missed a lot of non-major essays, but he let me make up for it at the end.
This man is so laid back. SUPER EASY...This is a definite "A" for a grade. If not, YOU'RE NOT A VERY BRIGHT PERSON....I'm so serious.

The class and the papers were pretty easy and hes kind of laid back about it most of the time, but then he gave us the final test. It was horrible. He had more than 40 vocabulary terms and almost as much sections asking for examples. Then he had us write 2 papers!

He doesn't tell us to use the book a lot, but he gets all the stuff from it. All his grades are essays and written stuff, but he sometimes does debates. When he's around he's really helpful and always willing to explain, but he takes like 3 days to answer e-mail. He also goes to conferences a lot, so you'll probably have a week off mid-semester.
Easy but extremely helpful and friendly.

Do not take him. Even though you can easily get A's on your homework and class assignment, your essays will always be lower than B's and C's. His comment on your Rough draft is crap. "A pretty good essay." he said, turns out you get a freaking C. You major grades are your ESSAYS!!!

Easy conceptual tests, good lectures, he's passionate and knows what he's talking about! Homework is good to study material and very reasonable amount and deadlines. The pace of the course is good. Expect to practice with the material outside of the lecture. He's a professor, not a teacher. Choose this guy over Jaehoon Yu.

he reads over slides which arent his, and can not distribute them due to "copy right" ,responds days later to emails, way to fast in class, verry stressful professor, no reviews for his test either. expects you to write a whole slide, understand the slide, and organize it in under 3 minutes. terrible STAY AWAY

Taken Spring 2021. Professor Zhang was a decent professor and I feel I could've learn better if it was in person. He had a hard time adjusting to the online stuff and did the best he could. Homework is fairly difficult and be ready for pop quizzes. Test were mostly conceptual and easier than the homework. His curves at the end helped a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Zhang is a very kind and caring guy. His lecture pace is just right, and the amount of homework he assigns is reasonable. He gave five pop quizzes, but they were mostly conceptual and went over the most recent lectures. Overall, I enjoyed attending his lectures and had a positive experience with his class.

All he does is go over the lecture slides. You have do your own study to better on exams. He takes 5 quizzes randomly, and one of which will be dropped. Exams are easy if you study well. Again you have to study your own to do better!
She really explained the material well
She is a great lecturer. I felt I really leant something in her class and will be able to use in real world.

She doesn't explain the content well and reads off the powerpoints. She doesn't show how to apply concepts to homework and exam questions or give real-world examples and doesn't help you work through problems. She's also very disorganized and doesn't respond to emails on weekends. The only supplemental material provided is pwpts. DO NOT TAKE HER

She was accessible through email and accommodating.

reviews.comment: She's a good professor but the lectures are kinds difficult to pay attention to just cause there long and slow. Two exams, homework, and a group project.

A good professor who works with her students if they need it, but is still learning the ropes of teaching herself. Attendance isn't mandatory and she is very easy-going and casual about participation. Take her if you feel comfortable with the subject; if you think you'll struggle, another professor wouldn't hurt.

Took her during COVID, she means well. She tries to help if you don't understand how to do something, and its definitely nice to see the effort. However, it was difficult following along the whole time. There were a lot of group projects, groupme helped familiarize myself with everyone. Chegg was what helped me the get through a lot of the hw.

The only grades were 5 exams. 70 minutes to answer 60 questions. About 90% of the answers are online, but a few questions come straight from the book. reviews.comment: I took geology 1301 lecture which was asynchronous. You're only graded by 5 exams and everything else is optional. The exams are super easy, I took notes on the chapters but it's probably not even necessary to get a good grade. I had lab with another professor which was easy as well.

easiest online class EVER. only 5 exams, literally nothing else. consisted of 60 questions each with time limit of like 70 mins. all answers online (download socratic to make it easier- TRUST ME) had lab with another prof, but it was also p easy, esp after moving to online lab after covid. take this class online for easy A !!

Chapter quizzes are 50+ questions, and none of the questions on the Exams match these. No study guides provided for exams. This is the most difficult class I've ever taken. This professor does not care and has no interaction with students. Horrible.

Online class, 5 exams plus the lab grade is your total grade. The exams were every 2 weeks so it felt like I never got a break. If you don't read the book you won't do good on the exams. reviews.comment: the teacher struggles at making things clear, either lecture slides or delivering ideas. It is an easy A if you can just follow instructions and tuirn in all homework on time, check your blackboard timely

reviews.comment: I took the class online for a GPA boost. Did not disappoint, got an A with minimal effort. I mean yeah, read the slides and try to do things, but sometimes I forgot I even enrolled in this class. Super easy A.

Prepare for 3 hour long slide shows, the good thing is such slides shows are available for download, so one can use formulas there to do work, but his class is very boring and hard to sit through. He has a thick accent, but this is offset by his slide shows.

He's the best Data Science professor at UTA. His lectures are clear, especially for beginners, and the homework is well-structured with group work opportunities. He chooses great TAs and is very approachable, even after the class ends. Highly recommend, especially for research.

I never write rate my professor reviews, but I have to write one for Dr. Rostami. 
I had him for two courses, he is one of the most caring and kind professors I have seen. He is so understanding when it comes to the work and if you have problems and gives a lot of grace as long as you communicate. You will not regret taking his class!
Great professor, he is very understanding that many of us are just starting to code. The homework correlated to the lecture perfectly

Professor Rostami understands coding does not come easy to everyone so he takes his time teaching. The labs and homework have clear instructions and are of reasonable difficulty. As long as you do the assignments, are present in class and follow along with the lecture, this class is an easy A.

Excellent professor. She really teaches you to think in a problem solving manner and not just coding. Even though this is difficult it is very helpful to me in all my future classes. I wish she was teaching other classes.

She is the best! This is my third class with her and I wish she was teaching other classes cuz you learn so much in her classes

Take her if you want to learn to code. The topic is not easy but she gives you the tools to succeed. As long as you put in the effort, you'll leave her class knowing a ton of stuff. She's also a super nice person and fun to talk with.

The way she teaches is excellent. True story...a couple of my friends taking this class with another professor were struggling with their hw for a few days. I was able to complete their hw in half an hour. That's how good of a programmer this class made me. I also have an A, so I learned a ton and also got a good grade. Win win.

This professor is just, amazing. She truly cares for the well being of her students, always making sure that the most difficult of subjects is taught in a way where even people who are new to programming can easily pick up the essentials to become decent problem solvers, not just coders. I was really struggling with programming through the first few classes, but she helped me overcome my troubles by offering extra assistance. Don't listen to that 1 star review, she is legitimately one of the best professor you should take if you're going into CSE. I never ever thought I would be able to code! And now here I am 2 and half months in and I am able to write programs in java! She posts everything we do in class online and it really helps me review. Definitely one of the best professors I've had. I used to be really intimidated by C (and programming in general) but now can code in C with my eyes closed. Amazing professor and helps out in any way possible-all you have to do is ask.

reviews.comment: Dr. Urban provides a lot of material that is extremely helpful. Read it ALL! This was by far the hardest class I have taken but the most beneficial. You will need to study A LOT. This is not a blow off class. Exams are difficult (hardest-3rd test), study hard. I will truly be a better nurse bc of her!
I really love Professor Urban. Pathophysiology was tough but i learned so much information. I have needed the information i gained over and over. She is super helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prepare to show everything for lockdown browser. Prepare to be deducted points either way for a silly reason. I am an A student and class material is overall very easy to understand but made hard by picky grading. Wouldn't recommend her.

I loved Dr. Urban!! She gives more helpful study materials than any other professor that I've had. I got an A in this class because I read (& re-read) the RRD's, I did the case studies, used the quizlet, etc. If you do poorly in this class it's not the professor, it's you. Don't buy the textbook unless you are contracting for honors. Best prof!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I LOVE DR. URBAN! the only reason I got a B is because i was taking pharm at the same time. She is so clear, organized, informative, and gives you all of the resources to succeed. She also has recorded lectures. Definitely need to be strong in A&P and study a lot, but she also provides A&P Preps to refresh you! She made it easy to WANT to learn.

The only thing I liked about her was that she has premade notes for us to study, which was a life saver cuz all you had to do was study them to pass. I wud have gotten an A if i hadn't doubled up with Pharm and patho. This class is not easy. Her lectures did not help, she read straight off the notes. I basically memorized the info for the exams.

BEST PROF AT UTA! Patho is hard, dense class but Urban gives you EVERY resource possible to succeed. If you dont put in the study time then doing poorly in this class is your own fault. Exams are crit thinking so make sure to understand her RRDs and not just memorize. Exam 3 was the hardest and most dense! She will truly make you a better nurse!

She lectures from home with her dogs barking. It is detracting from the little information she gives. The class is basically another canned online class that is designed to be run by teachers aids so she has little to do with anything other than a worthless weekly lecture.

Had her for patho. She runs a wonderful class. This was by far the hardest class of my undergrad. Her tests are hard but she gives you all the material you need. You just have to put in the WORK. There is no rounding, dropping of grades, or extra credit. Its a doable class and will make you a better student.

This was the hardest class I have ever taken in my life! Im not sure how other kids got A's. The class is very interested, but the lecture is on a level 5 out of 10, and the exams are like a 10 out of 10. The exams were super duper hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This was a fantastic class. The expectations are set so high, it felt very rewarding to pass with an A. The recorded lectures are gold in my opinion. You really have to work and put in the time for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Patho with this professor was extremely easy. I studied a week or less before exams and made an A-. All you need to study is the RRD material. Exam 3 is the hardest so make sure to study extra for that one. The final is not bad at all. Love Dr. Urban! She made this class as easy as it can be! Having a good SI leader will help you too. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Urban is very thorough in her teaching. She provides all necessary information plus extra material to help you learn everything. All test material comes from her lectures/notes so you don't even need the book. Patho is a very hard subject, but she provides you with as much as she possibly can. If you don't pass the class, it is your own fault.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Urbans class is very organized and her lectures are packed with useful information. This is definitely a class where you would want to be in a study group.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her exams are based off of notes she provides, no book needed. There are 5 quizzes and 5 exams. The final exam is 75% comprehensive. You need to know your A&P well for this class, if you don't, no need to worry. She provides "preps" which help refresh your A&P knowledge. She provides concept maps and everything needed to excel. Take her!

Dr. Urban is one of the sweetest professors you will ever meet. The class isnt easy and it is definitely A LOT of material to learn (if you want an A you will most likely have to study everyday) but she provides everything in order for her students to be successful including already made quizlet and extra material to understand the content.

Urban is GOD SENT. The material is hard but she really gives you everything you need to succeed. The test are straight forward. She made the class as doable as it could be while still teaching you the material. If you want to be a good nurse, take her.

Had her critical care clinical. Quizzes you over EKG interpretation on day 1, which really helps with Exam 2 for critical care. Does post-conference lecture to help understand exam material. Very knowledge and helpful and is always there to help you. Always available via phone/email/text. You would be lucky to have her as a clinical instructor!

As difficult as this class was, it definitely prepares your for nursing school. The class is tough, and you have to STUDY everyday. There's no going around it! Right now, I'm at a high B but I haven't taken the final yet. Dr. Urban is an amazing professor, but you have to put the work in.

Urban is awesome. She cares about you and wants you to do well. She is able to keep students engaged during her lectures and is always so excited about her job. She will never treat you like you are stupid, even if you are. So don't be afraid to ask questions. If you don't do well in her class it is your fault. Her notes are all you need and are A1

This course was very difficult . What made me so angry with this class, I felt like they were trying to "weed" people out . The 3RD exam was the most difficult . I felt they have broken this exam into 2 parts . I believe it would have made the course a lot easier and the information to be retain better .

Dr. Urban is the most helpful professor I have ever taken. She created quizlet, recorded the lecture and gives you a feedback about the questions you missed on the test. Wonderful professor! I would definitely recommend her. But you have to stand your material. If I fail the course I can't blame her because she gave me all she had.

Honestly, most amazing professor I have had through college so far. Her blackboard is so organized, and she provides everything for you to be successful on tests. She records the audio and ppt. from lecture and posts them as podcasts, so I watch them at home and just show up on test days. Tests are info. heavy, you must study to pass this class.

Tests extremely hard, test reviews worthless. Exams on LkDn Browser, 90sec/Q, one attempt, Q's are concepts and very vague and don't match HW, class progressively gets more and more difficult and voluminous. First class EVER to make a "B"! Btw this class and Dr Tanizaki in CHEM1451 I have PTSD! Poor professors, I regret going to UTA! Very sad!!!!!!

Extremely difficult! Very sad, you never find out which Q's you missed on exams-huge disadvantage. She's beyond scatter brain. 4 reg exams x100 each, 1 comp final exam 100 pts, 10 HW x1 each. Exam Q's are conceptualization and very far advanced from HW assignments and reviews. Get your BSN from TWU. Poor quality prof's at UTA.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Avg 30 hrs/week on this class. You will be told exam 2 most difficult. This could be further from the truth!! Class progressively gets more difficult and more voluminous. Don't fall into trap thinking class will be a cakewalk after exam 2. She provides ALL class material, you won't need textbook, I used my A&P book for reference.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Online class. Book was optional, I used it when I didn't understand a concept. Do not buy recommended books like Chemistry, A&P. She teaches off RRD packets you print & print! Her RRDs are busy looking & repetitive, & her teaching style for some concepts is hard to follow. You Tube was my best friend. For an A do all packets & take this class alone
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: great prof!

Her class was extremely hard. Her tests are hard and her test reviews are helpless. You are timed 1min and 30sec per question. On a critical thinking question?Common! She gives no extra credit and no second attempts. This was the first class I had ever failed in my life. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Definitely passionate about the course, a plus for anyone teaching a hard course as this one. I made an A by reading through the RRDs & highlighting stuff I didn't understand just from reading once. I then listened to her podcasts which she provides a few more helpful details, pictures, & explanations than what is provided on the RRDs. Takes effort
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher. Time consuming but if you read the RRDs & listen to the lectures, you will do well. Smart, organized, & her teaching style allows you to understand the actual disease processes. I'm a nurse & LOVED this class. Very responsive to emails. Requires critical thinking & will prepare you for nursing school/boards. No textbook needed
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Nice as a person, horrible as a professor.  Why did we have to pay for a online course where the professor literally only reads slides to you. She doesn't even know the material she's teaching. Just ask her a question, her response will be oh, let me check my notes or I don't have my notes with me. Easy A if you are strong in your A&P knowledge.

Mrs. Urban is wonderful. She really wants you to pass her class but isn't going to just hand it to you. It's on you to learn and understand the material, not her. Go to class and pay attention! Study a little every day, not a lot all at once. She brings in her real world experience and it makes the material applicable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Mrs. Urban is a wonderful professor. I took this class online. If I had any questions she was always happy to answer them. I would deff take her again. Although, this class is not easy. You have to work for your grade. I never had to use the book but her RRDs are a must read. If you know those you're good to go.

Mrs. Urban is an awesome professor! SO Sweet! This class is very time consuming and stressful! Definitely take this class alone or with easy classes because there is so much information to read. I took the online 11 week class in the summer and it challenged me! No need for a book because her tests are based completely on the RRD's.
She is very knowledgeable .She exactly knows how to break down the hard materials in order to be more understandable. She is an amazing teacher.

I took her for research online. Lots of reading, but I learned so many things about EBP. Mrs. Urban is smart and my academic coach was very helpful. You will need to do weekly worksheets and quizlet cards to do well on quizzes and assignments. Weekly OOH discussions cover assignments in detail and are recorded if you are not able to listen live.

She's a wonderful teacher! Lectures and notes posted on BB, extra cred. quizzes on BB. No dropped exams. Every test has bonus questions at the end. It's a ton of material, but I memorized the notes a few days before each exam and made an A on every one. She is very nice and helpful. Final sucks and is cumulative, but it's doable

Exams are straight from the notes, but it is a lot of information. I do not recommend her online class because her on campus class has more advantages such as: they were given an extra credit opportunity (7 points to exam grade) that online students weren't given, in-class packet exams while online is on computer with no backtracking, etc.

Wow! This class was difficult but I passed it because:  1. Ms. Urban is clear of what you need to know for exams. 2.  She provides an ABUNDANCE of resources access to email for help. 3. Her PODCAST lectures are awesome. They go hand in hand with the RRD. 4. I studied the RRD's, concept maps, and listened to her lectures on each RRD at least 3X

She's a great professor. Super helpful,  really nice,knowledgable,but the class is tough. She wants you to pass. Don't take this class w/ anything else, Bc you need to dedicate all of your time, energy in this class to pass. Hardest class at UTA RN-BSN. Best way to pass is to do the worksheets and quizlet cards that she uploads. Outline was a waste

Mrs.U is a great teacher. She is so helpful when needed and very intelligent. The course has a lot of information, so you will definitely need to study every day and stay on top of things from the very beginning. When she teaches, she makes topics interesting and easy to understand!

Mrs U is easy. Basically if you find this hard nursing is not for you. I've decided on medicine instead but this class is definitely a good one. It will introduce you to various conditions which you will run into whether nurse, doc, or pa. If you score below an 85 I suggest you reconsider your path. Read notes you'll get a good grade bottom line.

Professor Regina Urban is one of the most awesome professor at UTA. I love her lectures. She have an intensive knowledge on the subject and she is willing to help her students to succeed on the class. Ask her whenever you don't get the concept. Patho is one of the basic foundations of nursing,  so expect to work hard and study. It's doable though!

Ms. Urban is a wonderful teacher she is willing to help as much as possible. Patho 3366,requires 100% of your attention. This class is definitely NOT a cake walk. The test are timed 2 minutes per question, 40 questions per test. The reading material is overwhelming but manageable. Outline the Readings and take good notes and you will be fine.

She had fill in the blank style notes that were easy to study.  Test come straight from the notes so book is not needed and she says this the first day of class.  This class is straight forward but you have to stay on top of things

Mrs. Urban is amazing. She is more than willing to answer any of your questions and is very patient with you. Because this is an online class, her RRDs are indeed lengthy but they provide great information are you MUST read them in order to pass her tests. You will rarely even need to open the textbook.

Mrs. Urban is a wonderful professor. Pathophysiology can be a difficult subject, but if you go to class and listen to Mrs. Urban's lectures she does a great job of helping you understand the material. If you study and listen to the recorded lectures for clarification, you should do well. She is always willing to help you if you need it.

I would highly recommend this teacher! She is extremely nice. There were 4 exams and a final exam. There were bonuses on each of the exams including the final. A textbook is not needed. Everything on the exams is straight from the notes which can be printed offline. The only complaint is that some material is home-study.

Mrs. Urban was very helpful and gave us everything we needed to receive an A. I received a B because of what I was going through outside of class, but she is one of the best teachers I've had in a while. I would recommend her to everyone, and as long as you study a little bit every day, you'll make an A.

Mrs. U is very sweet. She provides you with all the notes you need. Just study the notes, do the quizzes, & make sure to answer the case studies at the end of each section of notes; they definitely help! You will do great if you make concept maps to assist with learning. I would study less than a week before the test & I still managed to get a 92.

I'm taking her patho class online. The information provided is crystal clear. I love biology, so this class seems like a review of all the classes ive already taken. love it !!! Im not sure if she's hot or not as im taking the online class, but she does sound hot on the audio lectures.

THIS IS A NURSING CLASS, PATHO. ONE OF THE FOUNDATION CLASSES FOR NURSING. URBAN IS A GREAT TEACHER, THIS CLASS IS NOT A CAKE-WALK. YOU MUST MEMORIZE A LOT OF INFOMATION, BUT IT IS ALL PROVIDED ON THE LECTURE NOTES. RE-LISTEN TO THE PODCAST & MEMORIZE ALL THE NOTES AND YOU CAN MAKE AN A. I HAD A 98 AVERAGE BUT I STUDIED A LOT! IT IS VERY REWARDING!

LOVE HER!!!!!! This woman is passionate about her job and studies. She is SUPER SMART. She is very helpful, understanding and explains everything, and I mean EVERYTHING beyond. She is always happy and she has that drive and I love that about her. I did not buy the book. Exams were tested from the notes only.

Great professor! Highly recommend her for patho. She gives you notes to print out and all you have to do is fill in blanks. Her tests come directly from her notes. You DO NOT need the book!! She will tell you that herself too. Easy class as long as you study your notes and go to lecture. She does record lecture incase you miss.

Actually had Stephens but Urban has taken over b/c I guess Stephens won't be teaching Patho anymore(?) But she's very nice and a good teacher. She is reading off of Stephens power point so not quite sure how she will run her own class. But I recommend!

Dr. Kim is really knowledgeable on environmental topics. She goes in depth so much during the lecture it can be overwhelming though. There aren't a lot of assignments, just a few reports, one midterm, and the final exam. A good portion of the midterm and final are free response questions and she can be a tough grader. Plenty of extra credit options

If you're a good memorizer, just verbally spill EVERYTHING on the exams and you'll be fine. She's very kind and intelligent, but the heavy content memorization kills me. Besides that, not much to do once you go home. And the class itself will leave you learning A LOT about chemical hazards and their regulations, which is great for EES majors.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This course is very information heavy but there isn't much work that goes along with it. the lectures are long-winded but good for the exams. she is very nice and understanding with late assignments and gives lots of extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She talks a lot during lecture (Powerpoint), enough to bore you, but at least she knows a lot about the course... she's nice though. Tests are based off of lecture, but she is super nitpicky about grading it. Tip: write test answers word for word like lecture and you'll pass. This class has a LOT of information, so make sure to study EVERYTHING...
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He can be intimidating at first but that is because he wants you to learn. He tries to push everyone to be a better student by asking tough questions that will make you think. Online communication and time can be better though.

He does seem a little unorganized and chaotic at first but now that medsurg clinicals are over, I realize what a great instructor he truly is! The information/knowledge that he provided to us (especially during post-conferences) not only helped us succeed in medsurg class exams but will also definitely help us in our nursing careers!

Great clinical instructor overall and is pretty nice. Communication with him could be better, but he does care about your success as a future nurse. Really gives good feedback and answers your questions. Post-clinical discussions about the patient's disease process provided a lot of good educational information. You'll be lucky to have him.

He will push you! He is nice though. Did make one girl cry this semester haha, but he never shouts or loses his temper. It is just that he will rapid-fire questions at you, but is understanding if you do not always know the answer. He is unorganized but he likes telling stories and is funny. Great instructor!

Professor Charlie is pretty cool! He is very patient and also gives great tips for remembering many priority interventions that are important for nurses to know, as well as exam content. He has a lot of experience and knowledge about the nursing profession and overall is a really great professor! You will learn plenty!

After studying this class for one semester, the professor hasn't written a single line of the program on any IDE. He only reads out ppt. The professor and TA for this professor get angry when we ask any doubts. They will say don't ask dumb questions. No one will be good at everything so it is at least good to show some directions for them to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Always gets angry when ever if a doubt is asked he gets confused These professors are not at all good First need to learn how to be good with students and respect there emotions Even they to try very hard to reach a certain level but due to this professors its so bad Mistakes are done by everyone and give a chance

How did he became professor, he doesn't even treat students as humans. Must be student friendly too. He Need to understand it takes some time for international students to stick to USA education. For some help he may also use online sources, but there was no plagarism check at that time.

The approach this professor takes to a topic such as Data mining is a complete shame. He is truly as worst as professors can get. He usually complains that students donot ask questions but he forgets that he gets angry every time any one asks a question and belittles anyone who asks him any question. He asks for feedback but gets mad at them.
Worst Professor at UTA . Never going to take him again.

The lecture is mostly the professor reading through the slides, you won't pick a thing up in class. The course's grade depends on how well you do in the project and in the exams. He doesn't convey things well, so good luck trying to figure out the project. Exams are difficult and attendance is 5% of the total grade.

This man is the definition of art. He cares about art and he cares about how you grow as an artist. If you put effort into your works and try new things, he'll be impressed and work with you. He's amazing at critique, explanation, and new ideas.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Be ready to work cause this isn't your typical art class. He takes art seriously and expects you to as well. If you just do the work and put effort things should be fine. His main goal is to help you grow as an artist so the class will be tough.
lots of work. Little to no feedback. Spent most of his class walking on eggshells because he gets angry easily. Not fun or enjoyable environment.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Unzicker was a good professor. I enjoyed the class very much and he's a very friendly, interesting man. His lectures tend to be repetitive and a bit slow, but he means well and is thoroughly interested in what he's teaching. Super easy class, and we watched lots of high quality films and heard some wonderful scores. Enjoyed it!

Pretty laid back dude. As long as you go to class, take down notes from his power points and watch the movies a little bit outside of class it should be an easy A. Outlining the chapters in the textbook also helped me out too.
He is the easiest music teacher and he gives lots of extra credits.

I really liked this class.  The subject matter is heavy duty demanding and requires attendance and work.  Once you figure out how to think along with Dr. Unzicker, it gets easier.  You can depend on him to know his stuff and he's totally approachable and prepared. Very pleasant man.

This class meets at 8am and he tends to speak very monotone. He knows his stuff but is not the best at transferring his knowledge into meaningful, useful information for the students. Good class if you take the initiative to figure it out for yourself. There is no prerequisite for the class, but you need to have completed Theory 4 to understand.
He is a really good professor. Sometimes i felt like he could have explained things a little bit better but over all he is great!

Mr. Unzicker has a rare combination of wanting his students to do well and working extremely hard to see that they do.  I had no idea what his class would be like, and ended up completely happy I took Music Appreciation.  He's thorough, fair, and is clear about his expectations.  If you are wanting a class to coast through, his is not for you.

While Professor Unzicker knows his topic well, his tests are excessively long, especially for an hour period (100 questions). There are 10 quizzes, which are completely out of order in accordance to the textbook. And there are a lot of off topic questions on the tests and quizzes. I wouldn't recommend him.

He is a graduate student so I do not know if he will be teaching Music Appreciation again, but he was ridiculously hard! I am an A student and I had the most difficult time! His lectures are vague and he likes to ramble and his test and quizzes are VERY textbook-detail specific! Do NOT take his class. Also, there were FOUR MANDATORY Concert Reviews
He will not teach you, the homework are nothing like lecture, the practice exam isn't like the homework's and the exam isn't like either
extremely hard teacher and class. 10/10 do not recommend. get ready to learn everything on your own.

I'm telling you guys please go through the designated textbook questions he provides for each module and trust me run through every single one of those questions until u understand why it's correct. That and understanding every single question on the practice exam. Pay attention to his practice exams!! They're just like the exams.

The professor is okay. He explains the topic well. As his classes were only 50mins, his lectured were fast paced. It would have been great if his classes were longer. He also has many pre lesson videos and readings to do. It is important that you actually practice and not procastinate your way through. Make use of SI, chemistry clinics and textbook

Tanizaki is an amazing professor, but you have to put in the effort. So go to SI, study, and do practice problems, and you will be okay. Pay attention in class because he really knows what he is explaining and can help make the info easier to understand. I hated the lab because of how long the experiments were,and LabFlow can be hard/time-consuming

Class based on homework, practice exams, class participation, and four 15 question exams + one 20 question final. Study for exams ahead of time by using the practice exams, rewatching lectures on echo360, and going to SI sessions for the mock exam. No curving, extra credit, or dropping of exams. Overall, professor was good. Challenging course.

This class was not as hard as I thought it would be. You should read the textbook chapters assigned before class to have a better understanding during lecture. Practice test questions are very similar to the actual test questions. ALEKS homework can be annoying but it's not terrible. Read the textbook and do many practice questions.

Tough class for someone who isn't best at math, but he is very professional and clear on what resources are available to help us pass. Majority of grade weight relied on the 15-question midterms (4), so it is best to really study up for those using the practice exams & lots of practice problems. 
Use the resources, echo360, and don't procrastinate!

I took Chem 1451 in a 4 week summer course, and was able to pass with A. Make sure to go to lectures, do the homework for extra practice, go to the chemistry clinics ( they help A LOT) , and rewatch lectures on echo. He is an amazing professor, and his teaching style is top tier.

I took this course during a summer accelerated course. Overall, great professor and not too hard of a class. Make sure you attend class because it is mandatory, do your homework, and study your practice exams because they mimic the real exam, so they were my study guide. The free chem tutoring also saved my life in the course.

Took during summer, not a hard class but you may struggle if you aren't good at math. Watching his pre-lecture & post-lecture videos are crucial to understanding the content. For exams, review every HW on ALEKS, and use his study guide where he tells u what you need to have MEMORIZED for each exam and you'll be set.

Definitely be prepared to put in the work, this is a very challenging course and he's not shy to place a large workload on students. Attendance is mandatory and participation is extremely important for success in his class. As a whole, super professor, I would absolutely take him again. Very professional, funny, and easy to reach outside of class.

I took him for a summer course, and he's very clear on the material you need to study for exams. He makes the material easy to comprehend with post-class lesson videos. He does take attendance, and you are graded on it. He calls out people being distractions in class(which I found great!) Overall, if you go to the lectures, you will do good.
Exams are 50% of your grade so good luck.

Tanizaki is a good professor overall. His lectures are helpful and comprehensible. He cares about students and their understanding. If you take notes, attend lecture, and study for the exam you should be set.
Doesn't go over everything you need to know so be prepared to read the textbook for tests
Too many rules.

Prof. Tanizaki puts a lot of effort into creating instructional materials to prepare his students for tests. Pre class videos, printed in class assignments, and homework questions all relate perfectly to exam questions. If you read the textbook, participate in class, and practice problems it's fairly easy to pass/get an A.

Tanizaki deserves a higher rating on here!!! I had him for my first semester as a freshman at UTA for CHEM 1442 (Gen Chem 2) and he was AMAZING. His pre-lesson videos, although not mandatory to watch, were very helpful and made the content we were learning so much easier to understand. To add on, he was very easy to reach if you had questions!

The negative reviews are from students who obviously didn't put effort. Tanizaki is Japanese - he comes from a culture that's very strict with taking class seriously. He does his best to ensure students understand info. Attend lecture, take 3-4 days to study before each test (use the textbook), and you'll do well. Easiest science course at UTA imo.

Tanizaki is the only one that teaches nursing chem, so good luck. Your grade heavily depends on exams, HW does basically nothing for your grade, and having to get an iClicker is annoying. He will call you out in front of the class for being distracting and is condescending at times. Lab is pretty fun and can bring up your grade a lot.

I loved having Dr. Tanizaki as my professor. His lectures are recorded on Echo360; however, he takes attendance using an iClicker. A homework assignment is given every time we have class. Tests consist of 20 questions and are very similar to the practice exam. USE THE TEXTBOOK! It is extremely helpful and worth the time spent reading.

Didn't expect so many negative reviews. I thought he was a great professor, funny, caring, and gave great lectures. I took his class in the summer, and while fast-paced, nothing was unmanageable. Tests are easy to get through if you do the homework, practice exams, and use the learning objectives and textbook as a study guide. Lab helped the grade.

Professor Tanizaki's class is challenging but rewarding. The lectures are fast-paced, so staying on top of the material through practice problems and unstuckstudy ai is crucial. The labs can be draining, but a dedicated study group helps a lot.

The professor's teaching style did not match my learning needs. His advanced level and insufficient explanations left me struggling. Even when I asked for help, he wasn't clear. He assumed prior knowledge that I didn't have. I believe I would have performed better with a different instructor. Know what his class entails before you take it.

Proctored thru ALEKS. Prof T. is helpful and communicative however inflexible when it comes to assignts submt'd in ALEKS. Course does not feel like a freshman lvl course. Lab req's renting a lab kit and purchasing items outside of class. Spent an addt'l $100 in items needed. Lab Prof is kind and helpful, 1st and 2nd exams are most difficult.

His textbook is the holy grail! It's pretty easy to follow imo. Doing ALEKS homework problems and practice exam questions also help a ton, too. Practice exam is close to the exam if you choose the right exam color. For anyone who are considering Rogers, he's a better teacher, but his class is faster, denser and overall hard

He's the only professor that teaches this course & thats a red flag on its own. FLIES through PowerPoints in a 50 min lecture, doesnt break any info down, but rather teaches like its common sense, makes you buy a $60 iClicker to use as participation grade, & will refer you to ALEKs if you need help understanding HW.  Be ready to teach yourself...
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
This professor is not good... the class is difficult, very draining. The lab was terrible too, TA was no good. The lectures were so fast and all he did was fly through the powerpoints and ask a question every so often we had to answer on a "clicker" that was $60 for a "grade". 
Don't recommend.

Dr. Tanizaki brilliantly distills intimidating biochemistry and organic chemistry concepts into digestible step-by-step lessons. He simplifies difficult topics from amino acid behavior to organic chemistry structures into comprehensible solutions. Supreme educator who both challenges and nurtures students. Deserves highest endorsement. 10/10

I took his class online, I would say he is a very hard grader. I would also say that this class requires a ton of practicing each module multiple times a week. For some reason on test I felt like I did horrible on I did well and on test I felt pretty good about I did absolutely terrible? I know that is not his fault but I found it frustrating.

Amazing professor had him for Chem 1451 this summer. The lecture is very straightforward, and it is mainly about practicing outside of class like doing practice problems, hmwk and practice exams, and you will get an A.

His lectures are a bit on the harder side to pay attention to. I found it easier to read the textbook outside of class on my own than listening to the lectures. He does not require attendance but unfortunately uses an iClicker randomly. He posts practice exams that are very similar to his exams which was very nice.

The lab drained me as I took this class in the summer, if you're doing this class I suggested you find a study group and tackle it tgt. I'm an A student and when I kept getting B's I was drained but was able to turn it around with final exam. I wouldn't take it in the summer, but dedication helps & coming in with general chem knowledge (3/5 exams)!

Not as awful as some of the reviews said he was but he had such terrible structure for the class like for the final we finished lecture the day before the exam. Also he doesn't drop anything so if you're looking for a lenient professor, don't take the class. Lab was also pretty stressful. I feel like this is a class that requires a whole summer.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: A kind and funny professor. I had him for the 5-week course in the summer and although it was fast-paced, I was able to learn efficiently with his help. Homeworks and practice exams are easy but study for exams because they'll count for most of your grade. Videos in canvas will help and he will repeat information if we don't understand at first.

I had him for chem (5-week summer course). He was so good! He has extra videos in the module section that helped a lot. He also records all the lectures so I would go back over them to prepare for the exams. His practice exams help too! They are just like the test. He explains everything and gives examples and answers any questions you may have!

Worst professor I have ever taken in my college career. Nice guy, but worst professor. Lectures did not help at all with course assignments/exams. This is a "teach yourself" course and the resources to do so are not helpful. I DO NOT RECOMMEND TAKING THIS PROF.

He breaks down the course material into bite sized chunks that are easy to understand. Additionally, there is a program that all coursework is done through-ALEKS. This program provides instant feedback and you can practice as much as you would like. If you make anything below an A, you are not making use of all the resources at your fingertips.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: (weed-out class) Don't take this professor unless you have a solid chem foundation! Tanizaki's lectures are fast-paced and overwhelming. Tests are rigorous. He makes everyone buy $60 clickers just to take attendance. Take Cleaver instead, his pace and content are much more digestible. Remember to get help at the chem clinic!

This man is one of the most understanding, caring, and capable professors I have ever had the pleasure of taking. He is always willing to help you, and he genuinely cares about his students. I had many troubles this semester, and he went above and beyond to help me, and he will do the same for you. Study for the tests, they are HARD. 11/10.

Don't feel discouraged, I had A&P 2 as well with this course and managed to do well on both classes. He is an amazing professor, he cares and will explain to you any questions you have. Be sure to study outside of class, exams come quickly so don't waste your time. You will do great, this class will be a breeze if you use your resources. Good luck
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Was terrified of taking chem since I was not that good in high school, but he made it doable. As long as you attend lectures and actively pay attention and participate, it isn't too bad. He often tries to make jokes in order to lift spirits but beware if he catches you talking to your peers while he is teaching, he will call you out!!

Professor Tanizaki is a good teacher, but his teaching methods are bizarre. If you don't do pre-class readings you won't have a clue what's going on in his class, which is really time consuming, since there are 10 videos to watch before every class. Attendance is mandatory and your grade is effected if you miss even a single week of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Tanizaki is an ok professor. He provides an outline of notes to guide you during lecture. However, for you to understand the material, you HAVE to do the pre-class reading and watch the pre-class videos to understand the lecture at all. Without it, it's very hard to comprehend. The course overall is very hard. No drops for tests and homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Tankizaki is an extremely talented lecturer, and I believe this is one of the sole reasons I received a high grade in the class. In every lecture, he supplies typed-out notes that go along with the lecture. The given handouts are useful for students just coming out of high school and not used to attending college lectures.

has thick accent, sometimes he doesn't even understand what the students ask, most of his answers are it's in the book, I dont get what you say,....? Had to do a quiz before each lecture. Attendance is for extra credit. Good with emails. Barely get anything from his lectures. If you need to take chem1441, crowell is a better choice

I took this class over the summer so I was a 5 week course. The class was very fast pace but Professor Tanizaki made it really fun and easy to follow. As long as you watch his pre-lecture (which are only usually like 2-10min) you will be fine. There was 5 MC in-person exams, but your grade is solely dependent on them.

This class is honestly pretty hard, I see he is very understanding with his in person classes but his online he doesn't give us a chance to take unlimited practice tests or even have a chance to raise our grade and even the no rounding policy is ridiculous

This class is easier than other people are saying it is. Tanizaki is a great lecturer, and very engaging. Make sure you are completely clear on the concepts in the textbook and work through the problems and you will do fine. This is probably the easiest of all of the natural sciences and has the least amount of memorization.

The more you study the more poor grade you get. No teacher to student interaction expect you to everything before coming to class, then wondering why you are a student to learn. He does not care how much effort you put and even if you are sick he does not care. Every of his question you will spend tons of hours to calculate yet you can't finish his

This class is not a measure of your knowledge of chemistry. This class is not a measure of your ability to learn chemistry. No, your knowledge of chemistry has nearly zero affect on your ability to perform in this class. The only things you need are patience and attention to asinine levels of detail. Abandon hope, all ye who enter here.

I took Professor Tanizaki during Summer I and his class was probably the easiest science class I've taken so far. His exams are not hard as long as you read his textbook and review the practice exam. He gave participation points during class, which helped boost my grade. Practice Exams had no LBD and unlimited attempts.

Tanizaki provides preclass lesson videos that are really helpful. I took the five-week summer session so we had an exam basically every week. The exams were 25 questions and you had 50min (in person). Tanizaki is a good professor that keeps long lectures interesting. This course does go by fast but it is manageable.Just don't slack off on the notes

How this professor grades your test is that if the average test score is 50%, you will not pass if you are not in the 10-15% top scores. It means that he does not curve to the proper distribution of the average grade of an exam. Is it fair? No, because that means 85 to 90% of the people in the distribution of that exam technically failed.
I am unsure why people dislike him. He is a great professor and provides many resources to get a good grade in the class. The only thing I wish he did was to offer extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is the worst experience I have ever had with a class, I had a 3.8 GPA up until this point. He was incredibly rude, I tried to ask help from him multiple times and he would act as if I was a nuisance. I loved Chemistry in high school, but this Professor quickly changed that. If you have the option- take this class at another school!

TAKE HIM confused on why people don't like him. He teaches well, reviews the practice exams which are almost exactly like the exams. His Texbook helps a lot while listening to lecture he covers everything you need to know. He also goes over things most people get confused with so it makes it 10x easier to understand the material. He is so nice.

He expects you to have mastered chem 1. He also expects you to read everything before you go to class, so in lecture, he is not really teaching it, but reviewing it as if you know exactly what he is talking about. He calls you out loudly when you are confused. He does not show you the math problems by hand. There are 5 exams and they are hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Don't listen to the negative reviews on here. Professor Tanizaki is very kind and explains the material very well in class. If you want to do well, you will need to go to lecture, read the material, and do the end of chapter questions!! Just put in the effort. The chemistry tutoring clinic was also very helpful for any further explanation I needed.

rude, judgemental, and knows the chokehold he has on the nursing students (we have to take his class). taking his class was the worst decision of my life. pls. do. not. take. this. class. you've. been. warned.

i would rather talk to my dad that left my family when i was 9 for another family, than take this class again. tanizaki is this most unsympathetic man i have ever encountered. the man doesn't teach or listen to his students, and you have to know the unit like the back of your hand to do decent on his exams. if i saw him on campus id prob cry
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not sure why other people say he doesn't teach what was on the exams. His class was very well organized and gave plenty of review materials. If you want to do good in his class take notes on pre-lecture videos, go to class, and use your practice exam and homework assignments to review before an exam and you will get at least a B.

His lectures are really boring, but if you participate he gives you extra points that can be added to either a hw grade or exam grade depending on the how many points you have. Personally I didn't learn much from the lectures but the online book was really helpful. If you have no previous background in chem, I wouldn't recommend taking him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: AGREE with comment below 100%: "WORST instructor! He NEVER assisted, NEVER taught, NEVER answered any questions. Even during his open "office" hours, he was NEVER willing to assist." That was on point!! Ask a question, get a one-word response, if that. No multiple choice on quiz/test so you better make sure everything is perfect or it will be wrong

When emailing questions over problems for clarity, he does not give you an answer, instead, he makes you go try to search it on your own. Isn't the job of a professor supposed to teach? Secondly, he's very dry. Lastly, after studying all of the materials from previous test and practice exams, the final exam was nothing like it?

WORST instructor I have ever had! Yes, Chemistry is a tough class, especially being online. He NEVER assisted, NEVER taught, NEVER answered any questions. Even during his open "office" hours, he was NEVER willing to assist. When asking for assistance, the only answer I would get from him is "Read the chapter", "Do the homework". Do NOT recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This was my second time taking this class. He is a great professor, I believed that when I took him last semester and I still believe it. To some he may come off as rude but imagine having over 200 students asking you the same question that can be found in the syllabus and/or announcements. Show up, read, and rewatch lectures and you'll do fine!

Professor Tanizaki is a really good professor. Some of the topics are difficult, but that should be expected from any course that isn't just a throwaway class. He gives you tons of study guides throughout the semester and dedicates a few lectures to reviewing. Put in the time, GO TO LECTURE, read the material before class, and you should be good.

This was one of the most difficult classes I've ever taken. It is very fast paced. I like that he had everything organized in his modules and the short videos he posts are supplemental to the lectures and textbook. He also records his live lectures which was a great help to go back and watch when studying for exams. I think he is a great professor!

I took this class online and it was hard and stressful. if you are going to take this class, be prepared to teach yourself... Literally, his videos and books are not helpful and POINTLESS. we have HW on ALEKS which are very tedious ;his exams are hard and he does not give extra credit DO GREAT IN LAB it will boost lecture grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Honestly don't even show up to class and if you do bring a blanket and pillow because you will fall asleep. I have never watched so many youtube videos and studied so hard for a course to get a 28 on an exam. This course should only be allowed to take if you are valedictorian of a ivy league school. Exception: you have won a noble peace prize

Taking this class over the summer was the worst decision of my life, even worse than going back to my ex three times. Starting off with an exam every Monday that I ended up failing was a great way to start my week. Really does a lot for the confidence. I never felt so stupid and inadequate as a person as I did taking this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Literally wtf is this class. Great sweet man when he's not talking about chemistry, but this class literally sucked the life out of me and I would not want anyone to experience the hell of this course. You WILL have to retake this class and if you think you will pass, you won't. Drop the class if you can or better yet don't even enroll in it. :)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Class is taught by McGraw-Hill online homework system. Professor Tanazaki does lecture vids on topics that are 5 minutes long max which are useless. Be prepared to essentially teach yourself chemistry. That being said, an A is definitely attainable if you study and use resources available such as YouTube to help explain things.

To sum it up, the professor is very boring. Chem was a fun class in high school, now it is boring. He's monotone. Also, I emailed him a question, instead of answering it, he told me to watch the lecture videos.

worst prof at uta. i made an a in the class solely because i did chem 25/8. unless u r taking chem & chem only do not take his class. its not his teaching, its his attitude, and his lack of empathy for his students. he comes off as blunt and rude and its not engl being his sec language- hes just rude. do. not. take. his. class. uve. been warned.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I failed chemistry twice before taking him. Made an A with Tanizaki! Just study his text book and you will pass his exams! His lectures were supplemental for me whenever I needed more clarification on his textbook.

A hard class overall, especially for a 5 week. If taken in the summer, the pace is really fast and doesnt leave room for slacking off. If work is done diligently, the class is passable. The class is heavily weighted towards the 5 tests. This makes studying a lot outside of class essential.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Some people say that he provides extra credit, untrue for my class. He does not curve, round, or help in any sort of way. 1-1 meetings are useless as he doesn't provide any advice or information you'd like to know about the class. He does upload his lectures and some sample questions that seem like they don't even compare to the exam. hardest class

Tanizaki is one of the best natural science professors at UTA. He gives you everything you need to be successful for tests (sample test questions, practice problems etc.). He even went over similar test questions during his review sessions. As long as your diligent and organized you will get an A.

Dr. Tanizaki everything ready for you. There were practice tests and sample questions galore, as well as participation quizzes that sort of counted as attendance. Overall, the class is difficult but passable, but I wouldnt take it over the summer as a 5 week course.

Exams count for 65% while lab portion is 25%. If you are taking the 15 week course keep in mind that you will have to learn the material on your own, however there was a TA who was really helpful prepping for the exams. Do not take the lab portion for granted it can greatly bump up your grade. I will say that the last 2 exams were the hardest.

The class is definitely fast paced and not necessarily hard but the work from the LAB portion of the class is what makes it time consuming and a bit difficult. I studied min. 10-14 hours a week. The class consist of : 5 exams, 10 ez HW assignments on MHC, Lab, & ez ExtraCredit that can help at end! Lec Vids are to short, def. use Youtube aswell!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: TESTS ARE 65% OF YOUR GRADE, several 1-2 min lecture videos. THICK ACCENT. This class is intro, bio, and organic chem in one not an intro to chem for allied health. TAKE INTRO ALLIED HEALTH AT A JC and transfer for credit to this class. A lot of information from an instructer who is hard to understand and communicates ideas poorly.

While the course alone is pretty hard and is a lot of work he provides many helpful opportunities. Very understanding. Lenient. Offers lots of extra credit. Gives breaks in between tests giving you time to study and prepare for the next test. Homework actually helps you learn material. Great at communication with students.

This is the only class option for the BSN program so there are no other professors. While I'm sure Dr. Tanizaki is a nice guy, His lectures are lacking in every aspect. For an online class, a 3 min video with minimal explanation is unacceptable. Especially when you consider how much we are all paying for it! Get ready, because this class sucks....

The synchronous format was distracting because people were asking repetitive questions and the 50 minute lecture was wasted most days. Luckily, my chemistry from my previous college eventually transferred over and I was able to drop this course. Dr. Tanizaki is not a bad teacher, however this course shouldn't be taken online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I was very impressed how well professor Tanizaki teaches his lecture. I have taken many online classes before and I have never had a professor that puts a video together to explain his lecture in detail. He made it easy to understand and learn the material. I was very nervous about taking this class since it was online, but I am so glad I did.

Chemistry was the hardest class I have ever done. I actually had to get a tutor because I was failing miserably. This class involves a lot a numbers and math. I truly did appreciated the extra credit opportunity. Get ready to have this class consume your life. The chem lab experiments were pretty fun though.

Professor Tanizaki is a very sweet guy and tries his best to teach the hard material to his students. He records his lectures but make sure not to slack off on them because then you will get lost in the class. He doesn't give much homework but when he does he gives you unlimited attempts. I recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: This class may be much better if taken in a class room but online you are completely alone. The teacher doesn't offer any help in explaining problems and the coaches assigned do not answer unless you get lucky and get a good coach. There is extra credit available but if you bomb more than one test you will fail. Do some every day. It is not easy.

I took Professor Tanazaki in the summer. When a person does not understand a concept, he would spend extra time to make sure that student understands. His lectures are interactive and covers the homework/test material. Do not procrastinate in this class and you should have an A.

Building off the previous review but for attendance. He's not iffy a/b it, but it did count as a participation grade. We either had to be in lec while he live-streamed at any point or had to watch the recording before the end of the day. He usually put in the grade for attendance the following day. P.s exam grades were not immediately released.

Dr. Tanizaki is very caring. He'll make sure the student understands before moving on from a question. Chemistry is hard, even more so online, but I think he did his best to accommodate. He allowed extra credit opportunities and provided study guides for every chapter. He gave sample exam questions that actually looked like questions on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr Tanizaki condenses the material into small chunks and gives lots of practice problems. If you work on those until you know them, you'll do well on exams. Lots of easy extra credit. The topics in chemistry BUILD ON EACH OTHER, so make sure you understand the concepts early in the course, or you'll struggle more and more as the course goes on.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I'm taking this course for a requirement for my degree plan, this course is very difficult for me personally since I really don't understand the material. There are sample exams that are similar to the test, there is an a heavy homework load,which i find it unfair for just 10% of the overall grade. Same goes for labs

This was the best class I have ever taken. Dr. Tanizaki provides all the information you need to earn an A. It is on YOU to watch the lectures, take the notes, and read the textbook. He expects competence. Organic chemistry is hard and is not for the weak. Dr. Tanizaki however provides the information, you just have to be diligent.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Attend lectures and do the sample exam questions and you will pass! He is organized and clear about all his expectations.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Best professor! His lectures are really good and understandable if you attend. Chemistry is hard but he makes it easy. Really easy to pass if you do the work, attend lectures, study, and actually watch his pre/post-class videos.
Chemistry is a difficult subject, and this class is no exception. However, he tries to be as helpful as possible and answers questions during the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Tanizaki has managed to make Chemistry into an easy & understandable subject. His textbook helps a lot! Always review the pre-lecture videos and read the textbook before class, take notes and you'll do great. Attendance is extra credit & homework has unlimited attempts. Most of the class made As & Bs in the exams. Easiest science class I've taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the hardest classes to take, I still love this man tho. In order to pass, you must read the textbook and attend his lectures. He also gives post and pre videos for the lecture to watch on your own. Hw is due 2 days before the test. 5 test. Gives a study sheet that tells us what to memorize. no comprehensive final. Lab is also a lot of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was so much harder than it needed to be. I've heard the other profs allowed extra credit, test corrections and curves. However, he doesn't believe in curves even after so many people failed. I don't even understand why it's so hard. This was my first class I had to drop. Just don't take him please. We're not even allowed a formula sheet

Hardest Class Ive ever taken. I have never withdrawn from a class before. I never could get a response from my coach. Took him 3 days to reply to my emails. For someone who chemistry doesn't come natural for, I would not recommend taking him, nor online. You will ultimately be teaching yourself chemistry. Grading criteria is ridiculous for online.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His exams are harder & theyre trick questions. Ive seen a sample exam from Rogers & it looked easier. Our class had over 100+ students & more than 1/2 failed the 1st two exams. I tried to protest a participation grade since he gave me a 0 & he threatened to send me to the dean. He didnt give me the grade since I wasnt in class long enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Take chem at TCC. Chem I should not be this ridiculous. He's not hard but UTA makes their chem classes unnecessarily more than they need to be. Made a B with him retook the next sem at TCC. Made an A there and learned more at TCC. Avoid prereqs at UTA. pls :)
