Tanizaki was the best chem professor! I took chem years ago and barely passed. I made an A in this class! You HAVE to work for your grade and attend class. He is very helpful with answering hw questions and reviewing exam mistakes. If you put in the work, you'll get an A. He wants his students to succeed.

This professor was a lot better than expected. Although his lectures are very long and he always goes over time they make understanding the concepts very easy. He gives more than enough information for you to study off of. I stopped attending lectures because I wanted to sleep in but I still made a 100.28. He gave extra credit for lecture attendanc

Chemistry is already a tough concept and he is a great professor, however, he is not the best choice you can make. He goes way too fast compared with the other professors and does not follow Rodger's lecture notes. He makes up his own tests (harder) and uses his own PPT. He has an accent, but it is not that bad. Take him if you want a challenge...

I took Tanizaki in a 5 week summer class. In saying this chemistry is already a tough concept to grasp. However, Tanizaki is a wonderful professor. His lectures are very informative as well his pre and post lesson videos. He also gives access to sample exam questions, which help a lot when it comes time for his exams.

Tanazaki is an incredibly good professor, who knows the material inside and out. I took his 5 week summer course, and although it was incredibly fast paced and heavy; he was consistent and very knowledgeable. He is also very kind when it comes to needing to work around certain needs (e.g a job, other classes, or emergencies). Definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Tanizaki is the BEST person I have ever taken Chem with. His lectures are easy to understand as long as you keep up with the reading. He gives extra credit with clicker questions and has review days before exams. I wish I could've finished his class in person (Corona). He made the transition easy for students to online as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I would not recommend this professor at all for chemistry. This is one of the hardest classes I've taken mainly because I pretty much have to teach myself the information. He is not good at explaining the material and doesn't seem to care if students do bad on the exams. Even after hours of studying I still struggled tremendously.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Come to class prepared and you'll do well. He makes it incredibly clear what material you should be familiar with before class. People who rate him poorly did not come to class prepared.

Tanizaki is nice person and you will thrive if your someone who already somewhat understands chem. The homeworks are SUPER EASY and you get like 4 attempts for each question. His has alot of clicker questions so you cant skip class. His test are only 25 questions and you have an hour, his test are based on textbook so my best advice READ TEXTBOOK!

He might be a good professor for an in-person class but taking this class online? I do NOT recommend. He wrote in his own textbook. Feels VERY incomplete! Most of what you see in the textbook is not on the test; so out of left field!! The vast majority of my learning came from Khan Academy and Youtube. He sends out stats after the tests, most fail!

Dr. Tanazaki is a very good lecturer, he gives lots of clicker questions, which count as attendance. His tests are harder though when compared to other professors. Got 2 B's, 1 C, and 1 A on his exams. I studied really hard and made an A on the departmental final (wasn't actually that bad). Lab is pretty tough, so be prepared.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Tanizaki is a good professor. He gives us so many resources to succeed in the class. All of the people leaving bad reviews just dont realize that its impossible to learn everything in lecture, you HAVE to spend time outside of class; its chem, its not easy. Lab is time consuming but do well and will help your lecture grade. Taking him for 1442

this professor expects you to learn on your own and be aware of the material come lecture. he gives lots of homework that only counts for about 10% of the overall grade. he has a strong accent that makes it hard to understand, don't ask questions or everyone including him will get confused. overall is the hardest teacher and course
just would not recommend taking this professor, its probably more beneficial to take chem at a community college rather than taking it at UTA

Tanizaki is a professor who's way of teaching is sort of flipped, he basically expects you to do the learning on your own and come day of the class you should be aware and know the material. Grading is horrible. You have a numerous amount of homework and it only counts for about 10% of your grade. Has a strong accent and is the only Chem professor.

If you're taking his Chem for Health Science Majors online, beware. Lectures consisted of an average of 15 minutes worth of video for each chapter. The text was a .pdf that is not well written. Homework was offered through the publisher and often had questions about material never covered in lecture and text. Be prepared to teach yourself.

I personally did not like this class, I did all the work and watched all the videos given and still would do poorly on the exams. He adds like 15 videos for each chapter and the exams would not reflect on the videos. our class average for the exams were always 60 or below. I would not recommend this teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is a good lecturer and really cares about his students. The class although was not the easiest. The labs are made harder by the TA's because of the intensive in class and out of class work. If you don't take the lab seriously you can fall really behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Tanizaki was great. He supplies enough material to prepare you for tests, the labs went along with lecture and actually helped me on the lecture tests. He seems like he really cares about people passing his class, unlike some other chemistry professors at UTA. Read his book and do his homework and there should be no problem in passing.

He is a brilliant professor. His class powerpoints follow the textbook chapters exactly, and his iClicker questions help him go over what majority of the class gets wrong. If you miss a day, youre going to have to read the chapter and practice on your own with online videos, or else youll continue to be lost as each chapter builds on one another.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took this class for 5 weeks summer session. This course is not an easy course. However, if you study hard, listen to the echo and write down the notes, then you will be fine in this class. There are two lecture homeworks and two labs report a week. I really like Dr. Tanizaki. I strongly recommend taking this professor's class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was okay for me. I used the study guides given to help me study for exams however a big problem I had was the professor never responded to any of my emails which I found odd since it is a 5 week course. Labs were also a bit tough, TAs took points off for little things. I definitely wish I had taken it at a Community college...
Great Professor. Use his resources!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This class was fairly easy to me. I got an A on 3 tests & a B on 2 tests. Each test was 25 questions & the final wasn't cumulative. Lab was the hardest part of this course for me but managed to get an 87 in lab. I would highly recommend reading the textbook & doing the practice problems to study. iClicker & homework were easy & bumped my grade up.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Course material wasn't too difficult, but he makes it a difficult class. He has a flipped classroom setting where basically you do all learning at home and only do practice problems in class. Nice guy but very fast paced, and not really a good instructor. Has a heavy accent and isn't thorough. I don't recommend him. Take any other professor.

Best professor I've had at UTA thus far. You can tell he really cares about his students success. He is very funny and make lecture interesting. Tests are very straight forward if you study well. Gives you supplemental videos over hard subjects and gives you lecture slides in advance. Also has his lectures recorded if you miss.

This is a science class so expect it to be hard. I took this class online and it can be manageable if you watch all of the lecture videos, take notes, and do the practice questions. He gives you one shot at extra credit and no excuses for late work. I feel like he does alot on his part to make sure all the information is there for you to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Get ready to learn on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: For reference, I am a 4.0 student. To get an A in this class the most important thing you can do is read the textbook before exams. The homework sometimes is helpful, you get multiple attempts. He does clicker questions in class, but you see them again on the exams. Use the exam study guides! BEWARE of lab. Tanizaki is the best professor I've had!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If online I STRONGLY suggest another professor. May be great in class but online theres no explanation, book and lecture has 1-2 examples and youll be on YouTube or other websites trying to teach yourself. Tests are different than review and homework. He emailed test stats after, most fail, doesnt seem to care though. Youve been warned!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Great professor! It's chemistry, so not the easiest class I've ever taken, but he does an excellent job. He has lots of office hours and is usually available to schedule times outside of them. He gives attendance grades that cannot be below a 93 if you show up. Love him, would gladly take him again even though I'll probably make a B.

Good professor, but English is his second language. He definitely cares about your success, and answers any questions. He is aware that he has an accent, and always makes sure his explanations make sense. Get ready for clicker questions. He offers 2 points on the semester if you complete HW1 a couple weeks before. 4 midterms, the lowest dropped.

Dr. Tanizaki is phenomenal, definitely would take him again if i had to. go to class everything he teaches during lecture will most likely be on the test. really down to earth guy and always willing to help. test arent too bad and the final replaces lowest score. as for homework 10 questions max per chapter (up to 3/4 chapters per exam)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This is the hardest class I've ever taken online. You receive a book, not a professor, so prepare to teach yourself Chemistry. I spent 30 hours a week on Youtube & studying just to get A in his class, no joke. Weekly exams are comprehension & nothing like the EoC's or h/w, so you need to know the material 110%. Lab isn't easy, coaches grade hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He assumes we know everything, and continues teaching every lecture without talking much about it. His homeworks are always way ahead of what he is teaching in the class, which makes everything more confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tanizaki sets us up for success. Go to class. Learn the class participation questions. Some (most) participation questions will appear on the exams. 25 question exams. Explains concepts thoroughly and slowly. Homework super easy. Labs are unpredictable but okay.

The textbook (he wrote it so its required and has few examples per concept) is different than the homework which is different than the review questions and the 10 question test is completely different than what is studied. Had to buy stuff for weekly labs and only used one time, not resourceful. 27 page Syllabus is used like a scavenger hunt.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: If flipped classroom works for you, then you will probably do okay in his class. If you don't, it will be a struggle to get through the semester. I loved CHEM 1441 with a different professor, but did not enjoy this class. He is a nice guy, but this class was difficult.
Really bad lecturer. I took this class and flunked, took another professor and got an A. This is NOT the chem professor for you!!

This class does not seem that hard, but the lack of direction and the amount of time it takes to get a response from the TA or the Academic Coach is crazy. The professor posts the test stats after the exams and you would think that he would wonder why so many people are doing poorly. I do not get the feeling that they care about the students.
He is a great professor. Take him!

Dr. Tanizaki is the first professor at UTA I truly love and respect. Not only he cares about his students, he really want us to do well and be successful. Ive seen numerous professors out here trying to give students doom days, but Tanizaki is different. Take him. You will not regret it. As for how to get an A, his reviews are super helpful.

I very much enjoyed the way this class was taught. Attendance is mandatory and this is done through iClicker questions, which are great prep for exams. He gives all materials necessary to do well, including helpful exam reviews and the textbook has good practice questions as well. Also has a good sense of humor, which helps get through lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Honestly one of the toughest science classes I have ever taken. I have made all A's in my science classes, but this was a hard class. You spend so much money buying the access code/textbook and i-clicker, but you still end up investing so much time in this class teaching yourself and struggling. Exams are hard. Save time and money, don't take.

I took a different professor for CHEM 1441 and took him for CHEM 1442 based on student feedback for CHEM 1441. He teaches by examples during class and has vague videos that you have to watch online. Studying for the test was less studying of the concepts and more of the practice problems he gave. Willing to help in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Tanizaki really wants you to learn. He loves lecturing, can be funny at times and tells you exactly what you need to know for the tests. I made 100's on all his tests. All I did was just read the textbook and study review questions. Chemistry is a hard subject and you have to be ready to put in work but it is doable.

Tanizaki is good/decent for chem 1441... NOT chem 1442. He teaches by concepts, you gotta do the extra work on your own. However, study your life away and you can make an A. I never paid attention in his class, but got an A. Just do as many practice problems as you possibly can. Made A's on all my tests except one. Used ICLICKER

Professor Tanizaki is super funny and nice, but his tests (particularly OChem - Exam 4) can be pretty difficult. Do the review problems from the textbook to prepare, begin studying two days in advance at least, and dont slack on the labs.

He is by far the WORST professor I've ever had! I've taken several science courses(made all A's) and I barely passed his. You have lecture videos, slide shows, homework, labs, and a test due EVERY week! I could understand if it was every other week like my other accelerated classes, but he gives you no time to even comprehend the material and study
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He's more specific in his lectures than other professors, but the entire class is taught from power-point slides. Attendance is 5% of grade. Some people complain he is hard to understand at first, but he really knows what he's talking about.

50% of your grade is 5 tests with the final test replacing your lowest test grade, other 50% comes from homework, lab, and iclicker attendance which I like because it can help boost your grade. Just rewatch lectures, read textbook, and do SI review/end of chapter questions and you should be prepared for the test. He' s clear on what he wants.

Hes a wonderful professor and is willing to help out students. Lectures are not boring, you do need a clicker as its a grade. Lab on the other hand sucks ! TA teach it and she wasn't very good at it. There was quiz everyday in lab. Oh and he wrote the book not the best written book but it suffice.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Super nice and friendly guy whose lectures are not boring. He's helpful and you can tell he's happy to be teaching. However, he uses the flipped classroom method where you watch his short videos before class and then lecture is mostly going over examples. If you don't watch his pre-class lesson vids, ur screwed. iClicker is participation grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This class is a difficult class. But if you come to class, understand the clicker questions Dr. Tanizaki provides and listen to his lecture you should do well. Lab on the other hand is very difficult. I am an A student and I am having trouble keeping a B in lab. Lecture is straight forward, but watch out for lab.

Tanizaki was recommended in CHEM 1441. This was a lie for 1442! His instructions are very unclear. His tests are incredibly difficult. Even if you understand the topic, the tests are easy to misunderstand. He gives extra data and trick questions on exams! Attendance is based on CORRECT answers given through clicker questions. ALEKS is required.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: You get a book and Homework. You do not get an instructor. Whether you need help understanding a concept or you just need clarification what a question means, you will not get a real answer. This is contrary to the reviews I read on him, and is felt not only by me, but my classmates, as well.

Professor Tanizaki is great. He actually cares whether you understand the subject matter or not. I'm taking him again next semester for chem 1442. The tests are definitely challenging, but its pretty easy to be prepared for them. He posts practice tests and questions from those as well as the book are similar to the ones on the test.

Great professor who really cares about the students! Has an accent but is not hard to understand. Be sure to read the textbook along with lecture in order to really understand the material as sometimes the lectures aren't sufficient. Lectures are great and funny. Overall a hard class but if you put in the work you will get the results you want.

Tanizaki's class consists of 5 exams (final included), they're all weighed equally, 55% total. First 3 exams are high school review, but you need to watch out for the last two (including the final). To study I read the book, reviewed the slides, and rewatched lectures through echo. Personally, the lab was more challenging, so watch out for lab.

Uses clicker and ALEKS. Clicker can be kinda stressful but it helps your grade. ALEKS takes up alot of time. However, tanizaki usually includes 1-3 clicker questions on every test. Make sure to PRACTICE the questions in Rodger's book, as well as the reviews Tanizaki posts, which are similar to the tests. I self study using this method. Lab is hard
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: The BEST & ONLY professor for nursing students! I studied a week before the exam, sometimes 3 days before & made all As on every exam (100 on ochem). As long as you study, youll be fine. Rewatch the lectures for extra help & take notes. Never went to office hours, honestly didnt need it. Youll love him. Hes the absolute best professor ever!

this professor does an exellent job of allowing you as many chances to pass this course. He drops several test grades and gives you as many options to get 100 on each homework assignment. HOWEVER.... this is a hard class. He wrote the book and it is not very well written. I had to learn everything from youtube. Tyler Dewitt is the reason I got a B

The professor really makes you learn this information. He gives good feedback. He drops the lower test grade and each section as well as homework. Labs are tough. You will spend some money outside on this course besides paying for it. Get ready to work but earn your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The subject matter is not easy, but I appreciate that he gives it in bite-sized pieces (tests) each week. It is important that you understand as you go because the material builds on itself. He gives grace in dropping the lowest scores in each category which is helpful. His class is a lot of work, but doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's a super cool and awesome professor, the material is just hard, but he works really hard to make sure you understand it. Lab is harder than lecture in my opinion. and your final (non-cumulative) replaces your lowest lecture exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: His test don't match the book examples, he is demotivating, and attendance is part of the grade so you have to sit thru lectures when you know he doesn't want you there, but if he "likes" you, you're good, not sure what type of student he likes... hmm, I'll never take him again, just passed his class and never look back, also he deserves no credit
Dr. Tanizaki is great. He very much wants you to succeed and gives you every chance to do so. No need to worry about surprises on the exams, because he tells you exactly what you need to study for.

He is a good professor who makes it clear what you need to know, took him for 1451 over the 5 week summer course and it was a lot of work but if you do what you need to do he is fair and you can get an A. participation grade in class boosted my grade, homework site isnt very helpful. lots of errors in the textbook

Best Professor I've had so far. He is very calm and relaxed, his lectures are very clear, and he made me fall in love with chemistry. Although it was only general chemistry, the way he taught was very exciting to me. Do the practice problems and you'll do just fine.

This class and professor is mediocre. I am at UTA for my second degree so I know what a good professor is. This class seems unorganized, but if you have to take it just get it done, but be ready to not take so many classes with this one or get a tutor to help stay organized. His syllabus is 21 pages long. Please, rewrite it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I was very frustrated with this course. You are required to purchase this book and use an online document to check for errors. The book was full of errors, including sample problem answers! The tests don't always reflect the book or short lectures. Multiple trick questions on tests. I made an A because of Youtube videos. Avoid if possible.

This was my first experience with a poorly structured course. The material given did not align with the tests. The material was published by Dr. Tanizaki and was difficult to comprehend. I took an equivalent course at another college and achieved an A after dropping late for a W. Enough students dropped this course that UTA should issue refunds.

Dr. Tanizaki makes this hell of a course a lot easier. Four different types of chemistry combined into one course.   The lab, however is a pain. Every pre/post lab I submitted was more than quality work, but due to poor grading skills and explanations of the lab TA, i suffered a bad grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I've never been a science person. The textbook's very understandable. Study the chapter questions, class participation questions & the review and you'll do well. Review is perfect. He's funny and patient. You have to study because it's difficult material but he's an excellent professor and is always sharing extra material to make learning easier
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Tanizaki. He is an excellent lecturer and does a great job of explaining the material in a way that is easy to understand. This is not a blowoff class, but if you put in the work, go to class and study, you will get an A.

Dr. Tanizaki structured this class very well and gives generous extra credit so if you are complaining and/or did not do well it is course it is from an absolute lack of effort. His book lines up everything you need to know for the exams. Lab assignments are easy and well structured. The discussion forums are really helpful for lab assignments.

I took this class for BSN pre req online. This class is pretty difficult and you will mostly be teaching yourself chemistry. Chemistry is generally a tough subject for many people, taking it online is no different. There are tests every week, homework and lab every week as well. I received an A in the class, it can be done.

I cannot believe I paid over $800.00 (tuition, stupid textbook, lab kit) to take this stupid class! UTA needs to refund some of our money for this class. The errors in the textbook are more than plenty. UTA should be embarrassed!  How can a textbook like this one can pass through the approval process is beyond me!! SHAME, SHAME, SHAME on you UTA!!!

Horrible! I suffer PTSD because of this class. So much inconsistency, many errors in textbook, vague answers in email replies, you are on your own for this class. If I knew then what I know now, I would not have pursued my BSN from UT Arlington, no kidding. 30 min timed, 10 question exam due every Friday. The online HW is even worse!

Believe me when I say if you can take this course somewhere else then do so. The ebook is full of EDUCATIONAL and grammatical ERROS. Exams weekly and very difficult. Little to no responses from the professor. I only enrolled in the course because of  "good reviews" from RMP. (Current Grade  80.1) That is with extra credit.  Lab is not so bad.

This class is extremely hard.  You will basically teach yourself chemistry.   The book is minimal help.  I felt like I understood the concepts, but then when it came to the tests he had problems on the test that were not even in the book or homework.  The problems in the book are simple, whereas the test problems are advanced.  Lab is also hard!

I LOVEEE Tanizaki. He is  a great professor and truly cares. Anytime you need some additional help you can go to his office hours were he is more than eilling to help you understand. Also Aleks and Ickicker helps boost your grades!! Attendance mandatory bc of iclicker. Funny guy and enjoyed his class. Lecture is way better than the lab portion.

I've never felt so stupid in my whole life. I believe professors can make the class understandable, but I also believe they can make it difficult. I've had both. This one, he sets you up for failure. I took this class 2 years ago at the junior college and made an A. This class, forget it! Most difficult class so far. The rest will be cakewalks!

He is author of textbook and it has many errors. The pre-lab data covers the material but the actual lab problems are not covered in the pre-lab. You have to figure it out yourself. Everything is tweaked so that you can not research on the internet for help in solving problems. If I knew then what I know now, I would not have chosen UTA for my BSN.

Do not take this class online! There is no support and you will teach yourself. I feel like a battered spouse. This class takes away your confidence, breaks you down, makes you second guess EVERYTHING, and destroys your self-worth. Concepts learned are easy enough, but on the test, it is advanced concepts you never covered in lecture videos or HW.

Took this class online. The book and examples in it are not helpful at all because they are oversimplified and not a true representation of what is used on the tests. The lab is graded extremely critically so if you do not do well on that portion on the class then you will not pass. You must buy HIS book from the bookstore.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Tanizaki is a great Chemistry professor. His lectures attempted to relate some more abstract concepts to things we'd see everyday in a comical sense. He does incorporate the iclicker 2 in his lectures, so be aware that being in his class is a must, and he does use ALEKS for homework. Overall, he is a wonderful professor to take.

Professor Tanizaki is not a tough grader. He will tell you what will be in the exams. Book is a required to study for the exams. Attendance is important, if you miss you will receive a zero for class participation. It is not an easy A but if you study you will pass.

Professor Tanizaki was an amazing chemistry professor. Every week, a unit on the ALEKS is due for a homework grade. These, and the grades he takes for participation, are easy A's to boost your grade. He takes time to explain difficult concepts in multiple ways with humor. Reviews are posted for the exams and are nearly identical, so do them to pass
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very funny professor with amazing lectures. A lot of homework due online out of class, but it helps you learn. He has four midterm exams and a final. The final can replace your lowest midterm as well as being your final. Great at explaining in his lectures and answering questions. I highly recommend.

Dr. Tanizaki is probably the most friendly and understanding professor I've ever met. It is so easy to understand him. Do his reviews(every single problem) and truly understand it, you will get an  A guaranteed. I wish Dr. Tanizaki taught every chemistry class I have to take. I'm so thankful to have been his student.

Professor Tanizaki was like a dad to me even though he didn't even know my name. His accent is very understandable and his lectures were very easy to follow. I've never learned so much about chemistry in my whole life. I started out with an F the first 4 weeks then raised it to a nice B. Do Aleks!! It'll really help you. Tests are 20-25 questions.
iclicker is used so attendance is mandatory but dropped 6 grades, tests are moderate, sometimes the explanations can be confusing  but overall is a nice prof, gives good demonstrations in class.
The video lectures could have gone over more of the chapter, but the homework will follow the textbook chapters precisely.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Tanizaki is a very good professor. His lectures are concise and easy to understand, he is caring and funny, and his PowerPoints are very helpful. You will need to read the textbook for every exam, but it is easy to read. I recommend studying every day for this class because it is difficult.

I really enjoyed having him as my instructor.  He never really cracked a joke trying to be funny, but rather was just naturally funny while talking. love him. keep up with the online work and print out the ppts before going to lecture and you'll be fine, but you gotta put in work.  Heads up, has a JAPANESE ACCENT BUT ITS NOT DIFFICULT TO UNDERSTAND
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Tanizaki is one of those professors that truly cares about you and your grade.  Chem 1 is a difficult course, but his way of teaching makes it easy. My first exam grade was a 66, and on the third exam I got a 100. If that doesn't say something, than I don't know what will. He's hilarious and cute. You won't regret taking him.

HORRIBLE. If you take his online class, expect to have to fully teach yourself. He never provided enough info to teach the subject, the textbook (that of course, he wrote) had to be updated weekly because of incorrect information, and there were at least 3 times where I looked for help and was ignored. If you can, take this with someone else.

For the love of everything, please I beg you to PLEASE go to class and really listen to his lectures. I screwed around and got a C in the class when I probably could have gotten an A. The lecture exams are straight-forward. Just make sure to really pay attention to your lab section and read the labs beforehand. His lectures are easy, go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Summer class, most intense course I've ever taken. He did Iclikers everyday & had to do alot of hw every week, apart from lab reports and studying for the exams everyday. 5 exams total. He is an awesome professor. He really explained the concepts well and used models at times. I suggest going to the Chemistry Clinic b/c they are very helpful.

This professor is very good at taking this subject and breaking it down into easy material to learn. The tests aren't hard if you go to class and do the online homework. Extra credit is offered on the tests! I took this class in the summer and really enjoyed it.

Amazing Professor! Don't read the book--it is a waste of time. Make sure to go to class every day and print out the power points. Study the power points and now the concepts well. The homework it way harder than the tests but still study a lot! my lowest exam grade was an 86 and my highest was a 96 (final). Do well in lab, it can keep you from an A

I had a major change in my home life that severely affected my attendance. I kept track of the lectures online but he not only noticed my absences but asked for a meeting to make sure I was okay and if there was anything he could do to help with the class. He cares about the students that care. I've taken two courses from him, take his classes!!

He provides notes online that make the course very simple and easy to understand. Follow those closely and the textbook is completely unnecessary. While not a comedian, he has hilarious stories and analogies relevant to the content that makes it easy to remember specific concepts.

Dr. Tanizaki is one of the best Professor at UTA. You need to spend ample of time doing your HW and studying but if you work hard and study than the materials aren't difficult. Do the Hw, study the lecture notes and practice the review question. Worth taking him coz he explains the concept very clearly.

Overall I enjoyed this class. The home labs were a lot of fun. Online homework was extremely helpful. Course is very well laid out. It's definitely not easy, but if you work at it, it's not overly difficult.

Dr. Tanizaki has a way of explaining the material. Reading the text book was actually very helpful, especially the practice questions in it. 5 tests and he replaces the lowest test score with the final. Tests 1-3 were easy, 4 and 5 needs a lot of studying. Online homework is long but do-able and attendance is required.

He's an awesome professor and his exams are tricky but they're easy. if you know the material you'll make an A. The homeworks are alot so you better do them in time. lab was annoying but i still made an A in lab. His lectures were interesting and he jokes around sometimes. he will help you if you meet him during office hours.  Uses iclicker

Professor Tanazaki was a great professor. If i had to take him again, I would be glad to. His tests are straight forward if you look over the notes, the homework, and the practice exam he gives you. He doesn't throw try to throw you off. Easy A, if you just try. Very kind soul

He is an amazing professor! He knows that getting an A is what we strive for. Print out his power points and go to class everyday. Do the homework! Although, they are harder than the exams. Don't read the book, it is a waste of time. Go through the study guides with the power points and you will for sure get an A. Lab is hard so study a lot!!

Dr. Tanizaki is a great lecturer and he's pretty funny. He uploads all his power points and provides practice questions throughout every lecture and they are so helpful, so go back and review them. Tests aren't too bad, but you need to study and do your homework to do well. I would take him again.

4 exams, 1 final (lowest dropped, not including final); 30 MC q's, relatively straightforward, some tricky q's. Very resourceful: online ppts, recorded lectures, study guides, sample exams (similar to exams taken). LOTS of homework (ALEKS system). Also uses iClicker 2 system (very helpful). Fair exams, so fair grade. TAKE HIM! He makes CHEM easy!

He's a nice teacher and his tests a relatively straight forward. Just make sure to review things before class. I also recommend going to SI and before an exam printing out the practice tests. I found the class pretty interesting at times and very confusing at others. Sometimes you just have to tell him you don't understand or you'll be lost.

Tanizaki is an amazing lecturer, tests are challenging but doable. My only complaint is lab. Extremely unorganized. Sometimes you have lab before you cover the lab material in lecture, so it can be confusing. Lab grade almost kept me from getting an A. Only the last two exams were hard. OChem material is not hard, but trick questions on exam!

A very helpful professor. He explains the materials in detail, step by step, to make sure you understand them. You have to do homework every week. Aleks is a very helpful learning system.  You have to attend the class in order to earn the participation grade.

does a great job at making you understand the material. Has practive Qs during class to make sure everyone understands. Copy down practice questions, makesure to participate, study your notes, and always ask questions in lab. Dont be scared of lab teacher, you only have to deal with them once .Tanisaki wants his students to pass and remember!
Don't take Tanizaki if you dont have to. It was very difficult for me to not fail especially with lab.

Excellent professor! He explains the material clearly, covers everything on the test, and is very enthusiastic and funny when he teaches. His test reviews are very similar to the exams. His lectures were informative and interesting, I never skipped a class. Easy A if you study the test reviews and actually try. I would absolutely take him again!
Very good at giving examples. Known for doing some minor experiments in class.

Tanizaki is a great professor! This was a class I look forward coming to every other day! Pay attention in lectures! He really goes out of his way to make the concepts to be understood clearly. DO YOUR ALEKS!!! and always do the practice exam before the exam because it's very similar to the actual exam.

Dr. Tanizaki is definitely my favorite professor! He is very helpful, and I can tell that he truly wants his students to do well in his class. He also cracks a few jokes here and there, which makes class more fun.  As long as you attend his lectures, study, and do the ALEKS homework, you will succeed!

All throughout the semester, the course is really easy up until you get into unit 4 & 5 with organic chemistry and biochemistry. But, overall, I would recommend this professor to anyone. If you read the book and pay attention in class, you have potential to make an A, however you have to work for it.

Dr. Tanizaki is an exceptional lecturer. He is very consistent and helpful. He incorporates ALEKS very well into all his lectures and tests. I would recommend him for any chemistry lecture because of his clarity and easiness to understand and explain concepts. He also uploads his powerpoints after lectures.

This was honestly one of my favorite professors!!! He is very clear and provides many examples. I took this as a 5wk class during summer I 2015 and thought i was going to fail due to my weak chemistry background. His teaching style is honestly very unique and wonderful. Make sure you get assigned a good TA cause lab sucks. Exams aren't hard at all!

CHEM 1441 is a tough subject to start with, but Dr. Tanizaki tries his best to make it manageable. Do the homework (ALEKS), PRACTICE PRACTICE AND MORE PRACTICE, and do the practice exam he posts before every exam. If you work hard and spend ample time studying for this class, you will get at least a B.

Overall, pretty good professor. Sometimes his English is broken up, but not so badly that it's impossible to understand him. He'll occasionally show you the wrong way to do a problem, which might be confusing or helpful to some people. Homework was on ALEKS. I recommend completing as much of the pie as you possibly can before the semester begins.

Dr. Tanizaki is an amazing professor because he really tries to convey the information as easily and clear as possible. He is always willing to clarify topics and answer quesitons. His tests are not easy but they are not tricky. If you clearly understand the concepts and review over lecture notes, making an A is not impossible.

Dr. Tanizaki is a great lecturer. Not to sugar coat the class, the class is not easy, but the tests are straight forward and test if you understand the concepts. Great lectures and always gives chances to ask questions during class, it's a waste to skip his lectures. Uses aleks, so make sure to do that. Great professor overall.

Dr. Tanizaki is great! His lectures are pretty straight forward and he makes sure to pause and ask if anybody has any questions after every topic. If you do the sample exams he provides then you will do well on his exams. He uses the ALEKS program for homework, although it is VERY tedious it actually makes you learn the material.

Awesome class! He gives extra credit online and exams have clear cut study guides. If you do the study guides you will get an A. Also he replaces your lowest exam grade with your final which is awesome if you ever slack on an exam. He taught very well especially Organic Chemistry.

He is one of my favorite teachers at UTA.  He is very straight forward and simplifies chemistry for easy understanding. He's always there to help his students because he shows concerns and actually cares about his students.  If you study his lectures, his test should be very easy.  He doesn't try to trick you.  He's funny and nice!

Dr Tanizaki is an awesome professor! He is always there to help you and his lectures are great! As long as you take notes you know what is going to be on the tests! He gives you a review that he posts online and all the points on there are going to be on the tests. Online homework, and always write down his reviews at the beginning of class.

Dr. Tanizaki's class is no walk in the park. You have to earn an A if you want it. It is doable, yet will require significant amount of studying and work in order to succeed. He is very helpful and will gladly answer any questions you have. Some people don't like his accent but I really don't mind it, you can still understand him clearly.

His class wasn't easy by all means, but he gives everything you need in order to make an A. Prepare to spend many hours studying. There are plenty of exams and he replaces the lowest with your final exam grade, if it applies. He has an accent but it is not difficult to understand him. Ask questions because he will always have an answer.

He records his lecture and you can print off his lecture notes if you happen to miss a class.  You can earn up to 5 extra credit points towards your final grade.  He also replaces your lowest grade with your final exam if it benefits you.  I would definitely take his course again, if needed.  The only thing I found really annoying  was lab.

I loved his class! He puts his lecture online so you can review them before exams.A lot of homework, but it's not hard and you most likely will receive an A on it which will help your overall grade. You get extra credit & if you complete the learning objectives you will make an A on your exams. He gives you everything you need to get an A

This was my first class I have ever failed in my ENTIRE life. The lectures are boring and confusing. His accent is extremely hard to understand. I am really upset I have to take this class over with him as my teacher.

I'm not sure he knows exactly when class starts, since he begins lecturing 5 minutes before. If you're on time, you've already missed info. Homework is the worst... hours upon hours using Aleks. Tests are nothing like the homework. Textbook is online (Aleks) and is not user friendly. Buy a textbook if you take this class. I USED to like chemistry.

I have no idea if he has any say in the lab grading, but that was the worst part of his class. The tests are  pretty tricky to interpret and his explanation of things during lectures will usually force you to find help elsewhere. DO NOT SKIP ANY LECTURE (I didn't skip, but I feel bad for anyone who did).

Such a great professor! Has an accent but it's easy to pick up on what he's saying. Clearly explains when there is a question and is actually quite funny! I have never liked chemistry but he made it easier to understand. There are 5 tests including the final which is not cumulative. Lots of homework in each unit but it prepares you for tests.
It was an okay class, lectures were informative and he tell you everything you need to know

Answers all questions. Homework is very helpful. Utilize office hours if you have questions, he is very willing to explain. There are some things that need to be memorized, but he tells you what they are.

Took his 5-week chem for health sciences class this summer.  LOTS of online homework, although extremely helpful and the key to doing well on tests. Posts slides and notes online.  Take advantage of this!  Offers extra credit via optional bonus homework.  Always willing to pause lecture to explain something in detail.  Highly recommend!

I took this class last spring. Chemistry has never been a favorite, but I feel he did a good job explaining the material. He did have an accent, but it's easily understood if people are willing to make the effort. Labs were not too difficult, and thoroughly explained. I didn't do as well as I would have liked ( I got a B), but I would recommend him

I took this class online in Spring 2014 and I must say, its not that hard of a course. Closer towards the end of the course is when the lessons gets tougher but still passed. Answers emails with no problems and gives you extra credit. Mr. Tanizaki is a wonderful professor and I will recommend anyone to him.

I took this class during the summer as a five-week course and it wasn't as fast-paced as I expected. A lot of homework to complete online but offered a maximum of 5 points bonus for your overall grade. Extremely helpful teacher who likes to see the students succeed! Definitely would take this class again if I had to!

he takes attendance but I'm not sure what he does with it. very helpful. provides study guides and the chemistry reviews are very helpful as well. ALEKS is time consuming, and unfortunately not all the material from it is on the tests, but just go to lecture everyday and you'll be fine.

This is the absolute hardiest class I have ever had!I took this class online.It was a pre-req for Nursing. It is a lot of work, more than any class I have ever had. The material is hard to understand and some of his lecture material he posts online is not consistant with the hand outs he provides.DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE!!

Tanizaki made me understand Chem better than I ever have. He breaks up the material so that each test(there are 5) is focused on one subject. He replaces the final noncumulative exam grade with the lowest exam grade of the 5. His tests are based off his lectures and notes. There is a lot of homework, but there is bonus homework.

Professor Tanizaki is a great professor. The course is not easy, but that doesn't make him a bad teacher. He will help you if you go to his office and seek help. Take good notes, the tests are straight from the notes. And also, do all the homework and bonus homework, it really helps. Lab sucks.

I took this class as required for pre-nursing class. The teacher was not too bad. I dropped because I didn't put the time into the class. You will need to study and practice the problems. Teacher seems like a genuinely nice person. Tests were hard and lots of homework. Study!

HATE THIS CLASS. I never missed a single class, yet he still gave me a terrible grade. I was constantly studying, spent hundreds of dollars on tutoring, was constantly in the chem clinic, and still the worst class I had ever taken. DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS.

His accents is obstacle and translates into his writings on test/ lab questions.  His questioning was very unclear at times.  I consulted other older individuals whom were graduates of Chemistry degress and Pharmacist and they said the same.  Professor took my love for Chemistry away with all the homework assignments tooooo many!

Was a bit nervous about taking this class because I wasn't sure about the accent, but he's actually very clear. And really informative, knows his stuff. Very patient too, so if you have a question, ASK! He's great at breaking it down. Go to class for easy points, online homework helps with studying and helps your grade. Not an easy A but possible
Very good professor, you just can't ever slack off. I did my online homework consistently and studied hard for tests, yet I still made a D.

I love this professor! He is really smart and funny at the same time. Chemistry can be a boring subject but he made it enjoyable by him teaching it. Do the homework, use the book if you don't understand something, and study his power points!

A very challenging class. You have to put in a lot of work.  The homework is lengthy but it does help out a lot. he adds bonus points at the end so do the bonus.  stay on top of material. He is very helpful with answering emails.  Highly recommended

Tanizaki is a great professor. Just make sure you attend class and utilize ALL the resources he provides. His exams are straightforward & the homework is lengthy but extremely helpful -- he also includes bonus homeworks that can really help boost your grade. I suggest doing all of it if you can; it'll also help you learn the material more too!

Tanizaki is absolutely perfect. His notes, power points, and study guides for tests help you out so much. Though the homework does take awhile it helps you understand the material so much faster. If you have any questions, he tries his best to answer to answer. He replies to emails pretty fast. Take him! Put in the work and it's an easy A.

Excellent professor! He has an accent but he is completely understandable and has really great lectures. When you have questions he is nice and helpful. NONE of the chem classes are easy, but his is the most fair and enjoyable. I HIGHLY recommend him if you take 1441.

I took intro to Chem with him. You don't need to book.  Attemdance is manditory & if you leave early or disrupt class he will call you out! Awesome professor...he made everything so clear, but the homework on Mastering Chemistry is SOOOOOO LONG!!! I am taking another class with him, so I recommend him to all.

I feel like he confuses himself a lot. He would say he wasn't trying to confuse you on the exam, but when it came to the exams a lot of the answers would be VERY similar. But the EC helps on the homework. Do it all it can make the difference between an A and a B. I never used the book, but I felt pretty knowledgable from studying his notes.

You'll have to study on your own time, the book will help enormously! The homework helps a little bit. His 4 exams range from easy to moderately difficult. DON'T worry so much about the departmental final exam. It's pretty much the same as his exams. Previous exams don't help a lot, but you should do them. Understand concepts!

Hard course, but obtained a lot of knowledge. He is smart. There is a lot of material to learn. As long as you study, you should do fine. All assignments are online, exams in class. I recommend him, but just be ready to put in a lot of study time.

He truly cares about his students understanding of the subject. If you ask a question he will make sure you know the answer. Homework is online and helps a lot. 5 Exams are 65%. Lab is 25%. Homework is 10%. There is also extra credit homework which allows you to earn an extra 5 points on your average.
it was a great class his accent is very understandable and tests were not that bad i would recommend

He is a good teacher. Hard to understand sometimes. All lectures are recorded and that helped me alot. YOU MUST STUDY and do all the homework. Extra credit is built in with homework. Made a B and I earned everybit of it.

GREAT!!!! he sets you up for an A. Do all the hmwrk and bonus early! take old test and you should do good. His accent is funny and still understandable. He is helpful. Ask lab professor specifically what they want so you can make A's on lab report. Bonus is worth a good amount and he doesn't trick you I love him!!!!! BEST CHEM TEACHER...no tricks!

This class is set up for students to make an A. Attend class, print out and fill in notes, do homework (including bonuses- it can make a huge difference in your final grade),study notes before your test, and do ok in lab. Very willing to help (he's more helpful than the chem clinic)

This man has unlimited patience: he aims to answer every question you ask and responds to emails promptly. The class is a little hard, but there are recordings for every lecture. Unfortunately, his voice is really soothing and he dims the lights during lecture, so it's really hard to stay awake. The homework is also really tedious.

It was actually one of the easiest classes I have taken. His homework and notes are all you need to do well, Oh and attending class regularly. Print out the notes and bring them to class. The homework is a lot but you later realize why he gave so much. Very good class and easy A if you want it. The book is not needed!! he's amazing and funny

Print the notes. Do the practice problems from the book! That helps you go from a B to an A. He answers emails very quickly and is available if you need him. He understands that he has an accent and tries very hard to communicate clearly. Sit close because from time to time he has visuals. He does record the lectures which helps with studying.

Print out the lecture notes, do the online homework early, study the old tests that are availible online and you will be fine in the class. Somethings he says are a little hard to understand, but he always ends up making everything clear in the end. Liked the class. Be sure to get a good lab though.
He is a good teacher, some say that they cannot understand his accent but i can, even though i didnt do so well i loved his class

I have learned more than I thought I would. I took the course online and was nervous but he does give good notes and the slideshows are helpful. Labs are interesting and he puts effort into helping you through them. His exams are easy but I didn't do well on them. Homework is time-consuming and makes you feel confident but won't help on the exam.

A lot of time consuming homework that doesn't really benefit you or your grade, even though it should. Gives basic examples, but the tests are much more in depth. Not very helpful outside of class. If you're a visual person, this class will be much easier for you. He's funny and a nice guy. READ THE BOOK and work the problems in the text!
he's funny but he spends too much time on one thing and gets kind of confusing a tad. the amount of homework he gives is ridiculous but pretty nice guy

Print out his lecture notes, go to class, do the online homework AHEAD OF TIME, do the old exams before the tests. If you do all that, you'll do fine in this class. Also, tanizaki is so freaking adorable!!!!! I love him, so cute and funny.
He is an awesome teacher. Just study his notes and do the old exams and you will be fine.
He's very nice. Yet, I agree he makes things look harder than they actually are. Same material, different professors, make a difference. Take community Chem instead.

Guys Tanizaki's class is no joke, but if you are intelligent enough, he has actually set his class up perfectly for his students to make A's.  If you didn't make an A, you didn't go to all the classes, you didn't print out the lecture notes and fill them out, and you didn't do every homework assignment online.  The man is genius, pityyoucantseethat

Though his heart is in the right place, he talks for twenty minutes about very simple (not entirely related) topics. The problems he works in class and concepts he discusses are much simpler than what is included in tests or on homework. Also, his example problems are almost always riddled with mistakes.

I have never had a teacher who cared so much and put so much into the material he teaches.  He may find it difficult at times getting the information across due to language barriers but at least he doesn't overload you with information you will not be tested over. He's also very helpful anytime you go to him for help.
This class is really easy as long as you do your work and study. He makes the lectures easy to understand. If you put in the effort you can easily make an A.

The most traumatic class I've ever taken (not to be said lightly) I'm an A student and had to drop this class. He really knows Chem but trying to get it across to students not his strong suit. Over 3/4 of his class dropped. Yes, I studied ALOT and attended every class. He didn't use the book and didnt explain things well. Would NOT recommend!
Horrible teacher, he knows material very well but can not explain it well, most of time it was students in class correcting him. Tests are easy, homework sucks.

He knows the material he is teaching. His style of teaching is very straight forward. Rogers tends to repeat a lot of the important concepts you have to remember or concepts from the past; helped me alot. Tanizaki doesn't do this as much. Can be hard to follow at times. You have to study hard and read the textbook to make a good grade in this class

Excellent professor. The best at UTA. He knows his material well and explains it in a very clear way. He has no intention of tricking his students like other profs. Also, the students that don't do well don't like him  because they did not study on their own. In any class you need to supplement what was learned in class by studying at home.

This professor is the best. I made an A and all I did was review his notes which are very clear and detailed. I took Rogers the semester before last and failed because he goes way to fast and his tests are very tricky.
i enjoyed taking his class I would recommend him

He was my first professor at UTA. I was really nervous about taking the class at first but he made the material very easy to learn. He is funny and genuinely cares about his students understanding the material. He is organized and even gives out lecture notes! If you are a disciplined student then you will find him to be an amazing teacher.

Worse teacher ever! Knows material, but doesn't know how to get it across to where ALL the students understand the point. Only chem 1442 teacher to give hwk ONLINE..(waste of time). Worse person to ask advice from!

one of the few teachers I've had at UTA that actually seems to care about what he's teaching. He will stay after class to answer any question you have and really cares if you understand. Attend class as much as you can, and READ THE BOOK. Online hw is easy. Lab sucks. Tanizaki is funny and nice, and not hard to understand, even with the accent.

Dr. Tanizaki is an excellent teacher and an all-around good guy. His genuine interest in the materials he presents even in Non-Science Chem totally won me over even though I just took the class for the science credit. You must attend the lectures, but you'll enjoy them. And his accent is wonderful and pretty easy to get used to.

I'm still enrolled in this class right now. I now know that it's going to be a tough journey ahead. He is hard to understand, very unorganized during lectures, and does not explain the material well or clearly. He knows the material but he REALLY needs to figure out how to explain it better for us.

He really cares about his students understanding the material, which sometimes slows him down and puts him behind. I found him to be very helpful and highly reccomend taking him. The only downside to him falling behind is that you might not always understand what is going on in the lab, but the lab grades are "normalized" anyways.

Great teacher.  Has a noticeable Japanese accent, but it's not too bad.  Occasional humor will make you laugh.  Has a sense of humor, able to laugh at himself.  Midterms are multiple choice.  Go to class and be on time for quizzes, you should do ok.
He is a good teacher. He teaches really well and really tries to make his points clear.

I was in the nursing majors chem and it was really easy. I think ppl really over look the point he is trying to lecture so they get confused and say its hard. Maybe it's because i'm better at math/science but this class is not bad! he has online hw thats easy and bumps up your grade...just don't get Annie Archarya for your lab, SHE IS HORRIBLE.

What's on the reviews for the tests are worthless.  He is hard to understand & follow.  The class description at UTA guide should say = chem 1445 (Non-science Majors)This is a useless Chem calculations class with a hint of practical use. This will be a waste of your time and you will learn more about practical chemistry on the Discovery channel.

He is a very nice man and understandable, but this is NOT a course to take if you never had Chemistry. Don't be fooled by it saying for "Non-Chemistry Majors".The content is fun, but the test are mostly calculation,and there is no note card or help of any kind.You can't use a graphing calculator either.  Over all, I wish I would have dropped Chem.

Great Professor. Really cares if you are getting it or not. Do webassign and homework in back of chapters to prepare for test. Print off lecture outline from website and just fill in the blanks from his lecture slides. He laughs at himself when makes a mistake. Really cares and will take time to work with you outside of class.

Dr. T is awesome. He tries his best to teach the students. Yes he has a very slight accent, but that doesnt bar him from giving students a thorough knowledge of Chem2. N he tries to be funny too so you will totally enjoy the class. Tests are decent if you study and do the webassign problems.
Dr. T may not be as funny and energetic as Dr. Rogers, but he's pretty helpful in terms of answering questions. If you study hard and do well on the lab then you should be fine.

He is hard to understand but if you work with him he is really helpful. He knows alot about what he teaches. Overall if chemistry interest you then this is the class with the professor you wanna take if you are not a science major, and just need science credits. Easy class

He is a really nice guy. I would take more classes from him. He is friendly and genuine. He will do whatever he can to make sure you learn and he is very patient. Overall great professor. The tests are harder than the practice tests so study!

Chemistry is a hard class but Dr.T really helped me understand this topic. Dr. T rocks! Go to class, study hard, do all the homework, and ask him when you have trouble. If you work hard, you'll do fine. I would definately take a class from him again.

the class is hard, he is very black and white, no gray area. he doesnt curve at all. good thing is that his test are not the majority of your grade. he is also very helpful, he will make you understand no matter what it takes

a really really helpful guy. the class wasnt bad at all. ya he may have an accent, but he tries. his test questions usually come from notes and problems that we work in class. just go to class and do what you need to. review what you learned from that class as well

Dr T. is a GREAT teacher. Sure, he has an accent, but college students need to get used to that or move on. He knows what he's teaching although sometimes he does get lost. He will go out of his way to help you if you visit his office. His tests are not a surprise if you practice the tests online and study the problems he works out in class.

I had a hard time understanding him. He made a lot of mistakes working problems, very confusing. He seems like he really wants to help, but I didn't find him very good at explaining things. I wouldn't take him again. I don't feel I learn enough, and he doesn't really apply anything to real life examples or usefulness.
Took him first semester.  Couldn't understand a word!! Made mistakes and just confused you more when corrected!  Take Dr. Rogers got a B after withdrawing from Tanizaki w/ a 40.

He's not THAT bad. Most of his tests come from either his notes, or end of chapter problems. He is extremely helpful outside of class. Don't talk during class because he asks you if "everything's okay." I think that's a chem prof thing because Rogers does it as well...He teaches some chapters better than others. Go to his lecture and you'll be fine

Excellent professor. His style is a bit different from Rogers, but he's not bad. Really cares about making sure you understand the material. He is familiar with the way students think and their common mistakes and he gives you plenty of warning on trickier problems.

Dr. Tanizaki is a great professor! Many students have written otherwise, but do not listen to them. If you take copious notes, and study hard at home, you will get an A. Chemistry is a hard course, but Dr. Tanizaki provides you with all you need to get an A in the course. He has accommodating office hours as well(it would do you well to use them)

he really is NOT as bad as people say he is-- you CAN understand his accent if you have a mindset to WANT to understand,and if you go to his office hours, he really seems to want to explain, and does not mind stopping his own work to help you clarify. and he is patient, and not intimidating! he bases tests off of lecture notes and e.o.chap problems

Dr. T cares that his students understand chem.  Last sem was his 1st at UTA and he had some trouble with pacing, only because time he spent time trying to make sure students understood. Chem isn't a subject where the teacher can open your brain and pour info in, you have to study on your own. His accent isn't so bad you can't understand if you try.
difficult to understand, teaches straight from book, not a good chem teacher
Really hard to understand and also confuses himself. This is a hard subject and should be taught clearly! Do not take.

Heavy accent, hard to understand especially with such an involved subject. had to drop his class. every time i attended class, ther were less and less people. all my friends who didnt drop his class are now failing
Tanizaki did not know the material he was teaching in class and did not teach the little bit that he knew well enough.

Professor Venable was very engaging and hilarious throughout my semester. He definitely cracks jokes but it is a way for him to bond with his students. He truly cares for everyones success and wants you to partake in class (understandable because its a communicative class). I would totally take him again!

I had Professor Venable for the lab portion of BCOM 3360. The labs were short and we almost always had a guest lecturer. I feel like the lab content/(and speakers) wasn't based on the lecture portion of the class at all, but it was very easy for the few assignments we did have. Easy A as long as you watch you LinkedIn Learning videos.

Good professor, makes his best attempt to get everyone comfortable and participating. Attending class matters, he randomly opens up in class assignments and grades in class. Be prepared to read outloud and for him to show your work to the whole class. He gives good feedback.

Professor Venable does make uncomfortable remarks about one's race, gender, or any noticeable physical disabilities one might have, if you can stomach that, I reccomend taking this class. Many Smartbooks, 2 major exams that will be easy if you've done the Smartbooks, one major year-end project in which you will create and present a business plan.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Venable's class was easy to pass but hard to make the perfect A. He is very nitty gritty and opinionated on our work when it comes to taking off points. Some things he says during lecture can be questionable, but he knows what he's talking about when it comes to business communication. Get ready for Linkedin Assignments though!

Venable is a pretty easy professor. He is a tough grader, which doesn't match his personality. He makes jokes that can be rude, but it is usually in good fun. He will also make you stand up and speak, though that isn't too bad.

I really liked this professor he is a professor that you can tell cares about his students , and that he knows what he talks about !! He is really cool, the crucial part of this class is doing good in the assignments and your LinkedIn badge(start early and get it out the way) He grades based on quality and will give you feedback for improvement.
His lab is easy just turn in your work on time. Make sure to do the linkedin certificates. Attendance is part of you grade.

Weekly smartbooks with over 60 concepts taking abt 2hrs each, a couple of essays, and extra credit every once in a while in class. He is a harsh grader on every essay. One midterm online no lockdown browser and the final is a marketing business proposal which is a major grade. No late work accepted

This is supposed to be an easy class but he makes it harder than an ACTUAL hard class. The average grade on every assignment was a D!!!! He makes racist, sexist, and predatory jokes that are NOT funny. He does not respond well to missing class for emergencies. NO PHONES. He is also the type of teacher who won't round up your final grade. Good Luck.

Took this as my BCOM 3360 lab. Attendance was required for a grade. Most classes featured presentations from outside speakers. There were several LinkedIn Learning assignments, some lasting over an hour. Overall easy grade

Honestly one of the best professors I have taken. I am a more outgoing person so when it came to this class it didn't even feel like I was going to class. The smart books for the class can be annoying but it evens out considering the projects are easy and theirs only one midterm. Highly recommend if you're an outgoing person.

He's alright, I would recommend taking him. The class itself is easy if you show up. There's only 1 exam and almost everyone got an A. He does grade tough on important assignments, but he gives PLENTY of bonus assignments. If you're afraid of public speaking he will make it easier for you. Only con- he can sometimes say things that are out of line.

Took him for BCOM lab. There was a sign in sheet each lab. Honestly don't know if I like him as a professor but the lab was easy for the most part. Lots of guest speakers that were sometimes interesting to hear from. He does call on people and makes jokes that can rub people the wrong way.

Honestly he's a lowkey racist, he tried to hide that under little quips and jokes but at the end of the day he's quick with making little micro aggressive jokes that nobody puts or says anything to, so feel free to take his class if you're comfortable being on the receiving end of that take him. But on the bright side his class is easy

He is very racist but tries to hide it under little jokes and quips that flys under the radar. He is quick to make little micro aggressive jokes that nobody calls out so if you're comfortable with being on the receiving end of that take his class. On the bright side it's and easy class

He was an okay professor, but if you dislike public speaking do not take this class, he has the tendency to call out students who are late or who are quiet. Will make you speak publicly in front of the class randomly. He does not respond well to make-ups or missing class for emergencies. Is very strict on attendance. No electronics allowed.

Take this professor if you hate public speaking. He will make you to like it. Genuinely enjoyed this class. He got tougher on grading but still grades fairly,  although he does copy/paste his feedback on assignment sometimes. Pair this lecture with Buckman for lab and the workload will be manageable.

He is a pretty good professor, makes sure everyone is engaged and he is committed to bringing everyone out of their shells. Only has one midterm which is open-note and a final presentation that you can submit as a video on Canvas. Can be a hard grader at times but he usually gives you an opportunity to resubmit your assignment for a higher grade.

He is a great professor; he loves to keep everyone engaged especially at introverts

So, introverts beware! he will call on you no matter how invisible you look.

He gives only one midterm exam and its open note and open book, no lockdown browser and you can take at home, he has a video presentation, very simple and easy

you will not regret it!

He mentioned how his upper authority told him to grade harder, so he definitely did. He no longer is an easy A professor. Instead, you really have to put the work in. I managed to get an A, but I put so much effort into this class than I did to others. He does take attendance everyday which I think is the "extra credit". Answers emails fast!
Tough grader on assignments and is very unprofessional to students. I am glad that this course is over.

I had Professor Venable for BCOM lab and he treated us more as friends than students, he joked around most of the class and would end class pretty early. He is extremely laid back and all we had to do was complete LinkedIn Learning activities. Take him for an easy A as long as you show up and sign the sign-in sheet

Very easy for lab, most grades are from in-class activities, so you do have to be present. I could tell he likes to joke around, but mostly just comes across as a jerk. Don't take his remarks personally, but it's just unprofessional in my opinion. I'd recommend him for an easy lab during a busy semester paired with Dr.U for lecture.
Easy going, and fun. He will make fun you and force you to participate. But the class is easy, just online homework were everything is on quizlet.  take him and chin le for lab and you will get an A

BCOM is a very easy class with Venable. His class has only 1 exam, which is online and open book/note, and a business project that takes up the last month of class. Take him for lecture and Chien Le for lab if you want an easy A.

Professor Venable is one of the coolest professors in UTA, his class is pretty easy, one midterm which is an online and open book, one major business plan which is divided into four parts, and the final is a video presentation of the plan you made, he gives a lot of chances to make your grade better, he jokes a lot so don't take it personally.
Took him for BCOM 3360. Very interactive class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He seems a bit scary at first but you get used to him. Class is very easy 10 hw online, 1 midterm open book and online, and a business plan broken down into 4 parts. The last part is a video which requires you to turn it in early or you get a zero.Very lenient with deadlines. Also gives extra credit. Introverts be aware he makes you talk in class.
Great!! 5 projects but they are not hard. Lecture can be very boring but he tries to make it fun. Great class. introverts beware he will make you talk FYI.

He will call you out in class and will grade your assignments in class in front of everyone. He is pretty lenient with deadlines throughout the semester except for the final assignments. Submit the final before the deadline or he won't accept it, even if there was a technical error. 1 midterm exam and 1 major business plan.

Professor Venable may came off strong and you might even be fearful of him at times. Rest assured he is a big ol teddy bear who really cares about his students. SPEAK UP FOR YOURSELF he will listen. Be prepared for surprise activities when you come to class.

actual work is pretty easy, big business plan broken up into parts and worth a lot. attendance is extra credit. late work accepted. one test, open notes. makes u talk in front of the class a lot & likes to poke fun. he can def come on very strong. the whole class kinda dog piled on him on how he's a jerk & he took it well. it was better after that

I only had him for the lab and my experience with him wasn't too bad. He does make some comments that can come across the wrong way, but he doesn't mean it. I guess that's his version of joking around. The lab is easy, just show up and do the stuff and you'll pass. The lab is pass or fail and only once a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Only a handful of assignments.  Expects participation in class discussions.  You do a marketing presentation for final but it is developed all semester.  A few other assignments.  He makes comments sometimes that can be taken wrong by some if he is not careful.  Don't take personal he means well. Accepts late work, no resubmissions.

He does lots of participation assignments so don't miss class! He provides lots of assistance in making sure you understand assignments.  Accepts late work but don't take advantage.  He does not allow resubmissions.  He does a VMOCK resume assignment.  A marketing plan that you submit multiple times for feedback.  Super easy and helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He responds to emails fast and gives out extra credit for those who show up to class. He means well but makes some crude comments. He likes to pick on the introverts so act confident in his class. The final project has SO many parts to it and its more related to marketing. Only one test for the summer class, which is a bonus. He's okay, not great.
