I am currently taking this course with Professor Venable. Summer classes are expected to have a lot of work, but he makes himself available for questions. He is more than willing to help you with any questions. He gives a lot of guidance on assignments during and after lecture.
Took him spring 22, he was cool but definitely a tough grader. 1 exam, online hw assignments, and 1 video presentation. As long as you put in effort, you should be fine.

Heavy, heavy workload for what the class is. You will spend hours outside of class on assignments based on common sense content that is mandatory to get credit.

He's not very friendly and very abrasive/rude.

This semester he is very strict on grading. The issue is that he doesn't give you a clear guideline on how he grades the assignments, thus most of my classmates barely get A's on their assignment. For an easy BCOM class, I wouldn't recommend taking him. 1 exam & 1 video assignments & other assignments that would require you to come to class.
Tough grader

Classes are engaging but doesn't really feel like a communications class rather than a marketing lite class. I think the projects given were literally recycled over from one of his marketing sections. Everything was super project and paper heavy. Expectations and grading aren't really clear. But no late assignments so that was nice.

Professor Venable is very funny in his lectures! If you participate in class discussions it makes understanding the material way easier. You are graded on quite a bit of things but none of it is too hard and he always works with you if you don't understand something or need some extra time.

His lectures are great; engaging and funny. Has sudden in-class assignments, so attend lectures. He is flexible with due dates if you ask him about it. Extra credits towards the end of sem. NOT CLEAR on grading criteria!! Overall, he is a great professor for BCOM, and its a refreshing class if you are from any other major.

Great professor. He makes the class interesting and likes to joke around. SmartBook assignments every week which are easy. He's pretty lenient on due dates for project based assignments. Only 1 exam that's easy and on canvas. He really wants to see quality work on the final project, which is a business plan and video presentation.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Held multiple positions prior to becoming a professor. This gives him some incredible insight to the real world, and helped a lot with his explanations of scenarios. Gives you everything you need early on, and continues to help with anything throughout the course. Strong leadership vibes, very personable.

Lectures weren't too bad. A little unclear on grading and assignments but he does his best to make sure you understand and uses class time to go over individual assignments and critiques. Super nice and does like interacting with students

Prof. Venable makes class interesting by having 90% of it open discussion. Very nice guy and likes to poke fun so, def. a cool Prof. Gives good feedback on assignments and is easily reachable. Some assignments have clearer instructions than others but take a class with him! HW was minimal and projects were a bigger thing than tests.

Very good and charismatic guy. As a lecturer, he likes to talk and crack jokes. He's definitely skilled at talking however the lectures are completely irrelevant to what we are being graded on. If you never show up and just do your assignments, you will pass easily. Tough grader on projects.

There is a single midterm and that is super easy. This class is mostly over developing a business plan and the final is recording your executive summary of an existing business. Due dates are flexible because he wants you to turn in your best work. He wants you to succeed and it shows through his class discussions. Would highly recommend it.
Very nice professor, grading method is different. BI-Weekly smartbook assignment, one mid-year, 5 small easy project, no final exam. Easy A.
Good prof. does very well to keep the class engaged and entertaining. However, tough grader when it comes to projects If you find a better prof. go with them instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He's so nice & hilarious! It was a great semester! I truly enjoyed his class & learned a lot from him! I'd 100% recommend him and take him again! Easy A's, helpful & accessible outside of class! Totally a wonderful professor!

Very engaging, personal, & kind. Cares greatly about students. Gives wonderful feedback on assignments. He lectures & will ask occasional questions; he enjoys interacting with students. He answers emails & questions, and he is very helpful. One of the kindest & most sincere men I have come across. I am grateful to have met him!

His lectures are not traditional and he sometimes gets off topic, but he lectures about real world issues. He assigns lots of writing assignments but they were interesting to me, not something that students are just doing to be doing. He does weekly quizzes online but nothing too hard and 3 exams. He assigns case studies and 1 for extra credit.

Venable really is a professor that all of the students like. Some mistake him being so cool for being a push over which isn't the case. There's only a small amount of assignments and a test. Everything is very straight forward and he'll help you as much as you need. You can't ask for more from a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: When I took him last semester I thought he was just alright, but after taking the next BSTAT I can finally see how good this guy is in comparison to the other BSTAT professors lol, MUCH better lecturer than the likes of MD Helal and he gave us proper test reviews that made sure we didnt have any surprises. If you see his name on the course take it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: Good class. Class is pretty straightforward: ignore the slides, he teaches straight from the textbook. Quizzes (mostly conceptual) were easy but other classmates struggled a little so depends on how well you studied. Exams got curved. Homeworks every chapter. Professor is easy to understand but only knows what's in the textbook. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It's a hit or miss. You might like him, you might not. I didn't. The quarter of my class that dropped this class prob didn't. And then the other 10-20% that failed prob didn't either. Attendance isn't mandatory and you might learn better just putting the topics in ChatGPT. Quizzes are hard, and exams are kind of the same but you get a cheat sheet.

This professor would mumble her way through class and completely trail off to play with her dog. She couldn't seem to keep ahold of her attention long enough to make it though the class for more that 10 minutes. She had trouble solving the math problems on her own, and would read the textbook to try to figure it out during class. She was unprepared

Although I received an A for her summer semester. This professor tended to be very nervous during lectures. She was a nice lady, but unfortunately, she made her course much more difficult than it should have been. I do not recommend her at all especially for those who are not good a math, it will be an ultimate nightmare for you. Pick somebody else

I have passed this class because of the mymathlab tutorials. This teacher is terrible when it comes to lectures and she always messes up every time. Luckily, I got an A because of mymathlab but I still do not recommend her and if you do, go in there to sign your name in the paper so you can get extra credits and walk out of the class like I did.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Has trouble solving some problems and will make mistakes. She will try to explain if you ask her but most of the time it will get you more confused. If you do the online homework and understand it then you will pass. she also drops some of your lower grades and uses attendance as extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment:
Graduate linear algebra is a very theoretical class. Dr. Vancliff is incredibly organized and knows her stuff. Be prepared to take notes, vibing it out is not an option. Her handwriting is perfect and she is very clear in her expectations.

She also goes the extra mile, providing tons of resources for understanding and even teaches study strategy.

Dr. Vancliff gives really good lectures and great feedback on exams. She assigns hw for practice, but it's not graded. The difficulty level of the class really depends on how much hw you get done. I barely did any and just barely managed to scrape an A (wouldn't recommend). In summary, she's great, you should take her class.

In her higher classes the material is all proof based, very few examples and lots of terminology to keep up with. She seems harsh at first but if you talk to her before or after class shes actually pretty down to earth.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is a really tough course, so the material will be a struggle in general. She has really great lectures and is able to communicate book material really nice. However, her tests are hard so make sure you study a LOT and know the material really well. The final replaces your lowest test grade.

Hw is from the book and isn't for a grade, but she uses hw problems and lecture problems for the tests. This class is confusing and I never really felt prepared for the tests except for the final. Your only grade is from the 4 tests you take. She doesn't mind staying after and answering questions you have, though! Study a lot if you want the A!

She really knows the material well, instead of just teaching procedure her class teaches you to think, which allows you to answer questions quickly. Time yourself as you go through her study sheet, which is very useful for the test. Kind and funny professor who wants her students to do well and learn the concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Grade was based off exams (all cumulative). Watch lectures thoroughly, do ALL suggested HW, and review questions to do well. Lectures would be extensive & she would have extra videos, but overall informative. Material is hard, but manageable. She is quite blunt, but honest. Testing policies were strict especially with time management.

Homeworks are not graded so it doesnt affect your grades. Exam are hard and not enough time is given. The whole class is graded over 4 exams. First exam is 12%, second exam 18%, third exam 32% and the fourth exam 38%.  When students ask for more time she tells you be learn faster and get used to it.

Exams were hard, especially in the online format she made them. Did not give us enough time to complete the exams. I studied very thoroughly but got a C on some of the exams because of how quickly she expected us to complete it. The entire class's exam averages were below passing, but she didn't give out curves and just told us to study better.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Awful. Couldn't understand anything, decided to watch youtube lectures instead which were 100x better. Youtube lectures use a lot of figures to demonstrate meaning. she doesn't use it at all. Looks at notes to teach frequently. Very nitpicking, If you ask something, better use proper words. Good for grades but you will not learn anything.

She knows her stuff and is OK in teaching. Must go to class, attendance will help in curving your grade. Tests are very difficult and related to homework but you might have to think creatively for particular questions in Tests. 3 Tests(12%, 24%, 38%), 1 final. Final score may replace lowest grade in one of the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She has a point to everything she does, when she says something she means it. A lot of people don't understand that. She can be very demanding but its obvious by her math skills that she knows what she is doing by asking so much. The classes she has taught are pretty difficult and she is being realistic about the difficulty of her classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is one of the harder linear teachers. She is crazy about attendance. She literally yells and harasses anyone who tries to leave early. This makes sense because her lectures are useless because she talks about so much theory that its ridiculous. If you love theory then take her class otherwise look for someone else. Her tests aren't too bad but

Dr. Vancliff is really passionate about teaching. She has very good lectures and going to class is worth it. Do not worry about the proofs she goes over. Take notes on lecture material. Reviews and HW help a lot for tests. Replaces lower mid term with Final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She knows the material well and her lectures are very interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's pretty good. Homework wasn't collected BUT tests are based off homework + review questions. TIP: Do every problem in the review and homework. Try to get a copy of an old exam because the format will be the same, but then again it's the same format as the review. Also show up to class, she'll be more friendly with curving u from an 89 to 90.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you are looking for nothing but theorems to explain Linear Alg, then this is your professor. Only takes grade from exams but will replace your lowest grade with the final if it is better. Good luck with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Vancliff was a wonderful professor. Has a slight English accent but I could understand her clearly. It was a difficult subject but during her availability in office hours she explained the subject clearly to me. I highly recommend her to everyone. 1 quiz, homework optional, 3 exams, and a final. Wonderful Professor!

Expectations are clear. Exams are fair. There are no surprises, as long as you do what is expected, namely the homework and reviews. I'd recommend her, but my guess is you will have difficulty finding an open seat. She's that good.

Dr. Vancliff is a very sweet lady who genuinely cares about her students. She is very strict though, and you have to respect her and her classroom rules. Her teaching is very thorough, but the book is the key to succeed. Unfortunately, her multiple choice tests means no extra credit. However, she's a very nice lady. I love her British accent.

Not a very hard course if you understand and do the homework, the tests come straight from her homework and uses some of the study guide questions as well, shes straight to the point in lectures and uses plenty of examples along with the theorems we have to learn in class
Very good class, tests not too hard if you do the homework and pay attention to her lectures, she will review a little before the test. Study guides help as well
Very good teacher, gets to the point of what we need to know for the class, her tests arent too hard as long as u study if you dont, you might not do so well

GREAT teacher! She definitely knows her stuff and is deeply involved in it. The book, I used alot, helped me work out the problems that I didn't know how to do. Lectures are mainly theorems and proofs so be ready for it. Don't run out of class early, because she will chase after you to come back. Use the study sheet that she puts online.
Great teacher! Go to her office!  If you are making an effort to understand she is much more helpful. Her class is extremely hard, but you come out with a huge knowledge of the subject
don't take this teacher...hard teacher
She will help you... just pay attention in class! :)

Prof.  Vancliff is a great teacher.  I took Honors Calculus I and II from her.  I would recommend her to anyone who needs to take Calculus.  She cares about the students and they are doing.  She wants her students to understand and pass the class.  Because of this she will get upset/frustrated at those who are not interested in learning Calculus.
No Comments

This professor is honestly one of the best professors I've had. His tests can be challenging since many questions come from the supplementary material and homework. However, if you take the time to truly understand the concepts, the exams shouldn't be a problem. The class only feels hard if you expect to pass without studying.
The most stressful class you'll come across. Doesn't give partial credit and goes too fast.
No sympathy, feels like you're talking to a robot
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor and well respected. He wants students to succeed and is willing to help if you attend office hours. He is a tough grader, so you must study lecture notes, homework, bonus problems, and supplementary material since they appear on exams. The class can be intimidating, but taking it at Dallas College is an option to save time and money
Overly hard for no reason.

He knows the material, but the class is overwhelming. Exams come from the problems we do, but there are so many that studying feels impossible. Nothing is narrowed down.

The workload is heavy with no study guides or direction. If you fall behind, you're in trouble. Overall, he explains well, but the class feels more like surviving than learning.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If your looking at reviews you dont really have a choice for this class or prof. This is a make or break class, my best advice is practice more than you think. Test come from examples in class and from practice. HWs are difficult, and bonuses are given randomly so show up to class. Honestly not a bad professor or person just tough.
He was a great lecturer. The test questions come straight from the lecture problems.

Nice professor that wants his students to succeed but still makes the class difficult. He goes through lectures fast, is a tough grader when it comes to tests and when given advice by other students on how to improve the class, he doesn't take it. Only way to pass is to do all supplementary problems and prepare to spend a lot of time on this class.
Although he's a professional lecturer, He's a fast lecturer and doesn't give partial credit for trying (exams/hw/bonus). Wouldn't take him again if i had a choice.
Great lectures but the grading is unnecessarily tough.

Professor knows his stuff, and since there's alot of stuff to know, imperative that you stay caught up and practice outside of class. He provides plenty of supplementary problems and graded exams from previous semesters. My key to success was to work through the previous exams and that's how I got A's. The homeworks are tough but overprepared me.

Lectures are top notch, be prepared to study and solve some extra problems.  You learn a lot from this class, highly recommended.  Professor is highly professional and helpful with questions.  Attend his office hours for any necessary additional help.
Phenomenal professor, I recommend attending lectures.

Dr Karbhari is a great lecturer don't get me wrong. I learned a lot and I'm confident to say the concepts I learned will be useful in the future.  However, he caught 3 students cheating on the Midterm before the final, and made the final painful for all of us. I don't think is fair for honest students like me who put in the effort to pay the price.

The lectures can be a bit fast, but they are excellent lectures. The course can be a little hard, but the professor encourages the class to ask questions and is overall very chill. He is good with communicating with students, and understands that we have other things going on, so he is lenient about homework and test dates.

Professor Karbhari is a great lecturer by using visuals and practices problems with lectures. He stops and encourages questions during lectures and asks the class for feedback regarding his lecture speed and formats of teaching the lecture. Offers supplementary problems to prepare for the exams and is accessible outside of class for assistance.
Get ready to study more than what you take a lot of things, go over material so fast
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: I will vouch for Dr. Vasquez, probably for the rest of my life. He is an amazing instructor who loves what he does, and you can tell. I've taken about 4 classes with him now, and each one reminded me how enamored he is with his work and sharing it with others, specifically his research on gangs. Take any course you can with him!!!!!!

Took this class an an elective, such an easy A AND he is so so caring about everyone! There are 2-3 essays to write and a book report, but it's not even that bad. I knocked those out in an hour. Truly an interesting and chill class!

He's humble, and quick to admit when he makes a mistake which is rare for any educator. You can tell Mr. Vasquez has high self-esteem because most people with low self-esteem are reluctant to admit any faults. There was an alternative option to the group project, which I appreciated because I'd rather write a paper than deal with that.

Took him for Drugs and Crime class as UTD. His lectures were awesome and we even guest speakers from every aspect of the field. He made this class fun and I would definitely take him again for other classes. Assignments are pretty easy, just exams and presentation or paper. Just show up to class and you will be fine!

BEST PROFESSOR I'VE EVER HAD! Genuinely cares about you & gets to know you. Has the most interesting stories & lectures & he ALWAYS looks out for you. I signed up for his 8:30 am class in spring, that's how much I like him. Does not want you to fail & will do everything in his power to prevent it. If you want to feel important/heard, take him!!!

I really enjoyed taking Professor Vasquez's class. He's humble, respectful, and it seems like he really enjoys his job. He showed videos and had several guest speakers (which really reinforced his lectures). Also, there were tons of extra credit opportunities (many of which were during our class).
Great professor. Enjoyed his lectures. Although attendance is not mandatory BUT he shows videos and topics only in the lectures that are needed for the tests.

Probably the most interesting prof I've had this semester. His lectures are great, and I didn't even read the textbook and just took notes on the lectures and did just fine in this class. There are lots of extra credit opportunities as well.

Overall really fun class, fun prof, fun stories.
Vasquez offers a lot of opportunities for extra credit if you end up getting less than an A on the exam. Most students score A's or B's initially on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He's a caring prof, his class was super easy, and he offers so much extra credit that you cannot fail. Attendance is not mandatory and on exam days there is no class so you take the exam at home. it's an open book open note exam. I highly recommend.

I am currently taking Prof. Vasquez at UTD, but he is not registered under them. I couldn't have more good things to say about Prof. Vasquez. He is extremely smart & genuinely cares about how you do in class. He offers so many extra credit opportunities & really looks out for you. The best professor I've had in my college experience! HIGHLY SUGGEST

Professor Vasquez is well respected, super funny, and gives great lectures, attendance is not mandatory but I would show up if you want to pass the tests, lots of extra credit opportunities. Don't need the book, but the tests are online and open book so if you want a straight 100 get the book. One paper at the end of semester but easy.

Professor Vasquez is really funny and he has a lot of stories to tell, which are very entertaining. He is very passionate about Criminology and he is one of the best when it comes to teaching it, because he has experienced so many things. There is 4 exams and 1 paper. There is a lot of extra credit offered. There is no way you can fail.

I did not fully experience the nature of this professor because he got into an accident and took a leave. But from what I have seen, he is a casual and laid back professor. Definitely a different vibe from other professors. He shared a lot of stories, liked to talk about himself, and taught class at the same time. Only 3 exams, 1 major assignment.

Fantastic professor. I am not a criminal justice major but I would take every class he offers if I could. I learned a lot! I rate 1 for easiness. I wouldn't say it is show up and pass though, but he makes it very easy to learn.
Definitely enjoyed his class; There were online exams and either a group presentation or 5-7 page paper, at the student's discretion.

PROFESSOR VASQUEZ IS A GREAT TEACHER. TESTS ARE ONLINE AND BASED ON THE POWERPOINTS THAT HE POSTS.  1 PAPER ON THE GRAFFITI BOOK. INTERESTING LECTURES WITH LOTS OF PICTURES HE'S TAKEN HIMSELF. BOOK IS NOT MANDATORY BECAUSE HE PROVIDES POWERPOINTS.

Great class, very knowledgeable about gangs and crime. I am not a CJ major but ended with an A in the class. I will take him again next semester. All tests are online and one 3-5 page paper over a book.

Tests are online (over powerpoint and lecture material) and he gives a lot of extra credit throughout the semester.  Also, he assigns a paper at the beginning of the semester that isn't due until the end of the semester. His class is very easy, if you go to class and take notes.

There are only so many stories about graffiti artists a person can take.  I found his lectures to bounce around making them hard to follow.  Tests are online.  Attendance is a must later in the semester because he starts asking questions about people from his 'stories.'

Great professor, lectures are very interesting. He has a lot of stories to tell regarding his research with gangs. Test are kind of hard, need to really know your material.  Tests are online but timed so make sure you study. Professor is always willing to meet with you to answer any questions.

Took theoretical criminology for the summer, and the class was easy. no paper. only 4 tests. ONLINE! he tends to ramble but that's okay because it's mostly relevant. WOULD DEFF TAKE HIM AGAIN! I made an A and I missed 5 days..

I took him for Juvenile Justice and again for Gangs. He's a fairly easy professor. Due to his research, he has tons of in-depth knowledge and plenty of stories to tell. While he's to follow gives plenty of opportunities for extra credit, his exams (while not necessarily hard) can be tricky.
Took this class, expected it to be hard and honestly it was the easiest he even says the class is easy that you have to work at failing. willing to help and always gives extra credit.

Vasquez is a chill professor, and his Advanced Crim class was interesting and funny. He is open about what his research is like and gives a lot of examples of it in his lectures. He talks to students not like a professor, but like a friend, at least that's the way I felt. Tests were online, lots of chances for extra credit. Highly recommend!
Great Professor. He is willing to help you with anything you may need.  The testing can be hard. Read the book.

Doing practice problems would help, but I didn't make time for it. He is a nice, chill guy to talk to, but his lecture style makes me drowsy (his voice) and goes slowly (good and bad).

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, definitely take. Cares about his students like no other. Easy to understand with good examples. Really knows what he's talking about. Gives example questions that are literally the test questions. Will infiltrate your groupme, but thats to your advantage. Gave extension on test because everyone was worrying in GC. Love this prof
Funny guy who cares about his students and wants you to do well. Tests really aren't difficult if you keep up with lectures and look over the reviews he gives out beforehand.

Dr. Schargel was super funny in and out of class. Very chill guy so u can just waltz into his office and chat. Class was not hard if you go to lectures and study the material. He literally tells you exactly what you need to know so pay attention. Uploaded all info so you dont need the textbook. Was very understanding amid covid changes and helped

If you think he doesn't know you because you're in a big class, just know he does. He genuinely knows how to uplift his students and makes them want to try harder, sure everyone fails but he makes you want to try harder! His teaching style is amazing, and he goes above and beyond for his students! Don't be afraid to ask questions in his class!

I have never taken stats before and Dr. Schargel really made this class as easy and straightforward as possible. 5 hw's are given, the lowest one is dropped, and one is a completion grade!! First test was super easy, second one was alright and the final was relatively alright. Really nice professor and super helpful too. Would definitely recommend!

I wouldn't say he is the easiest professor at UTA, most of the clinic problems do not show most of work, so its hard to understand where he got those answers from. His exams were somewhat similar to the clinic problem, but they were hard. This class is similar to elementary statistics, but for UTA its a different name.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I had Dr.S for Bio1 and now for Biostats. Honestly he is probably the best speaker and most personable prof I've encountered at UTA. The class isn't easy but he gives you all the info you need to make an A. Other profs give you too much extraneous info that wastes your time. All you have to do is study and an A isn't out of reach. Great prof!!

Too many topics to master in one semester. People are struggling and he just calls them lazy or losers. Allows cheating on homework, which dilutes the grade earned by honest students. Other schools separate elementary stats and analysis of variances into two semesters but for some backwards reason UTA combines them.

Professor Schargel is funny, relaxed and engaging in his lectures. His exams are hand graded and he gives a lot of partial credit. The homeworks are based off of examples in the book and only one of them is extremely time consuming. He drops one homework so I used that one as the dropped grade. He warns you of how long it takes when it is assigned.

Dr. Schargel is a funny guy and he really wants his students to understand and do well in his class. I would say to start studying for his exams a week beforehand, attend SI sessions and practice the clinic problems he gives. First exam was easy and the second was much harder but the final the easiest in my opinion. He drops lowest HW grade!!!

Dr. Schargel is by far one of my favorite professors. His class is doable as long as you keep up with the material, do the clinic problems, as well as the homework assignments. 2 midterms, a comprehensive final, and 5 Hw assignments (drops 1 and 1 of them is just a completion grade)!! Take him I promise you will not regret it!!

He is good professor. I took him for both Bio 1441 and Biostat. I really liked his biostat lectures, and I enjoyed biostat. His bio 1442 lectures were boring, and I always felt sleep in bio 1441. It is an easy A if you study. I'd definitely take him as Biostat, but not for bio 1441.

Dr. Schargel is a very fair professor. He tells you exactly what the assignments for the class will be upfront. If you have already taken some form of a statistics class, then this course should be really easy. All the homeworks you will use your own data. I earned an A and I only attended half of the lectures in the summer.
Excellent professor - fair grading and decent curve at the end of the semester. Definitely have to read the book and pay attention in lecture to make an A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Schargel makes a daunting class very simple and practical. He is a must take for Bio Stats. You get a formula sheet for all test. There is homework but it is very simple and graded easily. The test are graded easily as well. As long as you know how and when to use a formula the test are quite simple and straight forward.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He's a funny guy, but beware, the tests are departmental. The final is SUPER easy though containing 100 questions. He's better than all other biology teachers. Just make sure to go to class because of iclickers. He's funny and remember, it's biology, meaning memorization and TONS of reading.

You cant have a more perfect prof for the class. He elaborates on the concepts by pulling exmpls from the huge library in his brain to help you understand. Hes authentic, and so charismatic. His classes have always had the highest exam scores out of all the bio profs for 1441. Ask Qs!!! He WILL give you a thorough answer. Take adv of office hrs!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He lectures off of a powerpoint, and while I'm not a fan of that sort of teaching style, he did include diagrams in his lectures to help the material make sense. He uploads the lectures to Blackboard after class, so you can reference them later. The tests are departmental, but he tries to influence the other professors to make the tests easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: the guy is great, if youre looking for a very straight forward professor from whom you know exactly what to expect then hes youre best option. i blame myself for finding the class tough because i took it along with other fairly intense courses so my grade suffered quite a bit. not much room for error in this course bc theres only 3 exams,so careful
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Schargel is a gem. Class is enjoyable. Take the time to approach and get to know him. You don't necessarily need to book, but it is useful to have. Go do all the HW and Clinic problems with that in mind you should do well on the tests. Also, if he stresses a concept during lecture or review day, make sure you know it.

Dr. Schargel is a great teacher. He makes class enjoyable and though attendance is not mandatory it is highly recommended. The grade was based on 3 exams including a comprehensive final and 5 homework assignments with the lowest homework grade dropped. Dr. Schargel is very approachable, as are his TAs and I wish he taught more classes that I need.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: I took him for biostatistics and it was easy. He is a good professor and teaches well in class. I got 100 on all my test. Don't freak out about the tests just study the clinic problems in class and you'll do great. Also there are 5 homework's throughout the semester and he drops the lowest grade. I enjoyed his class a lot.

Absolutely amazing, do the clinic problems and you will make an A. Attend SI sessions and start the homework early (so you can go to tutoring). There is no reason to fail this course. ATTEND THE LECTURE. Buy the book, do the problems, rewrite your notes every day. I guarantee you will pass. Show your work on the tests!!!

Dr. Schargel is the best bio-stats professor that you'll ever find! when I took his class I was surprised to find out how easy his class was, he gives you 5 homework assignments which are a little tricky, 2 exams which are easy because he reviews for them by having clinic problem sessions and those question are very similar to those on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Do not take this professor if you are looking forward having a professor who works out the problem for you. Come to class prepared, his problem solving goes fast and he only displays the answer to the problem rather than working it out. Clincal reviews are a plus.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I almost changed my major because he makes biostatistics so interesting. Dr. Schargel makes math fun and really makes sure the statistics are applicable to biology students. The homework is hell, have lots of paper on hand. Do the homework, come to class, you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Schargel is fantastic! Lecture wasn't mandatory but I recommend you attend, the tests are all from his lectures. You don't need the book so just save your money! I took him during a 5-week summer semester which is why the class was fairly difficult. I highly recommend!

He's a great professor, but he's really monotone, so I tend to be very sleepy in his class. If you go to class during his clinic problem sessions, those questions are basically the test, and he shows you how to do them. Don't buy the textbook because he sends you a pdf of practice problems and answers, which were a huge help, but not needed.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Schargel is the man. He will explain every potential test question in detail and make it very possible to get an A as long as you actually try. There are 5 homeworks throughout the semester that seemed like an annoyance at the time, but helped me so much with solidifying the material for the exams. Would definitely take again.

This professor really cares for his students. He provides everything you need in the powerpoints but for extra practice I would recommend getting the book. If you feel like material is hard to understand do not hesitate to ask questions because he will go out of his way to make sure you know what you are doing.  And it doesn't hurt that he's hot.

Biostatistics is daunting at first, but Dr. Schargel makes learning the material easier with his PowerPoints and great sense of humor. I never thought lecture was boring. He makes it fun and he's very approachable. The 2 things you have to understand to do well is: 1)The HW assignments and 2)The Clinics, which he does in class before each exam.

Explains everything to you step by step so you can fully understand the material. Show all work graphs tables. Plenty of examples. Lectures can be slow but very helpful if you ask questions. Does not curve. Don't blow off hw. Study the powerpoints, examples, and hw and you can pass the tests. 2 midterms 1 final. Textbook is helpful!

Great professor! He is very clear in lectures and his power points are very helpful when studying. If you go to class, you will not need the book to study. I would recommend doing all the homeworks since they are harder than the test. Also, he is super helpful if you do not understand a concept! GO SEE HIM!
Biostats is statistics. Dr. Schargel does a great job at trying to make the topic interesting. He is a fair grader, but does not curve. So expect to put in the time necessary to earn your grade.
Biostat is not hard class even if you aren't good in math. I hate math, but I made an A!!!  Long as you study hard, then you will get A or B. His lecture can be bored sometimes.

Great teacher. Tests can be tricky, but if all you want to do is pass then attendance is minimal. If you want an A, GO TO CLASS. Classes are fun and he goes into detail that you don't get from his slides. Curves his tests. Gives easy bonus questions on each test.
Lectures from the power points he uses from the textbook, and he posts them on blackboard. He gives extra credit opportunities on each test.

Dr. Schargel is a great lecturer. He makes learns the subject material a lot easier because of all the examples he gives and how clear he lectures. He is very good about letting you know what will be on the tests and what to expect. He also gives bonus questions which are typically very easy if you read the current news he sends out. I enjoyed.

Biostats was not as hard as I thought! But of course you HAVE to go to class for his in depth examples. I suggest making a study group! It was very helpful.  Midterms and hw are easy.  Final is tricky since it's over 11 chapters of built up stats! I made an A in this course! And I'm horrible at math lol.  Again I suggest study groups!

Dr. Schargel is a nice professor but he doesn't elaborate on the powerpoint he shows. For BIO 1442 Evolution and Ecology he shows powerpoint and posts them online. No homework. He doesn't take attendance but encourages it. The tests are super hard but he gives some bonus questions.
Awesome. Helpful. Easy grader. Go to class, buy the book, easy A.

Let me be clear. UTA changed the bio 1442 from whatever it was before to Evolution and Ecology. This was the first semester for the class. In 1441 I made 90s on my tests. This, not so much. First test 76, 2nd 71, 3rd 53. His lectures are just the power points and he gives no information whatsoever about what to expect from the test. The worst class
This class is pretty straightforward. 2 midterms, 1 final, and homework. Not too hard just make sure you're in class to go through examples.
Clear and concise on expectations for exams. Do the homework (5) and clinics and you'll do well on the exams. He is also a very good lecturer.

The professor is really clear, though, you'll still have to do your share if you want to get a good grade. The only reason I ended up with a B is because I messed up the second midterm since I took it while I was sporting a light fever (don't do that, people), but his exams are hilariously easy if you do the homework, and the review clinics.

Dr. Schargel is a pretty good professor in general but statistics is a very hard subject. There is no tutoring outside of class to help students with homework. He does class reviews before the exams, which is helpful but if you don't know the material, it can be hard. He gives A LOT of homework; attendance is non mandatory but would help if you go.

Does not keep attendance, but I recommend going because it is easy to get behind quickly. Does not use a textbook, recommends a department study guide. Five long-ish homeworks, they aren't hard but his graders can pick anything apart. First couple tests are pretty easy, but the final is very comprehensive and tricky. Just stay on the material!

Awesome prof - have had him for both bio and bio stats and he's awesome! It's clear he has a passion for the subject and for teaching, and his accent is lyrical and very pleasant (and not at all difficult to understand).  Definitely take Schargel if you get a chance!  Grading was 23 based on 4 exams (lowest non-final dropped), 13 lab.
I love Dr. Schargel! I never thought I would enjoy a biostatistics class as much as I did! As long as you go to class and take good notes, you will be fine!
One of the best professors I've ever had. Material is presented in a very clear and organized manor. Very friendly, and fun to be around in general

Dr. Schargel has lecturing down! He explains PRECISELY what will be on the exams. The attendance was always high for class. If you go to lecture, you do not need book. Reviews are extremely helpful. He does problem examples right before the exam which are very useful. Good humor and explains material VERY WELL. 5 homework, 2 midterms and a final.
Do Homework + clinic examples + study = A. Everyone says it is easy but you still need to put hard work in to get an A.

Schargel is a good lecturer, but his subject is almost mind-numbingly boring. His tests are exactly like the clinics he does in class. I was an idiot and didn't show up for those, so I'll only pull out a C, but if you actually come to class you should get an A easily. This is the BIOL class with the highest pass rate at UTA, and that's saying a lot

Professor Schargel was really cool. I'm a science person but I struggled to pull of a B in this class. Would DEFINITELY recommend reading the textbook to fully comprehend lectures, and would recommend attending all lectures if you want to do well. Tests are fairly hard but the final is recycled questions from previous exams.

He is a phenomenal lecturer. I've never had a better teacher. The class it's self is really hard, but he makes it as fun as he can. PowerPoints = what's in the book; Book + PowerPoints = what's on the test; Do Book Questions + Reviewing PowerPoints before class + Attend class + (office hours if need be) = You getting an A+++.

Exams were just like the clinics he provided and he also provides lecture notes and slides. One of the easiest biology classes I've ever taken, but that doesn't mean you can make an A without studying.
Excellent professor!

TAKE HIS ONLINE CLASS!!!!! I got an A with no effort and plus its fun. You just need to order this lab kit that consists of 6 "experiments" that are actually really fun and EASY.I got A's on all of them so take him!!!

Very good and easy class if you do all of the homeworks then you should do well on his tests, the clinics that we do in class are very similar to what will be on the exams, professor knows what he is doing and is not borin at all very recommended

You don't have to buy the book; there are notes provided. Printing them out is cheaper than buying them from the Phi Sigma Society FYI. Tests are pretty easy. Just do the homework and a quick skim over the notes before the exam will do. Oh, and he HATES cheaters so don't think you can get away with it on the exams
Dr Schargel was able to make biostats a bearable class... and that's saying something.

The best way to pass his exams are to keep re-doing his review problems & reviewing the small problems in the chapters of the book. Make sure to know any general concepts he might ask about. Overall easy class. I just read the book and I made an A.
Professor  who tries to make class interesting. Tests are easy plus addition bonus points. goo humor, helpfulness, frank.

loved the course, during lecture he makes sure you understand concepts that will potentially be on the exams. after completing a unit, he is nice enough to provide a study guide outlining formulas from each ch. you must attend lectures,which are purrty entertaining. dnt be afraid to participate & ask questions(he will always try to clarify for you)

Great professor. Tests came directly from powerpoints and he provided a review sheet prior to each exam. An easy A if you don't wait until the last minute to study. Also had him for 2300, he was great in that too.
Easy A! He posts every powerpoint online, so you don't have to read the book. The final is comprehensive, but it's old tests questions which he posts. Plus he posts reviews for each test.
Very easy course. Do the homework and practice exam problems. Exams are very straight forward,

Very much an introductory course so if you have taken a stats course previously(like in HS), you will find this course pretty easy. Professor is very nice and helpful. Has test reviews(clinics) prior to every test which makes the tests simple; but he is shifting aspects of tests towards concepts. 2 Midterms(45% of grade), HW(25%), Final(30%).

Boring but easy class. Buy the notes and do all the hw (there are only 5 total), it really helps as practice for the tests. If you memorize the formulas and understand the overall concepts you'll get an A easily. I'm not good at math, but he teaches thoroughly enough that I don't feel lost at all. Take his class!

If you are looking for a convenience BIOL lab then take Prof. Schargel. He do take a while to update grades but since YOU are not the only one in the class but he is worth taking in the end.  There is no required book but you order lab online and it is 12 required labs that are very simple and easier n cheaper if you work in a group.Great Prof!!

Dr. Schargal was very helpful when I needed help. The class itself is very boring, but if you just learn and practice the material from the book you'll be fine. The notes are online or you can buy a binder of them printed out for $20. Tests are not hard of you know the formulas and how to use them. Make sure to do the hw, its good practice.

This professor is cool. Laid back. Easy. Just study from pwr pts and review sheets. Classes boring most of the time but tolerable. Gives bonus questions to help towards tests and final grade along the way. A lot of criteria to cover but easy not technical.

He goes over the material several times. The HW and the clinics are just like the tests. Do those and print the notes. Hard not to pass this class. He is very patient and doesnt mind explaining. Boring but not difficult. I would recommend him.

lectured from slides, reasonable hw, if u redo the hw problems & clinics then u should do fine on the tests, look up examples online to make sure u understand or ask him he will help & has a TA, know the formulas, if u had statistics in high school then u should do fine, it's not that bad

Sometimes hard to understand, but will answer any questions gladly.  Has a lot of patience, and if you show up to class and listen to his examples and study at least the weekend before each test you will definitely pass.  If you don't show up, he is less prone to help u out in the end.  Ask questions, he'll learn your name, & help you when needed.

he was extremely unhelpful. He often mumbled where you could barely hear him and i sat in the first row!! Also he only reads the powerpoints. sure he provides them to you online, but his tests seem to go into wayyy more detail then he provided us with.

He gives one hundred percent of the test material on powerpoint, which he also posts online.  He also gives reviews for tests that are so detailed.  All of that plus generous curves make this class nearly impossible to fail.  Outside study time is definitely required though.
He is harder than you think.  Class averages on tests were all failing.  Trick Questions.
Test material is from his powerpoint slides only.Just study the slides and you will do fine.

He's quiet, but he covers material fairly well. You will have a significantly better time if you engage with his lectures, I was in a class of 10 people and it was dead silent most of the time. Lecture material is harder than whats on exams, but most material is only in lectures. Look at his exam review guides and you'll be fine.

WORST PROFFESOR EVER!!! Can't understand a word he says, thick accent. He just reads off his slides. Even when he explains things it is impossible to understand what he is saying or talking about. :(  I had to teach myself. Takes attendance so you have to attend lectures that are the biggest waste of time.

One of the worst teachers I have ever had. His lectures are extremely boring and uninformative. He is very hard to understand.  I had to teach myself everything. I never felt prepared for the tests. Do not take him if you want a good grade in  precalc.

He speaks softly and has a little bit of accent so I suggest to sit in the front seats. His quizzes are super hard and he doesn't curve them at all. No extra credit is given. Homeworks are hard. He gives marks for attendance.
A good and helpful math teacher. You have to homework every week. Questions on the lab are a bit tough but the exams are not hard. If you study, you can get an A.

Quiet and can be hard to understand. Quizzes are multiple choice, reasonable, and if you practice on the homework and pay attention in class you will do just fine. He posted the homework online, no textbook needed. If you're confused about a specific part just ask him after class. Free UTSI tutoring is held as well. Attendance is taken.

I would recommend to sit close to the front of the class, because he doesn't speak loud enough. All of his questions from the quiz come from his homework. Also, one of the best things about having him was that he drops your two lowest quiz grades! I sadly didn't pay much attention in his class and blew it off, so I ended up with a B. Bummer.
He has an asian accent, but he knows what he's teaching and answers everyone's questions. Kinda dorky but funny

I second pretty much what everyone else said. She allows multiple cheat sheets for exams which is nice. She has online notes that you can follow along with during lecture, and even prints them out for you if you need them. The projects guidelines were a little confusing, but she answer questions thoroughly.
Just take her. You won't regret it. She makes the class so easy. By far one of the best- if not the best- professor I've ever had.

She is incredibly kind and her lectures are great. Everything is really clear and she will help out with everything to the best that she can. She prepares us very well and she is very fair in how she grades. I really enjoyed being in her class.
was really good with the lectures easy to understand but straight with the grading overall good to take the course

Hands down she is one of the nicest professors I have ever taken at UTA. She cares so much about the students and lets us know exactly what we will be tested on for the exams. Her reviews and lectures are very easy to follow. Her lecture reminds me of a high school teacher but in a good way. It's an easy A course if you do your assignments on time.

Hands down the best professor I have taken at UTA. Very nice, tech savvy, lectures are easy to follow and expectations for everything that carries a grade is clearly defined. Take Dr. Yang. You will not be disappointed.

By far one of the best engineering professors at UTA, I have taken her for IE 3301 as well. Her assignments and projects are extremely clearly laid out/described. She is always available for email/teams and will typically get back to you very quickly. She's a extremely fair grader and has amazing lectures. Everything is done in Teams, no canvas.

She is one of the best professors you could ever take. Dr. Yang really cares about her students and doesn’t mind going over the concepts over and over again until every student gets it clearly. Her tests and quizzes and exactly what she teaches in class. Dr. Yang is really approachable and engages her students. I really enjoyed taking her class.

I took Dr. Yang for Engineering Probability and I would take her for another class in the future. She's very caring and straightforward to how her class will be like. There's homework to each chapter we go over, but if you have any questions don't hesitate to ask. She gives exam reviews, etc which help tremendously for exams. One of the best profs
Wonderful! Great professor. She helps you understand the topic and gives clear guidance. Great homework assignments. Very fair and positive. Definitely recommend!

She is among the best IE professor at UTA. She really cares about students and wants to teach us the content. She is also straight forward as in what to expect on the exams. I would definitely recommend her for any class she teaches as she is so relatable to students since she is young and energetic. Highly recommend!
Shes new to teaching at UTA, but shes really caring and offers lots of extra credit. If youre lucky enough to be given the chance to take her for 3301, take it!

She gives extra credit for raising hand in class, she slows down and is making sure everyone understands. Took time out of 1 entire lecture to work exam review with us, and another lecture to review all topics before exam. This is done for each exam! HELPS ALOT. We get 2 page cheat-sheet to use on exams! Her behaviour will make you WANT to do well!

Shes very helpful and she always makes sure that everybody is on the same page. Even if youre not on the same page with her, she can help you. Shes gives a lot of examples and explanation on the concepts. She is willing to do whatever it takes to make the class easier for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The best professor you can find in UTA. I am taking 5 courses at this time, but she's the one who makes me feel like having a professor. She explains things clearly, and it's like holding your hand and walking you through every problem to make sure you understand what's happening.

Very easy class. No matter which professor teaches it, it will be easy. It's a project based class, and we had 5 mini projects, labs, and quizzes. The final is a final project that you can do in group or alone.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Be ready to study for this class. We had quizzes and homework every week. The midterms were hard but you have the opportunity to redo them and get half the points you missed. The final was better, and she added 5 points to everyone. You can get an A if you do all the homeworks and quizzes correctly, attend class, and get at least 85 on midterms.

She is a sweet person, nice and all. But as a professor, she could definitely be better. If you want to succeed in this class,  make sure to review the lectures notes, read the textbook and watch YouTube videos on linear algebra. Also, after each midterm she gives you the opportunity to redo the exam and gives you half the score you missed.

Avoid at all costs. She does a really bad job at explaining things. Her accent makes her very hard to understand. All the pop quizzes are really hard and are unannounced so you have to be there for every class. Each lecture is a waste of time because all she does is read off a powerpoint. Impossible to make A. Professor doesn't answer any questions
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This Professor ruined my semester. She made my life miserable for 13 weeks. Walking into lecture on the first day and listening to her speak through the syllabus, I knew this was going to be rough. She is a bad teacher!!! She hardly explains anything and just reads everything off a Powerpoint that she downloaded off the internet. AVOID AT ALL COST
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Can't understand what she speaks. Rushes all the mathematical problems. Has minimal to zero understanding of what she is doing.
Extreme biased
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
The professor doesn't have knowledge about a lot of things when it comes to data science and ml modeling. Given that she is teaching programming her focus should have been how to use functions and not on what is the mathematical theorem behind that. 
I don't know about mathematics but she doesn't have knowledge about programming. Not a bit.

She is a good teacher for those who can understand what she has to teach but often rushes through PowerPoints to the detriment of deeper understanding. However, you can be fully confident that what she presents in class will be everything that will be on the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Avoid her class if you can. The lectures are only based on what is in a book which you can read it yourself, no examples in class. Explains poorly, you will have a chance to pass the class only if you study on your own. HW is easy but it doesn't help you get ready for exams whatsoever. Final exam's average grade for the whole class was 49/100.

Agree with most reviews here. Rushes through powerpoints, does minimal ex., HW did not help, Reviews did not help, midterms were poorly structured and hard. She knows her stuff, but does not explain clear. Only good thing is that corrections are allowed for tests, Mult. HW attempts, Projects worth as test grade, and EC. Course is difficult as is.
dfh

Dr.Yang was unprepared for class to the point of students having to correct her. Avoid at all costs. She is super sweet and accessible outside of class, but you better have a good understanding of stats before taking her class.

Honestly, I can't think of one good thing to say about her. She's very disorganized, difficult to understand, and doesn't really know what she's doing. I had to go home and teach myself the content because I just could not understand what was going on in class. If math is not your strongest subject, I would not recommend choosing her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: by far the worst professor I've ever had. It is clear that she tries very hard, but she has an extremely thick accent, talks very quickly, and does minimal example problems. Lots of times she refuses to teach things because it's too easy or because she doesn't want to. So many people dropped at the deadline and if I wasn't a stats major i would too

wasn't very organized, difficult to understand at times, and rushed through lectures. she would get mad if we asked questions she considered to be 'easy' to HER. class would be fine if your good at working more on your own. online homework was helpful, and would recommend getting outside help if you need it.

She doesn't teach well at all so I had to drop. She repeats what was on the powerpoint and gives one or two examples. There was a lot to learn from the course. The professor is really good at teaching and the tests are easy. Spending some time on the coursework will get you an A.

Prof Santra gives good lectures, even if they can be boring sometimes. He covers all test material in lectures, but I recommend the textbook to help you study. Tests are pretty easy and graded generously. His accent is thick, but still understandable. He can be condescending when you ask clarifying questions, and don't answer questions wrong.

He's probably the easiest professor I had this semester. He has five tests (non-cumulative), each 15% of your grade, so one every 2 weeks which...was a lot. Then he has a final which is cumulative and 20% of your grade. His tests are super easy and I studied one day before for all of them (even the final). idk what I'm getting but it might be an A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Santra is probably the easiest option in respect to 2315, his lectures make sense, he exhausts all examples, answers every question (after you attempt thinking critically), and his TA rubric is generous despite his quizzes being easy already. He can be a bit difficult to understand at times, however, you can always ask him to slow down a bit.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: 3 Exams + a semester long group project (submission in phases) + project demo to TA of final two phases + end sem in class presentation regarding course feedback. He blatantly copied the style and material (just changed the name on them) of his mentor professor. needs to dial the coursework down a bit.

Lab is 60% so its hard to fail as long as you show up to lab. He changed the grading scale like 10 times which was mildly inconvenient. Nobody showed up to class so it wasn't very surprising when the average for the tests was in the 40-50s. But he wasn't the best lecturer so dont expect to learn much. Thats all I got

Terrible Professor, if you are ever cursed with having to take his section then I would recommend not even showing up to the lectures because he doesn't know what he is teaching AT ALL and only confuses you on anything you thought you knew. Lectures make no sense and just go with the theme of that class in general being stupid and useless....

The topics of the class are easy to understand if you pay attention in lecture, but the way they are taught by Professor Abusoua are not the best, as he can be confusing a some times. The homework's are what actually prepare you for exams, not lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not a hard class, but the department makes it difficult. By far the poorest execution of education. There are way too many assignments, grading criteria is not clear, syllabus does not reflect actual coursework. Course materials were taught incorrectly, you are better off learning on YouTube. TA's are nice and will try to help, but class was awful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There is tons of homework within this class, and you must constantly meet with your classmates outside of class. The entire class structure is a mess with three different syllabi. I didn't feel prepared for the exams and the professor is always confusing us. Moreover, he isn't even a processor at UTA, he's a Postdoctoral Researcher.

reviews.comment: This class and professor were okay. The structure of the course kept changing at the start, and there were lots of hw and weekly "group discussions". Most times I didn't feel prepared for exams. The professor tries his best but confuses the class when working out some problems. You will end up teaching yourself the material in this course.

reviews.comment: He is pretty nice and tries his best during lecture but is sometimes confusing. Answered any questions asked during class and broke down review problems before upcoming exams.

reviews.comment: Professor Abusoua was very unprepared at the beginning of the semester. I was also a part of the "Experemental learning" where we were to learn most of the material outside of the class. When the students would ask him about these things, he would seem like he had no idea what was going on.
