reviews.comment: This class was an absolute MESS. I was the guinea pig of an "outside learning" experiment that was TERRIBLY executed. They would assign outside-of-class group work TWICE a week, and HW was due every week on top of that. The prof was disrespectful and awful at answering questions, and he often found himself lost in his work in lectures. AVOID HIM
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very good man and professor overall. He was passionate about his undergraduate research methods class and teaches statistic's well. He is more on the tough grader end and will give you good feedback on your projects. Make sure you pick a good group for this class and that they're actually do their part. Overall good professor.

Great knowledge on research processes and gives good critique. HOWEVER also: hard to get a hold of, changed due dates lot (hard to keep track when you have other classes) or wouldn't upload the assignment so you couldn't do it at all, 3/4 of the time class time he mused about random things he's interested in. Take it as a summer class if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is more than 50% group work so make sure you have a good group of people you can trust. No need to buy the textbook. Class isn't structured, so Dr. Yilla just talks about random stuff during lecture. Pro, he gives extra credit for asking questions in class. Very little info on how to do assignments and his TA is a tough grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor is very unorganized and is terrible at explaining assignments/expectations. He is passionate about adapted sports due to his personal experience. He tends to talk down to students and can be problematic with his political views that he expresses from time to time. He is also unhelpful when you seek clarification on class assignments.

The professor was okay and but passionate about the class. It becomes difficult to be engaged when it feels like he is teaching graduate students. Definitely find a good group that will all do their part and meet outside of class time. Do no procrastinate during data collection! Professor is harsher on groups that do not talk to him at all.

Dr. Yilla is amazing, don't get me wrong. I just wouldn't take him again because I loathe group work, and he's big on that, it seems. This class wasn't hard in the slightest, but the challenge came from the group project. I cannot stress how important it is to group w/ responsible people who do their work. Dedicated people will make this class fun!

He is a good professor who is knowledgeable and passionate. You would learn a ton if he didn't go off on tangents so much. He almost exclusively uses group projects which is fine if you have a good group.

Dr yilla is a great professor. He cares about what he teaches and that makes the class better. He lectures from a power point base, but he puts his own spin on things. He gives extra credit for participating in class. If you speak, you get a bonus point towards end of grade semester; so take advantage. I loved his classes. Group work. Rarely any HW

Dr. Yilla's research methods class is a based on a group project. There are 2 easy tests & hw dont stress about those. instead, stress about choosing the right people for the project or you'll be stuck doing other people's work. The project workload is a lot so do not procrastinate & you dont need the textbook.

Dr. Yilla's sport & society class was so much fun. You discuss real-world problems all while discussing sports. You get up to 10 EC points if you speak in class. There are no tests just very easy quizzes and discussion boards. We had the option to attend online or in person bc of covid. Definitely a wise man and knows what he is talking about.

If you take Dr. Yilla be sure to be engaged and active in the class. He caters to those who are more interactive and while you can make an A by being shy, it's much easier to get out there and participate. Lots of group work for this class so make sure you have a solid group and communicate with him as much as possible and you'll make an A.
This class is centered on a research paper that is to be done in a group. Participation in group is necessary to pass. Gives great feedback to get a good grade on paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Such a interesting course and he makes you want to be engaged and present in the conversations, quizzes and discussion boards are assigned online. He will give extra credit for participating in the class. He really cares about what he is teaching and his students!

He is an amazing professor. We had two exams, one debate and a paper over the debate. You will need the textbook for the final review, don't try to find all the answers on Quizlet because you will fail.

I love this professor. This is an adapted class which you can tell is near and dear to his heart being that he himself is in a wheelchair. This guy teaches things you actually need to know and care to learn. 10/10 dude.

I love this professor, I have taken every class he offers and always look forward to them. This is an adapted class which you can tell is near and dear to his heart being that he himself is in a wheelchair. This guy teaches things you actually need to know and care to learn. 10/10 dude.

I've taken every class this professor has to offer and this was probably the most difficult. He takes this class fairly seriously and wants things done the right way. If you pay attention and make your lesson plans how he tells you, you'll have no problems.

This class was just very disorganized. The exams were hard and he does not give feedback or try to help you if you're confused. He says that we are adults and have to try on our own. Never felt comfortable going to talk to him and his lectures were confusing. I went to every single lecture and still did not understand the class.

Talk in class! He offers extra credit for this! Only 2 exams, the rest of your grade is dependent on group project. Be sure you choose people who will pull their weight, or your grade will be affected. Good luck!

I graduated from UTA in 2012, however Dr. Yilla was a very inspirational professor throughout my academic experience at UTA. He will challenge your views, even if he agrees with you. Grading is fair, and as long as you participate and read you will make a good grade. I will always remember his classes.

Dr. Yilla at times may seem to have some crazy views on things. However, he welcomes a well educated debate. He likes when people do not agree on all things.  he will not hold your grade hostage if you do not agree with him. as long as you can give facts and reasoning for why you think that way.

quizzes and discussions are all online. need textbook. he will challenge your viewpoint in class not because he's against you (maybe) but he wants you to be able to explain your thoughts. extra credit towards final grade for talking in class. not mandatory. interesting to go anyway and he randomly gives you credit for showing up.

Not sure if this was a Kinesiology or a government class. He uses the class to push his strong liberal views. Be prepared to stand up for your views, he respects it for the most part. Class was interesting but often off task. Very simple class, little effort needed.

Many students struggle with his views, however he is just trying to help you become more open minded. I had not considered going to graduate school until I had his classes. He is helpful, passionate about his subject, and knowledgeable. His classes are relatively easy. I not only highly respect him but admire him as well.
Dr Yilla is passionate about what he teaches and it shows. He gives you extra credit for participating in class and all of his test are done online.

Good good until the end. Perhaps it was the fault of the class but he acted in a most unprofessional manner on one day which has tainted his image in my eyes. Otherwise you will learn alot from him. Engages students to learn and participate.
Dr. Yilla is the best teacher I ever had! He is a genius
Dr. Yilla is very laid back and a very interesting man. the classes i took from him were fairly easy and he gives you a review that is the EXACT same as the test.

Dr. Yilla is a brilliant man. I love hearing him just for his British accent alone. He is really invested in teaching, and more so actually challenging his students. It is intimidating to learn under the techniques he goes by, but I am truly grateful that he teaches the way he does. OH... and he loves to give group work, no matter what class it is.
He's very challenging. He enjoys class discussions, so the more you get involved in class the better it will be. He's a good teacher.
He's an extremely fair guy. As long as you go to class you'll be fine! Speak up in class and he'll love you

Do not take any class taught by this professor. She is unnecessarily tough and quite honestly rude to her students. During a middterm exam a student raised their hand to ask a question about the test, she came over to answer and once the student started to ask, she quickly exclaimed "I am not answering any questions actually".

She does an incredible job lecturing and makes it fun and relatable. She is very knowledgeable in Marketing, she is a Ph.D. student, and gives great advice. I would love to have her as a professor again! Definity go to class if you want to make an A, going to class and just listening helped a lot. Her in-class test reviews are extremely helpful.
She is a great teacher received PHD in 2023 Lots of homework online but is very easy. Test are not hard just do homework and read and you'll do fine.
Professor Torres taught every single thing in class that was on the tests, so just show up. She also provides a study guide for the topics on the test. The homework assigned is not difficult at all.
She doesn't know what she is doing half the time and the tests are a great portion of your grade I wouldn't take her again.

Professor Heller is one of the kindest professors I've had. her exams are based off the study guide she gives and her assignments are helpful but very easy to do. She really is passionate about what she teaches and you can really tell. She is a very helpful professor and also a very sweet one

psych of adolescence was a cool class! lecture videos were provided on time along with study guides & review days. the class was consisted of quizzes, essays, DBs, and exams. they were all easy - pay attention & study. otherwise, don't complain. Abby made her material clear & you can ask questions if needed. she's super nice & understanding!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Took her Abnormal Psyc class online this summer and made an A. Her exam reviews were really helpful because they were exactly like the exam! Also there is a group project and individual essay involved, but it's really easy. Overall, I really enjoyed the class!
Abby is very helpful and cares about her students.

Abby is the best TA ever! Her lectures were informative and compact. The study guides she gives ARE the exams, but that doesnt mean you slack off. Show up to class, take notes and study the slides. Also, extra credit! Its easy to make an A in this course. Plus, a 5-6 page essay due at the end of semester which was fun to type. Take her.

A knowledgable professor who is clearly very passionate about counseling. I genuinely enjoyed her lectures. She is enthusiastic and fun to listen to during lectures. she is very organized and her grading is very clear and straightforward. Show up to class, pay attention, review the slides and attend the reviews and you'll get an A.

I really enjoyed this class. This professor really cares a lot about her students and is willing to work with you to ensure you are doing well. She has a passion for what she teaches and her test reviews are very similar to the test, she gives you the bonus questions and tests questions if you show up to class. Most of my friends and I got an A!

Abby is so sweet! I met up with her a couple times to discuss the theory paper and she was so helpful! I would recommend her to anyone who needs this class. Show up because she takes attendance and makes the lectures enjoyable! She talks about her experience in graduate school to prepare us for what'll happen because she was just thrown into it.

This is a MUST TAKE CLASS for a GPA booster. She is so nice and cares that you succeed. She gives a Kahoot of the questions on the exam and a study guide of the questions as well. There are three exams and one paper. Our class average for the exams were always a 90. There is a sign sheet for attendance and she knows all of her students.

SHE HAS BEEN THE SWEETEST TEACHER EVER! Very caring and clear about everything. She gives freebie attendance day, test reviews, review games, and feedback to your rough draft for your paper. Also she met up with me to discuss life in graduate school. She was very opened about every therapy situation she has encountered and it was very helpful.

Abby was amazing! She genuinely cares about her students and their well-being, and works really hard to make sure that her students have everything they need in order to be successful. Do yourself a favor and take her course, you won't regret it!

Loved taking PSYC1315 with Professor Aguirre in 2022! Her lectures were super informative and the course was very structured and organized, making it easier to navigate through the class. She's very passionate about what she does and had some interactive aspects of her lectures that were super interesting!

The lectures were interesting and she was easy to speak to. It was difficult to study for this class without taking notes, because the lecture slides are pretty empty. You can also only take homework quizzes once and they do have an affect on grade. The research participation isn't hard as long as you complete it as soon as possible.

Lectures were long but she was very engaging. There are 9 assignments and 5 exams including the final. Extra credit is available on every exam and the lowest exam grade is dropped at the end of the semester. The class was very easy and I would definitely take it again.

She is super sweet and interactive. Her lectures can drag but she makes them engaging. There is usually only 1 assignment per week sometime none. Make sure to do research participation early. I have no bad words to say about her. I recommend this professor if possible.

She spaces out tests and assignments, and her lectures are digestible. I would recommend skimming the textbook each chapter if you wanna go in depth cause some concepts are more complicated than meets the eye. She is very friendly and kind, so ask questions if need be. 

p.s All work is on canvas and given remote, so lots of time to do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She will make you answer a simple question that she throws in mid-lecture to take attendance. Her lecture is long and a little bit boring but she's very easy-going & super laid back. Try to finish the research requirement asap because people will fight for it mid-semester & all the opportunities will be taken.

Professor is the best psych prof I'll probably ever have. She is super intriguing and really understanding/easy to talk to. Her lectures were long but never boring! The assignment are easy if you read the book and go to the lectures. She gives out study guides before the exam, so I reccommend looking over it because it helps a ton! Love this Prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: It is easy A. She is a very good instructor.

All psych classes require you to participate in a number of studies throughout the semester. This instructor wasn't particularly engaging, all homework is quizzes, and she often plays videos to showcase different psych-related ideas. At one point she showed a video of a dog being hurt without any warning. Presentations can't be studied alone.

She works hard to come off as friendly on the surface but it's not real. Get ready to stay far busier with this class than any other you're taking, even more than your upper division classes in your major. Absurd amount of work for what is listed as a sophomore level class and she's not a kind grader either

She's very scattered in her teaching style and does not explain the material very well - she mainly just mimics what is in the book without any additional explanation or insight, which anyone can do who isn't very prepared. tests are pretty rough too.

This class was so easy and great. The professor was so nice, and made sure the course wasn't stressful at all. I don't know why she has so many negative reviews. The easiest A out of all my semesters so far! Would 100% recommend taking her for this class. Don't look for anyone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I hate leaving a negative review, I never have before but Im so sorry but she was awful. Her lectures were confusing and rambled a lot and many students didn't know what to study. She's a hard harsh grader and should be avoided if you can. Trust me.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Relies way too heavily on a group project plus the attendance rules are crazy strict. And she's one of those teachers that makes it quite difficult to get a reply to any of your emails. Take someone else and be glad.

The hardest part about this class was the group speech- not because the assignment was hard, but because working with people to give a speech isn't the easiest task. Other than that, very easy to make an A. These negative reviews are so far from the truth it's not even funny LOL. Never had a bad experience with Ms. Benton. Always kind and helpful.

Her class rules were often contradictory and her explanation of the homework and exams was often just as bad. No straightforward answers were given, always vague info. No clear understanding of what we were supposed to learn when we dared to ask questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I found her teaching style to be very frustrating. I did not enjoy this class and wanted to so badly. And she expects perfection. Avoid, don't take. You will also likely have trouble getting responses from her
Very unorganized, unclear instructions, and unlikely to respond to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She demands mandatory attendance, you lose points if you miss class, and she even demanded every person has their webcams on showing your face or you also lose points. She is also nearly impossible to get a hold of, her email response is nonexistent. She's nice but being a good teacher is about more than just nice; these other things matter too

reviews.comment: difficult to understand grading, not very clear, a nice person but not a good teacher, big difference, avoid
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: As long as you prepare for your speeches and show effort this class is an easy A. Abigail is super nice and I truly enjoyed having her as a professor. There are 5 speeches, 2 exams, and other minor assignments. I recommend taking her course.

Professor Benton is downright Superb. (Super-senior; had to take this req. again after coming back for a business degree.) She has the highest character and her communication skill are utterly impressive: take her class, do work, and consider yourself lucky (Big TY)! Highly skilled, highly effective, leader, prodigy. She's a real rare gem.

This was an online class, so we had to record our speeches and post them onto the Discussion board on Canvas (lucky me, because I'm shy at public speaking.) Gives great feedback. Practice your speeches.

Professor Benton is a literal icon. She is the best when it comes to feedback and genuinely cares. The book is not required. There are a lot of speeches, but she grades fairly. Attendance is required, but she is so understanding. When the pandemic hit, she did the absolute most to keep us updated and still recorded her lectures! Take her!!!
She is the best professor you can take for this course. Has clear grading criteria and if you try, she will work with you. Do the work required and it will be an easy A.

I understand that teaching this course may be unglamorous because it's a freshmen-level required course, but Dr. Benton is so enthusiastic, kind, and supportive, which makes the course so much more inviting. She thoroughly understands that students fear public speaking and promotes their growth through encouragement and specific feedback.

TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. She is a wonderful speech teacher, and i felt that she helped me blossom from a shy individual into an outgoing speaker. This class was extremely easy, just speak clearly, show that you care about your topic and you'll get an A.

Took the 5-week summer session. Will end up with a close to 100% in this class. 5 total speeches (only 2 longer ones) and 2 very easy tests. Book is not needed outside a handful of test questions. I'm a natural at public speaking though so you may have to practice your speeches before presenting to ensure an easy A in this class.

Mrs. Benton is a great teacher. She actually cares that you improve your skills. Its not difficult to get an A, but you have to put in some effort. You really don't need the book if you pay attention in class and read over the powerpoints a few times. Considerate and great teacher overall.
Mrs. Benton is a great teacher. Public speaking isn't fun but she makes it very easy. If you put in a little effort you'll get an A.

Mrs. Benton was very consistent and you knew what to expect from her. We did several group projects and if you didn't like a certain group member she wouldn't make you be with them next project. I'd recommend taking this class with a friend. This way you're assured to get at least one good group member. I liked the class. I would take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: With this being a speech class, there were a lot of speeches, but the grading was very clear and straightforward. Relatively easy grader, there are only two tests and it's a combination of multiple choice, true & false, and short answer. She takes attendance every day and will take points off your grade if you don't show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Benton is amazing! She is caring and wants us to pass. She is specific about what she wants from the speeches; grading criteria, outline, time limit, etc. Do not skip class, attendance is taken. Do what she says and you'll pass with an A. Tests are okay. Some questions come from the textbook. Majority of the questions are from in-class lectures.

Her class is pretty chill. She is a super nice Speech professor and her tests are really easy. All the information on them is provided from the powerpoints that she posts on Blackboard. She grades easy. Just try your best and come prepared for presentation days.

Don't buy the book. Take notes during class and look over PowerPoint. Tests easy A. 2 Tests and are straight from PowerPoint. She checks attendance and can only miss 3 classes. She is very caring and understanding. Make sure to practice speeches (4) and read the time limit. No final just speech. Sweet and funny teacher, wish I could take her again
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many--Caring

reviews.comment: She is very sweet and makes the class a warm and friendly environment for public speaking. She is clear about her expectations for tests and presentations. As long as you show up and do what you're supposed to, it's an easy class!
It's a coms class so expect to speak. If you are nervous about public speaking don't worry, Dr. Benton makes it really easy and is not a harsh grader at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: She was very sweet and graded fairly

The departmental exams are very difficult, I failed all but the first one. Get the highest grades possible on lab assignments, homework and podcasts. This class will require out of class study time to succeed but it is doable. Thankfully, Prof. Agarwal rounded my final grade to a C so I never have to see another accounting course again.

I recommend taking Rohit for acct 2302 because he provides notes that go along with every lecture, works on class examples with us, and overall is a good professor. He provides you with everything you need in order to be successful within the course.
He is a great professor. Very caring and wanna make sure you understand The material. I took him for ACCT 3311 and it was great. Take him!

Took him during the 5 week summer session . He really tries to go over everything and make sure you understand the material. However I feel like I would have enjoyed his class more if I had taken it during a full semester. Great professor.
He really is considerate of how students learn. Great teacher, if you go to class and do all the homework you'll for sure get an A.
Great Person and wants you to Succeed.
he is super caring and takes the time to help you! very efficient in teaching the accounting concepts and definitely cares about his students i highly recommend taking this professor

He truly cares about his students and is very good with communication. It was probably the hardest course I've taken at UTA so far but he tries to help his students out so much. Daily quizzes which you'll need to read the textbook for and homework about every week. He drops your 3 lowest daily quiz and 1 homework grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you have the chance to take this professor, do so at all costs. He genuinely just wants you to learn and succeed without having to stress out over the course content.

If you want to get exposed to ANSYS APDL/Icepak then this is the class to take. Projects will help gain acquaintance with the software, but try and be a part of a group that is ready to put in the time. A lot of international students take the class, and 90% of them are enrolled for an easy A without having to attend a single lecture.

This is an easy A class if you show up, have the book (solution manual will be a bonus), and do the homeworks. That's it! Funny professor though, and has a lot of insight in his field plus a lot of Masters/PhD students under his belt. Lectures are a little bit boring though.
Was not very inspirational and graded by a few projects. some grades didn't make sense and did not give good feedback, is obvious about his favorites in the studio.

Rhino proficient. Energetic but serious in the matter of presentation and progress. Professor Luis helped me find my confidence when I needed it. Do yourself a favor, he is an excellent mentor / instructor.

Luis was honestly an amazing professor, was really encouraging when I took his class. He's really passionate about his work and gave some insight into the situation going in California as well as getting excited to make architecture that is sustainable and helps the community.

I was delighted upon taking this professor for my studio as he is so encouraging and always available to help. He is passionate about what he teaches and gives honest feedback. He is definitely not a rude architecture professor! His teaching style is to motivate students to bring the best out of them. Best professor hands down! Take him!!

He isn't very good at explaining himself so you will have to learn a lot on your own and the labs don't correlate with the class. The homework he does go over it the day it is due but it makes it more complicated and harder to understand. He seems Kind and funny the first few lecture but after exam 1 I saw that it was going to be a difficult one.
He teaches from very unorganized power points and takes a long time to get to the point.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: HILARIOUS laugh, just play along. Some homework, just find what's asked for. Does the homework in class before it's due. Will try to trick you on homework. Tests can be difficult or easy depending on how much you learn from him, so they'll be very difficult. Not a great professor but an easy professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: First day he seemed like a great, funny, and helpful teacher but, after a few days the class was lost. He knows the material really well but, he will go into to much detail when he should not. The class I took should have been more construction based IMO and then followed with an example but, the work was thrown at us.
He's kind of all over the place, probably because he's old. His lectures are kind of confusing, he expects us to know everything as we've already taken this class but we haven't.

Professor is unorganized and does not follow the syllabus or go over all of the material in class. Does not respond to emails and if you are an online student forget it. The posts will be 3-5 days late and due the next day or posted on Saturday for a test on Monday. Tests on items not covered in class.

Professor will treat class like its a joke. He has no structure or organization. Yes this is a tough class that requires reading and attention to detail throughout the course. If you study you will pass. Very touch grader. Forget getting A or B in her class. Don't expect to learn any thing except non stop assignments. Very hard quizzes not from the text book.

Very easy course. Lays a great foundation into the field of nursing. Coursework was manageable but hated the discussion boards, but this wasnt the only online course I had to do db on. Interesting course, great instructor.

frusrating

she is willing to help and loves feedback.

Your grade is only exams, so studying for them can be a lot. But she gives amazing lectures and makes the content really engaging.
Beyond the classroom Dr. Sandford is the real deal, she's a total badass. A respected professional in her field and is so open in inviting her students to networking opportunities. Best prof I've had at UTA by far.

Professor Sanford is exceptionally knowledgeable, personable, and passionate about her work. Professor Sanford is AMAZING! Classes are engaging and full of stories, so you can actually remember the cases. Come to class--you'll miss a lot if you don't!
She's an amazing professor with unbelievable stories that make the material click. She cares more about us actually learning than just getting a grade.

Amazing professor! Very knowledgeable in her field of work. Her lectures aren't the best, but everything is provided on canvas. Exams are easy if you prep your cheat sheet well. Just follows those great comment down there. He is a really great professor, he know how to teach, you actually learn in this class. Made 88 in class w/o study much for exams.

Really nice guy, boring lectures. 5% attendance, 4 exams,  12 short quizzes. Everything is based off, 30-50 slide, ppts. Go to class, study the slides, gaurenteed A. No curves but replaces lowest test grade with highest & only uses 10 best quizzes. 4-5 chapter ppts per test. Chapters arn't long and the material is mostly common sense.
I received a 79.52 and he wouldnt raise it to a B... You cant even understand the guy..

Dr. Khare was very helpful when you asked him for help. He does have a strong accent this is sometimes hard to understand but you get used to it. Lectures get a little boring but tests are relatively easy if you study. Good professor.
Nice guy, but not the best professor.  Very hard to pay attention to in class, difficult to hear and also monotonous. Do not recommend for Marketing Research.

Attendance is 3% of grade; sign in sheet each class. Missed a few classes and let him know ahead of time, he gave me credit for being there.  Tests are easy if you attend class and read the book. EASY "B", "A" possible if you put more time into it. NO LAPTOPS ALLOWED OUT IN CLASS.. even for notes.  Overall, decent professor- knowledgeable & helpful

I enjoyed Prof Adam's lectures, he was respectful and went through the slides. I did have an issue when it came to the test because it was very difficult to study for. A lot of the learned material did not match the tests. Prof Adams warned us saying it's due to the tests being from the department. However, if you do the HW you should be fine..

This professor really cares, and I think sometimes because these professors are so smart to the point, they don't know how to teach students with no background. He really cares, and he is always of help. Since it is at a department level, he only can do so much.

2nd time taking class. class is departmentalized so professors are limited with how they do exams. DO EVERY HW ASSIGNMENT/QUIZ AND SCORE 100% IF IT ALLOWS YOU MULTIPLE TRIES. TRUST ME. YOULL WISH YOU DID BY EXAM 3. DO GOOD on exam 1. exam 3 be prepared to drop 10 points in course avg. curve at end but unknown bc based on percentile. I made a C or B

Mr. Adams is a very tough Professor. The Tests are difficult with no study guides given and they are 75% of your grade, He only uses Excel while making you use calculator + pen and paper for test. After test 1 his "Textbook" is useless and doesn't relate to the Hw or quizzes. Take 10-20hrs per week to study and do hw and you'll pass
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: With this being a heavy workload online course in general, this professor explains each finance concept thoroughly and possesses a lot of knowledge in the subject. Dr. Adams is more than willing to hold proposed Teams sessions for needed questions and effectively explains what level of effort is required to successfully pass the course. Recommended
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: TOO MANY ASSIGNMENTS!! Didn't pay attention to any of his lectures. Forced to buy the book and never used it. Very organized. Dry jokes. 1st exam - little concepts, 2nd - concept heavy so I bombed it. Das why I have a B. To summarize, pretty easy class. Just do the assignments and study concepts. Exams allow open notecards. Final is comprehensive.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
Pros: I appreciate the organization and how content is laid out over the course. Curving is based on your ranking in class. You get a notecard for tests

Cons: Professor has a bit of a chip on his shoulder. You have to pay to access the modules, And pay to be proctored on top of what you paid in tuition. No backtracking on tests for some reason??
He is not helpful and is condescending. He doesn't teach anything and doesn't want to answer questions.

Took 5 weeks in summer. It's not that hard. Exams are just like multiple choice quizzes. Final was harder, so do well on the first 2. It is just going through modules, reading text, and answering quizzes which you have as many attempts as you like. His excel lectures are useless most of the time. Huge curve at end. He is a good prof just plan ahead

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. If you are looking to take a finance course over the summer, then wait. It is not worth it to try to get ahead if you have to go through this teachers curriculum. Ridiculous amount of assignments and completely pointless materials. RUN!

RUN the other direction! impossible summer class. I do not see how this guy has a single decent review. His lectures are pointless, he uses excel for what I consider every hard problem. But no not you, you must use good old fashion paper and pencil. 

He could care less about your success! He gets pleasure in his class being "most dropped" @UTA.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
DO NOT take Prof John Adams. First, know that the course is written by him and a co-author. Next, know that he teaches everything through excel in the lectures and modules, you have todo everything long hand on the test. 75% test grades

Lastly, be prepared for 8+ hours of work for each chapter with lecture, module reading, quizzes and test.
Lots of assignments
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I have ever had. His instructions are never clear and he is very unorganized. We were made to pay just to unlock the modules and also have to pay for the proctor exams even after we paid for all of it in our tuition. He wasn't present during the in-class exam he sent a TA who was completely unhelpful.

He was the best option for finance and although I did not get the grade I wanted. That is more on me than him, he has a lot of information laid out for students to succeed, it' just the class is hard. I will say the excel sheets are a pain but that is really the only objective knock I have on the class. Fina is hard but he's the best to take with.
A good professor, he might come off dull sometimes but he teaches what you need to know

I really enjoyed taking this course with Dr. Adams. It's departmental, so I'm pretty sure the workload is going to be the same, no matter which professor you take (which is decently heavy). Do all of the work and make sure you're able to do all of the problems in the modules before the exam and you'll be more than fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I have never in my 4 years of undergrad have EVER written a rate my professor review. But when I tell you to avoid this professor. AVOID HIM. The load work there is to this class every single week. HW 20%. Exams 75%. No curves, no reviews, nothing to help students out. Tests are on ProctorU (someone watching you) , have to pay to take exams.

DON'T TAKE THIS PROFESSOR PLEASE! I read the ratings here for him here, it was the biggest mistake I've ever made my entire college career! BIGGEST SCAM EVER!! Not only does he tell everyone to drop if you have questions, but he chills in florida (during a pandemic) and leaves everything to us. The TA grades super harsh! RIP SPRING 2021!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Got multiple 50%'s on Excel worksheets although there was only one cell wrong. His comment was that he didn't have time to grade the papers so he just checked one cell. if you did it and got that one cell wrong, you ended up with a 50% for something worth almost a letter grade.
Professor Adams has one of the most well organized classes at UTA. He quickly responds to emails and has detailed information online to help with homework.
All exams are proctor and it's extremely hard
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: It's a lot of work and very tedious but it helps you get use to using TVM. The majority of it is TVM and some concepts. Focuses on a lot of calculations. It's manageable if you stay consistent so don't procrastinate.

There's 4 exams including the final. The TVM has been the same since 2017 so if you have a friend that has done it, just use theirs. Tests are the same as the homework which is through pearson. It's a tough class, sort of like the level of difficulty with accounting at UTA.

FINA is departmental so its a difficult course. However, I loved John Adams! He was a great professor and I am glad I took his online course. His online videos for the modules were very helpful! Do the study plan questions with Pearson and you should do fine in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This Class is departmental and is one of the worst classes I have taken at UTA . I mean I understand making a class "challenging" but dude they need a change at the head or something because its ridiculous man.

Bros and Brodettes for the love of your sanity stay away from this professor . Homework is very time consuming ( especially if taking at least 12 hours in a semester) . You must make a 90% on all hw assignments to even take the test and preparing for his tests are torture . Stay away

I do not recommend taking this professor. He has great credentials, but the work load is absurd. you will spend 3-4 hours on over half the HW. Must work thoroughly and efficiently because you have to make a 80 or above to move to the next assignment. 70% of the class made F's on final... NO CURVE. grade dropped from an 82 to a 65 :'(
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Don't take him, homework is not even homework assignments they're quizzes and you must score an 80 or better before opening the next quiz and test can't be taken until you do all the quizzes. There are 3 group essays. There is a TVM assignment (13 pages). All test are lockdown browser. Final is over webcam ($20 fee) or on campus.

Took online, not gonna lie its very consuming. The homeworks alone on myfinancelab take about 1-2 hours each, exams take about 2 hours. all exams require lockdown and final exam can either be in person or through webcam. the exams test over everything covered in homework/mostly fill in the blank math questions

Do NOT make the mistake of taking from this professor! 4+ hour quizzes every week, and material is not taught so get ready to teach yourself.... Also, we have group essays. I am literally about to drop his class because it is too time consuming.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I enjoyed this class online. I think I probably should have taken it on campus since it is difficult and time intensive subject, but that wasn't working with my schedule. I did change my major to finance because I did enjoy this course and the teacher and his TA were very quick to respond to questions via email or bulletin boards.

This was his online course which was really well made and organized. There is a lot of homework and three essays. Most people including myself were not prepared for the final at all. He did offer a chance to improve grades by reworking old practice quizzes, I was able to get an A after getting a 68% on the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've ever had. I had him in class and he didn't prepare us for any of our quizzes nor our final. Made the final worth 40% of our grade and didn't set us up for success. I walked into the final was an A and got a C in the class. Told us if we had three absences, we fail the class automatically. He also forgot to show up for midterm.

Do yourself a favor and don't take this class online. Worst decision of my college career. Difficult test and even more difficult final. You basically had to go back through all the old homework assignments to study for that final.. and that still didn't help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: too tough on grading , not ready to work with students on tests preparation, too many assignements,
worst class I've even been in. never got lower than a B in my life until this class. awful. do not take this class online whatever you do. hardest final.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Adams was very enjoyable b/c he teaches through a conversation style rather than reading from powerpoints. He is very knowledgeable and encourages you to ask questions during class because you cover a lot of info and he truly wants you to succeed. The final is worth 40% but if you go to class he gives you everything you need to be prepared.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Adams was a great professor, one of the least boring lecturers I've had. Accounting Info Systems is an easy class to begin with if you know how to use a computer. Either way he seems to have a lot of real knowledge about the subject and gives great examples. Quizzes were very easy, straight from the book and three tries. Reviews were accurate.

This was my first finance class and I'm thankful I had Adams. Attendance is mandatory, but he made classes go by quick. Very intelligent man and gives lots of real life examples. Gives lots of opportunities for extra credit. Grade is based off of effort, in my opinion. Most of the grade is from your final, which he still curves at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: So we just had our final, and it wasn't bad - nothing we hadn't covered in homework or class, but it requires a LOT of study and prep. He also gave a good curve at the end, and an extra credit opportunity. He is good at teaching, and gives every opportunity to succeed and pad your grade with hw, etc. leading up to the final. I recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very difficult but he gives a curve on the final, which is the only test, so it ended up being ok. Have to go to class though, he drops  you if you miss more than 2 classes, and there are daily questions during class which are a big part of your grade and can really help you. He's not the clearest professor but he wants you to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Grade is based on comprehensive final (40%), midterm (10%), 4 quizzes (10%), learning catalytics (20%), dynamic study modules (10%), MyFinanceLab homework (10%). Lots to do every day. Only the final, makes it tough to know if you should drop. Miss 3 classes, automatic F.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This class involves a lot of busy work, and if you miss 3 classes you do fail, I wouldn't have been able to pass if I missed classes anyway. Fina is hard, but just like opma, bstat, & acct it'll be time consuming. Adams was a great professor, he worked through almost every question with us, if you are willing to show up everyday take this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: miss the class 3 times fail. make sure you knock out all the DSMs right away. they're on a study card site. do all the homework. majority of the class will fail the quizzes so most will be make ups. get your grade as HIGH as possible before the final; then brace for the 10 point drop. go into the final, and just guess. thats what i did :)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: avoid this professor at all costs. 3 absences and you get an automatic F. you HAVE to read at least 2 chapters in advance. he has in class questions that add up to 20% of the grade. he half ass explains what to do and when he's done he gives you 30 secs to answer so you either miss the explanation to google the answer or miss the question. (1/2)

reviews.comment: teach it yourself class, many assignments due every class. unfortunately none of those assignments will prepare you for the weekly quizzes. only one exam - the final which is worth 30%. lectures are boring but attendance is mandatory
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: HW and dymanic modules for every chapter on myFinanceLab, 7 quizzes, and in class learning catalytics. One comprehensive final and an easy but time-consuming project due at the end of the semester required by the FINA dept. I suggest you do all your HW and dymanic modules  to keep your grade as high as possible before the final. Difficult class.

If you have the option to take a different professor; you probably should. This class was taken online and the teacher does not provide you with enough materials to teach yourself. The Excel Files are very difficult without instruction and he is very strict on his grading. Both the Midterm and Final are taken in the testing center without a book.

Adams is a good teacher for this class.  He is humorus and class work involves learning catalytics done online.  We had 7 quizzes, 13 homeworks & Dynamic study modules (all done online, one for each chapter we covered). Quizzes were averaged and weighted the same as the final.  If you go to class and do the work you can pull an A in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Pre-Quizzes, homework, and quizzes every other week. The Final is your only exam, but the bi-weekly quizzes are equally weighted as the final. Pretty tough course but personally I just didn't like the teaching strategy used by this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I wish he would actually use class time to teach the material, instead he uses learning catalytic. You have homework for every chapter, a few quizzes, dynamic study modules, and the final. If you actually want to learn something you have to sit down and teach yourself.

Okay, I'm not sure why he's getting so much hate on here. I thought this guy was awesome. He made the material relatable, and his quizzes are easy to ace if you follow along in class. Overall a great professor. Funny too.  If you decide to take him, do expect homework though. And definitely show up and pay attention--you'll thank yourself later.

The course isn't too bad. You do have to complete online hw and study modules for each chapter. Also, class consists of very little lecturing and a lot of learning catalytics, you login online and answer questions. I actually enjoyed it. There is only one exam (the final exam), but there are frequent online quizzes that can be tough!

The course itself is BS if you're not a finance major anyway. Uses MyFinanceLab. Quizzes replace tests but they're tough. You NEED a financial calculator to do well. Will say that you're probably learning by yourself through reading than by lecture (which you should attend to earn points through Catalytics anyway.) Waste of time but UTA requires it

This is a tough class for non-finance majors anyways. But John Adams is absolutely not helpful at ALL. He always replies with another question. He's style of teaching is good, but has no sense of the classes progress. He grades on 1 mid-term, 1 final, Hmk, Learning Catalytic's and DSM (myfinancelab). Be sure to do the work. It saved by grade.

Not a typical classroom environment, lectures are intertwined with online questions that are counted as part of your grade. This class is very hard, the tests and the projects are the most difficult. He grades very hard. He did explain difficult concepts in a way that made a lot sense to me. He gives some extra credit, and curves test quite a bit.

Adams is by far the worst professor I have taken so far in the business department. His class is like a online game show, you show up to class and login online and pick a,b,c,d answers to questions he posts on the board. Tests are tough two big projects worth a lot of points and he grades them very hard. Stupid WACC project, TVM papers, HW

ATTENTION INSY Majors! Don't take Adams. There is way too much assigned. Study Modules, HW, Quizzes for 15 Chapters, 3 Projects, HARD Tests, Book+Calculator+project$300 extra. He does curve but you'll worry all semester. He knows his stuff, but won't help you learn, instead the computer will teach you, and the tests won't be as easy.

DO NOT TAKE HIM. I DONT CARE IF  HAPPENS TO FIT YOUR TIME SLOT AND YOU THINK "OH IT'S FINE BECAUSE I HAVE A REALLY EASY LOAD THIS SEMESTER." The man LITERALLY does not teach. You teach yourself by doing hours of homeworkreading. Treats lecture like a GAME SHOW. THE TESTS MAKE YOU WANNA DROP OUT. Refuses to give direct answers. THE MAN'S A SADIST.

Professor Adams definitely makes you work for the grade you receive. Be prepared to understand in class lectures, homework, and the textbook in order to be able to do well on the exams you must study all three. Class takes a lot of time, but ultimately it is very attainable to do well. Ask him for help and he will gladly explain things.

Definitely doesn't make you feel important but he curves like crazy because class averages on tests are in the 50's. I was failing almost all semester and made a B for final grade.  Lots of homework and a big capital budget project, do not miss class on days where he explains those instructions or you will be in the dark.  Record lectures

No point in attendance since I went to every class and it didn't help. You are better off reading the text from home. He is not helpful at all & doesn't care to elaborate. Only people that understood what what happening were finance majors & even they had many questions. Makes the class harder than necessary a lot of busy work but no learning value

Homework is mandatory, long, and a waste of time. Nothing on the homework is on the test. He gives extra credit for doing extremely time consuming study modules online which for a few extra points I didn't think it was worth it. There's a project which you're basically on your own with since he didn't help nor set clear instructions for.

Worst professor in the world, extremely hard exams, he's very lazy, does not help, weekly homeworks take about 3 hours, 3 projects all semester long, modules take 45 minutes weekly, quizzes are hard, he does not care. He shouldn't even be teaching

I'm not really sure why Adams has such bad reviews on here. I didn't expect this class to be a breeze, and it wasn't. Basically all the test material is from the Dynamic Study Modules, Learning Catalytics, and HW. Adams expects you to take an active role in learning the  material, do that and you'll do fine.
He is very very lazy. Everything in his class is not clear. He made a lot of mistakes in everything. The class should not be hard, but he made it very confusing. Try not to take him for any classes.

I feel like I've been set up to fail with this prof. Tests are NOTHING like the homework and he expects you to teach yourself. Lectures do not cover test material and when I sought guidance from him his feedback was worthless and he didn't seemed to care. I expect a B from this class I know going into MS I'm doomed. Thanks prof for the worst class!

It baffles me that professors like this still even have a job. Homework might seem easy but the tests are the exact opposite. His idea of "teaching" is to make students do problems in class that half of the time, everyone guesses on. I always aim for A's but with this class, I couldn't care less and just want to be over with it. AVOID THIS CLASS

This man expects you to learn 85-90 % of the material via the textbook. His lectures are usually very dull and have no real importance to when it comes to test time. Don't expect a review, don't expect to have him help you out, and don't sign up for this god awful class.

I found Prof. Adams to be very helpful. The course material is a bit difficult but if you come to class prepared and ready to ask questions it's not too difficult.  He also gave real-life examples that were interesting.  I would recommend him.
Very easy A

You will learn mainly from the book just as you did in the accounting class you had to take as a prereq for this class. You will also be assigned homework problems on the MyLab platform (these are really helpful). You will learn to master the financial calculator in order to survive. 3 Exams + Final are all MC. 1 Project.

He also does NOT give any exam reviews. He will teach to the very last minute before every test. Homework and classwork is different than exams. Teaches a problem only once and moves on. He will only curve so the class will average a 75 for each exam and also for the course even if it is a 1 point curve. RUN FAST!!!!
Cool guy, but he's hard. If you're overall smart and can self teach this class will be easy. His teaching style sucks and homework is nothing like the teaches or the tests. Don't recommend

I agree with the comment prior to mine.  He seems friendly enough in class, but his responses to emails are short and meaningless.  He did assign a very difficult and time-consuming project in the last two weeks of class which was due during the first week of final exams.
Tests and homework are nothing alike. Does not allow notecards or formula sheets so they must all be memorized. He is passionate about the subject though.

This is a hard subject! Hit the ground running. Listen in class. Attend all lectures, do homework (every week w/few exceptions) do not slack! That is what is required for this class. He does extra credit (1.5 points) and drops a quiz. Not Easy...but I feel better for having completed his class. Idk other professors styles but he made you earn grade

He is terrible. He is the least helpful professor I have ever had. Dont even bother asking him any questions via email. He will be rude and refuses to help. UTA needs better finance professors. He is the worst. He is also a lot harder than others, gives a lot of hw, expects a lot, and refuses to help. STAY AWAY. One of the worst professors I've had
he has a nice presence, but he is not good at instruction. The notes he provides for test are vague, if you are not a finance major his lecture style is eared towrds students who are finance majors.

I enjoyed Professor Adams' class his lectures go fast but if you can keep up he works through almost any problem you will see on the test and gives favorable curves on the tests. Come to class and study for the tests and you will do well in the course.
Don't take this professor. He knows the material but he's not very good at teaching it clearly. Examples given in class are easier than test questions.

Very boring lectures, but that's the material. Attending is helpful just for learning to use calculator and for any surprise exam stuff. Gave 12 online quizes and dropped 2 lowest. 3 midterms and a final all mult/c - usually 3 to 6 point curve. Class is very easy if you study book and work his online reviews. Only need occasional notes from class.

Professor is incredibly vague as to what will actually be on the test. He has a fun way of presenting a problem, showing a formula, but then teaching from the calculator which does a good job of confusing the entire class. No cheat sheets, tons of formulas to memorize, tests are very hard, and minimal curving. DONT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!!

Quizzes and tests are difficult and examples given in class are on a very simple basic level. He provides formula sheet for the test but they are mainly accounting formulas, not financing formulas so you have to memorize all of them. Would recommend another professor.

I really don't want to give this professor a bad rating but this class is awful. He is a very respected professor on campus but the book he wrote for this class is littered with errors. There are typos on exams and homeworks as well. Avoid if you can. I wish I could say something nicer.

Dr. Adnan is one of the best professors in the MAE dpt. You can tell from his teaching style that he really cares about the material & does his best to be as clear as possible to his students. The guy deserves outstanding faculty of the year award, very inspirational & brilliant. Exams are a bit tough, review HW and old exams & you should be OK.

Usually I wait until the end of the semester to review a professor however I would like to say Dr. Adnan is fantastic. His lectures are easy to follow and the book goes along nicely with the lectures and homework. Exams are almost exactly like the homework and he responds to feedback on exams. If you can take this professor.

Dr. Adnan is probably my favorite professor in the entire college of engineering. The material covered in class is very tough but he makes it easier to understand and will go over a topic as many times in class as needed for everyone to get it. Homework is doable and is good practice for the exams, which are tough. Overall, he's a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The material covered for the structural statics class is very tough. However, he makes it really easy for you. HW is pretty challenging, some of them will take you a good amount of time. Still, I found the exams to be fairly easy. Sometimes he gets confused with simple stuff, so be attentive during class. Finally, the textbook could be improved..
He wants you to do well and he would do his best so do your best.

Honestly one of the better professors. Homework is assigned weekly and is either pulled from the book or somewhere else. Two midterms and one final, the final has questions from the hws and two midterms plus the material he cover in the future.

Hard class.But he teaches really well the subject material and also teaches you how to think like an engineer.He really wants his students to have good grades.Very helpful professor.Highly recommended!!!

Extremely hard class. Most people i know were glad to have past with a C. He seems to teach well and tries to get u to understand but his exams and tests are out of this friggin world. sometimes theres hardly any correlation to what was tought and what he dishes out in exams. If you want an A, do not take this guy, Period.

He is a good guy and tries his hardest to get the point across to his students. Homework and tests are more conceptual but he is very willing to help. Use his office hours!! I would recommend him to others.

Dr. Adams is an amazing professor, I took psyc 2300 (stats in psych) and it was a straight forward class. He made the lectures engaging and easy to understand and follow. He encourages you to ask questions during and after class, and he will happily answer, so take advantage of that!  Highly recommend taking him whenever you can!

Took him for developmental psychology and the course load was not too hard. The only "hard" thing about the class was the McGraw Hill assignments which had lots of questions. All tests and quizzes are open note and open book and are fairly easy to look up in the textbook. You will always get a 100 on homework assignments as long as they are done.

He is very straightforward and gives us multiple days to finish the exams. Easy class, just McGrawHill Assignments (which are time-consuming!!), quizzes, and exams that are open book/note. He does not do extra-credit or curves, but as long as you get the work done, you won't need it!

The class was very easy because of the open note tests and smart book assignments for completion grades (though they are annoyingly long). The only remotely challenging parts are the quizzes because the answers can be hard to find at times, but still manageable. Overall, take him
he so chill

Very laid-back and hilarious! Took him for statistics and math is not my favorite nor strongest subject so it was kind of boring for me. The work was fairly easy for the most part. His TA grades all the assignments, his feedback can be confusing sometimes but maybe that's just me because again - not a fan of math.

This class was very straightforward - everything he says will be on the exam will be there cuz its on the slides. Lab was fun even though we have to talk for 3 hours. Treat the class like its a fun conversation with him and you will be able to answer questions easily - I never took notes. Attendance is an easy part of the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Love adams! Took this class online while taking his 2300 in person. Your smartbook weekly assignments are worth 60% of your grade. Don't miss one or it drops, but they're easy and you get either 100 or 0. 3 exams, and a few optional zoom lectures with a quiz for that lecture. Very straightforward.

If you take him online, it's an easy A. The weekly assignments are 100 or 0, and if you do them, you'll get 100. He held 5 Zoom meetings over the semester (focusing on evolutionary mismatch), and then there was a quiz after. Everything was open book, open note, and open web.

Graded P/F but you pass if you show up. More like a small group than a class. We read 1 PDF about what good college teachers do and then made short PowerPoints over topics that we are interested in. He definitely wants you to explore your interests and understands that we already have a lot of work in other classes. Easiest hour a week in my life.
Dr. Adams is an amazing professor I definitely recommend taking this class, you won't regret it. He is very helpful if you ask and gives great lectures.

He's so fun. He'll tell you exactly what you need to know and what parts of the course you will need to remember in real life. It's very hard to fail this class, just do your work and you'll be good. He has study hall periods whenever we have a SPSS assignment so we can work on it with him and the TA close by if we have any questions. Love this guy

Very easy class with a very small course load. Most of the class is online through Pearson. But he did post a few lectures along with quizzes for them as well. Exams weren't hard at all, all the questions are from Pearson and past lecture quizzes so you would have already seen the questions prior.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is an easy A. However, make time to do the weekly Smartbook assignments since it makes up most of your grade. The tests are open-book and open-note, so make sure you take notes over the key points and definitions and the powerpoints he shares on Canvas.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Adams is the best instructor I have ever had. Lectures are fun. He will cold call on you so be ready to answer the class-wide quizzes. He truly cares about wanting you to understand what is being taught. Test are over power points and homework is in an online textbook. Note that attendance is mandatory. Showing up is a majority of your grade

Attend class cause that's a grade, 2 exams and quizzes worth 30%. SPSS assignments (worth 30% too) suck. And he gives you the final despite not having put in two SPSS grades, what a joke. The exams are open and done at home, but were still hard. Takes forever to grade, is annoying, doesn't respond to emails, and isn't very helpful. A joke.

Super simple online class. Only 1 connect assignment is due each week which takes at max 3 hours and you have the whole week to do it. Tests were open-note and directly from the connect assignments. He planned optional Teams lectures every so often covering an interesting topic which gives you an opportunity to participate or ask questions.

He is so caring and nice to his students. He doesn't ridicule you for asking questions and will go over topics again if asked. He is also very accommodating for almost anything if you ask. Powerpoints are life savers for the open-note and online exams, as well as homework. Homework and exams were super simple and did not require a lot of studying.
Dr. Adams is great. He is always attentive to students, and does is best to teach. My only complaint is that he is kind of disorganized on Canvas.

If you see this online class in MyMav, take it. As long as you do the weekly smartbook assignments (which essentially make up your grade), it's almost impossible to not make an A. Quizzes and tests are open-book and open-note, and you have lots of time to do them. Answers for them are also in the PowerPoints he gives out. Super chill class!

I absolutely hate statistics, but Dr. Adams was very good at explaining the material. He made sure to give everyone plenty of time to ask questions and was very patient. The SPSS assignments sucked, but he is generous with grading. As long as you pay attention in class, ask questions, and complete all the homework, you should be good.

Best professor I've taken in my 4 years of college! He encourages you to do your best and is very great at what he does! I look forward to using what I've learned in class! Thanks Dr. Adams, you rock!

Professor Adams is great and makes the material fun. 10/10 would recommend to any student. Class was composed of lecture and reading quizzes as well as 3 tests. Lecture was always fun and engaging. Take him!!

Show up to class and make yourself known to Dr.Adams. He is an amazing person and cares deeply about his students. I loved his class and learned so many new things about myself while taking Psych 1315 that has helped me become a better and more thoughtful person. He is an extremely fair grader. His tests arent hard if you take notes during lecture.

If you have the chance to that this class, TAKE IT!! I took this class online and made an easy A on it. Stay on track with your connect assignment, its what will save your grade by the end of the semester. The tests and quizzes are open book. The answers for the quizzes are easily found in the PowerPoints
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Caring--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: You have to have legit excuses documented or your grade will SUFFER!!! Be prepared for cold calls to reflect class-wide quiz grades & only 5-6 grades in this course total. Class discussions can help lower cold calling, talk a lot!! chill but also douche bag vibes but is also very kind. weird ik! if there is a problem def talk it out with him.

Actually one of the best profs out there, super chill and friendly. Mindtap (on Cengage) and SPSS HW can take a minute, so start those early and ask him for help. Two exams, both were open-note and open-book, although the second one acted more as a final, and was cumulative. Seriously though, if you see his name for a class, take him. He's so good.

If you have the chance to take his class, you should definitely take it! Hes such a caring professor and his lectures are very interactive as well. Genuinely had fun in this class. His exams rely very heavily on lectures. We only took 3 exams but they were all very easy (thats if you took notes and payed attention in class.)
Very nice and chill. A lot of homework but it is very easy. Tests and quizzes are open note.
Dr adams is very understanding if you have clear communication with him. Studying is a must if you want to pass his class. lectures are interesting for the most part, the beginning was kinda boring.
Every class I have had with Adams was enjoyable. He is genuinely a very nice person and his lectures are very interesting and insightful. I highly recommend taking any of his classes!

Best professor at UTA. Non-proctored and open book exams. Extends deadlines if more time is needed and doesn't assign hw during breaks. Genuinely cares and will do his best to help you out and make sure you've understood the material. If you can take him for any of your classes, do it, you definitely won't regret it!
Professor Adams's class was super easy and everything was open books!

Definitely take Professor Adams for PSYC 2300! It is easy and exams are open book. Exams were worth 30% of the overall semester grade. His assignments were worth more. Some of the assignments were time consuming since we used MindTap.

Dr. Adams is super communicative through Canvas. The course is very organized. You always know what to expect. He is very caring, and will even extend due dates to avoid giving us work during breaks! The assignments are super straightforward and ALL OPEN BOOK! (exam questions on quizlet) If you do what you need to, you will definitely get an A.

Very helpful prof and will explain anything if you have a question about the coursework! The work is hard at times but professor Adams makes it easy to understand and is not too strict on grading. If you do the work and study for the exams, you will pass! Ask lots of questions bc he genuinely wants to help his students understand the work!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class is rigorous & requires a lot of time but Dr. Adams makes it as straightforward as possible. My best advice is to attend every class, his lectures are really helpful and engaging. He is really helpful and goes around answering everyones questions during class. Felt like he actually cared about his students which was a refreshing change.

His students have developed a sort of cult following when it comes to Dr. Adams, and it's easy to see why. His lectures are nice, and he makes sure that people understand before going on, and does not mind repeating himself. He's genuine, which is refreshing within a professor. Overall, this course requires some work outside of lecture, but it's ok

(about John Milton Adams) Take him as much as you can! He genuinely cares for his students and wants to see you do well in his class! Easy A as long as you show up and take good notes. Tests were easy enough if you put in a little effort. Ask him questions if you don't understand something he doesn't mind at all!
Highly recommended. Take him and you won't regret it.

professor Adams is the most caring, understanding professor ever! he has been so thoughtful considering our current situation. I definitely recommend him, 10/10!!! one of my favorite professors and everything is self-explanatory; hw, quizzes, and exams! please take him over anyone else, trust me!

Not sure if this is the same John Adams for PSYC3310, but if so: hes been the most understanding professor this semester and cares about his students. Weekly quizzes and homework and provides powerpoints for the quizzes. Cant remember if his class was online even before the pandemic but Id love to take his class again f2f when this is all over
Hes an easy teacher to get along with, has engaging lectures, and the class has straightforward exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: A very fun professor who makes sure you're able to apply what you learn in class to your lives. Attendance is a H U G E part of your grade, all you gotta do is show up! An excellent professor, would recommend him 11/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I honestly don't know what to make of this class. Her lectures are extremely difficult to understand. You basically have to write down every word she says. She handwrites all her notes and it's just too little so I never really understood a thing. Her grading system is confusing and disorganized. She takes forever to grade. Do not take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Apathetic is the single best word description for her. Gets rude oftentimes on perfectly reasonable questions and makes you feel disrespected. I would not recommend this professor until you're used to being treated harshly. The worse thing an instructor can do is criticize a student for a question, and she seems to have a degree in criticism.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If she sees you otp twice she will fail you. All assignments must be printed & given in class, so that's an extra cost to the 2 required textbooks. The syllabus is incomplete- it doesn't even go as far as spring break. Lastly she says we'll do an assignment in class, then we have that class & it's never mentioned, so you never know how to prepare.

She is on a power trip. I received 95s on every homework assignment but my test were high Bs before the final I asked if she rounds she went off on me. My last homework she gave me a 93.5 giving me an 89.45. She counted off of the test for silly things which is what resulted in my high Bs. She was funny though. Worst college professor experience.

Spent 1/3rd of classes watching aimless videos that were vaguely related to class topics. Took FOREVER to grade and did not give good feedback. Gives 2 essays for midterm and final but gave grades for them after almost a month (or more). Group project didnt have any specific guidelines. Very disorganized grading system. Wouldnt take her!!!

I took her for her online course, she took weeks to grade one single thing she never told us what our grade for our final paper was. She uploaded the syllabus weeks late. She never answered her email whenever you had questions or anything. Horrible communication with her students. Bad teacher overall
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Roughly 30 classes in the semester, 10 of which were watching videos. Canceled class twice bc her dogs ran away. Canceled class once bc she was "too tired from grading all night," even though it took a month and half to return our midterms. This means we had no feedback for our 40% group paper. Basically just set us up to fail.

Great lecturer, interesting topics b/c global cultures! She likes discussion & feedback, will send ppl out of class if not participating (super easy tho so idk why anyone wouldn't) or reading material before class for discussions. Random quizzes, cool videos/quizzes. Grades papers heavily on grammar & kind of arbitrary/unclear grading for papers
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Adkins genuinely cares about whats she's teaching so even if you aren't interested in ANTHRO she makes learning enjoyable by how much she cares. Only a few test that are EXTREMELY easy multiple choice test, and 2 major papers done halfway through the semester and at the end. If you go to lecture you should be fine in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very passionate on topic tough. Has 2 major essays so get ready to write. But,she will personally peer review them to make sure you're grammar and spelling is correct. Take advantage of this. She gives test review a week before exams so you can start studying early. So, if you don't attend class make sure have book this will hep with review.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class isn't hard at all in my opinion. I honestly barely studied. I suggest attending every class, and reading up on things that you may not understand. I didn't really need the book because she explains things thoroughly, but used it if I missed something. Lectures can get boring, but the information is interesting. Just take some coffee.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Adkins clearly states that all of her students usually receive 85 on assignments, without individual feedback. She does not explain assignments well on what she would like, not does she return anything in a timely manner. The content of the class is actually interesting, sadly she ruins the class. I highly recommend not taking her.
reviews.rating_tags: SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY
