reviews.comment: Meh Professor. Lecture heavy and cancels class a lot. It felt like her personal problems were also somehow affecting how she graded. Super tough on grammar when writing essays. No tests- just essays. Wouldn't bump my 89.5 to an A. Lectures are interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Adkins is an okay professor. Her lectures are very heavy so take notes. If you take good notes theres no need to buy the book. She grades heavily on papers so make sure your papers are grammatically correct. Tests come straight from the notes. Study them youll be okay, dont? Itll be difficult. She hates phones out in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Adkins is a great lady but she was a bit of a mess. She takes forever to grade things. Her lectures are interesting if you participate but if you like to listen only it will get boring and you will find yourself doodling. Her tests are take-home essays which is helpful. She is a grammar Nazi when grading papers. Random video quizzes.

Adkins is awesome. Her class is very lecture heavy, but they are interesting if you like anthropology. The tests are easy if you study, she provides a review a sheet and ten extra credit points on each test. The two essays are also super simple. I'm taking her next semester for another class!
Professor Adkins made me absolutely love anthropology. 1306 is still hands down one of my favorite classes I've taken. Her lectures are super easy to follow along with and very interesting.

This class is ALL lecture based, so do not buy the textbook( I made that mistake). Literally every word she says, write it down. The tests are all based off the lecture which are pretty easy. There is always an extra credit on the test which is one of the free-response questions from the review.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof. Adkins is very knowledgeable and is very approachable. Her classes are lecture style and often times they can draw out, but the material is interesting and she has a knack for explaining things in a unique, relatable way.  Grade is based off of a few tests, papers, and attendance. Solid choice professor!

She is a very kind women that I have visited during her office hours and she provided a lot of very good information on continuing with my education in anthropology (I didn't even know I liked before her class). Her lectures may grow a little long at times, but she is a very good speaker and I had no problem with it. Just prepare for long essays.

A textbook is DEFINITELY not needed, as everything the test will be over are based solely on her lectures, however it is not a bad idea for those who need to read the material. Gives three tests and two papers, attendance matters.  Gives up to 10 pts. of extra credit for each test.  Lectures are interesting and papers are interesting to do.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: In the class, we had three tests and two papers. The papers were easy to do and honestly kind of interesting. If you pay attention in class you don't even really need to study. The tests are very easy. Her lectures are pretty dry but she's makes things funny and I definitely would take her class again!

If you can find another teacher, then you definitely should. She asks you to write 3-5pages on things that can not be drawn out that long.  Her test are  not from book but over her lecture, so take good notes also if have crisis and unable to make it to class more than don't take her attendance is a big deal to her. Test are extremely hard.

3 test aren't bad at all. Lectures can get long and boring but, everything on the test is covered in her lectures. She also gives a study guide. Listen in lectures + the study guide   good test grades.  The 2 analysis papers are death... don't expect to get a good grade because she grades hard. Overall good teacher. The class takes some effort.
I don't recommend taking this class for an hour and a half at a time... It tends to get long.

She is an amazing professor. Her tests are easy and she gives up to 10 points of extra credit per test. Her lectures are interesting and she is funny. I loved her class, and I would most definitely take a class with her again.
She is a great teacher. She is willing to work with you. Test are based off the notes in class so don't skip. Will look over essays before they are due for feedback.
Pretty decent teacher. Personally, this class didn't interest me. A lot of note taking. 3 or 4 tests, plus 2 papers. Responds to emails promptly. Attendedance is mandatory.

Lectures can get interestingboring at times. Explains material in simple terms and allows questions during class. Book not really needed she gives a good summary and info for the tests. Tests are easy there's not a lot of details to remember. Grades tough on the two essays. Should've gotten A but did bad on one test (personal issues..)

Dr. Adkins is amazing! I absolutely loved her class. She is very fun and her lectures are great. She lectures and shows a movievideo clip to help students grasp the concept much better. She is very helpful and caring and does everything she can to help her students.

This class was painfully boring. She constantly gets sidetracked during her lectures talking about unrelated things, and then is shocked when we get behind schedule. Her exams are not difficult, and it feels like a fairly easy A, but good lord, do you suffer for it. She's also rather snarky when responding in emails, so ask questions in person.
I loved her class! we did 2 fun projects and I absolutely learned a lot from her class. her class actually helped me with my biology classes. I totally recommend her.
She is not a bad teacher but she grades very harshly. No extra credit, no curve, no help. I don't recommend taking from this professor.
Her tests are kind of hard, she is nice, but her class is boring.

Never touched the book once. Came to class, took notes, did the review like you were supposed to, made above a 100 on each exam. She knows if you try hard, especially on the papers, since some students didn't go do the fieldwork required (zoo or museum) they got bad grades. She delivers her lectures perfectly. Pay attention and you'll get an A.
She is a interesting professor, but is not organized, constantly gets off topic. Hard to follow. Tests are hard. Papers are graded extremely hard.

Very good teacher! She is very interesting and nice. Attendance is mandatory and her exams are easy if you know the stuff she provides on the reviews. The book might come in hand for reviews/definitions, but other than that, just pay attention in lecture and you'll do great! Easy A.
Sweet intelligent women. 3 test go to SI and it we'll help. Gives review. 2 essays (but they are fun). Counts attendance. Loved her!!!

First off (referring to the comment a few below mine), you do not NEED the book! Her lectures are directly from the book.  I never cracked the book, took notes, and studied the reviews about 30 minutes before each test and had absolutely no problem making an A in her class.  Definitely a professor I'd recommend, and her class is interesting as well

Overall, easy. Make sure you actually pay attention during lecture. She provides keywords on the board but its your responsibility to write down her comments because some are not found in the book. Test were easy if you studied and extra credit is given on tests only. Attendance mandatory and you WILL learn a lot of neat stuff.

Her class is EXTREMELY boring. If you can pay attention the information is interesting but her delivery makes the class really dry. 2 paper 3 exams. Papers are easy and exams are ok if you study the review. She doesnt provide notes she writes key words down but the info on what to know is unclear so you NEED the book!
Adkins is a really cool professor, she has lots of knowledge in her area and keeps class very interesting. Tests can be a little difficult and tricky but the class is very enjoyable.
dis teacher is bomb yo!      Eas clas, jus study for dem tests and ask for help on dem 2 short papers you have to write.
I really liked her lectures and she's funny so she keeps the material interesting. As long as you listen in class and do the reviews she gives, then you will do well in her class.

She was not a good professor. She was never free to help and avoided helping at all costs. She could not teach and it was obvious, you would be better off studying on your own than listening to her. Her grading never made sense and if you asked about it, she could barely explain it herself.

She is not a good professor, if you can take anyone else. She jumps around from topic to topic, and never fully explains anything. She will never tell you the grades you have to guess where you are at. She is very unorganized, for example, she gave a project due 8 hours before the final exam because she forgot to give it before.

She is very organized and professional (which are qualities I have not been seeing from other professors this semester). Her lectures and video notes are very helpful, she really explains concepts very effectively. She also gives a lot of extra credit. Overall, just attend the lectures, do the homework, and watch the video notes and you'll be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: You have to put in work, but she's understanding of the fact that the course is 5 weeks. She's young and always available to chat, email, etc. You will get a good grade if you ask for help and show effort plus she always gives extra points. Homework on pearson each week with a take home test and one final exam. (Just need pearson access code)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Treats you like high schoolers; no sense of humor
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Exams are quite difficult, at least at the graduate level.  Not a ton of homework, but each assignment is hard.

This professor does very well explaining difficult material and enjoys providing feedback to us students. This class was exam heavy and is a fairly tough exam grader (you must show appropriate theory to support your answer for full credit even though your answer value is correct). Practice his study material to get a good exam grade! Time consuming

Dr. Ahmari was fantastic. This was just the lab for Fluid Mechanics. But there were still tests that were not difficult if you study by reading the lab manual and knowing some of those equations/ theories. Pro tip, also study your own lab report specifically the graphs. I loved how he walked around asking questions during the labs. Hes funny too.

You are surprised when you get the grade of exams and assignments. Tests are not open-book. You prepare a page formula sheet. He deducts credits even from a small calculation mistake. If you find 3.3 rather than 3.4 say goodbye to 20 points. Plus, you have to have a really good relationship with him to complete the class better than C. Good luck!
Intimidating. Grades harshly. Can be vague at times. Purposely chooses homework problems that have incorrect answers in the textbooks he recommends for his class. Good luck.

Great professor. Difficult subject material but he gives students plenty of practice exams to study off of. Tests make up 90% of the final grade. Hes a tough grader but thats how engineering is sometimes. The Gupta textbook he uses isnt the greatest. Hibbeler is better.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Great Professor! He really cares about his students. The class is difficult and the test aren't easy either. But he gives you everything you need to pass. He gives all of his old tests as practice, goes through numerous examples in class, and his test are really close to his homework and practice problems. Still, you gotta put in the work to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Unnecessarily challenging when I took him a while ago, even chegg won't save you. He's the only option for fluids as of now, even in the summer so you have to pass him. Does provide test review materials, practice those a lot, as well as hw and notes and you should be fine. I'm graduated now and like I said, unnecessarily challenging.
Tests were difficuly if you didn't put the extra effort in. He gives you all the material you need to pass such as past exam questions and in class examples. You had to work for your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tests are tough, but if you do ALL of the practice problems, homework, and review questions consistently, you should ace them.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hard homework especially his Exams

I am  happy to work hard and be challenged to be the best Engineer that I am able. However, there is a difference in creating challenging exams and homework in order to ensure understanding and making something overly complicated. HW arent graded to check for correct answers and understanding, they are ripped apart with a fine tooth comb. Good Luck
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He doesn't clarify and explain the material very well but you can get the idea if you focused on his lectures very well. Homework consider kind of hard but you can solve it after several trials.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Knowledgeable professor with professional experience. Exams are straight out of the course notes. The homework is more difficult but he gives you everything you need to do it. Very flexible regarding due dates; if you ask for more time or help--you'll get it. Put in a fair effort and you'll do well. I think there was one C in the whole class...

Great professor! At times lecture can be boring but he prepares you and actually makes you work for the grade you want. Review notes, do homework and make sure you understand the concept behind the problems and material. This is engineering, right?

All he does is read from the book. Doesn't explain anything. Also, tests consists of trick problems to try and throw you off and never really covers anything as difficult as what is on the test. You will learn more about fluids by throwing a rock into a river than going to class.
Highly intelligent person. He was very kind and understanding of people's modern-day struggles. 10/10

This course requires you to do the reading, and prepare for quizzes. It is also required that you be recorded while completing. You can use built in camera. Most questions are based on interpretation of material read, requires critical thinking. Unsure about an assignment requirements, email coach for exact guidance as they deduct points heavily.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This professor is absolutely horrible. He's difficult to understand and he jumps all over the place. Lectures are extremely long and very difficult to follow along with. I suggest student success if you want to be successful. All he does for lecture is make us play kahoots, its a big waste of time and money.

Awful awful lecturer. He is all over the place in lecture and bounces between topics and slides. You don't have a choice whether or not to take him because there is only 1 critical care professor at UTA.
he so good.

J2- Make sure to do his assignments before anything else! I know at clinical it can be crazy and you can get caught up in what the nurses/techs want you to do but make sure you do your work first! Do your assessment, write out your meds and there will be no problems. Remember you're a student, do the things you need to do to pass the course first!

Had him for J1/J2 at UTA for clinicals and he is truly a great professor. He is really devoted to teaching and wants to help you learn. He can be a little overbearing at times but it's well intended. You'll learn a lot with him! DONT ASK to go home early but sometimes he usually will let you. Ask questions, be engaged and you'll do well! good luck!

Took him at UARK. Amazing prof, knows his stuff very well. Lectures are engaging, but he's going to make the class engage in discussion one way or another. The course (Hitler in Film) was entirely graded on attendance/participation in discussion, and papers. No midterm or final.

I have taken 2 courses from this professor and absolutely enjoy his class. Classes are seminar based and he knows how to keep students engaged, there will be some reading each week but he keeps it very interesting as he is the author. Thomas Adam now teaches at The University of Arkansas and I was very bummed when I found out, page needs updating
I took two classes from Dr. Adam. Fine person, fine instructor. He demands participation in class, and the students respond well.

I took him for a summer class up at the UofA and he was great! I loved his class and learned so much. For a 4 hour class, he was able to make it super engaging. I would highly recommend taking his courses as he is very passionate about what he teaches and really wants his students to learn.
Tests are unclear and all essay. Goodluck on getting feedback for essay. No extra credit and hes pretty rude
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The most knowledgeable professor I've had on 18th and 19th century Europe. Teaches like a modern Socrates. Tests are take home, essays are 2 pages no citations needed. All that matters to this professor is that you learn something. Simple memorization is not needed, but critical thinking is, be able to explain why things happen the way they do.

Dr. Adam is respectable, but he is very tough. You have to be very attentive and go above and beyond to do well. His classes are all very tough and time-consuming as well. You will learn a lot, but you will read, participate, and study harder than you could imagine. I took multiple classes he taught and learned so much. But, again, tough courses .
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Less lecture, more seminar discussion style. Lots of reading, lecture expands understanding by leaps and bounds and makes the material relatable. Subject matter expert, easy to respect. Includes individual student's skills in the class, such as translating language. Every class ran to the end of the period, and it was an interesting class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: In the world Civ class I took with him the lectures didnt matter. The only test grades were quizzes from the book he wrote which wasnt bad. Basically just come to class and do work for another class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Ridiculously tough, but very respectful, respected, and willing to listen. You need to read for his classes (I've taken a couple), but you will learn more than you thought capable of a semester. Be ready to work hard! There are only a few assignments we received grades for. Be prepared to ask lots of questions b/c participation matters!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: One of my favorite prof's, but he is very difficult. You must do your work, stay on top of the readings, and participate (which is about 30% in the two courses I've taken). I love his class, but again, you must work for your grade. He is approachable even though he seems intimidating at first, too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Hardest class of my undergraduate career, however, I learned that I was capable of writing an essay over 20 pages. This class gears you towards grad school. Mostly student led with some questioning from the professor.

Dr. Adam is a premier undergraduate professor, and by taking him you will be trained how to be a professional historian if you are choosing this course for life. Although his rigorous reading schedule may seem tough, he only makes you read what he needs you to understand and will pull test questions and in class discussions directly from the text.
Very challenging but stimulating.  Just what I needed

Those who are quick to dismiss or berate Prof Adam's class probably have no business being there in the first place. This class is intensive and challenging, as are most worthwhile academic endeavors. If you keep up, you will be fine. Dig for answers! He likes it. Prof Adam is very helpful. READ!

Dr Adam is easily one of my favorite professors. A lot of people leaving comments here are complaining about his 3300 class, which I also took. Yes, it is difficult. But all 3300s are. The goal of the course is to write a 20+ page paper. To prepare for the rest of the History degree. FYI - He teaches German History. His quizzes/tests are open book.

I was nervous about this class from the beginning but I am so glad I stuck it out.  I don't know what my final grade will be but I will be a better student because of him.  He has challenged me to look beyond the conventional topics and interpretations and see other possibilities.  He has given me a small glimpse of grad school and I can't wait!

hard class run like a graduate course. read the material and study for the test and you will do fine. participation in class is what he likes. He was very helpful with my research paper, he reviewed it five times..! I dont know of any profs out there who would do that. If you want to learn, take his class. He is a fantastic writer.

Dr. Adam is a rude intellectual who makes it very difficult to pass his course. Unless Hitler is your passion, do yourself a favor and don't take this research heavy class. It is centered around Nazism.  He grades tough.  I am an accomplished professional writer w/ a minor in history and the best grade I managed to receive on my writing was a 'C'.

Instructor interacts vaguely with classroom discussion through head movements. German language, background on leaders, politics, history and geography is a required must. Lots of research and information cramming is necessary to pass course. Instructor is not cooperative.

Dr. Adams is very smart but not very helpful. I respect his accomplishments but I do not recommend this classes. His grading is very tough. Some people swear by him but he is not a good teacher for everyone. If you like to ask questions & may require help, this is not the teacher for you. If you do not require much help, then you will be ok.

Very knowledgeable professor and will make you think and question.  He assigns extrensive reading but makes for great class discussion.  Do the reading, you can't pass his classes without it.  I've taken a couple corses with him.  He is an excellent scholar, but you have to do the work to appreciate it.
Amazing teacher. VERY knowledgeable. Clear instructions, fair grading. Do readings, contribute in class and you'll do fine. You will be a better student in the end.
He's an excellent professor.  Homework is required, intensive reading.  I really enjoyed his class.
I've taken several classes with him.  He's an excellent teacher and a scholar on German history. He will extend himself to help you if you ask.  Not for the lazy people who don't want homework.

Contrary to what others have said, I took his 3300 class over the summer and loved every minute. Yes he has high expectations. Yes he will challenge you constantly. But if you work hard and actually do the reading you will get a lot out of this class and be better for it. Definitely not for those who want to float through school.
took 3 classes with him. got an A in all 3. Smartest professor at school.

He's not so difficult.  You do readings and discuss it in class.  There's usually a five question quiz on the readings, but it's open book.  He goes beyond the readings and makes you think in a different way.  If you plan on grad school I recommend him, he will prepare  you. He's German but his english is better than yours.

He's really hard to understand, grades the class like we're graduate students, there is a 40 question test from hell over an entire textbook which is extremely difficult not multiple choice but open ended questions. I would not take another class from him simply b/c of the stress factor. Half the class is failing, avoid this class if possible!

Abstract thinking, class is about as boring as you could ever imagine. This is a 3000 level class and he seems to think it is graduate level. I have a 3.0 GPA and have never felt so stupid in my life. I think I developed an ulcer from dealing with this man. DO NOT TAKE if you aren't an intellectual dingus like he is

Dr. Adam is amazingly intelligent, his teachings have left me more excited about history than ever. He is difficult and if you are shy i wouldnt take his class, he relies on participation. Always willing to talk to you about anything and is the utmost authority on Nazi Germany. I would rec him if you are up for a challenge. He is great!

Very difficult class. Abstract thinking. He gives very simple reading quizzes and lets you use the book on them. films he chooses to show are very interesting. Sort of intimidating, but overall a good professor
I ended up w/ a B in his class but be prepared to study everything in an abstract way. I liked the class but it was very difficult

Dr. Adam is a rare treasure among professors -- extremely intelligent, passionate, and challenging. He's a fan of the socratic method, so you can't just memorize stuff from the books. You have to think critically and answer questions in class. I've never learned so much in any class. Ever. His tests are not difficult, he focuses on participation.

Dr. Adam is an extremely helpful prof, but his class is very difficult. I struggled thru and hope that I make a B but I think a C will happen. If you take his class be prepared to think in a very abstract manner

Dr. Adam is the most intelligent professor I've ever had.  He is extremely knowledgeable and passionate about what he is teaching.  I will take as many of his classes as possible!  I highly recommend this professor.
to much work
Wonderful professor and very easy on the eyes
A very good teacher; he is incredibly smart. His classes are discussion classes so come prepared to talk. Tests are easy-just memorize a time line. He is my favorite teacher at this school.
Not helpfull at all... Never take History Hitler and Image. He is **** and has a temper
Good professor but his rosey view of communism was grating.

Some sources used for the class are un-available and he holds you responsible.  He has most of his students teach the class by answering him questions.  Other than that he knows what he's doing and he is very bright.
He is an excellent instructor!  Learned alot from him.  Test are the timelines, which are easy.  However, his article reviews are a bit harder.  Definately recommend!
Adam is clear and talented. A rare intelect even among professors.
Difficult to understand his accent.
Dr. Adam is a powerful teacher. His life growing up in East Germany provides him with a fresh view on European-American relations

TAKE HER IF YOU CAN!! The first time I took A&P 2 I failed it with a D and understood NOTHING with the professor I had. This semester I retook it with Dr. Ahles and I can actually say I learned and understood all the systems we covered. The exams are so straight forward and so are the quizzes. HANDS DOWN THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!!!!!

She's the best. She explains her materials in detail and doesn't assume that you already know stuff. It is very much possible to get an A on her quizzes and exams if you do the learning objectives. Also, attend office hours after every exam; they're super helpful. A&P 1 already has a lot of information to know but she makes it doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The best professor possible to teach A&P classes. Makes difficult concepts easy to understand. It is clear that she takes pride in her work, and she dedicates a lot of her time to create great lecture PowerPoints for her students. I took her for both A&P 1 and 2, and I feel like a super genius medical student.

BEST professor I have ever had!!! I had her for A&P 1 and 2 and if I could take her for every class I would!! She really does have the student's best interests in mind and does so much to make sure we succeed. She makes her own fill-in-the-blank notes and as long as you know everything on them, the quizzes/tests are a breeze! TAKE HER IF YOU CAN!
ABSOLUTELY LOVE Dr. Ahles! I had her for A&P 1 and 2. If I could give her 100 stars I would. Highly recommend. She truly cares for her students success.

Dr. Ahles hands down is one of the best professors at UTA. She makes concepts very clear as well makes fill in the blank lecture notes. She also cares about her students & is very approachable! Despite there being two bad reviews on here which there shouldn't, she's the best!!!!

Ahles was a great professor, she was helpful in "dumbing" things down or did well at explaining specific topics or ways to help you pass. She changed lecture to follow the lab schedule which was super helpful at making me pass and do well in both lecture and lab.
was late to posting assignments so people complained so she stopped making notes literally at the end of the year.

Ahles is absolutely great for A&P I, she did a great job and had fill in notes, very easy to pass. BUT she was all over the place for A&P II. She constantly posted quizzes and homework late and would have them due within the next 2-3 days. She may just have been struggling because of never teaching it before, but this lasted the entire semester.

Highly recommend! She has fill in the blank notes and explains her ppts really well. Although there is a textbook, I only used her ppts and aced most quizzes and exams.Take her because she makes anatomy easy.

Great professor. Gives resources that help you do well on exams. Go to the lecture and use her notes. At the end of the day, your grade is up to you. She is clear and gives you everything you need to succeed, your job to study and do assignments outside of class.

Dr. Ahles is one of the best professors UTA has gained. Her slides are fill in the blank so attendance is a must! She likes making class interactive with questions based on topics that she is teaching. The textbook isn't needed, but does come when you buy the homework software as an e-text. Hands down would take her class again!

I took Dr. Ahles in the summer of 2022 for A&P1 & I loved her lectures! I still remember more than half the material that was taught. I never used the textbook since her lectures covered everything I needed to know. Also, the fill-in-blanks for her lectures really help me memorize everything being mentioned. Totally recommend!

Dr. Ahles was one of the best Biology professors I've ever had! She gives you fill in notes to use during her lectures which are incredibly useful when studying for her exams. She really cares about her students to another level, as she asks for feedback from her students. Additionally, Dr. Ahles gives out prizes to those who attend her lectures!

Took her for A&P 1 after attempting the class with Henry the previous semester and she is truly the best thing that has happened to us. I actually learned stuff and as long as you pay attention to her slides and study them for tests, you will get an A. All I did before tests was study and memorize all of the slides along with going over the hw.

Hands down the best professor I've ever had. She uses fill in the blank notes with lots of pictures and explains everything very clearly. She genuinely cares about her students and wants them to succeed. There are quizzes once a week but are easy when you read through the lecture notes. Exams aren't too difficult and the lowest grade is dropped.

Dr. Ahles was an amazing professor! She simplified the material from the textbook onto PowerPoints and explained everything well into depth. Although attendance isn't mandatory, she awards little prizes for those who show up to class! She also drops your lowest exam grade! Take her! She shows that she cares and wants you to succeed!

(BIOL 2457) She does fill in-the-blank notes so make sure you show up to class because she does not post these notes if you miss them. She has 5 lecture exams and a final. A couple of quizzes per chapter and homework, in-class participation then lab of course. She thoroughly explains everything and is easily available. Best professor I've had!

(Was in BIOL 2457)For those who say AP is hard regardless on who teaches, they have not had Ahles!! Hands down best teacher, she actually explains the context, uses examples etc. Gives homework, has office hours daily, and learning objectives to study to prepare for the exams. 10/10

You can really tell that she enjoys teaching anatomy! She will tell you what to know for the exams. There are  weekly online quizzes and homework, but you're fine as long as you have her notes. A&P is a difficult course, she always answers questions and explain difficult concepts multiple times. Take her class, you won't regret it!

I would highly recommend taking her. she dumbs down the material so that anyone and everyone can understand it. You do have to study well for her tests, but she provides you with everything you need to make a good grade. She's top tier PLUS she gives out attendance prizes to reward people for showing up to class

This is the best professor I have EVER had. Dr. Ahles is patient and kind and genuinely wants you to do well in her class. She breaks down content to where it is understandable and tells you exactly what to study. I will be taking her for A&P II!!

Im taking her for A&P 1 and shes amazing. She has great lectures and slides. The only downfall is the amount of cousework. There are usually 2 homeworks and 2 quizzes per week, and on exam weeks we have all of that + the exam. Overall I really enjoy her class so Im 100% taking her for A&P 2 next semester!

She is a great professor would definitely take her again under different circumstances. This is just a forewarning for students planning on taking any classes I would recommend taking both A&P courses at another school. The classes require you to buy a webcam for the quizzes and exams. Also, you will be required to purchase an attendance app.

Absolutely amazing, she is great at explaining and helping you understand the material, her lectures are interesting and you actually learn! There was quizzes and exams that used lockdown browser and lots of homework but it is all helpful material. We filled in blanks from her ppts during class so it was easy to pay attention.
One of the best in the math department. He makes his lectures easy to understand, engaging, and interesting. He's a tough grader and makes you work for your grade though. Very fair.

Loved the class! He was also pretty easy to reach outside of class and had a lot of office hours if we had any questions. It felt like there was quite a bit of work in this class, but then again a lot of math classes I have taken felt like that anyway. He wants you to do well, but you have to put in some work.

He's a very chill professor and has good lectures. Though the course itself isn't too difficult, one issue I have is that the workload, at least in comparison to my other classes, was a bit much. The class felt like it was a bit more of a commitment than it should've been, but that's because he wants you to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was a decent professor and his test are not that bad. I found others saying that his lectures were great, but personally I did not learn from him very well. The homework is not bad at all and his key assignment is doable.
Amazing teacher and unusually kind for a math teacher. He is a solid choice if you're taking calc 3.
Great professor. He knows what hes talking about and will answer any question you have for him. His tests are fair and even though he wont show old exams he does a review session for each midterm.

I suck at math, but he's a wonderful teacher. 2 midterms 25% each, final 30%, hw 10%, quizzes 10%. Curved the first midterm and curved the final very heavily. He explains a lot, gives exam reviews, very chill/caring. Would pick him over anyone else and that's coming from someone who sucks at math. Only negative, NO CALCULATORS.

A young teacher who understands what its like to be a student. Lots of chances for extra credit with lots of reviews for tests. Basically no homework but he still does a lot of examples in class which are very useful.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great professor! He is probably the most chill professor out there! Super straightforward about everything pertaining to the class. Always available to help or just talk. Takes his time to explain concepts and work out examples by hand with the class. Not much homework, but it is sometimes time consuming. P.S. TEST REVIEWS ARE EXTREMELY HELPFUL!!!!

Professor Ahmed was always available outside of class (email/OH). The class was all online with in-person exams. The tests were good, not easy, but good. The lectures were pretty good alongside the homework. I would definitely recommend him, but be sure you understand Calc III isn't "easy", you do actually need to apply yourself.
Super helpful and super responsive to emails. Gives extra credit opportunities makes reviews for his students that are super useful for the exam.
His explanations are quite easy to understand and he will re-explain it if you're still confused

She wasn't great but she also was not as terrible as people made her seem. Also took her for CE2153, and she was about the same. She has a lot of expectations for the final house project for 1252. Her midterms can be pretty hard so definitely make sure you know what you're doing.

Built a lot of assignments to help us navigate AutoCAD, which were generally fun to do. Only real problems were that the final project had details that made it difficult to do accurately, and that the class size often made it difficult for her to spend much time helping any one student.

The comments about her accent are overblown and very rude.

She has a very thick accent which makes it difficult to understand, she also explains things so badly so those hand and hand together make it impossible to learn anything in her class, she is an extremely tough grader and will not show sympathy. She does not give reasons or a proper explanation on why and how she grades you, just a percentage.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This girl is a flat-out nightmare, you will not understand a word she is saying, She does not know what she is talking about, and you will suffer at her expense. She left during a dissection which is a #1 not to do rule. She fails everyone on their write-ups and when given back a rubric on why and how we got the score we received, it was left blank

The class is an easy class, but she doesn't do a good job at explaining assignments and grading. She won't post the assignments until the weekend that it's due and grades it based on a rubric that we aren't given or even made aware of. She is also a really hard grader and will not be lenient at all if you have issues turning in an assignment.

The class is very easy but as a professor she is very hard to understand what the assignments are and what is expected. She had, many times, posted the assignment the sunday before the monday due date.

Professor Mohanakrishnan is a pretty easy grader in general. As long as you are not talking while she is talking she is a fairly positive and kind professor. She does take attendance on paper everyday and will take it again if she sees students leaving class. Easy A if you actually put in minimal effort.
This professor was so fast paced and you wouldn't actually learn anything, he would give out 10 assignments a week and once changed the due dates from an assignment

Most lectures he would vaguely talk about theory and if you had any questions he would not help. Little to no actual notes would go over solving problems, so you were on your own for the homework, and the exam is not based on the homework so if you don't teach yourself the material outside of class you will fail. Worst professor I've ever had.

Very kind professor, his lectures can be fast paced but that's because he wants to twist your arm into asking and engaging with lecture. Grades only on the exams, HW, and lab. Homework is unlimited attempts, lab is mostly up to the TA. Since exams are departmental do your best you study the old exams he has posted in canvas.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Ali was awesome. He genuinely cares about his students' learning. He is very accessible outside of class and responds promptly to emails. Although his lectures might be at a quicker pace than most, he encourages his students to stop him and ask questions.
Great teacher. Teaches and reviews everything you need to know for the midterms/final

This class is all about the exams which are worth 80% of your grade and there are three of them. If you do horrible on the first one, it is over already. He goes very fast in the lecture, finishing a whole unit in about 30 minutes, and expects you to know it afterward. Unless you are some math genius, it is nearly impossible for you to succeed.

Professor Ali is a very charismatic teacher who teaches very well if you pay attention and dedicate time out of class to review the material he teaches during his lectures. This class is super test-heavy as the 3 exams you'll take over the semester accumulate to 80% of your final grade.

I am not good at math at all but, Professor Ali is very passionate about teaching and very patient with questions. He held tutoring sessions which helped a lot! Gives reviews before the exam and extra credit quizzes. The lectures are pretty heavy and attendance is graded. He also goes very fast but, as long as you ask him to slow down he will.

Enjoyed this professor, extremely knowledgeable of content. Homework has unlimited attempts per problem on MyMathLab, enabling you to earn a 100 on each assignment. Exams were MC, with a review provided and discussed in class. Bonus quizzes were offered for each exam. Open to answering questions during lecture and provided flexible office hours.

He knows and loves math very well. I worked very hard to get an (A) and was 1 point away from it. when asked if he could bump my grade. In-person, he told me not to worry, since I never missed a lecture, and sees how hard I worked. But when I emailed him he told me that my grade is a (B) and he can't do anything about it. That B messed up my GPA
Dr. Ali is one of the best professors I have ever had. He knows what he is doing, as soon as you understand his lecture, you should be good to go "A"

I honestly have no idea how I got an A since the last math class I took I got a C. But I think that is because of Professor Ali, he is very helpful if you ask questions and will provide guidance if you don't understand something. While I still struggled on the exams, if you do well on the homework and other assignments you should do fine!

Professor Ahmed would go over the material as many times as needed. He would also provide bonus quizzes before one of our 3 exams which could earn you up to 5 points added on the test. He would also go over a review for about a week before the exam which would be very similar to the questions that would be seen on the test.

An Amazing professor he makes lectures simple and easy to understand. Attendance is mandatory counts for a grade. He does reviews before the test which are really helpful and also has extra credit for 5 points that helps get your score up. As long as you go to class and pay attention you'll do good .

The concepts covered in this course are very complex however he tries to break down each concept to an understandable level. His lectures are very interesting, and the test reviews are very helpful. As long as you pay attention in class and do the homework, you should do well in this class.
I took this class previously at TCC and failed. With him, I managed to almost get an A, explains Maths and makes it easy to get a B/A.
Really chill professor and teaches the course amazingly. Attendance is a part of your grade but the lecture teaches you pretty well.

Overall, just an average professor when lecturing the material. Instead of discussing the topics first he would go straight to practice problems while going over the material. I didn't mind since I took Calculus before, however, this led to many of the students being confused. Practice exams are key, HW is useless, and pay attention for in-class Q.

He refers to the textbook while working on examples in class. There are 2-3 homework assignments each week, all due at the end of the semester. However, they can be tricky and will build up if you don't do them. There is 1 written assignment that requires you to explain how to do questions and the exam reviews are very similar to the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Ali was an amazing professor. He was very kind and lenient. He gives extra credit on the test. More than one attempt on homework and quizzes. Drops lowest quiz and 2 homeworks.

Professor Ali was an amazing professor. He allows homework to be done at anytime before the semester ends and everything is unlimited attempts. He goes over the signature assignments and gives extra credit for tests. The tests are very heavy but he reviews them beforehand. Attendance is apart of grade and code is provided at end of class. TAKE HIM

Practically a dad that just wants you to do well. Will do signature assignments, homework, and extra credit questions with the class. Goes over test reviews with the class. Communicate with him and he will see what he can do; he changed the test format for my class, which boosted grades heavily. Pearson HW w/ unlimited attempts. Quizzes w/ 2 tries.
Overall a very great professor. He was very kind, understanding, and funny. There is a lot of homework but he gives plenty of time to do it. Definitely not a stressful class.

he was kind, had a sense of humor, and was all-around just an enjoyable professor. he did require you to buy the textbook at the beginning of class, but you honestly do not need it (i didn't buy it). as long as you do your homework, study, and review, it's an easy A. i mainly learned through the homework, not by lectures.

Lectures are interesting to listen to and it extremely easy class and he posts recorded lectures online. ALL his exams are multiple choice and his reviews are super helpful and similar to exams. Super easy A if you attend class and study well!

Dr. Ali makes this class super easy. He likes to joke in class, but makes sure we get through the material. There are only three hard deadlines throughout the whole semester. Review days before test are very helpful.

Gives you past semester exams (they are all the same) 20 questions, 2-3 free responses at the end. After hours, and lab. If you apply yourself just a little bit an A is achievable. Do not be scared of Math at UTA. I once was because of everyones opinion on it. But this Professor greatly helped me strengthen my math. Highly recommend,very passionate
This professor is unclear with his instructions, and does not speak clearly. He leaves too much online homework and he teaches the lessons a day before the exams leaving no time for reviewing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: edit to my earlier review (i'm the one who said "EXAMS!!). attendance IS a part of your grade. my bad

this man let me ask him the most ridiculous questions at the end of class and literally never complained. he'd actually have legit answers too. this class was so easy. he would literally not get mad at me for being late to exams. EXAMS!! TAKE. HIM. he's VERY good at his job.

He was a very nice teacher, the work was simple and easy to understand and there were extra credit opportunities. Try not to miss any lectures because he goes over the work and any questions you have will be answered.
Dr. Ali's lectures are really helpful. Easy grader. For the tests, just practice the class examples. He is a nice person.

Ahmed Ali is a great choice if you want to take calculus. He is very thorough with his lecture material and tries to make sure that everyone understands the material before moving on. However, make sure you go through some of the HW before the lecture on it in order to get the most out of them and study outside of class so you're not behind.

my tag says a lot of hw but that varies. there's weekly stuff and sometimes its heavier than other times but its manageable. he's a funny great teacher that is super caring and will give extra credit at the end if u need it. super easy topics too

Class started off easy, and ended a tad bit challenging. Make sure to show up to class bc he takes attendance on Canvas. Pay attention in class, or notjust make sure u understand the material. Very cool teacher, laughs to make dad jokes (laugh even if u dont find it funny). Attend office hours, hes really chill and very helpful.

If you are taking Calc 1, Dr Ali is the best option. He thoroughly covers each topic and provides study material for every exam. He is passionate about the subject and is not being to listen to. Homework is at your own pace, and Dr Ali will answer any questions you ask, no matter how dumb, and lemme tell you, there have been some odd questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you're like me and you struggle with math, I would be weary of taking this class with Professor Ali. I read his reviews and had high hopes, but this was my hardest class. Most of the material covered was stuff that I learned in high school, but he made it more complicated than it needed to be.

I don't know about the other math professors, but Professor Ali is a solid choice. He seems to really care. He tries to make the lectures as interesting as possible. There is quite a bit of homework though, but I think that's just the class. You can retake an exam at the end of the semester. Pretty straightforward class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I was excited to take his class when I read all the good reviews. Class was nothing like the reviews. Half of the time he was making mistakes or jumping around. Asks often if he needs to slow down but never does. Calculus needs to be understood to succeed but he teachers it like its algebra. Labs have little to do with the lecture. Pick a diff prof
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'd already withdrawn from Calc a semester before, and came out not really getting anything. From these lectures though, I was able to start to piece the concepts together. He would go thru many examples and would be very encouraging in his streams. We were able to learn comfortably. However it is a fast paced class no matter the professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! The lectures are very helpful. He makes sure that everyone is on the same page and prompts students to ask questions. He will help after class and during office hours. 100% recommend.

He made Calculus a lot more easy for me to understand (I'm terrible at math in general) through his examples and chapters. He offers practice exams from past years to help study and study sessions within class and labs. The TA was very nice and she was also always willing to help. Both are very encouraging and nice and make math more bearable!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This guy helped me understand calculus after not knowing what the heck I did back in high school. He wants his students to succeed and will go over information when asked. Calculus is quite a tough subject, but he makes it so simple it's amazing how I now understand math. Best calc teacher B)

Professor Ali is the sweetest professor Ive had so far. He genuinely cares about his students and wants you to succeed. He is very patient and is willing to take as long as you need. Theres a lot of homework and assignments but thats expected. Tests are most of your grade so study well because you go over a lot of info in a short amount of time.

You are expected to show your "thought process" rather than arrive at a numerical calculation. SHOW YOUR WORK! He does use the book, but that is a good thing. Ensures continuity in the field. Even POTUS uses a book.

There are no surprises. Read the book and do the homework. Read.The.Book. Do it! It's not much homework either (about 7 problems per week). Exams are very reasonable. In all honesty, he expects you to master basic engineering concepts. Do this and you will pass.

Really nice guy that teaches you how to think more than how to apply. But unfortunately his teaching skills are pretty bad. If you do all the homeworks you should do fine but don't expect to hind him very helpful. He teaches straight out of the book (literally) so he is not anymore helpful than the book itself.

Professor with basic to average teaching skills for a public university. More arrogant than most profs at UTA. Knows his stuff, but it is probably his life and he probably has nothing else going on in his life. Boring personality and delivery. Do the homework and you will do well. I wish the program overall was better. He is not an asset.
One of the best instructors at UTA. Very helpful. Always willing to answer questions. Take him if you can. He is great.

Good instrucor. Very knowledgeable about the subject. Fair with grading. Exams like homework. No surprises, which is good. Take notes, pay attention in class and do the homework. Those things lead to a good grade in his class.
Very stubborn and also unclear sometimes. TA was terrible too.  Do not expect that your opinion will count.
STAY AWAY!! Terrible professor, does not know his material, plays favorites, and fails to explain anything!

Attend class! I have trouble with long lectures and tend to learn from the PPT my own, but coming to class helped a lot. Grades very leniently,lots of partial points. Had some personal issues and missed one of the three assignments, but still passed. I personally didn't find the group problem solving days to be helpful, but some people might.

The exam might be hard if you don't learn the concept at all :) however she allow to use a cheatsheet and actually very lenient with the grade as long as you write down your thought process and algorithms carefully. Otherwise I like her lectures and she explained the concepts very well. Amazing professor imo

I dreaded this class but she is a really nice professor. Being completely honest, I didnt know the answer to a single question on the test and I made up my own made up algorithm (which 100% did NOT work 😭) but I ended up getting an A on the exams. If you show your work and explain your thinking, she gives LOTS of credit. Just try your best :)

Allison is a great professor. Her lectures are clear and concise, grading is very lenient and she is funny at times. The course structure was 3 exams, labs, and online class participation quizzes. Do not expect her to entertain requests for make-up exams or late submissions, however, she is fair which I respect.
Wheh - a lot of papers. Not sure they help with real world software engineering or testing at all. Friends in the industry say this stuff is mostly academic. But it counts toward the degree right...?

reviews.comment: Her working knowledge of JUnit is quite poor.- she doesn't even teach about parameterizing tests. Code reading has nothing to do with testing.

Take it, she is amazing you wont regret it
Pretty much all about reading published papers. I wouldn't recommend or take again. Learnt almost nothing useful.

reviews.comment: Not sure why I wasted my time in this class - very academic reading mostly useless papers. It didn't prepare me for getting a job in the industry. Kind of a total waste.

reviews.comment: Her teaching is fine but the group research project which is worth 50% of your grade is very vague and you will spend hours trying to come up with just the problem statement. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Albrecht is probably my favorite professor I've had at UTA. She cares a lot about her students and as long as you show up and give effort, the class is pretty straightforward. She has lots of experience in business outside of teaching and gives great advice. Definitely take her!!

Very understanding of situations, and not a tough grader. Does occasionally call on people to answer questions and there is a presentation in front of the class near the end. Very easy coursework, with the only homework being textbook chapters. Only reason I did not get an A was because I missed more than 6 lectures (I missed 7.)

Bro this professor is genuinely one of the best I have had. Super super flexible when you talk to her, all you really have to do is put in the effort and show up. Only big thing I'll have to say though is that she will grade projects pretty strictly but as long as you put in the effort for them you'll receive a pretty good grade.

She is a wonderful teacher, one final exam and a few projects. Her work is very much doable and not overwhelming at all. Make sure to attend her class, because she only gives out six free 'get out of class' cards. Show up and you will pass, I wish I took it more seriously.
She's great at giving engaging lectures, and has a unique grading style that eliminated my stress of the class most times.

Attendance is required. There are no exams, just online quizzes, worksheets, discussions, and two big assignments at the end of the semester. If you complete all of these you should get an A in the class, as long as you meet specs. Her specs is how she expects the work to be completed correctly, though you have numerous attempts to redo it.

If you are bad at writing essays, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. She is a very nice teacher and very forgiving on deadlines, but almost every assignment that isn't a quiz is writing tons of long paragraphs and essays to answer questions. If you're looking for an easy history class to take, this is not the class. Spec grading can easily make or break grade
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you can write well you will do well in this class. AMAZINGG there is a TA that mainly grades but the course is so easy if you follow the rubric and there are no test but instead a group project.

Work heavy, but stay ahead and you'll be fine. The work isn't difficult either, and the grading criteria is very clear. If you make a small mistake, Professor Perez is quite understanding as long as you communicate.

The class does have some interesting topics. There is a group assignment where you choose a topic and it can be pretty fun if you pick a good topic. There is also an assignment where you interview a public health worker. She is not a very hard grader at all, also a few extra credit opportunities. I would take her again.

the grading was unusually strict. they graded harshly on work that was worth 5% of the overall grade. make sure you communicate w/ your group. it was a fun class tho. the occasional online meetings are mandatory.
Professor Gkergki's lectures are incredible, and she is very understanding about students' circumstances if they are not able to attend class consistently. Would 100% take one of her courses again!

reviews.comment: Antonia Gkergki is great, and I only got a C in her class because I am lazy and do not care about econ, but for those who try just a little will succeed i would take this class again. She is nice and easy-going

JUST GO TO CLASS AND YOU'LL GET AN A. I did really well in Macro though so idk how much that helped. She's really nice and truly cares for her students. The lectures aren't really recorded though, so it's best if you show up because her lectures cover mainly what's on the exam. One of the best professors you'll see. Hardest part of the class were the homeworks, but you have unlimited attempts. Exams are easy, and she gives a study guide before each exam. Just come to class pay attention and everything will be on the exam. Easy A
Literally the best professor I've had. Her lectures are very concise and informative, and before exams she gives you a study guide. You can literally show up to class once a week and still get an A+.

One of the best professors! Attend lectures, she explains really well. Throws difficult questions to the crowd for 2 extra points each. Exams are easy, got full marks on the first two. She the best

Best prof ever! Rarely missed class. Lectures are engaging and digestable. She doesn't read off slides and uses the whiteboard a lot for visual representation. Extra credit is added to exams. Total grade is made up of hw and exams, so dont miss any. Took her for both macro and micro and even moved my schedule around just to take her.
She is amazing, 10/10! I don't spend too much time on this class. She gave us plenty of extra credit in the exam, the exams were easy, easy assignments, and she was very helpful. Easy A

She deserves all the hype. She was very good at explaining the content and i never even had to study. Trust me, just show up to the lectures it makes everything so easy. litterally the only class i regularly showed to/wanted to go to. she gives extra credit for answering correct questions which boosted my grade past 100. wish i could take her again

amazing teacher to say the least. highly recommend her. One thing I like about her is she will make sure that you feel comfortable to ask questions and she will take her time explaining it to you. great teacher.

my favorite prof at UTA! Took her for macro and HAD to take her again for micro. theres one homework per chapter and thats it (except tests). Professor Gkergki was an amazing professor, and I loved her Macro class so much that I decided to take her again for Micro. the professor was amazing I never had to study outside of class because I just paid attention during the lecture, each test we took she added 10 points to everyone test grade. I would definitely recommend this professor.

Amazing professor. Like I highly highly recommend her class because of how straightforward she is and how easy (practically non existent) the workload is. I love this professor so much, I wish I can take her again next semester :( If you read up on the material before class and watch the videos she provides with the notes, it's so easy to pass this class. I love her she works with you in and out of class. The textbook isn't necessary to read because everything is summarized and better explained in the lecture slides. Her class is easy to understand and straightforward. There's Homework, 3 exams, and the final, each exam is worth 20%.

Professor Gkergki is a great professor, 2305. She tries to make sure everyone understands what's going on. Everything on the test comes from her lectures, but she uploads all the PowerPoints. reviews.comment: Easier than any other economics professor.

Genuinely my favorite professor of at time. I had no prior care/knowledge of ECON but by the end of her class, I was considering switching my major to it. She is VERY chill and all the material on her tests are only things discussed in class. I made a 105 in her class, that is how awesome she is. I fell in love with her i'm not joking. She is great
The professor was the sweetest and absolutely polite to others. She briefly explains Economics in clear detail and allows extra credit to tests, would highly recommend.

She is the sweetest professor ever! The class concepts are difficult but she teaches it so that even a 5 year old can understand. The exams are easy as long as you study just a bit. 12 out of 10, would all her classes!

I have never been good with econ. I was not supposed to have her, but I had her for 3 weeks and boy was she the best econ professor I have ever had. To put into perspective I took 2305 and never made over a 70 on a test no matter how hard I tried, but on hers i made a 77.  The way she explains everything just makes sense. Highly recommend!

She is an amazing professor, I could not have asked for a better teacher! I have always struggled with economics yet somehow she made it all make sense. If you see any course with her name on it, TAKE IT!!! You will not regret having her.
She is a sweet professor. clear explanations and goes over the test reviews. would recommend!

Professor Gkergki is awesome. She knows what it is like to be a student and helps us out by providing great test reviews. Exams were a majority short answer with some mult choice. She is heavy on lectures so I do not recommend to skip class. However, her lectures are easy to understand that you wont need to open your book. She makes her own exams so show up to class! If you want extra credit participate in class. Overall, I highly recommend taking her.

reviews.comment: She is amazing at lecturing and breaks down every topic so that it is easily understandable. She wants everyone to attend her lectures and it is worth it. Her review sessions are super helpful. Dont take Econ with anyone else but her!!

She was one of the best professors I've had. Her lectures cover everything that will be on the exam and often times has 2 lecture days specifically for test reviews. Exams were also pretty easy so that's a plus.

She is genuinely one of the best teachers I have ever had. Her lectures are so good and nothing that isn't covered in the lectures is on the tests, so just show up and take notes and you'll be fine. Also, her review sessions before tests are absolutley goated nothing compares. So well versed and educated it made it so easy to learn the topics.

Professor Gkerkgi is an incredibly good professor who does her best to make sure everyone is doing the best they can by giving out extra credit during class and going over potential test questions + important topics during reviews. super chill, happy to answer questions, fair tests. he curves + hes flexible with scoring if he sees a lot of people missed a particular question as to not punish people for his own shortcomings in his lectures. answers questions during tests. flexible with due dates. lately he's been giving extra credit points for attending supplementary lessons

He is the most relatable professor I have ever had. He is very knowledgeable and chill when it comes to any aspect of the assignment. I hope people don't take advantage of his kindness. The material for CV gets complex very quick. If you enjoy hearing topic, take him, but if don't and only skip class ... you waisted a learning potential.
He's very good at teaching complex stuff with better analogy.
Good at teaching difficult concepts and always open to questions from students. Your grade is determined based only on assignments and a group project, no tests. Easy to get A in his class.

Computer vision is hard but he's a great professor. He explains concepts well and lectures are recorded. Course goes over both theory and code. Definitely take him for CSE 4310!

I learnt a lot after taking this class. The assignments are really interesting and practical. Class is pretty interesting where he goes over research papers and does not bore you with derivations. Goated Professor. Highly knowledgable, makes class very interesting, assignments are great, lots of material to guide you through if you are struggling and professor is also always ready to help you out if you have any questions or have trouble understanding anything. highly recommend for all CS Students at UTA - you can learn a lot

Super chill professor.I will say the HW are super hard to understand once you hit a certain one. Overall such an amazing and incredibly understanding professor. Assignments and course load can get heavy at time, but he is always willing to help however possible. Lecture participation is essential for success but he explains the topics well, going step by step through each example. Genuine effort will go a long way in his class.

Alex is one of the best professors in the computer science department. He uses real world scenarios and have vast knowledge on the Machine Learning models and it's functionalities. He is one of my finest professor, his projects and assignments require tons of efforts but at the end it's all worth it. He is so friendly and always available.

He teaches just like a YouTube presenter, explaining things clearly with great visual aids. You can ask him the same questions over and over, and he'll still be nice and caring. Dr. Dillhoff is super chill and helpful. Take advantage of what he provides and ask for help if you get lost because some of the concepts will be challenging to grasp. Good teaching, assignments are very difficult
Amazing Professor

Great professor. Gives new examples. He gives nice feedback. He listens to students and cares for them. Extends assignment deadlines. He was very easy on the final project. He helps in making you understand. He will go the extra mile for you. Be good to him.

Amazing Professor. 100% recommend. He is very understanding with difficult situations and gives extensions. His exam reviews are helpful and goes over previous exam questions. AN ANGEl! don't think twice do yourself a favor and take him.

Excellent Professor. You will learn a lot. 1320 is your first real programming course, and I am sure that he is undoubtedly your best option. Do be warned, the homework later in the semester is next to impossible. They are extremely hard, however, keep at it and you will be better. Take him!
