reviews.comment: Great professor. Difficult class but I learned a lot.

If you have the choice, choose Dillhoff.
He is the coolest and most lax professor out there. Though his assignments may become more difficult as you go, they are very beneficial to you in the long run and he will extend the deadline multiple times in a row if deemed necessary.
His examples are very intuitive and all are posted on his class GitHub.

This is for 4310. Worst prof I've ever taken. He needs empathize his writing. His HW are two parts: 1) decipher what he actually wants, 2) the actual hw. HW instructions are so vague and lectures/slides are useless. Has to extend deadlines 2-3 times because no one can finish it in time, if at all. That's the only redeeming quality. Good person tho.
Best prof ever at UTA. Care about his students. Allow notes on exams. The exams are reasonable. Give lots of extra credits. Amazing python homework. Accessible outside the class via Teams.

generally, he is a good prof. give a curve on test, give a chance to improve a grade on hw. Do not use outside source otherwise you will be in trouble. just do ur best and he is always willing to assist u.

Professor Dillhoff is very knowledgeable and a great teacher. That doesnt mean his class is easy though. He is very considerate and will explain things 1:1 if you ask. I did feel like some context/underlying knowledge was missing in my understanding as he was teaching, so I would recommend building at least some experience before taking this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Honestly, he is one of my favorite teachers at uta. He is cares a lot about you. I would definitely take his classes again

If you are not advanced level in programming, definitely do not take this class. Extremely hard homework and exams. Dr. Dillhoff may be knowledgeable but I guess he is not good at explaining. Sometimes I think professors forget that we are just students. Flexibility in homework deadlines and curves were the only pros. Don't recommend this class.

Professor Dillhoff is a saint. He is so caring and understanding. There were many times I needed help with homework and he would schedule a meeting to help me with my code. This class was hard and there were many homeworks but he will help you with whatever questions you have. I learned more in this class than I have in previous cse classes.

To be candid, he's a good professor. I only rated him 3/5 because his assignments and exams are very heavy and could take too much of your time. You might want to rethink taking him if you have a very busy schedule in/outside school. Had to drop him just for those reasons. Although he's lenient on HW late submission (you'll be losing some pts.)

The GOAT. Not even kidding. Words can't describe how phenomenal professor Dillhoff is. He CARES about you: the student, but also you: the individual. He'll work with you, even on things that aren't class material. Extremely forgiving when it comes to late work, though I wouldn't try to rely on that. Rough tests, but curved if the class does badly.

If you have no experience in coding at all, take him! I definitely struggled, but he teaches the class as if most people don't have experience. The extra credit assignment is easy and WORTH it! Just email him if you are stuck on an assignment and he is super helpful! The class problems help a lot on homework and tests!

If I could rate him higher I would. Take him. Seriously. Don't even hesitate. By far the best CSE professor at UTA even though he's only been teaching for less than a year. Really down to earth and understanding. Will help you pass if you just show him you're trying. Trust me, you won't regret taking him.

The world doesn't deserve Dr. Dillhoff. He is a literal godsend. He would always listen to our emails and he gave assignment extensions whenever we needed them. He allowed us to send him direct messages and he would look at our code and give us hints and assess our problems. Dillhoff is one of the most caring professors I have ever had! :) TAKE HIM

favorite professor by far. explains topics and answers questions until you understand. super helpful outside of class and very lenient with deadline extensions. tests can be difficult given the time limit, but his homework and lectures definitely will prepare you. his curves and extra credit go a long way. it's clear he cares about his students.

Hands down, one of the BEST professors I've had. Took his class synchronously online, but he also recorded them. Great at explaining topics, and he really tries to help you understand. Homework every week, and tests can be a bit rough, but he does curve and offer extra credit. Quick to respond to emails and truly cares about his students. Take him.
Super good guy. Who's super good at teaching. Taking him again for Linear Alg and I can't wait

Probably the best professor so far at UTA. He CARES, really cares about teaching you. His lectures explain his homework, his homework explains his test. He will make time for you, he'll be straight forward, he will help you. Just show that you actually care about the class as well and he'll give the effort as well.

He is a professor who really cares about his students. If you have any problem , he will be very understanding of it (I really mean it!) . The lectures and assignment are not easy but it you put in the work you will have a solid grasp of the subject. Compared to peers in other intro courses , you will be far ahead.

He is an amazing guy! From what I know he too studied at UTA and also did his masters here. If you don't know some prior coding you might feel that the lectures are a little face-paced but you can ask him and he'll readily help you out. Grading is just on the basis of assignments that too are discussed in class. Easy A, if done right!

Overall, this professor was really good, and the class was easy to follow. It does require plenty of reading, studying, and online meetings with peers and coaches, but everything is clear and manageable. I'd definitely take this course again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Awesome prof! Super funny, made each class enjoyable, and created a communicative and fun environment. Great at teaching content, and the online textbook (while annoying to navigate) is helpful and easy to get good grades with. Extremely respectful; had no problems letting me use my preferred pronouns for the very gendered language.

She's a really nice professor, she let me take the midterm early bc of a funeral, no questions asked. Content is also really easy, homework you can attempt over and over for a 100 and she prepares you really well for tests (spent two weeks in class reviewing for the midterm). Also gives extra credit opportunities to add to your test scores.
Professor Garner is really nice.  She gives really good feedback and replies to emails fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Super understanding and responds to her emails fast, I recommend taking her and I guarantee you'll learn something. My class was online but she's been super helpful and clear with what she wants from you. She cares about all her students and even reaches out to make sure you're doing okay with the work assigned.
Feels like there is an exam every other week. Lots of homework and handouts, but how else would you learn a new language. Kind of exhausting, but easy overall and I learned a lot so far.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I have had Prof. Garner for both SPAN 2313 and SPAN 2314 online, and she really cares about her students, she gives extra credit, so it really helps with your grades. I really enjoyed having her.

She's a really nice teacher, but I feel that the class was very self-taught. It was online to be fair, but I felt very much like I was teaching myself Spanish. Read the notes, they have terrific links that are really helpful. She gives out tons of extra credit! Take every opportunity!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Best online class I've ever taken. She responds to emails quickly and genuinely cares about your concerns. She was so helpful and offered tons of extra credit. The class wasn't easy, but you would have to TRY to not do well

if you want an easy grade he's a good professor to take, everything is on expert ta and the work load is light. But if you need to know the information, ehh I wouldn't recommend. You'll have to do a lot of self teaching.

Dr White was one of the easiest classes ever. I took online PHYS 1441 and all of the tests and homework were open book with no lockdown browser. While it wasn't the best way to learn the material it was definitely the easiest class to pass. Overall, if you want to learn the material then you shouldn't take him but you will pass easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. White was great! I took him online for Physics 1441. He answered all emails in a timely manner, opened up homework assignments that you may have missed, and constantly sends out reminders for upcoming exams. The class consisted of 10 hw assignments, 3 midterms, 1 cumulative final all through ExpertTA. Would take him again!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: His lectures weren't really the best way to learn. Understanding the HW is the only way to pass. His exams are open book, but like the first exam was 7 questions, second was less than 10 and the third was like 14 but the final was like 30. I personally made A's and B's on everything except the final and still ended up with a 75.

He means well and repeatedly mentions how he wants to accommodate for students during COVID times. However, he is not the best lecturer because he breezes through his PPT's. 1 HW assignment per week with 3 exams + final. Lowest exam & HW grade dropped. Exams are open-notes, but questions are not simple (they're taken off the textbook so practice!).

The worst professor I have ever had at any college or university. He speeds through the lectures and barely explains any material in enough depth to even learn anything. He is a smart guy but at some point that does not mean you should be a teacher. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. Most people I know are failing and he seems not to be concerned at all.

Overall he was a good professor. Maybe not the most enthusiastic of lecturers, however, he clearly loves what he does. The homework was straightforward as well as the tests. I enjoyed the class for what it is worth.
Dr. White is an okay professor. He may not be a charming one, but he has a great love for physics. Tests are not very hard either. It's not easy A, but it's not too difficult to get A.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor is horrible. He teaches much more than what is necessary for PHYS 1443, his exams have nothing to do with the sample exams he provides on blackboard. Make sure you do all the homework and get a good grade on the lab because you'll really need that. Do not take him.

Teaches 2 chapters ahead of tests, gives 2 online homeworks a week, teaches to the board, clears his throat constantly, and tries his best without success is all I learned from this class. You'll learn intro physics but it won't be that fun. He clearly loves physics, but he's not good at conveying physics to students. SIT IN THE FRONT OF THE CLASS.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Seems like a real nice guy and I'm sure he wants all of his students to pass but he isn't a good instructor. His tests are 8 questions long and if you miss one don't expect any credit for showing your work. Eventually he will start teaching multiple chapters ahead; at this point go ahead and teach yourself because you won't remember the lecture.
DROP AND SWITCH MAJORS

Dr. White is clearly very passionate about physics, but I would not call him the best lecturer. He goes very quickly, uses handwritten notes that are barely legible (by his own admission, he couldn't understand his notes on occasion), and his grading criteria is very arbitrary. Tests were hard, homework was easy, class was passable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Teaches the whiteboard most classes. Really good at physics, but goes incredibly fast through the material. He does, however, really care about his students and wants everyone to pass. Be prepared to study outside of class. His tests are all free-response and will definitely have a curveball or two so be prepared.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. White is a really nice guy who's really passionate about physics. He lectures from a PowerPoint and tends to fly through it, so it is important to review the slides outside of class. I was struggling about halfway through the year so I went to meet with him and he seemed like he really cared about my well-being and was very willing to help.

I took this class over the summer, and I highly recommend for other pre-meds. His tests are very straightforward, coming directly from the end-of-chapter problems and he makes old tests are available, which is really nice. He's not the most interesting teacher, but the class was easy if you pay some attention in the class. P.S. know the derivations

Took Dr. White for 5 weeks summer session. Super nice and knowledgeable, but goes through the material really fast. Talks to the board in lecture, sometimes hard to hear. Work through the end of chapter problems to prepare for tests. Tests are all write out problems, and drops a test. This class a self-study class for me.

Dr. White was a very helpful professor. He gave three tests, one drop and mandatory final. Test questions reflected the material taught, and as long as you do your homework, you should be fine. He tried very hard to make sure that his class was fair and was interested in seeing the students succeed.

Andy White is a good professor and takes 3 class tests and a final. He drops the lowest test grades and the tests are easy and generally based on the homework questions. Only thing I found lacking in his class is that he explains very fast and do not give enough time to students to absorb all the information, but hey he's a particle physics prof.

Really nice guy, a lot of practise exams available, sometimes questions are straight from there, mastering physics or textbook end of chp problems. He didnot curve because class avg was good. However ppl who didnot do well were relying on the curve. Pretty straight forward class. Going to class is not helpful except for review days.

Goes through the material too fast. By the time we had taken the 2nd exam, the next class we were already finished with ALL the material needed for the 3rd exam! His teaching style was difficult to comprehend. He sometimes skips some steps on the problems he works, so when you go back to rework them, they don't make sense. Please don't take him.

Very nice guy, horrible teacher.Goes through material very fast and often in a disorganized manner.Not great at answering questions on a simplistic level.Has past tests in science center and always gives practice tests.  Know how to do the problems on the practice tests as well as variations of those problems.Dont rely on lectures to learn material

Goes through things ridiculously fast by copying off his note papers rather than discussing/showing how to come up with solutions. He claims to give partial credit, but I haven't seen any yet. If you've never had any physics before, his class will be super confusing.

He is really nice, but not a great teacher. He goes really fast and most of the time no one understands what he is trying to explain. The homework is harder than the tests AND he makes copies of older exams available (Which is VERY helpful). If you take him, I suggest you get familiar with the physics tutors in the basement!

He's nice, but not very helpful. If you want help outside of class you'll have to chase him down and it always seems as if he was trying to rush me away. I don't consider myself a dumb person, but either I am a complete retard or his teaching style is horrible for me. I'm going with the later.

Always traveling for his research, constantly misses office times. Hard to get replies on e-mail. His one strong point though, is he understands some may not have had calculus yet so he is lax on the cal you are to know. Overall all it's been a horrible experience. Avoid.

Not a good experience. He was always out of the country so his TA's did a lot of the teaching and when he was there he went through the material so fast. He is a VERY smart guy just didn't teach it at an understandable level. It was a blur. Tests covered around 3-4 chapters with 10 short answer and work it out questions. Class was very hard.
Never there basically no curve no reviews by him just the TA

He goes very fast in his lecture, so I suggest you get a voice recorder if you are not a good notetaker. His tests are made up of questions that are a bit easier than the homework questions so as long as you spend enough time with the online homeworks and understand them, you will do fine. He also curves the tests and drops one too! I recomend him.
Extremely smart, teaches a lot of theory. When he lectures it's more of him going over what he knows instead of him teaching us what we don't know.

Good guy but too smart for lower phys classes. The homework is so much harder than anything we discuss in class but it helps your grade and his test can be difficult.  There is at least one derive problem on each test so be prepared to study those. His grading is based on a 40 point scale so if you miss one problem you start at a B.

Very good and professional professor. Goes very fast and covers a lot of material, so keep up or else you will be lose. Uses UT quest system for homework and has about 3 tests. Also his lectures are very close to the book, but the number one thing is to keep up with him and read in text a lot or else you will be lost. Recommended though.

He lectures very quickly. In addition, he uses very few slides, and writes everything on the board, which makes class fairly difficult to follow. However, he does follow the book pretty closely, and the SI sessions for the exams are very helpful. The review handouts are basically the test with different numbers.

Retired now but may pop up in higher level classes. Many say he's mean but he is just dry and has sarcastic humor. He really cares and opens up to students who put in effort and talk to him. He gives great explanations on the 'why' for engineering choices vs. making you memorize information. Explains in a way that sticks.

Rudest and most arrogant human beings I have ever had the displeasure of meeting. Awful is an understatement. Shame on UTA for bringing him out of retirement to oversee the Senior Project Design Course. Guy will not explain anything clearly and will berate you the second he can. He will tear you apart during questioning when you present your slides

My group dreaded having to talk to this guy. Brings nothing to the table, in terms of help, suggestions, or even care. Tried to avoid him as much as possible throughout the semester. Even the project director that we had bumped heads with him numerous occasions.
I can't say what this guy is, but it starts with a D and rhymes with ick. Not a very nice or respectful person whatsover.

Dr. Kruzic's classes are a lot to learn from. Although they are heavily loaded and crammed up with material these are intended to give you all things that you will need. He is a very helpful and supportive if you approach him and will go beyond to help solving your doubts and queries after you have put in all your efforts. He is a devoted teacher.

He's very intellegent, and one of the best at what he does. However, he knows this and will often belittle you so he can feel inferior. I would quote his work but I wouldn't study under him even if held at gun-point. I'd rather change my major than take another class under him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: In this class you will be forced to think. There will be a ton of homework but if you need help he is always ready to help if he is in his office. The solution is never clear and all he is looking for is evidence that you have thought about how one thing affects the process. Truly this was one of the best engineering classes I took at UTA.

Very Difficult at the beginning, more difficult at the end. Intentionally he makes things complicated, so the students will say he is tough. long time you need to spend on HW which they are not related to what he "reads" from his VAGUE notes. I DON'T RECOMMEND HIM TO ANY BODY.
Great professor.
He needs a lot of improvement

This class is difficult.  He teaches to high standards, which is good.  You will need to put in a good amount of effort for this class.  Text is a bit vague.  However, it is obvious he wants his students to succeed and it shows.  He offers after class and weekend study sessions which are infinitely helpful.  He is an awesome professor.
This guy can not teach very well.
Hard as they come!  However, he's extremely fair as long as you show you are working hard.

I absolutely adored Professor Andrade. Very encouraging and gives good feedback. The class consists of 1 film, 1 discussion board, 1 30-min writing lab w/ LDB + Webcam, 1 chapter quiz, and 1 chapter review assignment PER week. Also 3 "teach back-presentations" spread throughout the semester and 1 final exam. Interesting material!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is the toughest grading professor I ever had. Week after week its multiple assignments that are long and even after I have put in hours to do the assignments she doesnt grade off effort at all. I have turned in pages on pages following questions by the book and still receive low grades. Her replies to grades are also useless. Dont take please!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: An okay professor and class work is easy. Just turn in on time.

Excellent professor and is super caring! She knows many people don't love theatre (I do but many don't) and does her best to work with you. You'll have to see a play for class but it's a fun experience!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Her class was extremely enjoyable and easy to sit through and it was a 3hour lecture. She really held my attention. Also if you show up and pay attention and take notes you are guaranteed and A. Really an amazing professor.  2 exam and one papper her class was simple and awesome.

Y'all, take this class. i loved her and the class itself. I actually learned something because I wanted to and not because I had to. She's funny, as well. Her tests are somewhat easy, but it's good to have a "study group" so you guys can "help" each other out. There will be questions on the movies you watch in class so pay attention.

Dr. Andrade is a tough teacher, but everything she does prepares you to be a better student and actor. She will push you to be your absolute best and to get outside of your comfort zone. There is alot of reading and discussion in her class, and the books are very beneficial. Come to class prepared and ready to work hard, and you will be fine.

I love brandi! She's is so fun and her assignments are super easy! She just wants you to participate and learn something new! 2 tests, midterm and final, dont stress too much over them, make sure you take notes from the lectures and watch all the movies.  She's spunky, and knows how to make you enjoy a 3 hour lecture.  also, her outfits are cute

Class was really easy. Lectures over specific topics about theater and film history but note taking isn't necessary unless you want the final to be super easy. Watched movies for about 5 total class meetings & extra credit was given by writing a page reflection.  Midterm and Final are taken online with study guide made together in class.

The readings are incredibly long (20+ pages). Most of the readings are interesting, some I had a hard time understanding. Lectures are interesting though. I enjoy the discussions. Honestly would rather study for an exam than do a paper. She expects too much out of you and her instructions aren't really clear.

Her advanced class is completely different from theater appreciation. This class is about history of theater, rude teacher who likes to cuss a lot & assign readings of 20+ pg plays, long papers, no tests, pop quizzes, mandatory theater attendance. After we got to know her only 8 people remain in the class. This is a history class more than anything

She's extremely passionate about the arts, which makes her lectures really interesting. She gives a lot of extra credit opportunities, and lets you make up a certain amount of absences. Make sure you do the theatre-going project; it was really fun anyway. If you want to take a theatre and film appreciation class, she's the one to take it with!

Dr. Andrade is very energetic and passionate, but she can be rude. There is written project that you will turn in throughout the semester and that's your final. No test! She gives great feedback on papers. Be prepared to read the textbook & the articles posted on BB, there are random quizzes. Extra credit is given by attending plays.
This class is VERY easy. Just make sure you don't  miss too muchn,,do some extra credit, and you'll be fine. She is very passionate about threatre and makes the 3 hr class fly by!!

She is a good lecturer, very energetic. However, she is not a nice person. Two straight forward exams and a paper that you HAVE to go see spending your own money and tickets ain't cheap!! Save your brochure because she needs proof. Attend lecture because she takes attendance and it will count against you, he does offer extra credit through!

Fun & passionate lady, but 3 hr class tiring 'cause DOESN'T stop talking.  2 exams: Midterm & Final, both easy, & 1 easy essay (have to go to play); easy material but gotta takeborrow notes to study. Some days are movie days, & attendance is always mandatory, or you'll be penalized (after 6 absences).  Take her! Easy A!

Professor Andrade only uses three grades for the semester: A theatre going paper, a midterm, and the final. There's also TONS of extra credit opportunities. You're allowed to miss up to six classes before it penalizes you, but if you need to erase absences you can do extra credit. She also has a fun quirky personality.

Dr. Andrade is AMAZING. I was dreading this required class but it quickly became my most amazing class of my first semester of college. The class is long but her lectures make it fly. Interesting movies. Do NOT miss the chance to take her class. The assignments are fun and reasonable. There is extra credit for more pointsto help remove absences.
The best professor I had this semester! She's fun, loving and trust me, you'll laugh a lot! The material was very interesting and you'll get to watch a lot of movies. Would definitely take again!
Awesome teacher!!!
Fun class as long as you pay attention and enjoy getting involved. Very easy class, the hardest thing you do is go see a play and write a short paper on it.

Dr. Andrade is a very good professor. She makes the material interesting (although it is already very interesting). And getting an A is easy. Just go to class, study the study guides, and go on your "theater-going adventure". I enjoyed her teaching.

Dr. Andrade is a great professor! She has passion for her job and shows great enthusiasm when teaching. You don't need the book, but attending class is necessary to get a good grade. Very easy class, I highly recommend her! Also, she gives loads of extra credit opportunities.

Sooooo easy. The study guides for the midterm and final are the same as the test just jumbled up. Very energetic and passionate. Don't need the book or need to take notes. Go to class, listen, study the study guide, get an A.

Andrade is a GREAT professor. She is so much fun and she brings the class room to life. The work load is decent and at times, she will make you go out of your comfort zone. She also curses, if that offends you. However, I loved her class and I would take her again in a heart beat!

She is very nice, funny, and energetic. The only grades are two tests and one mandatory theater going where you have to see a play outside of school and write a short essay on it (the essay is very easy). About a third of class visits are movies where you're released from class once the movies over. I would recommend her.
This teacher is absolutely amazing! She is very energetic and don't think she is a push over just because she is nice! Group Project was very fun to do!
Awesome teacher. She gives out a lot of extra credit opportunities. She is hilarious. gives you study guides before tests. No quizzes. only 2 tests(mid term and final)

Dr. Andrade is AWESOME!!! She has about 1000 students and knew me on a first name basis. It is very obvious to tell that she loves what she is doing and is so enthusiastic about her lectures. The movies that you watch are really good. There is tons of extra credit and no reason to fail! I wish I could take this class again! I highly recommend!

attendance is mandatory, she used to be real lax on this but she says that if shes there you have to be there. i missed 4 days and i received a C. if your not a theater person then you will get on your nerves. shes ok, not easy. you have to go out and watch a play, and act out a play. and write 5 essays. she grades kinda hard, very arbitrary.

Absolutely loved her class! watched 5 films, did one page essays over them, and the test were super easy. You do have to go to a play, but it's well worth it. She's very energetic and enthusiastic and very passionate about what she teaches.

This class was so easy! The professor is really entertaining and cool but I took the once a week class that was 3 hours long and no one can be that interesting for 3 hours so BRING AN ENERGY DRINK. But otherwise this class was a piece of cake

Well, when she gives her lectures, she seems alright. If you need to talk to her about something, forget it. She's extremely rude and accused me of cheating with no evidence whatsoever! I wish that I would have never spoken to her. Avoid her and you'll be fine; the class is simple but it does "require" you to go out of your way to see a play.

She is very passionate about fine arts...will spontaniously act on stage.  Easy class, attendance is not manditory, definately don't buy the book just take good notes, ace the exams and you'll be good.

Attendance is loosely mandatory, meaning you can miss 5 classes without losing points and after that you only lose 2 points per day.  This class is SUPER easy.  You can pretty much bs your way through any assignment and still get high A's.

This is a very easy class. She's a extremely cool teacher, very nice, and loves what she does. My only complaint was the class I had her in was 3hrs long and boring. You write small 1 page essays over the movies and her quizzes are simple and she gives study guides out before each one that YOU help put together. I highly recommend her!

She requires a very minimum attendance.  The class is fun and easy.  She does require essays every other week, but they are graded really lightly and can be written in a about 1 hour.  DONT BUY THE TEXT BOOK, she doesn't even acknowledge that it exists.  Overall its a good fine arts credit class to take, You watch movies :)
Very nice, easy class, you must take notes for the tests! i almost lost my A because 9am is waaayyy too early lol

Very interesting class. Great experiences and always entertaining. Wouldn't recommend for theater majors. I loved the class, the only catch was that you attendance is checked daily and you must have less than 10 absences to pass. I highly recommend this class.

SUPER EASY CLASS if you know nothing about theater. Theater majors stay away! She can't teach the basics of theater properly messing up commonly used terminology like stage left or stage right.  DON'T BUY THE BOOK YOU WONT USE IT!  Expect to shell out around 40 or 50 to pass the class due to a mandatory theater experience.

Her class is very easy; whether you attend or not. However, if you miss more than 10 days you fail the class. It can be interesting, but the best part is getting to watch the films/clips she has chosen. Take good notes. You would be surprised what pops up on the final.
Class is easy. There is no hard work. Midterm and final is very easy.

For a professor in the theatre department, she doesn't have much knowledge of the theatre. Changed her mind on all the essays. Would say one thing, then when you turned in the paper she would say it wasn't done right. The final was very advanced and a project that intro to design students wouldn't be expected to complete.  A very frustrating class

Talks really fast I would suggest you bring a tape recorder, her lectures are kind of boring half of our class would fall asleep. Don't bother buying the book I never even broke the seal, the first few movies are really old black and white.

the worst and most difficult course and prof i've ever taken. profs for this course is very limited so be ready to teach yourself the entirety of this class if you just so happen to take him. mumbles off slides but you can't even understand him, horrible handwriting, and takes forever to grade. gave us 0 exam reviews or guides.

This professor was completely unfamiliar with Java. Instruction was reading slides and writing chicken scratch on the board, never opened an IDE or showed runnable code. He struggled with basic installation and technical concepts. Class struggled universally; quizzes/exams were bad. Zero feedback on assignments. You must teach yourself everything.

The professor speaks in a thick accent and mumbles/goes off topic ALOT. He will expect you to already know Python for this intro class. Also, we got to retake our lowest test grade. Her lectures are good and shes funny. No HW so must do the examples in the book to get practice. Would definitely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Prof. Andrews was a great teacher. The content was sometimes difficult, but her way of explaining things and the examples she went over in class made everything easier to understand. She is willing to help anyone with any question, really cares that everyone gets the material, and gives exam reviews that are helpful. Would definitely take her again
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Pretty good professor. You MUST go to class if you want to know what the heck is going on. Also, she gives a pop quiz every week so u have to be there to get points. She explains things very clearly and gives you everything you need for exams. This is a challenging class, but she makes it do-able. She gives extra credit. Homework is optional.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I don't learn anything from her. Class is way too hard and unnecessary since she taught nothing relevant to the exam. I doubt her understanding Accounting at all to begin with.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She was pretty great.  She was unfortunately thrust into this class at the last minute as the assigned prof was unable to attend.  So, she was a bit unorganized and unprepared.  Overall, she tried and she cared.  She would do what was necessary for you to understand and pass.  Exams don't always match what is learned.  Must attend class for quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: She was amazaing! The class itself was difficult but she gives many examples and simplifies the material. She would work out problems and always answered questions! She curves first 3 exams, gives you PPTs, solutions, and outlines. Would definetly recommend!

Literally, one of the best professors I've ever had in my undergraduate career. She is truly passionate about making sure students understand the material. If you don't get it, YOU HAVE TO ASK. She doesn't mind answering, you just have to let her know you need help. Financial Accounting sucks to begin with, but she makes it 100x more bearable.
Take her! She's amazing! If you don't attend class, you won't pass. She takes key things from lecture and puts them on the tests along with the examples she works in class.

Great professor for a hard subject. Homework's take awhile but are really helpful! Go to every class and pay attention. She is interesting and class isn't boring like most teachers for this subject. Study guides given for test are super helpful.

She isn't tough, but the subject is. She will help if you ask for it. Study the handouts, notes and PP. Utilize the Wiley hw & study guides too. You have to study to pass the course, but again it's the subject matter not her that is difficult. She tries to explain it so that ppl understand it. I wouldwill take her again!

Took her because people told me she is "amazing". She has a great personality - but I do not like her teaching style. She rushes through problems and throws in concepts randomly when she remembers them. I felt like I had to teach myself at times. Review old exams because many questions will show up again on final! I made a high A though.

I thought this class would be ridiculously hard. It wasn't too bad if you just studied. She gave you basic things you needed to study for. Homework is pretty easy and bumps your grade a lot. I think she made it easier than prior semesters so I would take her now.

She is a great proffesor. She goes through lectures pretty fast but if you ask her to slow down she will. I recomend that you study the handout and all major problems that you worked in class because something similar to those will be on the exam. Exams are not hard if you study your notes and handouts.

She is an awesome professor. The class itself is hard, but she does her best to help us understand. Study the handouts and go through the PP and notes and you should do fine. She will do what she can to help you understand. She's very positive and definitely knowledgeable! You won't regret taking her class.
You have to study real hard for this class if you expect to pass  the class.

Awesome teacher! She is a little fast but if you ask to slow down she will take the time to explain. Study what she puts on the reviews and any class handouts. Written problems are similar to her hand outs. If I could I would take her again.

She is by far the best accounting professor I've had at UTA, and if you get the chance, take her. The class is tough, but if you put in the work it isn't bad at all. She explains everything very clearly, and doesn't test you on anything she doesn't cover. Highly recommend.

Really nice professor. She gives curves if the grade is low. She allowed note cards for all the tests except one. Most test examples are practiced in class. Class itself is hard but she makes it pretty easy.

it is very easy class if you pay attention, do all assignments. I made an A in the class. You really need to understand every problems instead of just memorizing them.Final exam was very easy, much easier than regular test.

Very important to come to class prereading the chapter. She usually just skims the book and get right to the problem. Recommendation is to work the problems she does and label the page number so you can rework it later. All the problems are usually covered in the test. Conceptual problems are on you to study and read the book. She's fair grading.

The material is so in depth, I do not think she could do much to make it easier.  Study ridiculous amounts for each test (there are 5 tests!) and you might be able to get a B. She grades the exams really fast so thats a plus.  The take home exam took forever to complete.  Can use note cards on tests, even though they never help.

I really enjoyed her class, She cares for her students and the exams are not as hard as you expect. She curved one exam, and had one take home exam. Her exam reviews are really detailed and they help a lot. Also the homework is weighed as much as an exam so do your homework and go to the review you will get  a B

Class is hard no matter who you take. I liked her because she really does care about her students. She tells you what you need to know and what you don't. She teaches you computational material, but conceptual is up to you and your book.

Andrews is arguably a good professor, but she is not very accommodating and presumes you already understand the material before it is taught. Her lectures don't cover everything on the exam (which is HARD), and she looks down on you if you can't follow and catch up. She made rude remarks to me.

This class is hard no matter who is teaching it, but Andrews makes it bearable. The book will be your best friend. She teaches what is needed in class such as examples of problems, etc. The conceptual part of the class is up to you to learn on your own though. Take her if you can!

Extremely useful and a practical course..She is very interactive in the class and is very patient in listening to our doubts and answering them.I scored an A..and I was active throughout the class learning on a day to day basis.
Shes not a bad teacher but the course is just hard. A lot of challenging topics to take in in one semester. Don't think it really matters who is teaching it.

The class is hard no matter who you take it with, but Andrews makes it bearable. She goes out of her way to try and make it okay. Intermediate is just plain hard though. Be prepared to study like CRAZY if you want a good grade.

The class itself is hard no doubt about it. There is a lot on the test that she really doesn't cover in class, but basically because there's not enough time. To get a good grade in the class you have to study a lot outside of class. Expand on her reviews and you should be fine
Didn't know what to teach to the class. Taught different from how the book taught. Tests where completely different from what was learned from the lectures or the textbook.
A little confusing, but I will say the more I studied on my own the better my grade was.  Ended up with a B, used the McGraw Hill Connect to study, examples were very helpful.

Doesn't help out really. Lets you out early but it comes back to hurt you when the test and homework becomes due.  Puts little to no effort and rarely emails you back.  When asking for help just usually tells you to practice more or do what you can.
Was not helpful in answering questions. Tests where almost completely different than what she and the book would teach. Probably the worst teacher i have ever had.
She is alright. Her tests are hard, but fair. She skips around some, and can be a little confusing, but overall, she covers the material well. Not fantastic.

Isn't very helpful.  Is nice and acts as though she puts in a lot of effort but is not very prompt in emailing you back.  She shows simple examples in class only for there to be more difficult problems on the HW/Test.  Get the feeling that she's there just for a 2day a week job with a paycheck.  Doesn't seem to put in a lot of outside effort.

She is a nice lady and does a good job explaining the material.  I study more than most, take notes, and attend all class, but I barely passed the first test and did not pass the second.  There is a difficulty inconsistency  with what she lectures on/assigns for homework and what is actually presented on the test. Be warned

She is not my favorite teacher, I didn't like her teaching style. Not very good at explaining why things are certain ways. But she does a lot of examples, and do the homeworks because they are a good pick-up for grade! She also gave extra credit toward end of semester.
good prof, difficult subject. be prepared to study and go to every class.

Know that acct is hard if you have no prior experience. I thought it would be mostly math & it turned out 2 be mostly memorization. Final is departmntl and comprehensive, 75 multi choice questions. Exams R 25 to 30 M/C & 3 to 5 free hand questions (computational & journal entries).  Between the HW, reading the book, & tutoring u should be okay.
She's a great teacher, just right amount of homework that helps with the exams. Answers any question that a student has.

She is soo hard, and just goes through what is exactly in the book during class. Not worth taking because whenever you ask her a question she will answer as if you are stupid. Her homework is very easy compared to the test. I never missed a class, and did my homework on time, but still ended up dropping that class!! Don't take her it is not worth it !!!!
Excellent teacher. She breaks it down.

She is the worst teacher, she is goes over the same material as the book. She gives easy homework and really hard tests. Also if you ask a question, she answers you as if your really stupid. Her examples during class are so easy but during test  the question are nothing similar. I would not recommend her at all. I never slacked in class, attend all classes and did he as well as study ever day. In the end I had to drop the that class due to two bad test grades!!
She is not nice, wen u ask her a question she will make u feels stupid. She gives harder test than what she goes over in class!
BEST ACCOUNTING TEACHER EVER!!! The class is not an easy one but her teaching method is really good. She really wants her students to learn and grasp the material really well before she moves on.
She requires that you understand the material that she teaches.  Is willing to help.  You must show up to class to pass.  Enjoyed her teaching, she made things easy to understand.

I took this class Fall 2009, and I made a B. Class attendance is not mandatory, but she is very good about reviewing the text and making sure you understand everything. She makes it easier to understand. Tests aren't easy, but they also aren't hard and she makes sure you are prepared. I would recommend her.

Great professor! You can tell she really wants you to learn. Lectures are very helpful and the book wasn't terrible. Test and grading are fair. I wish she would teach more classes. If you don't do the homework you will not do well.
Does not test over what is taught and expects you to know and understand material not covered.
Simply the best accounting teacher at UTA. Textbook stinks.

she goes a lot into detail, n uses too many words. I get lost when not prepared before the class. She might want to use fewer words and teach succintly. However, i really appreciate tht she tries hard to do her very best.

She has experience and teaches how it really is. Some things can be confusing on the tests or quizes, but not enough to make a big difference. She gives easy EC. You will need to do your HW and go to class.
No Comments
Doesn't know how to write understandable test. A multiple choice ledger? Come on! Math teachers at least give partial credit for showing work.
She tries to work with you and is really good about answering any questions.
No information at all!  Bad professor.

Nice, but not very helpful. I normally make A's, but no matter how hard I tried, I could only muster a "B". If it were not for the SI session, I doubt I would have passed. It is clear that she loves accounting, but she is difficult to follow and her tests are confusing. I do not recommend her class
No Comments
Very good
Has no idea how to write fair and unbiased tests.
Don't ever take her, she might be the worst English teacher. Doesn't even consider any excuses for late assignments even if you are in hospital(like I was)...

Do not take her! she wants students to come prepared and take over the discussion on the assigned readings in the class. Does not even accept an exuse for a late assignment. I am sure there are better english teachers than her in UTA.

She is an easy teacher but her grading is bull. She expects way too much from a freshman in college. No matter how hard you work on your paper and how good it is you will get a C on it. She really sucks!!

This teacher Rocks! She is willing to help you out when you need it and can also deal with you on email and facebook. She is very young and creative and full of ideas. I would recommend her to lots people.

Her grading was bull! She basically wanted everything written like a high school paper and the way SHE wanted to read things. She limited the topics you could write on, just because she'd been bored with past writing topics other students wrote about. If you are even 2 mins late to class she'll just give you a 0 on the daily quiz. Worst ENGteacher!

Great teacher. Would definitely recommend her to others.She uses via email as well as facebook to send out assignments. There are quizes sometimes but it's open notes and very straight forward. Grading for essays are easy but you'll have to put a little bit of effort if you want an A in the class. Participation is a must. Overall great experience.

Participation grades count a lot in her class. She is immature, insults you in front of class if you do come prepared. She was helping, but I did not like the way she taught, I felt her class more like a discussion class and group work. Attendance is mandatory!

Easygoing, and always available thru email and such. Lots of work, esp reading quizzes. Grading is straightforward; just follow the rubric, citations, grammar rules, etc. and actually gives back essay/grades. Lets class leave early sometimes.
Great teacher, she's really nice when grading, there's a lot of busywork in the course but that isn't her fault. Very easy going and helpful, I would highly reccomend her.

just follow the instruction and do what she said! She is every clear about that she wants. Every helpful (facebook contact too). I made an A in 1301 and Im an ESL student! so just do what you need to do
I did not like the way she teaches, she expects students to come prepared reading every class, and want them to carry out the discussion! PARTICIPATION GRADES REALLY COUNT!!! I dropped this class :(

Good teacher.. Not a hard class but a lot of work and reading assignments.. She helped make my writing skills improve.. I would recommend her if you like to write, but also if u want a teacher who will be straight up with u help u when u need it.

I hated this course but Ms. Slack is very helpful and it helps that she grades easy. It's an easy to follow course but there are a lot of assignments (as of any other 1302 class though). You get to leave early most of the time!

Great teacher! Explains all assignments thoroughly and provides all necessary information in order to make A's on your assignments. Everything is very straight forward. I recommend going to every class because of things lectured in class makes the assignments easier. Besides she usually lets us out early.

Awesome teacher. Young but very intelligent and dedicated to teaching. You don't have to go to every class. Attendance counts towards participation but it is a small percentage of the grade. Take her class if you can!

This class is pretty easy, but it's not a blow-off class. Attendance isn't required, but it harms your participation grade if your not there. Definitely one of the BEST English teachers I've ever had.
she's super easy just do the work with some effort and clarity and you'll make a very good grade.
Super cool teacher. She tells you what you need to know, just follow the rubric and what she says and you will do fine.
Show up to class, pay attention to the rubrics and instructions, and do the assignments. Easy A.
Excited to teach. Great energy. She will help you with whatever you need and go out of her way if you really need it.

Very unmotivated. It seemas that he was ready to retire a decade ago. He is tired of this job and students. There was no useful information from his lectures, but the textbook allowed me to make an A in this class. In addition, he doesn't keep up with current events and 2001 textbook edition was just fine for his class. He is stuck in 1990th

The class is reading intensive and the only tests are midterm and final. However they are open book/note. The lectures are excruciating. He is quiet and monotone. He writes in a very tight cursive that is incredibly difficult to read. He does know his stuff but I wouldn't recommend him.

very hard to hear and read his writing...only gives 2 exams...but both are open book and open notes but you still need to know the material beforehand though...not very lively and his lectures can be very boring at times...he had his TA take attendance every day so you had to sit in the same seat every class...he bumped you up if you attended...
I took him in the summer for financial markets and institutions and made a decent grade, you can miss as much as you want he's a pretty cool teacher he just writes sloppy and speaks in a low voice
Very unmotivated teacher. By the end of class, less than half showed up.  Might as well have been a self study class. Textbook used was great.
One of the best teachers I've ever had.  I learned more in his class than I learned as an Econ major in undergrad.  Definately take his classes

Made accounting so much easier than it should've been. That being said, always go over his reviews as it is a MAJOR key to being successful during midterms. Take this professor over any other professors!! Attendance is mandatory; the same goes for labs.

He is so helpful and responds to email pretty quickly, lectures are the best way to study for exams and help with your grade as he does a participation grade after class. I really enjoyed him as he made accounting a lot easier than it should be.

The professor is dedicated to his students, responds to emails quickly, and makes himself available when needed. He compares concepts to the real world, which makes it easier to understand. There is a participation grade in every class and his exam reviews make the exam easier as it is similar to the exam.

He's knowledgeable and actually likes his job,  quick to respond to emails, and sticks to what he says he'll do. That said, he seemed to take a liking to certain students, which definitely worked in their favor. ;) If that doesn't bother you, he's otherwise a solid professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Don't worry you're in good hands; he already knows what's difficult (to students) and what's not and he's really good at simplifying the material. You will leave his class feeling like a genius if you try. Participation, Lab, and homework grades are extra credit. Fast paced and content heavy but provides a bunch of study outlets videos, notes, etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very great Prof. Would definitely recommend him if you think ACCT is hard. He compares concepts to real world, which makes really easy to understand. Every class there is participation grade. His review really makes the exam easy, very similar to exam.
SHow up and study the pp notes and its an easy A.
Amazing professor, His lectures are interesting, group assignments are easy. Easy grader and overall enjoys teaching his students
Had a blast in this class. Lots of videos, but insightful lectures to go along with them. Was very encouraging and made me excited about the program.

The professor has a film background besides landscape and implements this into his lectures and style of teaching. Ask for group presentations that work as a gallery towards the end of this course. Uses a lot of videos and movies for lecturing sometimes, so a pretty stress-free class. Professor himself is very kind and gives good feedback.

Allen was awful, rambling and going off course, and emphasized making videos in a class that wasn't film-related, providing little instruction for some assignments and far too much for others. His class felt more like a Video class that talked about sustainability than an intro to urban design course instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Austin is very enthusiastic about Spanish and Spain.  She is also very understanding and caring towards students. One big project (no exams) to be created in the FabLab about some aspect of Spain.  Lots of reading and analyses to be done, but all very thought provoking.  It does take considerable effort, but it is a interesting and fun class.
She was amazing and showed that she cared about her students. I loved having her as a teacher.
the best spanish teacher

Dr. Austin is truly the best there is! She's super flexible and understanding to life outside of school and doesn't overload you with work. Her lectures are interesting and she's a super funny, and cheerful person, which makes her class fun! Take her if you can, you won't regret it.
One of the best professors at UTA. She is flexible, gives clear expectations, kind, and makes all of her lectures engaging. Definitely recommend!!!

Had her for SPAN 3311 one of the best Spanish classes Ive ever taken. Dr. Austin delivers such clear and interesting lectures, its a really great experience. I learned so much about Spain, and enjoyed her enthusiasm about the country. Make sure to prepare well for the essays other than that DEFINATELY take this professor for a Spanish elective!

This is my second time taking her as a professor and I still think shes amazing! Class is discussion based so participate! Come to class with your work done and a bit of studying & youll pass. She also offers lots of extra credit opportunities!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Super straightforward and makes lectures interesting! Will go out of her way to make class understandable and enjoyable! Open note tests, mainly lectures & class discussions, and a project. But everything is definitely easy if you put some effort into it!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor

Dra. Austin is a great professor. She is very straightforward and the syllabus tells you exactly what you need to do. This is a Spanish lit class, so expect to write 3 short writings and 2 full essays, but she does workshops before they're due so she can give us feedback on them. Easy A if you do all the work and follow her feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Austin is friendly and caring, but she won't coddle you, either. There is lots of reading and class participation/group work, and a few challenging projects, but overall the class is work taking. The midterms and final are personal interviews conducted entirely in Spanish.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Austin is a great professor! I really enjoyed her class. The tests aren't hard. There are a few essays, but they aren't too bad. It's really important to do the reading before every class. Class is pretty much discussion of the reading. Spanish Lit with her is not scary/intimidating, she makes it very accessible to students.

Professor Austin is not only passionate about Spanish, she's extremely passionate about teaching. I've never had a professor take as much time as she did to answer my questions. She made Spanish fun and kept me interested.  I can't wait to take her class again.

ONE OF THE BEST PROFESSORS AT UTA.  She is extremely passionate, as well as lenient and understanding.  I truly feel that she was able to teach something to every single one of her students.  Can't wait to have her again!

awesome professor! She's very passionate about Spanish and there are a few presentations you have to do, but allowed a note card. Also, all of her exams are completely oral, like an interview in her office but she doesn't put lots of pressure on you. Overall fun class and helpful if you don't get to speak Spanish as much as you'd like to

So this teacher claims that our e-mails go to her junk folder. By the time she responds to your e-mail it will not matter anymore. This class is really more of a literature class that happens to be in Spanish. Its not really a Spanish class. She is a tough grader. The tests are ridiculously hard. It's just useless memorization for the tests.

This is one of the most intresting classes I've ever taken Dra. Austin is extremely dedicated to this course since this is what she majored in (medival literature).  There were 3 essays and you have to be prepared for every class which means reading is mandatory.  If you keep up and talk to her for clarification you will do fine.

Dr. Austin is a great teacher and is very passionate about Spanish literature. The subjects taught in this class really prepared me for the classes that followed. She is big on participation and loves when you contribute. She is also very fair on grading. I missed a big test and she let me make it up and only took off 10%. And yes, she's beautiful.

She's a great but strict teacher. You must read everything BEFORE class and come prepared to discuss intelligently in Spanish. She encourages questions and takes time to meet with you if you need extra help. All in all, she is a great teacher, but be warned that she grades tough. You can rewrite papers but it only adds a few points. Tsts are essay.

This wasn't the easiest class in the world, but it was a lot of fun. You must participate actively in this class to succeed, and that means showing up and speaking up- in Spanish. She will help you out whenever you need, and she will reward you for giving an effort. And, by the way, she's gorgeous.

Loignon is a great professor and he and the TA are kind and funny and give good feedback. The assignments are mostly bi-weekly writing assignments about what was discussed in lectures the past two weeks. If you take good notes it's pretty easy to write one out in about an hour. The final and mid-term were also essays and the grading was lenient.

- his lectures are like storytelling sessions
- all assignments are essays ~500 words
- no tests; midterm and final exam are essays ~1000 words
- essays are opinion-based; TA grades leniently and gives feedback
- you can ask him or the TA to review your essay beforehand
- attendance is recommended (professor isn't keen on using ECHO 360)

He is an amazing teacher and person. I truly enjoyed going to his class because he made it interesting. His assignments are super easy and his TA does not grade hard at all. If you do the work, youll get an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's always willing to go on interesting tangents if you want to get into the details of something, but he's still able to stay on top of curriculum and cover what's needed. When I took the second half of Western Civ, he had short readings and class discussions over different ideologies instead of a final exam, which were a lot of fun!

Definitely the best teacher I've had at UTA. His lectures are very engaging because he teaches history like a story, and I really feel like I'm learning a lot. Attendance isn't graded, but obvs your grade will be better if you go, and class is super fun anyway. He's really passionate and puts a ton of effort into his curriculum. I highly recommend!

Professor Loignon is one of the best professors I have seen at UTA. His teaching style is mainly lectures(usually great attendance), which are genuinely fun to go to because of his personality and the way he makes the material interesting. Workload was easy with 1 writing assignment/2 weeks and midterms. Take him for HIST and you'll thank yourself!

Professor Loignon is honestly one of he best professors that I've had in college so far. His lectures are very interesting and he knows a lot about what he teaches about. I highly recommend his course.

The class was entirely based on the lectures, with no reading except for a book review assignment. Reflection writing assignment every 2 weeks, easy completion grade. A few heavier essays, no traditional tests. He grades fairly and will give feedback if you turn a paper in ahead of time. Approachable, easy to talk to, and cares about his students.

One of the most amazing History professors at UTA. He really cares for his students and loves when they reach out. I took his online course which consisted of a video per week, a quiz or journal entry over the video and an essay for the midterm and final. He is always available to help his students and puts a huge effort into his course material.

Professor Loignon gives great lectures and is open to answering any questions. He's super passionate and wants you to understand the material. He'll proofread your papers if you send them in early and isn't a harsh grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He's a dope professor. Very good with relaying information and keeping the course interesting

Professor Loignon is an excellent professor, his lectures will make history come alive and change the way you view the past. His lively personality prevents drowsiness and his stories provoke your attention, take him every chance you get.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Loignon is probably one of my favorite professors I have had so far. He genuinely cares for his students and is very helpful when something is not understood and needs further explanation. He is also very accessible to talk to and gives very good advice for how to improve throughout the class. I would definitely take another one of his classes!

Dr. Loignon is a dedicated, attentive professor. It's easy to get an A if you attend his lectures, they are very interesting easy to understand, and recorded. The grading is fair, and he offers to review any papers before you turn them in, which is very helpful. I would take his class every semester if I could, I loved it and highly recommend it.

Professor Loignon is a great teacher, he is very interested in the courses he teaches and keeps the class engaged. The professor does not teach from slideshows they are just there for back up on the topic he is reviewing over so it is very important to pay attention to what he says
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Loignon is an amazing prof to do well all you need to do is be engaged, show up and put in decent work. Overall he really enjoys the subject and is very open to chat and explain just about anything. He is an incredible professor and I am very glad to have taken his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Loignon is the best! He genuinely cares about his students and will work with you to ensure your success. Make sure to come to lectures as the exams are based on them. His lectures are really interesting too.

Dr. Loignon is honestly the best history professor I've ever had. I'm not a history person, but he made the subject really interesting to me. His lectures are engaging and he explains everything clearly. He's always willing to help and is very understanding. Take his class if you get the chance!

A weak subject for me, but I was engaged during lecture. He's fair, respectful to all & welcomes any questions you have for him. The workload is light but if you don't do the work, you won't pass and honestly doesn't take much to just get it done. Exams are mainly lecture base, so although attendance isn't mandatory, it will benefit you.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: 3 papers for the semester Read 1 book: Escaping Salem, which is a good read by the way 1 test with 4 ID short essays 5 or 6 quiz's that were really just an opportunity to raise your grade . All online only 5 questions each - Very Engaging - Video records his lectures for students - You can tell he enjoys teaching

Grading rubric is clear and not strict at all. Most of the assignments are journal reflections and the rest are simple things that will help you. Majority of classes consisted of guest speakers so you could ask lots of questions. Great professor for the class!

Dr. Austin is a really good prof, and her lectures prepare you for the exams pretty well so you can get by without focusing too much on the textbook readings. 4 tests and 4 other assignments make up your grade, but she does curve the exams depending on how everyone does. This class has a heavy courseload but as long as your group is cooperative it should be easy enough so choose your groups wisely! I enjoyed applying all my research and statistical knowledge to these projects. If you're planning on going to grad school, this class is super helpful!
I have thoroughly enjoyed all of Dr. Austin's classes and have learned so much! Just pay attention in class and study a bit and it's pretty easy to get an A

This is the hardest class I've taken through the entire semester.... short answer assignments are too lengthy, Exams... don't get me started on that... super hard........ I wish more extra credit was offer... Overall, one of the most difficult courses....

Professor Austin is truly an amazing educator. I have learned a lot in class and it really is not hard at all if you do your part as a student and read, pay attention in lecture, and stay on top of your work. She is super kind and helpful, if you need help she is very accessible.

smart guy, however, with this intelligence comes a lot of arrogance. kind of stuck up and rude at times, especially towards women. overall, rude but good at teaching and organizing his class.

Dr. Sedai is an excellent teacher and knows the content of his class very well.  He is a pleasant and approachable person.

This is an easy class with a great professor.
Easy class, and very BORING

Easy Easy class. He's a ranter but it's not bad. He's a nice guy even though he can come off as being kind of harsh. Just be respectful. It's an easy A. Professor Robinson likes to talk, a lot. He's very nice, but it's clear that he desperately wants approval. He grades tough on the first couple of speeches,  more lenient on the last two. 4 speeches, a few quizzes, one paper, 2 tests - it's an easy A if you pay attention and have a functioning brain.

Mr. Robinson cares about the students that go to class and make an effort. If you're having troubles with the speeches go to his office hours and that will help a bunch. I loved having him and I still keep in touch. Not too tough, just go to class. Need the book for exams as well.

If nothing else this guy is unique.  Not because he is the only conservative professor that i have ever had but because he is so weird. Otherwise, easy class, good & helpful professor.

Robinson makes you take attendance otherwise no one would show up to his class bc its so boring. The essays aren't bad, if you do them its basically a free 100. He is extremely easy. take him

Extremely easy A as long as you do ok on your speeches. Funny guy but can be kind of boring sometimes which makes the class drag on.

He tends to talk a lot about the Republican party and was upset that Obama was reelected. Can be rude at times, depending on how well we get along.

No point in going to class but he takes attendance. Whole class will be spent listening to his beliefs, all of his life accomplishments, and how much he has made a difference in people's lives. Wouldn't recommend cause I'm sure there are better professors out there, but definitely not a hard class

Super easy, but like previous reviewers said... hes super republican and WILL shove his beliefs down your throat. Presents his opinions as facts. Lectures are almost unbearable nowadays... good thing this semester is almost over.

The class itself is super easy. He says he is an understanding professor, but he's not. Super religous, Republican, and will shove opinions down your throat like their facts. Show up and you can get attendance points, but the class the largely common sense. Really looks like Vernon Dursley.
Very conservative republican, says hes unbiased but obviously oblivious to his jokes. Talks about nascar a lot. Can get pretty boring, but ultimately he's a good prof. Very easy speeches.

He was a great professor! I loved going to his class and I always looked forward to itbecause he has some interesting stories and loves teaching! I really learned a lot and he tells you what he expects for each assignment. Make sure to attend class even though he doesn't make you. He's an open book so TAKE HIS CLASS! Best professor by far!

He is a super charming professor. He never grow up. His class looks hard but he'll show you how easy it is if you pay attention on it. He have some easy extra credit for everyone. Don't hesitate to choose his class

Very good professor. Really easy but at the same time allows you to grow as a speaker. Be warned that he is a strong conservative republican and will crack democrat jokes every now and then lol. Attendance is mandatory but time goes by really fast.

I love this class, when I wasnt trying to keep my eyes open. He can be interesting sometimes, but then he can put you to sleep sometimes too. I love the class so far, but I think he just needs to work on how he speaks like whe he tries to be animated, it so does not work and it is so boring. But overall he can be very funny and his class is easy!!

Super easy A.  Attendance mandatory. If you show up and study a little bit for the exam you are almost guaranteed an A in the class. Robinson himself is a bit annoying. Very easy class. The teacher is cool too. First day of class, I personally thought he was weird because he always talked about NASCAR and Star Wars and such. Really easy class. Teacher is super annoying with his pretentious attitude; I don't care if he likes NASCAR or is Republican, but I'm thoroughly annoyed by his self-righteous regard for himself. Rambles about NASCAR and his native American jewelry. Easiest class in the world.

If you want an easy class and you dont mind the nonsense, take it.

This teacher is very easy! There are quizzes, ya but he sometimes does not even give them and just hands everyone full points for showing up. Got an easy A. Dr guy was not as considerate with late work for partial credit or extending the midterm which was worth 40 percent of grade even though we lost a week due to the winterstorm in the middle of a pandemic. reviews.comment: Professor Guy made a huge impact on me. When you're taught by someone as passionate as he about learning, it makes you feel inspired to want to learn too. Awesome professor. He teaches with such a passion it makes you actually want to pay attention. He's accessible outside of class and very understanding of your circumstances. I've even thought of taking his other classes even though they're not in my major. Mainly unit conversions and some MATLAB at the end. Not hard, just not familiar w/ them @ 1st
You can't go wrong with this professor. Just follow the syllabus and attend class and you're golden. He made what sounds like a boring class enjoyable.

reviews.comment: Take this professor. He is very professional and does a great job. He rarely trips up, and even in quarantine, he is the only professor I've had that teaches AT THE SAME LEVEL as he does in the classroom. He may seem a bit scary, can sometimes teach a tad vague, and really make you work for it. If you do your job, you'll pass EASILY, he is awesome

DO NOT MISS LECTURES!! He gives such great lectures, do not miss out! Funny, intelligent, and interesting professional. He cares about you and your future. Exams are actually fun, and so was the homework, but they are difficult.

Super chill professor that teaches material in a very clear and concise manner. He can make simple concepts more interesting and more complex ideas simple by using personal anecdotes. He is very down to Earth and understanding, so he'll help you out if you have a reasonable issue.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Guy is probably the best professor I've had so far. He makes sure we understand the material by giving everyone a chance to participate. That might sound scary but trust me, you'll be thankful. There aren't enough words to describe how amazing of a professor he his. Take him in any class he's teaching.
Dr. Guy might be the best instructor I have ever had. Supremely knowledgeable, harsh but understanding, gifted teacher, great communicator. Take him for any class you can.

Prof. Guy knows his stuff. Hes absolutely brilliant. Hes a caring professional and expects you to do the work he gives you. Hes strict on dates and times. I made a C because I messed up on on out of the 3 tests we had. If not for that I would have made an A.

Ashley Guy might very-well be the best professor at the University of Texas at Arlington. His style of teach is amazing and I believe that he gets the best out of each of his students. He is also able to explain and teach rather difficult concepts in a way that is easy to grasp and understand. Guy is incredibly knowledgeable and still passionate ab
ENGR 1250 is pretty much the same all around. Tons of hw and three exams. This professor was fairly good at explaining concepts. He also replies to emails within the same day.

Absolutely flawless, clear lectures, clear concepts, some HW tough but always ready to help and fair grading, there are some teachers who have been teaching in UTA for almost 50 years. They should learn from DrGuy how to make student get knowledge without much pressure.

One of the greatest professors I've had at UTA. He is very thorough in his lectures and makes sure that every student's engaged. If you have any worries on the material, go to his office. He is always willing to help his students. Homework is tough and tests can be brutal but he gives tons of points just for setting up the problem. Show up to class

Hes a great lecturer, actually teacher very well and cares about the students learning the material. Some homework is tough, but he is always willing to help. Attendance isnt necessary but dont miss lecture. Grades very fair, partial credit.

His passion for teaching and sharing knowledge was observed throughout the duration of this class.

reviews.comment: Took him for Dynamics and then Methods over the summer. He is an amazing dynamics professor! Gets the class engaged and makes sure everybody learns.
