reviews.comment: Boswell knows his stuff, make sure you do any changes he suggests as it will help your grade cause it has what he wants. Has a hard time connecting with students and will often throw jabs at students. Isn't a bad professor but if you're stuck with him, try your best and you'll most likely pass
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is a good professor and he knows his stuff. as a person he sucks. He calls you out in class and for the jury he was trying to make the other professors laugh at your work. So terrible person. his class was the hardest class ever, nothing made sense until the last project where everything you did, came together. No softwares, all hand projects.

Absolutely fantastic professor. Knows his stuff and will sit down individually to work through your project with you, given you're receptive to feedback. Likes to poke fun at students, but expects it back - so don't take these as personal attacks. If you can throw a lighthearted jab back at him, you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: If you genuinely want to be the best possible architect you can be and you are willing to do whatever it takes to become this architect. Take professor Boswell, it will not be easy, but if you love architecture you will love his class. If you are just trying to get a degree however, don't take him, you will hate him and be miserable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Best professor.  Expect to continue learning a month after the class is over if you're at all thoughtful about your projects and the readings he assigns after the class ends.  READ EVERYTHING HE SUGGESTS!!
SMARTEST PROFESSOR IN THE SCHOOL OF ARCHITECTURE.
This professor does not work for you, he doesn'l help anyone with projects, yethe asks for so many colsses.

The most intelligent professor I've ever had. With just one look at your work, in one second, he would tell you what you had to improve. He enjoyed dropping by the studio in the middle of the night just to see who was working. One tip: while the final presentation always leave a bowl of M&M's next to his chair...he'll be in a better mood.

Rather blunt, and opinionated. Will not tolerate slackers, appreciates hard work and someone with a sense of humor (don't take the class if you can't laugh at your own silly mistakes). Overall one of the best teachers I've had; worked really hard, learned A LOT and would do it again.
Maybe he is good professor, but not so nice as a person.
Best teacher you'll ever have or know. A wealth of knowledge, heavy work load, multiple projects. In the end you will have some great projects for your portfolio.
Boswell is a great teacher but you need to work hard. If you do this, you'll learn a lot and enjoy the class. If you want to slack and not work so hard then he is not the teacher for you.

He's helpful when he wants to be.  You have to know how to handle him.  He wants to be picked on, he wants to be joked around with.  It's as simple as that.  If he likes you, you'll do well, you'll get the help and the grade, if he doesn't, well, you might want to pray because you just simply won't get that much back from him.

I had this guy in 1980 and still remember how he left a bad taste in my mouth. I guess if he is letting you know what it's like to someday have the "boss from Hell" then he does serve a purpose. He had a TA named Hunter that was about as bad as I remember it. I'd love to show him my drawings in Archetectural Digest Jan 91 edition...
No Comments
No Comments

This guy taught some of the professors who are teaching now at UTA. He thinks hes the****, he knows hes the****. Hes is no holds bar when it comes to judging design or work. I really enjoyed the class and am most likely going to take him again.
Can you Dig it ?

She is a nice professor, gives extra credit pop quizzes almost every class. Exams are open book and she gives opportunity to retake one midterm. I usually did other work in class and studied the slides a day or 2 before exam and always got above a B on exams. Overall I would take her again.

I'd rather die than attend her class again. She is one of the rudest people I've ever met she lacks communication skills and merely reads from the PowerPoint. If you care about your GPA,don't take her. I regret taking her.She dose not help at all. I've never received a B in any of my classes, and this was the first. I was one point away from an A.

She let us converse with our classmates to do active recall together and if we have questions on certain topics, she would help us out. Some people in the class said that she didn't teach us. Sure she may not have been too in depth with going over the lecture slides, but she gave us a nice set up of the materials we needed to know for our exams!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Not the best professor, but you are able to get by in the class just fine. Her powerpoints are straight from the textbook and all exams are open book. She does not give out homework and gives pop quizzes that are counted as extra credit towards your final grade.

The lack of structure in this class made it hard to learn. Reading the textbook, notes, answering the questions on the textbook wasn't enough. The test questions can be strange at times. Asked her questions over the material, didn't give me a straight answer! AVOID

Dr. Boutte is an okay professor. She is willing to work with you, but there were some moments I felt that she could come off a little snarky. I've had worse though. It was her first semester teaching the course, and it was kind of obvious haha. She was anxious during most lectures, and you can tell SHE knows the material but was trying to teach it.

I would not take another class with this professor. She really struggles to write tests in a way that aren't so incredibly difficult that the class average is a low C on basically every single test. Also on the assignments just take her slides and repeat them on your concept map. She doesn't want you to add to the ideas just regurgitate.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Wonderful professor! She mentioned that this was her first time teaching micro lecture and I hope she knows she did wonderful! She is very passionate about what she does. Exams were based on mainly on the textbook, so make sure you read it! (don't worry, the textbook is very easy to follow - coming from someone who struggles w/ reading textbooks)

dont listen to any other positive rating for this teacher, she is so rude and expects us to know as much as she does. She only started getting "nice" towards the end of the semester, but she has easily been the worst professor I have ever had at my time in UTA. Literally only take her if she is the only professor for the class. Def not worth it!

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSORPlease don't make the mistake I did, she is the rudest and worst professor, she literally wants the worst for her students.Her feedback is very degrading, not even mentioning how rude she is when answering questions in class. She always comes to class with a bad attitude and gets upset when we don't understand. DO NOT TAKE
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Every assignment (minus exams) is a group project. If you are the only one in your group that shows up and you complete the assignment, everyone in the group will get the grade for it. Extremely tough grader. Incredibly rude attitude with her students. This class is "flipped" - you only come in to work with your group.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Horrible, rude, snotty, disrespectful. That's all
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Boutte is a fantastic professor: very lenient grading, gives feedback and allows for corrections, VERY helpful in office hours. THE PARTICIPATION IN THIS CLASS IS MANDATORY- IS NOT OPTIONAL! this class is mostly group projects, so you have to showup. your participation is graded by your peers and costs 22% but the work is easy if you show up

This class will take up A LOT of your time and focus so plan ahead wisely. The way the class is taught is very unique so you'll struggle at first, but subsequent assignments become easier with experience and Boutte is great at giving feedback. This class helped the most in understanding how to read research papers than any i've taken in 3 years.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class is DEMANDING! She holds you to a high standard, but you learn so much. It's project-based, no exams, most assignments are done in groups during class. Her recorded lectures are great and she gives you all the background you need to understand the papers. Her feedback is very blunt, but she always answers questions and is easy to contact.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: She has a very unique class structure that is rewarding, however, way too much work. Not only that, she lacks tact when giving feedback, going so far as to belittle people. Her expectations of students are irrational (she will expect you to know biochem even if you haven't taken it yet, etc). You will learn a lot but is it worth it? Up to you.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Class itself is useful but it's also in development. We had to do various activities with groups, which was fine until we had to change the members for every paper which gets annoying. She also draws concepts during lecture but they are not good. Overall, she isn't bad and will help you understand.

Professor Boutte is a great professor. This class is focused mostly on giving you the skills you need to actually do well in science. Be prepared to read papers, do group projects, and use online resources that actual biologists use to learn pathways. She gave me a great basis of knowledge to work off of for later classes as well. Take this class.

I really enjoyed taking this course. Professor Laster was very helpful and wanted students to succeed. I found the lectures and reading very interesting. The workload was very easy and overall, if I had to retake this course I would.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Laster's lectures aren't mandatory, but you get the most information out of there. The exams are very easy too. The only thing worth any stress are the case studies, but she isn't a tough grader as long as you used thought and logic.

I had Dr. Laster for PSYC 3317 and 3310. Just a couple of exams and a couple of assignments for both of the classes. I LOVE her lectures because she is very engaging and provides opportunities to connect with classmates. She is one of the best psychology professors at UTA and you won't regret taking a class with her!!

Dr. Laster is great! Heard so much hype around her coming into this class so I was expecting greatness and she delivered! Very respected teacher and has very interesting and engaging lectures. Can't wait to take her for my Adv Topics class. Take Dr. Laster for any class you can !!! Wish I had her for some of my other psych classes.
This professor is not understanding of life experience or forgiving in any way.

I've taken several of Dr. Laster's courses over the past few semesters and have passed every class. She really knows what she's talking about - classes are interesting and engaging. As with any class, you need to take some time to read the textbooks and understand the material. I highly recommend taking any course taught by her!

While a textbook is required, it is paid for by your tuition. I absolutely loved this class. While attendance is not mandatory, her lectures are incredible, and if you attend, you won't have to study for the exams. Only 4 exams, no midterm or final, and only a few very easy assignments, overall, it is definitely a pretty easy-going class.

I didn't know what to except coming into this course, but I'm glad I enrolled in it. Prof Laster does a great job of breaking down the content in a way you can understand and is eye opening. This class allowed me to be self-reflective of my own way of thinking and decision making. Assignments and exams are super straight forward. Highly recommend!
She was nice during her lectures and she knew the info but her grading guidelines were stiff and the course was uninteresting.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: professor Laster was an amazing professor she was clear with the material and super interesting. i think her class was very well put together and was not difficult. As long as you do your work and take an hour or 2 out of your day to read the textbook you will excel in this class I promise you that!
This class was pretty easy and her lectures were helpful and engaging if you showed up to class. There were a couple of tests and a couple of assignments, but overall very manageable.

It doesn't let me select it, but I took Dr. Laster for Developmental Psychology this semester. She is awesome! I genuinely found her class and psychology interesting. She is so passionate about what she teaches! We had 2 exams and a final, some McGraw-Hill assignments, and two field experience papers. Overall, really easy and enjoyable class!

took her for developmental psych, super easy open note exams, her lectures are so good and interactive with funny stories that help you learn. attendance is not mandatory but def come if you want to pass. would take her again she is so nice!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved her lectures! She provides personal examples during lectures and keeps us interactive in class. Her exams were on the harder side in my personal opinion. I did not do well on exam days. Exams are taken from home. the McGraw Hill assignments are few and far between, but easy and time-consuming at times. Papers are easy, and there's only 2.

A word of advice: just know that you can do well on your case studies and all of your assignments, but if you don't go for attendance, the most you are making is a B, which is not fair because she does them randomly. I would just take caution if you are looking for an "easy course."

Best professor in the psych department, take her for all your classes if you need the credit. Her lectures are very fun and productive, attend them. She also has a great personality and humor, you will love her as a person. She has a PhD in educational psych, in other words, she knows exactly how to do good teaching and giving great lectures!!!!

She has such a sweet and fun personality; the day after Halloween she brought us candy for answering questions. Her lectures are engaging: she plays videos and breaks up the lecture with class discussions and role plays. Although the case studies are a bit of work, overall it was an easy A.

THE PERFECT PROFESSOR!! Throughout my entire Psychology studies, whenever she was teaching a class that I needed, I jumped at the opportunity. I think that class being constantly waitlisted says a lot about how excited students are to take her class. She's super respectful and kinda males you want to try your best at whatever the course is.

She is a great professor. Her class is very lecture heavy, if you don't attend lectures or watch the echo 360, it is hard to keep up. She is very Interactive and makes class where you genuinely learn with active recall. She provides outlines to follow, and the exams usually cover everything on them. I would definitely recommend her!

Can never go wrong with Dr. Laster. She's nice, passionate, and helpful. This is an adv. class but the material was never difficult or frustrating. The class also had 15 hrs of volunteering which was alright. The volunteer location was boring but I get why she wanted us to do it. Lab portion was busy work but gave a lot of easy A's for assignments.
She is very knowledgeable on psychology, has a great sense of humor, and grades fairly.

Lectures were fun, easy to follow along. Grade consists of attendance/participation, 2 exams, 1 final, 3 case studies -- all explained and grades easily as long as you put in the work. Use her study guides, go to class, ask questions and you'll make an A

Tests are helped by outlines, which draw from the lectures. Some of her test questions are "gotcha" questions that rely on technicalities of the English language instead of the student's comprehension of the actual subject. This may be intentional, or a symptom of a lack of preparedness in creating her exams. Other than that, she is great.

Super easy case studies that are interesting, most of what you need to know is based upon her lecture outlines. Go to class if you can. She used to take attendance but stopped. The only thing that really irked me about her is that she spent a lot of class time complaining about ppl coming in late and kept bringing it up. Some tricky exam questions.

Dr Laster cares about you learning the content above all else. She is so easy to communicate with and extremely accommodating. Dr Laster readily answers questions and provides outlines to make note taking easier. She is also super funny and encourages you to be active and get to know your classmates. My favorite professor in my three years at UTA.

I took her for abnormal psychology and I really enjoyed the class. It wasn't as easy as I assumed but she is  great. She does take random attendance and does encourage speaking up in class/group work. If not, watch the lecture videos and take notes!!!! Tests are open book but sometimes questions are only from things she mentions in lecture.

There are three exams that professor Laster makes. Multiple questions on the exams are flawed and she gives minimum credit back which is extremely unfair. There are two case studies which she meticulously grades, and when you approach her for help the "feedback" is not helpful. Don't recommend taking her if you're searching for an "easy" course.

She is a very nice professor and person. She makes class fun and knows what she's talking about. Exams are easy and everything is straight from her lectures. She gives easy assignments as a grade boost and it's difficult to fail, just take notes. She's also accommodating, just reach out and ask. Love the class and love the prof, highly recommend.

Amazing professor and an amazing class. The best class I have taken and the professor just makes it even better. She is incredibly nice and makes class interesting. She is accommodating and will move material around if she didn't cover it. Offers extra credit at the end for a grade boost. Easy exams as they are only on what she covers in lectures.

She is incredibly nice and a great professor. She knows what she's doing and makes the class enjoyable. She's very accommodating and will help students in any way that she can. She does ramble a bit, but it always connects to the lecture somehow. Easy exams and everything is straight from her lectures. One of the best professors I've had.

If you see her name for a course, take it if you can. Seriously, she's that good. You can tell she loves what she teaches and her lectures are hilarious. Social and Personality Development is also a super interesting class. Make sure to take good notes and go to class though, all of the exams and final were open note and there's no textbook.

Amazing professor! Truly cares about her students, class is easy if you attend lecture and engage. Take good notes for exams, those helped me out the most. Definitely would take this class and professor again!

Professor Laster was an amazing professor. Her class was very engaging, having us group up to discuss certain concepts and applying the material we learn in real life scenarios. The class is graded off mainly exams, along with chapter quizzes, and a small portion for attendance/participation. Lectures are important, textbook is a great supplement

Dr. Laster is one of the best professors I have ever had. I looked forward to her lectures every week. She tells very interesting stories to help you remember the material and welcomed class participation. The exams were open book. An essay was also due at the end of the semester, but you got to choose the topic, and it was an assignment I enjoyed.

It's hard for me to sit through lectures, but Dr. Laster's were so fascinating I was always eager to listen!! It is very important that you read the textbook for the quizzes and the exams. Exams are open book. This professor is determined to have her students pass and I really loved having her this semester!

Dr. Laster is one of the bests professors ever, she is very caring! her lectures are very interesting, & in order to pass her class, do attend class because she goes over important material that will be on the test!! I've taken her for a summer course and i'm currently taking her this fall semester.
Dr. Laster is one of those professors that you will remember long after graduating. Her lectures were so enjoyable that they were the only classes I ever looked forward to attending.
She is amazing! Gives free therapy during each lecture and helps if you need to understand the material. She makes sure students pass, so if you fail then you probably weren't trying. Awesome!

She is awesome. One of the few profs that still offers class via Teams, making it super helpful. She understands how students learn and structures her class in a way where it is fun and helps to retain material. She is super sweet and her exams actually test over the material covered in class. Overall great prof, would recommend.

Dr. Laster is awesome!! Shes so kind & understanding & genuinely cares about what we learn & how we learn. You definitely need to pay attention in class & take good notes, if she says write it down, WRITE IT DOWN. you dont HAVE to use the book, but you should, it helps lock in the material. Her tests are logic-based, real scenarios. 10/10!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: she's the best!

Dr. Laster is sweet, but very easily distracted by things that are irrelevant to the lecture. She makes things so much harder than they need to be. For example, she gave book clubs and even if every answer is right, it's very hard to get full credit (no rubric). The tests are open note but you will still need to study a lot so make sure you study.

I've never taken a class where I enjoyed the lectures as much as I did in this one. Dr. Laster has a way of making lectures engaging and exciting. As long as you attend every lecture and take notes there is no reason not to get an A or a B on the tests. The research paper and case studies were challenging but enjoyable. Best psych prof for sure!

Dr. Laster is my favorite Psychology professor, ever. She is very knowledgeable in the material and always has exciting lectures, I've learned so much in her class. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but going to her lectures will help you a lot on the tests, even though they were open notes. For assignments, only 2 short case studies and 1 essay.

Best PSYC class I've taken! Really enjoyed her lectures! Very knowledgeable and passionate. Tests are open book but heavy knowledge application therefore understanding the material is imperative or notes won't help. Great lectures and although there is a term paper and lengthy assignments, it was worth it! Learned a lot!
She is hands down the best professor in the psych department!

Dr. Laster is a super sweet professor. Exams are based on lectures. Attendance- not mandatory but recommended. Her TA grades the case studies with a graduate level mentality, resulting in poor grades/given no feedback. Research paper is 4+ pages with a confusing rubric. Participation graded based on how many times the course is viewed on canvas.

Cognitive Psych is not a walk in the park by any means if neuro is not your thing. But Dr. Laster explains it so well that anyone can understand it. She WANTS you to learn and will explain a process enough so you can succeed. Her exams are open note, they are based on real life scenarios, so try to give real life scenarios in your note taking.

Dr. Laster is AMAZING! The book is not required, she pulls all exam questions from lectures BUT uses real life scenarios as questions. Her lectures are funny and engaging. Every exam including the final are open note, so if you take good notes the exams are a breeze! I am taking her for PSYC3334 as well! Hands down the best and hilarious.

Cognitive psych is a hard class but Dr. Laster makes it as easily understandable as possible. I did not think I would do very well considering the difficulty of the subject but I am very surprised at how much I have truly learned and retained so far. There are 3 exams and weekly book clubs-- all very doable and easy if you pay attention in class.

Professor Laster is truly one of the kindest most supportive people. Her classes are difficult and rigorous but I have never learned so much in any of my classes. She is an educational psychologist and she is really good at teaching us to be successful learners. The TA is really tough though and grades pretty harshly.

3 exams, 2 case studies, 1 paper ( 4+ full page).
her class is good. but case study graded by her assistant. tough grade. Feedback was not provided for all. 
the level of case study is harder than paper.

She is really understanding, cares about her students, and the material is not hard. If you are not understanding something, just reach out and she'll work with you until you are confident you know how to do the work. At the end of the semester she drops low grades and tries her best to make sure you pass. Would definitely recommend taking her.

Ms. Booker is a great teacher whom I recommend anyone take for elementary stats. Her class isn't very difficult if you keep up with the assignments and properly prepare for exams. She also gives out stat coins, which help immensely by replacing your lowest test grade with your final if it's higher and/or adding 5 points to exams. Take her 4 summer
i love her! she cares so much about the subject and will do anything to help you succeed!

Ms. Booker is one of the kindest math professors I've had. She explains things clearly and slows down when needed. I had her for Contemporary Math and again for Stats. Even though I struggled with Stats, she was super accessible and gave helpful feedback. Always open to questions. If she had a easier stat class I would def take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: An absolute sweetheart. I loved Ms. Booker and her teaching style. Super easy course, although definitely plan on attending every class. The content is incredibly simple, but missing a class puts you really behind on the workbook (PLEASE get the workbook!!) and the many homeworks. As long as you show up, listen, and do the hw, you will do great!

Professor Booker is a sweet person and the class was pretty easy if you pay attention and follow along. The only downside of this class was the amount of homework and how quickly things can become unclear if you miss a day of class. There was no textbook, however, the workbook is REQUIRED to pass Math 1301.

She lowk gives a bit of homework, but it is so manageable. Super sweet teacher, and she truly cares about you. I would definitely take her if math isn't your strong suit. Math 1301 for me was a joke class, but if you struggle with math Ms. Booker is the teacher for you. You won't regret her I promise.
The lectures were very clear, and that made me understand math much better.
BEST MATH PROFESSOR.

Prof Booker was a great person, but in my opinion I felt it was easier to learn from the videos in canvas than from the lectures itself. Also, the home works were a lot and if you don't work on them soon, they will pile up on you, but there is a 24 hr grace period for all assignments, except tests. The class is easy to pass, GET ALGEBRA COINS!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor, and very accessible. She always tried making lecture fun and entertaining, take her!! The class overall involves so much homework, and requires studying. Textbook and attendance are mandatory.

Amazing teacher, made a course that would normally be very hard pretty easy.  As long as you keep up with your assignments, this class should be an easy B. There are 3 exams, and 1 final. With the use of algebra coins you can retake 1 exam or replace your final exam grade with your average of the three exams.

She's a great teacher, and made getting through the course easier even if it was tedious. Better than other math profs from what I hear - very accommodating as long as you ask. There's a 24-hr grace period on hw & you can redo an exam (3 + a final). Pretty frequent hw but use the workbook (required) and it's easy, just don't rely on it too much.

So so so much homework, but it honestly helps with the test. She explains everything in detail, and if you get lost, she'll help you no matter what. She also records all the lectures, so if you miss one day, watch it and you'll be fine. I'd say she's one of the best professors to teach the course!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures are paper on a projector.We were three weeks ahead of syllabus at one point.He doesn't know the syllabus and thought we had two additional homework's due.He only gave us one quiz all semester (10% total grade weight) and 3/4 of the class wasn't there so everyone lost a full letter grade. There is always one crazy hard problem on each test.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Blow up my head....

His lectures are impossible to follow and unless you are an expert in Matlab no use of taking this course. Also the lectures are not at all organized. I am not saying this because I got a B. Cause I know I studied hard and tried but the over all experience with this course was horrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Horrible lecturer, has difficulty explaining concepts accurately and in a way that makes sense. Forgot to post homework's and quizzes on multiple occasions leading to the class being behind. Although he is nice I would not recommend him as a professor, was able to pass the class from studying the concepts from other lecturers (Jeff Hanson).

reviews.comment: All I'm going to say is take Santra. Save yourself the trouble. Wouldn't even use this guy as a last resort.

Exams are messy. Doesn't give you a clear guideline on what to expect. He says to look at the syllabus or the hws but it's useless. His partial credit SUCKS, either half credit or no points for the problem. Cal 2 was easier than this class.
Chat gpt is a better teacher. He does way too much for no reason.

Last resort professor. Tough grader, ask him for help he will say go look at the lecture videos. Does not release grades on canvas. I rather miss a semester to take Professor Santra instead of him. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: His partial credit is not the greatest. Exams are not hard honestly. But if the answer is wrong half credit only, and even sometimes no credit for the problem. Also he doesn't really say what will be on the exam. It's a bit difficult to study the right topics. Recommend book/hw. Chill prof partial credit kills also doesn't put grade up till end.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: His lectures contain a lot of unnecessary and unclear bad examples. Chat gpt is a better teacher than him. UTA dont put him for lecture put an AI instead of him.

The teacher doesn't give feedback for exams. Whenever I email him with questions, he always says, ‘I went over this in class,' which isn't helpful. He replies quickly, which is nice, but his responses often feel rude and make it seem like it's my fault for asking. This class is easy, he makes it harder.  Get Abhishek Santra he's better.

The way he lectures is clear and will pause to allow students to ask questions or fully grasp a concept. When taking his class, it is imperative to pay attention. His grading policy is that of following procedure according to UTA, so there is no leniency. This class (similar to calc 2) can be difficult because of the subject, so take time and study
Amazing professor, you will learn a lot from him if you put in the effort

The professor is overly strict with deadlines, giving a zero for being seconds late on assignments. A fairer approach is to deduct a small percentage instead of dismissing the effort entirely, where your effort doesn't go vague. This rigid policy has negatively affected my grade, and I would have done better if the grading were more reasonable.

If you are 1 min late for class to submit the homework, you get 0/100. If your code for some reason doesn't compile or has a little silly error, you get 0/100, no points for the attempt at all. He is anxious and is very jittery and it bothered me throughout the whole semester. His weird accent was horrible. Worst professor ever, run away telling ya
His class is the reason I dropped out of computer science tbh.

Originally, I didn't like him but I actually grew to like his way of teaching. He pushes his students so they are prepared for anything that comes at them. The class becomes very easy if you take the time to understand what you are learning and apply that to homework and exams.

The first few assignments are easy but then the later ones make you wanna question your life. Never stressed over the homework so much before. Do yourself a favor and pick another instructor. You will save your sanity and a lot of your time.

I honestly don't know why this professor is getting so many negative reviews for 2312. Assembly was one of the classes where I actually enjoyed attending and learning. Homework is tedious and long but very rewarding. Exams are easy if you study homework and practice coding.

Not a bad professor. Explains things pretty well. Hw every week but not very hard. I believe 80 percent is exams. Do your best to get an A on the first two as they are very easy in hindsight. Exam one is a free A. The final is a little harder.

Overall good professor, he knows his stuff and teaches relatively well to professors in the CSE department. Tests are 70%, hws are 30%. His tests are 4 questions, as long as you pay attention in class and do hws, the tests are easy. He posts youtube videos outside of class that were helpful. Wish he had slides posted all along. There was a curve.

Good, passionate teacher. His class did require some outside of class learning to get concepts as the lecture goes fast- but he's the best teacher if you want to really understand it all. Fairly strict grader but lots of partial credit and the lectures are recorded. He went pretty fast so you do have to keep up- but his weekly hw was manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super tough grader, difficult to understand lectures. He's very erratic and not very helpful unless you see him outside of class *in person*. First few homeworks are easy then suddenly are long and confusing. He prioritizes you understanding the material but it means he wont help you out with the hws. Think mad genius maybe...
never cried and stressed so much over homework and a professor's grading style save yourselves the panic attacks
Grades homework so harshly do not take him. RUN

Personable professor, prioritizes understanding the material over anything. Hard course to juggle if you are taking other CSE/core classes that you will prioritize over Assembly. The weekly homework is annoyingly complex and graded strictly. Course and professor's grading have contributed to a sharp deterioration of my mental health this semester.
no resources. makes the class next to impossible to study for. canvas links are too broad. tests, are 2-4 questions. make a mistake, you get 25+ points taken off.

He was a good professor back in 2019... not so great professor now. He's new to canvas system so his modules are full of links to broad topics and his recorded lecture are not good. His homework is confusing at times. He definitely doesn't take responsibility in his poor teaching skills. He emails us stating why we failed to pass his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: i like this professor, however, he does not teach 2312 well. like, at all. makes you want to tear your hair out.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: horrible teaching style, good smart guy. take someone else. this course in general is not taught very intuitively.

There will be a lot of people who say Dr. Brezeale is a terrible professor. There will be a decent number of people who say Dr. Brezeale is one of the best professors they've ever had. Almost no one will have a moderate view of him. If you want to learn the material and get the grade you deserve, you cannot ask for a better teacher.

This guy can make the easiest topics seem very hard. I was struggling in his class and consider him as a professor with little teaching skills. Try to find someone or some resource that teaches you if you registered for his class. Final grade is the lowest average of either your HW or tests. I studied a lot and still worried about my final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You might be intimidated by his grading, but it's actually not that bad because of his amazing lectures. His tests aren't there to screw you over - everything on it was covered in hws/lectures, and hws were straightforward. Algorithms is tough, but he makes it easy to understand. If he ever teaches the course again, DEFINITELY take him
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I will be graduating in a few months, and I can say that this person was the worst "professor" I saw. I attended the classes, worked the HW,and did my best and failed the class in the first time. I learned almost nothing and regret what I paid for his class. a lot of searching the Internet, long hours, and textbooks helped me but not Mr. Brezeale.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I would rather quit study if i have a professor like him in future. Teachers are motivational factors of students but i am so demotivate with his character. I don't know about his mission but believe me or not you will frustrated taking his class. His mission is like failing students.

He's clear and to the point. Good at explaining concepts. Easy to make an A just by doing the 10 homeworks and going to class. Tests are DIRECTLY based off the homework. Some Python in the last few homeworks.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've taken, he does not read from powerpoints, but rather prepares his own notes and learns the material himself to teach you. Lots of homework, but you will learn alot and can use the material in the real world you learn. Tests are easy if you go to class and takes notes. No quizzes.

Brezeale should change his grading policy. It appears as if he cares more about failing students rather than their learning. Grademin(hw_avg, exam_avg) is ridiculous. Not that his homeworks or exams are too hard, but showing zero flexibility (no extra credit, no curve nothing) shows that he care more about his policy rather than students
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Ridiculous grading system where he takes the lowest of your homework/test average and that is your final grade for the course. Made us use archaic text editors like vim which makes debugging nearly impossible for students learning to code in C for the first time. I would only suggest taking if you already have a strong programming background.

If you actually want to know and use the material he teaches in this class later, take him. If you want an easy A and don't care about learning, DO NOT take him. Yes his grading policy is odd, yes his class is theory based (not just formula memorization), you actually have to learn and understand the material well in order to get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's a solid teacher, but I wouldn't recommend taking him during the summer. Class moves much more quickly than any other class and your grade is equivalent to the LOWER of labs/tests grade total. If you do want to take him during the summer, make sure you aren't working a full time job or taking some other courses. (I did both).
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: His grading scheme is definitely weird. But his homework assignments are not difficult and the exams are based on homework. He is lenient on grading and lectures are easy to follow. So if you study good, it should be an easy A. But you will need to do more by yourself if you want to learn more about the topics.

The last two defending rates sound exact like what Brezeale says about his classes! Grades haven't been posted yet the defender got 2 A's! I did not understand what he was saying in class. I read the book, did the homework, and didn't do well in class. I should have taken this class in TCC, it is transferrable. I wasted my money on this class.

What Dr. B teaches in 2312 is really good! He understands that assembly isn't something most people will be dealing with in the CS field, and so he teaches us to code a very gentle assembly. The computer organization stuff he does teach has been really helpful in terms of how things work, and really interesting, especially about performance.

Dr. Brezeale is very clear on what he expects from you. His grading policy is unique and sounds like a nightmare, but doing your homework means you will do fine on the exams. People who say he doesn't truly teach likely were not actually paying attention; Dr. B's lectures and website are packed with useful information regarding LinAlg. Awesome guy.

Reviews say he was good, I wish I took him when he was the best professor. He makes a lot of mistakes which made me rely on the textbook rather than his lectures. Now, we have 4 tests, he used to give 3 tests when he was a good professor. Know how to coin your question, otherwise he would be disrespectful. Has a poor ability to convey the material.

I learned almost nothing in his class. Luckily, I have a friend who already took linear algebra with the math department who helped me. Take his class if you are very good at the topics he will "teach." He doesn't teach coding in python but gives python coding assignment.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. B is one of the best CSE professors at UTA. He's a great lecturer and he gives a lot of good analogies to help understand the material better. Your final grade is the lower grade between your homework average and your exam average so it forces you to do both. The exams are not hard as long as you do and understand the homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Best professor at UTA, hands down. His lectures are amazing, you will learn a LOT and he will always try to relate things back to CS. Everything you need to know is taught in class, homeworks are usually straight forward. Brilliant guy, super smart, very enthusiastic about teaching. Anything on the test is fair game as it is always found in notes.

He does not waste your time be prepared to come to class and take notes as the homeworks and assignments are directly based off the notes - Programming assignments require prior knowledge but demonstrate real world principles and applications - his tests are 5 questions - study homework and you will pass - master the concepts not the questions
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I very much enjoyed his lectures. The class covers a lot of material and he is pretty tough on grading, but if you come to class and pay attention you should be good.

If you have signed up for one of his class, get ready to work hard.  He used to make every single class (1hr 50 mins class)  would go so fast. During his class, make sure you are not distracted for even a single second,  because you will be missing some valuable information. His lectures are well packed & organized and u'll learn a lot at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: His grading policies are strict but it is very easy to learn in his class.

reviews.comment: I have had him for cse1320 and cse3380. One of the best professors at UTA.  If you expect to come in and breeze through the class you will have trouble. You actually have to learn in his classes.  He explains material thoroughly and if you are having any trouble ask questions he will answer them
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great teacher, no nonsense at times. He understands the material can be a rough at times so he works through lots of example problems in lectures that help out with the homework and tests. He takes the lower of your test/homework average which is a little scary but neither of those are outrageously hard if you keep up with everything.

I'm not sure why this professor gets such a bad rep among some students. He is a challenging professor but the notion that he doesn't care about the students is total BS. Take notes religiously during lectures, understand the homework, and go to office hours if you're still having trouble. Tests are very similar to homework. You will learn a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Please do not take this class unless you already know the subject, he is insane. The labs are extremely hard and the way he grades it is very unclear. He doesn't even care about you, this is a very important class and this will mess up your gpa.
Awful teacher. Like many said, he's hard to understand, work is hard and he doesn't provide any useful help.

Takes HW or Exam Avg for final grade. Expected to have lower Exam Avg, but I found HW more challenging. People let tutors do the work or copy off each other, and it shows with their test scores, yet you're allowed to replace bad score w/ final. Need to be able to make up HWs! If you work and commute, make time for reading. Otherwise great teacher!

He is a very good teacher, but expect to work for an A. You should really invest in going to class, attendance isn't mandatory, but if you want a good grade go to lecture. He never assigns anything out of the book, but you should read chapters. Test are short and have problems very similar to the homework, so understand the homework very well.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher! Lectures are packed full of information, and the homework is challenging, but very do-able! He makes sure to explain how the topic is relevant to CS and will do his best to answer any questions. He is very willing to help in his office hours, too, and genuinely cares about your success. Take him if you want a challenge and to learn
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Brezeale is one of my favorite professors at UTA. His classes are very challenging and his grading system is difficult, but no one will do a better job of teaching you the material. I've used everything he taught in his class in subsequent classes. Beyond that, he actually cares about his students, and that's a quality I'll cherish in any prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: You will LEARN A LOT with Dr. Brezeale. He will show you why his courses are relevant to your degree and to your career goals. People that are saying he is "awful" are not in school for the right reasons.  Dr. Brezeale is one of the few reasons I am proud to be a UTA alumni.
Have you ever heard any professor drop the highest grade homework or exam? No? Now you have.

Darin is a very difficult teacher, but by far one of the best. The only thing is, if you trip, you have a low chance of catching up. UNLESS you go speak with him. I made the mistake of not doing so until after it was too late. But that's not his fault, and he was still helpful when I did come to him. Definitely advise him to learn a ton.

This class is guaranteed to make you a better programmer if you stick with it till the end. This is not a class you want to take if you're looking to get a high grade. Homeworks take hours on end and tests are relatively easier. If you do take this class with him please know this is the toughest class you possibly can take as a freshman/sophomore.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Poor and unclear lectures.
Just avoid him. He is impatient and sometimes loses temper.

He puts a lot of work into making his assignments- homework will keep you busy. Does an okay job of explaining concepts in class. Aside from that he's not a very nice guy- not approachable during office hours, first time dealing with such a disrespectful professor. Incredibly condescending.

He is OVER QUALIFIED to teach at UTA. Brilliant teacher. If you take him, make sure you know what you're doing. He is more than willing to help you anytime of the week, even weekends. I unfortunately had to drop his class only because of his grading policies. He takes 2 averages of HW & tests. Which ever average is lower is your final grade!

Dr. Brezeale is one of the best professors I've encountered at UTA thus far. He is extremely knowledgeable in what he teaches. He expects that students taking 1320 have a firm grasp of the fundamentals taught in 1310 (i.e. loops, functions, variables, lists, dictionaries etc.). Don't skip class because hearing him talk about the material helps.
You couldn't pick a better professor for 1320. Homework is reasonable and the exams are challenging. You will end the semester feeling like you learned a lot.

I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND HIM. Homework is given back to back, and his lectures are really long. His lectures are important to go to so you know what is going on, but he tends to get off topic a lot. For many this is the first time using C in his class, but he doesn't do a good job. very FAST place class. Good person, would not recommend for an easy A

Tough class, tough grading system, but extremely likable professor. He teaches with enthusiasm in a way that shows he knows way beyond the material he's teaching. If you do and understand all the homework, the tests aren't bad. But you need to keep both your test and hw averages high--your final grade is the LOWER of the two.

Amazing professor, very intelligent and able to share his knowledge effectively. Down to earth and always willing to help. Good sense of humor too!  Don't expect an easy A though, he is insistent that you understand the material. Will take again, every chance I get.

Hands down my favorite Professor. You can set your watch by his homework due dates and class schedule. He really understands what he is teaching and is very clear about what you need to do. You will learn a lot from him if your willing to work. He is a tough grader, but consistent and very willing to help you 1 on 1.

He is a very good professor. Very Very difficult. If you take him, you will learn alot. expect to put 10+ hours on each homework. He is very strict when it comes to grading. He is helpful in answering over email. Don't expect him to give the answers  as only faint clues are given. Pretty imppressive actually. Don't expect to get an A in his class.

Great professor. If you want to LEARN how to PROGRAM take his class. If you want an easy class to get an A in, DO NOT take this class. He is helpful, he knows what he's doing, he's overqualified to teach, and he will hammer programming into your head. If you want to be successful in the real world, then you won't be afraid to take him.

He is a good teacher but too hard. Each homework takes around 15 hours. exams are very hard and there is no curve. I thought i could make it since i was taking online course and reading the book i bought for learning C. Maybe i could have passed in a regular semester. DO NOT TAKE HIM IN SUMMER! unless your don't have a job.
Tough professor, but he is very helpful and cares about making you learn the material. He does not curve grades. If you take one of his classes, expect to put in work.

Very helpful especially if you see him in his office or in the halls he WILL help you as much as he if you put in the effort.  It may seem like he is going fast, but thats the nature of the course but you learn a ton, he teaches in such a way that it is really easy to understand difficult concepts like SVD and Least Squares.  Great guy and helpful.

One of the best professor in UTA. After you take his class, you are guaranteed to success ahead of your programming class. You will learn advance stuff with him which will sharpen your knowledge of programming through out your career.

The way he grades, he will do as much as he can to try to fail you. He is an angry man. Do not mess with him. His homework will take you millions of hours to finish. If you dont have prior programming experience, listen to this. Do NOT TAKE HIM because you will regret your decision. Take him if you dont care about your grades, you will learn

best professor in the CSE department. He does everything he can to show you how useful programming can be, and to help you out with whatever it may be. I even go to him now (1.5 years after i've taken his 1310 and 1320 classes) for help occasionally. Make no mistake though, you will have to work, but you will most definitely learn the material.

I took him for CSE 1310 and CSE 1320. HE IS THE BEST TEACHER you will get. I really miss his class. While you're taking him, you don't appreciate everything he does, but you will. YOU WILL NOT REGRET THIS CHOICE. He also is  super helpful. If you have a question, don't hesitate to go to his office hours! He loves speaking to students.

Great Teacher! Attend his classes, do all homework and you will do fine in the class.His exams are just like his homework assignments. Don't expect it to be an easy class since its an intermediary course. Also, No one can teach you pointer better than him.
Best professor in UTA. If you are a beginner, study hard at home. He will make you a professional programmer.

His class is definitely not on the easy side, but it is still very possible to make an A. He is very clear about what he wants and how he wants it, which is a positive thing. He is always available and willing to help when you need it, and he replies to emails very quickly. DO THE HOMEWORK, attend class, and you should be fine!

ATTEND HIS CLASSES, he will tell you that you don't have to show up other than for exams but you WILL FAIL if you don't attend his classes.  Course becomes easy if you do the homework and show up in class.  He will answer questions, don't be intimidated by how he speaks.  When you get to data-structures make sure to practice and study them a lot.

You can attend class only to finals and make an A. You have to keep up with the course and submit the homework though, of course. He posts his examples and lectures(ppts) online so you can easily teach yourself. Highly recommended. He does NOT expect you to have experience. He only asks if you do.

I had to retake because I skipped too many times. If attitude is, if you're not caught up, then you need to read the book, or his examples. Exams are easy if you've done your homework, and practiced a little.

Materials before first test easy. A beginner? course gets really tough progressively. neither books nor office visits help. Labs aren't too hard. Expects you to have programming experience before class. Speaks waytoofast. Tries to help you. NOT recommended for beginners. Not beginners? you'll pass. Just be careful &Be ready to spend HOURS on it.

Don't take class with him. He doesnt give a damn how his class is doing in exams regardless of low avg. He will kill you in finals with all  data structures questions which are supposed to be taught in higher classes.

I do not recommend this prof. He taught data structures at the end of semester. I was hoping that I will do good in finals to make up my grade . But he gave all the questions worth lots of points  from data structures in the intermediate programming class.you will get easy F if u have not taken C before..!!!
If you are genius then go for it else don't take a risk. He will kill you and after working hard throughout the semester you can expect F as your grade. So stay away from him.

OK.My first programming class was more than I expected. It all went well for the first few months of the semester. But at the end, he taught us more data structure and no C or C++ at all. I guess he just went crazy trying to make other professor's work easy. But how can you teach all data structure in C. If he is like this? I don't recommend him.

Ok so Brezeale is a good guy. However I took him this spring and I guess he expected a lot from us. The test are completely writing code so they are easy to fail. I don't think his HW is that hard. Also even if his class did cause me strain I can sincerely say that he DID though me C well. So  I have to say that I recommend him, but be warned.

Difficult course at UTA, regardless of the teacher. If you're going to take it, Darin isn't a bad way to go. This semester was his first 1320 course, and he will probably be a lot better next time. If you need help, he will try to give you as little as you need, but in my experience, won't stop until you're good.
Same as below, smart guy great prof very helpful, but DON'T take if you are beginner. Text book is no help, great class for majors.

I am taking this class current spring sem. Darin used to be very good teacher, when I took him for python, cse 1310 year back. But this sem, he is so  rude when u go to him for doubts, just let u know the fault and thats it. May be he is busy wid other stuffs. :) Still I would recommend him. 10 Labs are short but challenging as its just for a week.
Easy for those who are familiar with programming but for the beginners , he is worst. Hard tests. No extra points, but he is really helpful.
Best teacher in the CSE department.

Nice guy, short labs, go to class and practice programming, you'll be fine.  A rare prof who really takes an interest in his students and his role in their learning.  Writes a good bit of free supplemental CSE-related help guides available on his campus web page.

He is an outstanding professor. Goes out of his way to be available for students.  Very quick email responses.  Tests are always straightforward.  If he would grow back his beard he would get a chili pepper for sure.

I took him back when the course was still taught in C and found it pretty easy because I already knew how to program.  It's hard to judge his teaching ability because of his but I can say he's a great person.  He set a great example of the CSE department.
Professor Brezeale is a great teacher. The class was fun and not too difficult. The homework is not terribly laborious and the midterms/final are not that hard either. Take him if you can!
Great Teacher!  Very easy to follow and teaches in a way that everybody understands.  Very down to earth and friendly.  Very helpful if you have questions.

An awesome professor.  I've had a little experience with C so I had no troubles with his class, but even so he goes into great detail and makes sure everybody understands the subject to the greatest degree possible.  Very friendly and helpful.  Textbook is optional but helpful to have one.
Too bad there arent more teachers like Brezeale. The world would be a more intelligent place.

He is awesome! He is really helpful. He answers your emails right away and is always available to help you. It's a pretty hard class requiring weekly homework but you learn the material by figuring out the homework. So you don't need to study for tests if you do the homework! He is nice and teaches in a way anyone can understand and posts everything on his website from homework solutions, past tests to powerpoints! Take him!

Probably the most down to earth professor.  He doesn't have PhD syndrome like most teachers i have had.  His class is pretty easy if you keep up with the material.  He is a fun guy, but expects you to know the material.  Will definitely try to take him for another class.

Class was taught in C89.  Teacher is familiar with C99 and C++.  1310 isn't as rigorous as his 1311 course.  80% of test questions are reading code, 20% you write.  Brez knows his stuff, and teaches well.

Great Professor, can seem a lil' whack but he is very awesome to talk to.He is too helpful(lol!), tests are simple show output of c programming and create simple c programs. The book assigned for the class is only used for reference, but is a plus to have. Easy A if you do at least some programming practice while not in class. Definitely recommend!
He is extremely helpful.  Answers about a billion emails a day, i bet.  Homework every week, but if you can do those then the exam is really easy.  He is a good one.
This class is really easy as long as long as you print out his powerpoints and study the slides you'll do good.  don't buy the lecture book, but you do need to buy the book for lab.

I took this professor for CSE 1301 and he is a good teacher. His class was easy all you have to do is study the powerpoints and that's basically it. The book is not necessary for the class; only the book for lab. His test are all short answer but not difficult. There are only 3 test, no final.

I 'm taking his class CSE 1311. He's very good and clear in teaching. His examples, practices and infomations already there. He take step by step level in the homework and very helpful. He's the best.

If you think this class is going to be an easy elective then think again. Your grade will solely depend on content heavy exams and free write answers.She's so rude you don't even want to ask a question. Her class is meant for graduates or field majors, she expects you to know everything and to understand topics even though its an intro class.

 Beware, just review the lectures and don't attend class if you don't like her.
