reviews.comment: Her class is unnecessarily difficult. She gatekeeps resources that could help students do better in the class, then expects you to be an expert on every topic. She tries to do in class discussions that waste time cause no one cares. Random unannounced assignments have a huge impact on your grade. Any other professor would have given me an A or B.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I give this grade based on two items. Number 1 for the lab assignments it doesnt' matter if you get 90% of the assignment correct. If you miss one part you get a zero. It's all or nothing. And yes that is serious. Number two I feel that he teaches on on a basic level and then tests on an advanced level.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Budiman's class was difficult because AWS is unnecessarily complex. Yes he does read from power points, but he also does everything on screen for you to follow along. After every class people lined up to ask for help (myself included) and he always helped. If you follow along in class & do all of your assignments you'll be OK.
worst professor if you are struggling with grades he wont help you at all and he will just read slides wont be able to clear doubts you have if you want to score good don't take his classes

Pretty useful class. Coursework can be a pain. Labs you'll probably spend 2-3 hours to make it work but gives you some practical work with AWS. He's knowledgeable about the subject. No textbook. Attendance not needed but helpful if you attend his lectures he emphasizes key points that shows up on tests. Recommend if you need a INSY elective.

This is my first review on here. Hardest professor I've ver had, "so to say". Strong accent hard to understand. Every single class is just a lecture over the pp. That's it. Handwriting is the worst I've ever seen so if you don't pay full attention you will be lost. No curves. Exams are very hard. 2 extra credits MAYBE. (bc whole class failing)

This is one of the worst professors I have ever had. He reads of powerpoints then questions us how we did so bad. If I didnt have chegg to walk me through problems, I wouldve had to drop out. Chegg is the only thing that got me a D. Thank god this is not my major, laughes about curving and extra credit.

Worst professor I've ever had, I have all A's in all my other classes except this one. His lectures are pointless, he just read off of the slides. No example questions, be expecting this class to drop your GPA.
Man, DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. I underestimated the comments. The Exam is NOTHING alike from the hw. Please chose somebody else. You can understand the hw 100% and still be lost during the exam.

Beware. Professor isn't student-oriented. Exams are nothing like assignments. You could understand OPMA, but you still won't get an A. Maybe a B? No extra credit or curves. Have a homework question? Don't bother to ask.

You're on your own, so to say. Teach yourself by studying the hw probs and going over his pp for concept q's on exams. Questions take a good amount of time to complete, so be prepared for exam. Exams are done through lockdown browser but you can use your notes.

Does not require you to show up, but definitely helps. Exams are tough and you must know what formulas to use. You can have open calculator and formula sheets he provides on exams but the TA will answer if you need help, not him. Only way to fail is if you miss any exam or refuse to do the homework. He also holds events outside class for jobs/inter
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: While I wouldnt say his class is an easy A, if you do attend every class and pay attention, its not that hard to grasp. It is a hwk heavy class but he does tell what to study for each test. follow his exact review and youll do great. plus the tests are noncumulative.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Care free professor. Show up to class and attend his test review you will be fine. His class was not difficult if you are willing to practice the homework on your own time in preparation for the test. I will agree that his lecture is boring, but he drops hints about the test. I got an A. He doesn't care whats on your cheat sheet, so use it wisely.

He's not a bad prof. Just read off the slides and occasionally write on the board for math problem. HW WAS A PAIN AND TAKE TOO MUCH TIME! Grading was also weird, 3 tests each for 250 points and hw is 250 (1000 pts total). Also 1 cheat sheet so I don't really understand why everyone complain he was hard. Dull. Easy A this whole semester.

Reads off powerpoint. Math heavy tests. 3 tests covers rediculous amount of content. 10 HW. Class average is pretty low. I stopped attending lectures because i coukd just read the powerpoint myself. Only nice thing i can say is he allows 1 cheatsheat for the exam

DO NOT TAKE HIM! Lectures are useless. He just reads out of powerpoint. Homework takes a lot of time. 3 tough tests in total and not a single point curve even if no one in your class made an A. The average score in our 2nd test was D. Just avoid taking him!

Very rude person over all. Cornered me and another student during lab to discuss his conservative views. When asking questions he would want you to find the answer on your own, when in reality he did not even know.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Does not have an understanding of anything he teaches, gives no partial credit, tests look nothing like reviews
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Brian Bui is the worst professor I've ever taken throughout my college exp. He is the most unorganized and rude prof. He is not knowledgeable in the subject and it's ridiculous how students correct him all the time when he has a PHD!! I would definitely not recommend him. You will end up teaching yourself and failing the course. -OLLU STUDENT SP20.

Served as an adjunct at OLLU SP2020. It was the most miserable experience of my life. Most condescending and rude professor I have ever had. If I were taking enough hours not to lose scholarships, I would have dropped this course in January. Begs you to ask for help, and then when you do he is demeaning. Run for the hills before taking his courses!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took him in 2014. I felt like he changed teaching styles 3 different times during the semester. To be fair, he wasn't very experienced, so I'm sure it was hard for him to figure out how to best convey the material. But he was just terrible. I didn't learn anything in that class. He had to curve our grades in the end because we learned nothing.

His tests were answer questions. It was better than the multiple choice. If you wrote equations right, you got credits for them even though you don't know how to solve questions; He also gave credits for the steps even you calculated wrong. Most questions were one or two steps. He gave 210 ? were hard which need thinking. But he gave curve a lot.

Tests are difficult and his grading makes no sense. Randomly switched from online to book homework halfway through the semester. If you emailed him he told you to look at the equations, no matter what your question was. He was confusing and I spent most of my time in the Physics Clinic with Spurlock who was very helpful.

Bui is a graduate student who is inexperienced and lacks social skills. He made fun of students in class and blamed the poor class averages on the stupidity of the students. It got bad enough that several students had to speak to the department head, which caused a temporary improvement. The tests and homework were unreasonably long and difficult.

He is new professor. Noone is perfect, i think u all have to understood. After he changed the way to teach by powerpoint. Everyone really like it. Its save more time for him. He will gain more experience and be a great professor. Take him, do what he told u to do. Good to get A

Do not take him after 2 or so semesters teaching he is still horrible and very unorganized.  Great guy and funny. But if you want a good grade and understanding of Physics do not I REPEAT do NOT take his class. Changes his teaching style way too much and makes things confusing for students.  No real review for test. Homework takes hours to complete

You do not want to take him. He is nice guy, but that is where it ends. He is not organized at all. Homework takes forever, he provides little help. Has no structure, so you never know what to expect on a test. He is a physics don't. It is a self teach class. Be prepared if you take him.

Great Guy. Since it was his 1s sem. teaching, there was an adjustment period for him and students. Tests (other than test1) are fair and he does give curves. Tests are all free answers. Lab/HW/3Tests are all 20% each and he begs you to ask him Ques in his office hours. Hard class but def the best if you want to be forced to learn material.

his first test was super hard, that the class average was 56. He expects you to know things you leaned in math and physics from centuries ago. He is funny, and nice to be fair to the man, and his teaching has gotten better since the start of the semester, but he needs to give examples so one can understand... very negative experience!
He is helpful.

I took Buckman for Bcom 3360 & Bcom 4380. He was by far my favorite professor at UTA. He gave  good advice and is quite inspirational to me. He had clear set expectations and only wanted to see his students improve.

Professor Buckman is a good guy, incredibly funny and educated. He is a tough grader in someways but you'll pass if you put effort. He doesn't like silly questions or useless input. But this is because he wnats to train us to provide value to discussions. Homework sucks, and if you're shy youll grow as a speaker by the end of the class.

Professor Buckman does not have a good track record but he is a great professor. He is hard on his students and holds them to a high standard. He can come off as rude and scary, but the more you talk to him and participate in class, the better your experience will be. He makes you TALK, so beware. Can be intimidating but overall a rewarding class.

The entire grade is attendance based. He's extremely rude to students almost every class ESPECIALLY if the come right when the class starts or even a minute late. He randomly causes issues and is intentionally disrespectful but it's a free grade as long as you show up for 50 minutes. absolutely don't take him for bcom lecture.

Actually L professor, dude just wants to argue and make problems. I don't see how any sane college student can think highly of this guy, he's genuinely a terrible dude. Dropped his class after the first day and got another BCOM professor who I genuinely liked and learned so much from. AVOID AT ALL COSTS
Easy A but he's rude.

One of the best profs I've ever had! He holds his students to higher standards than they hold themselves (which is why his rating isn't higher!). He has very analytical feedback, but it's to improve you for your projects. He is funny, highly intelligent, and has a lot of valuable experience & connections in his network that he can offer you!

Had him for Lab only. No assignments, nothing to turn in, just show up for attendance. He has his own way of doing things in lab such as everyone has to sit as close to the front as possible, late people get to sit in the back (Not sure why). You get 3 absences before it will affect your final BCOM grade.

I don't like Buckman as a person. However, he is an ideal professor that wants you to develop soft skills and do a lot of introspection. He is typically dismissive of students who experience language barriers and nervousness, who are the ones who most need the valuable skills from BCOM. Its demoralizing & gives some students less chances to engage.

I only had Professor Buckman for the lab portion of BCOMM so I can't speak too much on the course layout of his normal classes, but boy is he a character. Expect to be called on at least one per session as he loves the popcorn method of questioning. While he is knowledgeable, he's also very condescending and miserable to be around.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: It was one of my favorite courses at UTA. At first, you might feel uncomfortable sharing your thoughts if you are not ready, and his presentation standard is a little high. However, Professor Buckman helps to prepare us for the workforce. Later, you will realize that his lectures would be very beneficial in the real world. I highly recommend him.

Interesting lectures based on experiences. Attendance is recorded; arrive on time. Graded by chapter quizzes, a career pack, in-class presentations, and 2 page papers. Also, comprehensive SmartBook assignments that are helpful. Ask questions in person rather than email. The lab was P/F with an emphasis on practical skills.

Rate my professor guidelines isn't letting me write down my honest opinion about this professor, but to sum it up by the time I wanted to report this professor it was my last lab so there was really no point. Argues with students for fun. Gets upset when you disagree with his opinion. Please do not take him.

Had him for LAB BCOM 3360 and if you're shy or don't like being the center of attention, he is NOT the professor for you. The Lab is pass or fail, no HW/tests, and only 3 missed days allowed. Lectures consisted of random discussions about business and scenarios that students might experience in their professional careers. Just participate! Easy A!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took professor for lab, doesn't teach anything pertaining to lecture. Comes up with discussions off the top of his head, put my attendance grade in wrong, and would call students out for little things. Would not recommend this professor.

This professor comes off as very strict. The Exams are not lectured based and he will barely go over any exam material. He values participation over coursework and makes it a priority to know your name. He wants you to finish his class with a good understanding of the business world and helps provides the tools to get you started.

Took him for the winter-intercession. He only talks about his stories and doesn't really discuss material on the exam. You have to teach yourself the material. Attendance is taken and he has high expectations.

This was for my BCOM-3360 LAB. It was pass or fail only and based entirely from attendance. You can miss up to 3 classes and still pass. He is an amazing speaker and provides a lot of great insight into the profession world.
Don't take his class. only share his past story and discuss about that. Test from Connect and never talk about it in class. Prepare to read and study by yourself if you take his class.

Look, Participation is not optional. EVERYONE will participate, but believe me its sooo worth it. You get to know more about everyone and it helps you talk and get out of your comfort zone. I say take it and allow yourself to participate and get to know the class. Big presentation at the end, but is not too tough when grading. Mainly eye contact!
I only took him for bcom lab, superrrr easy class, only grade was attendance.

Took the maymester. Lectures are pointless to the material but is counted for a grade and is enjoyable. Attendance mandatory. This class will put you out of your comfort zone but you will gain a lot coming out! Not the easiest A tough grader but it is possible! Would take him again, he is a genuine guy that cares about students growth in the future
Really liked his class. Prepare to participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Buckman put his students on the spot but it helped me get out of my comfort zone more. he seems scary, but he truly is a really nice guy. homework was extremely easy, out of the book and he wasn't a hard essay grader as long as you wrote more than the minimum. Tests are hard to study for but if you do all the homework you will ace tests.

Professor teaches a Communication class but does not know how to clearly communicate assignment instructions to students. The content of the class is easy, but professor just wants to make it difficult for no reason. Be ready to participate in class even if you struggle with anxiety. Try to avoid if you can. Did not learn anything useful.

Took BCOM for wintermester to get it over with, class material was easy overall. Attendance was mandatory. He was rude at times but some of his lectures were useful. He kind of expects you to know the answer to everything and will put you on the spot. Be ready to participate in discussions whether you want to or not.

I had him for 3360 lab. Literally nothing productive was taught except u listening to his past experiences and stories. He picks students randomly to answer his questions but is very rude, cuts you off mid sentence and/or jumps to another student who would give HIM the right answer. DO NOT RECOMMEND

Prof Buckman does not give feedback on work. You have to set up a meeting to discuss the grade received. He just talks about stories that have happened to him and humble brags but no actual application. Presentation is a big chunk of the grade. Try to participate to be on his good side as its mostly interactive. I did not take lab with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Get ready to do work for his class a lot reading and assignments. Most of it are from connect. He'll help you write cover letter, resume, and LinkedIn. I don't like his style of grading. He provides little to none feedback and rubric to follow.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took this class for a 5 week summer course. Due to COVID the class had to be online. Met on Team meetings only a few times with not so clear details on assignments. Only met about presentations, did not do lessons on the book. Had to read book for quizzes & tests. No reviews for tests. Heard good for in person class, do not recommend for online.

Professor Buckman truly cares for his students as he has weekly meetings to discuss your cover letter, resume, interviewing skills, and tips on how to sell yourself. This class is definitely essential if you're going into any business field!!

Professor Buckman was great! Most of the work in this class is on your own, but the discussions led in his class were cool and his stories that he would tell are interesting. The only thing is you have to participate in his class If you do not raise your hand he will call on you. The way his class works is everyone WILL say at least one thing a day

For an online course in the summer, we met up once a week for 15 minutes, and it was my favorite part of the class. He is so helpful and responsive when I have questions. Theres 4 research papers about uta alumnis (2 pages). Everything is brought out on the syllabus. Exams were on connect. Lab with him was also great. Gives a lot of work but good.

Lots of different assignments, including homework & quizzes every week, resume, LinkedIn, cover letter, final presentation, etc. The lectures on resumes and cover letters were helpful. He may not be the most likable professor to some, but you shouldnt struggle to get an A. Participation and speaking in class matters to him, and he will call on you
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Homework and quizzes due before every class. Lectures are just discussions over online assignments due before each class. Long solo presentation at end of semester (was changed to 5 short papers due to covid-19). In class he will call on everyone, so be prepared to speak.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I hated this class. So much homework and some of it was not for a grade but had to be done in order to participate in the lectures. The lectures where based off of videos (homework), he will call on people randomly and single others out. His lectures had nothing to do with the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Good business preparatory class - you make a resume, linkedin, speech in business formal attire. He doesn't let anyone coast. He randomly calls on students and asks for opinions so you have to pay attention. Tests are straight from the textbook/homework. I recommend winter intersession. Brings in guest speakers. Old-school corporate ideology
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Truly one the most inspiring professors I've ever had. I took him for Wintermester, which made the class bearable -- I can't imagine the long semester. Really solid choice. He expects the best and demands a lot, but he truly cares about his students and seems willing to work with those who show effort. Kinda rambly but overall has some good stories

This professor turns a crucial hour of my day in his lab into a storytime about his real world examples, and starts his classes by treating it like 5th grade by making adults change spots in order to fill seats up front and singling them out. Dont bother with this guy, biggest waste of my time and money. very immature might i add

Very critical person almost expects everything to be perfect like a virgo/pisces/aquarius/leo. Do not take him since he doesnt find ways to work things out with you. Hes only concerned about the corporate news and business world. Money talks, but respect doesnt.

Do NOT take this class! Way too much work for a communication class. Lectures have nothing to do with the material and are basically made up of his personal stories. Grading criteria NOT clear, does NOT enter grades until the day they become official with the college, tests are not like homework, doesn't review. Attendance WILL affect your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: His lectures do not reflect the tests. Attendance is mandatory but attending class does not help . He doesnt post any grades throughout the whole semester until after the final exam. Also he says he is going to give extra credit but does not put it in.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: His lectures are interesting, but do not reflect the tests. Attendance is mandatory but attending class does not help to get a better grade. He doesnt post any grades throughout the whole semester.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. You will never know what grade you have on his class because he will never posted them on blackboard, plus he doesn't help the student at all. His lecture are boring as hell, and no reviews for the tests.
Doesnt review for tests. His lectures talk about real life, but to tell anyone thats not what we come here for we want to learn things that are applicable to standards.

Mr. Buckman is a great business man. He teaches his class based on real world examples. His lectures are interesting. You are given online assignments that help your grade but if you miss a few, your grade drops crazy! He is not clear on his assignment instructions and will take off points even if he does not explain the instructions. No curves!
overall easy if you come to class and do your homework, test are online and there easy
Very good professor, 3 exams, 10 HW assignments, create linkedin profile, elevator pitch, and 5 extra credit points.

I got to admit being thankful to him is where i warmed my respect. I dont think any professor with serious health conditions can go through where he is been. Forget the grades everyone he has made it clear from time to time that failure is a stepping stone towards progress, so dont feel bad because life hits hard and that is when you wake up.
His tests are really tough and he never reviews or passes the tests back, boasts a lot of success, helps somewhat understand the business world and little of what reality takes to become successful.
He refuses to grade an assignment online that shows 100. Do not take if you want to save your GPA.
I enjoyed his class and lab I strongly recommend.

Doesnt review for exam. Most people take his class because they are spoon fed to the idea that its an easy class. Exams have 50 questions consisting of 25 multiple choice, 10 short answers, and 10 T/F, and 5 matching responses. I would not recommend him if you want to save your grade from disaster.

I don't normally do reviews, but I really don't understand the bad reviews. (Only one week into intermester) He is a great professor! His topics are pretty much common sense and all the information he gives you is relevant to your future success! He sure keeps me awake at 8am!! Take him!! You won't regret it!!
He should give lots of homework.

Buckman is by far the best professor I have come across. He expects a lot of his students but give you all the tools you need to be sucessful and makes the material relatable with his lectures. This is an interactive class. Speak up, have an opinion and come to class. I wish he taught more courses.

Took him in a winter-semester, so that was why the course load was so heavy. Other than that, I really enjoyed the class and his lectures. He gives great feedback and is willing to help! He does not round grades AT ALL. If you make an 89.75 you will make a B in the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Plan to talk in his class,  you must participate or he will call upon you to talk.    You must attend the lab associated with this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: We are halfway through the wintermester, and so far I really like Buckman! The lectures are so different; I'm actually learning things that apply in real life, instead of memorizing things for exams. The exams are pretty easy, common sense stuff so far. I recommend him.
You will learn a lot from this professor. He makes the lecture interesting and fun.
Exams were tough and he doesn't provide a review. No homework but there are in class exercises that count towards your grade. I would recommend a different professor.

don't take him, you have been warn. Worse professor that I ever have. He does not prepare for his class. Test are tough, nothing were from the lecture neither homeworks or quizzes. HE NEVER EVER REPLY TO ANY EMAIL
Awful, he doesn't even cover the course material. Talks about off topic andom things. He doesn't even know what's in the book!!

His tests are hard and no reviews in class for participation is a part of the learning process. I am curious to know who made those tests. UTA must have strategic test makers because their ratio of questions from easy to hard are undefined to a point. Overall, i enjoy his class, but they need to understand that students need feedback on their test.

Professor Buckman is a cool guy, but I didn't like his exams. I felt like his exams were not from the material he was going through. Bunch of scenarios which made it a little difficult for me. Grades that I earned for exams were around 70s. Wouldn't really take him again. His learnsmarts are long and too many homework and quizzes.

Really cool guy - has great experience/examples. Some chapters timely, have 70+ LearnSmart questions. Quizzes can be a little difficult. Class was a big group discussion mostly. He seemed disengaged and unorganized at times. Assignment due dates were not always clear. Each assignment/quiz/test is 10-15% of grade so you have to do all assignments.

Attendance isn't mandatory but lectures are great. Class is basically one big group discussion & we learned stuff we could actually use in the real world! 2 test & a final which he gives reviews for & an easy speech. Book is online & you need it for weekly HW assignments, but won't make you do all of it if you just talk to him. lots of extra credit
Awesome class. Tests are easy. Coming to class will help you the most.

He gave us way too much homework, and didn't really cover the material in class. The tests were so heavily engrained in the homework, so it was really easy. You can make an A pretty easy if you're willing to deal with him.
Take Gary Lacefield. you will be glad you did.

This class was not an easy A, but it was an easy pass. Mr. Buckman is a good speaker, so lectures are easy to attend. He was nice and extremely clear on what he expects. I enjoyed the class and would definitely take him again.

seriously??, the teaching style is not the normal college style since the lectures are delivered with humor. not very helpful  when it comes to testing as a lot of his test questions seem like they where prepared by a different person.  .  As far as answering student questions a ton of emails sent to him were not responded to. not a good experience
You can use his advice in the REAL WORLD! Great public speaker because his stories are well crafted.

Would definitely avoid this class. My two biggest gripes: His interest levels in teaching are only equal to that of a person in a part-time position, which this is in his case, and he has a tendency to change important details constantly and right up to the last minute. AVOID!

prof name Michael Buckman.  took fall 2013. course focus on the book only.  MUST read the material and/or listen in class; his notes are slides from the material in the book. he gives hints of what to focus for ea test & no compreh final; but there is alot to cover.  homework assignm from sheets inside end book that cover grammar errors.

Do not take his Business Communication class.All of his lectures are just him regurgitating the slides verbatim. His homework is 7th grade level grammar-checking that is unrelated to the material and doesn't prepare you for the exams. His exams, which are 90% of the grade, are difficult pre-made ones not made by him. He is not forgiving in grades.

Took for Ancient Greek philosophy, not great. Lectures were nervous and high-strung, and overall failed to bring clarity to the readings. We were assigned a group project with very little instruction or coordination and most of the class ended up not doing very well. Knowledge of the material seemed to be lacking (esp. Greek language skills)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took her for intro to philosophy and she didn't have too much work. Most of her grades, however, came from discussion posts, two 4-6 page essays (she will provide feedback if submitted before deadline), and about three tests. She provides an outline but sometimes they don't help as she asks questions outside of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took this class online so it was very easy. I gave only 2 hours/week for this class (only on Sunday) and got an easy A. There will be discussion posts (20%), quizzes (10%), one essay (20%), and tests (50%) (everything online). One of the above four will be due every week on Sunday at 11:59 PM. You will be given an entire week to finish it off.

So far she is an okay professor, her quizzes her easy. She expects you to go into detail/deep understanding of her discussion board assignments. Her tests has 50 questions and it is proctored by respondus. So if you take her class, just be prepared to read, read, read.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Weekly discussion boards that she grades heavy on. Essays are difficult only gives one week to complete aside from grading extremely hard. Exams are self written by her and require for lockdown browser and webcam. Not an easy class and you need the textbook in order to complete the essays and the assignments in general.

Took Roman+Medieval phil with Professor Byrd.   
Pros:Super sweet, genuine love for philosophy+students.  She's patient with class-wide misunderstandings and sometimes pushes back assignments.  
Cons:She assumes  people have a lot of background knowledge, and she isn't extremely knowledgeable about medieval philosophy.
As a phil major, I loved her!

Professor Byrd is a very understanding, and fair-grader. I took the online section of this course, so I never actually spoke with her live.

The criteria for the assignments are clear, very easy to achieve full-marks on each assignment so long as you're paying attention to the posted criteria.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Byrd is very sweet and understanding, but can also be a tough grader when it comes to the assignments given (unclear grading criteria). She gives one quiz or a group discussion per week with daily readings to go over in class. Be sure to read the chapters because the exams are written essays, it can be challenging to grasp ancient philosophy.

Professor Byrd was readily accessible via email and helped clarify concepts. Unless you're really into philosophy, don't expect this class to be a walk in the park. Weekly work is required to be successful. The textbook was a godsend at clarifying concepts (Philosophy is quite challenging).

Easiest class I took this semester. It was completely online, so I had to rely on the book to teach me the material, but the discussions we did and the reading quizzes were really helpful for me. Also, instead of exams, she assigned essays, which took a lot of pressure off. As long as you read the textbook and turn things in on time, you'll be fine

Professor Byung was one of the best professors I've ever taken during my career at UTA. Highly recommend taking her.

she is ok

one of the best in COBA

Pros: Exams are just like the review's, no surprises there. Course work is well structured. Material is easy. Cons: He doesn't actually teach, he just goes over the material. This class is very structured, and you know what the professor is expecting from you. Make sure you study a lot and read the material. He goes out of his way to send weekly emails (I was in the online asynchronous course) to update and give materials and resources to help your learning. You will succeed if you put in the work.
Horrible. Avoid like the plague .

I took Prof. Carrasco for both Span 1441 and 42. I would say you definitely can't slack off in this class. It's hard. I took online so I can't speak for the in-person class but I can say a lot of it was on your own. Lots of reading. There wasn't much info in the lectures until the 2nd year. However, he was VERY kind and helpful if you emailed him.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Speeds through lectures , tried to include students to talk , grades very hard he expects you to know Spanish . Those tests were insanely hard. But if he sees you failing hell email you to see what your options are so he cares but overall hard
Horrible

I've taken Prof. Carrasco for both spanish 1 and 2 (online) and he was awesome! I didn't have any previous knowledge in spanish, and I still made the easy A. Make sure you do your homework, read the book, take good notes, and STUDY for the exams. His reviews were exactly like the exams. Notecards helped me a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Absolutely the worst prof Ive ever had. Class was basically self taught. Watched a lot of Spanish movies and videos. If you do not know Spanish well dont take him. He offers no extra credit to help you succeed even if youve passed the homework. His test reviews were not clear and did not match exam content. Horrible
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hes pretty easy if you know Spanish. He doesnt like it if you are struggling so dont take him unless youre pretty good already. He did have favorites and was bias to those who had a Spanish first or last name and had favorites in class who already spoke good Spanish, and that didnt seem fair, made it hard for those without a Spanish surname
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Carrasco was not that easy. I had no prior Spanish at all. He did seem to have his favorites in class. Doesnt seem very understanding
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He does not seem to care about students success. Dont question his grading. Worst Professor Ive ever had

This class was so easy, especially considering it was online. There's pretty much 2/3 things due a week, which only takes about 20 minutes to complete each. The book gives you pretty much everything you need to know so make sure you read! I definitely recommend taking him, you will not regret it!

Carrasco is an AMAZING and caring professor. He really helps you understand what we are learning rather than just teaching and getting it over with. My whole family speaks spanish so i understand quite a bit but i still found it a little difficult at times but as long as you go to him for help he will definitely do as much as he can for you.

Professor Carrasco is honestly one of the nicest professors I have ever met. He gives you good feedback and he is very helpful when you don't understand the material. He gives reviews for every test so you know what to expect on the test. Absolutely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Extremely nice. Classes were fun. Teaches extremely fast and moves on as long as a few people understand. I learned 95% of the material from the online assignments which had unlimited attempts. Try until you get a 100. Tests were fairly easy except the oral questions which you had to answer back in Spanish. Easy A if you keep up w/ assignments.
Wholesome and friendly professor. Proud to take classes with him. Much recommended to take media writing classes with him
Professor is good listener and very friendly, the class itself is a little more difficult but professor makes it much more smooth.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Goat professor at UTA. Such a nice and caring man. Proud to have taken classes from him.

COMM 1300: Responds to emails very quickly. Super caring and understanding, he cares more about our well-being than anything. Attend lectures, read his powerpoints, do the 2 main assignments, try ur best, & you'll pass. I am a Muslim who was observing the month of Ramadan during April & he was very accomodating & respectful about it all!!

Geoff was such a caring and kind professor, and it meant a lot to me that he was so willing to help his students out in any way possible. He made a conscious effort to give us projects that were interesting and fun and was always hoping to engage students. Overall, I loved him, such a great guy.

Hands down, the best professor I have ever had! His assignment do require you to put in work, but theyre fun to do! He is always there to help and check up on you. He is very understanding and cares about his students mental health. I enjoy his lectures because theyre informative and he has a good personality overall. I 100% recommend Geoff!

Professor Geoff's class has been my favorite thus far in my academic career. Although we were in an online class due to the state of our world at the moment. Professor Geoff reminded me of compassion and genuinely cares about his students' well being in his class. His feedback helped me become a better writer am for that I am grateful!!
He truly is one of the best professors I have ever had. His class isn't super easy, but you will definitely come out smarter and thankful you had him as an instructor.

He never puts in grades. You won't actually know what you have until after the final. There are AP style quizzes and current events quizzes every week. He does give feedback on each paper but his handwriting is hard to read but besides that, he is a very caring prof.

Geoff assigned tons of stories but he always gave ample time to complete them. He cares more about receiving it at all than receiving it by a deadline. He grades strictly on adherence to AP style. No tests, but weekly AP style and current events quizzes. He gives lectures some days to help with your writing, but the content is never tested.

Geoff is the kind of positive individual you want to stay connected with after graduating. He really cares for his students, and the students show him a nice level of respect in return. I would highly reccomend taking him if you can.
He's a great professor and I learned a lot. You have AP style and current events quizzes every week but they're easy. Show up to class and do the work and you should get an A!

Never updated Blackboard with grades, so the entire semester, I had no idea what I was making. AP Style quizzes on Tuesday and current events quizzes on Thursdays. Need to read newspapers to pass quiz. Good professor, don't be afraid to ask questions if you are lost or don't understand.

Do not let his 23-page syllabus scare you off! This man sets his expectations at the beginning of the term. Be sure to know AP style. He has a lot of real-world experience. If you are looking for an education, Geoff Campbell delivers. He gives you all the tools to succeed, it's up to you to utilize them. He is very helpful and accessible. THE BEST.

TAKE THIS CLASS. This is one of the few classes I actually enjoyed going to. It's not an easy A, but you definitely learn the material. There are a lot of daily grades. Only a midterm and final as far as tests go.

Hard teacher compared to friends mass media teachers. Attendance is mandatory.  Have a quiz every tuesday, and a different type of quiz every thursday. Almost no homework as it's all in class work.  Only have a midterm and a final as far as tests go. Best teacher I've had as far as actually learning the material!

One of the best teacher at UTA. Will help u out and work on ur problem. Ur skills will be improved. Took his class in summer, got an A. But not an easy A, u must work hard to earn ur grade. But easy B, I guess! Key thing is u must come to class.
Great teacher! He is really passionate about his class and always willing to help or compromise. The workload is heavy and you have to keep up and know your stuff!
Very funny and helpful! Seriously, don't even hesitate to take his class. Wish he taught more classes. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Cool guy. A LOT of in class assignments. You must attend class. His sarcasm can come across as rude sometimes, but I felt he was serious about teaching us. You need an AP Style Book, & "When Words Collide" helped me find the terms that were on the Midterm. Barely used the "Writing for Mass Media" text at all. I got an A & I would recommend him.

Campbell is definitely my favorite prof at UTA! He encourages students to participate (I always hated participating, but he got me to open up). Work is mainly in-class, but it's good practice for deadline pressures! The textbook isn't really necessary. The only complaint I have is that I was only able to have him as a professor once.

Hes probably one of my favorite professors of all time. His sense of humor is quite interesting. Most of the work is inclass, but theres only so much you can do in 50 minutes so youll find yourself rushed quite often. He requires you to read the newspaper A LOT for a current event quiz. You also have AP style quizzes and blog assignments each week.

He is my favorite journalism teacher. He works with you if you have problems and he genuinely cares about his students. I would HIGHLY recommend him for any class. I don't know of anyone that doesn't like him.

Nice, yes.  Professional, questionable.  Likes to use "young" words...from a different generation and intelligence level of the collegiate student.  Demeaning?  No, just taking the side of public education churning out more stupid people.
Geoff is amazing! He is the nicest teacher, ever. He truly cares about his students and is a fun teacher.
Geoff is Awesome! He really cares about the students and making sure that we learn all that we can, but he's totally down to earth, understanding and funny! Wish I could have him again!!! =)
The nicest/funniest person ever.

Geoff is a great teacher! He is fair and has a fun enviorment in the class. Just make sure to go to class because there are alot of in class assignments. Also his mid-term and final are a little hard becasue they are so broad. Also be ready to do ALOT of copy editing. Overall come to class and you'll pass!!!

Great teacher! Genuinely cares about each student. As far as grading, a little too lax in my opinion, but I am not complaining. Geoff and his class will teach you a lot due to his experience in the field and his funny/energetic classroom.

It's not possible to quantify how good a teacher Geoff is here. I have nothing but respect and admiration for him. Bottom line, take this class. You'll learn a lot and have fun doing so. Can't praise Geoff enough.

I took him for Reporting. Very good teacher and genuinely cares for his students. He wants you to do well, which is refreshing from the other professors. I was worried about my grade since I got plenty of C's and D's on my early assignments, but he definitely gives good criticism and I became a way better writer in the end with a good grade too.

By far, the most creative professor I've had so far, you do write something, or edit something every day, but it's not dry or boring, it's always something you'll snicker at because it's realistic and extremely silly all at once. Awesome teacher, cool guy and very helpfull. There are man opportunities to improove you grade if tests are an issue.

one of the best teachers i have had in years.He knows his materials and is willing to help you.Missing class is okay with him if you have a good excuse,but for your own good,please avoid it.He prepares you to be a good writer and uses fun materials to teach(watch out for Joe Momma..lol)You will definitely walk out of this class,a better writer.
Awesome Teacher!  Goes out of his way to help you.  Not too hard to make an 'A'

Best professor ever! If you get the chance to take him do not pass it up!! Geoff is such a great guy who really wants his students to learn. He grades very fairly and makes assignments fun! One day we wrote a lead over the song Pour Some Sugar on Me! Loved it!! Ask him for help and he will go out of his way to give it to you.

I should have dropped the class when I got the chance. Doesn't help with grades, won't help boost your final grade, and doesn't seem to care to help in that sense. Wouldn't give me the opportunity to boost my grade by a few points to get an A. Takes forever to grade things too. 

Different class code but it wasnt available.

Really enjoyed con law with Dr. Canelo!
Covered scotus cases each class. Don't buy the textbook btw, use Oyez. Slides are not uploaded to canvas, so show up. Gave exam reviews for one midterm and one final; both open note and timed. Major project was the opinion assignment; expectations clear. Grateful for the semester.
She wants you to succeed!

Attendance isn't mandatory for her sake, but more for yours since she doesn't post her slides. Her exams are very much based on the slides and are straightforward. The exam bumps really help, but I wish there were some HW's for her to grade because assignments could've pulled our grades up. Overall, nice person and decent professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wonderful personality and the class is very easy to pass. She doesn't assign homework, gives a curve on all 3 exams, gave us an extra credit assignment that can boost your entire grade by 4 points. She doesn't make study guides for the exams but as long as you attend lectures you really don't need them at all.

Be aware she is a great person, but maybe not the best professor. She only gives you 5 grades, her attendance is not mandatory but she will not post her presentations or any additional quizzes to practice so if you miss her class yo will have no knowledge. Her book is boring and too long. Her exams are not that hard, but require attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Professor Canelo this semester and her class is very easy if you pay attention and attend lectures. She will not post the lectures online or PowerPoints, so ill recommend going to class so you won't miss anything! Her exams are easy! There is no hw but there is a research paper which is not hard! Definitely recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She talks t herself while teaching and does not care about making sure students understand her lectures or not. You have zero for a late sub, a mission of homework with no possible make-up test. Talks down to students for giving wrong answers to her questions.

Professor Canelo is very understanding towards students and definitley cares about her classes. If you show up to lectures and take good notes from them, you'll definitley pass the exams, and therefore the class. Light homework, and very clear about what each exam is going to be over. 10/10 would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Just show up at the lectures and take notes. The tests are truly easy and she gives extra credit. She does class discussions as well and is only fun if people join in.

The content of the course was extremely simple and easy to understand however lecture was considerably dense and more difficult than necessary. It might have been the strain of having both in-class and online classes to manage but the lecture felt unnecessarily difficult and confusing. Homework is incredibly simple and exams felt fair.

One of the best professors! She is caring and sweet, very knowledgeable about what she is teaching. She knows her stuff. She doesn't require attendance, super understanding about it being a pandemic. Just watch the lecture. The tests are difficult, read the textbook but her slideshows help a lot. Doesn't post them to canvas though. Very minimal hw

worst professor i had she started off great but is terrible at her job she doesn't know how to grade before i went on christmas break i was passing her class with a B i just check and she removed my grades now i have a F and she stinks dont take her class take anyone but her

She's not a tech-savvy teacher, and takes off points cause of her technological errors. The critiques she gives are incredibly insufficient as well. When attempting to teach she only talks at you, and gets mad when you as for clarification and help. Doesn't allow you to work ahead, and even gives you extra work if you do, no extra credit.

Professor Vila was so disorganized; she was never satisfied with any work. She makes it so hard to get an A because she grades terribly. She will always find something wrong with your work. She makes classes feel like you're still in high school, makes assignments to do in class, and does not actually teach. Always makes 5+ assignments a week.

Inconsistent grader, you will ALWAYS have something wrong with whatever you submit. Even if you correct your mistakes she will find more pedantic nonsense to "correct" you on. Gave me extra work and punished me for turning in my assignment early, when it said nowhere in the syllabus or in person of such repercussions. two faced.

She was SO disorganized, she assigned us several assignments the day before it was due, and when we turned them all in she would push back the due date or make them an in class assignment. She did not leave helpful comment for essays and let certain students turn in their work weeks late. She also would cancel class 1-2 hours before it started.
oh brother this guy stinks

May is a great professor and the class is pretty easy. You'll need a lot of materials outside of class, but the projects are really creative and he gives you room to be unique. It starts pretty slow but the audio projects aren't too difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Dr. May's class. He's a great teacher. The class was led with loose guidelines which allowed for more creativity but caused some trouble for understanding expectations.

Doesn't use blackboard, you get to see your grades once before spring break and that's it. Assigns a lot of homework, and an extensive amount of out of classroom field trips (mandatory research done at archives, etc). Assigned mandatory daily journal - had to write every day, 7 days a week, (even on spring break) from January til May.

Dr. May is very well versed on his coursework.  He doesn't test you on anything he has not discussed in depth.  He gives you books to read that may be classics but then he gives you insights that make you look at them in a whole new way.  I would take multiple classes from him.  He has an honest love for literature and is an excellent teacher!

Dr. May is an excellent teacher that really makes you understand the material. This section is not really an English class, more like making a website class. He teaches how to make a website so if you want to know how to do this take him! The class is fun, but it takes a lot code to memorize. Other than that it is a really fun class.

syllabus has all reading assignments for the semester.  reading assignment almost every night [class day], a short quiz is given, questions cover the reading assignment. tests are based on what you have read in the weeks prior [not comprehensive], so if you read you should do well, he doesnt ask you to read anything that you cant handle. one paper!

Great teacher, really cares for his students and has a passion for literature. Do what he asks you to do and you will get an A. He hands you everything you need to succeed. Tests and Quiz's are guaranteed 100 if you just read.
Dr. May is a wonderful professor.  He is enthusiastic about what he teaches, and he cares about the success of his students.  I am sad that I could only take one class with him.

HE HAS TO BE ONE OF THE WORST TEACHERS EVER! HE TAKES HIS JOB TOOOOOOO SERIOUS, GIVES THE HARDEST WORK,  HIS EXAMS WILL MAKE YOUR BRAIN BLEED!   MOSTLY ESSAY QUESTIONS AND SHORT ANSWERS. NOTHING IS MULTIPLE CHOICE, YOU HAVE A QUIZ ALMOST EVERYDAY, TOO MANY BOOKS REQUIRED THAT YOU HAVE TO READ OUTSIDE OF CLASS.I HIGHLY SUGGEST YOU DO NOT TAKE HIM!
No Comments

Dr. May's class was interesting but he is very inflexible and a harsh (and slow) grader. We had a major assignment that he didn't even explain until after it was due... He also expected everyone to buy $300 worth of recording equipment. The class was worth it to me because it was interesting but is definitely not for everyone.

The class was basically broken up between pop quizzes, final, mid term and a journal over the reading. Attendance is not required but there are pop quizzes so be aware. The quizzes are easy if you read ahead, but there are unannounced. I took him for African American Literature, the readings were good but YOU NEED all the books to pass the class!
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I've taken Dr. May for two classes. He is a wonderful professor - smart and passionate without coming off as a snob. His lectures are engaging and he takes your participation seriously. He tends to cancel class at least a few times during the semester, plus you get two freebie days. No excuse to not get your participation credits in. Great classes.

Literally my favorite professor of the semester. She gives extra credit like she's Oprah as long as you participate in class. She really strives to make sure that we understood the concepts and made sure we knew the information on the tests, even making reviews for us. She's funny too and gave us stickers.

Celina is an awesome professor. She is really caring and wants all of her students to succeed. The fastest she's emailed me back was within 15 minutes!!! She gives extra credit too! If you have any questions, always ask her. She likes it when people respond in class and attend office hours! If you're looking for a caring professor, TAKE CELINA!!!!
LOVE
Her lectures are awesome and she's really easy to talk to. she offers extra credit and cares about grades

Seriously an awesome professor! lectures are great and interactive. She does an amazing job at explaining things and giving examples. She really cares about the students. Very nice, relatable and easy to talk to. I highly recommend attendance. READ THE BOOK STUDY FOR TESTS Seriously just listen to Celina, she literally tells you how to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took Brain and Behavior during the Summer and was immediately intimidated that we had a test every week and several chapters of homework. It wasn't bad at all! Cover a chapter a day, do the homework that night, and several days to study for the test. Lectures were ALWAYS engaging, enthusiastic and just straight up enjoyable. Genuinely cared.

Easy class if you pay attention. Really nice, funny teacher. Expect to spend around 100$ on the online textbook though- it's mandatory for all intro to psych classes anyway. Four tests, homework for all chapters- all online. She encourages you guys to go to her office hours. Little bit of extra credit here and there. Make sure to go to class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Though the class is a bit tough, Celina is great and she makes the topic easy to understand. There's online homework for all the chapters we go over. No quizzes/essays of any kind. Four exams online, timed for an hour each. Offers limited extra credit. Attendance is taken randomly, so it's better to just be in class as it's 10% of overall grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Not worthy of even being a professor, too caught up in his research to care about his classes. You're paying for him to do a mediocre job of narrating the book to you, he is literally the laziest professor I have ever had. Absolute trash.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! He cannot teach physics. I've never felt so lost in a class before. You never know when exams are, homework is tough, and he is an audiobook. Exam reviews aren't close to the material on exams. All of his exams were different formats and the curves are ridiculous. He didn't even show up to class the week before finals.

Very poor teacher. He claimed he failed the same class he was teaching about three times. And also, beware the sweat towel,tis gross! I also believe that he is conducting a physics experiment with his body. He is trying to create a large enough mass to start having things orbit around him. Basically taught myself physics.
Cedric Mayfield is a physics teacher. Ummmmm.... That's the only physics related thing I have learned all semester and it's the end of the semester.
couldn't see how he worked the problem cant hear him always late to the lectures  works the examples out of the book in the lectures
If you already understand physics, you'll get an A. If you want to learn physics, don't take this class with him.
Terrible teacher. Reads from the book during the lecture and has tough tests. I would give a 0 if I could.

One of the worst physics professor I've ever had. Study guides were misguided and practically useless when it came to his tests. You basically pay $1k to have someone read the textbook to you. Also gives 15-20 pt curves since everyone is failing so badly. If you're not a physics ace, AVOID THIS PROFESSOR.

he reads straight form the book so there really isn't any point in going to class. he goes through t problems in the book but he literally writes what is written in the book already worked out and he sometimes doesn't know how the book got those numbers.

Dr. Mayfield is a new teacher so he wasn't very prepared. He teaches straight from the textbook, so the lectures are not very helpful, unless you don't want to read the book, then you can get information from him. If you put in the work, then you will get the grade you want. You need to understand the concepts well.

His class is not hard, so long as you are prepared to read, watch YouTube, and teach yourself a good bit of the material. Take your book to class, It helps reading along with him because his slides are from the book but leave off details and can be confusing. If you put in the work, you can make an A. No surprises on exams.

Possibly the worst physics teacher at this university. I honestly believe that my high school teacher taught better than he did. His lectures are pointless because he reads directly from the book. His study reviews are pointless as well because he doesn't provide good examples as to what may be on the test. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS. AVOID AT ALL COSTS

Possibly the worst teacher ever. He doesn't explain the tests, his study guides don't help you study for the test, and his "lectures" are powerpoints that the book provides without much detail, as they don't explain equations or variables. He thinks he's the savior of physics, but when 80% of the class is failing every test, he's far from i

Horrible teaching. He reads parts from the textbook and uses some of the exercises from the book, which isn't helpful. Students can do that on their own. The only reason to show up to lecture is to know when the next exam is because he doesn't give the dates in the syllabus. Study the book and learning the material without his lectures is best.

DO NOT TAKE. Dr. Mayfield is a boring, unenthused word for word narrator for the book. He reads the book word for word in lecture, doesn't say when the tests are, is extremely disorganized, & blames his class when his study guides are over the wrong material. Also, he has 5 random tests and covers 7 more chapters than the rest of the department

NEVER TAKE THIS TEACHER. His way of teaching is reading and giving examples STRAIGHT FROM THE BOOK. I'm a 4.0 student but this class is going to ruin it. Gives "study guides" which are still stuff from the book but the test is different from it. The only way to do pass this class is to study everything on your own.
While attendance was not mandatory, if you skipped class you missed access to activities you only get access to in class that is used to calculate your class grade. So show up!!

This course was taken in partnership with the English department. It had two professors, Dr. T and Prof. Bethany Shaffer. They would divide up lectures and assign "Python days" and "English days," which were planned ahead of time in the syllabus. One of the best courses I have taken at UTA. Exam: 2 - 1 py, 1 engl. Sign. Asses.: 1+1, 1 engl + 1 py
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
She is the best professor I have ever taken in the summer. Even though her lecture was pretty fast. 
I didn't need a textbook for this class because the slides she lectured us were based 100% on the textbook, don't procrastinate, attend her class, actively use the advantage of the office hours, and do homework, YOU MUST BE FINE WITH AN A.

Just introduction to school resources. Final project; you're given prompts and a random group. The project itself is easy as long as you have a good team. Had a team that did nothing, informed Dr.T basically said that I would just have to do it on my own, that's how the real world works. The grade also based on group reviews. (not necessarily fair)

Easy A as long as you do the simple homework and attend her lectures. Offers tons of extra credit if you do miss an assignment. There are group projects involved. Great speaker and shares informative content.

Dr Tiernan's the best! She gives tons of extra credit and her reviews are very identical to the tests, which are open note. She is somewhat strict with due dates, but she gives you plenty of time, so make sure you don't procrastinate and start on your assignments early, especially coding labs.

Dr. T is the best professor I've had so far. Her exams are really easy since they're all open notes. Also, she gives 10 points of extra credit on each of her exams. Her labs are really lengthy but she gives plenty of time to complete them so they aren't that bad. If you pay attention in class, the labs are a piece of cake.
Dr. T has high expectations for her students, so labs can take 20 hours to do, but she is very lenient and gives a lot of extra credit. If you actually wanna learn to code take her.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Doesn't respond at times when issues arise and is difficult when theres issues

Pay attention to everything. Insanely long labs, open book/note exams, grading is super outlined. If you don't have prior knowledge youtube is your best friend, make friends, gives extra credit. Responds to emails, always has office hours- go to them. Available after class for questions, ask them.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: For those deciding to take Dr. Tiernan's class. DO NOT take her. Her labs are insanely long and you will spend a good amount of hours even days to doing it. Also her teaching methods are not great either she just posts code on the projector and goes too fast when giving lectures over it. Avoid her if you can.

She does a great job going through the beginnings of C coding, the only downside is the 4 labs you do. I believe we need more labs/homework/practice coding to actually understand what we're trying to type, and those are the only things aside from the tests she grades. Allows notes on tests, practice code daily at codewars(.com) to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. T is a great professor however her class can be difficult, her tests are can be difficult to prepare, her labs are by far the hardest part of her class, I would recommend going to her office hours for any questions and help! She also gives lots of extra credit opportunities!!!

Professor Tiernan is a great speaker, and ENGR1101 is an easy A if you just show up and participate. I felt like some of the activities we did were unnecessary though, and had little to do with what we were learning. And you're just kinda on your own for the final group project. It is hardly ever talked about in class.

Do you REALLY want to learn programming? Choose Dr. Tiernan. I had 0 previous knowledge, Dr. T. made it so easy to understand all the important concepts from scratch. Exams are open note(electronics too), which makes it easy to do well. Labs are long but very educational. Her e-mail game is amazing. Ask a lot of questions and you'll do just fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Insanely Hard labs. Attend every class and make friends from who you can take advice. Exams are just from practice questions. Cons: Very little practice done throughout the class, you will have a hard time on the labs. Pros: Very understanding.

For an intro to programming class, she does not make it seem like so. Even with no prior experience, you will still pass but will have a hard time. Professor grades harder than other professors(said so herself) and it is hard to understand the material if you don't stay ahead. Pick a different professor since this was my only choice left.
