Extra credit for showing up to class! Don't sign-in and leave it really upsets him! TA is helpful just email her and she responds in a timely manner.

I'm a psychology major and Dr. Coleman was not a great first impression to the study of psychology. While I did find the class to be an easy A, I would often catch myself drifting asleep at lectures as he often gets off track. If you don't like animal behavioral psychology BEWARE- he got his Ph.D. in it and often ties the subject into his lectures!
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This is not a very good professor. My entire class did rather poorly and he will NOT curve. He expects you to practically memorize everything. He grades on extremely specific details and the assignments take hours and hours. I got D's and C's on all my tests even after hours of study. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR.

Amazing professor and expects a lot from you which is understandable. People complaining its hard want the exam handed to them in a review. It's a growing culture to go through the semester and be proud they got an A without buying the book.
He was okay. Lectures got boring. And the learnsmart assignments took forever

Stay away.... Lectures are random and very boring! Get ready to learn all this stuff on your own. Test seem to be based on slides only. He said the study guides are his slides. No curves on exams whatsoever! Very few extra credit opportunities. Just stay away...
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This professor was kinda awkward. He is pretty boring but gives extra credit for attendance. Course grade is strictly exams.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: You don't have to attend class, but he gave extra credit for being there on random days that he decided to take attendance. He had a tendency to go off on tangents during lecture so we didn't get through the powerpoints for the chapters on a couple of tests. So you really had to read the book thoroughly to ace without extra credit.

Three exams with a final, not comprehensive. The tests consists really of the book so thats what I did to get a good grades on exams and i would look at his powerpoints bc he said whatever overlapped would be on test. Has about 20 multiple choice, 15 matching, and 15 true or false questions. No homework no quizzes. He's nice and funny.

To be honest, he's a terrible lecturer. He's hilarious and his the material he teaches is interesting, but it feels like what you learned in class is not even RELATED to tested material. I tried studying slides, taking good notes, and even studying the online book material and still did poorly on all of the test. He gives a lot of extra credit tho.

This was NOT an easy class. I got an A barely, but put in more hours studying for his tests then all of my other classes combined. The only grades are 5 tests, and 2 extra credit opportunities. Study all his PowerPoints, notes and book. He tests on random little details. Know animal, researcher, and field. He wants you to take his class seriously.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This dude is awful. His test are so hard, you have to pay attention to the most pointless information. He only talks about his stupid falcon club. His tangents confuse me (and I normally like tangents). Avoid

This class was one of the easiest classes ever. I did not get A's on most of my exams, but I ended up with an A+ in the class. Workload is very light and attendance counts as extra credit, 5% towards your final.

Really liked this teacher. His class was interesting and the tests were not hard. I put in the bare minimum required and got a B. Definitely helps to read the textbook when studying for the exams. He offers two extra credit assignments over the semester. I would take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: All you have to do to make an A is read the book and take good notes. He is really nice and I've taken him for several psychs. If you miss one exam for any reason you can retake it. 5 points on final grade if you go to class, but going is not mandatory for an A as long as you study. Textbook is easy to read imo, only 3 chapters per test and final
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The review before me is very accurate. Took this class expecting and easy A. Tests are no longer online. Definitely have to work for an A on a test. I put in minimal effort and pulled off a B. Just be prepared to study for tests because they are lecture heavy and cover a lot of material. Basically nothing on tests come for LearnSmart.

Great guy, but if you do not have a photographic memory, you probably wont make an A in the class. Tests are pretty hard. I went to every class and wrote notes along with making note cards for the test and I made C's and B's on the tests. Four online chapter homework's due before each test and each homework has between 50-150 questions on them.

Dr. Coleman is super cool, this class was fun and very informative. Make flashcards from the ppts to study for exams and read the end of chapter interviews, he likes to test on those. There are also a couple of extra credit opportunities too. Know scientists/researchers and their experiments for the exams too!

Dr. Coleman changed his entire syllabus this semester! No i-clicker anymore! No more online tests! Mostly the reason why I signed with this professor in the first place. However, he tells you EXACTLY what's on the test, give 20 bonus points for attendance! Learn smart is crucial cause he takes questions from that VERBATIM! Not a good lecturer.....
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He's a nice and funny professor. Does iclicker for extra pts. He didn't review for his 3 online exams which sucked. Print the notes out so you can have them during his locked tests. 50% of final is review he gives. I didn't make A's on all exams and  still got an A for the course. Do the online hw as well and do the 6hr credit thing quickly.

I loved Dr. Coleman's class! His lectures are enjoyable and one class between each exam will be a video day and you must be there to watch it because it will be on the exam. Exams aren't too hard if you read the book & chapters (know the researchers in the book & lectures)! Attendance is extra credit! An easy & fun class!

I loved this professor. I took him for a super easy class where all tests and hw are online and attendance is only extra credit. I went to his lectures anyways just because I enjoyed it. I found them interesting most of the time and he was really goofy and sweet. He's a great lecturer. Take him for a easy class!

4 Online tests including final. Gives extra credit from I-clicker. There are hw given but u can actually do all of them in a day. I making a clear point here. If you don't get A in his class, plz re-consider if you are truly suitable to college. Take him

this class was an easy A, as long as you show up he does random clicker questions for extra credit. He also let you take a 10 question quiz for extra credit and you got 2 tries. All test online although very hard to look up answers bc short time limit.  Theres homework but i would just do them in class while he lectures, no need to pay attention

Coleman is a great guy & you can tell he is really passionate about teaching. He goes over the powerpoint in class and attendance is not mandatory so I barely went. Although he does have some extra credit opportunities that you can only get in class hours. All homework is online and it was a very easy class as long as you do your work you will pass

This is a great class but don't expect it to be a blowoff class. Dr. Coleman is very passionate about his work so don't disrespect him by not showing up to class or asking him a question that is clearly answered in the syllabus. If you're interested in animal behavior take him, you won't be disappointed.

Dr. Coleman is one of my favorite professors I've ever taken! 3 tests and a final (which is just the last chapters, so not really a final). I never read the book. No homework/quizzes. Takes attendance randomly and if you are there for 9 attendance days you get an extra 5% to your grade. Cares about the students, there to help, very approachable

There are 4 exams (all equally weighted) each over 3 chapters. They consist of 25 multiple choice, 10 T/F, & 15 matching (split up in groups of 5). He gives 20 extra credit points if you go to class (he takes attendance 12 times throughout the semester). Most of the exam comes from his PP's, but reading & attending lecture is helpful. Great prof!

He's a funny guy, makes the class somewhat entertaining. He posts powerpoints online, but they can be unorganized. His tests have multiple choice, true/false, and matching. There's no study guides so you have to read & refer to the powerpoints to study. He does give extra credit by taking attendance randomly 12 times (3 times for each exam)

Scott posts the notes and powerpoints online, so there is no need to buy the textbook. And since the notes are online, showing up to class is not needed some of the time either. He is monotone, so lectures might become boring 10 mins in. Does offer extra credit during class. Homework and tests (including the final) is online.
All 3 tests are online even final exam. He gives almost 50 extra points on those 4 exams.  It was so easy A class to me though.

Dr. Coleman is goofy and will say just about anything during lecture, including the regular spill about his personal life.  His lectures were interesting but confusing at times. He will clear things up if you ask him. Smart guy, knows his stuff. But VERY disorganized and slides are a mess.  READ THE BOOK! Attendance is extra credit.

Apparently this is his first year teaching this course so he does not have online tests like his other psychology classes. His test for this class consists of multiple choice, true/false and matching. I do not like the way he teaches and there is no study guide for his tests which I strongly do not like in professors.
Great professor, very funny and interesting. Exams are easy and power point are useful.
His lectures are boring and the class is disorganized. He takes too long for grading. The test is average. Overall ok but it's better if you got another professor...

Everything is done online. Lectures aren't exactly helpful but are interesting sometimes. Gives out lots of extra credit points during lectures through an i clicker. The online tests are actually somewhat difficult, you're only allowed to work one once question at a time and after you submit an answer you won't be able to go back to it or change it

Nice guy, and clear about what he expects. Lectures can be a bit dull at times, but also interesting. He has a quirky sense of humor, and I find him cute in his own goofy way. Tests aren't too tough, just read the book, take notes, and know how to apply the details to the big picture.

This course was overall easy and straightforward. His lectures were very enjoyable, he really knows the material and there is a lot to learn from this man about life in general. Learned something about falcons too.

Showing up to class and simply participating in surveyclicker questions is counted as extra credit. He is a great lecturer and provides you with nearly everything you need to know for the ONLINE exams. Easy class! The book is helpful and provides real  examples, but is not necessary to do well in the class

He was pretty boring. I started to skip class, but still go occasionally because he took attendance about 13 of the time. I went to maybe 50% of the lectures, and still had a 100 for participation (10% of grade). He said he was planning on changing that to be extra credit instead though. You can easily Google the answers for tests, they're online.

Pretty cool guy, took him for animal behavior. Definitely knows the material. Cons- 5 tests, needlessly 50 questions long. No curves. Doesn't drop a test. Has his own little 'attitude' about they way all of that should work, which jut makes it harder on the students. Yet he gives you extra credit, a general university no no.

All the tests are on-line including the Final. Random "iClicker" days for his attendance (usually on the day you start a chapter) Posts his powerpoints and literally reads word for word.. Google is you and your tests best friends!!(:
It's a very easy class as long as you go over the PowerPoints and read the chapters. Easy A!

easy class, not an easy A. book isn't necessary, the powerpoints cover most material in the exams. tests are online so open book test if you have it. I'm managing a B and not trying to hard. he's funny and boring [like someone else said]

Look, the class is easy. The test is on blackboard, you can use your notes and textbook. The problem is this guy is the most boring, inarticulate man I've crossed in a while. Maybe it has something to do with it being an 8 AM class, but he loses his train of thought, mumbles, then sort of shouts what he remembers he was going to say.
I was expecting Research Design and Statistics to be a very hard class and between Mr.Coleman and the lab TA it was a great class! I would recommend this prof to everyone!

Coleman, Research & Stats. Easy A. Lecture is from his notes/book, very easy. Lec tests are multiple choice. Lab is busy work, not as easy. Lab tests are short & simple. Keep up w/ readings and weekly stuff & homework and get your A.

Attendance is not mandatory.  I attended class once a week and still managed a "C". This professor was funny n boring at the same time.  There is three test total including final.  All you need for the class is the required book and a clicker.  He gaves attendance points at end to try to boost grades.

This class is easy if you read the book a little. Make sure you go to the test review; what he goes over is exactly what is on the test! He lets you drop the final too, if you do well enough on the other tests.
He was horrid, did not know how to teach, major disorganization, and I do not thing this class prepared me for the real world which sucks cuz its a valuble information

well this class isn't easy to pass if you just read off the slides.  i had to read every chapters and connected them with the slides in order to do ok on the test.  however it's worth it at the ends. tests questions come from ppt slides and book.. got an A in the class.  another thing is that i rarely attend class and still manage an A, so can you.
Must study the book to pass the test...there not easy...
You must study the book to pass his class...The test are NOT easy...

good enough professor. I probably wouldn't take him again, just because pretty much all he did was read off of the ppts. I could've stayed home and taught myself. he puts things from the txtbk in the tests that we never went over in class, so you MUST read the book. tests are about 65 q's each, and pretty straight forward

He's one of the worst professors I've ever had.  Don't get me wrong... he tries, and he took over for an amazing professor who passed away during the semester, but he was terrible. The TA would even shake her head at him when he tried to explain concepts in class. He talked in circles and if you asked a question, you'd leave even more confused.

I enjoyed his class and he is funny and makes the subject comfortable to talk about. You do need to read the book, study his powerpoints and taking the online book quizzes help alot. The class is not difficult, just read the chapters and attending the class can be helpful. I will leave the class with an A. I highly reccomend

Okay, nice man but his lectures are boring! I hardly attended class and made an A on both tests. I just studied his notes mostly and read the book a little to help elaborate some main points. Just took final which was easy as well. So, take him if you can teach yourself because then its an easy A. He is very nice and responds to emails.

This Professor could possibly be very interesting with his Falcons and such if it weren't for the fact that he speaks in near perfect monotone. The tests are ridiculous, coming from someone who's taken multiple psychology classes with a strong interest in the field, they're near impossible to make high grades on even with intensive studying.

I actually think the HUman Sexuality class is pretty interesting.. of course it's awkward to talk about these things in a class of people but he makes it funny and comfortable to ask questions. Attendance isn't mandatory but in order to do good you should show up most of the time!

Prior to taking this class, Human Sexuality was a very interesting topic for me.  However, this teacher ABSOLUTELY ruined that for me!  He is VERY boring and creeped me out a little when he talked about certain sexual issues... He would laugh at something as if he were a little boy!  NOT A GOOD TEACHER!!!
horrible teacher. he just reads directly off his power point. as a teacher he's not help at all! you need to read the book to pass the class

Dr. Coleman is superrr boring! His class is such a drag.i ended up skipping class and sleeping on many occasions and missed nothing. Easy if you read and use the accompanied website that goes w/ the textbook.

I took Human Sexuality with Dr. Coleman and the only complaint that I have is the length of time he takes to post grades on webct. He usually takes about 5 days to post test grades.  This class is pretty easy, though.  Just memorize the notes and review for a B.  Also read the book and attend lectures for an A.

He is very EASY!!! A little slow and boring but otherwise an easy way to get an A!....This semester he usually made the tests from the slides but idk if he is going to continue tht...He also does a 'reality check' at the end of each chapter from which he included some questions on the test..the final is optional...So take him to get an A!!! :)
The class itself was fairly interesting, but Dr. Coleman is a bore.  Study the slides and read over the chapters and you're fine.  Attendance is not needed

One of the worst professors I've had at UTA. He lectured straight out of the book and bored everyone on a subject that should be interesting (Human Sexuality)! I was definately looking forward to this class, but was extremely disappointed by his style. I emailed him several times, but never got a response. Never in his office during office hours.
he's great!
No Comments

I took this professor in Fall 2018 during his first time teaching this class while he was in his PhD program. He had so much patience, never tired of questions, and linked us to campus resources. We had a farewell surprise party of sorts for him on the last day, if that tells you anything about how great he was. You'll be lucky to have him!

Show up to class, ask questions, participate. Do that and you will leave this class learning more than you ever expected. Excellent professor who cares about the well-being and future of his students. Could rave about this class and professor for weeks honestly. 

He makes research much less scary. Take this in-person, NOT online.
TAKE THIS CLASS! Professor Keaton is so kind and understanding. The class is not difficult, but you have to speak up and engage in class.

Literally the best professor at UTA hands down!!! He is very caring and always gives you life lessons that you can carry with you in your social work career. He treats you like a human being and not just another student in the class.. I woould take his class over and over again!! Thank you Craig for eveything!!

Craig Keaton is possibly one of the greatest teachers I have ever had. Literally so kind and adapting to students' needs. Honestly cares about what his students are saying and what they want to pursue. His class taught me so much about social work and ways to improve my college life.
He is amazing if I could take his class again I would I learned so much !!!!!

Oof where do I start with Professor Keaton!!!!!! HE WAS AND STILL IS MY FAVORITE PROFESSOR!!! He is such a caring, optimistic, and empathic person and teacher. He cares way more about what we obtain in his lessons rather than grading us. If I could take him again, I most certainly would. Shout out to Professor Keaton youre the best!
I have taken this professor for two different classes, and each time he is the best. If there is another class he is teaching; I will be signing up for that class to A++++

Best professor I've had at UTA. Super flexible with deadlines and understanding of life circumstances. Makes the class interesting! He is very receptive to feedback from students and always makes sure everything is super clear for assignments. Will explain a million times and never make you feel dumb for asking! Very encouraging!

Uses Rogers style notes during lectures. The information is not as difficult compared to organic chem. Homework is a completion grade and is usually harder than actual exams. Attendance isn't mandatory, but he gives extra credit if you attend. Can be hard to predict what will be on the exam since there aren't reviews, but they are reasonable.

If I had the chance, I'd take every chemistry class with him. He really shows a solid understanding of chemistry. His lectures are brief and to the point. He's funny and super nice. Just follow his instructions, and you'll find it's a pretty easy class overall.

Dr.Crowell is an amazing chemistry professor where its obvious he knows what his talking about. Lectures are short and sweet and get to the point. Answers all questions and clearly states what he expects on his exams and classwork. With him I have a clear understanding of the basis of Chemistry where it will build your foundations!

Definitely one of my favorite professors, that wants nothing but to see his student succeed, he helped me understand the basics of chemistry after having trouble in my previous years. Assignments are given and due by the end of lab but him and the TA's will help so much if you're having trouble, don't be scared to ask questions, he's happy to help!

The best professor I've ever had,hands down. Its rare to find a professor who loves teaching, and even rarer to find a professors whose passion is teaching. I took him in a 5 week course which was really challenging, but I couldn't have done it without him. Enroll in his courses!You will not regret it. He rounded my 88.0 to an A- also :) I miss him
Amazing at teaching an intro to chem course for those who need refreshers or barely know about chemistry.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is passionate about teaching Chemistry and excels at breaking down complex concepts, making learning more accessible and engaging. His approachable and student-friendly attitude creates a supportive environment. He also offered four extra bonus points for completing the course evaluation, showing his commitment to student success.

Honestly, Crowell is one of the sweetest professors out there. He is very understanding with his students and he really takes the time to explain the work problems. Every day it is a lecture then for the rest of class you work on problems on your own or with a group. Really take advantage of the time to ask questions and study on your own too.

his lectures are the textbook. his notes are based off the textbook. went to class to confirm what i already read in the textbook 99% of the time.
Attend lecture for the small instance he gives you a trick to solve a problem, other than that, just read the book in class and do hw problems/txtbook problems.
in summary, do all the textbook problems.

Very enthusiastic about his field, but not a great professor. Goes on long tangents, delaying the course. Study guides for the exams mislead you on what you need to study. Homeworks often cover material not taught in the class. Exams cover small details mentioned in class rather than big concepts. Only saving grace is his availability.

If you take 1400, he does a great job building foundational chem ideas for people who have never taken it. If he taught 1465 I would 100% take him again. He is a jokester and has pretty fun stories to tell, I don't think they take away from lecture. But he also stands on business when needed. He also has a southern twang that made lectures better.
He goes so fast during class, I watched his recored classes, because going to in person class was a waste of time.

Crowell is very clear from the beginning on what it will take to pass the class. Overall, I liked his teaching style and would take him again. You will have to read the textbook and do all the practice exams to do well in the class.

This professor is very good at what he does but he has the tendency to go off on tangents during lectures. In my opinion, he is not very good at explaining the material to people who have never taken chemistry or people who have little to no knowledge of chemistry. For me, it was too hard to follow his teaching style.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Crowell knows the material by heart, but he is not good at dumbing it down for students who don't really understand the content. He loves theoretical questions and there is barely any math on the exams. He will tell you repeatedly to look back at your CHEM I notes. I ended up dropping the class because he is not a great professor imo.

Professors Crowell knows the lecture material by hearts.But he expects you to knows the materials. His test is nothing like what his lectures cover. You need to study a lot to pass his class. The good side is that free answer he will give you partial credits has long you write the right stuff down or show you knows the material.

The best part of this class is that he replaces your lowest midterm grade with the final. What really helped me with studying is to do the practice problems in the back of the lecture notes and read the textbook since it had problem-solvers. I would use the final exam review from the lecture notes along with reviewing past exams for the final.

I would not recommend him for CHEM1442 unless you really like chemistry or you're determined to study for hours nonstop. Did the book problems, old tests, note practice problems, reviewed the HWs, etc. However, he puts in random numbers and variables that throw you off during exams. If possible, take Rogers for any chem class really.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Crowell taught at a very fast pace which at times was difficult to comprehend the info. Exams were back to back, 2-3 weeks between each. Be prepared to study a ton. He does provide great practice exams and questions that cover most of what will be on the actual midterms/final. I'm not sure how he is one on one but he seemed cool during lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took him this fall and his lectures are easy to follow up until we get closer to the tests is where he speeds up and confuses everyone. He is not nice outside of class and talk so much during class which makes us miss half the information. He said he got better about that but I don't believe it. If you get the chance, take Rodgers. CLEAVER IS BAD
His lectures are easy to follow. His exams closely follow the exam reviews he has posted. Overall I recommend him as a professor; however, he is not very nice when you talk to him one-on-one.

Joshua Crowell is the professor to chose if structure is important to you. He gives practice tests that if you complete twice you will definitely pass the exam. He teaches as if you were reading the textbook but slightly more interesting. He isn't that personable so just research the problems you have because he will make you feel  dumb.

He explains the concept very well, but Exams will be spontaneous, last writing questions are worth 50% of the Exam. 
No matter what you write, if he doesn't like how its worded he will give you a zero. Overall, he's nice as a person and respectful, but his Exam style is bad. 

4 EXAMS, that's it. 
no assignments, no curve, no extra credit.

If you don't work and only go to school, you can pass. If you work and have other responsibilities, don't take him. It's only 4 exams and each have about 20 questions. There will be about 3 questions on the exams he doesn't cover. Some he will briefly touch and the rest he will hint it out during lectures.

I didn't like him as a teacher. His method of teaching was so fast paced and he never went into depth. I went to his office hours and came out more confused than I went. A trick I wish i knew sooner was to practice with his old exams cus he tends to repeat questions. No curve, no extra credit and no assignment. 3 exams and a Final.

I enjoyed this class! The course grades entirely on exams. He tests pretty much entirely on in-class notes, and lectures. This is so helpful because the book is too in-depth, and his notes makes it clear. I highly recommend going to lectures, because of this! Also, watch AKlectures! Overall, he is a nice guy, and this was a great class.

The professor is not very kind during office hours, and tends to miss class and rely on videos he made in 2020. This course is taught on the fact of if you can solve questions not so much of if you truly understand. Its like the SAT for chemistry; save your time and choose Rogers Crowell does not seem to like his job.

The tests were straight from the notes and lecture. During lectures he would give us hints about what would show up on the test (histidine). The book sucked so dont open that. Echo360 quality was terrible from either the microphone not working or the recording just flat out not recording.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The prof is extremely interesting to listen to, explains each topic clearly, and is extremely understanding and fair. Every other week or so there is a homework assignment. Other than that, there are basically just exams. A lot of content is covered, some math based, some memorization, so make sure you review decently often.

One of the better gen chem professors. He uses Roger's notes and textbook. Exams are doable since they're similar to problems from the back of lec notes and reviews. Crowell provides a lot of resources for his exams, so DO them. Pay attention to lectures then hw is easy. You got to work for an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Out of 125 students, about half of them failed with an F and the remaining were D's. These were extremely talented students as well; sadly, this professor was ill-prepared, made many mistakes, and very bias in his grading. I would AVOID at all cost!!! Take Biochem with anyone else BUT HIM. Very rude, apathetic, and does not care for the students.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Crowel is a pretty good prof. in my opinion. I usually don't show up to his classes because he teaches extremely slow & gets off topic a lot but his prerecorded lecture are straight to point and have everything you need for the exams. The textbook was online & required bc the hw is on there. If you watch the lectures & understand then you will pass
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The kind of professor that just wakes up in the morning for his paycheck. He doesnt care about you at all- not that a teacher should, but he is very rude about it. Just an unhappy person overall. Unorganized and scattered, he knows the material he just doesnt care for his students success. Hes fine for gen chem but dont take for biochem.

Exams are a big part of your grade. When you ask him for help it feels like you're a burden, and he can be a little rude. He seems like he doesn't care about his students whatsoever. The only positive thing I could say is that he did mention what will be on the exams if you really pay attention in lecture. Other than that, he does the bare minimum.

Unfortunately, this class was way more difficult than it had to be. This was due to constant mistakes, back and forth from online lectures to in person lectures and more. Do not recommend him for this course, a large percentage of the class FAILED and this was not entirely due to lack of preparation on students ends. He isn't understanding either.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The lectures are so so important, so skipping them will probably hurt you in the long run, however if you show up you will be fine. He explains things at a good pace, and will explain them differently if you did not understand his first one. I would most definitely take him again for 1442.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took Crowell online for Summer 2021. There's no homework for the 5 week program, so you're only graded by the lockdown browser exams and the labs, the latter of which can be grueling at times. Crowell offers fill-in-the-blank lecture notes, which can be purchased in the bookstore. Lectures were recorded, but the notes cover the exams well.

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I would take him for General Chemistry but never for Biochem. It isn't his subject so his lectures are full of mistakes, his exams are never clear, and he can be a bit rude. He's okay, but this professor will make you doubt your science foundation with all the mistakes. I'd recommend taking somebody else. You've been warned!

Definitely one of the hardest courses I have ever taken. With that being said, I still made an A. Didnt have much of a life outside of Chem, but with enough work you can do it. Josh cracks me up. I would definitely take him again. He does drop lowest midterm grade which definitely saved me. Exam 3 is super tough.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Crowell is actually a really good CHEM professor. This course is hard, so average test grades usually in the 60s range. He is clear in what you need to know and how to study. Do ALL the old test problems he posts because those help a lot with exams. Exams are about 50% conceptual and 50% math. Do well in lab to keep your grade up!

made a very difficult course easy to understand. lecture alone will not help you, you NEED to do practice from the textbook! lectures are entertaining and engaging. tests are just like practice qs. final exam was significantly harder than previous tests, so he gave everyone ten extra points for free. overall, you have to work for an A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Apathetic! When electricity wasn't available for many of his students during the snowstorm, we emailed him that we couldn't take the exam. Told us that didn't sway him even though campus resources were shut down too. He does work out examples in lectures but he doesn't explain a lot of the processes well. He & his vacuum make good background ASMR.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I passed after failing with Rodgers. Basically, Crowell had tests worth less and lab/hw worth more. The tests are impossible and don't expect to pass half the time. Insane memorization required to get any good test grades. Getting a 100 in hw and lab is required to pass the class.

He is a pretty good professor, but does not give much help. It may help if the course was not online. Chemistry is hard in general.. you need to study. He was nice, but did not care if students were going through something. He did not care about power outages during the snowstorm.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you need to take CHEM 1441 I would much rather recommend Professor Rodgers than Crowell any day of the week. If you do not want to mentally exhaust yourself by teaching yourself the entire course material then do not even consider Crowell.

hes an incredible lecturer, but he was snarky when it came to students having issues with internet, especially with the snow storm that hit texas in february. i wish he was nicer, but he is good at what he does.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There is no way that this guy became a professor to actually teach anyone. His lectures are intensely long, overpacked, and at least 1/4 about his personal life (?) At the end of the lectures, he never says goodbye or shows any concern for his students' well-being or education. If he's so great at chemistry, he should really use it somewhere else.

Take Dr. Rodgers. Crowell doesnt care about whats going on in your life unless its chemistry related. Lacks so much empathy for his students its painful. Sometimes I wish some people wouldnt teach because of the effect it has on so many students. Its costing them time, money, and effort and he couldnt care less. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He teaches alright but he lacks empathy; didn't feel bad or make any accommodations for students who were going through the snow storm that caused electricity blackouts. Very tough grader; try to read & do LOTS of practice problems to fully understand whats going on. Wish I could've taken this class in person, but lab was easy so it bumped my grade

Dr. Crowell has shown no empathy to his students. I have emailed him many times and have only gotten ignored. His lectures aren't that informational and I have had to use supplemental material to get by with 50s. Compared to Dr. Rogers this dude has crap exam grades and won't even try to curve or help his students at all. Don't take his class.

Class isnt bad just watch lectures and regularly do practice problems. Prof isn't understanding. Got mad at students for not being able to take an exam during the huge snowstorm that caused statewide blackouts. He also got mad again at students when he forgot to provide a periodic table for an exam. His teaching skills are alright tho.

Dr. Crowell is THE BESTTTT!!! I have had rodgers (who is such a gem and an amazing professor), however, Dr. Corwell goes a little bit at a slower pace and makes SURE you understand the material. So kind, chose him again after taking his 1400 class!!!

As of 2020, he was the only professor who taught Chem 1442, so it's not like I had a choice to choose lol. He talks a lot about his life, which is interesting, but as a student who is struggling and suffering in chem, the stories should be saved for later... also thought our class was cheating because we did so bad... maybe because chem is hard??
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He spends 85% of lecture going over theories which only makes up less than 20% of his tests. He glazed over the math portion which is the bulk of his tests. Be prepared to teach yourself. He wasnt lenient during corona/online times. Failed by 2 points and he wouldnt round my grade to pass. Take the other chem professor.

One of the best professors for chemistry. His lectures are amazing and he uses Rogers' fill in the blank notes. Do the practice quizzes and attend live online lectures and you will do good. Highly recommended!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took 5 week Summer Class. Lectures were old and inconsistent in ECHO360. 2 weekly 10 question quizzes make up 75 of your grade so study like hell for them. Lab was in LabFlow due to COVID but was easy. Do your practice problems and extra ones and you should be ok. Does not respond very often to email, is only available once a week via Teams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Crowell. Others might not because he teaches slow, but I appreciated the extra time given on each topic. Make sure to read!! I really liked his lectures, because he incorporates his experiences and stories into them. He's also so funny. When we switched to online because of the pandemic, he was really understanding! Take him!!!

Corwell's notes are fill in the blank, which is what a majority of the chem department does as well. I didn't really like this style because I feel like I don't learn anything. Normally lectured up until the day before the test, which was frustrating because then you're studying last minute as well and feel rushed. Tests are okay.

do yourself a favor and take the class with rogers, this guy sucks. he's mean, makes you feel dumb, and doesn't respond to emails. lectures don't explain the content well and will always rush in the last 5 minutes to cram all the material
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was a 5 week course that was almost impossible. He uploaded his old lectures & expected us to watch an ENTIRE semester worth of Echo videos in a VERY short amount of time. 2 tests per week with only 10 questions & we only had 1 day to learn the material. He was hardly available for help & difficult to get ahold of. Do NOT recommend

This is fast on a higher level. He expects you to learn an entire chapter in as little as a day before you will be quizzed on it. The quizzes are just 10 questions, a day apart from each other, and worth 75% of your grade. He posted lecture videos on Echo360 from WINTER and just expects you to do everything on your own. Lazy and unfair professor.
I wish he would answer his emails/messages...

This professor is so funny! Sometimes he will get side tracked to tell a story from his life, listen. His notes are fill in the blank style which really helps with paying attention in class. His exams are weighted heavily so pray that you do good but he also gives extra study material. He is a really good teacher and cares for his students.

Crowell is passionate about chemistry and very personable. His lectures are very by the book, and make sure to read and do the practice problems. Easy A if you delegate proper time. Chem 2 is a chore, but it builds the foundation for Ochem and Biochem so pay attention. He's good regarding homework and cares about his students. Great in office hours
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: First of all its chem guys cmon theres no easy way to get an A. You have to work using the textbook and there are so many resources available (except the chem clinic really didnt help it seemed like they didnt care to be there). But Crowell is a nice dude and will try to help you as much possible. But in the end its up to you for your grade.
He makes u feel dumb when you ask questions. Also, tends to go off topic a lot and rush at the end of class to finish the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Biochem is hard and is a class you will HAVE to put in continuous work in, not just a week before an exam. Great lecturer, well prepared, passionate, and very knowledgeable about material. However, professor lacks capacity to understand and feel for students that experience hardships and will fail them instead of seeing them succeed/help at the end

Dr. Crowell is amazing. Although this course was tough, he makes it so enjoyable. He is a very relatable man and has a lot of funny stories. As long as you attend class, study your notes, do the homework and read the textbook, you will do just fine! He tests very fairly (although the final exam was tough) and he does not set out to trick you.

Prof. Crowell was amazing! Not only was he funny, but he also taught all the material really well! There were times where he would ramble BUT anything he didn't get to, he wouldn't put on the test! Also, since the tests are based on lectures there is no real reason to read the book. BTW the school no longer uses ALEKS! Will definitely take again!

Biochemistry is a difficult course. With Dr. Crowell, prepare to read the textbook and do practice problems from the book (assigned, but not for a grade). He gives fill in the blank style notes and records lectures, which is helpful in guiding studies. However, the course is based off 3 unit exams and a final so you have to work hard for an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Read the book in advance and do ALL practice problems. That alone will ensure you get an A in this class. Test averages are generally about a 60 because most people do not do this. Crowell as a professor is excellent. This class requires a lot of time and effort so be ready to commit if you want the A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His lectures enjoyable and not boring with hilarious stories to connect to the concept. The fill-in lecture notes are helpful, and textbook is great for extra help. Chemistry is not easy, but you will pass if you study! I got two 100s on the midterms! I studied by doing textbook practice problems, practice problems on back of notes, and old exams.

Crowell is one of the best professors I've taken this semester, I have him for 1441 and his lectures are well structured, with fill in the blanks notes which are very helpful and make the textbook unnecessary. However, the class is hard, you have to study if you want to pass and I would suggest going to the SI sessions, I went from a D to an A.

Do the practice problems and practice tests. Read your notes after lecture, and you should be good for the tests. Tests aren't necessarily hard, but if you do not practice your concepts, you will not do good.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The dude is funny! He makes me want to change my major. He uses his own lecture notes, so the book is not mandatory. I only utilized it for more practice problems. Just show up to class, pay attention, work out the problems with him, and understand "why" you are doing what you are doing and it should be an A. Overall one of my favorite professors.

His lecture was taught from fill in lecture notes which I liked. Some of the material was really difficult, there was a lot to learn. His tests were only 20 questions long so it wasn't easy to make high test grades. The homework was online (ALEKS) & we had chapters due almost every week. No extra credit was given & this class took a lot of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Crowell is a good lecturer and covers what he needs to, but doesnt do many practice problems in class. There are echo360 recordings which help A LOT. He randomly does clicker questions so dont skip class! I found his exams challenging, but plenty of people did well. The chem department does not curve or give EC so do well on the midterms.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: In class, he does fill-in-the-blank style notes. He explains the material relatively well and he goes at a good pace and allows time for questions. There are also Clicker questions as a participation grade. Then there's the horrible ALEKS that doesn't help whatsoever. Lots of practice questions available for studying. Easy class if you work.

He is a decent teacher, if you can take his class with a longer time then 50 min DO IT!! all the professors at UTA give the same amount of problems for each test. EX: 50 min lecture  50 min to take a 20 ? test. 1hr 20 min lecture 1hr20min test time for 20 ? . you will need extra time! It's not fair that other classes get more time for the test.

Dr. Crowell is a good person, decent teacher but the chemistry department at UTA is very unorganized. 4 tests each 10% of your grade. final is 25% & can replace your lowest test. NO EXTRA CREDIT! He gives 5 extra points on 1 test ALEKS homework doesn' help at all, just busy work. It's used 4 all chem classes. Go google ALEKS reviews you will see.

Professor Crowell is a really nice person, and he does fill-in-the-blank note style. All of his lectures were available on Echo360 outside of class. The notes were pretty straight forward. The grade for the class depended on 2 midterm exams and the final exam, so if you do poorly on one, you don't really have a chance to recover.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: the best biochem professor! Very helpful fill in the blank notes.

Awesome Professor for MCAT Prep. All information is presented in a precise, efficient and effective manner. Very approachable. Test are not tricky and are similar to past exams. Emphasizes important material in class. There are In class quizzes that are bonus toward your final grade and are similar to exam questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Took him for intro to chemistry. You fill in printed notes and do examples during lecture. He tells you what you need to know for the test, and teaches you exactly how to do it. Attendance is mandatory, but not a second of your time is wasted. We had no homework, and instead we did it during lab time. Effective teaching methods and engages you.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Rogers 2.0.. Great professor, printed notes, enthusiastic in class. Attendance is extra credit, he usually won't deviate tests from the material on his notes unless he specifically tells you. His FRQs are more intuition-based. Read the book, it helps a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Crowell seems nice but he isnt a good teacher. He has fill in the blank notes but leaves some sections blank expecting you to know how to do it. He uses iclicker for attendance and ALEKs for homework. First test went bad like half the class failed. Going to take the class next semester with a different teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Textbook isn't necessary. His lectures are interesting and he's funny. The online homework is a lot, I'm a procrastinator all the way but it's hard to get all of it done by midnight if you wait till the last day. Practice the questions from old tests and from his practice problems because those are exactly what's on the test.

I was a final year student before taken chem, needed it to graduate. You got to study for lab quizzes, you go to do lab reports, pre labs and oh yeah Aleks. If youve ever taken Aleks you know what Im talking about. The prof was ok, always gets easily distracted however. If you have the option of taken it somewhere else, take my advice and do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Crowell was awesome! He uses fill-in-the-blank notes which are super helpful. The online homework is somewhat time-consuming. However, his lectures were informative and funny, and he has great examples to work through. He is very honest about what to expect in other Chemistry classes and medical school. He does use the iClicker, though.

honestly, this class isn't so bad, it just SO MUCH WORK. The HW system sucks. If you have ever used ALEKS, you know why. Tests are 20 questions, all multiple choice. Study the practice problems from class AND the ones from the textbook. Also, take LAB seriously, it can either really hurt or help you.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Usually, I review my test answers. Here I bubble in 5+ answers per test. He reminds us often, the mult. ch. test answers  your most likely mistakes. Aleks (online HW) is so, so much Love chem? have O-chem next? take him! Good guy, knows his stuff, answers questions and teaches well. I believe his testing/HW standards are too zealous for Gen Chem

Attendance is 5% of grade and notes are fill-in-the-blank. Most people take Crowell because he's attractive but the class is difficult. Extremely homework heavy and exams are hard. He gets distracted really easily so while the class is fun, time is wasted and homework assignments and labs are due before you even learn the material in lecture

Dr. Crowell was amazing. Very clear in what he expects you to know for the tests. He's fair in what he asks on the tests, he will not try to trick you, just think. Going to class benefits greatly. Read the book, study his notes, and do the practice problems he assigns.

Entertaining professor who knows what he is talking about. Strongly recommend to buy the notes from UTA bookstore. Attend class and do as much practice as you can for an A. Replaces Final with lowest mid term.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Makes chem interesting with his jokes! Chem is difficult but easier with his lectures using Dr. Rogers' set of notes to fill in blanks (purchased at the bookstore for like $14). The textbook is online and found through ALEKS, where you do your homework. There are iclicker questions each class, 4 exams with 20 questions, and a departmental final.

Easy on the eyes and a great lecturer. Never thought I would enjoy chemistry but he definitely helped make class something I looked forward to. He has chemistry puns and uses Dr. Rogers' notes so it was a win win. I'm actually looking forward to taking biochemistry now that he is teaching it.

He is an excellent professor. He helped me learn and really enjoy chemistry concepts that I thought I'd never understand. He wants to help you learn, not just get an A. He's pretty funny too, and you can never ask a stupid question in his class. He's one of those professors that will make you consider switching your major to take more classes.

He is an amazing  professor. He really tries his best to keep class attentive. He is hilarious and has a joke for every class. He is around for students and gives out easy bonus as much as 20 points in tests. It is difficult, but he manages to make it seem easy. Be prepared to do a lot of ALEKS. It is very annoying, but he is fair in duedates.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Crowell is very helpful, always accessible in his office and has former experience teaching in high school so he knows how to keep everyone entertained. CHEM1441 is a hard course but Dr. Crowell tries his best on helping out (even giving out extra points at tests sometimes).
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She always sent out reminders so we wouldn't forget to do the assignments. There are a lot of McGraw-Hill hwrk plus disc board, hwrk quiz, practice review, and unit review—all due in a day, so don't procrastinate. Try to do at least one McGraw-Hill every day to keep up. You can only retake the practice review, but they are all open notes.
She is very professional. She is Excellent and goes the extra mile to assist her students gives great feedback.
She is amazing intelligent easy to work with she goes out of her way for students to succeed
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took the online NURS 3333 8 week. The pace and workload was perfect. Quizzes are open book and she drops your lowest quiz grade. No exams but you do have a group project which is great if all group members do their part and don't procrastinate.
Professor Rahman is the most caring professor I've ever had, and I don't say that lightly. She's truly an amazing educator, and I can only imagine what kind of nurse she is. AMAZING!

Professor Rahman was an amazing instructor who created a productive and welcoming learning environment for all of her students. I felt extremely supported and she was always providing us with stories from her own nursing experience to help us grow, quizzing us on important material, and pushing us to do more and blossom in the clinical setting.

There were a lot of ups & downs during my experience in this class, but in the end I really did learn a lot about what makes a compassionate, understanding, and caring nurse. Her lectures could be more lively but it was 8am, I'm sure her afternoon lectures were better and more interactive. Overall, I liked her but you'd have to decide for yourself

Having an instructor who is intimidating and rude is not helpful. She can get very angry if she misjudges a situation and does not hear you out. A lot of people loved their clinical experience, but unfortunately I cannot say the same. I had so much anxiety before going to clinical. If you have her, good luck & push through
She was alright, there are better teachers so you would prob get more bang for your buck NOT taking her
One of the best and most organized class I have ever taken.

She is very rude! She create a toxic learning environment by belittling students and failing to provide adequate support. Save yourself the trouble and stay far away from this instructor (if you can lol)
.
Will develop your critical thinking and make you a better nurse. Has high expectations and focuses heavily on patient safety and communication.
Learn alot

Rahman is a great med surg instructor! She is passionate about nursing, is available to talk about struggles you may face, and is a great resource for achieving any clinical goals you have. She provides opportunities to redo clinical assignments for full credit but her grading can be inconsistent which is frustrating. Also, she's big on med safety!

This class was so difficult,i'm glad its over.Exams are the main thing,you read the material and modules but exam Qs are just so hard.4 assignments which are not too hard, you can get help online or tutoring at UTA.Gave extra credit thank god.I would take this class as my last resort ONLY,every test I held my breath scared because i didn't want aC.

reviews.comment: Lots of reading and basically a self taught course. Graded some assignments using ChatGPT (not making this up, he admitted it), and refused to give helpful feedback.

The professor is lecture heavy and missing a class can leave you confused if you didn't work on your foundations well enough. Very large and in-depth time series section. The professor really does care about students and makes a lot of allowances to help students develop. Well done, professor!

Professor Crowder is a monotone and by the books professor. If you ask him questions about current economics he will get more exited about what he is talking about but outside of that be prepared for 

lecture -> test -> rinse and repeat

do all the extra credit, doesn't seem like much but you can save a really bad grade

reviews.comment: Be prepared to teach yourself with the modules. Textbooks are a must have .

reviews.comment: Don't take him. I took asynchronous but his lectures or modules have nothing to do with the exams and the exams are worded weirdly so there's no way for you to study for the exam unless you love econ and know everything about it. He won't respond to emails or be in his office. Final is 100 question cumulative exam with lockdown and webcam.

Online course. Very knowledgeable and the recorded lectures were interesting. Tough to recover from bad exam grades. 4 exams and a final, 4 writing assignments to accompany the exams, graded discussion component. Not bad, not great but so goes economics.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Crowder is an amazing economist, but that does not make him an amazing professor. The exams are just difficult. The key to pass, is by making sure to use BOTH attempts for the practice quizzes, use those quizzes as your main study aid. Another great tip, make sure you know how each model moves with each other depending on what situation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He isn't a bad professor. The class is just boring, I would go with someone more enthusiastic.

Specifically this course is by far the hardest economy course ever. It is not even my major just for a core economics but it is even harder than my major. Professor does not offer any reviews for exam nor any meetings for questions but the exams are in extreme difficulty in both complexity and lingual perspective. Don't take this class.

By far the worst class I have ever taken. He has both lectures and textbook assignments, yet exams often have nothing to do with either. How can you study for an exam that has nothing to do with what you study? The mean scores for his exams range from low 70s to high 60s. Either the entire class is stupid, or he is a poor professor.

He has a nice set up in canvas very clear to understand and know when everything is due. Of 4 exams he takes the 3 highest exam scores 4 Writing Assignments Discussion Board and Final. Teach your self no lectures but he has each week planned out in modules along with his old lectures. So if you are use to purely online he is great.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He says the textbook is optional, but I highly recommend getting it and reading it before the lectures. I found that a lot of the material covered on the exams was not covered in the lectures and reading the chapters saved me. Also, do the practice tests! Review any material you didn't get right on them and you should be OK.

I don't think Prof Crowder is a bad professor, this is just a hard class in general. You will have to read this book & listen to the lectures if you want even a chance at passing this class. Your only grades are tests, written assignments (w/ the tests), and discussion board posts. At the end the only thing that saved me was the discussion boards.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: His class was by far the hardest thing to take for an elective. I agree with most of these people and that this class should be for Econ majors. I was 10 points shy of a C, no extra. The Exams stray to far from what you learn in class, Lectures, videos, and book. None of it aligns to test with exception of definitions, which are very few on test.

I would not take this course if you can avoid it, especially with this professor. His lectures, notes don't match anything related to his quizzes or test. You have to read a ton, watch is long lectures and then piece meal what you think will be on the exams. Not worth it.

reviews.comment: 4 tests, 4 Hw, drops lowest test grade, comprehensive final with 100 questions. I hated this class, so much to read and test did not match the book material. Tests were very hard. One sheet of notes allowed for test. My first C in 4 years of school. I did not find teacher unresponsive to emails or super rude, everything was on syllabus.

Not a bad teacher , just doesn't know how to reply to emails and sometimes feels as if he ignores me. The semester just ended and his syllabus said clearly we would receive points for discussion boards still have not received that and also said he would drop lowest test grade never did it ive . This professor acts condescending towards those who take his online class for some reason and responds rudely to emails and provides little to no feedback. A lot of material to study and makes exam questions much harder than review quizzes.

reviews.comment: Crowder is the worst professor I have ever seen in my life. He doesn't teach the class, you have to figure everything out on your own, and when you ask for feedback he replies with one or two words. He is also very rude, tort, and it is very evident that he doesn't care about his students whatsoever. Professors like him should be outlawed.

reviews.comment: Took his online class and it was a mistake. He makes you do a discussion every week and test.3-4 weeks. No review but you do get a cheat sheet. The Test were really difficult even if you read the chapter participate in the discussion and prepare with a cheat sheet you will still have trouble. I wish I would have took this class in person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I took him for an online class; it was a mistake. He doesn't care that people take online courses because they have busy schedules. There's a lot of material, he doesn't give study aids for his exams so you can't save time for studying. I missed one exam because the internet crashed, and the other because of military obligations, and he didn't care

Taking as an elective? DON'T. An OBSCENE amount of studying is required and it is a seriously steep learning curve. Video lectures, extra videos, everything covered in the book, Power-Points, extra articles, discussion postings. The material is DENSE and he lectures very fast. Should be for Econ majors only. Stay away unless you like pain.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I get Lockdown Browser for online classes, but he takes to another level. You cannot go back if you accidentally clicked the wrong answer. You have to be recorded via webcam and if you don't have one he told them to buy one. 360 views of your area is required. Basically you had to be completely alone with NOTHING around. TOO Much for Online Class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Lectures are boring  and you won't learn much from them alone. Read the book and make sure you completely understand every concept. There are 4 exams and a cumulative final. Grade based on 4 highest scores. Each exam covers 3 chapters . The best strategy is to read before and after lecture, then make a study guide, and do the practice quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Took him for Money & Banking, has great lectures and lets you bring a cheat sheet. Almost got an A but he doesn't curve (albeit he does drop lowest test grade). Definitely worth taking, just study and go to class for that A
Great guy. He's the guy who saves the UTA economics department in my opinion. I wish the guy taught all the classes.

Dr Crowder is an awesome professor . He uses real world examples to explain tough economic concepts and is more than willing to help students outside of classroom. He also gives you access to practice tests on blackboard and most of the test questions are quite similar to the practice tests. A truly great professor would highly recommend

Hard! Very hard! If you are not good at econ and such, please don't take as an elective like I did. He's a very good teacher, really knows his stuff, he's nice and will explain, but the material is A LOT and it's TOUGH to master the concepts if your brain doesn't work that way. I did NOT do well, even though I studied hard. It's just a tough class.

He lectures very fast and I took him for summer so it felt even more fast. We didn't have many people in the summer class and we had pretty low scores on the test.  I would not recommend taking him in the summer, take him for a full semester. I got a B but he let us have cheat sheets.  He claimed he was going to curve but my grade said otherwise.
WOW! Wish every professor was more like him. Not an easy A, but you will actually learn the material. Highly recommend.

If taking Econ 3303 for an elective, do not recommend.  It taking for a semi-effort gpa booster class, do not recommend. If take, be sure you allow time to read the book and know the material. He teaches in class but in order to get A need to study powerpoints online, book, and most likely have study groups. Not easy A
Fast paced covers a lot of material. Knows his stuff, likes his stuff. Good class if your an econ major you'll learn a lot.
Great professor. Wish he taught more classes. I learned a great deal. He is very laid back and knows what he is talking about. No need for a book if you Attend class and actually pay attention.

Keep up with Crowder and the material in order to survive. Crowder lectures topics just as they are structured in the book so read and go to class. Crowder uploads reviews that are 80% exactly like exams. Plus he gives a review sheet of topics. What more do you need? 1 Midterm + 1 Final. All short answer and a few MC. He allows a cheat sheet. STUDY

Took him for sports Econ with mainly non-econ majors. Class was geared for econ majors so test scores were low. Since its only midterm/final I dropped. I wouldn't recommend taking his class unless you are an econ major because the material went straight over my head.
This professor is hard and is an unfair grader. He takes off points for neatness and the book is not used. I would drop this class if I could

One of the best professors I have experienced at UTA.  I wish he taught many more undergrad courses, but he's make me think about grad school.  He makes advanced Econ interesting and enjoyable.  He is incredibly knowledgeable and enthusiastic.  The exams are essay, don't require the book, take good notes, make a cheat sheet and NEVER miss review!

Tests and quizzes are much more difficult than the powerpoint slides and much more difficult than they actually need to be.  Has to go quickly through the presentation because each PowerPoint averages 75 slides.  Would not recommend, there are much better ECON professors.

This class is hard first thing.do not take class unless required to do so due to subject material.  The prof does his best to make sure its understood though. offers quizzes as extra credit. if you dont go to class you'll fail. Can buy any edition of the text. offers only 2 grades, mid-term and final. however reviews the problems before the test

Lectures were very interesting & organized.  He is always willing to stop a lecuture to answer questions or clarify a point.  Tests and quizzes were difficult due to complex wording/phrasing. Don't miss class or you'll fall behind & miss a quiz. Buy the texts if they are on the syllabus!  Crowder is a good prof -- it's just a very difficult course.

Attendance is mandatory since the exams are based off lecture notes. Exams are centered around graphs he draws, so pay attention to all of them. Pop quizzes are extra credit. Only 2 exams. The exams can be hard because you only get three questions...missing one can drop you to a C.

Intermediate Macro was a very interesting class, and he made the topics very clear. That being said, learning intermediate macro is like smashing a hammer thru your face. however, his 2 tests are SOO easy, and he allows a cheat sheet. It is very easy for a class that very interesting with material, at least for me,that was difficult.
Intermediate Macro- fast-paced but if you attend class and take good notes, you'll be fine.

Tough class. Don't use textbook, if you try to use text it will just confuse you. Go to every class, write down everything he puts on board or says, and study, study, study. It helps to listen to recordings of lectures. Ask good questions at test reviews.

Took this class over the summer, which was incredibly fast paced. When i mean you must take notes to even think of getting a reasonable grade, I mean it. However he is a great speaker and knows what hes talking about. Take this class seriously, Got a B without the book but i wouldn't recommend it because I had no life!

fast paced, must attend to do well, don't need book to pass, need book for highB/A. must study for tests, is clear in class, posts exam study guides online, reviews in class. 4 tests and final, lowest of 4 dropped. go to class, study and you will ace.

He was an okay professor. He let us out of class early most of the time. The final is taken EXACTLY off of five previous tests. He is somewhat difficult if you are not a big fan of economics. Attendance is not mandatory but it helps. I wouldn't take him again.
I think he is hot

fast paced teacher. Knows his stuff but kinda lazy in my opinion. Best thing to do is ask questions if you don't understand b/c his lectures basically follow the lecture note provided by the publisher of the textbook. As with any class you must study

Without this professor, I simply could not have done regardless of my competitive i.q. He has been very patient and understanding without lowering his academic demands or standards. He tried to fill in the gap between students various backgrounds and the required academic level for the course. Thumbs up for a job well-done!

Crystal & Victors class is such a refreshing change of pace from standard studio classes at UTA. They try super hard to accommodate around tests in other classes, holidays, and school events. They're super tech savvy, have great resources and can give feedback on a variety of design challenges. They give you the freedom to explore and learn. 10/10
Took this professor and Victor for the Spring semester and nit a single thing was taught. Majority of the times, they walk around the class and ask if we have questions
Taking this Professor and victor now. Not organized and lots of contradictions. Final project is also not very helpful for real life. Not terrible but there are better people to take.

reviews.comment: recommend 10/10

Took Crystal and her husband Victor together for second year studio, they are extremely helpful in progressing your own designs and go out their way to ensure what you produce is to the best of your capability and are responsive to helping out with software troubles. Very relaxed and fun but still expect great work, highly recommend!

You literally can't not get an A in this class. Prof. Cruz gives extensions on listening guides (very easy), and she replies quick to emails. Answers to the listening guides are found in the recorded lectures, which are a bit long, but optional. Only one easy group paper. Your extra credit is to literally attend a concert.

Was a fun and easy class. Everything on the quizzes are on the study guides. Two things I would say though are don't fall behind on the Listening Guides, cause there are quite a few and sometimes a pain to do. Additionally, there's a group paper, but as long as you paid attention to the lectures it's really easy. Overall, great teacher great class.

Great Professor. Assignemnts were based on lectues and were easy. Quizes were also easy as long as you looked at the study guide. Caring professor, she extended due dates and was very lenient. There is also a group paper towards the end of class, but is simple if you've paid attention during the course.
Very relaxed, loved her! When I was getting behind, she checked in and made sure I was doing okay, and offered to extend turn in dates.
Prof. Cruz was amazing and was very flexible with us considering we shifted to an online delivery. Would definitely take again and highly suggest!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is a real gem! The tests are extremely easy, right out of the study guide. 5 tests are taken out of which the lowest one is dropped. Just one group project, which is also pretty easy, but attendance counts. She is extremely caring and always smiling! Willing to help you always. Amazing professor!

Took her summer 5-week class. Easiest class I've taken so far. 5 tests, lowest 1 dropped. Tests are right from a study guide and extra credit on the tests can boost your test grades well over 100%. 1 group project paper. Attendance was counted and mandatory.

Amazing teacher! Took her class over the summer, easy 100! We had one group paper to write, and we had a few tests, but they were so so easy. Theres powerpoints and she gives her lectures are very clearly. Would def love to take her again. Shes also funny and inspirational. Attendance does count. reviews.comment: Dr. Cuts is the best professor EVER! She's very down to earth and extremely intelligent! Her playing and artistry is very evident in her playing and she's very willing to take the time out of her day to help any student be a better at what ever they are struggling with at UTA!

Dr. Cruz is someone who really cares about her students and will do everything in her power to help you be successful in her class. She is the best professor for freshmen Ear Training .

reviews.comment: She made me cry. Feedback was unnecessarily condescending, offering no constructive feedback. Replies sometimes (at best) to emails. Could not receive a grade above a C on anything I turned into her. Made me hate history, wish I could have dropped out.

Stay away

This professor is tough. You have to stay on your toes. I learned to become a better writer due to her tough standards.
No Feedback, grades paper late
