reviews.comment: If you can help it, don't take a class with G. Crowell or if she is COACH for a dynamic online course. Ask the school prior to enrolling in History if this professor will be a coach. Grades are subjective with no valid explanations. Responses are condescending and belittling. My first class receiving C's on papers. Run, it ruined desire to learn.

I used to love history. I have NEVER EVER received less than an A on any paper in ANY class, Gen Ed or even the more technical nursing paper. Could NOT get above a C, even following the rubric exactly by copying it into Word and filling it in, point by point, source by source. And 34 assignments in 8 weeks is unrealistic for an online Gen Ed class!
Unrealistic grading and papers which count for more of your grade than any test.  Lack of clarity on assignments and not helpful when asked.

I've taken online classes from 3 different universities. This is by far the worst class and coach I've ever had. Rude, obtuse, not helpful, condescending. Work load is ridiculous for a survey class. Recommend getting history requirement from another university. Obviously UTA does not care as Crowell has a history of bad feedback and nothing changes

Crowell has given me the most issues of any professor I have had to date. It will be impossible to get an A regardless of the effort you spend. The tests being multiple choice is where you'll score the highest because she can't "grade" those. She does not inspire you, she is abrasive, and if this weren't my second to last class to graduate I'd quit

I made an A in this course, however, I have never worked so hard in my life for one. She is an incredibly harsh grader of papers and not helpful in any way. This course is just tough period. Expect weekly individual and group discussion posts with severe criticism of whatever you write. Tests are fair, and you will pass if you do the reading.

TOO MUCH COURSE WORK! This prof. has the most course work for a dynamic class. Quizzes over each chapter of the book (5 minutes to answer 6-8 questions), group assignment, extra readings, watching documentaries, discussion board posts(2-3 due each week). Just a ridiculous amount of work for a history class. NEVER TAKE HER!

I heart Ron Cross for discrete structures. It's been over a year since I've taken this course and I still compare other professors to him. If you show up to class and truly participate, you will not need to put in too many study hours outside of class. Textbook is optional. Ron Cross forever.

He's a pretty good professor, and I found his anecdotes interesting. The course takes some effort, but its not overly difficult. The "pop" quizzes were announced a week before. We were given two formula sheets to use on all assignments, that had everything you need - no memorization required. Exams were open-book but closed-note. Read the textbook.
Wish I had someone else. Uselessly tough class. Mandatory attendance and surprise quizzes

Bwahaha

The class is discussion based. He likes to share his previous experience working in the industry so you could actually learn a lot from his experience. As long as you pay attention to his class it should be easy to earn good grades. He also has a lot of extra credit opportunities

He is the best professor at the university, no cap. He loves his students, and we LOVE him. Not one day goes by without thinking about his class. His assignments = exciting. His exams = amazing. This class is okay, you have to write a few papers, 3-4 pop quizzes and 2 tests. Most students get around a 80 on most assignments. Almost no one gets an A, more likely you'll receive a B.

Grill him for more details on his spontaneous assignments, the rest of your classmates will thank you.
Lot's of assignments. Exams and project are very important. Don't skip any. Just meet the requirements and you'll get good grades. Amazing professor. Tough homework.
case studies are helpful but it takes lot of time. very good prof , always available to clear ur doubt .happy to have a prof like him

3 tests the entire year. Totally prepares you for them with ample review and posts a review online beforehand. Really cool professor. What he expects is pretty clear and will do well as long as you read his supplementary material and read the book. Not a difficult class and if you are interested in space and life then this is definetely the class to take

Lectures were interesting and even showed us a piece of meteorite one time during class. If you have taken physics then be prepared for a review, astronomy is pretty much the same stuff. Dr.Cuntz is one of the few caring professors at UTA. He is always willing to help. He is very knowledgable in his field. READ what asks to read and you will get an A.

ASTROBIOLOGY: The professor s a caring and knowledgeable professor that is always willing to help each student grasp the concepts. An A is obtainable and not hard but you must apply yourself. I enjoyed this class very much. I learned so much by going to class and it will help you get that A. Amazing topic and professor that is active in research.

Very thick German accent, but tests are very easy if you pay attention in class&take good notes!He gives a practice test &review prior to each test&same questions from practice again in real test!Funny prof.&gives breaks during class&let's you out early usually. Professor Cucalon is an all-around great professor. GOOD PROFESSOR!!! I LOVE HIS LECTURES!! TAKE THE CLASS WITH HIM!!! PLUS YOU HAVE A GROUP PROJECT AND ITS A HUGE PART OF YOUR GRADE SO PICK GOOD TEAM MEMBERS!!!!!!
Dr. Colbert is a good teacher, he'll get side tracked on some crazy story for little 30 minutes, but somehow it all ties in with the lessons.

This is a great professor, very genuine and very funny.  His stories about his life are very interesting even if no one else is "gullible" enough to believe him.  I learned a lot from his class, and not just things out of the textbook.  He throws in interesting things in his lectures from architecture to psychology.  I really liked his class.

This a required class? If you're interested in the layout of japanese offices, feng shui, obscure famous people and a movie written by the prof that noone can seem to find anywhere then take this class. No 'design' or 'structure' to his lectures. Dont expect to learn anything or use the textbook you spent so much money on.

It is pretty easy. On his tests, if there is a "A and C" thats usually the answer. his lecturers are interesting and he makes up a ton of stuff how famous he is dont buy it. just pay very close attention, he gives answers to his test during his rants. and oh, dont buy the book. should be an A or B. and get a SMART GROUP for the project.

Inside the shell of [somewhat excessive] personal accounts contains some real applicable nuggets of wisdom. Attendance is necessary; borrow the book (reading is minimal); take good notes. Entertaining, long-winded, and abstract.
He is a complusive liar. He makes up the stupidest stories about things that never occured. After looking this guy up found out he was a joke. His class was a waste of my time
Starbucks is the third place.

Thoroughly enjoyable! He's a non-linear lecturer who (literally) doesn't go by the book.  He uses experiences from his quite interesting life to point up the many of the lessons contained in the text. I always looked forward to his lectures because they made you really think about the issue rather than try to recall something you read in the text.
worst teacher and name dropper in the history of UTA
If you are naive and gullible you will probably like this class but if you are an experience business professional you will realize it is a big waste of your money and time.
This teacher rocks!!! Although he goes off subject alot he is easy come to class and listen to what he has to say, and you will make an easy A!!!

Dr. Culbert is a pretty good professor when he doesn't ramble...doesn't lecture out of the book, expects you to read it on your own time...75% of the tests come from his lectures...so just make sure to take really good notes in class...really easy going prof...group project is not too bad, just don't wait until the last minute...learned a lot about business communications from him that you can't necessarily learn from a book
Let's hear some more about North Richland Hills and his cool car.

I've had his class for a week and this is what I have learned so far: He is an author, is late to class for meetings at Starbucks, Johnny Depp wants to make one of his books into a movie, he has made 2 movies, etc...so where is BUSA2302 in this picture?
The class should be renamed to Culbert 2302. End of story

This guy is terrible! avoid at all costs. you will learn nothing and he name drops like he knows all these celebrities. the ppl that like him are no offense, dorks. it's impossible to know what the tests are over. he's late to EVERY class and then goes over the time limit
He is one of those great teachers that likes to teach you more about life and how to apply studies to it than about studying from a text book. He also teaches English at TCC NE campus.

Didnt learn anything in his class except about his "movie contracts" and "book deals."  His final project pretty much grades grammar and thats it.  He'll rip you up, no matter how good your grammar is.  I made a B though.  Just prepared to be bored by a compulsive liar.
He is real nice professor. He is pretty easy going. Just attend his lectures and take all his notes and u get an A.  lovely
Steve is a cool dude, it was real fun listening to his stories... He is real honest and the group research project is not that hard.
Culbert is an awesome lecturer and a very interesting person. Fun Class!!
Very friendly and excited to teach, she loves answering questions and shes very passionate. honestly one of my fav professors since i started college almost 4 years ago.

Professor Nagy is one of the best instructors that I've ever had. She is very good at what she does and she is very understanding. She has endless resources for her students and I defiantly recommend her class to anyone interested in ASL.

i was afraid to take ASL online, but it was a great experience! EASY (6) assignments, (three 25-question) quizzes, (2) short essays, project and final. modules go by steadily, so you will have plenty of time to learn the signs! show up, participate, complete the work, watch all videos and PRACTICE YOUR SIGNS. helpful material is linked: USE THEM!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Second time I took her and loved it. She is so helpful and she always gives you feedback so you can improve. Just pay attention in class, practice your signs, and you'll be good!

Because of COVID and how all the classes went online, I was scared to take an ASL class. Professor Nagy is easily one of the most helpful professors I've had. She was always there to answer any questions you would have, whether by email or in class. I learned a lot of ASL this semester and I am excited to take her for ASL 2 next semester as well.

Because it's a language class, you get out of it what you put in. If you're checked out, you won't learn as much. She's a very sweet lady and nice professor- only two rules really. No speaking aloud in the classroom, and keep your technology use to a minimum. Awesome, engaging course, and professor.
I absolutely love her. She's Deaf and learning from a Deaf prof is such a wonderful experience. She takes the time to get to know her students! She is amazing!

Professor Nagy is one of the most compassionate and caring instructors! That being said, DON'T try to take advantage! She is super sweet, but when she gets upset, well, DON'T talk in class! She is Deaf, but she WILL know when people are talking. Besides, its rude. I've learned so much from her in ASL 1 & 2. FANTASTIC!

Professor Nagy has to be my favorite professor ever. She is indeed Deaf, so expect to be fully immersed in the language. There is a strict 'No Voice' rule that, if broken, will get you kicked out of class early (and rightly so). Class is fairly easy for visual learners and those with a decent memory. I can't wait to take her again in spring '18!

Dr. Choi is the kindest, humblest college professor I have ever met. He loves and gets excited when people participate, is very accessible and passionate. He is a good teacher, but is lectures are pretty disorganized and his thoughts are not collected, so he is hard to follow at times. His slides and notes are lacking, but not too bad either.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Just know youre getting a very strong quality education when you take Dr. Chois class, its not easy and thats the point, he doesnt want this to be just another course. he is a very passionate economist at his core and he takes pride in the subject. he is the very first prof to actually express concern for my grade and give up his time to discuss it

You wont do well if you skip classes, however, in the event you just cant make it, you can watch the lecture in echo 360. If you just pay attention you will find everything revisited on the exams. No need to take notes, just print out the note slides he uploads AMD fill in the blanks as he gives lecture. This isn't a class for the lazy kids.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Didn't find this class as hard as some people said! He's really amazing and passionate about economic. Testing style is different because there's MC AND SHORT ANSWERS to test your knowledge. Try talking in class, y'all! He will know ALL y'all names by the second day so beware! His jokes are lame and I love them! Group project was a pain but I lived

Dr. Choi is a great lecturer and a very smart man. He is a hard grader and his tests and quizzes have a lot of short essay and short answer questions, but if you show up to class and take good notes you should be ok. If you go to class and show that you're interested then he'll notice and help pass you. Pretty funny too.

Absolutely do not take this Professor! This is by far the worst class I have ever had to take. You can attend every class and study every page of lecture notes and still not pass. Hes terrible at teaching and very unorganized. PowerPoint slides are not helpful. His tests are fill in the blank and short answer and he grades very hard. Stay away.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: CY Choi is the most intelligent professor I have taken from, and really knows his stuff. He only have two exams, and they are hard, especially the final! A group of us studied flashcards for hours for the final, and we walked into that exam SHOCKED at the level of difficulty. Choi cares about his student's success, and wants them to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: 3 quizes, 2 exams, group project & 1 comprehensive final. Study his powerpoint slides, do extra reading in your book if you are lost. He has extra credit ops. His exams are MC, fill in the blank, and short ans. same with the quizes except for the short ans. Make sure you participate in his class. A lot mat to study!! Love his lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: First of all a very knowledgeable Professor. Not too difficult as long as you come to his class, pay  attention, and participate you will walk away with an easy A. Since this is University you will need to  know some of the material he is taking about, either by reading the textbooks, using web. I had a wonderful experience  and fun  time.

This was the worst class I ever took. I attended class regularly but never understood a thing. His method of teaching was very disorganized. Had to print off like 10 pages of slides every lecture and fill it out in class. so if you missed class, the slides are basically useless. The professor as a person is like on another level of petty.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: CY Choi has the amazing ability to captivate with his lectures. If you can manage to put your phone down for an hour and a half and absorb the useful information this man lays down, you will leave his class a smarter and more economically aware. He provides you with real world knowledge and lots of extra credit. Moreover, he's a comedy wizard. 9/10

I needed the book to understand the lecturesTons of info in slides, hard to weed out whats important. Slides to print out with fill in the blank that are outdated compared to what he presents in class. Tests are very difficult. If your not an A student then stay away. I was constantly confused by so much info he presents. Very hard class to follow.

I Hated econ before taking this class, in both econ 1 &  2 I barely passed with a C at TCC, I currently have an A in Dr. Choi's class. Come to class everyday & take notes. No book is needed! Attendance is not required, but extremely helpful to your success. He gives a lot of extra credit! Sometimes just showing up gets you extra credit
Very good Professor.  Not easy but very informative.  Makes you work for a good grade but it is collage.  I would recommend him if you are looking to learn.   Some good comic relief in there as well.

I highly recommend that no one take his class. Was of no help what so ever. Took off all the slides and no review for the final and would ignore emails sent to him regarding questions over the final. Among many other things, this is a very poor instructor.

This guy is one of the worst teachers I have ever had. Group Projects? If you want a good grade then you have to be a group leader and do absolutely nothing because you will still get 25 extra points regardless, fair right? Slides printed out did not match slides presented. Instead of paying attention, you have to make sure the slides coincide.

He was one of the most challenging yet informative professors I've had. He explained everything very well and could answer any questions we threw at him. He used exams that varied in response options to test students knowledge.

attendance is not mandatory but ppt. slides are fill in the blank, book is not necessary at all. Tests cover ppts. half multiple choice, half open/fill in the blank,I struggled with that part of the test but if you study you should be good.

Nice guy.  Do not need the book. To do well you have to memorize the powerpoints.  The test questions cover a lot so you have to memorize huge amounts (way more than necessary honestly).  His tests are difficult but he grade leniently on the long answer questions.  Do not expect an A without tons of studying.
Didn't use the book at all in this class. Also, his tests were easy except for a few questions that asked for odd specific details. Must attend class because his slides online are fill in the blank.

No matter what you do, do not take economics with him! AVOID HIM!!!His test are "fill in the blank" Yes "FILL IN THE BLANK" with no reviews only a few power point notes. When I took it a lot of people dropped his class & on the first test only about 25% of the people passed. I would not recommend this professor to anyone unless you are an A student
Funny and knowledgeable

You should print out slides. It is best you do not miss class because he gives so much information.  His tests are a bit hard because they are hard, but you should do at least OKAY if you study his slides.  The final is comprehensive so that's something to think about. I did learn a lot , but this isn't a class to slack off in.
You have to print his slides. It is really important. In class, you have to write down the missing blanks that he will show in the pp. His test will be covered from every thing he said.

This is by far the easiest class I have taken at UTA up to this point. I never took the plastic off my text book just studied the slides/note that we took in class. He sometimes throw random "fun facts" as questions on tests, so you need to pay attention to what he says. He's funny and tests are curved with grades from optional homework assignments

Simply one of the best professors I've had. At first I had a bit of trouble understanding but then everything was fine. He really enjoys the subject and he's really funny. I would recommend him to anyone. He gives really fair test, MP, fill in the blank and free response worth about 30-40% of the grade. But he is awesome
learned alot in this class.. Gives extra credit and bonus points..

I've learned the most from him out of all the professors at the business school so far.  Very helpful if you have question and is very funny.  Attendance is not required but strongly recommended to get the info for the powerpoint slides.  Textbook not really needed unless you need for more clarity on the subject matter

Professor Choi is an excellent teacher. I have never seen a teacher who is so dedicated to his job. His classes are hard but it worth the time, effort, and the money you spend. I have learned so much from him. The material is very hard and  I strongly recommend reading the book. If you really want to learn something take him YOU WON'T REGRET IT!

Dr. Choi is straightforward and to the point. That being said, the class is challenging and you WILL need to study to pass the exams. Tests are based on lecture and PPT slides. Review thoroughly and keep up with him in class. There are also quizes and easy extra credit opportunities. He will cold call on you in class randomly. Great class overall.

He is really good at explaining complicated matters in easy way. He is very helpful and wants the students to understand everything that is being taught, the information that I learned is massive and very helpful. No textbook is required, he keeps everything up to date and tests are easy if you attend his lectures and take notes.

Great Professor, but not easy. You will learn more than you have in any other class. If you want to learn, take him. That's why you're in college anyway, right? If you want an easy class......change majors or do not take him as an elective.
A great class to learn lots of things about money and banking. Too-big-to-fail... Be careful, it's not easy though.

This class if very hard if you are not an Econ major. I would not recommend this class b/c he is hard to follow, his powerpoints do not coincide and he gives way too much information that you have to memorize. I agree that the quizzes are easier than the exams. Barely passing his class with a low C.

The subject is very interesting, but he makes it way harder than it should be. I did felt like I was in high school.attending class is very important. Don't be tricked with the exam reviews, they are way easier than the test. If u want to learn about money and banking take him. If ur looking for a cake class , this isn't it.

He is not easy, do not expect an easy A for this class. quizzes are 20% and there are only 4 of them. and 3 exams. i never learned so much in my life after taking this class but just to let you guys know that it's not easy at all.

Dr. Choi makes his expectations very clear first day of class. Be on time and attendance is key to doing well in his class.  He expects a lot from his students but in return does a great job of teaching using many different methods.  Truly cares about the subject and it shows.  Great professor
Took his 3303 class in summer II along with precal II.  Fortunately the class was easy and made it easier to get an A in math.  Make sure you're on time for class.
Yes, I agree that his class was worth taking. You learn a lot more by showing up at classes.

He loves his subject. Wants to impart knowledge on the students instead of just making them memorize junk. PARTICIPATE IN CLASS. I made mostly B's on tests and quizzes, but got an A because I asked questions and participated. Show up for class. You will enjoy it. He throws in some jokes and stuff to make class interesting. Definitely take again.
He is passionate in his class and lectures were worth attending as they often the real world material instead of just repeating the textbook. You need to pay a lot of attention during class.

This was a pretty easy class, if Econ is your subject...Prof. Choi made things very clear ahead of the tests but you HAVE to attend class in order to keep up with the subject. I would have easily made an A in the class only if I wouldn't have missed the in-class quizzes (20% of the grade)...everything else was pretty straight forward!

Dr. Choi is a very good teacher. He highlights main points clearly and gives students old practice exams to help them study. He definately seemed to enjoy the subject he was teaching and attempts to pass what he knows onto his students. This class was by no means easy but if you want an A you'll definately need to work for it and study.

If your an A student expect a B, if ur  C student EXPECT a D. whatever standard grade you are used to getting, deduct 10 points. grades very strange on tests on short answer and essay questions which happen to be the most important. im am A student yet made D's on tests due to the awkwardly graded essay/short answer sections.

Took Money and Banking and Econometrics from him. Both were moderately difficult classes, but the trade-off is learning so much more than you do from many of the other professors. These are not classes where you memorize facts for tests then forget them afterward. Very enjoyable lecturer in both large and small class sizes.

You must attend class!  Oh and get into as many disscussions as you possibly can and then get into more.  He curves based on participation even if you dont know what your talking about.  He wasnt biased in my class really gave multiple perspectives.

I took this class over summer and really enjoyed it.  He is a good professor and really knows his stuff.  Very few HW assignments, no papers or projects and helpful test reviews.  I would take Dr. Choy again for sure.
I like his class cuz I learned lots of real world issues. Professor worked hard to make the class interesting. You need to attend every class to get a good grade.
Enjoyable! Good job!

Did the professor just rate himself below?  Were we in the same class?  I agree with the other two, totally biased and while he can be funny at times, the class was uncomfortable, biased and not that advanced.
I've neever enjoyed economics class as much as this. He covered a braod spectrum of macro topics. Very well organized and clear. Need more math background to enjoy the course though.

Unfortunately, there is not another option for graduates to take Macro theory.  We learned very little theory, it was more intermediate material.  I would not recommend but there really is no choice.  Too far left in his philosophy for me.  UTA should find someone who can prepare graduates for research instead of indoctrinating them.

I should have known this class would be a bad idea in the first week when he said that government had no hand in the mortgage crisis and praised the stimulus package.  He is very biased towards failed Keynesian policies and if you express any challenges or have a difference of opinion, your grade will suffer through his subjective grading system.
his class was great. i like his real world examples.

must attend!...notes are fill in the blank and can only get the blanks if you are there...has quizzes throughout the year that are 30% the length of his real tests and are really difficult...hard to understand at times and tries to be funny...tests are pretty difficult...must study and pay attention...
his class is the most challenging I've ever encountered, yet it was one of few classes where I've actually learned something exciting

he cracks a lot of funny jokes. You don't need book at all. all you need to do is to pay atention, his class is very important, you cannot be absent one single class. all exams materials are from his lectures and handouts. very easy teacher, straight A if regualr student, even if u r not then read da book, u'll be okay, gives sample similar to test
Hey, i am very impressed with your prediction. The current financial market turmoil is going on exactly what you mentioned in class. I've enjoyed your class a lot.
I took his class last year and it was so tough then. Now I am working for bank and find that what I learned from him is very helpful. thnx.
He was so good.

This professor is very hard!If you are taking him.I am warning you!!!He has quizes every week that is in the length of an exam and exams harder than a departmental exam.For his quizes and exams he has multiples choices, fill in the blanks with NO word bank, and short essays.If you take him you'll be under a lot of pressure, and stress.
tough and hard, but learned a lot from his class. that's what classes should be!

This guy is very hard. I would say 70% of the class was making a D and needed to get a 90 or above on the final JUST to pass. He gives random quizes which are as hard as the exams and the exams are very very hard. You basically have to memorize very word from the book/notes to get an A in his class. I suggest taking Mr. Crowder! Easy A!
not helpful at all... would not take if have other options

This professor treats his students like high school kids. Does not let you use a lap top, you will have random pop quizes, he will call you out if you try to leave early. The tests are short answer fill in the blank and multiple choice. Hard to understand, has a thick accent. Do not buy the book he gives everything you will need on power point slid
wierd notes with fill in the blank so you really have to be in the class to get the notes. exams have part short answer questions and those are the ones that throw you off
I took his class last fall. If you're looking for easy grade, forget about it. But if you want to learn something seriously, that's the class.

course materials were challenging, but he did a great job to make them understandable. it will be tough if you don't work hard as he set higher standards than most other classes. yes, it was worth taking though.
Very enthusiastic and well prepared! I learned more than from any other class at UTA!
worth taking this class!
One of the best teachers out there
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great, actually took more classes than necessary. Would love to take her again and again

I actually took Dr. Clark's class back in 2007, but I'm here because she and her class were that memorable. History was never my subject in grade school, and I certainly wasn't looking forward to sitting through it in uni, but she made it fun and interesting. The tests were, from what I can, fine if you paid attention. I made an A in the course!

I looked forward to Dr. Clark's class both semesters I took her. She lectures all of U.S. history from memory; tells it like a story book. Tests are half multiple choice, half essay. The multiple choice aren't hard, and all she wants from the essay is for you to spit out facts. This class requires minimal outside studying and class attendance.

Dr . Clark was one of the best professors I've ever had. She made learning the information fun because she introduced it chronologically and all as one big story. I took her class in the Fall of 2013 and she had 2 exams, a final, 2 quizzes (one per short novel), 8 homework assignments online. Do your assignments and study notes and you'll get an A!
Her class was super easy the work load was not difficult at all. the assignments are online and really the main thing was just getting her reviews and you are good

Professor Clark is amazing! She made history interesting and relevant. There is $100 "textbook" to buy and assigned seating that you pick. Other than that, just go to class, take notes, and you should earn an A. Her reviews and outlines of the essays are exactly what you need to earn an easy A. Take her!!!
besides the $100 for the online class, it isn't that bad. don't need to go to class except the first couple days and review days. Online assignments are very easy. Do it with friends.

I took Dr. Clark after reading the good reviews and was unimpressed. If you want to get an A it is pretty easy, however. Just pay $100 for the useless textbook that she requires you to buy, and take notes. She takes time out of your class to tend to people's personal issues. Oh, and there is assigned seating, which I don't care for.

AWESOME professor! She makes you love history simply because of the way she teaches it. Her pace is a bit fast so you'll need to write or type pretty fast if you want to cover everything in your notes. It is very important to be there all the time because it WILL pay off. VERY INTERESTING.

I am not a history person but after taking her class it seemed so easy yes I did miss some classes and didnt pay attention but it showed in my test grades to if you go to class write your notes and study them then your test will be easy reading the bookms are a must too the online book work are very easy I would take her again!

She is an amazing professor! She claims she will make you extremely interested in history and from the very first day she will accomplish this. I 100% recommend her. By the end of the class you will respect her as a person and you will respect history. Always looked forward to next lecture.

Great class!! Great teacher!! It's an easy class if you go to the lectures and take notes you'll do fine. The online assignments are SUPER easy you can do they as many times as you want. The only downside is that you have to pay $100 for a book you'll most likey never look at.

She really is an amazing teacher. Although it sucks having to read two books, I ended up not reading them and still made an A in her class. I really recommend taking her class. Oh! Also, she does assign seating, so try to sit next to cool people on your first day.
LOVE HER!!!!

Easy class if you are good at history. She talks about herself too much and goes off topic easily. Overall, if you study you'll do great. The text book is a huge rip off. $100 for an online text book ridiculous.

People told me to take her, so I did. And I'm glad I'm right. She gets off topic a lot, but her off-topic stories are actually interesting. If you take notes, and listen to her lectures, you'll be fine! Another downside is the $100 online text book. The online assignments are SUPER easy. You can even redo it if you get answers wrong.

I love Clark!! She teaches history by making it into a really interesting story! I always enjoy going to her class!! It isn't a blow off. There are some online assignments which are easy, the tests are multiple choice and an essay. If you listen in class and keep up you will do great! Definitely recommend Clark!!!!

People will tell you that she is the easiest class you will ever take and it isn't true. I have a 3.9 and you still have to study for this course. I am expecting to get an A in her class but I would never take her again. She gets extremely off topic, inappropriate, and she is very strong in her political beliefs which make her teachings bias. :(
She is an awesome professor, so funny, and very helpful. I HIGHLY recommend her. Only downside is the textbook is required and its like $100.

GREAT PROFESSOR!!! She gives so much extra credit its hard to not get an A! I only needed a 32 on my final to get an A; that's how easy it is. She gives you reviews and if you have her on a day that's only 50 min class then you won't even have to write a full essay she'll accept outlines. I would write an outline and write 4 sentences as my essay
Professor is pretty chill and sometimes tells weird stories in class. Really awesome and easy class!
The easiest class you will take! I highly recommend her!

I loved her class. all you have to do is go into class and listen to her lectures. Its like a long story and very easy to pay attention. required essay for each test which is easy. she gives a review the day before the test which is very helpful! online chapter assignments are the only down point because it costs $100!
I absolutely love her! She is so down to earth and gives extra credit. If you don't make an A in this class it's bc you did absolutely nothing. Attendance is required.
All I can say, that she is super duper easy. Best professor ever at UTA.

Honestly the best 200 dollars I've ever spent for 1311/1312. I fall asleep easily to lectures but this class kept me interested and awake. She makes learning history very interesting and I not once read the book (only to do the assignments). Best professor by far for 1311/1312. Easy A. All you have to do is come to review and you'll be fine.
if you want to have an A in a easily way take her class
Take good notes, and go for the review, guaranteed A.

AMAZING TEACHER! I've taken 3 of her courses and she is my favorite teacher at UTA! She tells personal and funny stories to relate to her topics which makes you not help but memorize what will be on the test. Her personality makes the class incredibly enjoyable. Just take notes and listen and you will do great! I learned so much about history/life

Took Clark for 1312/1311. Easy! Only bummer about her is that she requires you to buy her book that is only available online. I like to rent books because I want to save money. She makes that impossible. Attend the review day and you will ace the test. She picks the easiest essay topic to help us out. Interesting person with a lot of knowledge.

I took her for both HIST 1311 and 1312 because i liked her so much! I made an A it was EASY. Hard work to maintain it though because of tests. She lectures exactly what you need to know for the tests and she uses only her own memory no powerpoint slides. Take good notes! Easy assignments! Highly recommend! Not tricky. Take her!

I'd recommend her to anyone! She's a great lecturer and makes her lectures into a story time. Her assignments online are easy and her exams are easy too. She provides review days before. Attendance is mandatory.

If her TA didn't take attendance, I would only show up on review days and test days. It's that easy! She's really friendly and funny, and the online assignments are so simple and easy 100's. Also, extra credit opportunity for 25 extra points which helps a ton. She makes History not so boring. Take her!

she was very easy. I made an A.. just do the online assignments and study them for the test. she makes you sign in. but you don't have to pay attention, just write down the outlines she has on the board
Absolutely love this teacher. The best I ever had!!!

and 1312. She's a pretty awesome. Really into history and can get excited about certain topics which makes the lecture much better and easier to pay attention to. Lectures are pretty clear and holds reviews before her exams which are pretty simple if copy down her lecture notes on whiteboard and take some time going over them yourself. Take her!

Excellent teacher, Easy A. All the material comes from the homework assignments and the book. Reviews before the test and tells you exactly what you need to know for the essay questions. Read two books in the semester but didn't need to because the test was so easy.

Absolutely fantastic prof. I don't hate history, but learning and retaining it has always been difficult for me. Her class wasn't an especially easy class, but her lectures made it easier and more enjoyable to remember and learn. I would def recommend this class to everyone. It is her goal to make EVERYONE love history and, with me, she succeeded.

wonderful professor with a great attitude (not one of those professors who tries to make the class harder than what it needs to be) everthing on the exams are covered n class. jst be sure to take notes!!!
THIS CLASS IS AWESOME, DEFINATLEY TAKE HER EASY A!! I WILL BE TAKING HER AGAIN FORSURE!
Easy A, tells you what to expect on the exams and even has a day of reviewing for exam. We had assigned seats, attend class or else she begins taking points off your grade

GREAT PROFESSOR! She really knows her stuff. Lectures are pretty intereseting, if you pay attention. Her tests are easy and she reviews the day before the test. If you go to class, there is no way you can get an A.
This class is VERY easy.  She tells you exactly what to study and the exam is going to be over. Great attitude and isn't afraid to tell it how it is.

Very easy class and grade. Test material is made very clear ahead of time. But I can't say I was a big fan of Dr. Clark. Her lectures bored me to tears. And the "online testbook" was a one hundred dollar joke. Easy A, but I wouldn't take her again.

EASY,EASY,EASY. I just took her and it was my freshmen year. Take her. She tells you everything you need to know for multiple choice. Plus you have to write an essay for the test. During review, she gives you three essays and tells you what to writ , every detail. And two of the three are on the test, and you pick which one to write. And shes funny

Attend class because she gives 5 points EC to those who miss less than 3 lectures. On all three exams, she gives you three possible essays ahead of time, two will be on exam, and you get to pick one. Every single time, the longest essay and one of the shortest essay are on the exam. For the book quizzes, you cannot slack off. Easy A.
Ms Clark is a very talented professor. You can tell that she really likes her profession! Her tests are not tricky...but are not that easy... you must take good notes to get an A.

Dr. Clark knows how to teach. If you attend class regularly, take notes, and study, you should receive an A. There are two exams and a non-comprehensive final. She goes over what you need to know before each exam. There are 25 MC (50pts) and 1 Essay (50pts). You have to memorize at least 2 essays before each exam. Overall she?s a great professor.
Take her! She's so easy! I knew nothing about History and made an A, attendance helps boost your grade a bit. 3 easy tests, but 2 quizzes where you need to read books and those were tough.

Everything you need to know for her test she tells you the class before. Great History professor if you just need a history credit. Some effort is required for an A, but not much. A TA messed up grading my essay, and Prof Clark took the time to help correct the error. She was really nice about it too. She's also hilarious, which never hurts.
Awesome professor! Knows her stuff. Fairly easy class as long as you attend class everyday, take notes, and read your texts.
Awesome professor, she knows her stuff!!  As long as you read the book, which is not bad at all, and pay attention in class, you should do quite well.  I got an A!

She had some personal issues come up which affected her semester. I would have preferred she email us when  class was cancelled instead of leaving notes on the doors at the last minute. It would have saved me a number of 4:30am starts. I would not take her class again. Easy 'A' but for a $1000 class I feet like I got the short end.

Great if you want an easy A, but it was absolutely ridiculous how much she cancelled class with no communication with students.Take home midterm and final.DOES NOT RESPOND TO ANY EMAILS which is a problem to some students. If you're looking to walk out of the semester with a lot of knowledge about history, I do not recommend taking her.
AWESOME ALL THE WAY AROUND! TAKE HER FOR ANY HISTORY CLASS YOU HAVE!

Anyone who says she is great obviously recieved an easy A.  Sometimes she hands them out like candy.  She missed several classes and is slightly aloof when she is in attendence.  Great for an A, insulting if your here for knowledge.

She is am amazing professor.  She makes you feel history which helps you understand it.  For someone who does not get history, this made it very helpful.  She also provides an extremely helpful review.  Attendance isn't required but helpful.

Very funny n approachable prof. All the work in her class isn't out of this world hard.You can do the online assignment over and over till you get 100. Test are easy 25 mc n a essay, she gives a review the day before.I just recorded the lecture and listen to them a couple of time and I was good for the test.Must take if you hate or dread History.

Awesome teacher.  I did not like history before her class and she made it interesting, and I loved it.  Her tests aren't easy but if you go to class, and review and study you will do great. Sign up for her as soon as registration begins because she fills up immediately.  Very smart, and funny prof.  Would recommend her to anyone.

Great teacher! clear of what she expects, doesnt try to trick you on tests.  Gives you a review the day before class with everything you need to know for the test.  funny and easy going.  favorite teacher so far!
One of the best professors at UTA. She makes the subject very interesting to learn and her test are super easy.

I am not good at history at all and it doesn't interest me. However, I managed to get a 'B' in this class. She makes it interesting and the class isn't too hard. I suggest bringing a recorder to class, it helped me a lot because she talks pretty fast..

Her lectures are interesting and if you go to class, you'll make an A. There are chapter assignments online but they're super easy. Has quizzes over 2 books each semester, I never read them and still made an A in both classes. Tests are 20 mc+essay but she gives a very helpful test reviews the class before the test.
Dr. Clark is amazing! She makes History fun and her class is super easy. All you really have to do is show up and listen. Take her if you can!

She's Interesting and her tests are pretty easy, but you definitely need to study. Lots of Chapter Assignments and Lots of reading in Novels. She also likes to share personal information....and it's kinda awkward. lol

I never liked history, but I took 1312 last semester and she is amazing! I am taking her again for 1311, she is that great. The book is online, and she wrote it, so if you go to class and listen to lectures you dont have to read. Shes really nice and helpful, and I actually enjoy going every class. Shes easy and makes things interesting. Take her!

Great professor. Is funny and interesting and you'll love attending class. Tests are 20 mc and then an essay but she goes over the material the class before the test so its impossible to not make an A. Attend lectures! They're fun and you'll definitely get a great grade if you do.

BEST PROFESSOR AT UTA!!! JUST DO UR WORK, N YOURE GUARANTEED AN A!! i HATE history, n never looked forward to learning about history, but professor clark changed that for me! n she gives little surprises here n there! =]
Awesome teacher, very helpful and actually cares about how you do in the class. Would take another class with her.
Dr. Clark is my favorite professor. Really easy and helps students a lot. tests are really easy. no matter what yu should make an A.
She is very good!! and also funny.

OH MY GOSH I LOVED HER!!! She is awesome!  I learned more about history that I ever would have with any other teacher.  She is funny too, and loves doing what she does!  TOTALLY TOTALLY TOTALLY  recomend her!

This teacher actually values the need to learn. Most teachers teach you then grade you. Not actually take much care in what you learn. Mrs. Clark really wants you to learn and makes sure you get all the info you need prior to the test. The tests are pretty easy and the online stuff is pretty much a given. A very fun teacher

AWESOME.  I've had two upper level History classes with her, and I've known people who have taken upwards of six with her.  Very cool and fun teacher.  Just do your best to keep up with the material and you will pass the class.

MY FAVORITE CLASS AT UTA SO FAR!!! Professor Clark is a down to earth teacher and will make you LOVE history! She makes the class interesting and always adds funny stories about herself in her lectures. If you miss a quiz/text you can always retake it...she's very flexible. You really have to attend class/take notes to pass though. TAKE HER!!

I mean today was my first day in her class, and I just think she is the coolest professor I think I'll have in my UTA career...love her sense of humor..I know this is going to be a fun ride for the next five weeks LOL
SUPER SUPER flexible! the work is all online & she pushes back dates all the time :]
Love the way she dresses ;)
So i thought that she was really easy... and she is until you take her quizes... i failed those and thats what cause me to get a "B"
I hope I will fail so I could take her again, and again

the best history teacher ever. great personality a good sense of humor and actually makes history interesting. i would recommend anyone to take her, if not you are missing out. her tests are pretty easy they come straight from her lectures so you have to attend class. there is some essays on the tests but she tells you what to right about
Best US history teacher ever exists in US history
She talks really fast so I would suggest you bring a tape recorder to keep up test are 24 multiple choice and a 3 page essay sounds hard but it's not she's by far the best prof I've had all semester.

she is a great teacher. anybody who doesnt like her, did not go to class a lot. her tests are straight from her lectures. it is very easy to remember her lectures. she is very clear and honest in her lectures. i would never take another history teacher. she is great. and she is gods gift to history. very knoledgable.(spelt wrong)
keeps things really interesting and shes is also very interested and lively. you have to go to class though, if you miss you miss out on alot

She is an awesome teacher. I didn't have to buy the book because her tests came from lecture and attendance is mandatory , but she is a good teacher and easy to listen to and go along with. Tests are MC and 1 essay, which she gives you a study guide for. Her name used to be Northrup, Cynthia...so also check the profile that is on this website.
The best teacher in the history department!! I Like her! she is so nice and helpful.

Professor Trott was my professor for KINE 1300 and was my professor again for 3415 (Exercise Physiology). The class does have a bit of studying to do and the labs were pretty easy. Amazing professor, explained topics thoroughly especially for an advanced level class. I'd take him again for any class!

Pease take his class! He deserves it. He works so hard as a professor and cares for his students. Goes out of his way to help us without judging. Always ensured we understood class material and knew what was going to be on the tests.
This is the nicest professor that I've come across. Don't hesitate to take his class.

Professor Trott is a great professor! Lectures are interesting and most of the exam materials are from the lectures, so be sure to take notes in class. He is one of the few professors that will take time to answer your question and make sure you understand everything. Would definitely take him again if possible.

Professor Trott is a very good professor this intro KINE course. He will always make sure his students understand the material and is willing to answer questions from students. Exams are easy as they are completely over everything he has taught. I recommend him to anybody getting into intro to kinesiology.

Professor Trott explains things very well and always does his best to explain a given question. Attendance isn't mandatory but I highly recommend you go especially for the second unit which involves more anatomy and physiology of the human body. Other than that it's a pretty easy class with not much work to do.
Prof Trott is an average professor. The University level of lectures was missing. He seems to run through PowerPoint during the lecture.

i went to every single class, did every single assignment and still got a C. very difficult exams you wont get the right answers even if you cheat even the best students get a B. his lectures are great but you have to remember everything. gives homework and in class assignments every week. good professor but very difficult class

I can't help but feel like this was a bit like the Naruto chunin exams where you're meant to cheat. I realized he's a great lecturer but I do remember getting eepy early on in the class. For exams you're expected to rememeber everything. Good but tough love intro into business world in a way. Prof is VERY approachable. Writes are funky.

reviews.comment: He was a TOUGH grader, but a lot better than I expected. Be ready for weekly take homes and very long lectures which you should pay attention to as the exams are based on the slides... Personality wise he was great, funny on a good day.

Genuinely a good professor and an interesting guy, very knowledgeable and prepared. Impossible to fail but almost impossible to get an A in. PLEASE check out "MavGrades" for the grade distributions for professors; I shouldda done this. His TA gives random grades for the weekly writes. I'm sure Shurtleff would have given insight on them if I asked.

You'll need to get ready to read the text books, articles for the homework essays, more articles for the research paper. As this is global business, a lot of the information and homework stems from the real world.

Great lecturer, and you actually learn so much. Just make sure to actually try on the assignments given because he is a bit of a tough grader. Still worth it, I would take him again if I had the chance. Also, all exams, at least for my section, were online with lockdown browser, no camera or mic.

best prof yet. weekly papers and quizzes, 3 exams, final exam, and industry analysis paper. knows his stuff, grades hard but if i tried harder in the beginning, a B is easy, take him to get better discipline, high business knowledge from real world, dad jokes, and lectures that force you to learn something due to in class assignments and exams.

he's a very strong, passionate professor. He does give take homes twice to once a week, with difficult exams and quizzes, but he makes sure you listen and participate. His lectures are interesting and he's really big on no phones or distractions in class.

reviews.comment: Be ready for lots of homework. This is an intro-level class yet he gives you a paper to write every week that has no clear grading scale. Exams specific to lectures.

reviews.comment: Be ready to deal with his weekly 400-word essay which is hard to get above the grade of 8 if you do not put in the effort. Do not enroll in this class if you are looking for an easy A, but you can really learn a lot from the professor.

reviews.comment: Gave us many take home research assignments but ones that were relevant to what we were learning in class, so they did help. Harsh grader but in a way that pushes you to do better. As long as you put in the time and effort into studying then this class won't be too difficult.

His class can be interesting at times, he randomly gives in-class assignments and weekly 2  take home assignments which you can only submit in class. exams are online and will make you question your answers. Weekly quizzes and case studies on mindmap where the grading system marks right answers wrong sometimes I'd suggest to not take his class

Lectures are stale and boring, and he assigns an unnecessary amount of in-class and take-home work. Exams are tricky—many answers seem correct depending on how you interpret them. reviews.comment: He is alright, he is exams all online, no LDB. He gaves us a lot of hw and couple of pop quiz during the lectures

This is my fav class at uta, gona miss this prof, important lectures you will enjoy & funny! He truly is an amazing professor and just wants to make sure his students come out wanting to know more about what's going on in the real world. Would absolutely take his class again.

I gave bro a one star in the beginning of the semester and I take it back. He's like the sensei or teacher you hate at first but end up loving at the end of the show. His class is not easy and I fr hated him in the beginning but I grew very fond on him. (If you're seeing this shurtleff, You're alright.) I recommend taking him.

In the beginning I didn't like this class but as the semester progressed I realized he was actually a really great professor. Sure, the workload is heavy but with good friends to help you and breaking procrastination you can handle it. He covers his stuff well, also nearly all work (even exams) is online so take that as you will.

His tests were online and taken at home. Overall I think he was a good professor who enjoyed what he teaches. There is a major paper you would need to do but it's actually very interesting. Definitely take notes, but he does share his powerpoints.

I like his teaching style because it grabs your attention and its explains things pretty well. He assigns A LOT of papers and his  homework is textbook HEAVY. If you are looking for a professor who gives you challenges and forces you to learn the material, then this is your professor.

I liked this professor! Lectures were interesting and informative. He assigns alot of homework but it is very doable. His exams are okay. They are online and not proctored. They are a little overwhelming since they are 50 questions, 55 minutes, but if you study you'll be okay. Very tough grader on the essay so don't procrastinate and do your best!

need to show up for lectures!! he gives in-class assignments and make sure to listen bc everything on his lectures is on the exams. had 4 exams and 1 final (cumulative).

he gives a bunch of take home assignments throughout the year but they arent hard to do. he was funny and encourages questions bc he wants us to actually understand.

reviews.comment: He is a great professor who wants to prepare you for the real world. He will give many assignments but wants his students to get a deeper learning experience. He will also use worldwide examples when lecturing which helps. He is also accessible and is happy to help.

Professor Shurtleff is truly an amazing teacher. Even though many students may complain about the heavy lectures+ own time book notes, high amounts of homework, and a fast paced lecture, it is worth it. It will be a struggle but it is worth it because it pushes you to adapt and develop techniques to conquer time management. Difficult-high reward.

Professor is absolute funny as ever and absolute fun when it comes to the lectures. The certain things that In-Class Assignments would require people to participate and get involved in his lectures for a grade. I recommend taking him for a MANA 1301 (BA 310)

Professor shurtleff would randomly give in class assignments or take home assignments which would be graded harsher than the homework. He assigns a lot of busy work that will take time away from your other classes and assigns on average 2-3 writing assignments a week with an online quiz. will grade thoroughly.
If you're starting out in COB take him to ease yourself into more intense classes to be taken later on, otherwise, find a different professor.
Lectures are good, but there is a LOT of homework, some of which is used for a participation grade. Tests are very conceptual, and there is no practice test/review.
Lecture heavy, and a harsh grader on the major essay so really prepare for it.

I took this professor last semester and I was doing well until the very end of the grading period. A little backstory, I had been really sick and seriously considered that i might have had covid-19. I relayed this information to Shurtleff and asked if I could make up a participation assignment in class which he replied with a big fat no.

He is an amazing professor that really tries to make you think harder about the topics at hand. He teaches with real world examples so that the concepts are easier to understand. Make sure to show up to every class because the in-class assignments can really make/break your grade. He's a very funny person and definitely take him if you can!

There are assignments that need to be turned in inclass and they are also assigned in class. The exam material does pull questions from stuff only discussed in the in-person lecture as well. Overall a good professor, entertaining, enjoyed showing up to class.

Reading the textbook is ideal so you have an understanding before class, as he uses examples more than definitions. 4 tests. Study the powerpoints. He often includes specific numbers in test questions. 1 paper. Start early; he gives you a review of what you should add to get a higher grade. Gives about 15 assignments throughout the semester.
I enjoyed his lectures. The weekly assignments were not difficult at all. People just need to stop whining over 400 words. Also get started on the paper as soon as he assigns it.

Shurtleff's lectures are very boring. It was very hard for me to stay engaged during the entire class period. He gives assignments in class as participation that can not be made up. It did not take me long to realize how much I dislike this course. Lectures are sinfully boring sometimes I feel like days pass in Shurtleff's class. Extremely unforgiving no matter the circumstance. tests online and 80% lecture so you have to go to class. He does keep his lectures very interesting and relevant. good professor and cares about his students.  there are lots of homework assignments in class but typically they are easy if you paid attention.

He is fact-based and gives amazing lectures with current real world problems and examples. If you read the chapters beforehand and attend his lectures you will be FINE. Test is more application than memorization so study to understand.

If you want to learn, take this professor. If not, there are much more lenient professors. Dr. Shurtleff is very entertaining. He clearly knows what he is talking about. I really disliked this guy. Lots of writing assignments with minimal feedback. His attitude the entire class was pretty off-putting. His lectures and PowerPoints were alright, but pretty difficult to take effective notes on. Can't tell you enough how much I didn't like this class. Avoid if you can.

The lectures were very interesting and most of the test questions are from the lectures. He grades tough on the one paper. Overall, I liked attending his class.

Lectures were thought-provoking and insightful, honestly the best part of the course. Speaks on experience and provides data to back up all claims that he makes during lectures. Exams are mostly pulled from lectures/PP and some from the book (required for assignments). Tough grader on the one analysis paper, weekly assignments, overall Easy A.

Prof. Shurtleff is a great teacher. The H/W in his class was primarily weekly assignments of a quiz & short case study. I found his quizzes to be a bit challenging & the paper was long but interesting.
Shurtleff is a good professor. His assignments are not hard. He has one final essay which requires work but is not hard to do. His lectures were interesting and helpful.

if you want an easy A, Shurtleff is the professor for you. if you study and review the chapters, you'll do well on the exams. His class is very entertaining, he is a funny guy. his lectures are pretty straight forward and he knows the material really well.

He's really into capitalism and sometimes kind of preachy about it. His exams are very fast-paced. But otherwise, it was a pretty decent class. If you read the book (which the online text will do for you), attend/watch lectures and complete the assignments, it's pretty alright.

reviews.comment: Genuinely enjoyed going to his class . Attendance isnt necessarily required but he does take attendance randomly as extra points. The only thing i dont like about this professor is his hand writing, everytime he does a math problem it does get a little bit messy and unorganized but you can tell he's trying his best. Other than that he's really nice and he never makes you feel stupid if u ask a question.

Very kind professor who was always willing to work with the student. I really enjoyed his class and thought the material was easy and useful.
