Have a question during the exams? He will answer those! His teaching style is perfect for Intro to proofs

Warren's style was to let you present proofs in class and he'd tell you what was right or wrong about it. He grades homework late and there was very little to base your grade on. If you are good at understanding concepts quickly, can work with a free-style method of learning, and are willing to put in a reasonable amount of effort, it's an easy A.

Dr. Warren is a very sweet individual but can be disorganized at times. Lectures go by super fast with him telling you things, not explaining it. Homeworks not distributed evenly and sometimes will even drop 10+ homeworks due in one day. Very understanding, though. Will help you pass if you ask for help. Stay on top of your work.

Professor Warren is a great professor who explains the material thoroughly. The class itself is very easy, so it is not hard to fail. He answers your questions during tests and makes sure you understand. I would recommend taking him as a professor.

I took him for calculus 3 over summer 2023. Although I got an A, I'm a really slow learner. However, he strongly encourages you to ask questions, even if you feel like it's a dumb question. That really helped. The Pearson hw aren't representative of exams. Do the paper hw, it helps a lot. ASK FOR THE EXAM REVIEW AHEAD OF TIME. Overall, very good!

Pretty chill professor. He's a late grader and goes over the material very quick. We'll summer courses wise yes, but he's very understanding, and would only test based on what we have learned so far. He has a terrible handwriting which is frustrating, but hey! you'll make it.

He's a good, chill guy but he's disorganized and has two modes of HW, paper and online. Lectures very fast. Tests are all open-ended so some may struggle with that format. Paper HW grades will not go in until the end of the semester so no feedback on those. Posts exam reviews late.

No clear grading system. He will tell you if it's easy to get a C and you only need to get the mid-50s on exams. He writes fast and his writing is hard to follow even from Echo 360. You can still fail even if you go to all the lectures, do your HW, and get 60+ on the exam. He gives vague answers on grading.

He's a great prof, very funny. He tries his best to explain each topic, however he goes through the problems very fast. Sometimes, he omits "details" of the problems so you'll have to ask him to clarify. He also doesn't respond to emails sometimes. Other than that, he's great! Would take him again for credit.

He's really chill, Maybe to chill lol. Grading was simple 50% Participation (go up to the board and solve questions or submit written work) and 50% exams. He just watched us solve questions during class he didn't teach. Since this is a REAL math class he understands it is hard and was very helpful, but exams are difficult!! & Grades VERY late.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took him for this course in the Spring of 2022. He is one of the better instructors. Really nice and hilarious and helpful. He is actually willing to help you if you visit his office hours. The university needs to pay this man more. Very generous to curving as well if a lot of people do not do well on his exams. Take him! You will not regret it.

Missed two lectures during the summer which definitely slowed down the learning. Also came late quite a bit. Nevertheless, he was very engaging and had productive lectures. His homework's are also great because they make you go through each step and it connects it all together and truly helps you understand. Need help? just ask

It's Calc II, so it's bound to be difficult, which is why his lectures are pretty fast-paced. If you miss one or two lectures you'll feel lost, but the homework can help you refresh your concepts. Warren is a really good professor, with great personality, and very patient. He also extended deadlines for us without any hesitation. 10/10 professor!

Warren is the man. Good personality, and sure he goes fast, but it's not his fault he has no choice its calc 2 for goodness sake. He explains the material simpler than the textbook. Also is very very patient and available to help in labs.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Great professor but the math department is a death trap. Take all math classes at TCC instead and transfer them. The departmental exams are very difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: It's foolish to attend lecture in calculus 2 and assume you'll get everything immediately, Dr. Warren supplants this by being extremely available for office hours. Use this man for everything he has to get a good grade and ask questions frequently. Textbook usage is optional, but highly encouraged in order to solidify concepts you feel shaky on.

I have literally no idea why this professor has this high of a rating. He comes late everyday. Unless you learn from youtube, you won't pass for sure. He is so fast I am pretty sure 99% of students just cant catch up. I definitely wouldnt take him. Do not be fooled by reviews. Doesnt reply to you as well on emails or anywhere. He is a bad teacher!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: It's probably the nature of the course, but his lectures are extremely fast paced and it feels like he doesn't give you time to process the information. Though the info is pretty good though. You'll probably have to spend some time outside of class to review the lecture notes. Use the exam reviews to study for tests, because they are very similar.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Pretty chill class and dude, basic and useful math. Lots of opportunity for redemption if you miss something or do bad on a test. Attendance is a small part of your grade but if you miss class there are plenty of online resources to catch up on the material. Tests are 20 questions and straightforward from online homework material. Sig assn easy.

I made the grade I did due to medical issues I was dealing with throughout the semester. He's a great teacher, very understanding, and gave me extensions on tests when I was in the hospital. He's funny and always keeps you engaged. Never be afraid to stop him during lectures and ask questions, he will always rephrase it or explain more.

He goes kind of fast so you'll probably have to watch some videos on YouTube to understand the lecture material. Handwriting is pretty hard to understand sometimes, but overall a good professor. He cares about his students. Lots of homework. Review past exams and ask questions.

Very funny, great guy. Wish he was teaching calc 3. Always looked forward to going to his class. Homework did suck, but thats for all of calc 2. He makes understanding calc 2 pretty easy, but its still a difficult subject.
I've never once in my life sat through so many lectures just to go home and be confused day after day, mans is litterally talking at light speed. FF
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He teaches super fast. Doesn't care to ask the students if they understand. wants the students to know all of the material before even teaching it. Every student who has taken his class, I'm sure has had to go through youtube and other study materials, because he doesn't teach well. No reply to emails for weeks. Be ready to TEACH YOURSELF!

The class was very difficult and professor Warren taught well but was too fast and did not really explain the logic behind where things came from. He knew his things very well but I had to look up videos to understand some of the material.

He is the kind of teacher you go out of your way to take over and over again. He is super understanding with his students and will extend due dates and help you on assignments. This class is slightly confusing so if you don't understand something, ask him or go to office hours!

You need to use the learning modules to your advantage, that's the only war I really learned the material. He moves through the course super fast but if you ask him to go back or repeat something he will. Super chill dude and helpful when you ask about something you need help on.

Prof. Warren is a laid back professor and lenient on homework deadlines and usually extends them after they are due. Homework is harder than the exams. He's accessible outside class. However, the drawback is that in class, he struggles to explain the material and more often than not, you feel as if you're having to self-teach yourself to understand

He is a great professor. He is really understanding if you have stuff going on at home you just have to communicate with him. He does take a while to get back to you sometimes and he is very last minute with things and can change things the day of. He does lectures in his handwriting which is very hard to read and he moves really fast.

Dr. Warren is a chill guys and his class is pretty fun even though its online. Calculus itself is hard but he made it quite simple. Its true I learn 70% from him and the other 30% from youtube, I would definitely would take his class again. He's always helpful and once you get to know him he awesome. Overall a great professor.

He is awesome! I took cal 2 in HS and didn't understand a thing, but he makes it so much clearer. The test reviews are literally old exams so those are the best to study with, if you can get those down then you're set! Stay on top of your notes and homework because it can get overwhelming if it piles up.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've had! Lectures were heavy, and since he writes so fast, it's hard to keep up, but he was clear in his teaching and was always glad to answer questions. Even with the switch online, he was always good at explaining concepts. Multiple HW assignments were usually due a couple days before exams, so don't procrastinate!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor, if it was not for him, i would probably fail this as it is the most difficult one ive taken. During the whole covid-19 business, he even got a tablet to teach us better in Microsoft teams.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Warren has been one of my favorite professors so far. His hipster look really masks his intellectual prowess and nice of a person he really is. That aside, the course is heavy on work and I ultimately had to drop the class from working full time work and full time school. I will however be taking his class again because he is a great professor
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This professor is one of the most enjoyable people Ive had, but I could not learn from him. He lectures with handwriting with a projector, but its VERY difficult to read. His mind goes so fast he tends to leave the class behind. Some homeworks were near impossible, while others were quite simple.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This dude is a legend. Best math professor not too hard. Teaches from the heart.

I am in my second year of college, and had to drop this math course twice because I could not seem to make a connection with my professors. Professor Warren is a very caring man, he really does want you to pass his class. I did not go to his class often but I should have, he has a great energy that many professors don't have.

Dr. Warren is probably one of the best math professors I have encountered in my life. He gives terrific lectures and all. The best thing about him is he uses Desmos in the class to help us visualize the function and how it works. I wanted to take him for CAL III as well, but I could not because of the schedule conflict.
He's a super chill professor, does a great job explaining things so anyone can understand, which was very helpful for me because I suck at math. Wish he could teach all my math classes!

exam 1 I majorly MESSED up. It didnt matter because the final replaces your lowest grade the 2nd exam I did well on. I would not take this class if you don't have too it was very difficult for me to understand I took it with calc 2 at the same time. I think If i had taken more advanced maths it be easier great prof tho very clear answers questions

If I did not have Dr. Warren for cal II and III I would likely not be a math major today. He is one of the most creative professors I have ever had at UTA and his classes benefit from his work. He is extremely dedicated to anyone who enrolls in his class and is an extremely good communicator. If I get to take another class with him I will be lucky.

Dr. Warren is a fantastic professor! He is one of those rare professors who earnestly listens to your questions and clearly explains what is going on if you ask, rather than just repeating himself (as so many profs do...). He's reasonable and easy to understand. He's super chill, even takes his shoes off during the lecture lol.

Lectures were hard for me to follow, kind of all over the place. I learned by teaching myself and Khan academy. STUDY OLD TESTS AND YOU WILL SUCCEED. Try to master the free response test q's bc they are very similar each yr. and worth more points. Hw is harder than tests and a few sections are due about every week. Don't get behind!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I took Cont. Math. Everything is on Pearson. Homework and quizzes you can do at home, test are in a lab. The homework ?s get progressively harder and harder, but the tests are never as hard (just the basic stuff), plus the tests are EXACTLY like the hw style wise. His lessons sometimes dont match up with whats on Pearson. Really funny guy though.

Warren is chill and hilarious, very easy going. Teaches with humor. Pretty understanding when you're having problems so if you need help, just ask him. Everything is online - homework, quizzes, and exams. Textbook is also online so use it if you want. Have to pay to access the online MyLabsPlus program. Really enjoyed having him as a prof

An amazing professor will help you on any subject in the course even on his own time. Extra credit is available every day as he posts problems on the board and will be added towards your grade at the end of the semester. Homeworks and quizzes are online and easy to do. Will sometimes push back due dates if you ask him to. Passed his class with a B+.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: He's very helpful in class and easy to talk to! He explains the material well. I stopped attending towards the end because a lot of the material is learned through the online HW/quizzes. For tests, study mainly the quizzes and some HW. It's very easy math, just remember to review before tests!

Dr. Warren is a great teacher although the course can be difficult. He gives all of the material needed to succeed on tests, but the tests are given by the department which can be a huge hassle. Otherwise, solid teacher

Prof. Warren is honestly the best professor Ive ever had. If you want an easy A this is the class for you, but you also learn. I really like how he never used power points , he teaches you everything you need to know. Homework, quizzes, and tests were super easy. He's also pretty funny

It was a hard class and he never responds back to his emails if you need a quick and immediate reply. Lectures and homework, quizzes, and exams were nothing alike. You have to teach yourself everything. I would not recommend this class.

I like this class and the way that Dan Warren teaches it! Not too fast, not too slow. Everything makes sense. Get ready to do lots of group worksheets. You don't need a physical textbook but you do need an access code for about $100. There's homework due every other day but he goes over everything in class. Just do the work and you'll pass!

Lectures are fast paced but structured enough to understand as long as you're paying attention. He does well at explaining theory and then demonstrating through practice. He's also pretty laid back and approachable if you have questions or need help; makes class enjoyable. Homework demand is pretty high so take care to stay on top of it.

You may think you are understanding what is going on in class. Homework and test are way harder than anything he goes over in class. Is very vague on what is asking for. If you grasp the homework, the test is only harder. Don't take if you need a good grade. Only plus is that when all fail, he will pass the class. But you deserve better!! DONT TAKE
Great Professor

Great Professor, Really cares about his students, I fell blessed to have him as my professor.  Loved every lecture, enjoyed his class, felt really sad that I won't be able to take him as my Calculus 3 professor. If you get a chance please take him. He is really a gem.

Dr. Warren is a fantastic professor. He explains concepts and why they work really well. He also does a lot of illustrations to better understand the material. He assigns hw assignments once a week and they're quite difficult but he is available for office hours almost everyday. If you can do the hw, you'll do well on exams.

Dr Warren is a wonderful professor, very smart and helpful.  I took him for cal 3  after 4 years of taking cal 2. He was very helpful throughout the semester.  His test  and homework questions  are standard , but he will help you through it if you go to his office. If you put in the effort you will be fine.

If you have the opportunity to take Warren, do it. He's a very down to earth and helpful human being. I can't tell if being purposely vague is his style or if it's just the nature of Number Theory. He'll lecture apples, give hw on orange groves and then test on the farmer's market. Web-search "Monkey and Coconuts Puzzle." Ready for a challenge?
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: His tests and homework are tough but he will help you through anything you are struggling with. I had him for Cal 2 and 3....I wish he taught Linear and Differential Eq. By FAR, my favorite professor that I've had at UTA.

If you care about mathematics, you will get so much out of his class. He's very implicit about how or why formulas work sometimes and assigns very little homework, so I had to study a LOT on my own time for this course. He cares about proofs and creativity, and doesn't see math as just regurgitation of algorithms. The best professor I've ever had.

This is a difficult class. It is very lecture heavy, and the tests are difficult given the time, if you are slow at calculations. The homework is a must to understand the concepts, as well as outside study via other resources to cement the ideas.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Warren is probably the best math professor at UTA. Easily accessible by email, easy to talk to, and has a general passion for what he teaches that spreads to his students. While he is unable to write his own cal II tests and labs, because they are standardized by the math department, he takes the time to review each test so they are graded fair
Dr. Warren is fantastic. His lectures are easy to follow and understand. I was dreading taking calculus 2 and 3 but he helped me through them. UTA needs to hire more math professors like him.
Great teacher. Just pay attention in class, and you'll be fine. He's also available outside of classes. Pretty funny too.

Dr. Warren is hilarious, and a great teacher. His class is heavy on homework and quizzes, but it's super easy, and all on MathLabs. It's a real world math class, and the book isn't really necessary, just the MathLabs.

Professor Czarina Reyes makes it easy to take this class, all the Homework, Quizzes, and tests are taken on MML. Just be prepared to do tons of homework which have a due date a. Two attempts for each Chapter Quiz, you have unlimited attempts for the "Practice Sample tests which prepare you for Tests" You need to work for the grade you want!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took this class online during fall 2017 semester. I was worried about this class because I do not love math. However, statistics is way more applicable to my world than algebra. Once you get through the homework and take the quizzes, the test are very doable. Do all the homework, quizzes and exams and you will be just fine!

Pros: She offers extra credit in the form of extra homework and webcast attendance  Cons: Just about everything else. She is a poor teacher, she rarely covered actual statistics in her webcasts, and if you aren't good at math, this class will take up most of your life. In short, I don't recommend this professor to anyone.

The pros, she offers extra credits (technology assignments and attending webcast). She drops 2 hw assign. & 1 quiz.  Allows 1 test retake.  The con, I love math and although I did not encounter any problem, it was very time consuming. The teacher wont teach you, and refers you to the book if you have a question. Basically, you will teach yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Reyes is very helpful, gives lots of info during webcasts. A word of caution, if Math is not your strong suit, stay away from the 8 week statistics at UTA!!! It is very fast paced and once you get behind, it is almost impossible to catch up.  Dr. Reyes does give extra credit for attending LIVE webcast and doing technology assignments.

I took contemporary math with Dr. Reyes, and she was very helpful in her webcasts. If you attend webcasts, you will have examples of the types of problems on the test. I just finished Statistics with her, and she is a great professor. She provides examples of what will be on the test. I recommend you attend webcasts even though they aren't required

Class was reading heavy! Test and case study discussion boards weekly. No extra credit, lectures are her reading PowerPoint slides which are basically an overview of the readings. The test are based off the reading and lectures so you really have to pay attention to every detail.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Pro. Desai is one of the best instructors I've had. Her communication is clear, consistent, and respectful. She follows the syllabus closely. I really appreciated the test reviews. Extra credit is given. I highly recommend Prof. Desai! The class content is hard so it does require lots of homework and studying.
overall, the class is similar to introduction just a little bit of new items. Exams are quite easy if you pay attention during lecture and reviews. Homeworks are not hard as well.

Let me preface this by saying she is really nice as a person. Her accent has gotten better and is understandable (going off of previous ratings), however my biggest issue were her exam reviews. They really don't reflect how the exams will be. Lectures were okay but not very informative. Expect to self teach on some concepts. Keep her as a backup.
She dont even know how to teach. She dont even know what she is talking about. Very bad lectures. Hard grader. I would never take this class again. She is rude as well.

let me start by saying she is actually nice person and available if needed but she seems like she cannot lecture at all and is not a good speaker at all the classes are incredibly difficult to get thru on top of this she has a heavy accent. the slides can be very hard to understand bc there is so much going on. if you study the hw you will pass tho
They should visiting meet your professor on the website.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Teaches a method not allowed on exams. Gets offended when asked questions. Whispers to where you can barely hear her.
Very hard to understand. During lecture she talks like she is talking to herself. She also writes very small on the board and hand writing is very bad. The exams question are not clear either.
shes not great at teaching, puts me to sleep. very boring

The lectures can get a bit dry at times, but Dr. Deb is always reachable via email for any questions, concerns or additional help. She also gives opportunities over the semester for extra credit and drops the lowest quiz grade. She is a generous grader when it comes to exams and quizzes, while also still giving good feedback. Overall, great!

If you like getting extra credits, you'll love this professor also she gives printed copies of her slides. The homework was hard, but her exams were really easy. Going to class is worth it because she gives a lot of hints about what will be on the exam. The best part is, I didn't need to watch Youtube  her 360 lecture videos helped me a lot!

I'm really sad she's not my professor anymore. She was so kind and understanding. She even accepted my late work, even though it wasn't normally allowed. She made things less stressful and graded fairly.
It's really hard to communicate with her. Though she put efforts in her class but regarding one to one communication, it doesn't help too much.
Very immature towards students

Dr Deb is a decent lecturer and her course is much more cohesive than may of her colleagues in the IE department, however she treats her classes like children and "disciplines" them when she feels like she isn't getting the respect she wants. Mostly impressed by her unprofessionalism with students. Required attendance enforced by quizzes.

She explains very well but she really really values attendance. If you do not attend her class, then you will fail :). One thing I don't like about her is that the homework are not really correlated with the class material.

Dr. Deb is fantastic at explaining and her lectures generally follow the textbook, so you just need the textbook for review. The textbook is surprisingly good, and there is only 1 short homework every week that is due the night before the chapter quiz. The quizzes are short and moderately easy, and Dr. Deb is a forgiving grader.

Pretty hard class- lots of homework and there are 2 midterms and a final. There is 1 project which weighs the same as a test, but is easy if you don't wait until the last minute to do it. There is a pop quiz once a week that has about 3 questions. She offers extra credit if you go to her office hours and participate in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: EXTREMELY HARD COURSE. He is very knowledgeable in ECON and you will learn a lot, but if you're just looking to pass the class pls don't take him. He goes off topic often about things not related to the class. Exams are really difficult. If you're not taking many other classes give him a chance, otherwise take literally anyone else.

BEWARE, GOOD RATINGS DON'T MEAN EASY CLASS! This class was not what I expected, but overall I am satisfied with the course. Professor Czajkowski wants you to think for yourself so you can succeed later. SPEAK UP in class for bonus points and attend lectures to pass. Give the same effort to studying as he does teaching.

Professor Czajkowski is an excellent instructor who makes even the most difficult concepts understandable. Attend lectures, participate actively, and use unstuckstudy alongside the free textbook - that's the recipe for success in this class.

He is alright. His exams are VERY lecture-based, so you have to understand EVERYTHING he talks about in order to do well.  He does teach interesting information from finance and accounting on top of economics, but he also makes sexist comments, mentions his wealth countless times, and talks about his right-wing beliefs at least 3 times a lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a born teacher able to explain very difficult topics in a very simple way. Other professors should take his class to learn teaching profession. I wish he taught more courses. I ended up with B by my own fault. He gave us plenty opportunity for extra credit. He makes you earn your grade but in a good caring way. Really good guy afterall.

Professor Czajkowski is one of the best professors I have ever taken and he is extremely knowledgable over this subjects along with many others. Come to class and record lectures or else you will not do well on the exams. He gives bonus points for participation which will bring your letter grade up immensely.

He is difficult to understand at times during his lectures. The Exams are more of Critical Thinking instead of what was covered in the chapters. His class participation to earn points are considered by answering his questions during lecture. Asking questions about lecture are not considered participation in class. Overall, I wouldn't recommend him

Czajkowski is by far the best professor I've had at the College of Business. You must come to lecture, because his tests make sure you understand the material well. He cares and wants you to take an active role in your learning. Don't worry about your grade, he rewards hard work and dedication. Seems rude at first, but he's just direct and honest.

One of the best professors i've ever had. His material is difficult but he truly helps and wants his students to learn. Do not worry about your grade just participate in class and actually try. If you participate he will give you extra credit points just for answering questions. Definitely recommend him!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He gives extra points for you reading the textbook and answering his questions. But most importantly is to read the textbook and attend his lectures. He wants us to learn not from the student's POV, but how it applies to the real world.

I do not usually rate professors, but this guy is amazing. At first, like many others have said you will not like this guy. I cried after my first test grade, but in the end I almost made a perfect score on the final exam. Just do what he tells you to do, and COME TO CLASS. He may seem arrogant at first, but I can assure you he is very humble.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Czajkowski is one of the best profs I have taken since school went online. He cares more about our intellectual development than just our letter grades. for my course, he just posted lectures we could access at anytime. 3 exams, 3 quizzes, and a final. I would recommend reading the textbook and watching his lectures if you want to do well.

Study a lot or you won't pass. There are 3 quizzes, 3 exams. No extra credit. Final is cumulative. He grades based on your improvement throughout the class. You must prove that you truly understand the concepts. He cares about your learning, so much so that it is highly difficult to succeed unless you dedicate a lot of hours towards learning.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor helps his students however he can. You need to study seriously if you want to make a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Czajkowski is THE best professor I've ever taken in my life. Lectures are very informative and creative in the way it is delivered. You will have to work in this class. The content and exams are difficult and are lecture heavy but he makes it worth it. As long as you try, you will pass. Many love him, others just don't understand him. TAKE HIM!

Absolutely devoted to explaining the intricate details and workings of the systems youre tested over; attendance to lecture will perfectly prepare you not only for this class but also a couple courses afterward.

He is a great professor. He will challenge you to think critically and know the material. He is willing to work with students to help them learn the material. However, you have to make a concerted effort. If you don't attend class, then you will not pass. If you really want to learn, then you will love this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: HE'S THE BEST. HANDS DOWN. ATTENT LECTURES, TAKE NOTES OR RECORD ECTURES, CURVES GENEROUSLY. YOU WILL PASS THIS CLASS AS LONG AS YOU ATTEND ANND TAKE NOTES. HE IS A WALKING ENCYLOPEDIA.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: One of the kind! Best instructor at UTA

Rafal is "not a professor within the realm of academia" as he will state in class at first. Its because he trains you on how to critically think for yourself rather than memorize a bunch of useless stuff. He actually holds a very high corporate position that serves as a testament to his vast experience. id take him again and again. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: He's a great professor that actually cares that you learn something in his class instead of memorizing the material. He is understanding and applies his lectures to real world. (Which is great, because half that stuff we learn in Campus aren't applicable). There's 2 test plus the final. Some bonus hwk too. READ! STUDY! and you'll be fine.

Hands down the best professor at UTA! Just come to class and absorb the knowledge he shares with you. He will make you think, he will make you question, he will make you better version of who you are. I would take him again and again only if he had time to teach more classes. reviews.comment: Prof. Degges is an entertaining lecturer. His writing assignments drive the class but aren't difficult. He is clearly politically biased and it bleeds into his lectures on most days, but he is mostly professional if you talk to him about it. You can pick your own topic on the term paper but sometimes it can be tricky to meet the requirements.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved this professor very good at making interesting lectures. You learn a lot about history in a entertaining way. I highly recommend taking him if you do the work you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor! he loves it when you ask questions. we normally got out of class early. 2 tests and a term paper. The term paper is very easy you get to pick your topic. I got a 97 on the term paper and I normally get 80's on papers. The quizzes are easy. He also gives 4 writing assignments that are easy.

5 quizzes 1 dropped. 2 tests including final which can be exempted based on your average. 1 major essay assignment. No actual hw besides the quizzes and essay. Really nice and funny! Not too harsh on grading, attendance sometimes required, you'll know when. Online textbook (free, not rlly used tho). Highly recommend him. Pay attention to lectures.
Dr. Price was a good and considerate professor in HIST 1301. She has lectures every class, so I'd recommend recording. There's no extra credit, and the midterm + final are writings.

You're graded based on 4 things, one being participation which she only takes twice a semester. Lectures are not available online so you have to show up. You only have one assignment, a midterm and final. The midterm and final consist of 4 questions each, you have you write a page paragraph in order to answer each question.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: fun lectures. participation is graded but not harshly; you should still show up because she doesn't put her lectures online. there's only three assignments (not including participation) but she's an easy grader

Dr. Price is a great professor who really cares for her students. You are graded off 4 things and one being participation, so make sure to show up sometimes for credit. She will work with you and will accommodate to your needs if you just talk to her. I would take her again.

I would definitely not recommend taking her class if you want an easy A or B. You will have to write a paper every week, but she is a hard grader. Her exams are not multiple choice. You have to write in essay format. This was the hardest and worst class that I've taken at UTA.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: What she teaches is very interesting. There are weekly summary and response papers but they are not hard.

reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Just skip the class. She is extremely though while grading and does not even give good feedback when asked. The exam is just writing huge answers to the questions and no multiple choice at all. And to add to all of this, there is n extra credit given in the entire class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor. I don't know why she has so much negative criticism. I really enjoyed her class and lectures. 15% of your grade is just showing up, and as long as you have a basic understanding of history and follow along her lectures, you'll easily get an A.

reviews.comment: A BIG NO!

The instructions for the essays were very confusing. Also, be sure to pay attention to the pictures she shows in class, because she expects you to write about them for the tests.

I dreaded going to her classes. Every single class was incredibly boring. She was unclear in her feedback on the essays we got back. reviews.comment: OMG BEWARE

Extremely well-spoken professor, she knows her stuff. Very warm and welcomes all questions and discussion. Class includes 3 short papers, a midterm take home paper, and a comprehensive final exam. Very fair grader and wonderful lecturer. SUPER organized. Always accessible for help and questions. One of best professors I've ever had

15% grade from class participation (show up to class, and you will be fine), 2 papers on document review, 1 mid-term and 1 final exam. That's all. No book review. NO MCQ. There are 4 questions in mid-term. 2 fairly easy questions and two questions to identify a character, event from the picture given. Just come to class, and you will pass with A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She gives great, in-depth lectures. She's extremely detailed and easy to follow. There are no notes on the PowerPoints - only pictures, but Dr. Price does a great job painting a good picture.

She tries to answer as many questions as she can. She is big on her lectures and doesnt post PowerPoints on the lecture but shes very detailed in her lectures so if you dont attend them youll miss out.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Banjade is a great professor who I enjoyed having very much. His lectures are based on the Canvas textbook, however, there's nothing in the exams that aren't covered by this. He is incredibly flexible and seems to really just want his students to do well. The class is inherently hard but you can see that he's trying his best!

The worst. Should not teach an online class, clearly does not understand how the system works. Does not pay attention to what due dates are listed in the assignment, had HW say it was due January 16th even though I took this course during the fall. Had one asgmt locked until AFTER due date. Was excited for this class, upsetting that I had him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Unfair grading system: D- class average, the most horrid lectures & exams, ever. Shows you how to do nothing, you're on your own. All your time to maybe just barely pass through the skin on your teeth. No curve & no extra credit. Most of grade is from sadistic number entry exams w/ questions to be deduced on the spot. GPA cyanide, honor roll r.i.p.
He is the most laidback professor Ive taken. Tons of extra credits, tests are basically based on homework and quizzes.

I dont understand why he has many bad review. His accent is strong, however he always tries to get his students understand everything he says. He focuses on the main points that makes everything become so much easier. He cares and is always available to answer questions. I would definitely recommend him.

I wonder that is he even a professor? He may be a good tutor to help to solve some math problems but certainly not a professor quality. Don't bother him asking questions, you are going to teach yourself anyway. Overall, taking his lecture is like punishing yourself, it's that hard to tolerate him talking. NO curve, A BIG NO!! YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED.

Dr. Banjade is willing to work with you if you have issues in this class! He was very accommodating of students' needs and gave plenty of practice material to work on before exams, often at the request of students who needed it. For some people, he may be hard to understand, but he's not a bad professor by any means.

The most awful class Ive ever had at UTA. This professor acts as a puppet while the department is the one really organizing the homework and test for you which are hardly anything alike. I dont know anyone who did not struggle with this class. Be prepared to have no life, even if you just want a C. Lectures are no help and youre on your own!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Stay away. One of the worst professors I've ever had. Nobody even went to his lectures because they were useless. He just read straight from slides and didn't answer questions. I thought I'd be okay because I'm used to teaching myself classes, but this is a poorly run departmental class. You WILL need help and you won't get it from him. Take Adams

He is a very forgiving teacher, gives extra credit and points on basically all exams and quizzes. Although he is difficult to understand, so I would recommend recording him in class or taking him online and re-watching lectures reading what he types in comments is very important as well! Online is basically teaching your self, I will take again.

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors on campus. Barely teaches and does not know what he is doing

He is very difficult to understand and had a lot of problems with MyFinanceLab. He basically just read equations off a PowerPoint everyday and didn't really add anything more to the class to help teach us. Very monotone. I would avoid taking him if you can. The class wasn't very hard but you will basically teach yourself.

Professor Banjade has a very thick accent and speaks very quietly, so it is hard to understand what he is saying. Additionally, he has very little control over the class, similar to a high school substitute. Best advice, sit close. He is a good teacher but hard to hear/understand even when he uses a speaker. His tests are very similar to his homework, he just changes the numbers. reviews.comment: You will have to self-teach, and sometimes the material isn't covered in the book, so Google is your friend. If you can do that, this will be an easy A because his exams are very similar to his homework and quizzes.
Great Professor. Study quizes and you will get an easy A. He also curves!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He takes attendance, but most people didn't bother to show up because he teaches from the PowerPoints. He didn't post our grades online, so you have keep up with how you are doing on your own. He's a quiet talker, so sit close. He makes A LOT of mistakes in problems, if you catch it POINT IT OUT. His class is doable and somehow easy. All of his quizzes and tests are based on the HW, like exactly, but just playing around with the figure. As long as you make effort and spend time to work on all the homework, understand of how to apply all the formula, this is definitely an easy A class.

Nice Prof but hard to understand sometimes due to accent and volume, teaching style does not work for me and it seems most skip class and self-teach as well. Asking questions never seems to go well - answers are confusing or vague. Takes attendance. HW helps a LOT - do not skip it. Formula sheet for tests - long answer and multiple choice.

Beware: half of the information that is not covered in lecture is in the textbook. An okay professor, and is very helpful when you do your writing assignment. As long as you do write notes from lecture and add more based off the textbook, you'll be okay.

Hands you no practice questions, but did go over the lecture slides (Not that helpful). If you take this class with her, you have to study A LOT and make your own practice questions. Activities or work done in class don't help with test, but attendance isn't mandatory. She does do extra credit at least twice in the semester.

Professor Dias is a very nice and caring person. I wish her lectures were a little more engaging cause Abnormal Psych is such an important class for psych majors. READ THE TEXTBOOK - Only reason I got an A+. She kind of has a lot of busy work assignments for the class but as long as you do them its an easy A. Not a terrible professor at all though!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: she's a very good professor, easy A. she would have a textbook requirement and would need to read the textbook since the test are based on the textbook and the lecture notes. But overall very understanding and very nice :)

If you need to take Intro to Psych for a Core requirement and want easy grades, she's fine. I do not recommend her for Psychology majors and minors. Lots of information was not covered and she is not good at answering student questions. You're not gonna learn much.

No homeworks to be graded, but he gives you solutions to them to practice for quizzes/tests. Everythings pretty easy if you study the homeworks given. He is pretty soft spoken and has an accent. Just be sure to study the homeworks hard enough to understand the topics and youll be fine. He gives lots of partial credit on tests/quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor, makes assembly easy to understand. He does have a accent but still is super clear when speaking 99% of the time. reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is an understanding professor that will accommodate to students needs. He is very clear about the syllabus from the beginning and about what he expects to be turned in and when for credit. He gives tips for quizzes and tests. He has an accent.
He makes assembly a lot easier than it should be. He will tell u what to study for the quizzes and the exams. There are no homeworks, but show up to his reviews. Excellent professor, and TA's!

Professor Hughes is without a doubt the best patho teacher you can have at UTA. She broke down so many of the complicated material and engaged with the class. Thats what made her awesome! The class itself is delicate, so if you put effort into studying the material, you will make an either an A or a B. Good luck!

Not only is Prof Hughes the kindest instructor I have ever met, but she is SO passionate about what she does! She provides ample resources for success, you just have to put in the time and effort. She makes complicated subjects easier to understand and truly cares about her students. You will have to study a lot but it is totally doable!

The class gets harder as it goes,Everything CONNECTS! Exams aren't memorization, you have to apply what you know. The professor's YouTube videos help a lot, so watch them and take notes. Going to class isn't necessary, but it helps reinforce info. There are five exams, practice tests, and concept map, so stay organized and ask questions! LOVE HER

Patho was hands down my fav class of pre-nursing because of Prof. hughes! she is the most amazing/ caring prof. ive ever had! she is very uplifting and you can tell that she loves what she does. Her lectures/lecture videos are amazing and she uses some great memory cues to help you learn/ remember information! use all resources she gives you too.
Took her class this past Fall and was one of my favorite professors. Her videos and lectures are very important but be ready to study a lot on your own time for class material!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hi! Mrs. Hughes is a very awesome professor. If you take this class make sure to just not take any jobs, focus!!
She is the only reason I passed Nursing School so far with student success; she is an AMAZING professor!!!!!!

I feel that when a professor receives high ratings, it may seem like an "easy A," but this class is far from it. If you watch her lectures, read her detailed handouts, and actively participate, you'll grasp the challenging content effectively.
Best professor at UTA

The best professor there were 200 students but she made an effort to know all her students she reached out to all students when they did well to congratulate them and when they did badly to help them. I was so scared of Patho but she was the best professor and teacher I have ever had!
Amazing professor. A professor who genuinely wants the student to succeed. Lectures are always helpful and she is clear about what is needed to know for the exams. GO to lectures!!!
Professor Hughes is a smart, amazing, approachable, knowledgeable, and great communicator,

Prof Hughes is a great teacher. Patho is a heavy course, so you will have to make sure to really study your notes. Study, study, study!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: BEST PROFESSOR I'VE TAKEN!! Professor Hughes is an amazing lecturer and definitely knows what she's talking about. Patho is difficult but she explains the topics well and gives you a lot of resources to study. Watch her lectures before class, take notes and ask questions during class, and then study your notes and her blueprint after. TAKE HER!!!

okay so this is for N4581 student success, not patho. I LOVE HER, SHE IS WHY I PASSED CRITICAL CARE. She is literally so helpful and sweet. The exam reviews are what YOU make it, she will answer questions or just let you rationalize on ur own, whichever. Watch her lectures. Review your exams! she will email u a prep sheet for the next exam if u ask
She was my favorite professor of all time

Loved Professor Hughes! Study a little bit and you will make it! Engaging lectures! Super sweet! She utilizes lots of resources that are provided in canvas such as exam blueprints, case studies, lecture notes etc. I wish she would be my professor for all of nursing school!

Best professor! The information is VERY detailed, but she explains the why and how very clearly. A strong background in A&P will help you a lot! reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This course was one of the hardest I've ever taken, but she taught it in a way that was easy to understand. The course is hard, so attending lectures isn't enough to get the grade you want, but she's an outstanding teacher and person.

All I want to say is THE BEST Prof. ever. Watch her pre-class lecture videos and the notes she provides. You are in very good hands. I wish UTA had a caring prof. like her for other difficult pre-req. classes that count for nursing admission.

This class itself is TOUGH! Use all the resources she provides, attend lectures, ask questions. The tests are very challenging, so prepare a lot for the class! However, Prof. Hughes is caring and reassuring! She teaches with passion, and I love attending her classes! Wouldn't want to take this class with any other professors!

Hughes is THE best prof I've ever had. I would def take her class again if I could. She cares so much about her students and gives you everything you need in order to be successful. She replies to your emails quickly and will help you in anything you need. Just stay on top of your studying by watching her videos & study sheets and you'll be good.

I came into patho very scared due to the fact that everyone says its super hard and because I didnt know my method of studying. She is the best ever. She explained everything so PERFECTLY. This class has a good amount of info but if you stay on track and dont procrastinate I promise you will do fine. Her lecture notes are everything you need

Hughes was literally an amazing professor. Her lectures notes are everything that you need and more to excel in exams. Her recorded lectures were actually really fun to watch and was not boring at all. She explains everything so well. Lots of info though, so make sure you do not procrastinate.

She cares so much about her students and their success. She is one of the most understanding and caring professors I know. She's one of the - if not THE - best professors I've ever had! She clearly cares about her students and is always willing to answer questions. I love Prof. Hughes. I have e-mailed her 10+ times a day and got a response back promptly. She always encourages her students to ask questions and clarifies questions answer. Professor Hughes cares about her students and it shows. She will answer your questions through email and post them just in case other students are also confused on the same topics. She always does and exam review before the exams, and is an excellent instructor. She has pre recorded lectures, so Id youre busy and cant attend class, no problem!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Love Debbie! Such a great class, so much fun, friends and memories collide. Take her!

Best professor I have had!! Her recorded lectures are amazing and so helpful in prepping for exams. She gives you everything in the lectures/RRD you need to know for the exams. Very quick at responding and very encouraging. More instructors should be like her! Take her for patho :)

patho is a rough course in general, but the professor explained everything well. lectures isn't required but it helped me a lot with exams. the professor is sweet & answered all of my questions. textbook not required, lecture notes is basically the exams. time management is important for this class!! do not procrastinate
DONT TAKE HER

This class contains so much information but if you take the lectures day by day and are consistent, you will get a good grade! Follow the lecture notes closely bc that's exactly what will be on the exams. TAKE HER, YOU WON'T REGRET IT!

Hands down the best Prof for Patho. Power points and lecture videos are all you need, no book. The tests are directly from lectures/powerpoints. TAKE HER!!! Responds almost immediately to emails and helps you with anything you are stuck on.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor and I highly recommend her. She gives you all that you need to learn in her notes and her lectures are very easy to listen to! There's definitely a lot of material to cover but if you use all her resources and study a bit everyday, then you will do just fine.

Professor Hughes is the best professor at UTA! You will learn everything you need to know about patho for you nursing career. The lectures are straight forward and simple. The info is pretty easy to memorize, but do not expect to make an A without a little work!
Easy A! Professor Hughes is the best nursing instructor at UTA. Tests off lecture, so no textbook required. You will not regret taking her!

Possibly the best professor I have had the privilege of taking during my entire UTA student career. She explains everything in a way that is so much easier to grasp than a textbook and she tests directly off her lectures. No textbook! You will most likely make an A or a B in this class.
She is the best choice for Patho. If you take her you will do well.

Love her as a teacher! She is funny but she is incredibly organized and fantastic at what she does. Listen to her recordings and the tests are off her lectures only! Most people make an A or B in this class.

Dr. Hughes was absolutely incredible! She outlines the material ahead of time and puts lecture notes online, and then records her lectures and posts those online as well. She gives great examples and really makes the material relatable and understandable. Many concept charts and concept maps are given, which help also!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: What an amazing professor, she makes this class easy and fun. She's always there for her students, always accessible and always reminds you what you need to do in BB and email. Know the material, lectures are straight to the point. She also does a lot of silly stuff during lectures just to help you remember the content. Review a little daily!

Professor Hughes is such an amazing educator. She loves what she does and its evident in the way she teaches. She makes Pathophysiology bearable. Her notes and exams are very straightforward as long as you know the material well. Definitely not a class to slack off in. Study a little bit everyday. She is always there to help if you have questions.

Professor Hughes is an amazing lecturer and she makes the material seem easy. It is a lot of material so get read to read. The book is not necessary, just a tool for extra understanding. Her test are very straight forward. Just listen to her and you will pass!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is an amazing teacher!! Truly cares for all of her students, and will do anything to see them succeed! Love her!! everyone should take her class

My fav professor ever! She is SO helpful & very accessible anytime. She connects material to real life stuff & did silly things that help you remember. 4 exams, 1 compreh final & 5 quizzes, NO rounding. I studied every day & got A's on all the exams but it's alot! of material. Tests are timed & you have to think why the choices don't fit scenario.

She is an amazing teacher - LOTS of material, but she keeps your attention. Tests are every 3 weeks which makes the semester go by quickly - DO NOT GET BEHIND. Gives great feedback if you seek the help! She makes it clear that there are no dumb questions. Recorded lectures, grades (typically) posted within 2 days, and she is available for you!

she may be my favorite professor ever! lectures are in depth and she provides you with all the materials you'll need for her class (so no book) if you miss class no worries she records her lectures along with the powerpoint played in class final is comprehensive 4 other tests and 5 quizzes will make up your grade patho is tough she makes it easy!

She makes me want to come to lecture because she's so energetic and she's very friendly. If you have any question she will answer it to you very politely and maybe add in a joke or two. Sometimes the units contain a lot of information but everything in that class is critical thinking as well. If you want an A just study a little every day.

I had such an amazing semester with Mrs Hughes.  She is down to earth and lectures in a manner to support those who are visual, oral, or kinesthetic learners .  She is patient and willing to help you understand the material so you can excel in the nursing program.   I hope I'll become as good a nurse as she is!

BEST PROFESSOR. Her lectures are very interesting and keep you focused during the 3 hour lecture. Exams are as expected. Study, review the notes and be able to apply critical thinking. Exams are 40 Q's w/  couple bonus. 5 Quizzes. (remember 70 rule) Book is not required.  Definitely would take her again!

She's AMAZING!! She gives 4 exams & a cumulative final. There is a lot of material to cover in this class but she gives you everything you need to succeed in her class. Her lectures are fun and engaging and adds real life scenarios to help out. You won't regret taking her. I highly recommend her!! FYI- the book is not required

She is a great professor. This is not a easy class, you will work for your grade...I was struggling and I went to visit with her and she helped me a lot. I recommend reviewing notes within a few days of listening to her and also listen to the lectures again. Attendance is not mandatory, but must go to learn! Awesome teacher, I would take her again!

Hughes is fabulous! I wish she taught every NURS course I'll have to take. Never used the book,  her lecture  notes were required to print and bring and are very detailed and organized. Just study those. No quizzes, just exams.  Interesting, funny, clear, caring, personable professor. Patho's been my fav class in 3 12 yrs! Favorite professor!
By far the MOST amazing professor... she should teach a class for other professors!

She explained the materials so well that I just studied one night before the exam and still got an A. If you want an A, pay attention in her lecture and take good notes, which is simply filling in the blank. No need to buy textbooks. She is always there to help students. Very funny and makes you believe in yourself. TAKE her!
BEST professor I have ever had. Explains things so well and always there to help. Very encouraging and kind. It is a tough course but I loved it! Definitely take her!!
AMAZING teacher! Most organized class, notes very concise and clear. Tests were straight from the notes--easy and interesting! She will go out of her way to help you too. Recommended!!!

Pathology is a tough course.  No other way around it.  Prof. Hughes is great at breaking things down and providing you with the necessary A&P background (had been a few years since I took A&P, so that was really helpful for me).  Also: incredibly sweet lady.  Had a great semester with her!

She is a phenomenal instructor. Down to Earth, real lady. Crystal clear instructions and expectations. Gives you tools you need to succeed and teaches nearly everything you need to know. She is okay!

reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: MSW Fall 24 - Overall, I thought she was pretty good. She provides feedback and easy to access outside of normal hours. Lots of reading and discussion boards. I took her SOCW 2238 Diverse Populations class. Professor was kind, easy to work with and gave great feedback on assignments. One major assignment that she gives plenty of notice about in the beginning of the semester.

This professor clearly cares about her students! She is very understanding. There are not many assignments, mostly quizzes. lectures are educational. She does not require attendance but going to class has its benefits.

This online class consisted of weekly discussion boards, a quiz, and a ton of reading. The quizzes are short and you will not pass them if you don't have the books. There was zero professor participation in this class so basically you are spending a ton of money to read a book. There is no lecture or any real insight provided on the topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Definitely not one of my favorites.  I took her online and she gives ALOT of work  and quizzes. Some of the assignments were interesting, so she does try. The midterm I found to be very difficult and the final was easy.  One easy paper which I actually enjoyed doing.  I made a B and did everything I was supposed to do.  You need the book.
Do not take her online Diversity class.  She is incommunicado.

Online course is demanding. Professor takes a long time to respond to any emails. Doesn't post grades until the end, so you don't know how your doing. Every week there are three or more assignments due and lots of reading. She might be great in class but online you are on your own.
This teacher was VERY knowledgable. She just finished her PhD and uses all sorts of new teaching methods. she tries to make the class FUN but educational. loves class participation. I recommend her!

Very enthusiastic, knowledgeable and fair. Promoted class discussions, used creative teaching techniques and used material from lots of other sources than just the text. Dr. M. makes good use of WebCT. Definitely would take her for another class!

New professor and she is absolutely great! I learend so much in her Diverse Populations class. I wish she could teach all of my classes, she is by far one of the best professors at UTA. I hope to she her teach mroe subjects int he future. Take her, you can't go wrong! She is very knowledgable!

She was very nice don't get me wrong, but kind of clueless at times. I would leave every lecture a little confused, but would end up figuring out how to do my papers on my own and hope for the best. Her conferences do help on what to fix for your final draft, but she does take a while to grade assignments.

Professor Dickerson is amazing! She shows what exactly you need for each paper and make sure to sign up for conferences. The conferences helped out a bunch and she gives you notes on what to add or revise in your essay before the final submission. Very very understanding and will help you no matter what. I recommend sending messages through Canvas
She is a very nice professor, and she always tries to help you to understand the class, and pass.
Very nice professor, she helps you to understand and give you the feedback to write a quality essay, to pass the class.
Prof Dickerson was a good teacher. Just stay on top of you essays and the class is fun.

I think this is Professor Dickerson's first semester at UTA, and I think she did a great job! The rubric and expectations for assignments for papers were always really clear. She is super warm and caring and a great person! I only gave a 4/5 because sometimes she takes a while to grade papers and assignments, which can be a little stressful.

Professor Pryor is a solid instructor. The video complemented the reading (text and supplemental). Regarding Canvas, she is technology savvy and expects her students to be as well. Be sure to read her comments she provides on your completed assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Pryor is SO SWEET! This class sounds intimidating, but it really isn't. There are many small activities that make up your grade, and they're all easy. Opt for midterm & final tests; the material comes from all the chapter quizzes, very easy. This is a great class for introducing meaty content without high stakes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class is assignment heavy but easy. Discussions have no word count, and a lot of easy online activities. It's a lot at first but her routine is very consistent every week. Discussion board and short quiz with a mini activity. You can choose between and paper or midterm. Do midterm, it's everything you've learned through online activities.

She gives lots of options for assignments and has interactive assignments which I love. It was a hard class but it is about the brain, which is a tough subject. She gives good directions and is very sweet. Easy grader. There is quizzes and tests.

It was a straightforward class, the instructions for her assignments were clear, and she provided a lot of info on how to complete them. She also adds examples of how your work should look. Class consisted of 4 small assignments based on readings and a final exam. As long as you do the 4 assignments, the final shouldn't hurt your grade too much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was nice, but I had some issues with her. Expect strict grading, tests were easy, and be prepared to explore the campus. Overall, all not bad, but I wish she would be the slightest bit more considerate.

I took her over the wintermester and there were only 4 assignments during the whole period. Honestly, she's very rude and unprofessional, which makes the experience frustrating. The class isn't difficult, but she overcomplicates things unnecessarily. Just make sure to follow her assignment descriptions closely, and you should do fine.

She has such vague instructions for her course work material that it took me a solid 2 hours to start my work. I kept second guessing myself and when I attempt to email her, it takes a hot minute for her to respond.

Professor Donaldson is hilarious and will teach you everything you need to know about the school plus the processes you need to take in architecture. She had us draw for participation and had all sorts of guests for each major to learn from. I wish this class was longer than an hour.
Laid out clear boundaries/ expectations on the first day, as long as you follow them you're good. Lectures can be entertaining. Assignments are easy, show up to class for participation credit.

I took this class during the winter break. Really good class, but your grade is only dependent on two quizzes and a final and you only have about a few days to prepare for each quiz so beware. If you are good at teaching yourself and studying, then you will be fine. She only posts the readings during the winter semester, unlike the full semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's super funny and cares about students. Our class was supposed to be in person but we did online just because everyone wanted it. Everything is basically a completion grade (just put effort). Lecture information was very useful. 1 participation assignment every class (super easy) and 6 other assignments that you have to write for but are easy.

She is a very fun and entertaining person. She was very informational about the CAPPA program and what our future years in architecture will look like. There are a few assignments, but they are very easy. The class mainly depended on participation through iClicker which I recommend the app version not the remote.

She is super caring and tries to make class fun and upbeat. I had her for University Class and the class itself was pointless but it was required. I would for sure recommend her. She relates to us very well.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Took in mini semester. Great class. 2 Quizes & a final exam. Each quiz 20 questions timed at 15 mins. Final 40 questions timed at 30 mins. Study pictures and you will do awesome. Easy A

This class is pointless. She makes you buy those clicker things which are like $50 so try to rent one for cheaper if possible. Attendance is 15% of the grade. Assignments are easy just annoying. Cheryl is nice and funny, the class is just annoying.

Instructor Cheryl Donaldson, was okay and I really believe she has a good heart when it comes down to her on- line class.   Here are some things I did not like about her on-line class.  Everything is done on a TIMER because she thinks that her student might CHEAT on the quizzes or exam so if you like deadlines and race against the clock this is it
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Never skip the discussions. You will pass just by posting them. Easy A class.

Mrs. Donaldson is a great instructor and advisor. As long as you do your discussion board assignments you will make an A.  Quizzes are easy.  I truly enjoyed taking her class and would take her again. She is clear with her expectation. As long as you post your discussion board postings on time you should be making A.
Do not miss the discussions as they count for the majority of the grade.

She's is super funny and enjoyable to listen to. She does drag out classes longer than necessary for the people who are slow. The class I took was pass or fail. You just have to do the assignments, which are not difficult at all.
Made you buy a clicker to sign into the class... 50 dollars for something a piece of paper could do

She's GREAT!! She's fun, nice and, as the best advisor ever should be, mainly concerned with you passing. You seriously have to not care to fail this class. You WILL learn a lot about the UTA and Architecture at UTA as well as a profession. Stuff you won't get in other classes.
good professor, interesting material

The material is hard and she doesn't make it easier by skipping chunks of it in lecture, she expects you to learn a lot of material on your own time. However, there are 6 quizzes that count alot towards grade and theyre pretty easy with 2 attempts allowed. Surprised I passed but I think its bc she curved our final grade which is very appreciated.

Pretty mediocre professor. Her quizzes were all lockdown browser & she skips big chunks of lecture material. But, she responds to emails very fast outside of class, includes 10 built in bonus points on exams (besides the final), and allows you to miss 3 lectures before deducting attendance points. I believe there is also a curve on the final grade.

She is not a bad professor. She is very knowledgeable in her field and can answer any question you have. She also is very adamant on using out of class resources such as her office hours or TAs (USE!). BUT she expects you to learn a lot of the material on your own. Large sections or even entire chapters were skipped and to be learned at home.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is tremendously passionate, and her test is straight forward. Be ready to use your book because I believe it's more helpful than her lecture ;)))). NO HOMEWORKS, YAYY!! BUT have quizzes with lockdown browser, which for each you have 2 attempts, and it's not that easy :DD. some of the test questions are from her note too, SKIM through it.

She cares about her students and encourages you to come to her office hours to her material. It's a hard and test-heavy course, but she gives you all the resources to succeed. She uploads notes, practice questions, and quizzes to help you prep. She even gave us extra points on our final and extra credit which increased our final grade by 3%!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Her grading system isn't helpful to students. There are 6 quizzes, 3 midterms and 1 final and that's all you're graded on. No curves or extra credit to help students out. Zooms through the lectures without properly teaching the concepts. With OChem already being hard, she doesn't try to help students like the other professors do.

The first half of the semester wasn't too bad, but after that? Go over your notes again after class or you'll be 100% lost. She goes so fast over so many complex, multifaceted things, you're MUCH too busy trying to write it all down to really understand/remember anything. You'll need to go back over the lecture recordings regularly, guaranteed.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you can take anyone else then take anyone else. She barely gives us resources and in lecture, she zooms past many information instead of actually explaining it properly. She gives us quizzes which are lockdown browser. You are only graded on the 3 midterm exams, one final exam and those quizzes. Attendance is 5% of your grade and no extra credit

professor he dong is by far the best professor i have had at uta, she gives a clear criteria on what she wants from students. she has 3 exams and a final. if you want to pass with a good grade. make sure to utilize the resources she gives you, rogers problems r a must, do those not once or twice but over and over until it sticks. great curves!

Let me first say that this was my first organic chemistry class and my expectations were not high. The final looked nothing like her initial tests and the quizzes. Our mean for the second exam was a 55 and her solution was to give extra credit points to ONLY those who had less than 2 absences.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Dong was an amazing professor! This class is very content heavy so make sure you start studying early since the topics is based on previous chapters. She gave out a few quizzes over the most of the material.  She is helpful during office hours and she uses Dr. Rogers lecture notes and practice problems which helps a lot with the midterms.

Dr. Dong was absolutely amazing. Ochem is a VERY challenging course and she did everything she could to help us succeed. She would always tell us what is going to be on the test and would take questions from quizzes and lecture notes and put those on the exam. She never tries to trick you on her exams, just wants to ensure you know the information.

I found it helpful that she uses fill in the blank notes during lecture that follows the textbook. She tries to make the material easier to understand and provides practice problems to help study for the exams. She does not give homework but there are a few online quizzes throughout the semester. She does go pretty fast during lectures though.

The fill-in-the-blank notes, practice questions, and practice problem-solving sessions from Dr. Dong were very helpful. Homework was not assigned which saved time to prioritize what needed to be studied most. Dr. Dong replies to emails very quickly and is always available during office hours. She's truly a professor that is there for her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is very nice and I think she is an alright professor, just somehow the way she taught the course didn't click with me. Although it should be noted ochem is typically a hard class overall no matter the professor, it made it a bit harder that she finished the last chapter right before the final not leaving much time to prepare.
Dr. Dong is a fine professor, she gives a lot of homework and of course you have to pay attention in lecture and study to do well in exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Difficult to understand expectations for exams. After she stopped doing as many practice problems during her lectures and imploring us to review some sections and most practice on our own time, I reverted to following the textbook. It was a struggle to go through the class with her hasty form of teaching.

There was NO CURVE. Professor's emails were one worded and unclear. When we took tests online, we couldn't go back to the questions because it would be locked after answered. Her grading system was so ridiculous, she claims it helps us but it was probably worse than before when we took it face-to-face. If you have to take online with her, don't.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader
