reviews.comment: He Dong is a good choice for taking OChem. She has a slight accent but it won't really affect your understanding. Notes are fill-in-the-blank style. She goes over examples and tries to help us understand. Definitely attend class or at least use Echo to understand the material. Uses WileyPlus for hw. Exams are straightforward enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: While the professor is very lax in attendance, please attend class it will truly help you down the road. Make sure to habitually check Wiley so that you don't miss homework due dates. Her lectures are very smooth and easy to follow and have many examples that she works through.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Has a work-along with you approach of teaching. Works problems with you to see how to do them. 3 exams, 1 final, and Wiley homework for each chapter. Echo's are available. Find reviews from test banks on campus and use them, she provides a list of concepts type of review. Textbook problems will help you significantly for homework and tests.
Very helpful professor. Def would recommend over some others
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Shes nice and very willing to help
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I've taken two classes with him and wish I could take more. He's amazing. His feedback is clear and helps connect the work to real-world practice. He's one of my favorite professors at UTA. The only issue is he's hard to reach, but when he replies his answers are detailed and very helpful. I definitely recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The feedback that the professor gave was handwritten and was unreadable. He had poor communication and made the class more difficult than it needed to be. Would recommend taking a different professor if possible.

Dr. Schuman is great; this was a ROUGH course to take over the summer due to the amount of reading and learning though. Grading was done in such a timely manner, although I do wish he had marked the rubric because my lowest grade, it wasn't clear what he marked off for. I still made an A+, so just do all the work and stay on top of assignments!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He does not answer many questions, and did not work with me like other professors did, but he was still an awesome prof. If I needed something answered I did have to message multiple times in order to get a answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor!

Professor Schuman is an absolute kind professor. If you simply communicate if you are struggling, he will understand. He goes out of his way to make sure we are understanding what to do, especially for online courses. The syllabus is pretty clear and straightforward. Weekly quizzes and discussion boards but not hard at all. I enjoyed the course!

This professor added on an additional paper during the week of thanksgiving break that was due two days after we got back from break. He is very rude to students via email, and overall hard to contact. I do feel like he just adds unnecessary work and assignments for no reason. Keep in mind that all the quizzes are the copy and paste for the final.

He is nearly impossible to reach. Even with prior notice, life emergencies do not earn any grace. He copy/pastes feedback on multiple students. He also doesn't give feedback on recorded skill videos. He only gives feedback on self critiques. Self critiques are useless without knowing if we did an assessment correctly. Would not recommend!!!
Great proffesor who cares about his students. He is not hard to get ahold of and I just loved his class. TAKE HIS CLASS!!!

Took him for intro to substance abuse and was scared on the first week because there was so much to do but after I started doing assignments and quiz I realized everything was easy. You will have 11 quizzes, 4 discussion boards, a final, book report and 4 reaction posts. He is very organized and responds quick. Easy A if you do the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Schuman is one of the best professors I have ever had. He allows us to take quizzes as many times as we want for as long as the module is open. The reaction papers are only one page double spaced and it is based on how you feel about the class. Discussions are quite easy as long as you do a little research (you can use google).

His quizzes are grossly inaccurate and his policy requires you, the student, to submit evidence of such in order to receive credit. Generally speaking, the course is easy. You'll really enjoy it if you want to go into law and have to argue your case for a fair and accurate grade.
Must stay on top of your work but he is available to help if you reach out.
there is a lot of work and a big paper at the end but overall great class
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Schuman is the kind of professor I will look back on and credit for success in my LCDC and Social Work career because he is is an invaluable source of information and he cares about his students. Yes there is a time commitment to the course but its also a junior level course. Your grade and success is a direct reflection of your effort.

Professor Schuman is the kind of professor who, if you absorb his teaching and input, will be a key player in helping to shape you into a successful LCDC after you complete the program. He grades very fairly, offers a chance to make up missed assignments for partial credit, and gives you every opportunity for success in his class.
He was.. ok.. very passive aggressive but other than thats hes ok. Wouldnt take him again though.

Online course, no book required, assigns weekly reading articles. Quizzes/tests were not over the reading material but easily google-able/found on quizzlet. There is one major book report assignment at the end which seemed hard but he changed the requirements due to pandemic and made it really easy. Easy A, super nice and understanding.

I do not recommend taking this professor for intro to micro. He is not helpful, assignments do not lend themselves to learning, there is no class material, just reading the textbook. This class is not getting me ready for field practice. I have zero understanding of micro practice after taking this course. Do not enroll in a class he is teaching.

He was very laid back and was willing to answer any questions you had. He would also take charge if your field instructor wasn't working with you. He even let some of us not have to write the paper for the end of the semester presentation! I would take him again next semester for field II if i was able to pick my liaison.

He only gives one "test" and it's pretty much just explaining how you think you met the course objectives for the class. He's a super nice guy and he will definitely answer any questions that you have. The assignments weren't hard and I honestly only opened my textbooks like twice the whole semester.

This was his first semester teaching at UTA.  While he is very knowledgable about addictions, he was all over the place in his teaching methods. I hope that he will improve how he runs the class because he has such a vast knowledge to share.  Be sure when you present to think back to your speech class, he grades you on everything.
He is fair but tough teacher.  Dr. Schuman teaches the class based on his experience in the Social Work field.
Grades presentations like it's a speech class; not on the material presented.

One of the best Professors I had. Lectures are extremely detailed and well explained. The weekly OLQs get progressively more difficult and so do the coding assignments. It will feel draining but at the end you will learn things worth more than the money you put in. She uploads the lecture recording. Review those before the OLQ and ATTEND CLASS.

If you procrastinate, this is the professor for you. I took her for both 1310 and 1320 and I would take her again if I could. Her teaching style is tough, but also gives you great feedback if you ask. With every quiz or test, she uses lockdown browser so it forces you to study. STUDY and PRACTICE your coding is my best advice for her class.

Attendance was optional but 10% of a weekly quizzes grade comes from in class paper worksheets. Weekly lockdown browser cumulative quizzes weren't bad. Lecture gives you everything you need for them and the coding assignments. 55% of grade comes from the weekly quizzes. She teaches the material extremely well and is available via email, ASK Q's!
Please just do your work, this class was great. Also, go to class you will not pass if you do not attend the lectures in person if possible

Had a quiz every week. There are also in-class assignments that effects your quiz grade the next week. I missed every other Friday due to work and still managed an A. She does record her lectures and posts them after the week is over. If you contact her in advance, she'll work with you within reasonable means.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lol prof. Easy a friends
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: In simple terms - if you want to learn, professor Donna is the best. She will make you work hard throughout the semester with coding OLQs (online quizzes), coding assignments, homework, benchmarks, crash quizzes and the Finals. She is a tough grader but the grading criteria is clearly explained and very specific. Follow the rubric and you're good.

This is my favorite professor at UTA. Any class you take with her will be the one you LEARN the most in. She makes topics easy to understand as you can tell that she is a dedicated professor. Take her you will not regret it! I'd say any reviews that don't like her are more her jokingly sassy personality rather than her teaching.

If I had all the classes she teaches, it would be such a blessing for my GPA. She made one of the toughest classes so much fun. There is some in-class activity that visually helps you understand the coding mechanism. Her fun approach to teaching makes me feel way more passionate about coding. You will not regret taking her

she's great!! i came into this class with barely any knowledge and was able to learn a lot from her. lectures are amazing, she explains everything very well and makes it easy to understand. lots of work though.. but its not too hard if you just pay attention in lecture and review the slides. she's kinda hard to approach but still a 10/10. take her!

pretty simple for an intro class especially if you're familiar with programming. professor sometimes had a bad attitude and wasn't approachable, most of the time I just assumed she was having a bad day though. LOTS of in class quizzes and assignments, also good amount of out of class assignments. tough grader for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Piss easy class, but the professor is so annoying. She does way too much for an intro class and act like a typical CS person—a literal Karen. Keep in mind, I have a 100.

I have heard from any upperclassmen that she is a good teacher, but I do not think that is true. Often times, she expects the class to understand everything and catch every little word she says despite going through lectures so quickly that nobody can even keep up. She also gives daily participation and at times gives up 30 seconds per question
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She has the worst attitude I have ever seen, she cares more about us cheating rather than actually trying to help us. She thinks we are all already masters at coding and she is a very very mean person which is surprising because of the way she acts and her appearance. Don't take her, she thinks she knows everything when she is just a grump old lady
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Had her before for three of the introductory CS classes. Specifically for 3318, I only recommend French compared to Stefan and Weems. Her assignments are NOT hard, but her attitude in lecture is unprofessional with the comments she makes towards students. Grading criteria is NOT clear at all for Coding Assignments. Responds to emails fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There were a few topics where she had to pause & try to understand what she is teaching. After spring break she got more irritated from students not understanding topics. The online quizzes were ok until we started learning more complex topics. Grading wasn't 100% clear which lead to confusion since we would solve correctly but not enter it her way
Her attitude is extremely poor, and it's best to avoid her. Her grading policy is very strict, and she always seems to be in a bad mood. Honestly, she is the worst professor I've ever had at UTA.

I was excited to take her, because of the good reviews. She went slow in the beginning then started going fast heading into spring break. Stopped responding to my messages and was very rude and condescending towards the end. The atmosphere felt like she was more worried about preventing cheating vs actually helping students learn the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Teaches very well but there were negatives. The weekly quizzes (50% of grade) although not difficult were overwhelming because you never had a break from this class. Attendance is mandatory but only for the "pop quizzes" which went to 5% of each weekly quiz. Helpful in office hours and responsive to emails but does not have the best attitude.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Good at what she does, but has a terrible attitude. She can be condescending with students and often belittled students for asking questions. VERY quiz heavy, gives pop quizzes if class is empty, and gives an automatic 0 if your code has any compile issues. Easy class overall, but her grading style, attitude, and pettiness make the class difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: i believe that she is great for visual learners. however, she kind of expects you to understand the material on the first go so expect some "pop quizzes". she had a poor attitude majority of the time, made it hard to approach her.. even in email. even though material is hard to understand sometimes, i was glad she posted her lectures online.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: not a big fan of some teaching methods and grading. assignments at the end of class based on the lecture that you must complete from memory, basically pop quizzes, which can be frustrating if you dont understand the material the first time. graded VERY strictly, the smallest mistakes will cost you lots of points. typos dropped my grade by a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Not test heavy but quiz heavy. 60 percent of the class is quizzes. Very nice professor and makes the class easy. If you ever have the option to choose Donna French for any class make sure you do it.

Nothing new. If you have taken her before you know what to expect. Her OLQ being her major grades and the rest are just extra credit. If you can pass her OLQ every week, you can literally skip all of her coding homework. Would definitely take her for summer classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very easy-to-follow class structure and lectures. There are weekly online quizzes which count for 70% of the grade. The HW and Crash Course is basically free points. And if you submit your Coding Assignments on time, it's an easy A tbh. If you're taking a class for the grade over actually learning properly, this is 100% the best choice.

Her lectures are excellent and really help you understand the class material. She can be a bit strict on her coding assignments, the other out of class work she assigns us can be very excessive, and I feel like she taught at a very slow place, but overall, shes a great teacher.

I took her for 1320 and 1325, and she is amazing for both. Weekly quizzes are not easy, but the study guide tells you what to review so you're prepared. 5% of weekly quizzes are from class participation. Labs for 1325 are easier than 1320. French goes slow enough that those who know nothing about OOP have time to grasp the concepts. 100% take her.

Prof French is an amazing teacher, the way she teaches code just sticks in your brain. Her style of grading is clearly defined with big emphasis on the quizzes. Coding Assignments are insanely hard, but they're supposed to be challenging and worth only 10% of your grade. If you aim high on your early quizzes, you should be able to land an A.

There are weekly quizzes, which contain a lot of repeated types of questions so it's not that difficult. To be honest, I attended one lecture the whole semester and managed to get an A, using the recorded lectures and slides. Very clear questions and answer formats. She uploads a review doc for every quiz, so it's easy to be prepared. Good luck!

Prof. French gives entertaining, well-structured, informative lectures that teach you a lot. My only complaint is that the grades for coding assignments are too low for the amount and quality of work given, but they're only 10% of your grade. The short weekly online quizzes on lockdown browser are in-depth, but you can do well if you study.
WORST PROFESSOR EVER. I REPEAT SHE IS THE ABSOLUTE WORST. I CHANGED MY MAJOR BECAUSE OF HER. Very homophobic and racist.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Everyone says she's the best professor because she teaches a certain way to code and once you understand that you can get good grades only in her class but in reality, you cannot use other ways to code because she will give you a zero. Extremely arrogant professor and highly racist. Very mean to international students. No extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Don't get me wrong, Donna French is a great teacher, but her excessive work can be a lot. I felt like I was always trying my best, but she made something due almost every other day. She would be an even better professor if she gave examples with full-on code; rather than little snippets to understand the whole picture and connect the dots better.

There are very few professors in my degree that have yet to really wow me, Donna French is one of them. She gave clear, concise, and informative lectures with projects that came directly from the slides while still expanding your knowledge of the course. If I were to give any advice, it is to stay on top of the projects and code for ONLY yourself!

This professor is better to be working as a programmer in some corporate office rather than teaching students. She doesn't know how to teach. Very bad at teaching, not able to explain clearly programming techniques. Material provided by her doesn't make any sense. Worse teacher, hard to understand.
Awesome

She is one of the best professors at UTA, quickly responds to messages. If we go to her office, she explains further in detail. And you can easily grasp the important concepts even without paying 100% attention. You do not find professors like her often. The exams are quite good if we follow her lectures regularly.

Literally the best professor ever. She is great at teaching and grading. She actually enjoys teaching, you can tell! She is very kind towards students and will usually be willing to drop tests/ reopen assignments.
not good

French was such a great professor. Her teaching style consists of power points and demonstrating code which makes it easier to understand and organized. Took her for 1310 and now taking her for 1320. Most of your grade is based on quizzes and coding assignments that make you think but if you paid attention in class is not hard.

Great professor, by far one of the best classes I have had especially when it comes to being online. Majority of your grade is based on quizzes, with the rest being coding assignments and homework. Homework is never hard, and the coding assignments really get you thinking, but don't usually take too long. Pay attention and this class is an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Wow I loved this prof. I took Tiernan last semester and had to retake bc I left that class with no understanding. French goes more in depth and organizes lectures into powerpoints that you can access on Canvas. Homework and coding assignments are not hard, not long, and actually relate to what you learn in class. A very caring and funny prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor French's class was very nice - she genuinely cared about us learning to program, and was very helpful in ensuring that we had every tool we needed to succeed going forward in computer science. The "no stupid questions" policy could fade at times - she could sometimes be a bit harsh on questions - but overall, great professor.

Donna French is amazing I took her for 1310 1320 and 2320 which is no 3310 I believe. Don't take algorithm with any of the other horrible uta professors such as seems or Stefan take it with French. You will learn alot more in the class and will get a better grade.

Took her for 1320 and 1325, the best cse professor in UTA. Highly recommend taking her, as her programming experience, lecture, and her assignments make you a better programmer. She's always threre to help, and she also prepares you very well for all the tests you will take. Attend all lectures.

Honestly probably the best professor you can take for any lower level CSE class if you would like to learn. Her coding assignments are pretty difficult but she is very accessible outside of class in her office hours and if needed she stays over her usual office hours. Very caring professor I wish I could take her for 1325 or other CSE classes.

Great professor. If you really want to learn, take her. Her coding assignments might be challenging but she always explains how it should be done and warns about errors not to make. Her lecture slides are very helpful to understand concepts especially when you attend lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor who really wants you to learn. She is always there for you when you need it, but she will make you work for it. Programming should be about you working hard anyways and learning how things work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I think overall Mrs. French is a good teacher, but much improvement is needed when it comes to the structure of her lessons. Compared to other teachers, Mrs. French does not give enough examples for concepts. She made up for this by giving extra chances for grades. The grading of coding assignments was horrible though. Too much room for error.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I wasn't too confident heading into 1320 from 1310 however she helped ALOT. Her professional programming experience, plenty of hw, quizzes, and coding assignments all you become a better programmer beyond just school requirements. Attend all lectures as she provides extra credits to boost your grade. She is one of the best professor at UTA.

Gives a lot of homework but if you pay attention in class you'll be fine completing most of the homework. She post all her presentations and if you have any questions you can just ask her after class or e-mail her. She stresses understanding the theoretical side of coding to help for future CSE classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She gives a lot of homework but its super easy and actually relates to what your learning. Her coding assignments are fairly easy and if you have trouble you can always ask her about it. She has great notes and is easily accessible outside of class. No textbook needed. Reviews are very close to the exam. Quizzes every week but again, easy.

Fantastic Professor very caring and thoughtfull as well as knowledgeable about programing and the programing industry. She comes from a radio shack programing background and provides some very key insight on the real world of programing. Enjoyed her class and appreciate all that she taught me. SHE IS AWESOME!
Just awesome.
She is really caring, quick respond to emails, very helpful. I would love to take 1325 with her but class was already full.

She is the best professor I have come across during my time at UTA. She is so helpful and understanding. She cares about her students so much that she promptly replies to all emails even at 1 am. Exams are super easy. Codes are kinda long but she gives more than enough time to complete them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is the best professor I have ever taken in my career. If you really want to learn just visit her during office hours. She is very responsive to emails as well. You can clear your queries through emails.
Great Professor, learned a ton, i wish more lecturers taught like Donna!

She is an easy A professor however I don't recommend her if you really wanna master C and be a good programmer cause I found her class more theoretical than practical since there were more of true or false & fill in the blanks questions than writing codes. Tests are pretty easy and they all come from homework with answers posted on bb before exam.

She was teaching my semester for the first time but she did a great job at it. She's really kind and friendly. Pay attention in class, do the homework and coding Assignments and you will get an A. If it were to me, I would take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I would like to mention how caring she is. We had a coding assignment extended by 3 weeks because students were having difficulty on it. If students do bad on a test she provides us with an opportunity to gain extra credit by taking a shorter version of the test. I would retake 10/10.

Her first semester ever as a professor, and she's great. Her lectures are almost in layman's terms, gives basically free quiz grades, homeworks are long but still take only <30 minutes, and tests are based almost solely on homework/lecture slides. I'd take her again anytime I had the opportunity.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: New professor but very good. Her lectures have taught me ALOT. Homework is very do-able, can be long but they are all from her lecture notes or from the textbook. Coding assignments are also very do-able, they start off easy and get progressively harder as the class goes by (obvi). Total recommend her. One month of class left, my grade so far A+
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I missed an A by 0.42% but the reviews scared me initially. I didn't expect exams in a theory class, but I passed every one by simply following the blueprint. Follow her rubric exactly and you will do great on the papers/discussion boards. She makes it quite plain, students make it complicated by wanting to “razzle dazzle”
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Bacchus is an interesting professor. A genuine, good natured individual that cares about the success of her students. Pace of the course was not too fast, nor too slow. However, the confines of her grading criteria got a bit blurred and confusing, almost as if she deviated from the rubric and trekked a personal vendetta with a vengeance.

This lady is awful. Tests are multiple choice questions that are confusing and poorly written. Her tone is condescending and uppity, even in writing. Grading is overrated and overinflated. Textbook is a pamphlet written in simple terms, but the class is made up to be hard and over-important. The academic coach cares more about APA than content.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Way too much work for a 3 unit class even at Master's level. Spent over 40hrs a week and still messed up my 4.0. Doesn't provide the tools to be successful in the class. The tests are seriously complex and proctored. You'd have to memorize the entire book to do well on the test. The test blueprint is poorly focused and useless.

Quizzes weren't proof-read & full of grammatical errors. First quiz wasn't posted on Canvas. Emailed the coach & she gave the wrong answer concerning quiz 1. I missed the first quiz due to poor communication from the coach. Dr. Bacchus was unsympathetic, gave a 0, & spoke down to me. More concerned with APA format than being a true teacher.
Shes horrible, steer clear. Her grading is ridiculous. Shes extremely rude as well. Taking her class makes me think twice about going to this school.

Extremely vague in what she wants, but when you ask her questions she gives you a general response and directs you to the rubric. A big indicator that a professor isnt good is when most of the class is getting 60s and still not even sure what they are doing wrong. I strongly advise to choose a different professor if you want to keep your GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Anytime one asked her a question, she would passively aggressively ask if they attempted to even read the syllabus/assignment/rubric. Unfortunately had to take this awful class as a pre-req. Her grading style was very inconsistent, and she always talked in pseudo intellectual jargon. The teachers pets attended the ZOOMs, but dont waste your time.
Do not take her! Hard grader, no leeway even if she messsz up on a grade, not helpful and really doesn't make an effort to help students pass. She doesn't care for her students. Do not take her!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: She is extremely rude and unhelpful. She belittles the student when the ask for help making them feel as if the are stupid for not understanding. She has a strong accent and mispronounces words constantly. Records quiz grades incorrectly. Passive aggressively answer emailed question in mass communication boards. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!

She is not very helpful, rude and is really trying hard to act like shes helping but she's not. I have never been treated this way by any other professor! Please don't take this class if you want to don't want to be stressed!
Bacchus lets you know exactly what she wants. A lot of students don't follow directions which hurts them. If you follow directions and give her what she wants, then  you should do well.

This class definetly is one of the easiest classess i have ever taken. If you pay attention and study for the quizzes , you can ace this class. the professor is boring and her lectures are long. the only not boring part was when the teacher assistant teaches. There is a project that is time consuming and my advice is to start early.

She is not that bad like people make her seem. She can be rude sometimes and likes stuff done specifically how she wants it. Easy class so take her. Your in a group throughout the semester and that really helps because you meet new people. our pal was helpful. She gives odd breaks too. She really liked our class so she was nice.

She is rude and unhelpful.  This is unfortunate bc she is a nurse practitioner with a PhD.  She should be an excellent person to learn from, but she's just unpleasant to be around.  Class is easy, but her attitude stinks.  I wonder why a nurse as educated as she is would be teaching intro to nursing, less $$ ya know?  Maybe coz no one likes her.

Bacchus is the most strict/judgmental professor I've ever had. If you want to be treated like a kindergartner then take her. She will be rude and call you out when you have your phone out during her 3 hour class. She is rude and talks down to students who actually have a brain. I don't suggest her to anyone. The class is easy she makes it hard.

For someone who needs clear guidelines and enjoys ridged structure Donna is really good. She is very consistent in her ways and has clear rules, but if you are a creative minded or freedom seeking person, or like to ask questions this is going to be a very challenging class for you. If you can't follow rules TO A T, you will struggle through.

Take this class. Yea, it is a long class but this class actually helps you with your new university environment. The quizzes are super easy, just pay attention to the lecture and take notes. Don't buy the books, you will not use them. The class will meet once a week, and you get homework every week except the portfolio (major assignment) day.

If you can avoid taking this teacher, do it. But the class itself is easy, blow off class, just this teacher takes the class too seriously, don't have your phone out, it's a three hour long class, but when she let us out halfway through for breaks, I'd always leave. I just went to turn in my homework and projects

I personally liked her but she can be very judgemental and passive agressive, and her attitude will make you absolutely hate the class. The class is 3 hours long, and the lectures can be incredibly boring. She HATES cell phones and will call you out if she sees yours out. It's an easy class, just don't make her alone change your mind about nursing!

I don't even know where to begin. She's very judgmental and passive-aggressive. This class is extremely easy, as it is really just a self-development course, but that doesn't change the fact that your grades may suffer based upon what she thinks of you as  a person. Absolutely would not recommend.

This professor literally made me consider choosing a different University to attend. She grades you based on how she liked your personality in class, not on the work you do. She told me in her office "I don't talk enough" and my grades suffered b/c of my "personality". She chooses who she thinks should be a nurse and gives all others a bad grade.
I took her class & I loved her! I miss her so much! She pinned me at the nursing pinning ceremony :) Yes, she is strict but it is all worth it at the end.

She takes nursing serious. This is a weed out class for the people who believe that nurses help doctors. Six students changed majors. Easy course if you do the work, but very easy to fail. Attendance is mandatory and it is your responsibility to look on blackboard for homework assignments. It is the same for all 1300 classes no matter who you take

You'll get an A either way, but she is the worst teacher ever. she will literally tell you off and not listen to you at all. she give you breaks but there like 7 minutes and thats what she tells you to take. The only good thing about her class is that I had a good PAL. Don't take her if you have a choice

Even though it's an easy A, she has a very poor attitude. I tried to email her for help and she gave me a smart a#% answer. She treats the class like its high school and HATES when you text in class. If I have an answer to a class discussion and she doesnt like it, she indirectly lets you know your answer is "dumb". I DREAD going to her class.

EVIL TEACHER. ALWAYS IN A BAD MOOD.. FULL OF ATTITUDE. Easy A, but you'll HATE attending her class. Lessons = BORING, and she makes you not want to be a nurse. PLEASE do not let her sour personality keep you from entering the beautiful profession of nursing. Bring food, class is three hours straight.

She was a horrible teacher. She had a big attitude. Her lessons where never postive but always saying that "if you do this... your going to jail", she dosent trust her students and you must come to class to get all assignments, because there is one every week. You cannont bring your laptop. Bring food, its a 3 hour class and its long and boring.

Professor Pirkle is an excellent instructor. She's kind, supportive, and gives clear, helpful feedback. She creates a comfortable environment that builds confidence and makes public speaking feel achievable. Her class is meaningful, engaging, and truly prepares you for the future and applies to the career path you're wanting to go in.

Donna is a very nice lady she love what she does. Since this was 1301 she didn't do too much and understood that not all of us wanted to take the class and made it fun and easy. There are in class assignments with a group and 2 major speech and lots of quick discussion homework

If there is one professor who made the classroom a safe haven for students of all kinds- it's her. From the very first day, she welcomed the students with an open arm, and she truly cared for every. Single. One. Of. Us. 
I'm not sure what else you need from a professor. She is an angel sent from the universe.

I 1000% recommend Ms. Pirkle for this course. She focuses on improvement rather than whether you meet the rubric or not. She is also open to communicate, is very understanding of personal matters, and you can tell she is passionate about teaching this. She is a slow grader, but it is *very* hard to get a bad grade, so you shouldn't stress about it.
Love love love her!!! She is so sweet and caring to all her students. She really wants you to try your best and gives good feedback on your speeches. Would def take her again!!!!!!

So incredibly nice. 2 speeches for the semester and an exam for each but she gives you a quizlet. It's so chill and felt like everyone was friends. She understands this is entry-level so she doesn't grade hard at all, and doesn't expect much either; lots of slack given on mistakes, swaying, etc. Met great people and loved hearing everyone's topics.

I was very satisfied with this course. The professor was engaging and knowledgeable. Giving speeches improved my public speaking skills. Overall an enjoyable course that enhanced my communication abilities. Highly recommend for the communication requirement.

prof. Pirkle is such an amazing lady that care about all her students, she understand that her class is just a mandatory class and does not make it hard for anyone, if you need to take COMS go with her

This class was pretty easy! We had no test or exams. Most of our grades came from short papers or presentations. Donna is a sweet professor! she cares a lot about her students and likes to get to know her students. we do not use a book and we do not have any reading to do. she does give almost 2 assignments per week but they are easy to do.
She's the sweetest professor ever and the class feels like a high school class. Only 2 speeches in the semester and she doesn't grade strictly either. Take her if you need your speech credit!
Two speeches during the semester! Not a tough grader. She is very approachable and caring! Definitely would recommend taking her class if you struggle with anxiety, she makes you feel comfortable.
I loved her class! She is super sweet and you can just tell that she loves what she does!
I absolutely LOVE LOVE LOVED Professor Pirkle. She was the sweetest, most generous soul I've ever met and you can tell how much she loves teaching. I would def take a class with her again if I could.

Prof. Pirkle is a super lady! Problem is that the class is easier than high school. I just didnt get my moneys worth. I never set challenges, or that I was even in a college class. Again, shes nice, but I expected/wanted much more. Maybe take the other lady?? Reviews say she can be tough, but Id prefer that, I think.
I love her class. She's a great teacher and she takes the time to know her students. The atmosphere she creates in the classroom is great. She's an easy grader and her exams are not hard at all.

You can tell she really cares about each and every one of her students. She wants everyone to do well, so as long as you give it your best effort, this class is an easy A. Seriously, she's so sweet I want her to be my grandma.

She is very nice and sweet, also just one of the easiest graders. I did not attend any lectures and just completed the homework and projects and received an easy A. Her test answers were also given earlier

She is one of the best professors at UTA. There are weekly discussions and three speeches. She really cares for her students and makes public speaking easy. I did not even realize and I was done with one of the major speeches for class. I would definitely take her again for different class.

An amazing professor, she is so sweet. I took her for business and professional com if you try you will pass and most likely get a good grade. I genuinely enjoyed this class, sometimes it did feel as if we were being assigned busy work and we did do assignments that I wasn't sure how it went along with the class but I did learn from them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Ms. Pirkle is so sweet. It is obvious that she genuinely cares about her students and wants them to succeed. She is so lovely and such an easy grader. I highly recommend this class for an easy A and a lovely professor.
She is really a nice and great professor you wont have any tests or papers in her class it will be breeze and easy. TAKE THIS CLASS ITS REALLY GOOD!!!

UTA GIVE HER A RAISE PLEASE. Honestly easiest professor ever. I have a 108 and I start/turn in the work 1h before its due. Really helps with a hard engineering course load. Give a strong effort and youll revive a strong grade. Also she is such a kind person who wouldnt like her.

Its weird to say, but Ms. Pirkle is a really nice lady, but she needs to have higher expectations! I felt like we were at high school or community college. Her class is so easy that its a joke. Again, shes sweet and funny, I just didnt get my moneys worth :(

Shes seriously such a kind soul. public speaking is hard and no one likes it. She did her best and this is not about her but the nature of the class itself. It can be hard and terrifying to be forced to give multiple speeches to strangers.
this woman is so sweet and cares so much about her students. literally you can put in minimal effort and get a 100 in the class.

She is the sweetest person you will ever meet, she is always so enthusiastic and loves her students. I was nervous at first because im not one to talk infront of a class but she made me feel comfortable and accepted. Her class was by far one of my favorites!!!! Take her you will not regret it

Amazing professor. Highly recommend taking professor Pirkle. She is one of the nicest people i have ever met and will work with you on everything to help you succeed. All her information is backed by years of experience in the work force.

Professor Pirkle is the best most sweetest professor there is!! She is so so sweet and an easy grades, just do all the mini speeches and show up to class and you'll get a 100 with no problem. Very understanding and cares so much about her students. Honestly, this lady deserves the whole world.

No textbook required. Idk how you can fail this class all you need to do is show up, present the speech required (she is so lenient with your grade just fallow the guidelines) and be interactive. Occasional homework I only worked on this class 2h a week and received a 99. Easy A class especially for the pre-meds out there like me. Best PROFESSOR!!!

I LOVE LOVE LOVE professor Pirkle. The absolutely most caring and delightful human being on the planet. Class is literally just a bunch of presentations. Easy A. I honestly went back onto facebook and friended her because she's such a delight to be around. Teaches you a lot about public speaking and how to be more confident and compelling. The best
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Words cannot express how much I love Donna Marie Pirkle. Her Business and Professional Communication class is right up there with my favorites. I learned so much about being a good leader and being a good person in general. Her class is a safe, stress-free environment. Take her if you can!

First of all she insists you call her Donna one on one, and she's the most caring and casual teacher I've had. There's a number of small projects but she hands you an A. The projects are very low effort and she is fascinated by learning new things about the world and her students, so try to be vocal. NO TESTS, extra credit, and wholesome convos.
Love Donna! She's amazing and so laid back! Super understanding, a true gem she is

Professor Pirkle is such a gem. Her class is very easy and she makes sure you're doing well. She's absolutely adorable and willing to listen to your issues. You have two main presentations with mini ones here and there. Very easy to get an A on. Very easy class, nice atmosphere, caring professor. Definitely recommend.
You wont fail even if you try

She is the easiest teacher you will ever have. She is so sweet and kind. At the beginning of the semester, she said that attendance was mandatory and had a sign in-sheet but as the semester goes on, your attendance does not affect your grade. Just show up once every week or so and you will be fine.

Mrs. Pirkle is really nice. She wants you to pass and she is pretty funny at times. She gives out little homework but there are 2 main speeches which are super easy. Honestly the best communications professor i've had. She grades easy and does take attendance but I don't think she'll mind you miss.
I love Mrs. Pirkle

Man this teacher is the best, all I did for most classes was show up and play on my phone the whole time. She does assign speeches which are major grades in her class. She grades very easily but it's important to prepare for your speech. Other than that this class is a free A.

I LOVE THIS PROFESSOR if you're taking speech at UTA it is a mistake to pick anyone other than her. I don't want to call the class an easy A but if you show up and you listen to her guidelines for speeches you'll do great! She is so fun and really does so much to make the students feel comfortable in the class & confident with giving speeches.

Professor Pirkle is an absolutely amazing teacher. She made speech fun and exciting. I have always hated public speaking but she makes you feel comfortable and she allows you to do topics that you love instead of forcing you to do ones. I would absolutely recommend everyone take her. Honestly her class was my favorite class to ever take in college.

The absolute best & sweetest at UTA. I was worried to take a speech class since I have always hated to get up and talk in front of people- but she makes ALL problems and fears disappear. Her powerpoints, lectures, activites, etc. are all fun and engaging. If you need to take this course, you MUST take it with her; I promise you will not regret it!

BEST PROFESSOR EVER. I've had public speaking from early childhood till senior year of highschool. When I got to university, I was worried about taking speech. She made me LOVE speeches and giving presentations. We only had 2 presentations the whole semester, but those 2 speeches changed my life. Bc of her class, I am no longer afraid. She is fun!

This professor reminds me of a sweet grandma that everyone loves. She is so kind and sweet and she will help you as long as you try. She's also very funny and down to earth, I stop fearing public speaking because of her. Love love love her! Take her if you want an easy A.

This has been the most amazing professor I have ever ran into. She is very kind, very understanding and made me not fear presenting. I feel like I evolved into a complete new level through this course. I am more confident, and I feel more kind. If you want a great experience in Speech, this is your teacher. Amazing!
She is an awsome proffesor
She's superrrr caring. Her classes are interesting and is very understanding. She gives you a lot of opportunities to pass and get an A. As long as you show up to class you will get an A.

Professor Pirkle is wonderful! She cares about her students a lot, formats do not really matter when you are giving your speech. She only cares about how much effort you put in. She makes you enjoy talking because she enjoys listening. Attendance is extra credit too! Take her for a fun and easy A class!
She is a real gem of UTA . She approaches a speech class the way it is supposed to. No tests or exams, you have to just attend classes and implement the material taught in class for your speeches.

Very sweet and down to earth. Gives good feedback. Primarily 2-3 speeches throughout the semester and a few in-class debates so show up to class. Also a few homeworks and journal entries but she reminds you in class. Come to class, pay attention, put some effort and get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE this professor ! She is caring, sweet , passionate about what she does and hilarious. Never in my 4 years of undergrad have I been so anxious to go to class and participate, especially in public speaking ! She makes the class a fun and safe environment to be yourself. Really easy A. Just show up and participate. DEF take AGAIN!

Mrs. Pirkle is great, she is a very sweet lady. Like some have said, her class is a lot of fun. I was really dreading having to take speech but her class was a breeze. She's very laid back and allows for a lot of open discussion on a wide range of topics. You wont regret taking her class.
Very sweet instructor. If you just try and improve yourself in the slightest, you'll receive an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Out of the 4 classes I took this semester, this was BY FAR my favorite. This is the first semester (out of 5) that I was actually excited to go to a morning class. She gives hella extra credit for all kinds of things. Attendance isn't mandatory but she gives extra credit for perfect attendance each month. Also, there aren't any real quizzes so YES!

I absolutely love Mrs. Pirkle and I would take her again if I could. She loves her students and goes really easy on you. She wants you to succeed, and she has such a passion for life. She's one of the sweetest people and gives you lots of extra credit. There is no homework, no reading the book, and no tests or quizzes.

Donna Pirkle is so sweet and really cares about her students. Her Pirkle Circles are definitely interesting and can get heated sometimes. The class was not challenging. I wish I learned a little more, but she does bring real world experience to the table. And she also has some funny work stories!
Her class is easy. I'm also taking two of her other classes!
She's an amazing professor with a funny laidback style and very easy to talk to. Her class isn't a bore and the topics discuss are fun, unique, and interesting.
Awesome professor, engaging course material, 10/10 recommend!

Dr. Schuman is such an extraordinary professor and I honestly got my money's worth taking her class! She makes complex topics very easy! She also structures her classes in a way that fits all kinds of learners! Better at writing papers? Choose to be tested through a paper! Better at taking tests? Choose that option! You learn so much from her!
Prof. Schuman is one of the best professor I've had! She is so caring and understanding! As intimidating people make research sound, she makes it easy! I loved her online class.
Research is scary class but she made the class interesting.  She cares about research and how well you do in her class.  I actually enjoyed this class very much.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Extremely unhelpful professor
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Easy online class. There is a weekly discussion board and quiz which all require the textbooks information. There is also a project that can either be an essay or PowerPoint.

She is a very nice, caring, professor, she replies very quickly to your emails if you have any questions. I took this class as an easy class and it was everything I expected. It does requires you a lot of work, discussion boards every week, with a quiz every week, but they can found online. There is a final project that she helps you prepare for.
She is an awesome instructor and I've taken this for credit and it went well there is an open book test that can be easy for students and if you do everything on time she is gonna give you 100.
Open note tests, super nice but do NOT miss deadlines.

Took the 5 week asynch class this summer and it was fairly simple. As long as you complete the discussion posts on time you will get 100s & test answers are in the textbook/online. She is available for communication and is very straightforward in her criteria. There is one research paper which was an easy A as long as you follow the rubric.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The projects, assignments, and tests are extremely tedious and require A LOT of time. Be prepared to sit for hours reading over the textbook materials and the PowerPoints that offer little to no help on anything. The testing is okay, but only if you have done the hours of studying. It is a summer class, yes, but just expect a huge load of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took this asynch, online, & in summer! Reading textbook is the *only* way to pass tests & participate in discussions. Turn in discussion posts on time & actually try, read chapters as much as possible, & don't procrastinate writing the research paper! Video lectures were *very* slow & mostly unhelpful, maybe she's better in person. Print syllabus!
Her class had only one big assignment (research paper) and the rest was mainly discussion/quizzes over the chapters in the book. She was available for communication.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This professor less explanation and narrowed expectations. Also, she is picky. Even though research paper is cited from textbooks and web-site and concluded, she decided it as a personal opinion that caused deductive points. I felt unfair during taking her class. I don't take her class any ever again.

I have nothing learning from HER because all materials are ready on-line. However, her aspect is really narrowed. It seems she didn't like what I did all the time. I advise to not have your opinion, copy textbook and have the same story difference word all answers.

Draves belongs in an Elementary classroom and not teaching a college course. We frequently had difficult pop quizzes along with boring readings each class. In addition, her teaching demonstrations were horrible and she expected the class to emulate her. However, her standards were too high and was never clear on what expectations she had for us.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took this course as an elective to help my GPA in the summer. There are 4 exams, each one slightly harder then the previous one. weekly posting of two questions from the textbook and replying to another two students weekly. Final paper required, she offers an additional 5 points added to your final grade for visiting the writing center. Easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I took her music 2300 class online as an elective and it was very easy! Their are 4 open book tests, weekly we had to post 2 questions to our discussions board and reply to 2 of our team members, and one assignment a week. Finally, a finals essay! Overall this class was very easy and interesting. Easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class is not bad. Read off of the slides, but he explain things well and shares songs and jokes related to the content (something I've never seen before). There are speaker notes to the ppts so I haven't used the book at all. Few assignments, 1 group project, and quizzes on LDB but not hard. He responds to emails as best as he can and easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Awful. Professor and the university have to know how bad this course is  based on the feedback they've received. They clearly don't care and have no incentive to improve.  Just “grin and bear it”.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He's super chill (but monotone). Had him for OA & Research (in person). He'll need help with the computer sometimes for lecture, but he just reads off the PowerPoint, throws jokes here and there. He's super helpful too. Research is a pain ONLY because of the paper and RAC things (just dive in and hope), but that's just the class, not him. Trust.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS CLASS THE FIRST 8 WEEKS to focus on psych/medsurg finals later. Lecture is boring, but do the participation activity (it counts), then leave. 3 Ozdemirs—HARD and 25% of your grade, so take them seriously. Do knowledge checks with classmates. One big essay—start early! Know APA. He grades tough, so proofread. 4 reflections = easy 100s
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I don't know why he has such a low rating. He's very nice and will answer lots of questions. It's a boring class but he tries his best. RACs and knowledge checks are hard, but do the other assignments and you'll be fine.

I don't know why students hate on him so much. I've had him for both older adults and research. He's super chill from the times I've contacted/spoken to him. He's kinda monotone, but honestly, that's about it. He makes funny comments/jokes during class (uplifts the class a bit), emails back quickly, and he honestly helps if you have him in person.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: For a 5 week course, he really tries to make this course so much harder than it needs to be. We have all taken English courses, so the need for this class really is meaningless. Incredibly condescending tone, instructions so unclear, unrealistic expectations for NURSING students, not a helpful person. Get ready to hate the 5 weeks in this class.
Awesome professor. Caring and nice.

Older adults is VERY BORING with this prof. Very monotone. He has a weekly quiz and discussion board BUT if you attend class and do the participation activity, you don't have to do the discussion board. A lot of us stayed for the participation activity and dipped. Easy class just super boring.

This professor makes every effort to help students do well. This course the most challenging course in the RN-BSN program.this professor offers tips and hints and valuable insights in the weekly TEAMS meetings. He is inspiring, has a great sense of humor, especially in his PowerPoint lectures, and really cares that students do well.

The absolute WORST professor I have ever had by far. So many people talked about how awful this class was and I under estimated their words. This class is terrible. There is little to no direction. So many assignments. Extremely fast paced and nobody knows what's going on. I dont understand how he's still teaching if everyone hates this class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class is SO bad. His Knowledge Checks are written in a way that you can't understand the questions and just hard for no reason. I highly recommend taking this class in the first half of the semester to get it done and over with! Def the worst class of J2.
pick him over hixon. make sure you know APA citations. very picky over citations. attend lecture ;)

Thomas is by far the worst professor I have had in nursing school. Research in itself is not the hardest thing we have come across.. I mean we are nursing students. It is the way he grades with obsessive detail. If you are taking this class just read the assignment instructions very carefully and follow them exactly how it tells you.

Course is poorly structured for BSN RN students. Too much focus on study design, statistics, and critical analysis of research papers but missed the essential of human research. Inadequate course materials, poorly explained videos, and overly stringent grading. Overall, unproductive and frustrating for students.
Rigid class for "obedience" training, rather than enlightening students for future research.

Dombrowsky is a tough grader and he does not care about students. For one assignment we had to create a table and we arent allowed to use quotation marks. He then referred me to community standards for plagiarism and tried to give me a 0 for not using quotation marks. I fought it and won. Another student in my cohort had a similar issue with him.

Research as a class is tough, so you can't blame Dombrowsky for it. Online is way easier. Exams are open book so pretty easy. 3 RACs are the assignments you should prepare to be scared of. Other than the RACs, pretty easy class. Just stay ahead, and communicate with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Attend the weekly Teams meeting with him every Monday. It is the only way I passed. He discuss the assignments and exams. Also gives you hints where to find some answers. If you don't, you may not pass unless you read and memorize the entire textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dombrowsky is an insanely tough grader! He will knock you for any little mistake formatting and citation wise on the final paper and don't even get me started on the RAC's! Do not use coursehero for the RAC's because the majority of the answers are wrong so just try your best to understand them on your own. Best of luck to those who take him!

Class is hard overall, but Dr. Dombrowsky helps students, especially taking some time to go live on Microsoft teams. If you have questions, he timely responds. Just don't hesitate to ask both professor and your coach. Make time to study materials and apply learnings on RAC and knowledge checks. Y'all got this!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Research class is mandatory, but Professor does not want us to pass the course. The direction was unclear, and he deducted points for very tiny things. If I could rate 0, I would do it. Useless!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I did not enjoy the class but it wasn't ridiculously hard. I took online and made it out with a pretty decent grade. Knowledge checks and RACs are difficult and will definitely ding your grade. He allowed open book on knowledge checks this semester, hopefully, this is a regular thing. RACs were ridiculous and the paper was tedious & time-consuming.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is a mess! The RAC and Knowledge Quizzes are extremely hard!!! The questions for these quizzes make ABSOLUTELY no sense!!! The online lectures/reviews he gives post RAC quizzes are NOT helpful at all.  The modules on Canvas are unorganized. Research is a hard class, but this class is designed to make nursing students fail in my opinion.

This class was so boring and long. The assignments were not clear and everyone was failing so he gave back a lot of points by throwing out questions that didn't make sense in the first place. The research paper was not fun to do either. I would not take this class again, even with a different professor, it's terrible.

I can't blame the difficulty completely on the professor. There is no reason for this class to be a 5-week class at the end of a semester where we are having back-to-back psych and medsurg exams. None of his instructions were clear leaving most of the cohort feeling confused and lost. Get ready for the most boring lectures you've ever heard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I've made all As on my nursing courses. This will be my 1st B. The quizzes had unclear/confusing questions. Unorganized format. Lectures were more confusing. Course-load heavy. Very hard grader. So many of my nursing classmates were almost failing, as I was. You don't get feedback to know if your answers were correct or not.Overjoyed that's over
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: class avg for RAC & knowledge checks is always below average. lectures don't help, textbook doesn't make sense, grades unnecessarily hard. by far WORST class i have taken in my life. 1 attempt for every assignment, unlike the previous semesters who have multiple attempts. good luck in this class, you will need it.

This class is horrible and takes away a lot of time from other courses. I wish it was used as a prerequisite course rather than a J2 course. Dr. Dombrowsky seems like a nice person and he responds to emails but he expects entirely too much from already stressed nursing students. Read the book and pray. (NO DIRECT QUOTES ON YOUR EBP ESSAY!!!)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Difficult quizzes specially no chance to learn the right answers so, very hard to improve the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: HORRIBLE! i don't understand why this class is even required for nursing school. ppl say he's helpful answering emails, all i ever got is "read the textbook". RAC & knowledge check is ridiculously hard, the class avg is always below 65. EBP took forever to do. he grades discussion boards easy
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is not that hard, it just requires a lot of time and hard-work which is bad because it takes away from more important classes such as medsurg and mental health. There are two knowledge checks (which are basically exams) and one research paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: I hated this class. Knowledge checks are actually really hard exams. This class is way too fast and hard. He does not grade hard on papers, but the exams are really hard. Always C or F averages.

Not sure how people do well with the discussions and papers but when it comes down to the quizzes , most are failing. You cannot see what you get wrong on them either. Unfortunately this is a mandatory class, my worst nursing class so far.
I am still in the process of this class, but I will say, I have never made such bad grades in ANY nursing class. I just pray that I pass.
Very monotone, geeks out about research and expects students to spend countless hours on assignments. No consideration for discussion even an hour late. Tough grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was by far the most fast paced and painful class of nursing school this far. The professor is terribly disorganized, RAC quizzes are subjective (with too many select all choices), and knowledge checks clearly dont have enough time allotted. What made this class worse was our coach J.D who never responded in a timely manner or at all.

This is arguably the toughest class in the second semester courses at UTA. It wouldn't be so bad if it was a semester long. The textbook has 13 chapters and you have an exam over the first 8 chapters after only two weeks. Knowledge checks can be pretty tricky. Put in a lot of effort of the projects and assignments and you can make an A or B.

Not gonna lie, this class is insanely fast. Follow his reading worksheets and you can do well on the knowledge checks. The article critiques were a little harder for me because it is very subjective. He is really nice, he just breathes really heavy over the microphone haha. Research and Psychiatrics are the hardest J2 courses IMO...

Dr. Dombrowsky is a great professor, yes research is hard and very time consuming but he is a good teacher. I dont think he grades that tough, also he is very accessible outside of class hours and his responses are very helpful. Study the worksheets, follow the rubric for the paper, and dont slack and youll do great

This is a 7 week course, so a lot of work really fast! It is definitely possible to make an A though. Make sure to read before Knowledge Check's (Exams) and you can do well. Prof. Dombrowsky himself is pretty chill. He is not a hard grader to be honest. I think people who have a hard time just don't do the reading. You can do it! :)
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This class should not be a 5 week class. There is too much information to retain. I feel I'm just trying to pass and not able to apply the material in real life. The tests and the RAC's seem to be purposely worded odd and vague. No feed back so you are not sure what you're not understanding. This was the only nursing class I think is terrible.

700 pgs to read a week (minimum). 2 assignments extremely difficult with reading done both worth a total of 30% of grade. No extra credit. All instructors teaching this course do not show what answers you got wrong, so no room for improvement. Do not slack. No study groups were allowed they did not want collusion. I would look for another professor
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: NEVer EVEr take this class with him. He is such a horrible teacher. He posts a video about lectures that won't make sense and does not have a transcript and you are listening to boring videos that will not help you in the test. Tests are so difficult .you have to relate definitions with the scenario. If wish it was not mandatory class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are really boring. He will cancel class right before it starts but he uploads everything on canvas. He allows a cheat sheet on exams and the review covers literally everything so just fill that out and you will get at least a B
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Make sure you study, there is a lot to memorize. Super funny, good at answering questions/emails, solid lectures. Just beware of the sheer amount of information you need to know for tests (there's normally a curve though!).
This professor's lectures are very boring, but he allows a cheat sheet for the tests. He drops the lowest test grade and curves all the tests.

I liked his class! Lectures can be boring, but his midterms were very fair. He allowed my class a cheat sheet of notes, which definitely helped a lot and he curves! You don't need the textbook at all. Just look at PowerPoints for review. My only complaint is that he does not upload grades to canvas and emails your midterm grade. Shouldn't do that.

Majority grade is Exams. Labs is super easy, exams are a bit difficult, so study the slides. extra credit for attending more than 90% of lectures. drops lowest exam grade. good class, just get ready to study for exams.
Great class, professor made the boring things very interesting. 10/10 recommend.

This class is fairly easy. But it relies on just exam scores and your lab grade. The lab is super easy and exams are not hard if you study the lecture slides. He curves the exam scores too. However, he often posts lecture slides late.
He's a pretty cool guy, very attentive, and approachable. If your looking for a science credit with barely any math and is more memorization based, take this class.

Probably the easiest course I've ever had, studied the Powerpoint slides the night before and managed to get A's and B's on all the exams. Just study the material he tells you to review and you'll do fine. Lab's not hard either just do the work and it's an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Not the best professor to take when looking for an easy science credit... He fails to posts powerpoints and reviews ON TIME. Lectures are not exciting to me considering that half the time, I couldn't fully understand him even though I sat towards the front. The only positive thing is that he provides a small extra credit for attendance and curves.

Wasn't that difficult. Has 5 tests with your worst score dropped at the end. and attendance is extra credit. He posts reviews, but they don't correlate very well. If you read the book you'll pass. He's really nice though and tries to make the class fun by making jokes here and there.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Only made up of 5-6 tests. He drops lowest test score and generally curves each exam. If you attend class, he curves your overall averaged test score by 5 points. He takes forever to grade tests and is almost unreachable outside of class. Teaches off a power point thats confusing and review doesnt help with exams. Never used the book.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He's a good prof, requires the textbook but you don't need it because info on test is just found on his slides. Does sometimes fail to post slides on time so you'll need to remind him. Attending class gives you extra credit near end of semester. Sometimes funny, lovely accent. No hw, 5 tests, drops worst. Be sure to pay attention in class!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Shows up late to class 90% of the time. His lectures are long and never completely covered in 50min, and never posts them for review like he SAYS he will. He doesn't post test grades, just emails them sporadically. The class is memorization from power points, but that's if he actually posts them so take good notes. 10/10 won't take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Attendance in Hunt's class is only extra credit via a sign in sheet, don't try to sign in and leave as he'll notice and call you out. Book isn't mandatory but needed to really understand whats going on. He lectures from bell to bell and gives 5 tests throughout the year. One test will be dropped, Final isn't cumulative and Scantrons are provided.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This guy is really fun but the subject is pretty boring. The exams didn't seem to cover exactly what the review had on it. I believe we just had very little time to cover everything enough to get really high scores on the exams.

He is not as easy as some reviews says that he is. You have to memorize over 40 slides for the test and the review he gives rarely helps. He has a quirky sense of humor and he tries to make the class enjoyable. I took him in the summer, only five tests, one gets dropped but they are difficult! Ready the PowerPoints slides AND the photos.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: For the most part easy class. Only the first 2 tests are hard then the rest 3 are easy. He also drops 1 test. I made an A in the class even though I failed the first two tests. Tests are multiple choice with only 3 choices.  Also gives a huge curve on all his tests. Lectures are very boring but you don't have to come to class since he posts online.

While Dr. Hunt is a funny man, his lectures can be quite boring if you aren't interested in the subject. Thankfully, he does post his powerpoint online before each test. Overall, his tests are not too difficult, and he gives reviews before each test. Dr. Hunt is extremely generous with his curves as well. It's an easy A. Take it!

Dr. Hunt is a great professor who makes class entertaining. He is knowledgeable about the material and offers extra credit for perfect attendance. He does assign homework online, but it is super easy. Reading the book helps, but he offers reviews for the tests that are self explanatory. Show up to lecture, take notes, study, and do the reviews.

DO NOT TAKE DR. HUNT. He assigns hours worth of homework just a day or two before it's due. His reviews are NOTHING like the tests, so you'd better memorize all 40 powerpoint slides if you want to pass the tests. His tests are very unnecessarily difficult. My friends who took other professors couldn't believe how hard the tests are for this class.

Easy class for those people that need science credit. Gives reviews before test and expect super easy online HW. 5 test, and lowest one gets dropped. Yes, lectures are boring but perfect attendance guarantees you and extra credit of half letter grade. Sometimes funny , and chill professor. Other than that, take the class for easy a. Lab are easy.

Love this guy! Classes are funny, the material is all available online. Gives reviews, grades on a curve AND drops 1 test grade. Did I mention his exams are only 30 questions with 3 choices per question. No textbook. Would totally take again.

His lectures are basically pointless in my opinion. I went to class because you got extra credit for showing up but I never really paid attention. He gives you a "review" of keywords and concepts  which will get you a decent enough grade on the tests if you study them. I found the class kinda pointless.

His tests are not easy like some reviews on here lead you to believe. You have to memorize over 40 PowerPoint slides for each test. He asks very specific questions on the tests. Dr. Wickham lectured for our class a couple of times and his lectures were much less detailed and were way easier to understand.  I would not recommend Dr. Hunt's class.

4 exams, 1 final, lowest test grade dropped (including final). Exams are 30 MC questions, VERY straightforward & simple. He gives you what topics to study for on exams. Recorded powerpoint lectures (ppts available online, uploaded late). Book not necessary. Extra credit if present for every class. Super easy and chill class. TAKE HIM. EASY 100 :)
