I really don't understand why Dr. Wickham has a lower rate than Hunt, I have heard from other professors that Wickham is way better. This class is so tough, I literally struggled this whole semester throughout this class. He can be funny sometimes but overall super tough. Wouldn't take him if at all possible.
He is funny, but his tests are tough. Had to teach myself most of the material

His test are very straight forward, if you show up to class then you can easily make A's on test. He also curves his test. No homework in class and lab does help for lectures. Show up for all classes then gives you extra credit.
No homework, or quizzes. Tests are mostly memorization, but it is a lot of information to process.
Easy class, all power points online. 5 tests and 1 gets dropped at the end of the semester.

The grade was 75% class, 25% lab, lowest grade dropped. I got an A after starting the semester failing 1st test. Gave extra credit for attendance. I thought he was hilarious. It was nice he posted powerpoints & lectures. No need for the book. Too bad he isn't teaching 1302 in fall. The lab wasn't terrible. Opportunity for extra credit there too.

He's a British dude and he reminded me of John Oliver. 5 tests, one is dropped. 75% class, 25% lab. Great guy. Doesn't take well to questions, but he's clearly messing around. Highly recommended! His personality is fun enough to want to go to lectures. The study-guide bullet points will help you pass the tests.

Pretty straight forward. Drops a grade, 5% bonus for perfect attendance and 25% of grade is lab. Easy A. The test are tough but he curves them. If you don't want the 5% then don't go to class. Just look at the review.

Give curves on grades. Very nice teacher and cares about what you make. Didn't use the textbook. Attendance mandatory. He was very nice and if you study the power points you will pass. Every test had a curve!

The first two exams were a killer, but the rest are pretty easy. He does give a curve to all his exams. In order to pass his exams, you have to HAVE TO study his powerpoints. One of the things that I loved about this class is that he provides extra credit points by just attending all his classes. Also, he drops the lowest exam grade.

There are zero assignments there are just 5 tests.  The first two were extremely hard and the class grades showed.  He curves the grades so that helps then the next tests he gave you a study guide and made the tests easier.  Tough course I think but he is a pretty good professor.  He posts all his lecture slide online but he does take attendance.

Pretty interesting guy, but his lectures are long and his tests are based on the lectures. If you pay attention to the powerpoints and memorize them, you'll do fine on the tests. He says you need the book, but you really don't. If you go to class every day for the entire semester, he gives you extra credit.

Extremely nice, and really helpful. The tests are really easy, just read the powerpoints (reading the book helps too) and memorize some important concepts and you'll be fine. It's really easy to pass the class

Really nice guy. I can tell he really wants his students to learn. He makes getting an A easy if you just try. Even if you are failing, he gives you plenty of chances. You must really not care about your gpa if you let yourself fail.

Did not crack open the book at all, just study the power point slides like crazy. Memorize it all because on some test he will ask detailed questions like location of something and on other test he will ask general questions. Just study the slides and attend class. He is also funny and extremely nice.
Attendance is a Must! Study the power points like Crazy and you will get an A. I personally dint use the book. An approchable Proffessor

Dr. Hunt is a really nice guy, he makes an effort to be available to students with questions and will answer your questions. His tests are very reasonable as long as you study. I truly enjoy this class. It is once a week though, so it can get tiring to sit for 3 hours. However, he keeps class interesting.

Nice guy, makes an effort to make exams easy..gives you a list of stuff to review the class period before the test. Lectures are sooooo boring tho! Hard to stay awake. He repeats every single thing out of the book.Dreadful. Go to every single class and he will raise your grade by half a letter point. Extra credit will raise it by half a letter too.

Nice, kind of funny guy, but painfully boring. Attendance isn't mandatory, but you can earn half a letter grade by attending class everyday. Lectures are based entirely on the book. It's hard to stay interested because he sighs or yawns mid-sentence.
Professor Hansz knows the material very well but the class structure was so short making the course very hard to complete the assignments, readings, and study for quizzes and test.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You will have to teach yourself everything. Obviously, it is a fast-paced course, but the workload is insane. I've taken 5-week courses and this has been the most difficult/big workload. You also do a group project and most likely will have to meet with your team outside of class. Only five grades.

If you take this course in the 5-week session be prepared to teach yourself all of the material. He reads a lot from the material he has prepared. You have to do a very involved project that takes away from learning "Real estate finance" Very tough grader, quizzes are very difficult for the amount of material you actually learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment:
Professor Milson is so so sweet! He cares a lot about his students understanding his subject and works hard at teaching the best way he could.
Attendance is not mandatory, but lack of attendance could result in you missing a pop quiz. 
Pop quizzes are also easy as long as you attend class.
Group project is simple and an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Participation is a grade and attendance is a part of that. Exams cover mostly the lecture notes and some questions from the textbook. Excellent professor
He is one of the most relaxed and understanding professors I have ever encountered.  The rules of law are on the syllabus they are clearly laid out so that you are successful.

I loved his class, he's such a sweet guy and doesn't want anyone to fail. There is a group project but it's not hard. I would recommend him, no matter what class you take of his. Attendance isn't mandatory, but keeping Attendance will let you skip the final.
I cannot recommend this professor enough, he keeps you engaged, cares about, and works with his students. Definitely take this course!

Best teacher! Really cares. Just come to class and take notes and occasionally have quizzes. We had no tests, just a major project that we worked on throughout the semester (which he graded very easily). He is always there if you need help

TAKE Dr. Milson you will not regret it. I have taken him for two classes GEOG3334/GEOG3310. He does not overload on assignments or quizzes. You have to read and participate, but as long as you do that you will get an A. He cares for his students inside and outside of class. He is always available and helps. Dr. Milson is a great professor. Very organized, interesting and relates class material to current topics. Encourages participation. This is the 2nd class I have taken w/ Dr. Milson. I love him bc you can tell he is passionate about GEOG and answers any questions you have. Great professor!

He's the sweetest professor ever. Super super easy class its just taking notes and studying them for the test. If you miss class, get the notes somehow bc the test is just like the notes. The three mini essays were extremely easy 100's. He's so caring and genuine its impossible to hate him. Pay attention and you'll get an easy A

Dr. Milson has an easy going lecture style. His Grading criteria is easy to understand. I have taken him for three classes and have done fine with a moderate amount of work. You need to attend class regularly but missing a few is not a problem.
Very knowledgeable professor with a clear outline for his class. If you go to class and listen to his lectures you will get an easy A!

Really great at communicating with students. Students have to participate too. You have to read for this class but the reading is not that difficult but make sure not to get behind since his tests are based off of the readings.

reviews.comment: Professor Milson was among my favorite professors. Youd be lucky to get him!

Dr. Milson is a great professor. He is funny, nerdy, and very much cares about each of his students. He responds to emails promptly, has study guides for all tests, and will curve a test if needed. I loved his Human Geography class and will try to take Dr. Milson again if possible. The final is optional if you have good attendance. 100% recommend!

Funny, gets to know your name and speaks to you personally when needed. He really knows his field and is passionate about it. Essay exams in a Blue Book, small group discussions once or twice a week, grades very quickly and he's very responsive. All around good teacher.

I loved Dr. Milson's class. He is funny and easy going but does expect you to participate in class. He seems to really care what you think about the issues being discussed. You will have essay questions for your tests but just pay attention, do the readings, show up to class, and you will be fine.

reviews.comment: Dr. Milson makes discussions during his classes, which are way more entertaining than a regular lecture. Attendance and participation is really what you need to pass, but being involved would require you to read. Easily my favorite professor.

Dr. Milson is an awesome professor! Read the assigned readings, find something important, and raise your hand and speak. reviews.comment: If your like me you always check here before choosing a professor... look no further because this is definitely the professor you want. Workload and gradings are fair. Professor makes this class as stress free as possible. Took every class he offered at the school.

Man Professor Milson's class was great. He was funny, easy and quite flexible with grading. No tests at all. Just outlines a big project in which he split up into 3 sections, then he'd give you feedback on those sections. Just really show up to class because participation DOES count. Definitely take his class for Human Geography. It's worth it.

He made the class very entertaining and insightful. Attendance is required and the book is required. Reading is required before each class and i would make notes on what you read. Wish i had more classes i needed to take with him for my major.

A really great professor! Gives us a chance to earn a really high grade. Read the chapter, prepare to say a sentence in class, and there's your "A"! reviews.comment: Attendance and participation are mandatory to pass. Lectures are solely based on participation. He's a great teacher who cares about his topic. Easy class just show up and answer some questions and you'll pass. Boring class but he's great at what he does

I loved this class! You read a lot from the textbook, but its interesting. The class is set like a seminar so you read the chapter and come and talk about it, i really enjoyed it, much better than doing a power point
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I have Taken Dr. Milson for two semesters and he is by far the best professor that I have ever had. I have attended three colleges over my 191 college credit career and he is the only professor too keep me interested every single lecture. He is also very educated about other subjects besides the geography classes he teaches. Best professor TAKE HIM

Perfect Attendance  No final.  3 Essays (you prepare for it and write in class) 10 Pop-quizzes (So easy) Participation required (you need to put your hand up and discuss about topic at least 1 time a week/ attendance and participation grade is 30% of total)  If you don't get at least B in this class, you don't belong to college.

Milson was a great professor, he is more than willing to help if you want to clarify any of the topics. The top things to know before taking this class, you HAVE TO READ and be prepared to participate. The quizzes are super easy, just memorize the summaries from the assigned chapters and talk about it during class, you'll get an A (TAKE HIM)

There is no final if you achieve perfect attendance for whole semester. There are 4 essay exams  which you prepare for it and write in class during regular class hours. There are 10 pop-quizzes during the semester but those are so easy if you just memorize the short 23 sentences from summaries of the textbook. U really need textbook though.

Dr. Milson was very kind and helpful! I only took this class for the credit, but I really enjoyed it. This class was based on discussion, so make sure you attend and contribute. Very nice professor, graded essays very generously too.

Great professor, super smart, willing to help. If you make valid arguments in your papers, his grading for it is really good. Fun discussions in class, and waives your final exam if you attend all classes. He also gives extra credit for a free absence. Very swell professor.

Dr. Milson is very clear with the information he teaches and is very willing to make changes to help his students. The only downside is that the online book is necessary and the online quizzes can be long. Overall, he's great!

Dr. Milson is very knowledgeable and is willing to make changes in class to meet the needs of his students. Attendance isn't necessary, but it's very helpful. His powerpoints are online, but aren't detailed since he explains in class. The only downside is that it's necessary to buy the online book.
Very good class, there is five essay exams and 10 online quizzes and five map quizzes which is easy if you memorize the countries. I would definitely recommend.

He is hard to follow in lectures but you will have lectures from a different professor available in the class. Those lectures are the ones to use. If you already have a decent understanding of physics this class is great being online. Only issue is the quizzes which are timed 15 minutes for 5 questions. There are moments you can tell he was great

This professor suffers from a medical condition which is not his fault but it does make him very irritable & rude. He has no patience and at times where he is at fault, he points blame at students. His lecture/notes are impossible to follow. Some of the worst power points I have seen. But due to it being an online class, it was very easy to pass.

Pretty easy online class. You don't learn much from the lectures, so I just taught myself. The homework and quizzes are easy. The tests are hard and very tricky so that you lose the max. amount of points for mistakes. The lab portion was also easy, all online PHET labs.
I do not recommend taking Physics 1443 online. I feel like I did not receive a great understand because of it, but I got an A so that cool.

He talks really, really slow. Watch the lectures and study for the weekly quizzes and the class is easy. Midterms aren't hard if you know your formulas. He's ridiculously boring and shows sports clips for half the class so don't bother joining class and just watch the online versions of the lectures, it's the same slides.

Professor is very passionate about physics, but this is the truth. The professor is getting old. He has health problems, which makes him talk slow which lecture boring. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROF.

reviews.comment: Took for Spring 2020. Professor Brandt is genuinely one of the worst lecture's I've ever seen, he talks and moves like he's in permanent slow motion and teaches entirely off of an ineffective PowerPoint. Despite this, Professor Brandt is very lenient with grading and tests. I learned nothing but made a B easily, definitely would take again.

He gives you three exams and drops the lowest with your homework grade. The final I took was fair and the way the test is set up guarantees that you always have a chance to pass. The only downside was the Kahoot quizzes that the TA would have at random days so make sure to show up to class if you don't want a 0. I was satisfied with his class.

I can't stand that this class is taught through slides. I need to see it being written down for me to understand. There's a lot of homework, but I hate ExpertTA. If you don't know how to do the problem, it gives you hints, but they don't really help. Also, expect pop quizzes here and there.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Brandt is the worst professor I've ever had the misfortune of taking. Lectures are poorly planned, exams are poorly planned, never writes on the board. He has tenure so he does not care about how he teaches the class, he just reads off slides only mumbling numbers. This is not how Physics is to be taught, that too a general course.

He loves teaching and is hilarious. He would answer your questions and gives good feedback. Lectures are easy to follow and not very confusing. Just do your basic study and you'll be fine. I would take him again!

This professor is one of the professors which I recommend everyone not to take. He never shows up in class and expects his students to do better. I'd better thank his TA instead of this professor. This is ridiculous that I did mistake by taking his class. Wish I could get my time and money back.

For some reason, his TA mostly taught the class (Michael Greene), but he is there occasionally. His lectures are easy to follow and understand with the help of the textbook. Homework was tough (we used Mastering Physics) and did not help. The tests themselves are easy. His class curves a lot too.

I would avoid Dr. Brandt if I could. His lectures are ineffective and poorly planned, which is something he himself acknowledges and even jokes about. He's incapable of giving a coherent lecture. It is essential to have a textbook for this class if you want to pass. If the textbook is terrible as well, buy another textbook immediately! Do not wait.

Lectures can sometimes be easy to follow, and other times the material is very dense. The only way to pass this course with an A, is to read the book carefully, several times. Understand the examples within the text, and buy another textbook.  The tests are never rigorous, however, to do well, you must show every step explicitly.

As far as Modern Physics goes, this class was extremely easy. Prof Brandt does his best to be fair and is an easy grader when it comes to tests & HW. There are pop quizzes, so go to class. Do the HW, it's helpful. He is always 10 minutes late. Such a nice guy, good sense of humor if you're paying attention.

Let me be clear: Dr. Brandt is very nice and he tries to help. However, he does not explain things in a clear, organized, and linear way such that difficult material is in reach of many students. Most of what I have learned has been from reading the textbook; if you take this professor, you need to be able to teach yourself to some extent.

Take him. This was a very easy class. Just do the homework, go to class, and do well in lab. I'll admit, this was a very stressful class. He rarely came to class on time and wasnt always prepared for lecture.  He gave huge curves though! I didnt learn much from lecture. But sometimes he gave extra points for going to class.
Such a nice guy, seems to really care about students.   Quirky/awesome sense of humor.  The material is not easy but he does what he can to help you understand and does curve tests occasionally.
Super intelligent, very helpful prof. Ask him questions. Tests are sometimes curved, homework can be tricky, but his class is very enjoyable. He is out of town semi-often for conferences.
Very smart guy, go to lectures and ask questions and you will be fine. The homework can sometimes be tricky, but he will help you if you ask. Interesting lectures

He is a little to smart to teach an intro level corse. He is a research prof. so he only teaches one class a semester, so not the best at lecture. However, he is fair on the tests, gives large curves and really does care about the student.   I would take him again.

He often appears lost during lectures, making it difficult to follow his guidance. The critiques he provides feel arbitrary and unhelpful, and he reacts defensively when students disagree. Additionally, his constant interruptions while I'm working, asking repetitive questions, are distracting and hinder my focus.

Summer course. He is very unorganized. Half the time does not know what he is doing. Long lectures and examples that he himself does not fully understand. Critiques are insanely long. Moody, if he comes in upset he will be irritable the whole class. If he does not agree with something he will stop the class and argue out loud with you. DONT TAKE

reviews.comment: Andrew Ortiz is a good of a Professor. His class is a bit unorthodox, mixing advanced students with beginners. As a beginner, I enjoyed the ability to pick the brains of my advanced peers. The class is pretty typical of a photoshop based course-4 main projects. Andy cares. He helps. He shares his own struggles as an artist. If you grow he notices
He's an amazing human being, super caring and helpful. critiques are good as well.

If you don't know Photoshop, good luck. He did show examples, but did not very well. He did bully you w your grades. He wasn't very good at answering q's; he would answer it, but if you didn't understand and ask it another way or another time he would get mad. He would make the whole class notice if you were late to class. OK teacher. Little mean.
Class is very easy and simple. He also has a fun personality

Andy is as people have been saying a little unorganized, but the guy is really easy to work with. He will help you with whatever you have a question about. I would suggest buddying up with someone in this class, and that'll make things a lot easier for you.

had him for intermediate photography. he does not explain assignments very well and is extremely slow at using photoshop. lectures are long and boring and very uninteresting, if photography is your main focus, I highly recommend avoiding him if at all possible.
He is not organized and i don't work well with that kind of instuction. A sweet man who is very funny and kind.
Critiques are long and boring.
No Comments

Pay attention and ask questions Dr. Dubay explains well, and I highly recommend going to his lectures because they're truly helpful, even though attendance isn't mandatory. Go to his office hours too! He goes over things you're confused about and explains what you get wrong. The exams are easy, and the homework is barely anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor is good. I mostly skipped his classes and still made an A. His lectures are simple and he answers all your doubts in class or office hours. His grade is based on homeworks, practice exams and actual exams. His exams are very simple. Just do your homework (additional non graded ones too), the exams are literally just that.
very nice, has good teaching style (to me) willing to answer questions during and after class
Dr.DuBay is the best teacher I've had, he really makes the bridge between student and teacher seem non existent. He is so accessible and actually has a desire for teaching. IF U CAN PICK HIM

BEST PROFESSOR EVER!! I wish that I could have him for 1442! He is very engaged with the content, and explains it very well! I was scared of this class, and he took all of that fear away! Your grade is just made of tests and 10 question weekly homeworks, so spend your time studying, and you will do AMAZING!!

Such a great lecturer! There was no attendance taken and the only assignments were biweekly homework that had unlimited attempts. There are practice exams before every exam. He is great during his office hours and will explain to you what you got wrong on exams.

amazing guy. he is very understanding and you can tell he actually wants his students to do well. bio 1441 is not an easy class itself but he makes it manageable. attend lectures, take notes, DO YOUR PRACTICE HOMEWORKS, quiz yourself over lecture slides and you will be fine on exams.
Great guy, he is so cool
Dr. Dubay is so incredibly kind and fun. He works hard to make sure you understand the subjects. He's also an incredibly nice grader. Just go to lecture and take your tests and you'll be golden.

One of the best profs at UTA, really understanding and caring. Easy A, 5 quizzes, final project, final exam, and lab make up your grade. Prof Dubay really cares about his students, he will go out of his way to help you, just show up to class or watch Echo360 videos, put in minimal effort and you will make an A.

Class was very straight forward and format was designed to make you learn. Exams were short answer, which I preferred because it tested your ability to retain information and actually learn. Lectures and slideshows were interesting and he was a very good lecturer. The slideshows provided you with the material you needed to pass the class.

Dubay is a cool dude - totally approachable and encourages in class discussion. I avoided going to class because I get anxious but I was able to learn online. If you look for that in class, take him! I will say I was close to an A, but he didn't bump me up. I'm not even mad about it - just make sure you put in the work during the semester.

Dr. Dubay was great; grading was based off of 2 exams and 1 final project with an optional final. His exams were free response, but all of the questions were very easy to get and were ones that you would def get right if you attended or listened to his lectures. Lab wasn't as smooth purely bc of the outdoor component, but it also wasn't hard

Dr. Dubay was a fantastic lecturer. He is very good at explaining concepts and is always willing to help. The exams are all short answer, but if you learn the content from the ppts, they are very straightforward. There are 2 midterms & an optional final exam. Textbook not necessary; the ppts have all the info you'll need. Attendance not mandatory.

Extremely easy and nice professor. You do 2 mid-terms, final project, and an OPTIONAL final exam. Tests are unfortunately all free response questions, but are super straight forward and he gives a lot of room for answers. Everything is found in slides and you don't have to go to class, as it is recorded and slides are on Canvas. Would take again.

Not an easy A at all, but worth it if you're disciplined and willing to put in the work. Expect him to be very direct with his feedback, not repeat himself much, and expect high-quality work/craftsmanship. Take lots of notes and don't take anything he says to heart. He's passionate about architecture, and there's plenty of wisdom in his words.

consistent favoritism in class. Some students get praised for incomplete work while others face harsh critique. Terms “sexy” are used inappropriately. One student gets long feedback while others wait. dismissive comments, very biased environment. students were divided into Group A passing and Group B failing students. DO NOT TAKE!

Very architectural-focused and follows strict design principles. He knows exactly what he's looking for, which can make it feel like he has favorites. Doesn't show much sympathy, but if you meet his standards, you'll do well. Be prepared for tough critiques and a structured approach.

I am an interior design student he's very architectural based. His plan does come out to look good at the end of semester however, his class is not for the weak. Definitely has a specific vision and follows a specific design principles. Sometimes you will feel your has favorites, but he just really likes a certain type of his design
Just don't take him you won't be able to learn much anyway.

reviews.comment: This professor has a huge ego and doesn't care about his students at all. He used the f word on one of my projects. The problem with UTA is that even if you report these people they face absolutely no accountability
Not very inspiring and super passive aggressive towards the students
Do not recommend
He can crush your spirits and any passion you have for this field of study. Beware

reviews.comment: I took him for my first semester, he was a hard grader, and honestly a lot of the time frustrating but he was clear on what he wanted for each project as well as the deadlines. There is no way of passing if you don't show up to class and put in the work. However, I think if you put in the effort, you can learn a lot from him as far as craftsmanship

To be challenged in a class is one thing but to be challenged and unmotivated is another. Dustin doesn't seem to offer much encouragement or support for his architecture students. Every time I wanted to chat with him about the feedback on my model, Dustin never seemed willing to help me do better on the next one.
Not very organized, criteria tends to be unclear/inconsistent. No syllabus for the whole semester.

reviews.comment: He cusses at you and belittles your ideas
Professor Wheat is good at explaining the work that needs to be done. Expect harsh criticism.

He always gave you great feedback on your drawings and wants you to work with him and other students to keep improving yourself, He was always very polite and very helpful. always enroll asap because his class fills up quickly. He describes what he's looking for in each assignment very well so you always know what you're doing. Take his class.

Was very unsure about going into this class seeing the reviews, but honestly Professor Wheat isn't bad at all as long as you do the work, ask for feedback and take that feedback to heart. I recommend this class if you're passionate about architecture and looking to build a strong foundation.

If you like to challenge yourself he will be great fit. However, his criticism does not help you improve your lack of knowledge he critics very bluntly without any advise and expects for you know things. If you personally go up to him for help he does not guide you for improvement.
Gives good feedback as to what he's looking for, as long as he sees improvement in your drawings you'll pass. I wouldn't say he is a hard grader but just make sure to listen to his critiques.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Wheat is the best professor that i have taken for studio so far! You can tell that he is passionate about architecture and really cares about his students and watching them succeed. He really makes you work for your grade but as long as you take his critiques into consideration you will do great.

Took him once for Design Comm 1 in 2018, I will never take him again. His grading for the course is based off of your peers. What he deems the best is the top grade then graded everyone else based on that person. This gave those with drawing experience automatic As and left those with non completely out of luck. No feedback on how to get better.

It's just bad teaching, I'm not going to tell you why, it's just bad teaching. THAT is the type of feedback to expect from Wheat. Perhaps those who can do shouldn't always teach. I failed to do my research and just signed up for Wheat because that is who everyone on campus raves about. But they are not raving about his teaching. Research!

Dont believe all these reviews of praise. You will only get anywhere with him if youre one of his favorites or somone he likes, other than that expect no feedback. Very vague on projects and contradicts himself after youve turned it in. Very rude man who enjoys being on a power trip and terrorizing students rather than being a role model
Best of the best

You will regret it if you never take wheat at least once in your education career. He's very inspirational and gives great advice. He gives you a lot of freedom in projects but still strict guidelines. He explained his assignments so well that we felt bad for not asking questions but what was there to ask!! I wish all professors were like him.

I took wheat for my first studio, he is defintitely the professor who can teach the most, although his class was rigorous and he is a tough grader and hard critiques. I received an A in the class, and you can too if you work hard and are motivated. Super inspirational, and makes you work for it. Take him!

I switched over to architecture after trying out engineering at UTA. My first true studio was with Wheat, and boy did he fire up a passion for architecture in me! He has trouble, sometimes, conveying what he wants from a project but you CAN understand what he is getting at. Granted, the things that are taught in studio are tough to comprehend.

EASILY the best studio I have ever had, and will ever have. If you don't take Wheat at least once, I feel sorry for you because you're missing out. I don't know why all profs can't be like him. He's just a great guy, very knowledgeable, helpful, and personable. Just talk to him, he'll help you out. Not an easy grader though, but for your own good.
He was great! I would take his class again

Professor Wheat is a great Architecture Professor in UTA. You must take this Professor at least once. He is a great freshman teacher that pushes  the student to do the best and improve. I learned a lot from him and improved my drawing so much. He also teaches sophomore, junior and graduate studios.
Wheat is a great teacher, very calm and knows his onion. Learning a lot in his class so far.

Prof Wheat Great guy. If you show interest in your work then he will be happy to help you out. We had one student in my class that doesn't go to class that often half worked the project and Wheat didn't even evaluate it. There goes to show if you put effort in your work then you will do fine the the class.

Wheat is a great professor. He will help with your work as long as you show interest in the work. If you have a question on the grading or just a question on how to do something he will answer it, but the way he answers it is by having you answer it yourself.  I've gone from getting c's to getting a A's-A's+ on the last few drawings

If you are looking to be in Architecture for what it really is instead of this lie where professors tell you that you will actually be drawing in Architecture in the real world, do not take Wheats's class. First off, you do not have to be a good drawer to be an architect. I have worked at a firm for 5 months now no one knows how to draw. Worhtless.

Wheat recognizes hard work and creativity. He is good at building confidence in your drawing and letting you take chances and explore unlike some other arch. professors.. overall he is a fantastic drawing professor, i recommend him over any other professor for architecture year 1.

Wheat is actually a really nice dude. He seems pretty intimidating, & can be at times, but overall I thought he was great. He can sometimes be vague in explaining what he wants, although what he wants is specific. He's glad to answer any question. I'd take him over Lee.
Very helpful, passionate about what he teaches, and assignments are fun. The projects sometimes got to be too much at once, but overall was easy to complete.

He is a good prof in the school of archi standards.The workload is always overwhelming no matter who you take and the assignments very vague.In general,to make it in archi,at UTA at least,you should be prepared to have no life,no job but still be able to pay for your material (middle class to rich).Keep in mind archi used to be an elite  profession

Great professor. I would highly recommend taking him, especially if he is teaching 2551 or 2552. You will work hard for your grade, but if you are looking for an easy way out you should probably not be in the school of architecture. He is passionate about drawing as well as architecture.

Mr. Wheat is a good choice. Workload is heavy but not unrealistic. If you manage your time you won't have to pull all nighters. He is vague to an extent. He's there to guide you through your project not do it for you. You can't coast and fool him. He sees how much effort you put in your projects and will appreciate hard work!
Very knowlegable professor.  Will call you out on anything so be prepared.  Very willing to help but has an extremely large work load. You must live in studio to make an A.
I enjoyed him, found him to be a good professor. I find that most people that don't like him just weren't committed.
No Bueno!!!

Good: Professor Wheat lectures passionately about architecture. He is open to new ideas in deisgn, as long as you can back your concept up. Bad: Work load was too much! Only one student finished the final in my section.  Overal:Wheat would be perfect if he were to cut back on some work, not all.
She explained each concept very well and often reviewed before each exam.  Alongside, she is very funny and answered questions from students when needed.  She also rounded my 89.6% to an A.

Very clear in her lectures, often stops to answer questions, and helps prepare for midterms and finals. You'll often hear that Calc 2 is the hardest calculus you'll take. That is true. She's pretty quick paced which I appreciate since I don't have much attention span. Labs were unnecessarily hard and you'll get all the information in the lectures.

This was an amazing experience for what is probably the most difficult math course. Professor Banawa is very good at explaining topics and working through practice problems, ensuring that the class is following along. She is also really nice, incredibly smart, and she dedicates herself to helping her students learn.

While his course seems interesting, he's soft-spoken and has an accent, making him hard to understand. He veers on slides and lingers on chapters, with handwriting that's also unclear, but he tries to help when asked
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Currently taking this class for Summer and he definitely cares about his students! Always open to answering questions and explaining any problems. Genuinely wants his students to succeed.

Going to class doesn't help, his teaching and accent is hard to understand. Thankfully attendance is not necessary so I recommend going home and going over the powerpoints. A lot of extra credit opportunities, which help alot! exams and quizzes are open notes. Total of 3 homework assignments, 2 group projects, 12 quizzes and 3 exams.

I had a difficult time with this professor. While he puts in effort, he was often corrected by students and struggled with time management—spending most of the class on the first slide, then rushing through the rest. His accent also made lectures hard to follow. I ended up having to teach myself and would not recommend this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He wasn't THAT bad, he was just quiet, bland, and hard to understand. He's not rude, but he's not the most welcoming professor when it comes to helping you. If you can take someone else I would, but if you want a challenge then go for it. The tests are easier because it's open note, but he doesn't really teach so your notes might not help.

Didn't enjoy. The professor was quiet, confusing, rude, and uncaring.. People expressed their grievances about his teaching style to me, and the general class consensus was that we were clueless about what to do. The tests and quizzes were high stakes, open book/ open note. You will be teaching yourself, and even that didn't work for me. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great instructor. Shows concern for students. Gives chances for extra credit and prepared to devote more time to complex topics. Well-prepared for lectures and knowledgeable about course material. Quick to respond to questions through Teams. 3 dept. open-note tests, including a cumulative final; study PowerPoints, study guides, and class examples.

He didn't speak loud enough, likely to give students unclear answers about hw questions through emails even though he replies fast. He gave extra credit. He was mad at me when I asked him a question about HW just because he talked about it in class before on the day I didn't go to class and refused to give me any instructions.

Kind of hard to understand at times, but if you keep up and don't lose focus then its easy. He gives out hand outs for each chapter and the tests are identical to the reviews. Attendance is not mandatory, but is extra credit if you attend. Homework is a bit tedious but very doable. For an upper level finance course, he makes it great. Take him.

He is a great professor and cares very much about your success. If you show up to class YOU WILL DO WELL. He may be a little quiet and have an accent but it is definitely worth it to take his class. A great grade is very easily attainable if you try. Take his class.
Very boring lectures, but tests are open note. If you take him, please remember to use the finance tutors!

I was very nervous to take this class bc everyone said it was difficult. However, Prof. Du is an awesome teacher. He makes sure to clearly explain the material. The exams are open notes. You can tell he really cares about his students & wants to make sure we all pass. He is always in a good mood. I would definitely take him again.

an online class: class is thru percentile or if your grade is higher than ur percentile, they'll take the higher of the two. the class is thru modules so just take notes and do the example problems with them. the exams were open everything which was helpful on tests. as long as you have good notes to take with you on the test, you'll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Took him as online course but the test is in person on campus. Since UTA changed the head dept of finance, the test is now open book, open notes, and you can use your laptop for the test! Clear grading criteria but learning the stuff would still be tedious and take up a good chunk of time and effort. Take good notes and the test should be a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The only reason I passed this class was because of the grading by percentiles. The tests aren't multiple choice, and they're mostly math. The lectures are boring and all he really did was read off of the slides, he wasn't that helpful either when it came to questions on the material.
Attendance is mandatory . His lectures are very boring and the extra credit is actually counted against you in your final grade. If you try to ask for help he just refers you to the finance tutors.

Average teacher who reads off powerpoint slides the whole time, test is extremely hard! Best bet would be to try aim around the average grades for the test (which are usually 50) and you should pass since the class is based on percentile. Get ready to learn the materials on your own since the only advice he will give you is to attend tutoring.

Counts attendance, lectures are crazy boring, exams are not multiple choice, does not care about his students. Every time I ask him a question he tells me to ask the tutors... its like he either doesn't want to help or doesn't know how to help. But at least you get a notecard for the exams and he does give extra credit. Just try not to take him.
His classes are very hard and boring, and he counts attendance so you do have to attend. His exams are super hard and not multiple choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE! literally the worse professor i have ever had and the first professor to ever failed me. his attendance policy is dumb and if you miss a class its 5 points off your total grade?? his exams are hard and not multiple choice. he gives out homework every week. he does not care about your grade and if you pass or fail at all.
He really cares for his students and does help out. It's not his fault the exams are departmental and tough. Compared to all other finance professors, he is the best option you have got.

You can tell this professor cares about his students. Its really a shame that he does not make his own exams, that would make the class a breeze in my opinion. He is always available for questions and comments, overall a really nice guy. Someone just needs to make the FINA tests non-departamental again, its not his fault the tests are so hard

Theirs a homework and discussion for each chapter. Their is 3 exams, the questions from exams come from the review, study review and practice questions and exam will be easy. Didn't do so good on 1st exam because I didn't study but 2nd exam went over review and practice questions and got an A. Overall explains the material well and goes into detail

Dr. Du is great. Always accessible and is willing to help you until you really understand the concepts. Majority of the grade is make up of exams, with potential for extra credit, and a few homework assignments
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class requires lots of time for homework and studying for exams. Homework due every week, a score of 85 or greater required for all homework. Homework takes a few hours to complete. Class is departmentalized, therefore, professors do not know what will be on exams. Professor Du is great at answering questions, feedback and guidance.

He's passionate and cares about student's succeeding. Available outside of class if you need extra help. Homework prepares you for exams. Extra credit available. Bonus questions available on exams. Posts lecture notes. Read them, do the homework & extra credit & you'll do fine.

Can't give him a hard time because this class is departamental so he has no control. He's really nice & caring and will help you if you need. He'll try to provide as much extra resources he can to study but only as much as they allow him to. He doesnt make exams, dept does, but he's good at guiding you as much as he can. READ BOOK READ pract exams!

One of the worst FINA professors at UTA. Monotone voice, tough grader, and just doesn't convey the material to his students. No matter the class is empty a week after it starts and is full on test day. I would not recommend taking this professor at all.

Hes a really nice guy, but he doesnt teach anything he tests over. Questions are pulled straight from the textbook so you have to read. I would never have gone to class, but its worth 5% of the overall grade. The final is worth 40% and theres two exams worth 30% but he drops one. The homework is worth a total of 25% and takes a while to finish.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There are 6 homework assignments, 3 exams, and a comprehensive final. You'll do well on exams as long as you study his notes, and do the homework assignments. His notes summarize the material very well but practice the calculations. This is not a difficult course and he makes it even easier by providing reviews and notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: He is a really nice professor and provides his own notes. FINA 3313 is standardized so the department creates the exams and they are taken through MyFinance Lab just like the homework. The percentile grading system is also from the department. All you can do is study the homework and concepts for the exams which are hard.

His class is so boring and it makes you not want to go to class. He takes random attendance which counts as 5% of grade. He gives hw and chapter exercises due before the end of semester. His exams are easy but he does not teach you stuff that is on the exam. You have to self teach for the exam, but its based on hw related questions. Study quizlets!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Overal Du is a nice guy. As it gets to the end of the semester this becomes harder. Tests and hw are ridiculously hard and TOO MUCH TIME CONSUMING. Even you can have a note card still you get 50% I grantee you, It's ridiculous to use just one small note card for final, which covers chp 1 to 13. Do not take this class if you have another choice.

I heard they changed whole finance classes since fall 2018. After taking this class I changed my finance major. This class is an introduction to Fina but they made it so hard. Each HW took me A WHOLE day to finish. 2 exam plus comprehensive final. you can have one index card note for exams which is NOT enough. Avg class for first exam 60% second 56
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: WARNING Uta has decided to make this class departmental so all other ratings that were given for Finance 3313 before Fall 2018 are now irrelevant since they have changed the whole structure of the class. This class is now extremely hard. Long homework assignments every week that take up to 2-3 hours. Tests are just as hard. Everything now online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He's an easy and friendly professor. If you don't understand anything, freely to ask him. The test now is done on mylab system, and it's similar to the homework of each chapter. Make sure you complete all the homework, it helps a lot.

The lectures were very boring and comes from word docs projected on the whiteboard while simultaneously writing on. The Chinese accent made it very difficult for me understand. On the bright side; exams are heavily based on the lecture notes which the instructor provides in great detail and goes over. The grading is straight forward as are exams.

Super friendly and understanding professor. It seems all his finance classes have similar structures, so if you like listening to lectures and answering questions on word doc, this prof is for you. Easy work but it's just time-consuming. DON'T procrastinate on the homework project, it does take quite a few days to complete. I highly recommend!!!!!!

Professor Du is a great & genuine person. He is very knowledgable & good at explaining any questions you may have. I would strongly recommend taking him as the work may seem abundant but it's very easy, & doable w/out a textbook. If you really do it w/out finding answers first, you'll get an A. if you didn't it's a B. Con: his classes are late

This class was easier than i thought we only had 2 tests and he dropped the lowest of those plus a mandatory final. The test come exactly from the homework just different numbers. He takes random attendance. Also we had a finance tutorial and homework project due at the end of the semester very easy just a lot of busy work. Super nice guy!!
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Would take again

reviews.comment: There is a huge language barrier. You can't understand what he says 95% of the time. You do have to self-teach yourself the whole semester for the same reason. His tests are like the HW so you don't really need his reviews nor go to class. If you understand the HW you'll pass the class. Oh and he drops the lowest test grade.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests? Not many--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Easy teacher, make sure you stay on top of the homeworks and the homework projects! He responds to email quickly and exams are almost like the homework!

Homework is time consuming but not difficult. Do the homework and look over the review and you'll Du fine ;) As others have said, his lectures are pretty dry but you can skip them all, show up for the tests, and easily get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Taking him for the second time because I like his teaching style and he makes it possible for everyone in the class to get an A. You learn stuff, but also, the exams are easy enough, and he gives bonus points on them. Also drops lowest exam grade (not including final). Take him; he's best.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Taken over the Summer, and he made it as easy as possible. Test were very similar to homework, he taught how to solve problems in class, and while I did use the book to better understand, most people never opened it, so save your money. Drops lowest exam grade, but no curves. He does give bonus questions on exams, so that helps. Recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Pretty good guy, and doesn't mind answering questions. Very helpful, and gives homework very similar to exams. Definitely recommend him. You will learn, and you can for sure get an A if you put in some studying time.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Amazing lecturer who loves what he's doing. I actually am very lazy and skip class a lot. Only 2 midterm exams (drop lowest) and 1 mandatory Final. 3 Homework that's due before each exam dates. Test are mostly from HW so make sure you know to do the HW, then you'll get at least 90 on the exam. He also gives extra credit and curves the final grade.

Excellent professor! I take all the classes that he teaches and I passed them all. His classes are easy to understand, and the exams are not hard if you do your homework well. 80% of the questions are from the homework he gives. Just go to class and do your job and you well be fine!

Professor Du can do absolutely no wrong. If I could take him for every class, I absolutely would. His lectures are very easy to understand, and he drops the lowest test grade. Final is mandatory but he prepares you for it like no other. Professor Du has given me a reason to come to class. I would 110% recommend him and his great teaching habits.

3 tests including final(90% comes from HWs), 3 HWs (85% easily googable, ask 4 help 4 hard Qs), 1 easy finance tutorial (can be done last minute).He added an easy semester long project, keep up with it tho as its quite long. The guy does try and is very easy to talk to and will compromise. Requires effort, mostly time, but a borderline easy A class
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is not easy to understand or pay attention to. Lectures are boring. He provides a good review before each test. Read the book and do the homework and you'll be fine. Half a week before final grades were posted, I sent him an email with a question regarding my grade on the semester project. He never responded.

Didn't use the book at all. Tests are similar to homework he assigns so if you understand the HW and read over study notes he provides, you'll be fine. You have the whole semester to complete a HW project and finance tutorial which is an easy 20% of your grade. Nice guy who clearly has knowledge in finance but just has a hard time communicating it.

Professor Yibing is a very nice professor, but he is very HARD to understand. His method of teaching the class was confusing. I constantly got lost when he was writing on the board. He has 2 multiple choice exam and drops the lowest. The final is multiple choice. A lot of homework, financial tutorial, hw project.

Professor Du was  a really nice guy, but he was really hard for me to understand. He talks very fast while he goes through things on the board, and I get lost quite frequently. I had to teach myself a lot of the material, but his grading structure is made to help off set your test grades if you do bad.
Easy A. Two exams and one final exam. Will drop lowest exam. Exam questions are same on homework. Homework is a full load but easy to do or search up. Totally would recommend for a GPA booster.

Class is very easy. There are only two exams (midterm and comprehensive final), but they are short (40 questions), easy, multiple choice, and exactly like the homework. He is always energetic and happy to be in class. Very likeable, but sometimes difficult to understand his English. Great professor, would recommend. No textbook, either.

He is a very good professor, very friendly, will always spend extra time to answer your questions and try to help you. Sometimes he can not really explain things very well but you can tell that he is a very knowledge person. He will let you have extra points if you dare to ask for it. He made the exam very similar to the HW. You can tell he cares.
really hard class, don't take, I wish I took someone else!! AVOID, you need to read alot to just barley get by

Great lectures, I took really good notes in his class that relates directly to his exams and homework. He's very clear about his expectorations and offers his help through out the semester. simply brilliant and I will for sure take him again!
Mr. Du's ability to lecture and convey information needs work. For the most part the information and concepts are straight forward. I learned more from reading the book than I ever did in lecture.
He knows what he is talking about but struggles a bit as this was his first semester. Good overall grading system.

he does his best to deliver a clear lecture. The subject itself isn't so easy, so basically students need to study. If you do the HW, understand the problems, ask for help if you need it, you will be golden! I'm taking him again!

I rarely went to class because the lectures were boring. He speaks softly and has enough of an accent to make understanding him difficult. Also writes very small on the board so sit in the front. Four hws, a midterm, and a final. The tests come directly from the hw, most of which is online. Just changes numbers for problems on the test.

He is a new teacher so his teaching style is not developed yet. The language barrier can be a problem at times. I could only follow along in class if I had the book out during class. Doesn't follow slides. 1 Midterm 1 final. The homework's are basically the Exams. He's smart, but has trouble conveying his knowledge, so lectures are confusing.
He got u frfr
yessirrrrrrr

reviews.comment: Terrific professor! Guaranteed A+ . Easy course load and they made the overall class very fun .
good professor

He is a very funny guy who always say you look like or a such a bro joke . Funny guy and he so nice please get him has a professor sweet funny and cool good personality. His class is every interesting and I would take it again overall I had a blast
Prof. Duong is a great educator who gives great lectures and maintains a professional attitude.He is very helpful in explaining the material and he's great to talk to.
this proffesor is amazing and professional.He always spends time to help me solve the problems and explain my questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Duong is a really great professor. I enjoy learning in his class and its one of the best classes I've ever taken in my life quite frankly... You must take Professor Duong. What are you waiting for? Go sign up right now before its too late!! What are u still reading this for gooooooooo!!!!

The coolest student prof I've met so far: he's funny, caring, and always spares sometime for your questions. Despite being shortsighted, bad with copilot, can't play online game, and often slow in replying msg... I really enjoyed his teaching. Tests are manageable as long as you pay attention. I would definitely take his class again.

Professor Duong is a nice, sweet, and caring person. Very impressive, especially for a student-professor, he wants you to succeed in both his classroom, as well as in the real world. He takes Statistics and apply it to a real-world setting. Tests are fairly easy if you actually practice and study, he provides a review as well.
Made the class easier to understand and is very understanding!
He is a super patient and nice person. Fills the needs for students and never failed to let me down once. I would 100% have him again!!
It is really hard to miss a question when he is a supper, easy grader.

Professor Duong is nice, but sometimes he can be a bit strict, only because he wants the best out of you. As long as you put in forth the effort and he sees that, you'll do fine. Not bad for a student professor. Good lectures, no bullshit. Exams can be both easy and hard at the same time, so make sure you actually study. I would take him again.
chill
Great.
Jeremy is a great undergrad professor. Explains concepts very well, always has time to answer questions and he keeps lectures fun and engaging. Highly recommend him for a Mathematics Professor.
Jeremy is a great undergrad professor. Can explain concepts very well, always has time to answer questions about the material and keeps lectures fun and engaging. Highly recommend.

He's a great professor, considering the fact that he's only an undergrad student. He knows the material well inside and out. Statistics is a very hard subject in general, but he makes sure that you fully understand it and does care about your success. Will go out of his way to help you. Come to class!
cool

By far one of the best math student professor at UTA. He's only a student, but he can definitely teach because he knows his stuff very well! He really cares about his students and will do whatever it takes for them to succeed! Highly recommend. Tests can be a little bit tricky if you don't practice, but it's math after all!
This is the first year teaching in the UTA. Great prof. Quizzes are open book. A lot of group projects. Do assignments on time.

One of the best professors I have ever had! Really chill with work and was very understanding. Don't take her kindness as an advantage. Did have group projects but with a good team, it can be very easy. A couple of quizzes and papers, but not much that can't be handled. Overall a memorable professor.

She was new so there were a few kinks to work out, but overall a great prof. She was personable, and flexible when it came to the course schedule. She was clear with grading and easy to work with. This class was fairly easy, just get ready for projects.

She was an amazing professor and I really enjoyed her course material. Everyone else whining/complaining about her probably never showed up to class -_-

This course was one of the best I've taken! Everything learned is relevant in the real world. Definitely recommend! She was very understanding and kind!

DO NOT TAKE PROFESSOR DUSTIN HER CLASS IS HORRIBLE AND IT IS NOT STRUCTURED RIGHT EITHER ITS A MESS SHE LOADS ASSIGNMENTS UP AT THE LAST MINUTE AND EXPECT YOU TO GET IT DONE A FEW DAYS LATER THAT IS CRAZY AND INCONSIDERATE!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The sweetest professor youll ever have. She made it fun, was very caring, and always asked us how we were doing (which I appreciate and Im sure others do too). Her hard work and generosity does not go unnoticed. Definitely 10/10 recommend any of her classes.

She was very ready to end classes early because she had a long day. I'm not sure that's a good thing. She made the topic seem really easy and I kind of feel cheated. Overall she is very understanding of issues that come up, but is probably too hands off. Share the book with someone. Do what little work she gives you & you'll do fine. She is okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Harp is incredible. She is hilarious and she has not forgot what it feels like to be a student. She is understanding and lenient. She has a clear syllabus and will sometimes change things if she feels we need a break or if it was too much. I have fun in all of the classes I've taken with her. She also writes amazing recommendation letters.

I really loves this class,it taught me a lot about the field of journalism. Dr Harp is very helpful explaining assignments. Often we would have days off to work on assignments   Very lenient on grading!

She's the guru when it comes to qualitative communications and anything gender related. She's respected in the field and genuinely interested in the topic and helping her students succeed. We always got way off topic but it made for really interesting discussions and has been one of my favorite classes because of the dialogue.

I've had a few classes with Dr. Harp and enjoyed them all. She is supportive and doesn't have weird grading criteria like some of the other journalism profs (not naming names). This class had a lot of assignments, but my writing improved because of it. Definitely go to her office hours and ask about her research if you're interested in journalism.

I love Dr. Harp She is the best professor I ever had. Her classes actually help and relate to this century. She's funny and understanding. Not too hard but definitely have to put in some work to complete the writing assignments. Love her focus on marginalized communities. Need more professors and journalists like her.

Harp made this class fun and easy. She'd rather have a class discussion than lecture from the textbook. There is a lot of in-class work, but it's easy to get a good grade so long as you're there to do it. This was my first 4000 level course and it was a breeze.

She is by far the most understanding professor in FA! Gives really good instructions, the work load is heavy but its her way of teaching you better writing. Easy going personality and very approachable.Take this class if you don't mind a good teacher! How wel you do on your assignments and attendance make or break your grade.

A very understanding professor. This was one of my first 4000-level classes, and she made it REALLY easy for us. Yes, there is a lot of writing. Yes, there is a lot of reporter work. But, seriously? You can't go wrong with a professor that's willing to give you days off of class for interviews.

Harp is a great teacher because she is passionate about the subject. The course load is heavy, a lot of writing in her class. Attendance is mandatory and she takes off a lot of points for it. You can have an A on all of your work and your percentage will be an F if too many classes are missed. Regardless, I would still recommend her.

Teacher is nice and laid back but is unpredictible with assignments, excpects a lot because she came from UT Austin. Has actually worked as a Journalist. Does not explain what she is looking for very well.

Professor Durna is one of the best professors I have had so far! Fun lectures, quick & easy assignments, & easy participation questions she'll plant throughout her lectures! Tests are doable if you read the textbook. The short answers in the test require details from the textbook, & she'll give possible short answer questions. TAKE THIS CLASS!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Assignments help out your grade a lot. Takes long on grading.

Professor Durna is one of the best professor I have this semester! Assignments are pretty straightforward to complete! Tests are alright, but if you prepare well, there should be no reason to fail the tests. Grades take awhile to be put in, but if you ask, shell give an update!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Durna really listens to students and makes sure she is doing everything to help us learn. Attendance is mandatory because there are short quizzes during class time but we had the option to be online or in-person bc of covid. The book helps a ton with assignments and studying. Tests are multiple-choice questions with 3 short answer questions on LDB.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Kim is one of the nicest professors I have had considering I transferred in this semester. He grades to help students do well and he gives good advice outside of class. Lectures are also very informative.

Dr. Kim is a solid professor who cares that students understand concepts being taught. The biggest thing I judge in a prof is their willingness to delay teaching new concepts when it is clear the whole class is confused. Dr. Kim does just that. Overall, I gave him a 4 because his lectures are sometimes ambiguous without any prior knowledge.

I've had Kim for Micro-controllers and for Discrete Signals. For Micro he was mind numbing just reading from slides but he had very nice review lectures the day before exams/quizzes. Unlike most professors though he actually has listened to students feedback and started doing a lot more worked out examples in class. He has become a lot better.

I personally liked Dr. Kim. Hes a very straightforward professor, and isnt trying to play tricks on anybody. Doing the homework problems in the textbook will benefit you immensely on quizzes and tests. Lectures are recorded and he provides his notes that he wrote in class on Canvas. Beware that the class does get more difficult towards the end.
Boring Lecturer. Test moderately difficult but he does curve at the end of the the class. Attendance not required. You do not have to show up to class to pass.

AWFUL professor. Please DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME! Absolutely mind numbing professor, just reads from the slides word for word, with ZERO explanations. Quizzes and tests are easy at first, but get extremely difficult towards the end of the semester. If you have another choice, it would benefit you to avoid him.
It felt like it wasn't necessary to attend lectures at all as he mostly just read straight from the powerpoints that he uploaded for the class. The class wasn't too hard though.

I appreciate project-based courses, and due to COVID-19 this course was transformed into something almost entirely based on HW and projects. The project and HW assignments are challenging, but I'm genuinely proud of what I created because of it. You will have to put in a lot of work on your own, but Dr. Smith will definitely help you along the way.

Dr. Smith was a fantastic lecturer. He can be blunt at times, calling you out on things you should know, but his lectures are engaging and he is a brilliant man. He is very helpful, but be prepared to put the work in and learn

Avoid for freshman level classes, invaluable resource for later classes. Really cares about students who put in hard work. Understands that textbooks are expensive and provides many alternative resources.
Easy professor. Need to attend all class, it will be easier to pass this class. He really cares about his students.

He structured his class in such a way that made it very very difficult to get a good grade.  It was a "freshman" level course and in my class we had seniors that ended up having to drop it.  Out of 40 people over 25 had to drop.  I do not recommend this professor.

This professor is out of his mind. He expects students to do a project that covers the entire material of the course in one week during Thanksgiving break. There are no exams, except for the final. There are only open ended projects (there is no right answer). He should not be allowed to teach.
No all nighters all semester!!! The most fun hands on projects EVER!!!
LEARND ALOT FROM HER, IF YOU ARE A HARD WORKED SHE WILL HELP YOU. ALL NIGHTERS LIKE WITH ANY ARCHITECTURE STUDIO.
No Comments

Mr Williams is well meaning, but the guy cannot teach for crap. Will often go on tangents during lectures, and reviews were not sufficient enough for the associated tests. reviews.comment: NEVER TAKE HIM
Worst Professor I have ever taken. He just doesnt know how to teach math. Trust me, I love Math. But he made me hate Math.

This Professor was a nice cool guy,But he does not know how to teach math. It was better if he was a history professor as he he is very good at explaining definitions. Math is not about defining terms its about working problems which he never did that. I say its a very tough class.
Very sporadic, and will go on tangents in lectures. Reviews he posts have almost no correlation to the Test, but not necessarily a bad person.

Mr. William 2 is a great professor. A chicken is a better professor. He's super helpful if you visit him in his office hours. He's never in his office. He's got a create way to explaining hard things. He uses chicken in his examples too often. I hope this was informative! He's okay.

reviews.comment: Dwight Williams II is a really good professor. He takes time to make the subject interesting and provides practical applications. reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I totally agreed with the previous rater.

Such an amazing professor! Definitely take him if you get the chance. His lectures are interesting and engaging. He explains the material very well. He is never boring. The exams match the lectures. He gives clear information about what will be on the exams. He offers extra credit and bonus quizzes that help your grade.

A + P is a fairly tough class, but he made sure that he went over everything that we needed to know for the tests. Gave us some clever ways to remember things and added his own experience and stories where appropriate. You will still have to study outside of class to do well, but often we'd get to leave early once he finished lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Parks wants you to learn and understand your material, so he is a non-BS professor. However, his lectures are funny and there are so many chances for extra credits through pop quizzes and review lectures. For the exams, make flashcards off the slides and I promise you're set. He's wonderful professor who's caring and makes micro fun!

Best professor I have ever had! Honestly its the course itself that is difficult, but Dr. Parks does an absolute amazing job at explaining everything. He makes it clear that what he has on his power points is what will be on the exam, he also provides the textbook. He gives so many opportunities for extra credit, but be sure to come to class? 10/10

Park's lectures are very fast-paced and information-heavy. The exams are difficult as there is so much content, however, he gives you so many opportunities for extra credit. If you study before each class and keep up with the workload you will be fine. This was one of the hardest classes I have taken for nursing so far.

AMAZING prof, interesting lectures, the only option to consider for this course. There is SO much material you need to cover, but that's just the way the course is designed. As a nursing student who hasn't taken patho/pharm but has taken everything else, this was my hardest science class byfar. That being said, he is the best and only option.

reviews.comment: Dylan Parks is literally and Awesome professor. Finished taking him for 5 week course but although fast paced was a good experience. Note that the slides are your friends aid in both exam and quizzes. Good luck!

reviews.comment: An amazing professor who truly cares for his students!
As long as you do your work and study for both the lab and the lecture you'll be fine.

reviews.comment: Offers extra credit and there is no homework. Make sure to attend class because he offers extra credit and pop quizzes for extra points on exams. Although his lectures are long, the exams are mainly based off the slides so make sure to study those.

Dr. Parks cares about the success of his students. His lectures are interesting and he gives exam reviews. The pop-quizzes do not count toward your grades, they are more for extra credit points for exams. The textbook utilized is online for free.

Dr. Parks is really caring about his students' success. Don't get me wrong bc the class material is very difficult and you will have to study a lot. If you're struggling with something, just talk to him bc he's very understanding. Definitely attempt the extra credits bc they'll boost your grade. STUDY, STUDY, STUDY!!

Extremely intelligent; teaching style-very engaging. Brings a lightheartedness to this content rich course that helps it resonate & very understandable. He genuinely wants his students to get the most out of his class & truly comprehend the material in order to succeed. He surmounted his role as a professor, wish I could have him again!

Professor Parks is one of the best instructor. I have taken BIOL 2460 online. I was scared due to past experiences of science classes in UTA but he proved me wrong. I would prefer everyone to choose him. His lectures are so informative. He cares for his students. Extra credit and curve points are the plus. Thank you.

You can tell from the first day that he actually cares about the students. He gave us extra credit often, but don't ask for it! He rewards the class for effort, so just make sure you put effort into studying and he may give the class some points. He's a great lecturer and has no problem answering questions. I highly recommend him!

An amazing professor who gives interesting lectures. If you put in the effort and study his slides, quizzes and watch his lectures you will do fine. He also gives extra credit points which can make a big difference in your grade.

I took this class during 5 week summer and it was intense but Dr Parks is an amazing microbiology professor He gives clear expectations and does review sessions before test to give you hints on what to study for He sometimes does curve depending on how the class is doing but he truly does try everything to help you pass the class.I would recommend

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Parks! He made me understand microbiology. He's very kind to talk to, he curves test grades sometimes (if he can see the class is working for it), and gives lots of extra credit. Take him, you won't be sorry.

By far one of the best teachers you'll take as a nursing student when completing your sciences. Although this course was easy, you NEED to put in the work like watching lectures and taking notes. Course is exam heavy; however, he does drop the lowest exam grade. He does also provide a curve at times and will go over exams if you ask.

Really good professor at UTA. If you study hard and put in effort he will acknowledge that. Gives curves on test. Tests are pretty easy if you study hard for them. Get ready to read a lot and take lots of notes.

Professor Parks is really great professor and will tell you what is going to be on the tests. He even does extra credit, grade curves, drops the lowest exam grade, and an exam review before any test. reviews.comment: Dr. Parks is one of my favorite professors at UTA. He goes in-depth on his lecture and makes sure you know what will be on exams. All he does is read off slides and does not know how to grade correctly using canvas. Would highly reccommend taking this course at a community college. Also, for lab beware of the TA's and the lab report some grade easier than others.

reviews.comment: Sort of let down. Took this wanting to know more about e-mktg. But, as INSY class, it's more about tech side of e-comm, and mostly rehash of network and db classes I already had. So, if you're IS major that's had those, it's easy. If not, prepare to struggle and study. Prof is nice, but soft-spoken and dull. Lots of chances for EC, though.

His lectures can be quite boring, but his class is easy overall. The tests and quizzes are based on the power-points he presents during class which are available on blackboard. He gives you a review too prior to each exam.

If your an INSY major, then it's an easy A or B.  If you are any other major I would avoid this professor.  Not prepared and has no idea what he is teaching.  Course consists of 3 major tests, 5 quizzes and 5 surprise quizzes for EC.  If a professor has to google search most of his terms on his power point then he might not consider teaching it.

It must be his first time teaching. He was always nervous. Doesn't know the material he is teaching. He would have terms on his powerpoints that he didn't know and would google it and say "Yeah, that's the one" His 'review' is basically him saying study the book. Gives student incorrect information. Some people shouldn't teach. Wouldn't recommend

He has a organized coursework for his courses.
I personally liked it.
If you listened to his class, u will probably get an A.

I had prior coding experience which made it easy but beginners shouldn't expect to struggle. He's monotone but his lectures and the info he gives is great. Tough class, the quizzes have no relation with the PowerPoint and recorded lecture. The tests have no relation to do with distributed system. He never cares about the lecture, students, and what you can learn from this lecture. The TA randomly gave you scores on your HW w/o respect. He made this class very difficult. Easy class, the quizzes are from the PowerPoint and recorded lecture. The tests which are worth more are directly from the quizzes. He goes over sample problems similar to the labs.
